title: Processing Technician - 2nd Shift, Amazon Leo
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Leo is Amazon’s low Earth orbit satellite network. Our mission is to deliver fast, reliable internet connectivity to customers beyond the reach of existing networks. From individual households to schools, hospitals, businesses, and government agencies, Amazon Leo will serve people and organizations operating in locations without reliable connectivity.

Export Control Requirement: Due to applicable export control laws and regulations, candidates must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.

Candidates must be 18 years or older with the ability to understand and adhere to all job requirements and safety guidelines.

Key job responsibilities
- Primarily second-shift, but shift schedule may vary depending on production/processing/launch schedules
- Can apply a deep understanding of a broad range of tools, equipment, and handling machinery to accomplish your daily tasks effectively and efficiently
- Upholds all safety requirements in all zones and work locations of responsibility
- Assists in the development of new and junior team members and adheres to standards and procedures
- Independently execute and prioritize work to meet production schedules
- Integration and test of the Kuiper satellite and various complex sub-assemblies in a clean-room and Electrostatic Discharge (ESD) controlled environment
- Rigging and critical lifts of bulky, sensitive flight hardware
- Able to obtain and maintain licenses, operator permits, and/or certifications as required
- Use precision calibrated tools – torque wrenches, multi-meters, optical inspection devices, micrometers and calipers
- Read and interpret engineering drawings and technical documentation
- Perform work according to procedures, specifications, and test instructions
- Run functional and environmental testing on units, including some basic troubleshooting operations
- Use computer software programs for controlling tests
- Check and inspect your work after completion to ensure engineering and quality standards are met per the drawing and work instruction requirements
- Collaborate with manufacturing engineers to develop and document activities, including continuous improvement opportunities
- Perform other duties, as assigned, to ensure an efficient, safe and effective work environment
- Willing to work overtime and weekends as required
- Shift schedule will vary, depending on production/launch schedules
- Must be willing and able to perform extended travel up to 25% annually, either domestically or internationally as business needs demand

A day in the life
The Processing Technician will lead work to ensure junior technicians complete tasks and ensure procedures are adhered to and work is completed during quality and operations on flight hardware integration processes. This position requires skill and experience in a variety of areas, including mechanical assembly, propellant loading, rigging, electrical checkouts and satellite troubleshooting. In short, you will be responsible for a majority of the most critical tasks to process & integrate the Kuiper satellite for launch, ensuring high quality, workmanship and safety standards are adhered to on a daily basis.

About the team
Here at Amazon, we embrace our differences. We are committed to furthering our culture of inclusion. Amazon has ten employee-led affinity groups, reaching 40,000 employees in over 190 chapters globally. We have innovative benefit offerings, and host annual and ongoing learning experiences. Amazon’s culture of inclusion is reinforced within our 16 Leadership Principles, which remind team members to seek diverse perspectives, learn and be curious, and earn trust.

At Amazon, our mission is to be the most customer-centric company on Earth. To get there, we need exceptionally talented, bright and driven people. We're dedicated to supporting new team members. Our team has a broad mix of experience levels and Amazon tenures, and we’re building an environment that celebrates knowledge sharing and mentorship.

Basic qualifications

- High school or equivalent diploma
- 2+ years of experience in mechanical or electrical hardware assembly, test, and/or installation
- Able to obtain and maintain a US Passport & must meet customs entry requirements to include but not limited to: Yellow Fever vaccine and other immunization requirements as recommended by the U.S. Centers for Disease Control and Prevention
- Ability to pass Kennedy Space Center background checks

Preferred qualifications

- Experience in a fast paced, dynamic organization
- Experience in a fast-paced, high-tech company, or experience completing complex tasks quickly with little to no guidance and react with appropriate urgency to situations that require a quick turnaround
- Ability to work effectively in a team environment
- Experience in aerospace, automotive, medical device, aviation, military or other high-reliability operating environments
- Experience working with Foreign Object Debris (FOD), ESD sensitive hardware, and in a clean room
- Experience with forklifts, cranes, rigging, and heavy equipment (including previous certifications)
- A demonstrated ability in reading/understanding technical drawings, work instructions and standard operating procedures
- Ability to use multiple types of precision measuring instruments
- Able to stand for long periods of time and perform repetitive assembly operations
- Able to climb ladders, work in tight spaces, bending, grasping, sitting, pulling, pushing, stooping, and stretching may be required to perform the functions of this position
- Able to lift at least 25 lbs. unassisted

title: Software Development Engineer II, Programming Foundations (ASBX)
descriptionHtml:
Are you a software engineer who thinks deeply about what it means to ship high quality code with confidence: not just your own code, but code written by AI, across the whole company? Amazon Software Builder Experience (ASBX) is hiring for a unique role: you'll be joining the team that owns Amazon's core testing platforms, and have a voice in setting the direction for AI-native software development at scale. You'll have a direct impact: helping create the future of human-guided, self-validating agentic coding for tens of thousands of world-class software engineers at Amazon. You will partner with your manager and teammates as a hands-on engineer in a dedicated team.

Key job responsibilities
You will play a key role on a team as it designs, builds, ships, and operates testing platforms and AI-driven testing capabilities, by:
- Quickly and reliably delivering high-quality technical solutions that delight our customers;
- Building and operating distributed systems at global scale — serverless test orchestration, on-demand execution across every AWS region, and load testing platforms processing millions of transactions per day;
- Demonstrating good taste in developer experience and tooling design through the SDLC;
- Partnering with your manager and engineering leads to influence technical architecture and product roadmaps;
- Meeting with customers to learn and help them achieve their goals;
- Setting a high bar of technical and operational excellence, and empowering your colleagues to continuously meet and raise the bar.

A day in the life
Your customers are the tens of thousands of software engineers across Amazon, who are building AWS, Amazon.com, Alexa, and more. You'll be a hands-on engineer, building and operating systems at extraordinary scale: test platforms that are in the critical path of every deployment at Amazon, and AI capabilities already in daily use by tens of thousands of builders. You will partner with your manager and teammates to sustainably deliver high-quality customer outcomes.

About the team
In Programming Foundations, the Testing org builds and operates Amazon's foundational testing infrastructure for the AI Development Lifecycle. Our platforms execute millions of tests per day across every AWS region: on-demand test execution, serverless orchestration, and global-scale load testing. Our AI systems make those platforms smarter: generating tests, diagnosing failures, and measuring whether a change carries enough evidence to ship. Our north star is a future where every team at Amazon has an AI-powered testing partner that helps builders ship high-quality software fast. We're early enough that you'll shape what this becomes, and operating at enough scale that your work has impact from day one.

Basic qualifications

- 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
- 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
- 1+ years of software development engineer or related occupational experience
- 1+ years of designing and developing large-scale, multi-tiered, multi-threaded, embedded or distributed software applications, tools, systems, and services using: C#, C++, Java, or Perl experience
- 1+ years of Object Oriented Design experience
- Bachelor's degree or foreign equivalent in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field

title: HR Associate Partner, PXT
descriptionHtml:
**Dies ist ein 2-Jahres-Vertrag.**

Im Streben danach, der beste Arbeitgeber der Welt zu sein, treiben unsere globalen Human-Resources-Teams – bekannt als People eXperience and Technology (PXT) – den Unternehmenserfolg voran, indem sie eine sichere, inklusive und innovative Unternehmenskultur fördern. Die Rolle des Associate Partners bietet einen Einstieg in den HR-Bereich bei Amazon und konzentriert sich auf grundlegende HR-Prozesse sowie die direkte Unterstützung der Mitarbeitenden. Der Associate Partner sorgt für außergewöhnliche Mitarbeitererlebnisse, indem er sowohl menschliche Expertise als auch technologische Lösungen einsetzt. Er verwaltet wesentliche HR-Transaktionen und baut gleichzeitig bedeutungsvolle Verbindungen zu Mitarbeitenden in einem zunehmend digitalen Arbeitsumfeld auf. Diese Rolle ergänzt Amazons sich weiterentwickelnde PXT-Servicekanäle – von KI-gestützten Systemen bis hin zu persönlichen Supportoptionen – indem sie dort personalisierte Unterstützung und menschliche Nähe bietet, wo diese am wertvollsten sind. Durch die effektive Balance zwischen technologiegestützten Prozessen und bedeutungsvoller Interaktion tragen sie dazu bei, ein nahtloses PXT-Erlebnis zu schaffen, das Amazons Engagement, der beste Arbeitgeber der Welt zu sein, weiter stärkt.

Zu deinen Hauptaufgaben gehören die Bearbeitung von HR-Transaktionen, das Management von Zeit- und Anwesenheitsfragen sowie die grundlegende Unterstützung der Mitarbeitenden – bei komplexeren Anliegen erfolgt die Weiterleitung an erfahrenere Kolleginnen und Kollegen. Je nach Bedarf bist du als Associate Partner für mehrere Standorte innerhalb deiner geografischen Region (Cluster) zuständig und fungierst als erste Anlaufstelle für grundlegende HR-Anfragen. Als Associate Partner im One PXT Team trägst du dazu bei, durch jede Interaktion ein herausragendes Mitarbeitererlebnis zu gestalten. Die Rolle erfordert eine einladende und zugängliche Präsenz sowie die präzise und zeitnahe Unterstützung der Mitarbeitenden zu Themen wie Benefits, Unternehmensrichtlinien und Gehaltsabrechnung.

Du wirst vor Ort an einem Amazon-Standort arbeiten. Bedarfsorientiert unterstützt du temporär auch umliegende Standorte.


Key job responsibilities
• Reaktionsschnelle, freundliche und professionelle Unterstützung der Mitarbeitenden über verschiedene Kanäle (persönlich, digital, per E-Mail, telefonisch) – mit genauen und zeitnahen Informationen zu Benefits, Richtlinien, Gehaltsabrechnung und weiteren HR-relevanten Themen.
• Sicherstellung der Genauigkeit, Integrität und Vertraulichkeit von Mitarbeiterdaten durch die sorgfältige und sichere Pflege und Verarbeitung von Unterlagen.
• Beitrag zu einer positiven und inklusiven Unternehmenskultur durch die Unterstützung und Umsetzung von Mitarbeiterengagement- und Anerkennungsinitiativen – einschließlich der Planung und Durchführung von Veranstaltungen, die den Zusammenhalt fördern und Leistungen würdigen.
• Unterstützung datenbasierter Entscheidungsfindung durch die Erhebung, Prüfung und Analyse wichtiger Personalkennzahlen, darunter Anwesenheit, Fluktuation und Engagement.
• Zusammenarbeit mit Führungskräften und Supportteams, um Mitarbeitende über KI-gestützte und klassische Self-Service-Tools sowie HR-Ressourcen zu informieren und zu schulen – mit dem Ziel, das Mitarbeitererlebnis und die betriebliche Effizienz zu verbessern. Nutzung von KI als primäres Hilfsmittel bei der Recherche und Problemlösung sowie proaktiver Einsatz verfügbarer Ressourcen und interner Netzwerke.
• Erstellung und Veröffentlichung klarer, professioneller interner Kommunikation für Mitarbeitende und Führungskräfte unter Einhaltung der organisatorischen Standards und des gewünschten Kommunikationsstils.
• Erkennung und Weiterleitung komplexer oder sensibler Anliegen an die zuständigen HR- und Führungsverantwortlichen – darunter Gehaltsabweichungen, Dienstplanungskonflikte, Anträge auf Anpassungen am Arbeitsplatz, Schwerbehindertenangelegenheiten, Abwesenheitsfragen, Vorwürfe von Fehlverhalten, Richtlinienverstöße, rechtliche oder betriebsrätliche Anliegen sowie weitere Mitarbeiterbeziehungsthemen.


A day in the life
Ein typischer Arbeitstag umfasst die Unterstützung von Mitarbeitenden bei der Nutzung unserer digitalen HR-Tools und Self-Service-Plattformen sowie die Bereitstellung reaktionsschneller und professioneller Hilfe bei Bedarf. Du verbringst Zeit auf der Betriebsfläche, coachst Mitarbeitende im effektiven Umgang mit HR-Technologie, beantwortest Fragen zu Richtlinien und Programmen und erkennst Möglichkeiten zur Verbesserung der Self-Service-Nutzung. Unter Anleitung erfahrener Teammitglieder stellst du eine genaue Dateneingabe und Dokumentation sicher und leistest dabei einen außergewöhnlichen Service, der Vertrauen und Sicherheit aufbaut.

Im Laufe deiner Schicht bearbeitest du HR-Transaktionen mit verschiedenen Tools und Systemen, verfolgst Servicekennzahlen und vertiefst dein Verständnis des HR-Betriebs. Bei komplexen Anfragen triffst du fundierte Entscheidungen über geeignete Eskalationswege und arbeitest eng mit erfahrenen Teammitgliedern an der Lösung zusammen.

Für den Erfolg in dieser Rolle sind eine ausgeprägte Serviceorientierung, Sorgfalt, ausgezeichnete Kommunikationsfähigkeiten und die Fähigkeit zur Wahrung der Vertraulichkeit erforderlich. Durch praktische Erfahrung in dieser Einstiegsposition entwickelst du grundlegende HR-Kompetenzen und trägst gleichzeitig zu positiven Mitarbeitererlebnissen bei.

Amazon Operations ist eine 24/7-Umgebung, und Schichten können sich je nach Geschäftsbedarf ändern. Für diese Rolle ist die Bereitschaft zur Arbeit in flexiblen Schichten – einschließlich Wochenenden, Abendschichten und rotierenden Dienstplänen – erforderlich. Amazon übernimmt keine Verantwortung für aufenthaltsrechtliche Genehmigungen, einschließlich H-1B, TN und anderer Nicht-Einwanderungsvisa, für diese Stelle.

About the team
Unser Team unterstützt Fulfillment Center und Delivery Stations in Deutschland. Wir arbeiten direkt mit Mitarbeitern, Managern und verschiedenen Abteilungen zusammen, um eine faire und inklusive Arbeitsumgebung zu schaffen. Als Associate Partner wirst du der erste Ansprechpartner für Mitarbeiterfragen – deine Arbeit verbessert direkt ihre Erfahrung und Zufriedenheit. Wir lösen echte Probleme: Konflikte klären, Karrieren unterstützen, faire Prozesse sichern. Das Team ist unterstützend und kollegial. Du wirst Teil einer Mission, die Menschen wirklich im Mittelpunkt stellt.

- Grundlegende Kenntnisse in Microsoft Office (z. B. Erstellen von Dokumenten in Word, Nutzung grundlegender Tabellenfunktionen in Excel, Verwaltung von Kalendern und E-Mails in Outlook)
- Fähigkeit zur Wahrung der Vertraulichkeit im Umgang mit sensiblen Informationen
- Erfahrung in der effektiven Kommunikation mit unterschiedlichen Zielgruppen (z. B. Erklären von Prozessen, Eingehen auf Anliegen, Bereitstellung fachlicher Orientierung)

descriptionHtml:
AWS Infrastructure as Code helps customers to easily and efficiently adopt AWS services while ensuring that their applications run safely in the cloud. We develop services, including CloudFormation, Cloud Control API, and the Cloud Development Kit (CDK) that empower customers to spin up infrastructure across AWS at unprecedented scale.

Our vision is to make agent driven infrastructure management fast , reliable and safe. The Provider Experience team provides the building blocks for customers to scale and grow their use of AWS services and third-party solutions. With the CloudFormation CLI and Resource Provider Development Kit (RPDK), we enable AWS service teams and third-party developers to build a standardized resource-based interface to their services and provide access to customers via the CloudFormation Registry. From there, we make it easy for developers to discover each resource's capabilities and build solutions to manage infrastructure at AWS scale.

We are looking for an experienced Product Management leader to define the end-to-end vision and strategy for CFN Provider Experience.
A successful candidate will have strong passion for developers and experience in designing platform strategies. You have a background in software development and product management, specific to software platforms and ecosystems. You must be highly analytical, able to work extremely effectively across multiple organizations, and adept at synthesizing a variety of technologies and capabilities into high quality, simple products and applications that developers and customers love.

Key job responsibilities
- Drive the product strategy and roadmap for your space, and manage prioritization and tradeoffs against developer experience, customer experience, and time to market.
- Create buy-in for the product vision both internally and with key external partners.

- Drive product launches including working with public relations team, executives, and other product management team members

- Proactively identify and resolve strategic issues that may impair the team’s ability to meet strategic, financial, and technical goals.

- Is strongly oriented towards results
- Thinks big

About the team
AWS CloudFormation is the foundational Infrastructure as Code (IaC) service from AWS, enabling millions of customers to model, provision, and manage their cloud resources through templates. Our team owns the frontend public API layer, template and operation validations, deployment safety rules, and third-party (3P) hooks — the critical layers between the customer and the CloudFormation engine. We are the first line of defense for customer experience: catching errors early, enforcing deployment guardrails, and empowering customers to extend CloudFormation with custom validation and compliance logic. title: Engineering Operation Technician, DCC Communities
descriptionHtml:
Join our dynamic team and become a critical guardian of technological infrastructure! As a Data Center Engineering Technician, you'll play a pivotal role in maintaining the heartbeat of mission-critical technology infrastructure, ensuring seamless operations that power global digital experiences. Your expertise will directly contribute to maintaining an extraordinary 99.999% uptime, keeping the digital world running smoothly and efficiently.

Engineering Technicians are Amazon’s front line when it comes to hands-on electrical and mechanical equipment troubleshooting. They will maintain, operate, and troubleshoot, Data Center Operation’s Mission Critical Facilities, which includes stand-by diesel generators and related fuel systems, as well as three phase electrical systems such as: switch gear, UPSs, PDUs, wet cell batteries and associated systems, CRAC, centrifugal chillers, cooling towers/water chemical system, air handlers and associated systems, pumps, & motors.

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

NOTE: Amazon does not sponsor for immigration, including for H-1B, TN, and other non-immigrant visas, for this role.
NOTE: Lump sum stipend will be provided to eligible candidates who relocate for this position.



Key job responsibilities
- Daily building rounds to monitor and record information from electrical, mechanical, and fire/life safety equipment to ensure 24/7 reliability and availability
- Monitor Building Management Systems (BMS) and Electrical Power Management System (EPMS)
- Assist in troubleshooting of facility and rack-level events within internal Service Level Agreements (SLA)
- Perform rack installs and rack decommissioning within internal SLA
- Perform PM, troubleshooting, root cause analysis, and repair of electrical and mechanical equipment
- Technical writing to support change management program
- Monitor daily work requests and manage to resolution, and execute projects from conception to completion
- On-site support of contractors, sub-contractors and vendors, ensuring that all work performed is in accordance with established practices, procedures & local legislation
- Work schedule changes depending on specific site needs. Shifts can be up to 12-hours and may rotate on a predefined schedule. Some locations have on-call rotations.
- Role may support more than one location/site.

Physical Requirements:
- Willingness and demonstrated ability to work in the following physical conditions with reasonable accommodations:
- Regularly lift and/or move up to 39 pounds independently
- Participate in group lifts for 40+ pounds
- Maintain balance and perform construction tasks while on a ladder
- Regularly walk, use hands and fingers, handle or feel, reach with hands and arms, stoop, kneel, crouch or crawl, climb stairs, twist, bend, work above shoulders, grasp, carry, push and pull objects into position
- Work in an environment requiring provided ear protection

This role supports data centers in various operational stages. The position may be assigned to a facility still under development, which could require travel to established locations for training until your designated site becomes fully operational.

Essential Requirements:
- Ability to travel to or commute between data center locations as needed
- Willingness to temporarily work at alternative sites during training periods or until assigned facility is operational
- Travel frequency will vary based on business needs and operational status of assigned facility

Candidates must be able to travel (over 50 miles) or commute (less than 50 miles) to active data center sites as required by business needs.



A day in the life
This role acts as Amazon’s front line when it comes to hands-on electrical and mechanical equipment preventative maintenance (PM) and troubleshooting, reporting to a site’s Data Center Facility Manager (FM). They will maintain, operate, and troubleshoot mission-critical data center facility equipment including stand-by diesel generators and related fuel systems, 3 phase electrical systems such as switchgear, UPS units, PDUs, and wet cell batteries and associated systems. Mechanical equipment includes CRAHU units, centrifugal chillers, cooling towers, water systems, air handlers and associated systems, pumps, and motors. Additional support equipment is included in the scope of the role which includes fire/life safety equipment, building automation systems, and general facilities equipment.

- 2+ years of electrical and mechanical facilities maintenance, or 2+ years of electrical facilities maintenance and 1+ years of mechanical facilities maintenance experience
- 2+ years of Microsoft Office products and applications experience
- Work flexible schedule including weekends, nights, and holidays

Preferred qualifications

descriptionHtml:

We are seeking a Principal Tech Operations Engineer to lead and scale regional manufacturing operations across a complex, multi vendor hardware production ecosystem. This role owns the end to end orchestration of external manufacturing partners, driving supplier onboarding, site enablement, technical roadmap development, and sustained performance management across Supply Chain, Quality, Technical Operations, and Procurement functions. You will shape operational planning inputs that determine how the region builds and delivers enterprise hardware at scale.

You will serve as the single threaded owner for manufacturing operations outcomes, aligning diverse stakeholders, setting strategic direction, and delivering results that meet business scaling targets. You will build consensus and drive decisions at velocity across Manufacturing, Supply Chain, Hardware Engineering, Risk Management, Public Policy, Finance, and Customer facing organizations while maintaining full accountability for production performance and customer delivery.

This is a senior role which requires 10+ years of technical program management experience. The role demands deep, tenured expertise in high mix, high complexity hardware manufacturing. You will have personally led organizations through product transitions, capacity ramps, supplier onboarding cycles, and operational transformations. You thrive in dynamic environments where shifting product mix, evolving customer demand, and technology transitions require rapid, high judgment decision making that balances quality, cost, throughput, and delivery reliability.

You will own complex integration programs from conception through design, validation, implementation, and scaling across manufacturing sites. The scope includes orchestrating a multi vendor ecosystem of manufacturing partners, managing the largest and most complex supplier engagements in the region, and delivering next generation technology programs. This includes enabling the region's first liquid cooled rack production, supporting the industry transition from air cooled to liquid cooled infrastructure. In 2027, the role expands to lead the site setup, vendor selection, and operational ramp of a purpose built Manufacturing Center of Excellence, a greenfield facility that will double regional manufacturing capacity and set operational standards for global replication.

You will bring strong technical depth across server, storage, and network hardware architectures combined with expertise in program management, supply chain operations, capacity modeling, new product introduction, and manufacturing engineering. You will drive systemic root cause resolution using structured methodologies (5 Whys, 8D, Six Sigma) and own all site capacity planning across the region. You will maintain accountability for critical financial levers including direct and indirect labor optimization, cost per unit, and overall cost competitiveness.

You will champion the highest standards of safety, security, and operational excellence across every engagement. You will communicate with clarity through structured business reviews, establish the metrics that define success, and influence across engineering, supply chain, quality, and executive leadership to deliver customer commitments at a global scale.



Key job responsibilities
Strategic Planning and Transformation

1. Define and own the 3 to 5 year manufacturing operations strategy, anticipating future capacity needs, identifying critical capability gaps, and prioritizing technology investments that position the region for sustained growth
2. Lead transformational programs that fundamentally reshape manufacturing capability, including advanced automation deployment, robotics integration, and lights out manufacturing initiatives
3. Drive manufacturing agility through flexible line configurations, rapid changeover capabilities, and multi product qualification strategies that enable the network to respond to evolving customer demand and technology transitions
4. Own capital expenditure planning for manufacturing operations, developing rigorous business cases that quantify returns on equipment investments, facility expansions, and technology upgrades
5. Proactively identify, assess, and mitigate operational risks across the manufacturing network, including single points of failure, capacity constraints, systemic quality issues, and workforce availability challenges before they impact delivery
6. Develop high quality strategic documents and investment proposals that influence manufacturing priorities at the executive level, articulating trade offs, quantifying risks, and presenting clear recommendations that drive action


Final Assembly and System Integration Excellence

1. Architect and continuously evolve production line design, material flow strategies, and workstation configurations across the manufacturing network to deliver step function improvements in throughput, cycle time, and ergonomic safety
2. Define the manufacturing execution system strategy for the region, establishing real time visibility into work in progress, station level yields, and production constraints that enable data driven decision making at every level
3. Lead a culture of relentless continuous improvement through lean manufacturing principles, kaizen programs, and value stream mapping, systematically eliminating waste and unlocking operational efficiency gains that set the benchmark for global operations

Data, Metrics, and Operational Excellence

1. Architect and own the manufacturing operations performance framework, defining the metrics that matter (overall equipment effectiveness, throughput, cycle time, first pass yield, on time delivery, cost per unit) and holding the organization accountable to world class targets
2. Build executive grade dashboards and reporting systems that provide real time visibility into production health, quality trends, and delivery performance, enabling leaders to make informed decisions at speed across all sites
3. Champion Industry 4.0 adoption including IoT enabled production monitoring, predictive maintenance, and AI driven quality inspection, positioning the manufacturing network at the forefront of smart factory innovation
4. Design scalable mechanisms and intelligent automation that eliminate manual effort in production reporting, defect tracking, and capacity planning, creating operational leverage as the network grows
5. Translate complex operational data into compelling strategic narratives for executive leadership, shaping investment priorities and manufacturing direction through clear, insight driven recommendations
6. Lead digital transformation across manufacturing operations, driving manufacturing execution system modernization, automated test equipment upgrades, and smart factory capabilities that deliver measurable competitive advantage


A day in the life
As the Principal Tech Ops Engineer, no two days look the same but the mission is constant: scale enterprise hardware manufacturing globally. You spend your time defining multi year capacity strategies, onboarding new manufacturing partners, and driving technology transitions such as enabling the region's first liquid cooled rack production. You lead manufacturing readiness reviews for new product introductions, build business cases for facility expansions, and architect digital transformation programs across the supplier ecosystem. You own the operational excellence framework, establishing metrics and scalable mechanisms that replicate across sites worldwide. You partner with hardware engineering, supply chain, and executive leadership to shape investment priorities, mitigate operational risks, and deliver next generation manufacturing capabilities. You develop future leaders, influence long term vendor strategies, and drive automation and Industry 4.0 adoption that positions the manufacturing network for sustained growth at scale.

title: Ingénieur(e) en Chef DCEO, Data Center Engineering Operations
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Web Services recherche un(e) Ingénieur(e) en Chef rigoureux(se) et expérimenté(e) pour rejoindre notre équipe Data Center Engineering Operations (DCEO). Ce groupe s'engage à maintenir l'infrastructure physique critique qui supporte Amazon Web Services, en garantissant un fonctionnement des systèmes mécaniques, électriques et de protection incendie/sécurité à 100 % de disponibilité, tout en assurant un service client de premier ordre aux équipes opérant au sein des centres de données.

AWS Infrastructure Services (AIS)
AWS Infrastructure Services est responsable de la conception, de la planification, de la livraison et de l'exploitation de l'ensemble de l'infrastructure mondiale d'AWS. En d'autres termes, nous sommes les personnes qui font fonctionner le cloud. Nous soutenons l'ensemble des centres de données AWS ainsi que tous les serveurs, équipements de stockage, réseaux, systèmes d'alimentation électrique et de refroidissement qui garantissent à nos clients un accès continu aux innovations sur lesquelles ils comptent. Nous travaillons sur les problèmes les plus complexes, avec des milliers de variables impactant nos opérations, et nous recherchons des talents qui souhaitent nous aider à relever ces défis.

Vous rejoindrez une équipe diversifiée composée d'ingénieurs logiciels, matériels et réseau, de spécialistes des systèmes critiques, d'experts en sécurité, de responsables des opérations et d'autres rôles essentiels. Vous collaborerez avec des collègues à travers AWS pour maintenir les plus hauts standards de sécurité tout en fournissant une capacité apparemment infinie au coût le plus bas possible pour nos clients. Vous évoluerez dans une culture inclusive qui accueille les idées audacieuses et vous donne les moyens de les mener à terme.

En tant qu'Ingénieur(e) en Chef DCEO, vous serez responsable de veiller à ce que tous les équipements électriques, mécaniques et de sécurité incendie/sécurité des personnes au sein du centre de données fonctionnent à leur efficacité optimale. Cela implique à la fois la maintenance préventive planifiée des équipements, les travaux correctifs quotidiens et la réponse aux incidents urgents. Vous jouerez le rôle de référent(e) technique unique pour toutes les opérations des installations, en reportant au Facility Manager du site et en interagissant avec les Techniciens en Exploitation des Opérations d'Ingénierie (EOT) ainsi qu'avec les prestataires tiers. Les équipements des centres de données supportant des serveurs critiques doivent maintenir un taux de disponibilité supérieur à 99,999 %.

En tant qu'Ingénieur(e) en Chef DCEO, vous gérerez des projets à impact faible à moyen, de la conception jusqu'à la livraison. Ces projets impliquent une part importante de travail en autonomie ainsi qu'une collaboration avec des équipes supports transverses incluant l'ingénierie, l'automatisation, les opérations et la finance, dans des environnements locaux et internationaux. Vous créerez et assurerez le suivi des jalons clés, obtiendrez et suivrez les devis pour tous les coûts nécessaires, et documenterez les résultats des projets pour une mise en œuvre future dans d'autres installations. L'objectif est de piloter l'innovation et la résilience tout en réduisant les coûts opérationnels.

L'un des aspects les plus enrichissants de ce rôle est de diriger, former et encadrer les Techniciens en Exploitation des Opérations d'Ingénierie dans leur mission de dépannage et d'exploitation des équipements électriques et mécaniques. Cela inclut notamment les groupes électrogènes diesel de secours, les tableaux de distribution, les onduleurs (UPS), les PDU, les unités de traitement d'air (UTA), les refroidisseurs centrifuges, les tours de refroidissement, les systèmes de traitement chimique, les pompes, les moteurs, les variateurs de fréquence (VFD) et les systèmes de gestion technique du bâtiment (GTB).


Key job responsibilities
• Superviser les opérations quotidiennes et la maintenance des équipements mécaniques et électriques du centre de données.
• Travailler en autonomie avec un niveau de supervision directe limité.
• Agir en tant que point d'escalade pour tous les problèmes liés aux installations du centre de données, en escaladant au Facility Manager selon les besoins.
• Effectuer des analyses des causes racines (Root Cause Analysis) des défaillances d'équipements.
• Dépanner et signaler les événements au niveau des installations et des serveurs dans les délais SLA internes.
• Créer et déployer de nouvelles pratiques standard pour les Techniciens EOT, les Ingénieurs en Chef et les équipes prestataires.
• Assurer la formation et l'encadrement des Techniciens en Exploitation des Opérations d'Ingénierie.
• Veiller au strict respect de toutes les procédures de sécurité par les prestataires et le personnel Amazon.
• Utiliser le CMMS interne pour gérer et suivre les flux de travail des installations.
• Communiquer des informations techniques complexes à un public non technique.
• Gérer des projets d'amélioration des infrastructures de la conception à la livraison, en assurant le suivi des jalons, des coûts et des livrables.


About the team
Pourquoi AWS ?
Amazon Web Services (AWS) est la plateforme cloud la plus complète et la plus largement adoptée au monde. Nous avons été pionniers du cloud computing et n'avons jamais cessé d'innover — c'est pourquoi les clients, des startups les plus prospères aux entreprises du Global 500, font confiance à notre gamme robuste de produits et services pour alimenter leurs activités.

Expériences diversifiées
Amazon valorise les expériences diversifiées. Même si vous ne répondez pas à toutes les qualifications et compétences préférées énumérées dans la description du poste, nous vous encourageons à postuler. Si votre carrière débute, n'a pas suivi un parcours traditionnel ou inclut des expériences alternatives, ne laissez pas cela vous empêcher de postuler.

Culture d'équipe inclusive
Chez AWS, la curiosité et la connexion humaine sont au cœur de notre identité. Nos groupes d'affinité portés par les employés et soutenus par l'entreprise favorisent l'inclusion et permettent à chacun d'être fier de ce qui le rend unique. Nos événements d'inclusion renforcent des équipes plus soudées et plus collaboratives. Notre innovation continue est alimentée par les idées audacieuses, les perspectives nouvelles et les voix passionnées que nos équipes apportent à tout ce que nous faisons.

Mentorat et évolution de carrière
Nous élevons continuellement notre barre de performance dans notre quête pour devenir le Meilleur Employeur au Monde. C'est pourquoi vous trouverez ici un partage de connaissances infini, du mentorat et d'autres ressources d'avancement professionnel pour vous aider à devenir un professionnel plus accompli.

Équilibre vie professionnelle / vie personnelle
Nous valorisons l'harmonie entre vie professionnelle et vie personnelle. Réussir au travail ne devrait jamais se faire au détriment de sacrifices à la maison, c'est pourquoi nous nous efforçons d'offrir de la flexibilité dans notre culture de travail. Lorsque nous nous sentons soutenus sur le lieu de travail et à la maison, il n'y a rien que nous ne puissions accomplir dans le cloud.

Basic qualifications

- Niveau intermédiaire en anglais et/ou en français (oral et écrit)
- Diplôme de niveau Bac+3 minimum en Génie Électrique, Génie Mécanique, CVC, Technologie Industrielle ou Génie Électrotechnique
- Minimum 5 ans d'expérience professionnelle pertinente dans un centre de données ou tout autre environnement critique
- Expérience significative dans l'exploitation et la maintenance d'infrastructures critiques (onduleurs, groupes électrogènes, tableaux de distribution, CVC, systèmes eau glacée/refroidissement)

Preferred qualifications

title: Principal Technical Program Manager, Alexa Shopping-Core
descriptionHtml:
Alexa+ is transforming how hundreds of millions of customers shop by voice, and delivering on that promise depends as much on how we build as on what we build. We're looking for a Principal Technical Program Manager to define and deliver the horizontal initiatives that raise the bar across all of Alexa Shopping — leading with the Amazon Stores Agent, the experience that lets customers complete multi-step store tasks through natural conversation on Alexa+ enabled Echo Family Devices, and extending to the cross-cutting programs, including testing and quality automation, that determine how quickly and reliably we ship. You will own a portfolio of very large, cross-organizational programs, remediate endemic problems that no single team can solve alone, and create the mechanisms that keep these programs succeeding with and without your involvement. You will work at the intersection of agentic AI research and production-quality delivery, often in areas where neither the business nor the architectural strategy has been defined, driving clarity where the problem itself is not yet clear. This is a highly visible role: you operate with complete independence, act as a force multiplier across peer teams inside and outside Alexa Shopping, and represent complex decisions and trade-offs to leaders up to three levels above (Directors and VPs). You will operate as an extension of the organization's leadership, anticipating where the org needs to go and building the programs to get it there.

Key job responsibilities
Amazon Stores Agent
-Own and scale the Amazon Stores Agent on Alexa+ enabled Echo Family Devices — launching agentic store actions that let customers complete multi-step tasks across Registries, Payments, Subscribe & Save, Addresses, Orders, and Returns by gathering what's needed through natural conversation and completing the steps on their behalf.
-Drive the program from its first actions to a customer-complete experience, holding a high task-completion bar and standing up the shared foundations — routing, evaluation, and API integration — so customers finish whole tasks hands-free and new actions ship faster over time.

Horizontal Program Leadership
-Define and own a portfolio of very large programs that cut across Alexa Shopping teams and organizations, beginning with the Amazon Stores Agent, decomposing ambiguous, org-level goals into clear workstreams that teams can execute independently.
-Anticipate future needs and stand up new horizontal initiatives before they become blockers, defining the problem, scope, success criteria, and ownership where none exist.

descriptionHtml:

About Journal
Distributed systems such as Kinesis, S3, and DynamoDB need to durably and correctly commit customer writes at high scale and with high availability. For this, many such systems use Journal. Journal is a fault tolerant, high performance, durable log service. It offers an elegant solution to a complex, distributed systems problem. The challenges in building such a system stem with right durability, availability, resiliency, performance (microseconds matter), and scale (we commit in excess of 100 million transactions per second) at low cost.

* Designing and developing novel, cutting edge, highly available, distributed systems software.

* Mentoring other engineers.

Candidate must be able to work with a minimum of technical supervision and supplemental engineering support, while responding efficiently to multiple program priorities. title: Operations Manager, Customer Fulfillment
descriptionHtml:
Operations is the beating heart of Amazon. This key part of our business makes sure we fulfil and dispatch orders efficiently so that our customers get their items on time. It’s driven by Operations Managers who bring the team together to push excellence in safety, quality and productivity across our sites. At your site, you’ll lead other managers and create the operational plan that helps your teams meet their targets. This role is all about driving operational excellence to create the Amazon of tomorrow.

The applicable collective agreement (CCNL) for this role is Logistica, Trasporto Merci e Spedizione. The position is classified at livello Quadro or above, depending on the candidate’s skills, competences and experience.

Key job responsibilities
- Manage and develop a team of Area Managers
- Lead operational teams on a shift, deal with issues, and positively impact site performance
- Analyse shift performance against relevant business objectives, and put in place actions to improve our operational excellence
- Work closely with other support teams, including HR, Finance, Health and Safety, and Security
- Design and deliver initiatives across the sites to improve operational performance

A day in the life
You’ll lead shifts at one of our operational sites. You’ll also be the key link between a number of teams, including finance, safety and operations integration teams. That means you’ll be close to the day-to-day operations at your site but also contribute to new ways to innovate at your site.

A typical day will involve meetings with different areas of the business, deep diving into performance and risk metrics for sites, and looking ahead to prepare for different levels of demand. Every day will also involve mentoring and coaching your team. You’ll be a source of leadership and support your team to be the best managers they can be.

About the team
Customer Fulfilment, or CF, is where it all started for Amazon. CF has scaled up from a humble team of booksellers to a sophisticated global team which handles more than 1.5 million orders every day. The team is the foundation of our business and its efforts have helped us diversify across new regions and services. With the help of emerging technology, we’re always looking for ways to offer a bigger, better product range – delivered quickly and affordably.

The CF team are the first people in the chain that helps customers get products at the speed we’re known for. We’re based in Fulfilment Centres, which are at the heart of Amazon’s fast-paced Operations network. Our centres are sometimes referred to as the ‘First Mile’ because it’s where most Amazon packages start their journey. We help to manage dynamic inventory and facilitate speedy deliveries round the clock.

Lots of different people work in our Fulfilment Centres, so there are plenty of opportunities for every skillset. Some of us work with physical products, while others analyse data to help everyone across the business make smart decisions.

- A degree
- Relevant experience in people and stakeholder management
- Advanced proficiency in verbal and written English and intermediate proficiency in the local language
- Relevant experience in using data or anecdotal evidence to influence business decisions
- Relevant experience in key areas of production and supply chains
- - Possess a degree from an accredited institution,
- - Previous experience in leading large, diverse teams,
- - You possess excellent communication skills, both verbal and written,
- - You’re competent in two or more production or supply chain areas, with an impressive track record in a similar, fast-paced logistics, distribution or manufacturing environment,
- - You possess the ability to manage details, establish and carry out root cause analysis, and then extract and analyse the data you generate,
- - You thrive on change, and are willing to relocate if necessary
- - You have excellent written and spoken English and Italian
- - Work shifts, including weekends, in an operational 7/365 environment.

Preferred qualifications

- Preferred qualifications are not required to apply for a position at Amazon. If you have all the basic qualifications above, we’d love to hear from you.
- Experience in Lean, Six Sigma and Kaizen techniques
- Experience in a similar logistical working environment

title: Social Intelligence Manager, CCR Social Media team
descriptionHtml:
Amazon is seeking a strategic, data-driven analyst to manage social listening capabilities. Reporting to the Principal, Global Social Analytics, Intelligence, and Listening, you will support the design, execution, and continuous improvement of social listening programs that inform Amazon’s communications strategy, surface emerging issues in real-time, and measure reputational impact across major moments.

This role sits within Amazon's Global Social Media team, part of Amazon's communications organization, Communications & Corporate Responsibility (CCR). We manage more than 35 brand and country accounts across LinkedIn, Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, and X, including the main @Amazon brand handles. The role is based in Seattle or New York and is an individual contributor role.

Our social listening function exists to make CCR smarter, faster, and more effective. You'll support three connected workstreams:

1) Social monitoring. Reactive monitoring to identify emerging issues before they escalate, plus ad hoc tracking around major events and announcements. This work is the early warning system for CCR, enabling us to detect and respond to risks in real-time.

2) Real-time intelligence for communications strategy. Using social listening to identify conversation trends, narrative shifts, and opportunities where Amazon can authentically engage. This gives CCR a real-time read on the environment around our priorities, surfacing trends and insights quickly and enabling us to participate in organic conversations.

3) Retroactive analysis of breakthrough moments. Contributing social listening insights to listening products designed for senior leadership. Helping identify the coverage thresholds and conversation patterns that predict reputational breakthrough, and translating those learnings into recommendations that shape future communications.

You’ll also be adept in owned social analytics, analyzing performance across our global channel portfolio: tracking against annual goals, building the benchmarks and metrics that define content success, and turning performance data into insights that shape what and how we publish.

Key job responsibilities
Support day-to-day social listening operations across CCR, including query design, tagging frameworks, alert thresholds, and reporting cadences across global priority topics (e.g., AI, sustainability, workplace, retail).

Build, maintain, and refine social listening dashboards within Amazon's enterprise tools, partnering with tech and engineering teams to inform future iterations of our in-house tools.

Help develop measurement frameworks that surface long-term trends, sentiment shifts, share of voice, and key voices driving conversation around Amazon and its priorities.

Translate social data into guidance for partners, helping shape creative, content, and business decisions.

Run rapid-turn analyses for breaking issues, news cycles, and reactive moments, partnering with partner teams to inform engagement decisions.

Contribute to regular reporting, helping present findings to senior leaders and synthesizing insights from multiple sources into clear recommendations.

Mentor colleagues and partner teams on how to use listening data and self-serve insights from shared tools.

Partner with channel leads on content optimization — surfacing what's working across formats, platforms, and markets, and translating findings into publishing and creative recommendations.

Connect owned, earned, and paid measurement, partnering with research and paid media partners to evaluate amplification and campaign impact.

Basic qualifications

- 5+ years of professional non-internship marketing experience
- Experience building measures and metrics, and developing reporting solutions
- Experience delivering complex, data-driven recommendations to senior leaders
- Bachelor's degree in a related field (Communications, Marketing, Data Science, Computer Science, or equivalent).

Preferred qualifications

- Experience in professional communications or public relations
- Familiarity with applied AI/LLMs in social listening or communications contexts (topic clustering, summarization, sentiment modeling).
- Experience partnering with engineering or data science teams to design or improve analytics tooling.
- Demonstrated ability to influence cross-functional stakeholders, including senior comms leaders, without direct authority.
- Experience managing programs across multiple time zones, languages, and global markets.
- Experience in large, complex global organizations.

title: Full Lifecycle Recruiter, Amazon Stores Japan Recruiting
descriptionHtml:
The Amazon Japan Recruiting team is seeking a Recruiter who embodies a passion for learning and curiosity — someone who continuously seeks new knowledge, embraces different perspectives, and thrives on growing alongside a team of innovative professionals. We welcome candidates with a strong drive for innovation and a customer-first mindset.

You will successfully manage, prioritize, and close multiple requisitions against a timeline, with experience setting benchmarks and metrics. You will also bring strong sourcing skills — proactively identifying and engaging the right candidates to build robust pipelines. You will partner closely with hiring managers across multiple business lines to create customized hiring strategies for talent pools and market conditions. In addition to end-to-end recruitment responsibilities across multiple hiring requests concurrently, you will work on both tactical and strategic projects to continuously innovate for our customers.

At Amazon, you'll work alongside the latest AI and GenAI tools that are increasingly woven into how teams operate: from AI-powered capabilities that accelerate decision-making, to Generative AI that helps you focus on work that truly matters. You'll have opportunities and resources to develop AI fluency at your own pace, with continuous learning built into the culture.

Key job responsibilities
Partner with hiring teams to build effective sourcing, assessment, and closing approaches with an ability to manage customer and partner expectations.

Recommend ideas and strategies related to recruitment that will contribute to the long-term growth of the company, implementing new processes and refining existing processes in alignment with Amazon's mission to deliver the highest quality results to the customer.

Build and maintain robust candidate pipelines through proactive sourcing via direct outreach, referrals, and market mapping.

Articulate in writing, hiring plans with deliverables, timelines, and a formal tracking process.

Participate in special projects and recruiting initiatives, including assessment of best practices in interviewing techniques, leveraging internal sources of talent, and identification of top talent for senior-level openings.

Communicate, organize, and negotiate effectively with a keen focus on delivering business results.

Proactively communicate and collaborate with multiple stakeholders — including hiring managers and HRBPs — to drive the end-to-end recruiting process smoothly and efficiently.

Collect and organize recruiting data, analyze results and trends quantitatively, and leverage insights to inform hiring strategy and drive continuous improvement.

Basic qualifications

- Experience building and executing candidate sourcing and closing strategies
- Bilingual proficiency in both Japanese and English — reading, writing, and speaking
- 3+ years of recruiting experience in a fast-paced, high-bar environment
- Experience partnering and managing relationships with multiple stakeholders, including hiring managers and HRBPs
- Experience collecting, analyzing, and reporting on recruiting data and metrics

Preferred qualifications

- Experience managing and prioritizing multiple searches, projects, and client relationships simultaneously
- Experience leveraging AI tools and recruiting technologies to enhance hiring efficiency and quality
- Experience managing candidates through recruitment lifecycles; from reach-out, assessment, preparation, negotiation and closing.

title: Senior Delivery Consultant - Application Modernization, AWS Professional Services
descriptionHtml:
The Amazon Web Services Professional Services (ProServe) team is seeking a skilled Sr. Delivery Consultant – Application Modernization, to join our team at Amazon Web Services (AWS). In this role, you'll work closely with customers to design, implement, and manage AWS solutions that meet their technical requirements and business objectives. You'll be a key leader in driving customer success through their cloud journey, providing technical expertise and best practices throughout the project lifecycle.

As a Sr. Delivery Consultant - Application Modernization, you will be proficient in leading the architecture of complex, scalable, and secure solutions tailored to meet the specific needs of each customer. You’ll work closely with stakeholders to gather requirements, assess current applications, and propose effective migration strategies to AWS. As trusted advisors to our customers, providing guidance on industry trends, emerging technologies, and innovative solutions, you will be responsible for leading the implementation process, ensuring adherence to best practices, optimizing performance, and managing risks throughout the project.

The AWS Professional Services organization is a global team of experts that help customers realize their desired business outcomes when using the AWS Cloud. We work together with customer teams and the AWS Partner Network (APN) to execute enterprise cloud computing initiatives. Our team provides assistance through a collection of offerings which help customers achieve specific outcomes related to enterprise cloud adoption. We also deliver focused guidance through our global specialty practices, which cover a variety of solutions, technologies, and industries.


Key job responsibilities
As an experienced technology professional, you will be responsible for:
1. Leading the design and implementation of complex, scalable, and secure AWS solutions tailored to customer needs
2. Provide technical guidance and troubleshooting support throughout project delivery
3. Collaborating with stakeholders to gather requirements and propose effective migration strategies
4. Acting as a trusted advisor to customers on industry trends and emerging technologies
5. Sharing knowledge within the organization through mentoring, training, and creating reusable artifacts
6. Experience as a tech lead or leading a high performing consulting team

About the team
ABOUT AWS:
 
Diverse Experiences
Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
 
Why AWS
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud. 

Inclusive Team Culture
AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.

Mentorship and Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional. 

10046

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree, or 5+ years of consulting, design and implementation of serverless distributed solutions experience
- Experience leading application architecture/design/modernization projects, including cloud-based solutioning (AWS or equivalent), with AI and automation
- 5+ years of architecting/operating solutions built on any cloud service provider like Azure, AWS, GCP, OCI, etc. experience
- Experience in automating, deploying, and supporting infrastructure

Preferred qualifications

- Experience communicating technical concepts to a non-technical audience
- AWS experience preferred, with proficiency in a wide range of AWS services (e.g., EC2, S3, RDS, Lambda, IAM, VPC, CloudFormation)
- Experience with automation and scripting (e.g., Terraform, Python)
- Experience leading large-scale software development and modernization initiatives, with deep expertise in multiple programming languages (e.g. Java, Python, C++, JavaScript, Microservices) and Generative AI tools/technologies
- Proven ability to lead software engineering best practices across testing, source control, code reviews, and deployment/release management processes

title: Responsable de Suministros y Materiales Operativos, Environmental Assurance and Protection (EAP)
descriptionHtml:
Salario mensual base: $15,687.50 MXN brutos más prestaciones superiores a las de ley.

Ubicación: Calle Fresno 397, Atlampa, Cuauhtémoc, 06450 Ciudad de México, CDMX

Horario: Lunes a Viernes de 7:00 a 16:30 horas, con posibilidad de cambio de turno de acuerdo a las necesidades operativas.

Nuestra misión en Amazon es ser la empresa más centrada en el cliente de la Tierra, y nuestro galardonado equipo de Environmental Assurance and Protection (EAP) es una parte clave para lograr ese objetivo. Amazon es una de las marcas más reconocidas en el mundo porque distribuimos millones de productos a nuestros clientes. Hacer nuestro mejor esfuerzo por nuestros clientes es de donde obtenemos nuestra energía, y es por eso que encontrará que abordamos las cosas de manera diferente aquí.
Amazon está buscando un Waste Coordinator (Coordinador de residuos) para que actúe como representante ambiental designado para su sitio. El Waste Coordinator brinda apoyo en la ejecución y en la implementación de los programas relacionados con el manejo de residuos del equipo de cumplimiento Ambiental Global (EAP) de Amazon dentro de las instalaciones asignadas.

Key job responsibilities
- Caracterización y determinación de los residuos, incluyendo su segregación apropiada, contención, etiquetado y preparación para su envío, de acuerdo a las normas Estatales y Federales de México.
- Organización de las áreas de almacenamiento y manejo de residuos, de acuerdo a los requisitos regulatorios y políticas de Amazon aplicables.
- Realizar auditorías exhaustivas y precisas para la mejora continua incluyendo pero no limitados a los sitios de disposición de residuos, kits antiderrame, áreas de Product Awaiting Determination, suplementos para el manejo de residuos, etc.
- Priorizar y manejar múltiples tareas técnicas.
- Atender la limpieza y manejo de pequeños derrames de sustancias químicas en las instalaciones de Amazon.
- Participar en todas las investigaciones relacionadas con incidentes ambientales en el Sitio. Trabajar en conjunto con el MSEM para realizar investigaciones exhaustivas para prevenir la recurrencia de los incidentes.
- Apoyar en todos los envíos de residuos, y organizar toda la documentación necesaria para asegurar el correcto manejo de los residuos (permisos de los proveedores, manifiestos, comprobantes de disposición final, bitácoras, etc).
- Solicitar órdenes de compra para equipo, contenedores, etiquetas y otros suplementos para mantener niveles de Stock apropiados en el área de residuos.
- Asegurar que los registros necesarios para asegurar el correcto manejo de los residuos son completados y mantenidos adecuadamente.
- Coordinarse con los equipos de WHS, Operaciones y otros equipos de los sitios responsables del correcto manejo de las sustancias químicas peligrosas para el correcto manejo de los residuos peligrosos y de los residuos no peligrosos o de manejo especial.
- Apoyar al Multi Site Environmental Manager en la preparación de la documentación necesaria para las categorizaciones como generadores de residuos peligrosos y no peligrosos, así como para cumplir con los requisitos de tiempo máximo de almacenamiento de los residuos peligrosos.
- Apoyar en la identificación de tendencias y áreas de oportunidad para reducción de costos.
- Ser un recurso para responder preguntas relacionados con el manejo de los residuos por parte de operaciones.
- Apoyar a operaciones en las actividades que se consideren necesarias para garantizar la consecución de los objetivos del sitio.


About the team
El equipo EAP protege las operaciones de Amazon en Mexico y apoya las necesidades de nuestros clientes internos de manera proactiva mitigando los riesgos ambientales y protegiendo al medio ambiente.

Basic qualifications

- 1+ years of Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, and Outlook) experience
- High school or equivalent
- Work a flexible schedule/shift/work area, including weekends, nights, and/or holidays

Preferred qualifications

- Comprehensive knowledge of waste management systems and regulatory compliance according to Mexican environmental legislation (LGPGIR and NOM standards)

title: Sr. Engineering Standards Program Manager, Worldwide Grocery Real Estate Growth & Development (WWRGD)
descriptionHtml:
Join us as we redefine the future of physical retail! Our goal is to be Earth's most customer-centric company and we're just getting started. We are looking for people who want to join a newly developing business unit full of ambitious and driven professionals that continue to push the boundaries of reality and improve the daily lives of our customers.

This team is seeking a multi-disciplinary Engineering Standards Program Manager with expertise in MEP, Refrigeration, and Control systems who will manage the building systems engineering standards for developing prototypes and ongoing construction projects. This position will serve as a department expert and act as a "bridge" between the department and the broader organization. The position requires strong working knowledge in a wide variety of building types and systems (both the design of such systems and also installation and maintenance).

This is a high-visibility, high-impact role for someone who is energized by building structure where there is ambiguity, who can translate complex technical requirements into clear standards, and who thrives in an organization where influence matters more than authority.

Key job responsibilities
Engineering Design Standards Ownership:
- Own MEP/R, FP engineering design standards.
- Establish and maintain standards with cross-functional partners, including basis of design (BOD) for technical disciplines to meet company criteria and cost targets.
- Manage equipment specifications and design coordination.

Technical Innovation & Cost Management:
- Execute MEP/R cost reduction, energy conservation, and sustainability goals.
- Lead technical innovation initiatives for building systems and quality control.

Consultant & Vendor Management:
- Cultivate relationships with 3P engineering consultants and manage production of engineering documents.
- Track consultant quality and cost, own relationships with MEP/R, Low Voltage, Structural, and Controls consultants, and manage commissioning standards.

Quality Assurance & Technical Support:
- Conduct site inspections and facility audits. Provide technical expertise to Pre-Construction, Design, Construction, Facilities, and Operations teams.
- Support preventative maintenance SOPs and partner with Facilities to ensure systems align with established standards.

Cross-Functional Collaboration:
- Serve as SME for MEP/R and Controls topics.
- Work cross-functionally to share best practices, provide engineering solutions for site-specific designs, and review construction documents for accuracy and cost targets.
- Proven ability to efficiently plan and prioritize deliverables and resources across multiple projects
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills
- Strong organizational skills and attention to detail
- Demonstrated ability to make creative design recommendations and articulate technical justification to diverse stakeholders

A day in the life
You will partner with 3P engineering consultants to develop programmatic MEP/R design guardrails and articulate design justification to different groups within the organization. You will value-engineer MEPR systems and reduce overall program costs while ensuring the customer experience is not affected. You will attend meetings as required to address specific issues, make decisions and find solutions quickly and with confidence. You will take ownership of your work, display a great deal of initiative, and exercise sound judgment.

About the team
The WWRGD Design Standards Team develops and maintains integrated design standards and programmatic design resources for Amazon's retail portfolio enabling architects of record and contractors to efficiently deliver consistent, high-quality store environments at scale. Our products include specifications , construction assemblies, reference architectural sets, and digital tools including Revit/BIM resources. We support all store formats, from Daily Shops to Large Format Suburban stores and new exploratory formats, and we coordinate alignment across format-specific brand experiences.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Technology, or Reliability Engineering
- 6+ years of engineering experience
- Strong working knowledge of building systems design, installation, and maintenance with focus on refrigeration design and controls
- Experience with value engineering and cost reduction while maintaining quality standards
- Experience managing stakeholder expectations, schedules, budgets, and scopes
- Experience managing 3P engineering consultants

Preferred qualifications

- Professional Engineer (PE) license
- Experience with grocery refrigeration and controls design
- Experience with Amazon or retail construction projects
- Experience with commissioning standards and processes
- Knowledge of sustainability, energy conservation, and carbon reduction strategies

title: Data Center Logistics Manager
descriptionHtml:
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

Be a part of operating the world’s largest cloud computing infrastructure! Amazon Web Services is seeking a motivated professional for a Data Center Logistics Manager position. The ideal candidate possesses a strong work ethic, attention to detail, the ability to meet deadlines, and a commitment to Operational Excellence.

The Logistics Manager is responsible for the oversight of multiple spare parts rooms located in staffed and un-staffed Data Centers. The role incorporates analyzation and continuous improvement around effectiveness of work methods, procedures, controls, and staffing. Our Logistics Managers ensure performance plans are set, maintained, continuously improved upon, and difficult problems are met with creative solutions to achieve highly accurate and timely inventory movement throughout our Data Centers.

Key job responsibilities
Logistics Operations Leader- It is the manager’s responsibility to guarantee the organization is running smoothly, ensuring our service meets the expectations and needs of our customers and business on a daily, monthly and yearly basis. Some of these operational tasks include:
Developing performance goals and objectives to achieve customer promise expectations and ensure accuracy and quality
Building and executing productivity plans by reviewing work forecasts, determining productivity requirements, and partnering with other Logistics Managers to balance labor
Determine timelines that meet business and customer expectations; ensure they are met
Partnering with the management team to establish and maintain quality control standards
Remove roadblocks and obstacles for major initiatives

Logistics Business Leader- It is the manager’s responsibility to act as a Logistics business leader by doing the following:
