title: Infirmier(ère) de Santé Au Travail et Prévention (H/F), Workplace Health and Safety
descriptionHtml:
Chez Amazon, la santé et le bien-être de nos collaborateurs sont une priorité absolue. En tant qu'Infirmier(ère) de Santé au Travail, vous serez au cœur de notre mission : créer l'environnement de travail le plus sûr possible. Vous travaillerez au sein d'une équipe pluridisciplinaire Santé et Sécurité, alliant prévention, soins, formation et gestion des urgences. Ce poste allie présence terrain et gestion administrative, avec une utilisation régulière d'outils informatiques (suite Office et outils internes Amazon). Il offre une variété de missions, des opportunités de développement professionnel au sein du réseau Amazon, et un package de rémunération et avantages attractif.

Key job responsibilities
En tant que membre à part entière de l'équipe Hygiène, Sécurité et Environnement (HSE), vos missions couvrent un périmètre large :

1 - Suivi Médical et Accompagnement des Collaborateurs : Organiser et réaliser les entretiens infirmiers et visites médicales réglementaires, assurer leur suivi via nos logiciels dédiés. Conduire des actions de conseil en santé et des campagnes de sensibilisation ciblées (TMS, gestes et postures, hygiène de vie). Accompagner le service RH et les managers dans l'aménagement des postes de travail pour favoriser le maintien dans l'emploi, en étroite collaboration avec une équipe pluridisciplinaire (psychologue, assistante sociale, ostéopathe, ergonome).

2 - Gestion des Situations d'Urgence et Formation Secourisme : Former et encadrer les Sauveteurs Secouristes du Travail, réaliser les soins d'urgence selon les protocoles médicaux. Analyser les interventions pour identifier les axes d'amélioration et participer aux enquêtes d'accidents du travail et de maladies professionnelles.

3 - Prévention des Risques Professionnels : Soutenir l'analyse ergonomique et assurer la prévention des risques sur le terrain. Gérer le suivi statistique des accidents du travail. Mener des observations régulières afin d'identifier les situations à risque, assurer leur traçabilité via nos outils internes et contribuer à la mise en place des actions correctives.

4 - Contribution active à la démarche Sécurité : Au-delà de vos missions santé, vous prenez part activement à la démarche sécurité du site : réalisation d'audits, support aux programmes dédiés, contribution aux analyses de risques. Vous réalisez des routines sécurité, analysez les données et déployez de manière autonome des plans d'action.

5 - Coordination et Gestion de l'Infirmerie : Assurer la liaison entre le service de santé interentreprise et les équipes opérationnelles. Gérer l'infirmerie (pharmacie, matériel) et tenir les registres réglementaires sur support numérique (soins infirmiers, accidents bénins, recueils d'incidents). Coordonner les approvisionnements de premiers secours et les fiches d'exposition aux risques, et échanger les bonnes pratiques avec le réseau d'infirmier(e)s français.

A day in the life
Vous occupez un rôle clé au sein de l'équipe Hygiène, Sécurité et Environnement (HSE). Votre quotidien sera dynamique et impactant, centré sur la création d'un environnement de travail sain et sécurisé. Vous alternerez entre la réalisation d'entretiens de santé, l'apport d'une assistance médicale, et l'analyse, l'anticipation et le traitement proactif des enjeux de santé au travail. Une partie de votre temps sera également dédiée aux taches administratives via nos outils informatiques : gestion des visites médicales, analyses de données sur tableur, et utilisation des outils internes Amazon.

About the team
L'équipe Workplace Health and Safety (WHS) joue un rôle essentiel pour garantir le bien-être mental et physique de nos collaborateurs au travail. Notre équipe travaille avec les responsables, les associés et les administrations locales sur l'ensemble de nos sites, en assurant le respect des politiques d'Amazon et des réglementations légales, et en garantissant la sécurité de nos environnements de travail. L'équipe offre une variété d'opportunités, des Techniciens de Sécurité aux Responsables de Programmes. Quel que soit votre poste, vous contribuerez au développement et à la mise en œuvre de la stratégie de sécurité sur l'ensemble du réseau.


Bienvenue à la Santé et Sécurité d'Amazon (WHS): https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=fVaTP7PgIVU&list=PL9JNmYfQa0bga3URD0fiGvGz0bzGd0nnZ&index=56

Basic qualifications

- Diplôme d'État d'Infirmier(ère) exigé
- Maîtrise de la suite Microsoft Office : Excel (tableaux de bord, statistiques), Word (rapports, protocoles), PowerPoint (présentations, sensibilisations), Outlook (communication, planification)
- Aisance avec les outils informatiques et capacité à utiliser des logiciels en anglais dans un contexte professionnel ; des formations internes sont prévues pour vous accompagner dans leur prise en main
- Rigoureux(se) et organisé(e), capable de prioriser et gérer plusieurs tâches simultanément, avec une attention particulière à la qualité de la documentation
- Adaptable, flexible et ouvert(e) d'esprit, à l'aise dans un environnement dynamique et sensible à l'amélioration continue
- Excellent relationnel et capacité à instaurer une relation de confiance avec l'ensemble des parties prenantes : collaborateurs, managers, équipes HSE, service RH, médecine du travail, partenaires externes et direction
- Engagement quotidien pour que les principes de Santé au Travail soient intégrés dans l'ensemble de nos processus

Preferred qualifications

- Formation complémentaire en santé au travail fortement appréciée (DIUST, DU, Master Santé au Travail)
- Une première expérience en santé au travail est un plus
- Un niveau d'anglais opérationnel constitue un réel avantage pour votre développement professionnel et vos futures opportunités d'évolution au sein de nos équipes
- Vous êtes reconnu(e) pour votre leadership et votre capacité d'innovation
- Vous aimez challenger le statu quo et proposer des solutions créatives

Amazon est un employeur engagé pour l'égalité des chances. Nous sommes convaincus qu'une main d'oeuvre diversifée est essentielle à notre réussite. Nous prenons nos décisions de recrutement en fonction de votre expérience et de vos compétences. Nous apprécions votre envie de découvrir, d'inventer, de simplifier et de construire. La protection de votre vie privée et la sécurité de vos données constituent depuis longtemps une priorité absolue pour Amazon. Veuillez consulter notre Politique de Confidentialité pour en savoir plus sur la façon dont nous collectons, utilisons et traitons les données personnelles de nos candidats.

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. title: Operations & Logistics Internship, Amazon Logistics
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Operations is the backbone of the Amazon customer experience. With over 50 fulfilment centres, hundreds of delivery stations, and tens of thousands of employees, the team works together to efficiently deliver items to customers. In the fulfilment centres, millions of items are picked and packed annually, while delivery teams work to get orders to customers on time. Safety is the top priority, and the operations culture is defined by teamwork, diversity, and a shared work ethic that keeps the business running smoothly. The team takes pride in delivering the quality service Amazon is known for globally.

Note: You must have the right to work in the country of employment by the start date.

INTERNSHIP LOCATION: PLEASE NOTE THIS ROLE IS AVAILABLE ACROSS MULTIPLE FIELD BASED UK LOCATIONS (East Midlands), FINAL PLACEMENT WILL BE DETERMINED BASED ON BOTH YOUR PREFERRED OPTION PLUS ROLE AVAILABILITY

Key job responsibilities
As an Amazon operations intern, you'll have the opportunity to apply your analytical skills to impactful projects that enhance the functionality and service of Fulfillment Centers, Sortation Centers, and Delivery Stations. Key aspects of the role include:

- Completing high-priority projects to the highest standard, demonstrating your ability to deliver results

- Analyzing data to identify operational challenges and opportunities for improvement

- Proposing and testing solutions, collaborating with the team to implement the most effective ones

- Developing communication and teamwork skills by working with managers, stakeholders, and frontline associates.

- Be on the move within the building to engage with various teams. This includes actively gathering knowledge by participating in activities such as pre-briefs, flow meetings, and discussions with the leadership team and associates.

- Ability to navigate the workspace and move between different areas is essential for this position.

- Displaying flexibility to work various schedules and shift patterns as required.

- Potential relocation to the designated work location.

Our internships are educational opportunities that allow you, our future managers, to discover how we lead and develop our teams of associates. This internship will place you at the heart of our operations, enabling you to trace the journey of a customer order. You'll gain a realistic job preview of the full-time opportunities awaiting you within our organization.

You'll learn how our managers cultivate a safe, productive environment, harnessing the full potential of their teams through effective engagement and performance management strategies. This is your chance to develop skills that will propel you towards a rewarding career with Amazon.

You can also join specialized groups focused on areas like sustainability to explore your diverse interests.

Support:

- Exclusive learning sessions will further enhance your skills, granting you access to Amazon's cutting-edge learning platforms and the expertise of industry leaders. These structured development opportunities will prepare you for the next step in your career.

Opportunities:

title: Praktikum im Bereich Logistik - Kobern-Gondorf - Start 2027
descriptionHtml:
Du bewirbst dich auf unseren Talent Pool für Logistikpraktika mit Start ab Januar 2027. Durch eine frühzeitige Bewerbung profitierst du von:

* Frühzeitiger Berücksichtigung für verfügbare Positionen
* Bevorzugtem Zugang zu gewünschten Standorten und Startdaten
* Größerer Flexibilität bei der Terminplanung im Interviewprozess

Unser vorläufiger Zeitplan: Interviews beginnen im September, das Role Matching startet voraussichtlich im Oktober. Dieser Zeitplan kann sich je nach geschäftlichem Bedarf ändern.

Bitte beachte: Wir haben verschiedene Möglichkeiten in ganz Deutschland und benötigen Flexibilität bezüglich der Standorte. Wenn du dich für die Stelle bewirbst, gib bitte alle deine bevorzugten Standorte in Deutschland an.
Alle unsere Praktika finden vollständig vor Ort statt.
Amazon Operations ist das Rückgrat der Amazon-Kundenerfahrung. Mit über 50 Logistikzentren, hunderten von Zustellstationen und zehntausenden von Versandmitarbeiter:innen arbeitet das Team zusammen, um Artikel effizient an Kund:innen zu liefern. In den Logistikzentren werden jährlich Millionen von Artikeln kommissioniert und verpackt, während die Zustellteams daran arbeiten, Bestellungen pünktlich an die Kund:innen zu bringen. Sicherheit hat oberste Priorität, und die Betriebskultur ist geprägt von Teamwork, Vielfalt und einer gemeinsamen Arbeitsethik, die das Geschäft reibungslos am Laufen hält. Das Team ist stolz darauf, den Qualitätsservice zu liefern, für den Amazon weltweit bekannt ist.

Hinweis: Du musst zum Starttermin die Arbeitsberechtigung für das Beschäftigungsland haben.


Key job responsibilities
Als Amazon Operations-Praktikant:in hast du die Möglichkeit, deine analytischen Fähigkeiten in wirkungsvollen Projekten anzuwenden, die die Funktionalität und den Service von Logistikzentren, Sortierzentren und Zustellstationen verbessern. Wichtige Aspekte der Rolle umfassen:
• Abschluss von Projekten mit hoher Priorität nach höchstem Standard und Nachweis deiner Fähigkeit, Ergebnisse zu liefern
• Datenanalyse zur Identifizierung operativer Herausforderungen und Verbesserungsmöglichkeiten
• Vorschlagen und Testen von Lösungen in Zusammenarbeit mit dem Team zur Umsetzung der effektivsten Ansätze
• Entwicklung von Kommunikations- und Teamfähigkeiten durch die Zusammenarbeit mit Führungskräften, Stakeholdern und Versandmitarbeiter:innen.
• Bewegung im Gebäude, um mit verschiedenen Teams zu interagieren. Das umfasst aktives Wissenssammeln durch Teilnahme an Aktivitäten wie Vorbesprechungen, Ablaufmeetings und Diskussionen mit dem Führungsteam und Versandmitarbeiter:innen.
• Die Fähigkeit, sich im Arbeitsbereich zu orientieren und zwischen verschiedenen Bereichen zu wechseln, ist für diese Position unerlässlich.
• Flexibilität bei verschiedenen Arbeitszeiten und Schichtmustern nach Bedarf zeigen.
• Möglicher Umzug an den vorgesehenen Arbeitsort.


A day in the life
Unsere Praktika sind Bildungsmöglichkeiten, die es dir als unserer zukünftigen Führungskraft ermöglichen, zu entdecken, wie wir unsere Teams von Versandmitarbeiter:innen führen und entwickeln. Du tauchst in die schnelllebige, komplexe Welt unserer Logistikzentren, Sortierzentren und Zustellstationen ein und erlebst, wie unsere Führungskräfte ihre Teams einsetzen, um Kundenerwartungen zu erfüllen.
Dieses Praktikum versetzt dich ins Herz unserer Abläufe und ermöglicht es dir, den Weg einer Kundenbestellung zu verfolgen. Du erhältst einen realistischen Einblick in die Vollzeitchancen, die dich in unserem Unternehmen erwarten.
Du lernst, wie unsere Führungskräfte eine sichere, produktive Umgebung schaffen und das volle Potenzial ihrer Teams durch effektive Einbindung und Leistungsmanagement-Strategien nutzen. Das ist deine Chance, Fähigkeiten zu entwickeln, die dich zu einer lohnenden Karriere bei Amazon führen werden.


About the team
Praktikant:innen-Community:
• Als Amazon-Praktikant:in bist du Teil einer lebendigen, unterstützenden Community, die dein Wachstum und deine Entwicklung fördert. Du arbeitest mit Praktikant:innen aus der ganzen Welt zusammen, knüpfst Kontakte und nimmst an sozialen Veranstaltungen teil, um deinen Horizont zu erweitern. Du kannst auch spezialisierten Gruppen beitreten, die sich auf Bereiche wie Nachhaltigkeit konzentrieren, um deine vielfältigen Interessen zu erkunden.
Unterstützung:
• Das Praktikumsprogramm bietet ein robustes Unterstützungssystem, einschließlich wöchentlicher Praktikant:innen-Sprechstunden, spezieller IT- und HR-Unterstützung sowie einem Programmteam, das sich deinem Erfolg verschrieben hat. Das stellt sicher, dass du die Anleitung und Hilfe hast, die du zum Gedeihen brauchst.
Lernsessions:
• Exklusive Lernsessions werden deine Fähigkeiten weiter verbessern und dir Zugang zu Amazons modernsten Lernplattformen und der Expertise von Branchenführern gewähren. Diese strukturierten Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten bereiten dich auf den nächsten Schritt in deiner Karriere vor.
Möglichkeiten:
• Nach erfolgreichem Abschluss des Praktikums kannst du für eine Absolvent:innen-Stelle oder ein zweites Praktikum in Betracht gezogen werden, was es dir ermöglicht, deine Reise mit Amazon fortzusetzen. Zusätzlich erhältst du ein wettbewerbsfähiges Monatsgehalt, Umzugsunterstützung und Zugang zu einer Reihe von Mitarbeitervorteilen.
Praktikums-Starttermine über das Jahr:
• Wir stellen Praktikant:innen ein, die jederzeit von Januar bis Juli 2027 anfangen können. Jeden Monat führen wir 1-2 Onboarding-Tage für neue Mitarbeiter:innen durch.
Internal job description

Basic qualifications

- Derzeit im vorletzten oder letzten Jahr und auf dem Weg zu einem Universitätsabschluss in Supply Chain, Business/Management, Ingenieurwesen oder einem anderen verwandten Bereich.
- Berechtigt, ein Vollzeit-Praktikum von 3-6 Monaten zu absolvieren.
- Sehr gute Kenntnisse in gesprochenem und geschriebenem Englisch und der Landessprache des Landes, für das du dich bewirbst (Gemeinsamer Europäischer Referenzrahmen C1).

Preferred qualifications

- Starke Problemlösungs- und Analysefähigkeiten mit der Fähigkeit, Prozessverbesserungen und innovative Lösungen zu identifizieren.
- Ausgezeichnete Kommunikations- und Teamfähigkeiten, fähig zur effektiven Zusammenarbeit mit anderen.
- Bewiesene Neugier, Proaktivität und Bereitschaft, Herausforderungen in einem unklaren, schnelllebigen Umfeld anzunehmen.

title: Applied Scientist,  Amazon Robotics
descriptionHtml:
Are you interested in how to build AI reasoning systems that give provably correct answers? Are you excited by science at the interface of classical AI reasoning and Large Language Models (LLMs)? Would you like to apply your technology to serve operations customers better?

Amazon Robotics is looking for a talented Applied Scientist. You will innovate on combining language models (LMs) with classical AI reasoning. You will work with a team of scientists and engineers to achieve this. You will publish your results in papers at leading venues in AI. You will be part of a larger team and have the opportunity to work on problems such as: using LMs to generate plans, using AI reasoning to verify plan correctness, learning efficient reasoning strategies, self-improving models. You will work on basic science and on business problems in robotics, automation and fulfillment across our operations.

Key job responsibilities
In this role you will:
• Work closely with other scientists and engineers, and be part of Amazon’s diverse global science community.
• Publish your research in top-tier academic venues and hone your presentation skills.
• Be inspired by challenges and opportunities to invent new techniques in your area(s) of expertise.

A day in the life
You'll meet regularly with your technical lead and your team on your ideas, get guidance and feedback, work together on architectures and algorithms, author papers, build AI systems, all with the aim of delivering results for your operations customers. You'll work closely with other scientists to review your plans and results. You'll meet with engineers to implement your ideas at scale.

About the team
The Veritas team is a science team working at the boundary between language models and classical AI reasoning. We work across on customer problems in fulfillment, automation and robotics. We focus on high quality research science informed by practical problems.

Basic qualifications

- Experience in building models for business application
- Experience in patents or publications at top-tier peer-reviewed conferences or journals
- Experience programming in Java, C++, Python or related language
- Experience in any of the following areas: algorithms and data structures, parsing, numerical optimization, data mining, parallel and distributed computing, high-performance computing
- Experience implementing algorithms using toolkits and self-developed code
- PhD or equivalent research experience, or a Master's degree and experience in CS, CE, ML or related field research
- Publication record in top tier venues in generative AI reasoning or classical planning
- Experience in reinforcement learning or neuro-symbolic AI
- Practical experience with PyTorch, the HuggingFace ecosystem, SageMaker, and RL tools

Preferred qualifications

- Experience using Unix/Linux
- Experience in professional software development
- Experience demonstrating software engineering skills in a previous intership, work experience, coding competitions, or publications, or experience in software development and experience that includes strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and effective communication abilities
- Experience using AWS tools and services - including AWS batch, Boto, S3, EC2 etc
- Strong skills in experimental design/statistical analysis

title: EMEA GTM Senior BDM, GTM Surge Acceleration
descriptionHtml:
Senior Business Development, EMEA GTM Surge Acceleration

Are you interested in joining our EMEA GTM Surge Acceleration team to drive transformational Generative AI adoption for our most strategic enterprise customers?

We are looking for a seasoned Senior Business Development lead with experience driving AI and cloud adoption across priority industries, creating opportunities and accelerating production deployments for EMEA's largest and most complex accounts.

You will be the trusted advisor helping C-suite leaders, you will live at the intersection of industry expertise, executive advisory, and AI-powered business transformation.

You'll join a high-impact, lean team of senior industry-specialized advisors who combine deep sector knowledge with commercial acumen and orchestration capability — peers who have worked at leading enterprises, management consultancies, technology companies, and system integrators before joining AWS.

The ideal candidate will have both business development and industry consulting background, with experience working with customers in ISV Independent Software Vendors with demonstrated experience interacting at the CxO/VP level, and with a strong understanding of Generative AI, Agentic AI, and the technical depth to credibly engage with solution architects and technical specialists.

This role requires a strong passion for customers, a high level of comfort navigating ambiguity in undefined AI spaces, and a keen sense of ownership to set vision, build strategy, and deliver measurable production outcomes.

You will own and drive the AI engagement lifecycle across a portfolio of strategic Surge accounts — from opportunity identification through industry diagnosis, use case prioritization, build team orchestration, and production deployment; lead customer engagements at the C-suite and Line-of-Business level; translate industry-specific business challenges into actionable GenAI use cases — connecting business pain points to AWS AI services, partner solutions, and proven replicable architectures; build relationships with Line-of-Business executives, not just IT procurement; collaborate cross-functionally with account teams, solution architects, GenAIIC, ProServe, ISVs, and industry partners; represent AWS at selected industry events and contribute to thought leadership content including POVs, executive briefs, and referenceable demos.

Your experience would come from engaging key C-suite and Line-of-Business stakeholders for creating pipeline and accelerating AI transformation deals at major enterprise customers across EMEA.


A day in the life

A significant portion of your day will involve customer engagement at the C-suite level and support to account teams across EMEA. You will travel as needed to customer sites, industry events, and customer meetings.

title: Engineering Operation Technician, PHX65 DCEO
descriptionHtml:
Join our dynamic team and become a critical guardian of technological infrastructure! As a Data Center Engineering Technician, you'll play a pivotal role in maintaining the heartbeat of mission-critical technology infrastructure, ensuring seamless operations that power global digital experiences. Your expertise will directly contribute to maintaining an extraordinary 99.999% uptime, keeping the digital world running smoothly and efficiently.

Engineering Technicians are Amazon’s front line when it comes to hands-on electrical and mechanical equipment troubleshooting. They will maintain, operate, and troubleshoot, Data Center Operation’s Mission Critical Facilities, which includes stand-by diesel generators and related fuel systems, as well as three phase electrical systems such as: switch gear, UPSs, PDUs, wet cell batteries and associated systems, CRAC, centrifugal chillers, cooling towers/water chemical system, air handlers and associated systems, pumps, & motors.

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

This role supports data centers in various operational stages. The position may be assigned to a facility still under development, which could require travel to established locations for training until your designated site becomes fully operational.

title: Embedded Software Manager, Mobile Robotics
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Robotics is seeking a Software Development Manager to lead an embedded software team building the safety-rated sensor processing firmware that lets one of the world's largest autonomous robot fleets operate safely alongside people. You will lead a team of embedded software engineers who own real-time safety applications, sensor processing pipelines, and system interfaces on heterogeneous multi-core MCU/CPU/GPU platforms: the firmware that enables robots in Amazon facilities worldwide to detect and respond to obstacles reliably. This is a hands-on leadership role: you will set technical direction, grow and develop the team, and own delivery of firmware that meets the rigor of IEC 61508 functional safety certification.

We are looking for a manager who pairs people leadership with strong technical depth in embedded or safety-critical systems. This is a highly technical role, not a purely people-management one: you should be able to dive deep in design and safety-analysis discussions, review architecture and code with authority, make sound architectural trade-offs, and earn the technical trust of a team that writes code where correctness is not optional. You will coach engineers, hold a high bar on design and code quality, and partner effectively across electrical, mechanical, functional safety, navigation, and manufacturing teams.

Key job responsibilities
The ideal candidate is passionate about building the right solutions for our customers, developing great engineers, and raising the bar for associate safety at Amazon scale. As the manager of this team, you will:

- Hire, coach, and develop a high-judgment, bar-raising team of embedded software engineers.
- Own the technical roadmap, delivery, and operational excellence for your team's portfolio of safety-rated firmware.
- Set and uphold engineering standards across the sensor processing pipeline: from driver integration through point cloud generation to real-time collision detection.
- Partner with electrical, mechanical, functional safety, navigation, and manufacturing teams to close failure modes identified in failure mode analyses.
- Represent the team in safety certification, design reviews, and third-party witness testing, ensuring artifacts meet the rigor required for IEC 61508.
- Make transparent trade-offs between long-term architecture and near-term delivery, balancing safety, performance, and schedule.

A day in the life
No two days are the same. You might start in 1:1s and a design review, helping an engineer think through a black-channel diagnostic or a latency budget. Before lunch you negotiate scope for the next certification milestone with functional safety and navigation. In the afternoon you head to the test floor alongside your engineers and the electrical and QA teams: is it firmware, hardware, or a faulty sensor? In between, you unblock the team, give feedback on a design, and think ahead about hiring and architecture. Our managers own it all, from their engineers' growth to what ships to production robots.

About the team
The AR Firmware organization is the world-leading embedded software team behind many of the robotic systems Amazon Robotics deploys: fleets of over 1M drive units and safety-critical products that let associates work alongside robots safely. Within it, the Safety Perception team owns the safety-critical firmware in Proteus, Amazon's first robot that can safely share a work area with people. We specialize in the bandwidth and complexity of depth cameras, LiDARs, iTOFs, and dTOFs, and in proving under certification that those sensors meet requirements across all operating conditions. We keep safety software lean, prioritize test infrastructure early, and sweat the details so others do not have to.

Basic qualifications

- 3+ years of engineering team management experience

title: Product Manager, Claims Automation & Integrations , On-Road Incident Management (ORIM)
descriptionHtml:
We are seeking a Product Manager to own the strategy, roadmap, and execution of claims-related integrations and automation capabilities across our incident and claims ecosystem. This role will focus on reducing operational friction, improving data quality, and accelerating claims handling through scalable workflows connecting internal systems, third-party administrators (TPAs), insurers, and business stakeholders.
The successful candidate will work backwards from customer and operational pain points to identify opportunities for automation, streamline cross-functional processes, and improve end-to-end claims outcomes. This role requires strong product judgment, stakeholder management, and the ability to translate complex business workflows into scalable product solutions.


Key job responsibilities
• Own the product roadmap for claims automation, workflow optimization, and third-party administrator (TPA) integrations
• Define and prioritize product requirements that improve claims intake, triage, assignment, investigation, litigation support, and resolution processes
• Partner with Claims, Risk, Legal, Insurance, Operations, and Technology teams to identify opportunities to reduce manual effort and improve customer experience
• Develop business cases and success metrics for automation initiatives, measuring impact on claim cycle times, operational efficiency, and cost reduction
• Establish mechanisms to identify workflow bottlenecks, data quality issues, and integration gaps across internal and external claims systems
• Drive requirements for integrations with TPAs, insurance carriers, legal vendors, and other external partners
• Create and maintain product documentation, business requirements, process maps, and stakeholder communications
• Influence cross-functional teams without direct authority to deliver business outcomes across multiple organizations
• Use data and customer insights to continuously improve claims workflows and operational performance


A day in the life
You start the morning reviewing claims routing metrics, spotting a spike in manual assignments for a specific TPA. You pull the data, identify a missing integration rule, and draft a requirement to fix it. Mid-morning, you join a sync with a TPA partner to align on data exchange specs for a new litigation workflow. After lunch, you review a BRD with engineering, negotiate scope trade-offs, and update your roadmap priorities. You close the day by prepping a business case showing how last quarter's automation work reduced cycle times by 15%.

About the team
The On-Road Incident Management (ORIM) builds the systems that connect Amazon's logistics incident management ecosystem to the partners who resolve claims on behalf of customers, drivers, and third parties. We sit at the intersection of insurance, operations, and technology, designing automated workflows that move claims data between internal platforms and external administrators. We prioritize simplicity, speed, and accuracy because every claim represents a real person waiting for resolution. You'll work alongside product managers, program managers, and engineers who care deeply about reducing friction in complex, high-volume operational processes.

Basic qualifications

- 3+ years of product management experience
- Experience managing technical products or online services
- Experience in product, program, or project management in leading cross-functional teams in delivery of major new products or services

Preferred qualifications

- Knowledge of SQL and VBA at an advanced level
- Experience building and analyzing cost/benefit scenarios and business cases and communicating results throughout the organization
- 5+ years of product management experience
- Experience developing operational processes and technologies
- Experience with claims management systems, insurance operations, Third-party administrators (TPAs), or auto litigation workflows.

title: Area Manager, Early Career (2027) – PA, DE
descriptionHtml:
Power that runs the world | Discover careers in Operations

Operations roles at Amazon put you at the center of how things move from a click to a doorstep. You'll help design, improve, and run systems that connect people, products, and places, at scale. You'll take ownership early, work closely with teams to solve real-world challenges, and see the direct results of your decisions as they reach customers every day. Here, the impact of what you build isn't abstract, it's visible, immediate, and meaningful - keeping one of the world's most complex operations moving forward. This is where your journey takes shape through action, responsibility, and the opportunity to grow in many directions.

This is not a corporate, remote or office-based position. This is a full-time, early career position located within one of Amazon’s fulfillment centers, sort centers, delivery stations or other operations buildings. Amazon is seeking customer focused individuals to lead a team of hourly employees across our Operations network! Our warehouses are fast-paced environments where standing, walking, and having on-the-production floor conversations are common as a supply chain leader.

As an Area Manager, you will be responsible for engaging, leading and developing your team in a warehouse environment. Your main focus will be motivating, mentoring, and managing your team to meet goals. Amazon provides extensive training and development to become an exceptional people leader. As a people manager, you will ensure that your team has all the tools needed to succeed and maintain the highest levels of safety, quality, attendance and performance at work.

Visit this page to find more information on each of our building types. https://www.aboutamazon.com/workplace/facilities

Please note we are not able to provide sponsorship now or in the future for these positions. Eligible candidates must have work authorization without employer intervention to be considered.

This posting encompasses all openings in the country. Site placement is matched by aligning your location preferences with location availability after your interview. Relocation benefits are offered at time of offer to eligible candidates.

Benefits: Medical, financial, and/or other benefits. Visit this page to learn more about the benefits Amazon offers. https://www.amazon.jobs/content/en/our-workplace/benefits-us

Key job responsibilities
• Support, mentor and motivate 50-100 direct report Amazon Associates.
• Work independently and operate in an autonomous environment.
• Stand/walk during shifts lasting up to 12 hours.
• Willing and able to regularly work shift patterns that include nights, weekends, and/or holidays based on business needs. While shifts vary site to site, most follow a fixed 4-day work week with 3 days off.
• Oversee truck deliveries, handle and sort packages using pallet jacks, operate PIT. equipment (at applicable facilities) and step in as needed.
• Work in an environment where the noise level varies.
• Lift up to 49 pounds and frequently push, pull, squat, bend and reach.
• Climb and descend stairs (when applicable).

A day in the life
As an Area Manager, no two days look exactly the same, but every shift gives you the chance to lead a team, solve real problems, and directly impact how millions of customers receive their orders.
Start of Shift: Set the Tone
• Get a handoff from the outgoing manager and review what's carrying over so nothing falls through the cracks.
• Lead a team huddle to kick off the shift. Huddles are used to align on goals, safety priorities, and key focus areas.
• Confirm your team is in place, positioned for success, and ready to go before operations begin.
Middle of Shift: Lead from the Floor
• Walk the floor regularly to stay connected to your team, spot issues early, and keep things running smoothly.
• Drive results across safety, quality, and productivity — balancing all three in real time.
• Adjust staffing and resources as volume and priorities shift throughout the day.
• Coach and develop your team members, respond to challenges as they come up, and partner with support teams to remove roadblocks.
• Keep peers and leadership informed on how the shift is tracking and flag risks before they become problems.
End of Shift: Close Strong
• Do a final walkthrough to make sure your area is clean, organized, and set up for the next team's success.
• Review your shift's performance data and capture what went well and what to improve
• Hand off to the incoming manager with a clear picture of priorities, open items, and next steps.
• Wrap up any remaining administrative tasks so you leave the shift with a clean slate.
• Every shift, you'll see the direct results of your leadership: from the energy of your team to the packages that reach customers' doorsteps. This is where your decisions have real, visible impact.

Basic qualifications

- Currently has, or is in the process of obtaining a bachelor’s or master’s degree. (You must have all degree requirements met before your first day).

Preferred qualifications

- Strong communication skills, both verbal and written.
- Excellent customer service and interpersonal skills.
- Currently enrolled in a Bachelor's program for Supply Chain, Business/Management, Engineering or another related field.

title: Senior Process Engineer, NA SSD Network, Sub Same Day Process Engineering
descriptionHtml:
Amazon is building the next generation software, hardware, and processes that will run the global network of fulfillment centers that move many millions of units of inventory, and ensure that customers get what they want faster than ever. We do this by building automated solutions to handle things that technology does well, while relying on people to handle things that humans do well.

We are constantly innovating in the ways we are automating and accelerating the delivery of products and packages which includes building custom hardware and applying robotics, autonomy, supply chain optimization, machine learning, manipulation, image processing, and real-time data processing using distributed systems.

Sub Same Day (SSD) Engineering is looking for a Senior Process Engineer with a strong delivery record and proven project management experience to own strategic and tactical, cross-functional operations and technology projects associated with (SSD) facilities.

As a Senior Process Engineer for Amazon, you will work with some of the most talented engineers in the design, development, and delivery of physical distribution systems around the globe.

You will lead initiatives and complex cross-functional projects or programs that focus on the building of new, the alteration of existing, and the closing of end-of-life material handling and technology systems. As a working leader, you are able to take the lead on the implementation and delivery of large system designs and advanced technology in ambiguous and complex problem spaces.

You integrate systems for safety, security, stability, and efficiency. You participate in the full system development life cycle, working within broadly defined parameters, including test plan execution and solution quality needs.

You must be responsive, flexible, and able to succeed within an open collaborative environment. Amazon’s culture encourages innovation and expects engineers to take a high-level of ownership in solving complex problems.

If you are a leader with enhanced focus on Quality, strong problem-solving skills, excellent communication skills, an ability to influence business and technical leaders in a dynamic environment with the desire to contribute to Amazon's next generation fulfillment technology, this opportunity is for you.

Joining our team provides the unique challenge and opportunity to deploy systems that benefit millions of customers.

The ideal candidate will draw upon exemplary leadership skills, program and project management, critical thinking, and problem-solving capabilities.

The candidate should be open to new tasks, innovative, creative, self-directed and a great team player. Candidate should drive continuous process improvement, and collaborate effectively with cross-functional operational and development teams to solve problems and implement new solutions.

Travel expected between 50% and 70%.


Key job responsibilities
- Design Process: Develop new processes or modify existing ones, focusing on equipment, workflows, and material flow, select and specify equipment required for the process, ensuring it meets productivity goals and safety standards, analyze and optimize existing processes to identify areas for improvement to reduce waste, increase efficiency, and minimize costs.
- Ensure quality and safety: Develop and implement testing methods to ensure product standards, ensure processes adhere to safety regulations and standards, and investigate, resolve issues that may arise.
- Collaboration and Communication: partner/ collaborate with critical stakeholders ensuring safety, quality, and efficiency gains, effectively communicate technical information to stakeholders, including technical and non-technical audiences.
- Monitoring and Analysis: monitor process performance, collect and analyze data for further improvement, leverage data analysis techniques to understand process behavior, trends to make informed decisions.
- Utilize emerging technologies: leverage process simulation tools to model and analyses processes, research and implement new technologies to improve process efficiency and effectiveness.

A day in the life
As a Senior Process Engineer, you will work across organizations to find solutions for complex problems, innovating on behalf of our customers. You will be engaged in tactical and some strategic problem solving and decision-making. You will drive efforts, individually or in collaboration to optimize productivity, prioritizing high impact projects. Your strong communication skills will be required when you present documents and findings to senior leadership. Your experience in conducting root cause analysis, will help in implementation of long-term solutions. You will be traveling (50%) to sites to ensure practical outcomes match theoretical ones.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Electrical or Mechanical Engineering, Engineering Technology, Reliability Engineering
- 5+ years of directly managing and being responsible for multiple large projects experience
- 5+ years of in material handling equipment (MHE) or automation environments experience, or experience in reliability/maintenance environments
- Experience and strong technical background in relevant fields of automated or non-automated material handling equipment
- Work flexible schedule including weekends, nights, and holidays

Preferred qualifications

- Master's degree in engineering, mechanical, operations, supply chain, business administration, or equivalent STEM field
- Experience in Lean Management, Six Sigma and other operations engineer tools
- Experience building launch readiness frameworks, standard work, playbooks, and scalable deployment mechanisms across multiple concurrent sites
- Experience with performance metrics such as OEE (Overall Equipment Effectiveness), downtime, throughput, or quality
- Experience in Amazon RME (Reliability, Maintenance, and Engineering), fulfillment operations, or automation deployment environments
- Knowledge of AutoCAD, VBA, and SQL at the intermediate level

title: Senior Manager, Bus Mechanical Engineering, Amazon Leo
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Leo is Amazon's low Earth orbit satellite network. Our mission is to deliver fast, reliable internet connectivity to customers beyond the reach of existing networks. From individual households to schools, hospitals, businesses, and government agencies, Amazon Leo will serve people and organizations operating in locations without reliable connectivity.

Export Control Requirement: Due to applicable export control laws and regulations, candidates must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.

The Senior Manager, Bus Mechanical Engineering is responsible for the mechanical realization of the Amazon Leo satellite bus across its full lifecycle - from architecture and design through qualification, production, and launch operations.

This role leads multiple mechanical verticals, including bus structures, avionics mechanical, harness engineering, launch support, and vehicle design, and ensures they operate as an integrated system. The Senior Manager provides single-threaded ownership for mechanical tradeoffs, interface management, and execution across concurrent vehicle configurations, balancing technical rigor, producibility, schedule, and mission risk.

This role manages frontline engineering managers, partners closely with peer electrical, thermal, and production organizations, and serves as the primary mechanical authority in system-level decision forums.

Key job responsibilities
- Lead and develop a manager-of-managers organization spanning structures, avionics mechanical, harnessing, launch support, and vehicle design

- Own mechanical architecture, integration strategy, and cross-vertical trade decisions at the satellite bus level

- Serve as the single mechanical interface to peer electrical, thermal, structural analysis, manufacturing, NPI, and production organizations

- Ensure mechanical designs scale effectively into qualification and high-rate production with consistent quality and configuration control

- Own mechanical readiness across development, production, integration, transport, and launch operations

- Resolve complex, high-judgment technical and organizational tradeoffs with lasting vehicle and program impact

- Establish integration standards, escalation paths, and decision frameworks to reduce late-stage risk and execution churn

- Drive headcount planning, skill mix, and long-range staffing strategy across multiple job families

- Represent bus mechanical engineering in senior leadership reviews, system forums, and milestone readiness assessments

A day in the life
In this role, you balance system-level decision making with organizational leadership. Your day may include reviewing cross-discipline tradeoffs with electrical and thermal peers, aligning managers on priorities across multiple vehicle configurations, and resolving integration or production issues that span teams. You participate in system and readiness reviews, guide escalation on high-risk mechanical decisions, and partner with production and launch teams to ensure execution remains aligned with mission goals. Throughout the day, you coach managers, set technical direction, and ensure the organization is operating as a cohesive, execution-focused system.

About the team
The Bus Mechanical Engineering team is responsible for translating satellite architecture into a qualified, producible, and launch-ready vehicle. The organization spans structures, avionics mechanical, harnessing, launch support, and vehicle design, working closely with electrical, thermal, manufacturing, and operations partners. The team operates in a fast-paced environment with multiple vehicle variants in parallel, emphasizing strong integration, disciplined decision-making, and ownership of outcomes. Collaboration, accountability, and a focus on mission success are core to how the team works.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, or an equivalent field
- 10+ years of new hardware products development experience
- 5+ years of people management, managing engineers experience
- Demonstrated experience owning mechanical system integration across multiple subsystems (e.g., structures, avionics packaging, harnessing, launch or operational interfaces)
- Proven track record of leading hardware through full lifecycle phases, including design, qualification, production, and operational readiness
- Experience making high-judgment technical and organizational decisions with program-level impact on cost, schedule, and mission risk
- Strong cross-functional leadership experience, partnering with electrical, thermal, manufacturing, quality, and operations organizations

Preferred qualifications

- Master's degree in Mechanical or Electrical Engineering or a related field
- Experience supporting high-rate production of complex hardware systems with multiple concurrent configurations or block upgrades
- Experience leading manager-of-managers organizations in a technical environment
- Background in launch vehicle integration, satellite deployment systems, or launch operations
- Familiarity with structural, dynamic, and environmental qualification standards for space hardware
- Experience operating in large, matrixed engineering organizations with multiple peer senior stakeholders
- Demonstrated ability to scale engineering organizations through growth, change, or rapid program evolution

title: Principal Data Scientist, Core Shopping Data Science
descriptionHtml:
Every day, hundreds of millions of customers arrive on Amazon's Homepage, search for a product, and land on a detail page. Along the way, some of what we show them is irrelevant — a recommendation that misreads what they want, a widget that repeats what they just saw, a headline that doesn't say what it means, a product that shouldn't have been surfaced at all. We have built the ability to detect these defects at scale using Large Language Models (LLMs), and we report them to Amazon's most senior leadership as a company-level measure of shopping quality. What we have not yet built is the confidence to act on every one of them.

That is the problem you will own.

Today, the most consequential categories of shopping defects — product quality, duplication, staleness,
irrelevance — go largely unenforced. Not because we cannot detect them, but because we have not
yet clearly defined when they lead to customer dissatisfaction. These are genuinely hard questions. When is a recommendation irrelevant rather than merely unexpected? When are two products duplicates rather than legitimate alternatives? Every answer carries consequences for customers and advertisers.

As Principal Data Scientist, you will own the analytical rigor behind Amazon's store quality metrics end-to-end: how they are defined, how faithfully our LLM implementations execute those definitions, and how accurate the resulting judgments actually are across relevance, presentation, product quality, and duplication. You will go deep enough to inspect individual model judgments and read the edge cases where they break, then come back up to argue definitional questions with the leaders who own the outcomes on both sides. You will also define experiments that will turn judgement into facts backed by data.

Your influence will come from deep dives so well-constructed that stakeholders across two large organizations change their minds. Getting there means building the tooling that makes rigor repeatable rather than heroic: agents that walk the store the way a customer would, automated inspection of experiments, and feedback loops that finally connect what customers tell us directly to the metrics we optimize. Much of the customer voice we already collect goes underused today; you will change that. You will begin on the Homepage, where measurement is most mature, then extend the methodology to Detail Page and Search — carrying not just the metrics but the standard of evidence with them.

Key job responsibilities
- Validate store quality metrics end-to-end: inspect metric definitions, audit LLM implementations, and evaluate LLM judgment accuracy across quality dimensions (relevance, presentation, product quality, duplicates)
- Starting with Homepage, extending cross-page — identify gaps and inconsistencies between Organic and Ads treatments that block the tiered enforcement framework
- Drive alignment through deep dives that present evidence to both Stores and Ads stakeholders
- Build and deliver deep-dive tooling (walk-the-store bots, automated experiment inspection via Gecko, VoC feedback loops) that make metric validation repeatable and self-serve
- Own the analytical rigor behind the alignment on definitions of subjective/debated metrics and moving them to aligned/enforceable

About the team
Core Shopping Data Science owns the measurement of shopping quality across Amazon's Core Shopping eexperiences, including defect metrics reviewed by Amazon's most senior leadership. We focus on the long term and big picture to ensure that the full Amazon shopping experience balances strategic trade-offs. We work across Stores and Advertising, partnering with personalization, ranking, and search teams to turn measurement into changes customers can feel.

Basic qualifications

You bring a graduate degree in a quantitative field — statistics, computer science, economics, operations
research, or similar — or equivalent depth built through experience, along with substantial industry
experience as a data scientist, including a track record of technical leadership on ambiguous, high-visibility problems. You are fluent in statistical inference, experimental design, and sampling methodology, and you write production-quality code in Python and SQL. You have owned metrics that other organizations made decisions with, and you have defended them under scrutiny.

Preferred qualifications

We are especially interested in candidates who have evaluated large language models as judges or annotators and understand where that approach fails; who have driven measurement alignment across organizations with genuinely competing incentives; and who have built the tooling that made their own analysis reproducible for others. Experience with e-commerce search, recommendations, or advertising quality is valuable, as is a history of communicating quantitative findings to senior executives in writing.

descriptionHtml:

The AZIM Operations team is the first line of defense in understanding network trends, delays, dwells and other exceptions that impact AZIM’s ability to deliver a world class transportation product that serves its customers on time.

- Use internal systems to gather data from multiple sources to support reporting on a daily, weekly, monthly and quarterly basis

title: Data Center Technician
descriptionHtml:
Join our dynamic AWS team and become a critical guardian of global cloud infrastructure! You'll play a pivotal role in maintaining the heartbeat of the world's most innovative technology platform, ensuring seamless data center operations that power millions of businesses and services worldwide.

Data Center Technician position involves in-depth hardware and network diagnostics followed by physical repair as well as participating in an on-call rotation.

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

NOTE: Amazon does not sponsor for immigration, including for H-1B, TN, and other non-immigrant visas, for this role.

NOTE: Lump sum stipend will be provided to eligible candidates who relocate for this position.


Key job responsibilities
• Performing server rack installations, hardware break-fix on various components, troubleshooting network issues, responding to operational incidents that impact service availability, and carrying out routine network, server hardware, and operating system repairs to contribute to the overall availability of AWS services
• Serving as a primary contact point for both internal and external stakeholders, including engineers, software developers, vendors, and contractors
• Performing on-call duties and participating in scheduled maintenance and change management activities
• Contributing to documentation and process improvement initiatives based on your analysis of operational issues
• Helping to interview, train and onboard new team members

Physical Requirements:
• Lifting and moving material up to 40 pounds each
• Working in cramped and/or elevated locations
• Bending, lifting, stretching, and reaching
• Standing and walking for up to 8+ hours a day
• Ascending and descending ladders, stairs, and gangways safely and without limitation
• Work in an industrial environment
• Work shifts longer than 8 hours to support 24/7 operations (covering both night and day shifts).
• This role supports data centers in various operational stages. The position may be assigned to a facility still under development, which could require travel to established locations for training until your designated site becomes fully operational.

Essential Requirements:
• Ability to travel to or commute between data center locations as needed
• Willingness to temporarily work at alternative sites during training periods or until assigned facility is operational
• Travel frequency will vary based on business needs and operational status of assigned facility
• Candidates must be able to travel (over 50 miles) or commute (less than 50 miles) to active data center sites as required by business needs.


A day in the life
Our Data Center Technician professionals, who have industry-leading technical abilities and demonstrate a breadth of knowledge while they:
• Take ownership of technical issues brought by their customer base, engaging other teams when needed to drive resolution
• Show a strong aptitude for troubleshooting and problem solving
• Solve problems at their root and step back to understand the broader context
• Maintain service level agreements through the implementation of proactive issue detection and reporting
• Are biased to act in the absence of direction or support
• Improve effectiveness through process innovation
You will be required to work shift work that will include days/nights/weekends/holidays.

Basic qualifications

- Work a flexible schedule including weekends, nights, and holidays
- 18+ months of computer/server hardware troubleshooting or related IT experience
- 18+ months of computer layer 1/2 networking experience (including troubleshooting and repair)

Preferred qualifications

- Experience in a data center or other critical environment
- - Bachelor's degree or equivalent professional or military experience in an IT-related field (e.g. computer science, network engineering, etc.)
- - Industry standard certifications (CompTIA, CCENT, Network+)
- - Understanding of Linux or similar operating systems
- - Behavioral interviewing and hiring experience
- - Experience training and onboarding of new team members

title: Senior Antenna & RF Engineer, Amazon Leo
descriptionHtml:
Amazon LEO is an initiative to increase global broadband access through a constellation of 3,236 satellites in low Earth orbit (LEO). Its mission is to bring fast, affordable broadband to unserved and underserved communities around the world. Amazon LEO will help close the digital divide by delivering fast, affordable broadband to a wide range of customers, including consumers, businesses, government agencies, and other organizations operating in places without reliable connectivity.

As an Antenna Systems Engineer supporting the development, test, and design of antenna and RF Front-End, you will design, integrate, and characterize antennas and arrays across multiple domains (phased arrays, reflectors, aperture antennas, and other relevant topologies). You will own “ADC-to-antenna” RF performance, collaborating with RF, systems, and calibration teams to deliver high-performance RF systems and links for both space and ground segments.

You’ll split your time between EM design tools, RF system analysis, and lab validation, working on high volume antenna design from concept to deployment.

Key job responsibilities
- Design and optimize antenna and array architectures (element selection, lattice, feeding networks, beam-forming strategies) to meet RF system goals.
- Own end-to-end RF performance from ADC/DAC through RF front-end to antenna radiation, working closely with RFIC, PA/LNA, and system teams.
- Use EM and RF design tools (e.g., HFSS, CST, AWR, or similar) to simulate element/array performance, mutual coupling, scan loss, and pattern characteristics.
- Collaborate with calibration, software, DSP, ASIC, and validation teams to define system strategies (array calibration, beam equalization, phase/amplitude error mitigation, IFFT gains, and more) and measure on-bench and in-chamber performance.
- Define and maintain antenna specifications and requirements at the module, aperture, and system level.
- Support prototype builds, bring-up, and test campaigns for active antennas, including chamber testing and over-the-air validation.
- Provide DFM and DFT feedback for antenna boards, modules, and test fixtures.
- Write design reports, test summaries, and present results to leadership and cross-functional partners.
- Develop and deploy code to support testing, simulation, and validation of antenna systems.

Export Control Requirement
Due to applicable export control laws and regulations, candidates must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.

Basic qualifications

- Master's degree in electrical engineering, computer engineering, or equivalent
- 5+ years of experience in antenna design, RF system design, or front end design
- Experience in MATLAB or Python
- Experience with one of the mainstream antenna simulation tools (CST, HFSS...)

Preferred qualifications

- Experience in phased array development, including antenna and RF system design

title: Senior Software Dev Engineer, Enrollment Experience - Benefits Experience & Technology (BXT)
descriptionHtml:
Enrolling in benefits today means navigating dense plan comparisons, decoding jargon, and hoping you picked the right coverage before a deadline closes. For the agents who support employees, it means toggling between disconnected systems, memorizing policy nuances, and spending 27+ minutes on complex calls that should resolve in under ten. We are changing both by making AI a strategic partner across the entire benefits experience: software that understands what a person needs, personalizes the journey to their life situation, and guides them — or the agent helping them — to a confident resolution at the moment of need. This is a generative-AI, agentic-engineering, and experience-architecture role first, at very large scale.

What you will lead:

A reimagined enrollment experience where AI is a strategic partner for employees making benefit decisions. Rather than walls of plan text, it understands who someone is — family situation, population segment, geography, past elections — and delivers personalized plan recommendations, real cost-per-paycheck impact, and coverage comparisons in plain language. Agentic MCP tools let employees self-serve enrollment actions through natural-language conversation: staging elections, handling qualifying life events, and managing dependent verification, all without navigating a portal.

A reinvented Benefits Management Console (BMC) that transforms how call-center agents support enrollment for a workforce of millions. The next-generation BMC surfaces the employee's full context instantly, displays intelligent adaptive workflows that adjust to case complexity, recommends next-best-actions for edge cases, automates routine verification and notification workflows, and learns from every resolution. The goal: dramatically reduce average call handling time and let agents focus on judgment and empathy rather than system navigation.

You will be the tech lead across both experiences, owning the shared architecture that powers personalized enrollment across all surfaces and the agentic foundations that let AI participate meaningfully in both employee self-service and agent-assisted workflows.

We build AI-native. In our model, humans own judgment and agents own the mechanical middle. Engineers write the specification and set the acceptance criteria; agents (Claude Code, Kiro) write a growing share of the implementation, author tests, and resolve code-review comments; engineers direct, validate, and own what ships, and still hand-write the novel, ambiguous, and infrastructure-heavy work where models fall short.

As a Senior Software Development Engineer, you are the tech lead for your team's product. You lead a system of many features across its full lifecycle — enrollment orchestration (BFF on Apollo GraphQL serving four surfaces), population-aware personalization, agentic tool architectures (MCP-based chatbot tools with consent handling and multi-turn state management), and next-generation agent workflow systems. You own the team-level architecture, make the high-stakes decisions, and review others' work — human-authored and agent-authored alike. You stay hands-on in the code and code reviews that matter most.





Key job responsibilities
• Lead your team's software development end to end: own the team-level architecture for enrollment orchestration, population-aware personalization, and agent console systems. Provide system-wide design guidance across all surfaces (mobile, web, chatbot, agent console) and make the high-stakes, hard-to-reverse technical decisions.

• Be the tech lead on large, ambiguous problems that span multiple organizations — enrollment flow architecture, agentic self-service, agent workflow reinvention, and claims-based plan simulation — where the customer direction is clear but the technology strategy is not. Drive clarity and align partner teams on the path forward.

• Own how AI participates in enrollment: design MCP tool contracts, multi-turn conversation state management, consent and authorization handling, confidence-based escalation, and the boundary between what AI does autonomously and where humans stay in the loop.

• Architect consent-gated, HIPAA-compliant pipelines for claims data ingestion and plan simulation — employee authorization frameworks, PHI handling, and personalized cost projections derived from actual utilization history.

• Architect the next-generation BMC that reduces call handling time: adaptive workflows that surface context and recommended actions, AI-driven automation of routine steps, and displays that adjust to case complexity and agent authorization level.

• Lead the team's AI Native build loops: define the specs, acceptance criteria, and simulation coverage that let agents safely take on more implementation work. Shape the agentic foundations (Bedrock AgentCore, MCP) the team builds on. Stay hands-on in the code and reviews that most affect the product.

• Lead and mentor engineers: coach multiple engineers on and off your team, drive adoption of engineering best practices, and hold human-authored and agent-authored work to the same high bar. Drive operational excellence including alarms, telemetry, runbooks, and root-cause resolution across team boundaries.

• Work backwards from the customer, bringing experience design judgment to technical decisions — partner with UX designers, technical writers, and communications strategists to ensure what gets built is also what gets understood and adopted by employees.



A day in the life
What the day-to-day looks like: you'll operate on a multidisciplinary team of SDEs, UX designers, and technical writers where every member owns real surface area — there are no inherited systems to passively maintain. Open enrollment dates are immovable, so you'll ship under genuine deadline pressure with genuine decision-making authority. You own production end to end, including on-call. You'll partner with UX designers on enrollment flows, collaborate with technical writers on how policy changes reach employees, and work with program managers to sequence delivery across teams. The technical breadth is uncommon: enrollment orchestration across four surfaces, a plan simulation engine ingesting claims data under HIPAA-compliant consent frameworks, population-aware personalization for corporate/WFM/operations employees, agentic chatbot tools for conversational self-service, and an agent console redesign aimed at cutting handle time in half — production agentic systems, regulated data engineering, experience orchestration, and AI-native methods in one seat.

This role is for tech leads who think in systems that serve people at sensitive moments — not just engineers who build features. You'll architect the full spectrum: from consent-gated pipelines that securely process claims data under HIPAA to the personalized recommendation surface that tells an employee "based on your family's actual usage, this plan saves you $1,200 next year." You'll own the boundary between what AI can do autonomously and where a human must stay in the loop. If you want to lead a team that ships production agentic systems, handles regulated health data with rigor, and measures success in reduced decision anxiety for employees and reduced handle time for agents — not just story points closed — this is a rare opportunity to own that end to end.

About the team
You will join Benefits Experience Technology (BXT), the Amazon organization reinventing how more than 1.5 million employees and their families experience benefits enrollment — and how the specialists who support them operate. Our vision is enrollment that is AI-powered, personalized, and proactive, and an agent console that is intelligent, workflow-driven, and fast.

Basic qualifications

- 5+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
- 5+ years of programming with at least one software programming language experience
- 5+ years of leading design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
- Experience as a mentor, tech lead or leading an engineering team

Preferred qualifications

- 5+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
- Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent
- Experience building scalable, distributed, front-end experiences
- Experience developing, deploying and managing AI products at scale
- Experience architecting personalization or segmentation systems serving multiple user populations at scale
- Experience designing production agentic or conversational systems, including MCP tool architectures, multi-turn state management, and confidence-based escalation patterns
- Experience with GraphQL (Apollo Server preferred), React/TypeScript, and cloud-native infrastructure (AWS ECS, Lambda, API Gateway, DynamoDB, CloudFront)
- Demonstrated experience designing production systems that incorporate LLM-based agents, with frameworks such as Amazon Bedrock AgentCore, Model Context Protocol, Claude Code, or Kiro
- Experience building HIPAA-compliant systems or handling protected health information in production environments
- Track record of designing intelligent workflow systems for operational users with measurable impact on handle time or efficiency
- Experience in benefits, HR tech, fintech, or healthcare domains where decision-support UX and compliance requirements intersect

title: Principal HR Business Partner, Amazon International Stores (AIS) PXT
descriptionHtml:
Amazon International Stores (AIS) People Experience & Technology (PXT) Team is seeking a strategic and solution-focused Human Resources Leader to power the trajectory of our business by ensuring we have the right talent mix, senior leadership, and capabilities to innovate and deliver exceptional customer experiences. This role will directly partner with VP of International Seller Services (ISS) as we empower sellers by building innovative solutions across multiple programs that serve millions of sellers globally.

In this Principal HRBP role, you will be the strategic link between multiple PXT partners and our business leaders, driving forward-thinking talent strategies (Strategic Workforce Planning, Org Design transformation, site strategies, re-imagining talent needs, etc.) across an international matrix that align with and enable our business priorities around the globe. The role requires a strategic thinker who can translate complex business challenges into simplified people solutions, influence across multiple stakeholder groups, and implement talent strategies that enable ISS to scale effectively while maintaining Amazon's unique culture. Your strong business acumen will be crucial in translating organizational goals into actionable HR strategies and initiatives. You'll serve as a trusted advisor, providing executive coaching and influencing decision-making at all levels of the organization.

The ideal candidate will have a proven track record of partnering with business leaders to drive strategic initiatives. You should possess excellent communication skills (including doc writing), the ability to diagnose complex issues, and the capability to influence long-term solutions and outcomes. Your expertise in change management, coupled with your ability to thrive in a fast-paced, ambiguous environment, will be crucial in this role.

If you are a strategic thinker with a passion for working in a fast paced and growing environment with customers that are leading industry innovations and have a drive to excel in a dynamic, global setting, we want to hear from you. Your role will be instrumental in fostering an environment where both our business and our people can thrive and grow.

title: Sr. Operations Manager
descriptionHtml:
Help shape the future of fulfillment alongside passionate, talented people who are obsessed with delivering for customers.

As a Senior Operations Manager at our OAK4 site in Tracy, CA, you'll be at the helm of a large-scale operation that delivers for millions of Amazon customers every day. This is your opportunity to lead, innovate, and make a measurable impact on one of the world's most customer-obsessed supply chains.

Be part of something extraordinary from Day One!

What You'll Do
- Own the operation – Take full accountability for budgetary performance, people development, and operational excellence across your functional area (Inbound or Outbound).
- Lead and develop leaders – Manage, coach, and mentor a team of Operations and Area Managers, setting clear expectations and holding them accountable while building the next generation of Amazon leaders.
- Drive continuous improvement – Champion Lean initiatives, process innovations, and quality programs that push your team and the FC to exceed business goals.
- Deliver a world-class customer experience – Ensure safety, quality, and performance standards are met or exceeded every single day.
- Collaborate cross-functionally – Partner with HR, Finance, Facilities, Safety, IT, and peer leaders to secure resources, share best practices, and drive site-wide success.
- Cultivate ideas – Source and nurture innovative ideas from your team, translating them into actionable improvement plans that raise the bar across the network.

- Growing city – Tracy is the second-most populous city in San Joaquin County and it's part of the greater San Francisco Bay Area Combined Statistical Area

- Amazon hub – Tracy is one of few cities in the world to have multiple Amazon facilities within city limits
- Year-Round Great Weather – Tracy enjoys mild winters and hot, dry summers, making it ideal for outdoor activities like hiking and biking year-round

- Close to Weekend Getaways – Residents enjoy quick access to Lake Tahoe, Yosemite National Park, Napa Valley wine country, and the California coast
