title: Optical Development Manager, Amazon Leo
descriptionHtml:
Amazon LEO is an initiative to launch a constellation of Low Earth Orbit satellites that will provide low-latency, high-speed broadband connectivity to unserved and underserved communities around the world.

You will lead a multi-discipline team responsible for development of optical communication systems between satellites. You will own the design, build, and verification of custom optical metrology stations used to build, test, and manufacture optical Inter-satellite Link systems.

Export Control Requirement:
Due to applicable export control laws and regulations, candidates must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.

Key job responsibilities
Lead the design, build, and qualification of optical system and metrology for build, test, and manufacturing of optical Inter-satellite Link systems.
Define and maintain a clear understanding of optical test requirements needed for qualifying optical systems, ensuring alignment across engineering and production teams.
Oversee optical module design validation testing and ensure delivery of optical test engineering reports for Program Reviews.
Drive resolution of technical problems arising in optical testing and manufacturing by developing optimal strategies and guiding the team toward solutions.
Champion the development of new and improvement of existing optical measurement methods, leveraging metrology equipment such as interferometers, cameras, imaging systems, and Hartmann sensors for optical module integration, alignment, and testing.
Ensure the team develops and maintains MATLAB/Python scripts for data analysis and visualization required for stakeholder review.
Own the development of measurement processes and procedures for volume manufacturing and lead the transfer to the production team.

A day in the life
You will tackle challenging, novel situations every day and have the opportunity to work with multiple technical teams at Amazon in different locations. You should be comfortable with a high degree of ambiguity and relish the idea of solving problems that haven't been solved at scale before. Along the way, we guarantee that you will learn a lot, have fun and make a positive impact on millions of people.

About the team


Basic qualifications

- 8+ years of experience in optical systems development across full product life cycles, from concept to production, with 3 years of direct management experience leading technical teams through design, qualification, and manufacturing transitions.
- Experience leading teams working with lasers, detectors, modulators, optical fiber and devices, and optical metrology equipment such as interferometers, cameras, imaging systems, and Hartmann sensors, including oversight of testing and characterization programs.
- Experience defining and driving optical metrology strategies for component and system-level test and qualification.
- Experience in physical and geometric optics, Gaussian beam propagation, and detection, with the ability to guide team members and review technical work in these domains.

Preferred qualifications

- PhD in Optical Engineering, Physics, Electronics, or related discipline, or equivalent experience
- Expertise in imaging and non-imaging optical design using Zemax or equivalent software
- Ability to lead interdisciplinary discussions across Hardware, Reliability, Firmware, and Manufacturing teams to drive alignment on optical test strategies
- Experience building and scaling automated testing and system characterization capabilities for production environments
- Ability to provide thought leadership and strategic input on new initiatives as well as programs underway
- Proven ability to regularly engage with senior stakeholders and influence across the organization to drive program decisions
- Deep knowledge and experience with precision optical components and systems, including fiber optics components and handling of optical fiber
- Strong organizational, analytical, and problem-solving skills with the ability to prioritize across multiple concurrent programs

descriptionHtml:
DC Security is looking for a Program Manager to own and drive Program Fortify and related training/career development initiatives for our global security workforce. title: Software Development Engineer, EC2 Nitro High Memory and HPC team
descriptionHtml:
Utility Computing (UC)
AWS Utility Computing (UC) provides product innovations — from foundational services such as Amazon’s Simple Storage Service (S3) and Amazon Elastic Compute Cloud (EC2), to consistently released new product innovations that continue to set AWS’s services and features apart in the industry. As a member of the UC organization, you’ll support the development and management of Compute, Database, Storage, Internet of Things (Iot), Platform, and Productivity Apps services in AWS, including support for customers who require specialized security solutions for their cloud services.


EC2 Nitro drives the planet’s largest, fastest growing and most feature-rich compute cloud. Nitro is AWS’s ground-up design for virtualization at global scale built on a fully custom stack of hardware, firmware and applications. Nitro has enabled EC2 to support Intel, AMD and Amazon’s custom silicon - Graviton3 - while raising the industry bar for security and performance across our product line. The Nitro Team is looking for engineers with systems knowledge and experience in area such as Linux OS boot sequencing, Kernel, Hypervisor (Xen or KVM), peripheral device development (PCIe or NVMe) and building compute infrastructure to support High Memory and High performance computing workloads.
The Nitro High Memory and HPC team owns the purpose built platform development for the High performance computing workloads and database workloads like SAP, Oracle and SQL with tens of terra-byte of memories. Team interfaces directly with system BIOS for bare-metal instances and drives critical system interactions within the Nitro Hypervisor and across EC2 control-plane services. We need engineers with the dive-deep and ownership to work across domains (such as PC peripheral firmware or Linux Kernel internals) to deliver features and new instance types for our customers. Work is typically done in C/C++ or Rust with supporting script and tests in Python and Lua.


About the Team
Our team is dedicated to supporting new members. We have a broad mix of experience levels and tenures, and we’re building an environment that celebrates knowledge-sharing and mentorship. Our senior members enjoy one-on-one mentoring and thorough, but kind, code reviews. We care about your career growth and strive to assign projects that help our team members develop your engineering expertise so you feel empowered to take on more complex tasks in the future.
Diverse Experiences
AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
About AWS
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
Inclusive Team Culture
Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (gender diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.
Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.
Mentorship & Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.
10017

Basic qualifications

- 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
- 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
- Experience programming with at least one software programming language

Preferred qualifications

- 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
- Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

title: People Manager, Operations Program Management (OPM), Product Operations
descriptionHtml:
Product Operations is looking for a People Manager to lead a team of Operations Program Managers (OPMs) responsible for driving NPI program execution across Amazon's Devices portfolio (Echo, Tablet, Kindle, FireTV). This role owns the performance, growth, and delivery output of a team operating in ambiguous, cross-functional environments where problem definition and strategy are not always predetermined. You will manage resource allocation across 25–30+ concurrent NPI programs, partner with Finance, Quality/AME, Supply Chain, and Hardware Engineering on program governance frameworks (e.g., 9-Block classification), and build the mechanisms that make your team's work auditable, data-driven, and scalable without your direct involvement in every decision.


Key job responsibilities
Team & People Management
• Own hiring, onboarding, and career development for a team of OPMs; proactively recruit bar-raising talent with NPI/program management expertise
• Build and share customized onboarding plans so new OPMs ramp quickly on programs, tools (Milestone Manager, NPI Data Hub), and process
• Run regular 1:1s tying performance evaluation to growth trajectory; lead the promotion process for OPMs demonstrating next-level scope; act as career sponsor for lateral moves
• Evaluate team members against role guidelines; participate in and begin leading calibration to ensure fair, consistent evaluation
• Identify underperformance early, document expectations and timelines clearly and respectfully
• Establish a psychologically safe team culture; actively listen and act on team feedback (reallocating work, escalating broken mechanisms)
• Manage workload sustainability; partner with leadership to remedy systemic overload rather than absorbing it silently
Scope, Influence & Execution
• Define metrics for program health, resource utilization, and operational excellence across the NPI portfolio
• Own resourcing decisions for the team — balance tactical program coverage against strategic hiring/restructuring needs (e.g., off-roadmap program gaps, Bee cohort resourcing)
• Drive cross-functional alignment with Finance, Quality/AME, and Supply Chain on shared frameworks (9-Block, SPOR thresholds, gating requirements)
• Own regular reporting mechanisms (MBR, OP1/OP2 inputs) that make program and team performance auditable to leadership
• Negotiate priorities across programs and product lines; make explicit trade-offs between short-term coverage and long-term team capability building
• Build audit mechanisms and self-sustaining processes (e.g., mechanisms with permanent BIE/OPM ownership rather than manager-dependent)
Problem Complexity & Communication
• Lead a team accountable for a cross-cutting program area spanning multiple product lines, not a single isolated workstream
• Present program and team performance narratives to leaders up to three levels above (L10); write clear, structured narratives (MBR, OP1/OP2, COEs)
• Resolve contentious cross-functional issues (e.g., GCM/MPM role conflicts, off-roadmap HC gaps) by building consensus among stakeholders with competing priorities
• Communicate a team vision anchored to customer/program outcomes, not just task lists
Process Improvement
• Establish operational excellence mechanisms that reduce repeated work and defects across the OPM team's workflows
• Identify and close gaps in program governance systems (e.g., reconciliation gaps across Roadmap, Pre-Concept Tracker, Program Driven HC)
• Drive simplification of program delivery processes; reduce team exposure to recurring failure modes (e.g., late-stage ID/packaging changes, phase-skip patterns at Dev Commit→HVT)

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Math, Business, Supply Chain or other related quantitative discipline
- Experience managing people including development, hiring, performance management, and leading teams dispersed across various regions
- Experience working cross functionally across finance, marketing or supply chain
- 5+ years of project management (including scope, schedule, budget, quality, risk and critical path management) experience
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to engage both technical and non-technical audiences, including senior leadership

Preferred qualifications

- MBA or advanced degree in Business, Operations, or related field.
- Experience in NPI/hardware program management (consumer electronics or similar regulated hardware environment).
- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to translate complex business needs into actionable strategies

descriptionHtml:
The Relay Operations Center (ROC) Tech and Operations Integration (OI) team is dedicated to the development and integration of technology that advances efficiency and elevates operational standards of the ROC. We act as liaison between Amazon Transportation Services (ATS) Product and ROC Ops execution teams, to ensure that tech development aligns with customer needs and operations' priorities at a global scale. Beyond technology adoption, we build and deploy AI-powered automation that reshapes how disruption management work gets done across the ROC organization.

ROC Tech and OI is looking for a Senior Program Manager to own strategic, cross-functional programs that deliver internal AI solutions across ROC Global operations. This role owns the journey from validated use case to production-ready tool: identifying high-friction, high-volume workflows, prototyping AI-assisted solutions hands-on (using LLM-based tools, prompt engineering, and low-code/no-code workflow builders), and partnering with engineering teams to scale what works into standardized, compliant global mechanisms. The ideal candidate is comfortable pressure-testing what automation can and cannot do before committing engineering resources, evaluating external AI solutions for ROC applicability, and assessing how ROC-built tools can scale to other teams and business units. Collaborating across tech, operations, and program teams, the Senior Program Manager will standardize tech advancements and drive the adoption of Work Item Management Systems (WIMs) globally. They will monitor program progress, identify risks, and communicate effectively with senior management, providing regular status updates and proposing solutions for challenges encountered. As a champion of ROC Tech and OI's global expansion goals, they will optimize resource allocation and achieve parity through the strategic implementation of Disruption Management technology standardization scaled to new teams and geographies.

Key job responsibilities
- Manage full lifecycle of complex cross-functional, tech and automation-related programs with considerable impact across multiple organizations
- Identify, prototype, and scale AI-assisted automation solutions: build proof-of-concept workflows using GenAI/LLM tooling and AI workflow builders, validate them against real operational use cases, and partner with engineering teams to productionize
- Lead scoping for cross-team AI opportunities, including evaluating external solutions for ROC applicability and assessing how ROC-built tools can scale to other teams and business units
- Partner with engineering, legal, and security stakeholders to ensure AI solutions minimize risk through reliable performance, human-in-the-loop design where appropriate, and standardized integration with the existing tech stack
- Work with various stakeholders to identify goals, roadblocks, gaps, and solutions, with a bias toward automation-first solution design
- Ensure stakeholder policy documentation needs are met internally and externally for our customers' needs
- Develop the overall program strategy (mission, vision, tenets), set objectives, and drive improvements that are quantified with metrics, tactically driving teams in and outside of your organization to deliver
- Work autonomously in an ambiguous environment, seeking to understand business problems, automation limitations (including where LLMs are and are not the right tool), scaling factors, boundary conditions, and reasons behind leadership decisions
- Partner with teams across the business you support and beyond to source, allocate, and coordinate resources
- Partner with internal/external teams and engineering teams to determine what projects move forward and in what priority order, with prioritization grounded in data
- Oversee gaps between teams, processes, and systems, helping teams reduce exposure to classic failure modes (e.g., requirements not sufficiently understood or documented, ineffective cross-team collaboration, long-term impact(s) from third-party solutions, security not considered, insufficient stakeholder review, etc.)
- Solve ambiguous problems and proactively identify and mitigate risks before they become roadblocks
- Work with program managers, business leaders, and the executive team to communicate and impact critical business initiatives
- Develop, implement, and govern Key Performance Indicator (KPI) reporting for a portfolio of programs, providing visibility to milestones and performance across all projects, including quantified automation impact (e.g., work items deflected, handle-time reduction, decision accuracy)
- Engage other Amazon business units globally to share AI automation best practices and improve end-to-end outcomes for Amazon customers
- Favor automation over human intervention; pursue and deliver enhancements that eliminate the need for manual communication and improve quality
- Prioritize long-term vision over short-term return
- Core understanding of intra-day operations and the broader supply chain middle mile network

A day in the life
The Tech and Operations Integration Senior Program Manager will focus on developing strategy to scale the ATS middle mile network through AI-driven automation and technology standardization. A typical week blends builder work and program work: prototyping an LLM-assisted workflow for a Disruption Management use case, advancing a validated solution toward production with engineering partners, reviewing automation performance metrics with operations stakeholders, aligning with product on the WIMs roadmap, and presenting program status and risk mitigation plans to senior leadership. This Program Manager works between product, engineering, and operations, acting as a liaison to drive continuous improvement on behalf of internal and external Amazon customers.

About the team
The ROC Tech and OI team is dedicated to the development of technology that advances efficiency and elevates operational standards of the Relay Operations Center. To that end, we act as liaison between MMPT (Middle Mile Product Team) and ROC Ops teams, to ensure that feature development aligns with customer needs and operations' priorities at global scale. The key objective of the ROC Tech Team is that all ROC Teams should on Relay technology to the extent that enables ROC to grow as a global organization with geographically agnostic team structures.

Basic qualifications

- 5+ years of program or project management experience
- Experience owning program strategy, end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership
- Experience using data and metrics to determine and drive improvements

Preferred qualifications

- Experience with a variety of digital workflows
- Experience carrying design concepts through exploration, development, and into deployment or mass production
- Experience in creating process improvements with automation and analysis, or experience working with large-scale data mining and reporting tools (i.e. SQL, MS Power Query, Python)
- Master's degree or above in Management, Business Administration, Economics, Engineering, or Marketing

title: Sr. ICT Design Engineer, Data Center Design Engineering
descriptionHtml:
About AWS Infrastructure Services
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we're the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we're looking for talented people who want to help.

You'll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You'll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you'll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.
________________________________________
About the Role
As a Senior ICT Design Engineer, you will serve as a technical leader within a global engineering organization comprised of highly effective Architects, Structural, Civil, Mechanical, Electrical, Security, and Controls Engineers. You will be a primary driver of ICT design strategy, standards, and quality across multiple data center builds, regions, and partner teams.

At AWS, we're revolutionizing the design of critical communications pathways, spaces, and cabling within our data centers. We're looking for a senior technical leader who can set the standard for ICT design excellence, drive cross-discipline coordination, and accelerate our time to market — while mentoring the next generation of ICT engineers and influencing the broader infrastructure architecture.

In this role, you will own complex, multi-site ICT design programs from concept through construction administration. You will lead design reviews, define engineering standards, engage with industry suppliers and standards bodies, and drive the adoption of emerging technologies. Your contributions will have deep and far-reaching impact on partner teams, regional infrastructure architecture, and the overall AWS global data center portfolio.

This role offers a rare opportunity to shape the future of ICT design at AWS at a systems and architecture level — where your decisions influence not just individual projects, but the long-term scalability, cost-efficiency, and resilience of AWS infrastructure worldwide.

Key job responsibilities
Technical Leadership & Design Ownership
• Lead the design, development, and delivery of scalable, high-performance fiber optic and copper plant designs, pathway systems, and ICT specifications across multiple simultaneous builds and regions.
• Own the ICT architecture for complex, large-scale data center programs — including new campus greenfield builds, build-to-suit (BTS) projects, and colocation environments — ensuring designs are extensible, cost-optimized, and aligned with AWS BOD standards.
• Drive the development and continuous improvement of ICT design standards, BOD templates, specification sections, and QA/QC checklists used across the global DE organization.
• Identify and resolve complex cross-discipline coordination challenges involving civil, architectural, electrical, mechanical, and security systems, removing bottlenecks that impact project delivery.
• Take a long-term view of infrastructure design decisions, balancing short-term project needs against global architectural consistency and future scalability.
Standards, Quality & Process Improvement
• Define and enforce ICT engineering best practices, design standards, and quality benchmarks across the team and partner organizations.
• Lead and conduct design milestone reviews (30%, 60%, 90%, 100%) for ICT systems, providing technical feedback that elevates design quality across the portfolio.
• Review and approve ICT pathway, cabling, and equipment submittals, ensuring compliance with AWS standards, applicable codes, and project-specific requirements.
• Drive root-cause analysis for endemic design deficiencies and lead programmatic initiatives to resolve them — leaving systems better, simpler, and easier to maintain.
• Contribute to and lead Correction of Errors (COE) processes and Lessons Learned reviews, translating findings into actionable BOD or standards improvements.
Cross-Discipline & Stakeholder Collaboration
• Serve as the primary ICT technical point of contact for complex projects and regional programs, engaging directly with Design Managers, TPMs, Construction Managers, Security Engineers, and partner discipline leads.
• Collaborate with the Security, Electrical, Civil, and Architectural disciplines to ensure ICT pathway and cabling designs are fully coordinated and constructible.
• Partner with SPEAR, DCESS, and other AWS security stakeholders to ensure ICT designs support physical security system integration requirements (access control, CCTV, PIDS, etc.).
• Engages cross-functionally with stakeholder teams including Networking, Hardware Engineering, Network Deployment, Operations, and Capacity Planning to gather technical requirements, align on constraints, and develop infrastructure designs that meet organizational objectives and operational standards.
• Engage with industry suppliers, manufacturers, and standards bodies (TIA, BICSI, IEEE) to define product requirements, evaluate emerging technologies, and influence AWS procurement strategy.
• Support the RFP process by developing ICT scope requirements, reviewing vendor bids, and providing technical input on consultant selection and scope comprehension.
Innovation & Emerging Technology
• Identify, evaluate, and champion new ICT technologies, construction methods, and design approaches that improve infrastructure quality, reduce cost, and accelerate installation timelines.
• Lead or contribute to programmatic initiatives that drive innovation across the ICT design portfolio (e.g., unified cabling platforms, modular pathway systems, next-generation fiber architectures).
• Stay current on data center technology trends and provide informed recommendations on which technologies are appropriate for AWS facilities and which are not.
Mentorship, Hiring & Talent Development
• Actively mentor and develop ICT engineers, improving their technical knowledge, design skills, and ability to deliver independently.
• Lead and participate in the hiring process, including conducting technical interviews and providing calibrated assessments for ICT engineering candidates.
• Provide technical assessments for DCIE promotion evaluations, contributing to the professional development of colleagues across the organization.
• Train and onboard new team members on ICT architecture, AWS design standards, and cross-discipline coordination processes.
Program Execution & Travel
• Identify and respond to design risks and high-priority issues rapidly and effectively, escalating through appropriate channels when required.
• Travel 25%+ to conduct site visits, lead in-person design reviews, coordinate with onsite personnel and contractors, and validate ICT infrastructure at AWS data centers globally.

About the team
*Why AWS*
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

*Diverse Experiences*
Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

*Work/Life Balance*
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

*Inclusive Team Culture*
Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (gender diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

*Mentorship and Career Growth*
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Engineering or a related field
- 5+ years of experience in industrial or commercial engineering in mission-critical facilities, including but not limited to: data centers, power generation, or telecommunications infrastructure.
- 5+ years of ICT design experience in Mission Critical Environments, with demonstrated ownership of complex, multi-site design programs.
- 5+ years of experience developing and leading the production of design documentation (plans, specifications, BOD templates, QA/QC checklists) for construction and/or permitting.
- 5+ years of hands-on experience with fiber optic components, cabling, interconnect products, technologies, and applicable standards (TIA-568, TIA-569, TIA-942, BICSI TDMM/OSPDRM).
- Demonstrated experience driving engineering standards, design best practices, or process improvements across a team or organization.
- Experience leading cross-discipline design coordination in a large-scale infrastructure or construction program.
- BICSI RCDD Certification or internationally recognized equivalent (e.g., CDCDP, DCDC, CCTT, CNIDP).
- Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite (Outlook, Word, Excel, PowerPoint).

Preferred qualifications

- Professional Engineering or Architectural License
- Experience developing or contributing to BOD-level design standards, master specifications, or engineering guidelines for a multi-site infrastructure portfolio.
- Experience with building codes, AHJ requirements, and permitting processes across multiple jurisdictions or regions.
- Demonstrated ability to carry design concepts from exploration and development through to deployment or mass production across multiple builds.
- Experience reading, interpreting, and producing construction drawings, specifications, and submittal documents at a senior level of ownership.
- Proficiency with AutoCAD, Revit, Bluebeam, and MS Office Suite.
- Experience engaging with industry standards bodies (TIA, BICSI, IEEE) or contributing to industry publications, patents, or technical standards.
- Familiarity with physical security system integration requirements (access control, CCTV, PIDS) as they relate to ICT pathway and cabling design.

title: Manager, Design Technologist, Elevated Shopping Experience
descriptionHtml:
We are looking for a Design Technology Manager to lead a team of Design Technologists focused on generative AI tools, creative workflows, and technical innovation for éShop.

This is not a traditional design production role. The team develops new ways to create content and customer experiences through AI-powered workflows, content generation tools, multi-model systems, quality gates, agent integrations, APIs, and connections with existing production platforms.

The manager will establish the structure, priorities, and operating mechanisms that allow the team to own work from concept through production. They will lead people, manage commitments, remove barriers, negotiate priorities, and guide technical decisions across usability, scalability, integration, governance, and operational readiness.

Key job responsibilities
1. Lead and develop a team of Design Technologists focused on AI tools, creative workflows, automation, and backend innovation.
2. Set priorities, manage capacity, and allocate resources across short-term delivery and long-term strategic goals.
3. Enable end-to-end ownership by removing blockers and creating structures for independent team delivery.
4. Partner with creative, product, engineering, science, operations, and platform teams to turn business needs into scalable solutions.
5. Manage scope, commitments, escalations, and technical tradeoffs across usability, quality, scalability, governance, and production readiness.
6. Establish clear workflows, service level agreements, operating mechanisms, and best practices.
7. Ensure tools integrate with existing systems and have plans for adoption, maintenance, measurement, and improvement.
8. Drive data-informed decisions by making customer outcomes, quality, and operational performance measurable and auditable.
9. Coach team members, support career growth, manage performance transparently, and build an inclusive and autonomous team culture.
10. Simplify processes, improve operational metrics, and ensure the team’s work receives clear visibility and recognition.

A day in the life
You will partner closely with the éShop Innovation Lead to set priorities and translate creative and operational needs into practical AI tools and workflows.

Your day may include leading stand-ups, planning sprints, reviewing team capacity, removing blockers, and helping the team resolve technical or delivery tradeoffs. You will assess internal and external requests, manage stakeholders, share project updates, and align resources against the most important priorities.

You will also coach the team, review work in progress, and help ideas move from early concepts and prototypes into scalable, production-ready solutions. A key part of the role is ensuring existing tools and workflows remain reliable, secure, measurable, and easy to maintain. You will monitor performance, address defects, improve adoption, and plan ongoing updates so solutions continue to meet customer and business needs.

About the team
This role sits within éShop, the organization responsible for creating elevated product content and shopping experiences across Amazon. éShop brings together creative, production, design, technology, and operations to help customers discover, understand, and engage with products across global marketplaces. The team combines UX innovation, design technology, AI-enabled content creation, workflow development, and operational readiness to turn new ideas into scalable customer experiences.

Basic qualifications

- Experience coordinating cross-functional inputs, meeting deadlines, and effectively managing competing priorities
- Bachelor's degree
- 7+ years of experience as a Design Technologist, Creative Technologist, or equivalent role building production-quality prototypes at the intersection of design and engineering
- 3+ years of people management experience, including hiring, performance management, and team development
- Proficiency with AI and generative interfaces, node-based workflows, and agentic systems, with the ability to build functional prototypes using real model APIs and production data.
- Demonstrated ability to work on large, ambiguous problems with limited guidance and deliver results

Preferred qualifications

- Bachelor’s degree in design, computer science, engineering, human-computer interaction, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
- Knowledge of multi-model systems, agent orchestration, evaluation frameworks, and human-in-the-loop review.
- Familiarity with generative AI systems, image generation, video generation, LLM-powered interfaces, or agentic workflows
- Experience working with workflow orchestration, system integrations, or backend service dependencies.
- Familiarity with accessibility standards, design systems, and UX research integration
- Usage of generative AI tools to enhance workflow efficiency, with a willingness to learn effective prompting and evaluation practices.
- Ability to recognize opportunities where generative AI could enhance products, workflows, or customer experiences.

Unlike most support organizations, AWS Support is a self-standing business with revenue and P&L responsibility and one of the fastest growing businesses within AWS.

As Premium Support BDM, you will be part of the Enterprise Support organization. You will support the Premium Support strategy and own driving the go-to-market (GTM) efforts for Support with the objective to increase adoption for paid support offerings amongst AWS customers while maintaining target margin performance and using Support to accelerate AWS platform adoption for the customers. You will engage our customers to understand why they need Premium Support solutions (or why not, e.g., Enterprise Support or Unified Operations), what are the pain points and obstacles in their current support offering. You will identify areas for sharpening our Support proposition (e.g., a differentiated offering value and return on investment vs. price) and design and execute controlled experiments driving commercial innovation. You will quantify the impact of Support in driving AWS platform adoption, estimate the ROI, and design and execute initiatives to help accelerate our customer cloud adoption journey. You will enable the sales team to drive the day-to-day interactions with prospects selling the Support value proposition in order to build long-term business opportunity. You will engage partners to develop and pilot new Support offerings via the partner ecosystem.

The ideal candidate will possess a keen business sense and exceptional analytical skills, is able to articulate and communicate a clear value proposition across customers, partners, and within the AWS organization, and is comfortable working across internal functions and geographies. The candidate will be naturally curious, going beyond the obvious to discover unexpected insights and translate those into tangible business value.

Key job responsibilities
• Engage customers, partners, and field teams to deeply understand and measure customer value and pain points in adoption of Enterprise Support Services (Enterprise Support, Unified Operations, Migration Services, plus other new products launched throughout the year) • Analyze drivers of Enterprise Support Services adoption and identify levers for improvement • Identify, design, and execute controlled experiments in driving Enterprise Support Services adoption • Review and analyze Enterprise Support Services pricing and costing, ensuring savings are passed on to our customers • Quantify impact of Enterprise Support Services adoption on AWS Platform adoption, estimate the ROI of Support investments in accelerating AWS platform adoption • Develop and refine sales collateral, reference cases, and value proofs for customers and partners • Drive commercial innovation in Support, e.g., differentiated support offerings per customer segment. In conjunction with Field Enablement, create Support-related training programs and material for the field team so that they can properly articulate the Support value proposition • Work with stakeholders across Commercial/Public Sales, Premium Support, and Enterprise • Prepare and present business reviews to the senior Sales and BD management team • Drive Enterprise Support Services deals end-to-end with Sales.

title: Sr. Electrical Engineer, Sustainability Engineering
descriptionHtml:
The Sustainability Engineering team is seeking a Senior Electrical Engineer to drive the definition, development, and continuous improvement of electrical infrastructure standards across Amazon facilities in Europe.

You will join a team which:
• Enables EV charging infrastructure implementation through electrical design definition and review
• Develops grid infrastructure standards spanning high-voltage up to 24 kV (HV) and low-voltage (LV) systems, ensuring a coordinated and resilient approach to grid design
• Explores emerging technologies to address evolving sustainability needs, with emphasis on smart grid integration, efficiency, and resilience
• Drives end-to-end deployment of EV chargers and other sustainability technologies across European sites
• Defines processes for procurement and maintenance of electrical and sustainability infrastructure
• Owns cost budgeting, forecasting, and tracking across sustainability programmes

Possible locations for this role: Luxembourg, London, Munich, Milan, Madrid, and Barcelona

Amazon is committed to building a sustainable future for our customers, local communities, and the planet. Under The Climate Pledge, we committed to achieving net-zero carbon across our business by 2040, ten years ahead of the Paris Agreement. To get there, we need driven people who are dedicated to making a meaningful impact through sustainable energy technologies and scalable infrastructure design.

Key job responsibilities
• Own and develop electrical equipment standards, including standard designs for core electrical infrastructure in partnership with manufacturers and internal stakeholders
• Perform design validation and review to ensure compliance with established electrical standards during installation and commissioning of infrastructure
• Act as subject matter expert (SME) for LV and HV (up to 24kV) electrical systems
• Align stakeholder expectations and define technical requirements for EV charging network infrastructure and smart grid deployments
• Drive the technology roadmap for electrical infrastructure, including EV chargers, substations, energy efficiency solutions, and IoT technologies (e.g. smart metres)
• Develop business cases and present recommendations to leadership to secure approval for programme scoping and investment decisions
• Coordinate with programme managers to ensure quality and standards compliance across large-scale installations
• Drive process improvement across commissioning, audit, value engineering, and cost control activities


A day in the life
Your day could include engagement with all levels of the organisation and multiple stakeholder groups to drive short-, mid-, and long-term technical decisions with large-scale impact across the Amazon network. You will also work with partners from Operations, Reliability & Maintenance, Health and Safety, Global Fleet Product, Finance, Procurement, and external vendors to design and deploy electrical infrastructure across Amazon’s operational sites in Europe.

About the team
The Sustainability Engineering team drives the execution and deployment of EV charging infrastructure, grid connections, and smart grid solutions across Amazon’s European sites. We manage supply chain, procurement, and maintenance activities, and define the processes that ensure consistent, scalable delivery. To enable this, the team develops and continuously improves electrical standards and technologies that underpin reliable, compliant deployment at pace. We power Amazon’s sustainable growth through operational excellence and continuous innovation.

Basic qualifications

- Experience developing or delivering training programs across multiple sites or regions, or experience with technical writing
- Master’s degree or Ph.D. in Electrical Engineering or a closely related field, with experience in electrical infrastructure design, standards development, or large-scale electrical systems implementation
- Demonstrated knowledge of HV and/or LV electrical distribution systems (up to 24kV) and applicable standards

Preferred qualifications

- Experience in technical program and product management, technical development or related roles in the industrial EV charging solutions sector
- Proficiency in one or more European languages (in addition to English)
- Experience working with public grid operators or Distribution System Operators (DSOs)
- Working knowledge of national grid codes and DSO requirements in one or more EU/UK markets
- Experience with protection coordination, fault level analysis, or power systems modelling
- Chartered Electrical Engineer (CEng) or equivalent professional registration

title: Security and Loss Prevention Specialist, NA
descriptionHtml:
Worldwide Operations Security (WWOS) is the global organization that supports field Security and Loss Prevention and is designed to support Amazon’s Worldwide Operations, as well as affiliate and retail businesses.

The Security and Loss Prevention Specialist (SLP Specialist) is a key hourly position within Amazon Operations. The SLP Specialist leads the effort to efficiently and effectively protect people, product and data (lives, physical property, equipment, inventory, data, & intellectual property) in a designated building. The SLP Specialist reports to the Security and Loss Prevention Cluster Manager responsible for their geographical area, and aids them in supporting the operational team, and cross functional teams throughout the organization.

Key job responsibilities
* Conduct confidential investigations and prepare prompt written reports of theft, fraud, and critical incidents
* Contribute to the identification of vulnerabilities (e.g., loss, associate experience, process improvement, data protection, physical security infrastructure) and define appropriate mitigating actions while ensuring compliance with legal and ethical standards
* Serve as department liaison and security/crisis management subject matter expert for site leadership keeping them informed on key issues, strategies, and the department’s performance
* Develop strategies for alarm reduction and conduct system diagnostic for problematic devices by engaging and resolving issues with internal and external partners
* Domestic regional travel up to 25% of the time when applicable.
* Lift up to 49 pounds and frequently push, pull, squat, bend, and reach; Stand/walk for up to 12 hours during shifts; Work in an environment where the noise level varies and can be loud; Work in an environment that is subject to variable temperatures and weather (delivery stations include outside loading departments); Continuously climb and descend stairs (applies to sites with stairs).
* This role covers 24/7 operations and must be able to work all shifts, including nights, weekends, and holidays.

A day in the life
As a SLP Specialist, you will join a team of Security and Loss Prevention professionals providing security as a service to business customers across multiple business units within a dedicated geographical area. You will perform regular physical security audits and investigate policy violations, security-related incidents, and loss events. During your investigations, you collect information by monitoring systems and tools, analyzing data reports, and conducting interviews. Your findings help to identify vulnerabilities in our processes, and you contribute to developing mitigating measures to address them. You play a key role in maintaining the physical integrity of our fulfillment, logistics and retail operations locations by auditing and monitoring the health status of our systems with subject matter experts and external suppliers to maintain their functionality. You will interact on a daily basis with our external security service providers to ensure delivery of high-quality security services and a smooth customer experience. You also act as point of contact for multiple internal and external departments (e.g., legal, HR, security service providers, local law enforcement) and subject matter expert in Security and Loss Prevention-related matters. Finally, you deliver loss prevention-related education and awareness programs to other teams and liaise with various stakeholders on policy and procedure across all management levels.

About the team
Worldwide Operations Security (WWOS) is the global organization that supports field Loss Prevention and is designed to support Amazon’s Worldwide Operations, as well as affiliate and retail businesses, by creating and maintaining a work environment that is both prepared and secure through global security centers of excellence staffed by subject matter experts in people and asset protection. We accomplish this by creating policy and implementation guidelines; training leadership and staff; using technology to eliminate subjectivity, complexity, and variation; identifying, preparing for, and mitigating risk; and auditing our practices to ensure compliance.

Basic qualifications

- High school or equivalent
- 2+ years of Amazon (Blue Badge/FTE) experience, or 1+ year in security service, loss prevention, asset protection, investigations, law enforcement, or operations, or Loss Prevention Qualified Career Choice Graduate
- 1+ years of experience using Microsoft Office, including Excel, in a professional capacity
- Workplace incident mitigation or de-escalation and Business Continuity planning experience

Preferred qualifications

- Experience making and influencing informed decisions by leveraging data and metrics
- Demonstrated ability to work independently in a fast-paced and multi-tasking environment
- Ability to effectively communicate, collaborate, network and influence across all business levels in a diverse workforce environment
- 1+ year of leadership or management and/or supply chain experience
- Investigative interviewing experience; Wicklander and Zulawski, Loss Prevention Qualified, Certified Protection Professional, Loss Prevention Certified, Certified Forensic Interviewer, Certified Threat Assessment Certification or other relevant certifications
- Experience in physical security systems maintenance/implementation and coordinating scope of work with security vendors

title: Generator Service Technician
descriptionHtml:
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. You’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

The Generation Service Technician has safety, customer satisfaction, and business responsibilities within data center operations. The person in this role is responsible for identifying, troubleshooting, diagnosing and providing quality repairs of electrical generator systems and related engine mechanical failures. As both a technical expert and primary customer support liaison, the Generator Service Technician is responsible for maintaining consistent communication with clients to ensure an exceptional customer experience while maximizing data center availability. All necessary tools and equipment will be provided by AWS.

NOTE: Amazon does not sponsor for immigration, including for H-1B, TN, and other non-immigrant visas, for this role.

NOTE: Lump sum stipend will be provided to eligible candidates who relocate for this position.

Key job responsibilities
Daily building rounds to monitor and record information from electrical, mechanical, and fire/life safety equipment to ensure 24/7 reliability and availability

Monitor Building Management Systems (BMS) and Electrical Power Management System (EPMS)

Assist in troubleshooting of facility and rack-level events within internal Service Level Agreements (SLA)

Perform rack installs and rack decommissioning within internal SLA

Perform PM, troubleshooting, root cause analysis, and repair of electrical and mechanical equipment

Technical writing to support change management program

Monitor daily work requests and manage to resolution, and execute projects from conception to completion

On-site support of contractors, sub-contractors and vendors, ensuring that all work performed is in accordance with established practices, procedures & local legislation

Work schedule changes depending on specific site needs. Shifts can be up to 12 hours and may rotate on a predefined schedule. Some locations have on-call rotations.

Role may support more than one location/site.

Physical Requirements:

Willingness and demonstrated ability to work in the following physical conditions with reasonable accommodations:

Regularly lift and/or move up to 39 pounds independently

Participate in group lifts for 40+ pounds

Maintain balance and perform construction tasks while on a ladder

Regularly walk, use hands and fingers, handle or feel, reach with hands and arms, stoop, kneel, crouch or crawl, climb stairs, twist, bend, work above shoulders, grasp, carry, push and pull objects into position

Work in an environment requiring provided ear protection

This role supports data centers in various operational stages. The position may be assigned to a facility still under development, which could require travel to established locations for training until your designated site becomes fully operational.

Essential Requirements:

Ability to travel to or commute between data center locations as needed

Willingness to temporarily work at alternative sites during training periods or until assigned facility is operational

Travel frequency will vary based on business needs and operational status of assigned facility

Candidates must be able to travel (over 50 miles) or commute (less than 50 miles) to active data center sites as required by business needs.

A day in the life
The Generator Service Technician has safety, customer satisfaction, and business responsibilities within data center operations. The person in this role is responsible for identifying, troubleshooting, diagnosing and providing quality repairs of electrical generator systems and related engine mechanical failures.

The Generator Service Technician is both the technical expert and primary customer support contact to the customer, and is therefore responsible for continually communicating with the customer to provide an exceptional customer experience and drive data center up-time and availability.

- 2+ years of electrical facilities maintenance and 2+ years of mechanical facilities maintenance experience
- 2+ years of Microsoft Office products and applications experience, or Bachelor's degree or equivalent
- Work flexible schedule including weekends, nights, and holidays

Preferred qualifications

- 2+ years of data center engineering experience
- Experience reading and writing procedures, technical documents, and engineering drawings

title: Manager, Software Development
descriptionHtml:

title: Startups GTM Leader, Startup Partners Center of Excellence
descriptionHtml:
This position is part of the AWS Specialist and Partner Organization (ASP). Specialists own the end-to-end go-to-market strategy for their respective technology domains, providing the business and technical expertise to help our customers succeed. Partner teams own the strategy, recruiting, development, and growth of our key technology and consulting partners. Together they provide our customers with the expertise and scale needed to build innovative solutions for their most complex challenges.

Do you want to shape how the world's most innovative startups go to market with AWS? Are you excited by the opportunity to work alongside top-tier venture capital firms, build GTM programs that turn high-potential portfolio companies into thriving AWS partners, and establish the mechanisms that help the next generation of enterprise software companies reach customers faster? If you thrive at the intersection of venture capital, cloud partnerships, and enterprise sales, and you want to build something new from the ground up with measurable impact on hundreds of startups, this role is for you.

We are seeking a Senior Partner Development Specialist for Startups. The role will own the delivery of go-to-market programs built from the AWS Partner Network (APN) that help VC-backed startups grow into future enterprises. In this role you will be a single-threaded owner to build and deliver GTM initiatives that help startups to move faster, get discovered more effectively, and win bigger by partnering with AWS. You will manage a hybrid of activities across VCs, ISVs with venture funds, and consulting partners. You will run quarterly business reviews, partner enablement workshops, buyer matchmaking, tracking succes of startups moving into AWS Global Startup Program (GSP). You will work at the intersection of venture capital, cloud technology, and partner strategy to improve the selection, onboarding, and co-sell delivery for portfolios of high-potential startups.

This is a cross-functional coordination role, requiring a mix of strategy (thinking, influencing) and delivery (doing). You will operate across sales, business development, marketing, finance, legal, and partner management to build and execute GTM initiatives. You will design scalable mechanisms that enable AWS to serve as the preferred GTM partner for startups.

The ideal candidate has deep experience working with venture capital firms or owning GTM outcomes (co-sell, alliances) at startups, a track record of building strategic business development programs that deliver measurable revenue outcomes, and the ability to influence senior leaders across multiple organizations. They think at portfolio scale rather than individual transactions, communicate with equal effectiveness to investment partners, startup founders, and AWS executives, and bring an entrepreneurial orientation to building new functions from the ground up.

Key job responsibilities
- Own the delivery of GTM programs with 3-5 VC and ISV partner companies, serving as the primary AWS Partner Network (APN) engagement point to design, build, and run GTM enablement.
- Drive AWS Marketplace revenue growth through structured partner onboarding pathways that startups from nomination through to co-sell program enrollment.
- Coordinate cross-functional GTM motions including enterprise buyer matchmaking events, partner enablement workshops, cohort-based education, and Marketplace acceleration for startups.
- Design and execute quarterly business reviews that synthesize GTM outcomes across dozens of portfolio companies into coherent narratives for investor partners and AWS leadership.
- Establish scalable playbooks, governance frameworks, and reporting mechanisms that enable the function to expand impact for the business.
- Prepare and deliver business reviews to senior leadership, translating portfolio-level performance data into strategic recommendations on resource allocation, program investment, and competitive positioning.

About the team
This position is part of the AWS Specialist and Partner Organization (ASP). The Startup Partners Center of Excellence (CoE) team within ASP builds new go-to-market models to help early stage and high potential startups to grow their business with AWS. The team operates at the portfolio layer, working across partner management segments and geographies to detect patterns, risks, and opportunities that support growth worldwide for the startup partner segment.

Diverse Experiences

AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS?

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Inclusive Team Culture

AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.

Mentorship & Career Growth

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.

Basic qualifications

- 5+ years of developing, negotiating and executing business agreements experience
- 5+ years of Go-To-Market, Business Development, Sales, or Consulting experience
- Bachelor's degree
- Experience presenting to both technical and non-technical executive audiences
- Experience leading complex, multi-year initiatives that may be cross-functional and/or span business and technology
- Experience developing, leading, negotiating and executing corporate and/or business transactions
- Experience interpreting data and making business recommendations across leadership and cross-functional teams

Preferred qualifications

- Master's degree in management, business administration, economics, engineering, marketing
- Experience developing strategies that influence leadership decisions at the organizational level

title: Software Development Manager, Alexa for shopping (Rufus)
descriptionHtml:
We're building the future of AI-powered shopping. Our team is developing next-generation conversational and agentic experiences powered by Large Language Models (LLMs), enabling customers to discover products, ask complex shopping questions, compare options, receive personalized recommendations, and accomplish shopping tasks in entirely new ways.

Alexa for Shopping brings together Amazon's AI-powered shopping experiences, including Rufus, our expert shopping assistant trained on Amazon's product catalog and information from across the web. Rufus helps customers answer product questions, perform product comparisons, receive recommendations based on their shopping context, and facilitate product discovery - all within the Amazon shopping experience.

We're looking for the best and brightest across Amazon to help us realize and deliver this vision to our customers right away.

More specifically, this role is in a team that is building new software systems and customer experiences that will greatly expand Rufus's availability to new cohorts of customers. The team is building agentic AI systems powered by LLMs, working at the intersection of cutting-edge AI technology and one of the world's largest e-commerce platforms. This team is considered strategic and has visibility with leadership at the highest levels.

The role offers a chance to build and launch AI-powered customer experiences from the ground up, and work closely with an exceptional group of product, engineering, and science leaders to shape the future of shopping at Amazon.

Key job responsibilities
• Influence the strategic direction and vision of the organization through an understanding of the intersection of business/customer needs and how these intersect with technical capabilities and opportunities.
• Provide technical leadership, vision and career guidance to team members.
• Create a culture of pride in engineering and operational excellence and drive best practices within teams and across organization.
• Be strategic about defining and building a engineering culture that takes ownership and delivers high performance engineering solutions.
• Work closely with technical (engineering and science) teams, design, and product/program management in an agile environment to deliver the best technical designs and approaches.
• Anticipate bottlenecks, provide escalation management, anticipate and make trade-offs, and balance the business needs versus technical constraints.


A day in the life
This Software Development Manager will:
- Manage a highly talented team of SDEs on the Rufus Agentic team, building scalable software systems and customer experiences powered by AI and LLM technologies. The role involves interacting with product, program, engineering, science, and other Rufus and broader Amazon teams to clarify requirements and build execution plans for the team.
- Define tactical actions to unblock the team and lay out a strategic quarter- or year-long vision for the team to improve its efficiency and deliver better AI-powered solutions for Amazon's customers.

Basic qualifications

- Experience managing a team of high calibre Software Engineers developing complex, world class, scalable software systems that have been successfully delivered to customers

title: Product Regulatory Counsel , Devices Legal
descriptionHtml:
Be the subject matter expert and trusted advisor on sustainability, ecodesign, and product compliance regulations affecting Amazon Devices.

Amazon Devices and Services is seeking an experienced Product Regulatory Counsel to advise on the rapidly evolving regulatory landscape surrounding consumer electronics, hardware compliance, product safety, sustainability, e-waste, recyclability, and ecodesign.

Amazon Devices develops and delivers innovative products and services used by millions of customers worldwide, including Kindle e-readers, Fire tablets, Fire TV, Echo, and eero. In this role, you will work at the intersection of technology, product development, environmental regulation, and sustainability, helping Amazon bring innovative products to market while navigating complex and evolving regulatory requirements around the world.

You will serve as a counsel across all Amazon devices, where you will partner closely with engineering, compliance, safety, and business leaders to translate complex laws and regulations into practical strategies that enable the business to move quickly and responsibly.

This opportunity offers the ability to operate with significant autonomy, develop deep relationships with business and technical leaders, and serve as a broad legal advisor while building expertise in a rapidly evolving area of law.

Some travel, domestic and international, will be required. This role may be based in Sunnyvale, CA or Seattle, WA.


Key job responsibilities
-Serve as a subject matter expert on sustainability, e-waste, recycling, ecodesign, and product compliance laws and regulations affecting consumer electronics and hardware
-Advise compliance and product teams on regulatory requirements, compliance strategies, product certifications, environmental obligations, and regulatory markings
-Counsel teams on product safety, hardware compliance, environmental regulations, product stewardship, and emerging sustainability requirements
-Monitor and interpret new and evolving laws and regulations and provide practical, actionable guidance to business and technical teams
-Develop legal strategies and scalable legal frameworks that enable the business to meet regulatory obligations while continuing to innovate and bring products to market efficiently
-Partner with public policy and government affairs teams on emerging legislation and regulations and support advocacy and implementation strategies
-Work with international legal teams and local counsel to assess global regulatory requirements and address complex cross-border compliance issues
-Manage attorney-client relationships independently, build trust with senior stakeholders, and proactively identify legal risks and opportunities
-Develop strategies for addressing complex legal issues in creative, business-centric ways that enable the business to move quickly

The Devices and Services Legal team supports Amazon's innovative portfolio of consumer products and services, including Kindle, Fire tablets, Fire TV, Echo, and more. Our team values intellectual curiosity, practical judgment, strong business instincts, and the ability to translate complex legal and regulatory requirements into clear, actionable guidance. title: Principal PM-T, Customer Success Intelligence Team , AWS Specialist and Partner Organization
descriptionHtml:
As a Principal Product Manager-Technical on the Customer Success (CS) Intelligence team within the AWS Customer Success Center of Excellence, you will own the product lifecycle for products and tooling that help AWS customers realize measurable business value after they deploy. This includes AI-powered systems and agent-based workflows that proactively surface risk, recommend interventions, and accelerate customer outcomes. You will set product vision, write PRFAQs, translate customer and partner requirements into technical specifications, design system architectures for ML-driven scoring and agentic automation, and work directly with engineering teams on sprint priorities and build decisions. You will run beta programs, UAT, and multi-region launches, measuring impact through how AWS and partners deliver customer outcomes.

You will work across AWS service teams, field teams, marketplace services engineering, data science, UX, and operations to build products that combine customer telemetry, predictive models, and intelligent agents — giving AWS and its partners real-time visibility into customer health and post-launch outcomes at scale.

This position is part of the AWS Specialist and Partner Organization (ASP). Specialists own end-to-end go-to-market strategy for their technology domains. Partner teams own strategy, recruiting, development, and growth of key technology and consulting partners. Together they provide customers the expertise and scale to solve complex challenges.

Key job responsibilities
- Own the end-to-end product lifecycle — from vision and roadmap through launch and post-launch iteration — for CS Intelligence tooling and systems.
- Write PRFAQs, business requirements documents, and technical specifications that translate field, customer, and partner needs into platform capabilities.
- Design system architectures for data ingestion, scoring, and workflow automation that operate at AWS scale.
- Work directly with SDEs and engineering leads on sprint planning, backlog prioritization, and build/buy/partner trade-offs.
- Run beta programs, user acceptance testing, and multi-region launches with structured rollout plans.
- Define and track success metrics — from model-level performance to customer-facing outcomes — and use them to drive product decisions.
- Collaborate across AWS service teams, field engineering, data science, UX, and operations to deliver integrated customer-facing experiences.
- Navigate legal, compliance, privacy, and data-sharing gates required for product launches.
- Manage multiple concurrent product streams with different engineering teams, stakeholders, and delivery timelines.
- Present to all levels of AWS leadership, including VP-level strategy reviews

Candidates must be comfortable working closely with and across agile teams. This is a high-visibility, high-impact role. The right person is naturally customer-centric and thrives in a fast-paced environment that requires strong technical and business judgment and solid communication skills. This role is for someone with a proven ability to execute both strategically and tactically, managing multiple product streams in ambiguous, greenfield environments.

About the team
Diverse Experiences

AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS?

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.

Mentorship & Career Growth

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.

- Experience designing system architectures or defining technical requirements for distributed systems
- Experience with sprint planning, backlog prioritization, and agile development processes
