title: Transportation Specialist, ROC
descriptionHtml:
ROC (Relay Operations Center) is the centralized command and control center for ‘Transportation Execution’ across the Amazon Supply Chain network supporting multiple geographies like NA, EU, India, Mexico, Brazil etc. It ensures hassle free, timely pick-up and delivery of freight from vendors to Amazon fulfillment centers (FC) and from Amazon FCs to carrier hubs. In case of any exceptions, ROC steps in to resolve the issues by keeping the stakeholders informed on the proceedings. Along with this tactical problem solving ROC is also charged with understanding trends in network exceptions and then automating processes or proposing process changes to streamline operations. This second aspect involves network monitoring and significant analysis of network data.
Overall, ROC plays a critical role in ensuring the smooth functioning of Amazon transportation and thereby has a direct impact on Amazon’s ability to serve its customers on time.

Overview of a Transportation Specialist

A Transportation Specialist at ROC facilitates flow of information between different stakeholders (Trans Carriers/Hubs/Warehouses) and resolves any potential issues that impacts customer experience and business continuity. Transportation Specialist at ROC works across two verticals – Inbound and Outbound operations.
Inbound Operations deals with Vendor/Carrier/FC relationship, ensuring that the freight is picked-up on time and is delivered at FC as per the given appointment. Transportation Specialist on Inbound addresses any potential issues occurring during the lifecycle of pick-up to delivery.
Outbound Operations deals with FC/Carrier/Carrier Hub relationship, ensuring that the truck leaves the FC in order to delivery customer orders as per promise. Transportation Specialist on Outbound addresses any potential issues occurring during the lifecycle of freight leaving the FC and reaching customer premises.
A Transportation Specialist provides timely resolution to the issue in hand by researching and querying internal tools and by taking real-time decisions. An ideal candidate should be able to understand the requirements/be able to analyze data and notice trends and be able to drive Customer Experience without compromising on time. The candidate should have the basic understanding of Logistics and should be able to communicate clearly in the written and oral form. Transportation Specialist should be able to ideate process improvements and should have the zeal to drive them to conclusion.

Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:


· Communication with external customers (Carriers, Vendors/Suppliers) and internal customers (Retail, Finance, Software Support, Fulfillment Centers)
· Providing real-time customer experience by working in 24/7 operating environment.
· Must be able to systematically escalate problems or variance in the information and data to the relevant owners and teams and follow through on the resolutions to ensure they are delivered.
· Develop and/or understand performance metrics to assist with driving business results.
· Excellent communication, both verbal and written as one may be required to create a narrative outlining weekly findings and the variances to goals, and present these finding in a review forum.
· Work within various time constraints to meet critical business needs, while measuring and identifying activities performed.
· Must be able to quickly understand the business impact of the trends and make decisions that make sense based on available data.

descriptionHtml:
The Amazon TD PACE (Tech Deployment - Product, Analytics and Customer Experience) within S&O (Strategy and Operations) organization is seeking a product manager – technical (PM-T) to drive customer experience and product strategy. This PMT will own AI centered systems/tools used during the planning and execution of robotics deployment in our fulfillment centers. They will facilitate the organization in making data driven bar raising decisions, through seamless partnership with the deployment teams and becoming an expert on field usage of the systems and tools they own. This is a fantastic opportunity to work with some of the best engineers in the industry and shape the direction of one of the world’s largest robotics driven fulfillment networks.

The organization you are part of is composed of teams which invent for rapid scaling of complex technical solutions, develop products for industrial equipment automation, and provide product ownership through unique field deployment expertise on robotic deployments. The software tools you build will improve deployment quality, cost, speed and add features that reduce complexity creating ease of use and operational excellence.

The focus of this PM-T role is the software products and associated AI Agents used to manage deployment of Amazon fulfillment center technology globally. These software products are leveraged by Amazon internal project managers, Amazon internal program managers, and internal and external installers. The scope of these products include functionality such as: project initiation, project planning, project execution, project monitoring & control, project budgeting, mobile application access, standard work instruction, task automation, and data insights and visualization. The products standardize, track, and enable automation in deployment execution which improves reliability and repeatability of Amazon’s deployment and testing processes.

In PACE, our PM-Ts are expected to listen attentively and speak candidly. Those conversations start with our customers and work backwards to collaborate with our development teams in the TD organization. Our PM-Ts seek data and diverse perspectives and use that insight to respectfully challenge decisions. We push ourselves and our development teams to accomplish more with less. We think big and do not sacrifice long-term value for short-term results. Your success as a TD PM-T will be measured on ROI (known internally as entitlement), customer satisfaction, and attainment of the product’s committed benefits.


Key job responsibilities
Product Focus
- Works with field teams to understand their problems and aggregate them into comprehensive use-cases.
- Support a complex robotics deployment organization through in-field product feedback gathering
- Evangelist of the product in the field, seeking new opportunities to increase depth and breadth of the installation base.
- Establishes the tangible and intangible value proposition of solving the problems in the use-case.
- Identifies capabilities to solve customer problems and works them into the strategy.
- Communicate roadmap updates to stakeholders and customers.
- Accountable to the customer for delivery of promised product value.
Voice of the customer
- Document understanding of the field customers, customer tasks, and their problems for the team’s use.
- Advocate for the customer’s needs with the team creating the robotics product.
- Gathers inputs from stakeholders, customers, and product team to determine prioritization.
- Seek or facilitates customer feedback on designs, early versions of product features, or demos.
Strategy
- Creates a benefit + entitlement VS effort analysis of the proposed product capabilities.
- Defines tangible and intangible (soft) benefit to be created by execution of the product roadmap
- Defines a roadmap with a goal of delivering the maximum benefit to the customer and long-term company value.
- Produce clear, concise documents (e.g., functional, technical specifications, PR/FAQs).
- Impacts and defines the customer experience (CX), feature usability, success metrics (e.g., customer delight, efficiency, ROI), and team-level business goals.


A day in the life

Benefits can vary by location, the number of regularly scheduled hours you work, length of employment, and job status such as seasonal or temporary employment. The benefits that generally apply to regular, full-time employees include:

1. Medical, Dental, and Vision Coverage

We are looking for a Sales Operations professional to join the Field Advisory as a Service Team (FaaST) within Central Operations at AWS Industries Operations. In this role, you will own Annual Planning and In Year Planning processes across four industry verticals, partnering directly with the operations teams that support those industries and the broader Annual Planning organization to turn complex data into clear, actionable plans. Your work will directly influence how our sales teams prioritize resources and deliver results for customers at every stage of their cloud journey. Over time, you will also contribute to AWS-wide annual planning initiatives, expanding your scope and impact beyond your immediate verticals.

Key job responsibilities
- Guide the operations teams across four industry verticals through their Annual Planning and In Year Planning cycles, delivering structured plans and recommendations that align with organizational goals.
- Analyze large data sets to surface insights, identify trends, and communicate actionable recommendations to stakeholders and leadership.
- Identify opportunities to automate and simplify planning processes using AI and ticketing tools, making workflows more scalable across the team.
- Collaborate closely with the broader Annual Planning team to align priorities, manage dependencies, and ensure consistent execution across verticals.
- Create clear documentation, communicate requirements to partners, and negotiate priorities while managing stakeholder expectations.

A day in the life
You will partner with the operations teams that support our industry verticals to guide them through planning milestones, working through large data sets and ticketing tools to track progress and resolve blockers. Between planning sessions, you will look for ways to automate repetitive steps and build scalable mechanisms that the broader Annual Planning team can adopt. Your time will split between hands-on execution and collaborating with stakeholders to keep planning cycles on track.

About the team
The Field Advisory as a Service Team (FaaST) sits within Central Operations at AWS Industries Operations. We take an industry-focused approach, meeting customers where they are in their cloud journey and working backwards from their challenges and opportunities. Our team enables sales success by building the processes and insights that help operations teams plan effectively and deliver results at scale. As you grow in the role, you will have the opportunity to contribute to AWS-wide annual planning initiatives, broadening your expertise across the organization.

title: Security Assurance Specialist , AWS Compliance and Security Assurance EMEA
descriptionHtml:
Do you have a passion for applying the latest technologies and automation in traditionally manual processes? Do you have experience in finding innovative solutions to scale security controls across diverse teams and technologies? Do you have ideas about influencing the future of security assurance?

At Amazon, Security is our highest priority. Come, join a creative team at Security Assurance dedicated to demonstrating the security controls of the services we offer here.

At Amazon’s scale, we are committed to inventing new ways to provide the highest level of assurance to our most regulatory conscious customers. You have a strong foundation in audit principles, as well as a diverse technology background. As part of the team, you will work with customers and regulators to demonstrate Amazon' security controls applicable to local requirements. You will join our team in helping customers understand how our infrastructure is designed, operated, maintained, and protected in accordance with global regulated industry standards.

You will help inspire, lead, and transform our audit and compliance programs through innovative process engineering across multiple organizations and teams, engaging technical and non-technical stakeholders throughout the company. Your combination of technical and audit background will help bridge security, technology, and compliance, and facilitate the scale of the program.

The successful candidate is one who loves working across many stakeholders, including internal and external customers, to design solutions for complex compliance challenges. You are passionate about the security of the cloud and you want to solve real business problems.

We have a team culture that encourages ownership, diversity, inclusion, and innovation. We expect team members and management alike to take a high degree of ownership for their program vision and execution of ideas. We expect this person to balance their unique perspective with those of the diverse perspectives of the team and its stakeholders. You will have an opportunity to work directly with senior leadership within Amazon to improve our ability to demonstrate assurance for regulated customers.

You should be a technically experienced and innovative security, compliance, and audit professional who has the ability to understand IT processes, communicate clearly and transparently with customers, and to be able to drive innovative process changes through multiple organizations and teams.

Key job responsibilities
As part of the team, you will work with customers and regulators to demonstrate Amazon security controls applicable to local requirements. You will join our team in helping customers understand how our infrastructure is designed, operated, maintained, and protected in accordance with global regulated industry standards. In this role, you will be responsible for the following activities:
- Dive deep into the Amazon control environment to develop broad domain and technical understanding of our security activities and control implementations to articulate compliance implications to both customers and internal/external audit functions.
- Develop understanding of regulated industry compliance requirements and communicate how we control activities to meet global regulatory obligations.
- Liaise with customers, regulators and auditors, articulate control implementation, and describe considerations for applying security and compliance concepts to monitor, evaluate, and continuously improve the organization by being a trusted advisor, facilitator and creative problem solver.
- Implement continuous improvements to the security organization and the program management process. Share program/project process frameworks, tools, and best practices that can be adopted throughout the organization.
- Apply a working knowledge of global information security regulation and policy to articulate customer and control impact and drive alignment to Amazon controls.


About the team
Diverse Experiences
AWS Security values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS Security
At AWS, security is central to maintaining customer trust and delivering delightful customer experiences. Our organization is responsible for creating and maintaining a high bar for security across all of AWS’s products and services. We offer talented security professionals the chance to accelerate their careers with opportunities to build experience in a wide variety of areas including cloud, devices, retail, entertainment, healthcare, operations, and physical stores.

Inclusive Team Culture
Here at Amazon, we embrace our differences. We are committed to furthering our culture of inclusion. We have ten employee-led affinity groups, reaching 40,000 employees in over 190 chapters globally. We have innovative benefit offerings, and host annual and ongoing learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon conferences. Amazon’s culture of inclusion is reinforced within our 16 Leadership Principles, which remind team members to seek diverse perspectives, learn and be curious, and earn trust.

Work/Life Balance
Our team puts a high value on work-life balance. It isn’t about how many hours you spend at home or at work; it’s about the flow you establish that brings energy to both parts of your life. We believe striking the right balance between your personal and professional life is critical to life-long happiness and fulfillment. We offer flexibility in working hours and encourage you to find your own balance between your work and personal lives.

Mentorship & Career Growth
Our team is dedicated to supporting new members. We have a broad mix of experience levels and tenures, and we’re building an environment that celebrates knowledge sharing and mentorship. We care about your career growth and strive to assign projects based on what will help each team member develop into a better-rounded professional and enable them to take on more complex tasks in the future.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree or equivalent in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems Management, Information Security or other related fields
- This role requires you to be a national of an EU member state
- 3+ years’ experience working and building risk programs and strategies up to date on related industry trends (e.g., changing regulations, innovations in risk mitigation, testing mechanisms)
- 5+ years working in highly regulated industries (e.g. financial services, healthcare, and energy, telecommunications), including direct work with European audits and frameworks such as DORA.
- 5+ years of working experience in performing and/or participating in IT audits based on ISAE 3401, auditing C5, SOC2, IT-Grundschutz and assessments of highly technical cloud-based environments.

Preferred qualifications

- Deep understanding of regulatory guidance, FCA guidance FG16/5 (Guidance for firms outsourcing to the ‘cloud’ and other third-party IT services), DORA requirements for Critical Service Provider, C5 requirements of the Federal Office of Information Security of Germany and other applicable standards and requirements.
- 1 or more industry-recognized security, cloud, or audit professional certifications (e.g., CISA, CISM, CISSP, CCSP, Amazon Cloud Security Practitioner
- Experience in technical security design, cloud services/deployment architecture (ideally Amazon cloud services offering), compliance consulting, or advisory work in a highly technical environment.
- A record of delivery of IT process improvement projects with technology processes and/or major tech companies along with generating automated metrics to measure effectiveness and consistency.
- Experience building certification roadmaps based on customer requirements, compliance documentation, and ensuring that committed assessments are delivered on schedule.
- A detailed understanding of evaluating the design and effectiveness of IT controls and experience working with auditors/regulators for these types of assessments

title: Visual Designer Key Art Dev, GSS Creative Studio
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Prime Video brings world-class storytelling to global audiences through high-impact creative campaigns and experiences. GSS Creative Studio combines creative and brand expertise with operational excellence to deliver scalable, high-quality creative solutions across Prime Video business lines, channels and marketplaces.

Creative Studio is seeking a Visual Designer specializing in Key Art Development. This hands-on role is responsible for executing high-quality Key Art and supporting campaign creative under the direction of Art Directors and the Creative Director.

The Visual Designer translates the direction and vision established in the creative brief into polished visual executions. They develop Key Art comps and design explorations within the approved creative direction, using strong composition, typography, image manipulation and retouching skills to bring each concept to life.

The ideal candidate combines strong design fundamentals with advanced technical craft and attention to detail. They can manage multiple assignments, incorporate feedback accurately and collaborate effectively with creative and cross-functional partners while maintaining a high creative and technical quality bar.

Key job responsibilities
Execute Key Art comps and visual explorations based on the creative brief and direction provided by Art Directors or the Creative Director.
Translate the approved creative vision into clear, compelling and polished visual executions.
Develop design options within the established creative direction, exploring composition, imagery, typography, color and visual hierarchy.
Apply advanced image manipulation, compositing and retouching techniques to create realistic and visually cohesive artwork.
Create presentation-ready comps and supporting materials for internal and stakeholder creative reviews.
Work with photography, talent imagery and licensed assets while following brand, usage and technical requirements.
Participate in briefings, brainstorms and creative reviews, contributing design options and executional solutions within the established direction.
Present assigned work during creative reviews and explain relevant design decisions.
Incorporate feedback accurately and efficiently while maintaining the intended concept, title narrative and brand expression.
Identify incomplete, conflicting or unclear direction and escalate it to the responsible Art Director or Creative Director.
Adapt approved Key Art direction across relevant campaign formats and placements when required.
Manage multiple assignments and creative iterations within agreed timelines, communicating risks that could affect quality or delivery.
Use approved creative and AI-assisted tools responsibly to support design exploration and execution.

Basic qualifications

- Experience prioritizing and handling multiple assignments at any given time while maintaining commitment to deadlines
- An online portfolio demonstrating strong visual design, Key Art, advertising or campaign work and the process behind it.
- Advanced proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite, particularly Photoshop, Illustrator and InDesign.
- Strong skills in image composition, photo manipulation, retouching, typography, color and visual hierarchy.
- Experience translating creative briefs and established direction into polished visual executions.
- Strong attention to detail and commitment to creative and technical quality.
- Effective communication, presentation and collaboration skills.

Preferred qualifications

- Experience developing Key Art or entertainment advertising for film, television, streaming or sports.
- Experience working with photography, unit stills, talent imagery and licensed visual assets.
- Experience preparing creative comps for internal, stakeholder or talent review.
- Understanding of entertainment brand guidelines, usage rights and asset limitations.
- Familiarity with collaborative design tools such as Figma.
- Familiarity with approved AI-assisted tools used for visual exploration, image development or retouching.

title: Area Manager
descriptionHtml:
External job description
Our WW Operations network delivers millions of packages and smiles to Amazon customers every day. We are looking for motivated, customer-focused individuals who want to join our team as an Area Manager. title: Principal Finance Manager, Pharmacy Strategy & Economics, Amazon Pharmacy
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Health Services (AHS) is reimagining how customers access and experience healthcare — making it easier, more affordable, and more convenient. AHS spans Amazon Pharmacy, One Medical, and a growing portfolio of services that put customers first across primary care, pharmacy, and specialty needs. Within AHS, Amazon Pharmacy is building the most convenient, transparent, and lovable pharmacy experience in the world — and we're still early. We are growing rapidly, serving millions of customers, expanding partnerships across healthcare, and reinventing what it means to get medications delivered to your door with speed, simplicity, and clinical quality.

Amazon Pharmacy Finance is the strategic finance partner to this business. We sit at the intersection of strategy, operations, and execution, focused on driving sustainable growth, advising senior leadership on high judgment decisions, and building the financial foundation for Pharmacy's growth. Our team partners across Pharmacy, AHS, Operations, WW Stores, and broader Amazon. We are building an AI-native finance team, using generative AI, agentic workflows, and automation to transform how we plan, forecast, analyze, drive controllership, and communicate.

We are looking for a Principal Finance Manager to serve as a strategic finance leader within Amazon Pharmacy Finance, reporting directly to the Pharmacy Finance Director. This is a high-impact, high-visibility leadership role for a senior finance professional who thrives in ambiguity, brings strong judgment to complex decisions, and is energized by the opportunity to help build. In this role, you will serve as a strategic advisor to the Amazon Pharmacy Finance Leadership Team, owning strategic analyses and executive-level communications that shape Pharmacy's long-range trajectory and business decisions, with AI fluency as a core lever to scale your impact. This is a role for someone who wants to build something, not just manage it, influencing decisions that will define how Amazon Pharmacy grows, where we show up for customers, and how we deliver care for the next decade.

This role offers significant career growth opportunities within Amazon Pharmacy Finance and across the broader Amazon Health Services portfolio and Amazon Finance.

Key job responsibilities
• Strategic Advisor — Serve as a trusted strategic advisor to the Pharmacy Finance Leadership Team, helping shape decisions that will define Amazon Pharmacy's growth trajectory, market presence, and care delivery model. Bring deep pharmacy industry experience (e.g., payer, PBM, or other relevant pharmacy experience) to high-judgment business decisions and emerging opportunities. Proactively identify financial, regulatory, and operational risks. Influence decisions at the VP and SVP level across Amazon Health Services.
• Long-Range Planning & Growth — Drive strategic analyses for Pharmacy's growth, translating ambiguous opportunities into long-range financial plans with clear trade-offs and quantified alternatives for senior leaders.
• Executive Communications — Translate complex financial stories into executive-ready insight that drives leadership alignment.
• Cross-Functional Influence & Org Mechanisms — Partner with senior leaders across Pharmacy, AHS, Operations, and broader Amazon to drive alignment on strategic priorities. Build the mechanisms that scale how the leadership team operates and decides.
• Financial Controllership & Governance — Promote a strong controllership environment, ensuring integrity of financial reporting and sound judgment on governance matters in a business scaling rapidly.
• AI Fluency & Innovation — Apply AI fluency to modernize how Pharmacy Finance operates — leveraging generative AI, agentic workflows, and automation to accelerate analysis, sharpen insight, and unlock capacity for the most strategic work.
• Talent Development — Raise the bar for the Pharmacy Finance organization through mentorship, knowledge sharing, and building frameworks that scale how others operate.

Basic qualifications

- 10+ years of tax, finance or a related analytical field experience
- 7+ years of finance technology, forecast & budgeting, or other finance-focused competency experience
- 3+ years of healthcare experience, including Pharmacy industry, payers, Pharmacy Benefit Managers (PBMs), pharmacy operations, specialty pharmacy, or healthcare reimbursement models.

Preferred qualifications

title: Líder de Operações, Logística Reversa
descriptionHtml:
Esta é uma posição de tempo integral, permanente, presencial baseada em XCV9 - Cajamar e não oferece benefícios de realocação. Os candidatos devem estar localizados e legalmente autorizados a trabalhar em Brazil para serem elegíveis para consideração.

Você quer fazer parte de uma operação que está transformando a logística reversa na Amazon Brasil? Nossa equipe é dedicada ao processamento de devoluções e à recuperação de valor de produtos retornados, contribuindo diretamente para a sustentabilidade e eficiência da nossa rede logística. Aqui, cada item devolvido é uma oportunidade de reduzir desperdício, recuperar valor e melhorar a experiência do cliente.

Estamos buscando um(a) Líder de Operações para nossa operação de Cajamar/SP, que seja apaixonado(a) por formar e desenvolver pessoas, obcecado(a) por segurança e qualidade, e que tenha a energia necessária para liderar um time operacional em um ambiente dinâmico e de alta performance. Nesta posição, você será responsável por garantir que as metas de produtividade, qualidade e segurança do site sejam atingidas durante o turno noturno, liderando diretamente um time de associados e garantindo a execução impecável dos processos de recebimento, triagem, grading e disposição de produtos retornados.

A Amazon está comprometida com um ambiente de trabalho diverso e inclusivo. A Amazon é um empregador que oferece igualdade de oportunidades e não discrimina com base em raça, origem nacional, gênero, identidade de gênero, orientação sexual, status de veterano protegido, deficiência, idade ou outro status legalmente protegido.


Key job responsibilities
- Segurança e Qualidade
Ser o guardião da segurança no turno, garantindo que todas as normas, procedimentos e práticas de segurança sejam seguidas sem exceção.
Promover uma cultura de segurança em que cada associado se sinta responsável pela sua segurança e pela segurança dos colegas.
Realizar auditorias de segurança e qualidade no gemba, identificando riscos e implementando ações corretivas imediatas.
Garantir o cumprimento dos padrões de qualidade nos processos de grading e disposição, minimizando erros e retrabalho.
Investigar incidentes e near-misses, conduzindo análises de causa raiz e implementando contramedidas definitivas.


- Gestão de Pessoas e Desenvolvimento de Time
Liderar, engajar e motivar o time operacional do turno da noite, promovendo um ambiente de trabalho positivo, colaborativo e orientado a resultados.
Formar e desenvolver equipes de alta performance, identificando talentos, promovendo o crescimento individual e garantindo a retenção dos melhores profissionais.
Conduzir treinamentos operacionais e reciclagens periódicas, assegurando que 100% do time esteja capacitado para executar os processos com excelência.
Realizar feedbacks regulares (1:1s, coaching no gemba), acompanhando a evolução de cada membro do time e criando planos de desenvolvimento individuais.
Influenciar e inspirar pessoas em todos os níveis para atingir e superar as metas operacionais do site.

- Gestão Operacional e de Processos
Gerenciar a operação do turno noturno de ponta a ponta, garantindo o cumprimento das metas de produtividade, qualidade e throughput nos processos de recebimento, triagem, grading e disposição de itens retornados.
Criar, documentar e implementar procedimentos operacionais padrão (SOPs), garantindo padronização e repetibilidade na execução.
Monitorar KPIs operacionais em tempo real (UPH, qualidade, backlog, aging), identificando desvios e atuando imediatamente para corrigi-los.
Ser intolerante a desvios de processo — garantir que o padrão seja seguido e que qualquer não-conformidade seja tratada com senso de urgência.
Conduzir reuniões de início de turno (start-of-shift), comunicando metas, prioridades e alertas de segurança ao time.
Garantir transições de turno eficientes, com passagem de informações clara e sem perda operacional.

- Resolução de Problemas e Melhoria Contínua
Criar soluções rápidas e simples para problemas operacionais do dia a dia, garantindo a continuidade da operação sem comprometer segurança ou qualidade.
Nunca se contentar com a solução paliativa — buscar e implementar a solução definitiva (root cause analysis) para eliminar a recorrência dos problemas.
Identificar oportunidades de melhoria contínua nos processos, propondo e liderando iniciativas de Kaizen, 5S e eliminação de desperdícios.
Utilizar dados e métricas para embasar decisões e priorizar ações de melhoria com maior impacto operacional.

- Eficiência e Resultados
Garantir o atingimento das metas diárias e semanais de produtividade, qualidade e custo do turno noturno.
Otimizar a alocação de recursos (pessoas, equipamentos, espaço) para maximizar a eficiência operacional.
Colaborar com as demais lideranças do site (turnos diurnos, áreas de suporte) para garantir alinhamento e sinergia nas operações.
Reportar resultados, desvios e planos de ação à liderança do site de forma clara, objetiva e orientada a dados.

A day in the life
No seu dia a dia, você irá:

Liderar, engajar e desenvolver o time operacional do turno da noite, garantindo que todos estejam treinados, motivados e alinhados com as metas do site.
Criar, revisar e implementar procedimentos e processos operacionais, buscando sempre a padronização e a melhoria contínua.
Monitorar indicadores de performance (KPIs) em tempo real, identificando desvios e agindo imediatamente para corrigi-los — nunca tolerando desvios de processo.
Ser o guardião da segurança no turno, garantindo que todas as normas e práticas de segurança sejam seguidas sem exceção.
Criar soluções rápidas e simples para problemas operacionais do dia a dia, sem jamais abrir mão de buscar e implementar a solução definitiva (root cause).
Influenciar e inspirar pessoas para atingir e superar as metas de produtividade, qualidade e eficiência do site.
Conduzir treinamentos, reuniões de início de turno (start-of-shift) e feedbacks regulares com o time.
Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com as demais lideranças do site para garantir uma transição de turno eficiente e sem perdas operacionais.

Escala e Condições de Trabalho

Necessária a flexibilidade para trabalho em horários diferenciados, trabalho noturno e aos fins de semana, conforme demanda.
A posição exige caminhar e permanecer em pé durante todo o turno em ambiente operacional de warehouse

Basic qualifications

- Ensino superior concluído ou cursando o último ano de graduação
- Experiência em liderança de equipes operacionais
- Experiência em formação de times, treinamento e desenvolvimento de pessoas
- Experiência em criação e implementação de procedimentos e processos operacionais
- Disponibilidade para trablaho em horários diferenciados e aos fins de semana.
- Capacidade de caminhar e permanecer em pé durante todo o turno de trabalho

Preferred qualifications

- Inglês no nível intermediário
- Experiencia com ferramentas de análise de qualidade (5 Porquês, Análise de pareto, Ishikawa, etc.)
- Experiência em operações de logística reversa, devoluções ou recommerce
- Conhecimento em metodologias de melhoria contínua (Lean, Kaizen, 5S)
- Experiência em ambientes de warehouse/fulfillment center
- Habilidade de influenciar stakeholders e engajar equipes em ambientes de alta demanda
- Capacidade de criar soluções rápidas para problemas imediatos sem perder de vista a resolução definitiva da causa raiz

descriptionHtml:
Amazon Advertising is dedicated to driving measurable outcomes for advertisers, agencies, and entrepreneurs. Our ad solutions leverage Amazon's innovations and insights to find, attract, and engage intended audiences throughout their daily journeys. If you're interested in joining a rapidly growing team working to build a unique, world-class advertising group with a relentless focus on the customer, you've come to the right place.

The Sales GTM organization is the voice of the customer and the field back to Ads Product, as well as the business owner for driving customer outcomes through adoption of product solutions. This team owns the relationship with each Product org, produces a prioritized set of Sales priorities, and influences requirements, roadmap decisions and trade offs. They develop and implement GTM strategies and sales plays for both existing capabilities and new launches to drive adoption and advertiser maturity.

This role will be responsible for:

- Earn trust with sales team, understand how to marry their key sales motions with ad product priorities

A day in the life
You start the morning reviewing seller feedback from mid market AEs and AMs on a recent beta launch. By mid morning you're on a call with Product, pushing back on a roadmap trade off that doesn't serve your segment's advertisers. After lunch you're refining a sales play for a new targeting capability, pressure testing it with a few sellers before scaling it out. title: Transportation Specialist, Amazon Intermodal (AZIM)
descriptionHtml:
Amazon’s Intermodal (AZIM) Operations team is seeking highly skilled and motivated Transportation Specialists to join this rapidly growing team. AZIM Operations drives the end to end operational execution of all loads (internal and external) shipped on our 1P network. The team supports regions and shippers across the Supply Chain network and is tasked with ensuring on-time pickup and delivery of freight from vendors, Amazon fulfillment centers (FCs), rail yards and shipper hubs. In the case of disruptions, the Operations team is responsible for addressing the disruption, keeping all stakeholders informed and ensuring timely resolution of the issue. The AZIM Operations team is the first line of defense in understanding network trends, delays, dwells and other exceptions that impact AZIM’s ability to deliver a world class transportation product that serves its customers on time.

An ideal candidate has a background in customer service/call center, transportation, and/or supply chain environments. Additionally, a passion for quickly providing solutions and resolution to challenges by using strong communication, problem solving and organizational skills is a must. Successful candidates will enjoy working in a fast-pace, high-volume call center environment with a lot of growth opportunity. They will thrive on accountability to themselves, team, carriers/drivers and work schedules!

Key job responsibilities
-Deliver excellent carrier and driver experience/solutions, in a high-volume contact center environment, through researching, problem-solving, setting appropriate expectations and working within the Amazon Transportation network to get trailers/trucks back on track when disruptions occur
- Work in fast-paced environment, and adhere to schedules: start/stop, and breaks/lunches
- Support workload surges and/or weather-related operations as needed to include working significant overtime during designated high-volume peaks
- Use internal systems to gather data from multiple sources to support reporting on a daily, weekly, monthly and quarterly basis
- Provide support to field teams and partners by creating repair requests, monitoring load execution, ensuring on-time pickup and delivery metrics
- Work with cross-functional teams. Use analytical skills to drive data-driven decision, and effectively communicate insights to others across Transportation Operations Management, Amazon Freight Shippers, rail partners, Carriers, and Fleet
- Provide support to drivers and carriers with over the road disruptions

Your calls will be monitored and recorded for training and compliance purposes.

A day in the life
The AZIM Transportation Operations Specialist facilitates the continued flow of Amazon’s supply chain by passing information to key stakeholders and resolving disruptions that impact customer experience or the flow of information impacting performance and delivery. The Specialist addresses or escalates any concerns arising during the lifecycle of freight leaving rail ramps, shipper hubs, Amazon fulfillment centers, or transiting between rail to OTR carriers. The day-to day role requires the specialist to provide resolutions by researching and querying internal tools and making real-time decisions in accordance with their guidance and standard work processes. In this role, the Transportation Operations Specialist will be able to understand the process and requirements/be able to analyze data and notice trends and be able to drive Customer Experience without compromising on time. This position will need to have the experience to understand Logistics and should be able to communicate clearly in the written and oral form.

Basic qualifications

- High school or equivalent diploma
- Speak, write, and read fluently in English
- Work 40 hours/week, and overtime as required
- Work a flexible schedule/shift/work area, including weekends, nights, and/or holidays
- Are 18 years of age or older

Preferred qualifications

- 1+ years of working with computers and Microsoft Office (including Outlook, Word, and Excel) experience

title: Lead Associate
descriptionHtml:
This site will be co-located with SOK1.

This role requires open availability seven days a week, and flexibility to work at various sites within 10 miles of the primary Operations site in the Oklahoma City metro area (as needed).

Join our dedicated team and contribute to a dynamic culture based on customer obsession, trust, respect, integrity, continuous learning, and fun. As a Lead Associate, you’ll be at the core of our fastest delivery operation, enhancing customer shopping experience. The ideal candidate possesses strong attention to detail, efficiently prioritizes tasks, demonstrates a willingness to learn, and maintains a commitment to delighting our customers.

What it’s like at our site(s):
1. Safety. Your safety is important to us, so we provide safe working conditions.
2. Surroundings. You'll be working in retail warehouse environment with various equipment– shopping carts, pallet jacks, stock dollies, and a variety of products, including food and alcoholic beverages. You'll also interact with our digital shopping technology.
3. Activity. Work involves frequent movement between different areas, standing while conducting most tasks, and some lifting. You may need to reach into coolers or freezers.
4. Noise level. Sound levels are minimal, what one would expect in a retail warehouse environment.
5. Dress code. Relaxed, with a few rules to follow for safety. Comfortable, slip-resistant, closed-toe shoes are also required for safety. Additional protective and visibility gear may be required.
6. New site opening: If you’re applying to a site that hasn’t opened yet, you’ll help prepare the team for its first customer orders. This may include tasks like setting up shelving and unloading product deliveries. You’ll also have an extended training and onboarding period, which may be at a nearby Amazon site.


Key job responsibilities
- Support, motivate, and model desired behavior for the rest of the team
- Manage operational processes, safety, quality, performance, and customer delivery promises following the Regional Area Manager guidance, and act as their main support at your assigned site
- Maintain a clean, sanitary, safe, and organized workspace
- Provide ongoing training in areas including system and equipment knowledge, quality training, general operations, and assist Regional Area Manager in identifying training needs
- Provide feedback on processes and standards, serving as the escalation point to assist associates and peers in solving issues where appropriate, training, deploying labor, and ensuring the team takes required breaks and lunches
- Maintain a key to the site, and open and close following the proper procedures.
- Handle a wide assortment of products including produce, meat, seafood, and alcoholic beverages
- Receive truck deliveries
- Collaborate with both associates and delivery partners to ensure smooth operations and excellent customer service
- Participate in associate onboarding as required
- Ensure consistent execution of product workflow processes, guiding associates as needed including receiving, stocking, replenishing product, and preparing for delivery
- Perform front-line duties whenever necessary
- Contribute to continuous improvement of customer experience and operations by participating in the development of best practices and continuous product knowledge
- Utilize inventory management systems to scan, process, and count product
- Perform additional duties as assigned
You’ll also need to be:

title: Sales Ops Lead, GTM Strategy, GTMO Sales Ops, AB
descriptionHtml:
Come be a part of a rapidly expanding $35 billion dollar global business. At Amazon Business, a fast-growing startup passionate about building solutions, we set out every day to innovate and disrupt the status quo. We stand at the intersection of tech & retail in the B2B space developing innovative purchasing and procurement solutions to help businesses and organizations thrive. At Amazon Business, we strive to be the most recognized and preferred strategic partner for smart business buying. Bring your insight, imagination and a healthy disregard for the impossible. Join us in building and celebrating the value of Amazon Business to buyers and sellers of all sizes and industries. Unlock your career potential.

We are seeking a Senior Sales Operations Lead to own our strategic and go-to-market execution for a new, purpose-built B2B fulfillment network launching across the United States. This role sits at the intersection of network economics, enterprise sales, and operational scaling, building the engine that translates infrastructure investment into customer acquisition and GMS growth. You will architect the GTM motions, scenario models, and pipeline frameworks that connect a multi-billion-dollar network buildout to measurable enterprise customer outcomes.

This isn't a maintenance role. You'll be standing up the operating model from scratch; defining customer segmentation, building incrementality frameworks that pressure-test top-down targets against bottom-up account-level data, and designing the sales motions that activate managed spend across thousands of enterprise accounts. You'll own the bridge between network capacity coming online and the revenue those buildings need to justify their investment.

Key job responsibilities
• Build and own the commercial strategy framework Build and own the commercial strategy framework for a dedicated B2B fulfillment network scaling from pilot to 20+ US sites, translating network topology and capacity plans into customer-facing GTM motions with quantified GMS targets by region, cohort, and sales motion.
• Design and validate incrementality models Design and validate incrementality models that bridge top-down financial targets to bottom-up account-level opportunity, using scenario analysis (Conservative / Base / Optimistic) to quantify the contribution of sales-led engagement, managed spend activation, and marketing-led motions across enterprise customer segments.
• Own customer segmentation and prioritization Own customer segmentation and prioritization for a 10,000+ account universe — developing composite scoring frameworks, cohort-level growth rate analysis, and managed spend conversion premium quantification to focus sales resources on highest-yield accounts.
• Architect multi-tier GTM motions: Architect multi-tier GTM motions: concentrated high-touch engagement for top-quartile enterprise accounts ($50M+ addressable base), scaled managed spend activation for mid-tier cohorts, and marketing-led automated outreach for long-tail accounts, each with distinct KPIs, conversion assumptions, and ROI models.
• Partner with Operations, Finance, and Network Design Partner with Operations, Finance, and Network Design to align demand planning with building launch timelines, translating site-level capacity constraints into sales planning inputs (coverage radius, direct dispatch eligibility, ASIN selection ramp, and delivery speed commitments).
• Drive Sales Operations infrastructure Drive Sales Operations infrastructure — Territory Planning aligned to network geography, quota development calibrated to building launch cadence, SFDC workflow implementation for pipeline tracking, and performance management frameworks that surface leading indicators of network adoption.
• Build the measurement and reporting stack Build the measurement and reporting stack for network-specific GMS contribution, including cohort analysis by managed spend engagement tier, pipeline-to-attainment waterfall, weekly unit forecasting against building capacity, and growth rate benchmarking across MS-engaged vs. non-engaged accounts.
• Model and simulate business outcomes Model and simulate business outcomes to inform VP-level investment decisions — including 5-year build plan economics, per-site payback analysis, reseller exclusion sensitivity testing, and ASIN category expansion accelerators.
• Develop executive-ready narratives Develop executive-ready narratives that translate complex scenario models into clear strategic recommendations for senior leadership, calibrating language and granularity for VP audiences while preserving analytical rigor in appendices.
• Collaborate cross-functionally Collaborate cross-functionally with Sales Leadership, Enablement, Marketing, Supply Chain, and Tech teams to ensure GTM activation is synchronized with operational milestones (inbound launch, outbound launch, tech releases, selection ramp).

Basic qualifications

- 6+ years of Microsoft Excel experience
- Bachelor's degree or equivalent
- Experience developing and implementing systems/tools utilized for CRM, variable compensation, revenue reporting, forecasting, Salesforce automation, etc.
- Experience defining, refining and implementing sales processes, procedures and policies or equivalent

Preferred qualifications

- Experience using Salesforce (or other CRM tool) or BI tools
- Experience presenting to senior leadership

title: Data Center Cluster Operations Leader (Senior Manager), DCC Communities
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is a fast-paced technology company and a leader in the world of data centers. AWS is growing rapidly, and we are looking for a Cluster Operations Leader to join our expanding Infrastructure Operations team.

The Cluster Operations Leader is one of our most senior management roles in the data center environment. The Cluster Operations Leader manages Amazon Data Center Clusters and Colocation Operations within their assigned region. As senior Infrastructure Operations leader, they oversee safety, security, availability, scaling, efficiency, and cost management.

Infrastructure Operations consists of two core functions: Data Center Operations (DCO) and Data Center Engineering Operations (DCEO). DCO manages server-level platforms supporting Amazon Retail and Amazon Web Services, while DCEO handles mechanical, electrical, and controls systems for critical environments. We seek a leader with experience in both DCO and DCEO systems. Through operating independently, a physical security team works closely with these functions to protect people, assets, and customer data.

The Cluster Operations Leader builds and leads high-performing teams across these functions. They manage daily operations while applying technical expertise to address emerging challenges. Their role requires both strategic oversight and the ability to dive deep into specific issues.

As a vital member of the management team, the Cluster Operations Leader helps scale the world's largest cloud computing infrastructure. The position demands innovation to solve complex daily challenges and drive operational excellence. Success in this role requires strong technical knowledge on both engineering (electrical and mechanical) and compute systems, process optimization skills, and dedication to achieving world-class operational performance.

If you are passionate about Customer Experience, think and act globally and want to contribute to the operational excellence of Amazon.com data centers. This may be the challenge you’ve been looking for!

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

Key job responsibilities

At AWS, each day presents unique challenges as the business evolves rapidly. Leaders in this space divide their time between collaborating with global partners and managing local teams. descriptionHtml:
Brand Innovation Lab (BIL) creates custom advertising experiences for the world's biggest brands across Amazon's canvas (Alexa, Fire TV, Prime Video, Twitch, Brand Stores, and more). We're looking for an Interactive Experience Designer to join our team.

This role is visual design, with part UX design and part build. You're the connective tissue between the campaign vision and the finished experience. You might start your morning reviewing a creative brief for our newest sponsorship program, then jump into Figma to iterate on high-fidelity layouts for a current campaigns landing page. After lunch, you're building a production page in Webflow while syncing with your Design Technologist on component hand-off and accessibility. Later, you join a creative review with your CD and Art Director to push a pitch concept further, then close out the day prepping mock-ups for a client presentation across two concurrent campaigns.

Brand Innovation Lab (BIL) is an award-winning team that conceptualizes and executes bespoke advertising experiences for global brands—including Nike, P&G, Hyundai, Pepsi, and Google—who invest in media with Amazon Ads, scaling successful campaign elements as new products or features in existing products. descriptionHtml:
Team & Project Overview

The NBS Data Central team powers analytics, data science, and AI capabilities for Worldwide Global Selling (WWGS). We build scalable data products, and insight-generation systems that drive seller growth across 10+ marketplaces.

Seller Intelligence is a P0 foundation theme at the Global Selling level, formed by merging "One Tagging" and "Good Contact" workstreams. It provides seller identity, segmentation, and contact-reach infrastructure that underpins all downstream seller-facing AI workflows — including intelligent outreach, personalized recommendations, and automated engagement.

Scope of Impact

Own the science pillar for Seller Intelligence within a cross-functional POD (PM + DE + DS + SDE)

Directly impact seller engagement metrics across CN, IN, LATAM, and East-Asia expansion regions

Models and data products consumed by 5+ downstream teams (ESM, NSR, MKT, NBS AI Ops, ROC)

Influence $100M+ annual seller GMS through improved segmentation and contact optimization

Key job responsibilities

Design and deliver seller segmentation and propensity models at scale — incorporating GMS, category, growth trajectory, engagement signals, and lifecycle stage.

Build contact quality scoring and lifecycle management systems (coverage optimization, dormancy detection, reactivation modeling).

Define success metrics, experimentation frameworks (A/B, causal inference), and measurement methodology for seller engagement interventions.

Productionize ML models and data products — partner with engineering to deploy seller scores, contact quality indices, and recommendation signals.

Explore LLM/GenAI applications: automated insight generation from seller data, contact intent classification, and intelligent report synthesis.

Serve as the science representative in bi-weekly NBS theme reviews; present findings and proposals to theme Bar Raisers and leadership.

Collaborate with BIE team members to democratize analytical outputs via dashboards and self-serve tools.

Contribute to cross-marketplace seller behavior analysis supporting Global Expansion strategy (IN, KR, VN, LATAM).

Evaluate, integrate, and iterate on AI systems — assess new AI/ML tools, frameworks, and third-party models for applicability to seller intelligence use cases.

Basic qualifications

- 5+ years of data querying languages (e.g. SQL), scripting languages (e.g. Python) or statistical/mathematical software (e.g. R, SAS, Matlab, etc.) experience

title: Facilities Service Coodinator, 施設管理部
descriptionHtml:
当ポジションの勤務地は愛知県名古屋市です。

Amazonは、何百万もの商品をお客様のもとへ届け続けることで、世界的に高い認知を得たグローバルリーディングカンパニーです。
その物流を最前線で支える物流拠点がフルフィルメントセンター（以下FC）であり、そのFCを「安全・快適・効率的」に保ち続けるのが、私たちRME-Facilities（施設管理）チームです。
快適な現場も、雰囲気の良いオフィスも、みんなが楽しみにするイベントも、あなたが整える施設の一つひとつが、Amazonで働く一人ひとりの毎日を支えています。

**あなたの仕事で、数千人の「働く」が変わる。**
施設管理の専門経験は問いません。 Amazonの施設に興味があり、働く人のために動くのが好きな方であれば大歓迎です。
建物・設備の知識は、先輩のサポートを受けながら現場で少しずつ身につけていけます。
本ポジションは、FCで働くすべての人を"カスタマー"と捉え、魅力的で働きやすい職場づくりを推進する役割になります。

主な業務
はじめは先輩と一緒に、慣れてきたら少しずつ任される範囲を広げていきます。
■働く環境と人を支える仕事
オフィス環境の整備 — レイアウト変更や快適な職場づくりなど、従業員が気持ちよく働ける環境を整えます。
備品・消耗品の管理と購買・請求書処理 — 必要なものが不足しないよう手配し、日々の購買・請求書処理を進めます。
売店・Cafeteriaの運営管理 — 従業員満足度の向上に向けて、食堂運営会社と協力してサービスレベルの維持・改善に取り組みます。
従業員向けイベントの企画・運営 — FCで働く人が楽しめるイベントを自ら企画・運営します。自分が企画したイベントで従業員が笑顔になる瞬間に立ち会えることも、このポジションならではのやりがいです。
社内外の窓口・調整 — ベンダーや業者、行政などとの窓口を担い、必要な調整を進めます。
■建物・設備を守る仕事
施設の維持管理 — 建築・電気・空調・衛生・消火・昇降設備といった建物全体のインフラについて、点検結果の確認や修繕の手配・発注を行い、倉庫の安定稼働を支えます。
省エネルギー活動 — エネルギー使用量のデータをもとに、照明のLED化や空調運転スケジュールの見直しなどを進め、環境負荷の低減とコスト削減の両立を目指します。
廃棄物・リサイクル管理 — FC内で発生する産業廃棄物やリサイクル品の回収・分別を、安全・品質・生産性の観点で管理・改善します。マニフェスト管理や行政報告など、法令に沿った手続きも担います。

**このポジションの魅力**
幅広い経験がキャリアの土台になる — 建物・設備・環境・総務・イベント企画まで、施設に関わることを幅広く経験できます。特定分野に偏らない経験は、この先どんなキャリアにも活きる強みになります。
若手でも「任される」 — 発注者側の立場で、業者やベンダーへの依頼・調整を自分で進めていきます。指示を待つのではなく、自分で考えて動ける環境です（最初は先輩がしっかりサポートします）。
カスタマーの声がダイレクトに届く — 「美味しい食事が食べられて快適に働ける」「オフィスの雰囲気が良くなった」といったポジティブな声を、すぐそばで直接受け取れます。
AI・生成AIを日常業務に — Amazonでは最新のAIツールや生成AIを日々の業務に取り入れています。学習を継続する文化が根付いており、ご自身のペースでAIや施設管理の知識を深められるリソースが用意されています。

こんな方を歓迎します
- 施設管理の仕事に興味がある方
- 人と関わり、誰かのために動くことにやりがいを感じる方
- 新しい知識を学ぶことに前向きで、自分で考えて行動できる方
- チームや職場全体のために、情報を共有しサポートし合える方

Key job responsibilities
Amazonの業務は数値で管理されています。キーとなる数値目標がセットされ、業務の改善を通してパフォーマンスを引き上げていくことがミッションです。
たとえば電気使用量や社員食堂の満足度には数値目標があり、電気は節電、社員食堂はメニュー改善、廃棄物はリサイクル率の向上などを、各協力会社とともに進めて目標達成を目指します。

A day in the life
1日は朝礼から始まります。朝礼後はチーム別に分かれて当日の業務内容を確認し、メールチェックや現場巡回を行います。
ランチはカフェtリアや売店を利用し、あわせてサービスレベルもチェックします。会議は1日に1〜2件ほど、サプライヤーとの定例会議が中心で、主に業務進捗の報告を受けます。
困ったときは先輩やチームに相談しながら進められます。

About the team
メンバーは多くの場合、1 FCあたり1〜2名が配属されています。少人数だからこそ幅広い業務を経験でき、成長のスピードが速い環境です。
全国各地のメンバーが一斉に集まる定例オンライン会議が毎週あり、成功事例の共有や困りごとの相談ができます。
本ポジションの所属部門等に関する詳細は、下記リンク先をご参照ください。

・所属部門:オペレーション技術開発
・職種:セーフティ/セキュリティ/ファシリティ

Basic qualifications

- 外部委託先協業もしくはベンダーマネジメント経験
- PCスキル（Excel, Word, Outlook）

Preferred qualifications

- 建屋施設管理業務、工事施工管理業務、建築や電気設備のPM業務経験
- コスト改善提案を行った経験
- お客様意識お客様意識を強く持って行動できる。
- コミュニケーション:職場環境に溶け込み、分からない部分を積極的に質問し自身で解決する力。
- 職場全体への貢献, 他人の仕事をうまく進められるように情報を共有し、サポートする。
- アジリティとフレキシビリティー 迅速に業務をこなし、状況の変化に柔軟に対応できる。
- 周囲の意見を聞きながら判断し仕事を進められる。
- 探究心と向上心 いままで経験がない業務でも新しい知識を学ぶのに意欲的で何事も前向きに取組める性質。
- インクルーシブなカルチャーへの貢献や多様性に富んだグループで働くことに対して前向きであること。

title: Senior Business Developer, National Security & Defence, Asia Pacific, Global Government
descriptionHtml:
Are you a seasoned intelligence or defence professional who has successfully transitioned into the commercial cloud and technology sector? Do you combine deep operational experience in national security with the commercial acumen to drive cloud and AI adoption at national scale?

As an AWS Business Developer focused on National Security & Defence (NSD) in Asia Pacific, you will drive regional NSD business development by leveraging your firsthand understanding of intelligence and defence operations to earn trust with the most senior leaders in the region. You will take proven patterns and approaches from mature markets and support other nations across Asia Pacific to learn from and adopt them at pace. Asia Pacific nations face a rapidly evolving and increasingly complex security landscape and are investing urgently in cloud and AI capabilities to strengthen sovereignty, improve intelligence and operational readiness, and modernise defence forces. You will accelerate their cloud and AI journey by combining your deep domain credibility with commercial cloud expertise to transfer what works rather than starting from scratch in each country.

The ideal candidate will have served in or worked extensively with intelligence or defence organisations, giving them an innate understanding of how these communities operate — from intelligence cycles and collection-to-assessment workflows to defence capability development, operational planning, and force employment. Critically, they will have complemented this domain depth with significant commercial experience in cloud computing, understanding how hyperscale cloud platforms are architected, secured, operated, and adopted by the world's most security-conscious organisations. This combination of operational credibility and commercial cloud fluency is essential.

You must possess a deep understanding of the security considerations and geopolitical environment across the Asia Pacific region — including alliance structures, threat landscapes, regional security architectures, and the political dynamics that shape defence and intelligence investment decisions. You will bring the kind of background and gravitas that causes senior leadership across defence and intelligence agencies to listen, engage, and act. You are recognised as a leading voice and thought leader within the NSD community across Asia Pacific and Japan, with the relationships and reputation to open doors at the highest levels.

You will work cross-functionally with AWS country teams, solutions architects, and partners across the region to build pipeline, close opportunities, and deliver measurable outcomes for customers. You will articulate compelling value propositions for cloud and AI adoption, shape joint go-to-market strategies with partners, and package repeatable playbooks that help country teams accelerate NSD adoption locally.

With AWS, our customers benefit from the fastest pace of innovation, the broadest and deepest functionality, the most secure computing environment, and the most proven operational expertise. In this role, you will bring these capabilities to bear for national security and defence customers across Asia Pacific, helping them solve problems that matter at national scale.

You will be part of a small, focused team of NSD domain and technical experts driven by customer mission. Your week will move between engaging senior defence and national security leaders, working with AWS country teams to align domain expertise with local execution, shaping partner propositions, packaging repeatable playbooks and engagement models that help country teams accelerate NSD adoption locally, and identifying where cloud and AI can make a material difference to how nations defend sovereignty and protect citizens. This is a role for someone who has lived the mission, understands what these organisations need, thrives in ambiguity, builds trust quickly at the most senior levels, and turns opportunity into outcomes.

This role is based in Australia or Singapore. Candidates must have existing right to live and work in their chosen location. The role is focused on working across the Asia Pacific region with approximately 30% travel expected.

Security clearance requirement: This position requires that the candidate selected hold, or be able to attain, appropriate security clearance in their country of residence.

- Serve as a recognised thought leader and respected voice on cloud and AI adoption for national security and defence across the APJ region, representing AWS at the highest levels of engagement.

- Articulate compelling value propositions for cloud and AI adoption in national security and defence contexts, translating technology capabilities into outcomes that resonate with mission owners by drawing on firsthand understanding of intelligence and defence operations cycles.

- Define and execute joint go-to-market strategies with consulting and technology partners (defence primes, system integrators, and ISVs) to deliver solutions tailored to regional customer requirements.

- Identify and codify proven business development patterns, GTM approaches, and customer engagement models from mature NSD markets, and support other nations across the region to learn from and adopt them at pace.

- Apply deep understanding of Asia Pacific geopolitical dynamics, alliance structures, and regional security considerations to inform strategy and shape customer engagement.

title: Senior Financial Analyst, EU Operations FP&A
descriptionHtml:
The right financial and business decisions have made Amazon what it is today. As a Senior Financial Analyst, you’ll help us optimize our finances so that we can enhance our customer experience even more and navigate the fast-changing business environment. This role is an opportunity to act as the key finance leader and get really involved with shaping our business. You’ll influence others and use insights to show senior stakeholders ways that we can move forward with our business ambitions.

Key job responsibilities
- Build financial models to drive business decisions and make judgement calls on challenges using your understanding of Amazon’s cost structure
- Lead projects by overseeing timelines, priorities, auditing quality and resolving issues
- Generate insights from financial data, identify opportunities for greater efficiency, and communicate findings with the leadership team to drive business actions
- Own the financial reporting, create scalable processes and monitor teams for accuracy
- Onboard, develop and mentor team members in areas of financial reporting for accuracy, create best practice materials and promote knowledge sharing

A day in the life
Your typical day involves consolidating weekly or monthly financials for Cost-to-Serve initiatives, connecting with initiative owners to gather updates and validate data accuracy. You'll prepare insightful analyses for Management Business Reviews (MBRs) and Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs), focusing on trends and performance metrics. A significant portion of your time is dedicated to leading Quadrant reporting for Cost-to-Serve, requiring close partnership with Operations teams to ensure alignment and accurate representation of financial impacts.

About the team
Our team uniquely bridges Operations Finance and Stores organizations, owning Cost-to-Serve strategies and cost allocations that span multiple business units. We are the only team within Operations Finance that creates this valuable connection between these two critical organizations.

Our mission centers on providing financial clarity, driving cost efficiency, and enabling data-driven decision making across the business. We take pride in our ability to influence strategic decisions through robust financial analysis and cross-functional partnerships. By joining our team, you'll have the opportunity to make a significant impact while gaining exposure to multiple aspects of the business.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree or above
- Experience in a finance role leading a project or program and partnering with multiple stakeholders within a business
- Experience working with Excel, reporting tools, and large-scale data mining tools, such as Power BI, Python, SQL, or Tableau
- Experience in financial modeling

Preferred qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Finance, Mathematics, or Economics
- Experience troubleshooting problems and offering solutions to streamline complex challenges
- Experience working in a large team or fast-paced corporate environment
- Experience making strategic business decisions and managing internal relationships

title: Recruiting Manager , Global Strategic Sourcing
descriptionHtml:
At Amazon we're working to be the most customer-centric company on earth. To get there, we need exceptionally talented, bright, and driven people. If you'd like to help us build the place to find and buy anything online, this is your chance to make history by joining the amazing recruiting team at Amazon. We need an exceptionally talented Recruiting Leader to help us find the best talent in the world to support our growth. The Amazon recruiting team is seeking a talented; results oriented recruiting leader with a passion for delighting the client and candidate, to join our recruiting organization. You will partner with the business teams to focus on both strategy and execution of meeting hiring goals. You will work with a close-knit recruiting team. Bring your recruiting industry expertise, passion for client service and commitment to viable talent strategy to Amazon, where you will be empowered to deliver world-class innovation and solutions and given the opportunity to grow partner relationships. The candidate should have strong business partnering and people development skills. This manager will work closely with the hiring managers and leadership team to build and execute against a longer-term Talent Acquisition strategy to deliver the necessary talent to support our increasing customer demand. This role will provide the opportunity to impact significantly the Amazon business as we continue our pursuit of being the most customer-centric company on the planet. Other offerings include career growth, highly collaborative teams, and a fun and passionate work environment.

Key job responsibilities
Drive sourcing capability & capacity across a geographically dispersed team within Amazon to proactively build diverse candidate pools while leveraging all available talent channels
Work closely with business leaders to influence and deliver quality assessment and high touch candidate experience through all aspects of the recruitment funnel.
Inform global teams on sourcing best practices and to help those team deliver the right results for the business to achieve their talent demand goals each year.
Partner with key stakeholders (Business Leaders, Hiring Managers, HR Business Partners and Recruiting Managers) to determine future talent needs and set and drive enabling sourcing strategies; this requires a deep understanding through extensive market research of the channels where we can find the best, diverse talent who fit our technical and cultural demands.
Build engage, manage and develop a team of high-performing staff in an extremely fast-paced and ambiguous environment.
Set team performance goals and metrics, timelines and a formal tracking process to measure and manage progress.
Develop and execute to plans to identify and drive productivity improvements that enable the team to deliver to hiring goals without having to scale deployed resources at a rate faster than the business is growing.
Periodically lead and/or participate in cross-business/cross-company special projects and initiatives related to talent acquisition.

Basic qualifications

- 5+ years of recruiting or HR experience
- Experience building, coaching and managing a recruiting team
- Experience managing large dispersed recruiting/sourcing teams
- Experience working with recruiting tools and systems, including resume databases, internet sourcing tools, and spreadsheets
- Bachelor's degree or equivalent

Preferred qualifications

- Experience creating, measuring and scaling workflow among candidates, hiring managers and the recruiting team
- Experience managing senior staff or staffing managers
- Experience partnering with hiring teams to build effective sourcing, assessment, and closing approaches with an ability to manage customer/partner expectations
- Experience with workforce planning

title: Sr. Modernization and Migration SA, Modernization and Migration Specialist SA Team
descriptionHtml:
As a Modernization & Migration Specialist Solutions Architect at AWS, you’ll build technical relationships with customers of all sizes and develop solutions to accelerate their cloud modernization/migration journey. You will operate as their trusted advisor, ensuring they get the most out of the cloud at every stage of their journey. You will engage with senior customer leaders and technical stakeholders to help them achieve increased agility and significant business value by leading their modernization/migration to AWS.

Come and build the future with us!

descriptionHtml:
The EMEA Water team is looking for a Senior Water Infrastructure Manager to support scaling and growth across our Data Centre network. If you like to drive the development, implementation and construction of new water infrastructure and have experience in infrastructure delivery end to end - this role may be for you. Your work will help deliver large-scale water projects, and water infrastructure projects outside the fenceline that our infrastructure needs to renewably and strategically operate.

AWS Infrastructure Services (AIS)

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

Key job responsibilities
- You will own the End-to -End delivery of external water infrastructure solutions, from scoping to physical delivery. This requires you to project manage as the business and technical owner of all aspects of the delivery.

- You will prepare project contracts, milestone payments and schedules; taking the contract through legal reviews and procurement pathways.

- You will build and maintaining overall delivery program and project budget, submitting Capital Allocation Requests to Senior leadership to secure finance for project delivery.

- Liaison with a wide range of regulators and external stakeholders (Water utilities, environmental agencies, health department, construction contractors etc)

Stromversorgung, Klimatechnik, Sicherheitssysteme, USV-Anlagen und Generatoren, du sorgst dafür, dass alles stabil und sicher läuft. Diese Ausbildung findet in einem hochmodernen Rechenzentrum statt, nicht in einem Lager oder Produktionsbetrieb. Hier zählen Präzision, Verantwortung und technisches Verständnis.

Du packst gerne an, arbeitest sorgfältig und willst früh Verantwortung für Systeme übernehmen, die wirklich zählen? Dann bist du bei uns genau richtig.

Key job responsibilities
Was Du lernen wirst:

• Installation, Überwachung und Wartung von Stromversorgungs-, Klima- und Sicherheitssystemen
• Analyse und Behebung von Störungen an Anlagen, die für die Verfügbarkeit der IT-Infrastruktur entscheidend sind
• Grundlagen und Vertiefung in Elektrotechnik, Hydraulik, Pneumatik und Steuerungstechnik
• Messen, Prüfen und Programmieren technischer Komponenten
• Zusammenarbeit mit erfahrenen Technikern zur Sicherstellung eines unterbrechungsfreien Betriebs

A day in the life
Deine Ausbildung verbindet Theorie und Praxis von Anfang an. Deine theoretische Ausbildung absolvierst du an der Werner-von-Siemens-Schule in Frankfurt, während du die praktischen Kenntnisse direkt bei AWS im Rechenzentrum erwirbst.

Ein typischer Tag? Du überprüfst am Morgen die elektrischen Versorgungssysteme, führst Messungen an einer USV-Anlage durch und dokumentierst die Ergebnisse. Am Nachmittag analysierst du eine Störungsmeldung an der Klimaanlage, lokalisierst das Problem und arbeitest mit dem Team an der Behebung. Am nächsten Tag programmierst du eine Steuerung, unterstützt bei der vorbeugenden Wartung oder begleitest die Inbetriebnahme neuer elektrischer Infrastruktur.

Du arbeitest von Anfang an Seite an Seite mit erfahrenen Techniker:innen, die dich fördern und fordern. Du übernimmst schrittweise mehr Verantwortung, probierst Dinge aus und lernst Fähigkeiten, von denen du vorher nicht wusstest, dass es sie gibt.

Das bieten wir:
• Praxisphasen am Standort Amazon Web Services Frankfurt, einem der modernsten Rechenzentren Europas
• Einblicke in elektrische Steuerungstechnik, Mittelspannungsanlagen, USV-Systeme, Gebäudesystemtechnik und IT-nahe Infrastruktur
• Begleitende Schulungen zu Projektarbeit, Sicherheitsstandards und kundenorientiertem Arbeiten
• Breites Angebot an Betriebssport- und Interessensgruppen (z.B. Firmenläufe, Team-Events)
• Entwicklungsperspektiven nach erfolgreichem Abschluss
