title: InStore Experience (ISX) Partner Coach, Reverse Logistic Services (RLS), Reverse Logistic Services (RLS)
descriptionHtml:
Reverse Logistics Services (RLS) exists to make returns effortless and reliable for every Amazon customer — no matter which store or partner they walk into. In Germany, we deliver that experience across a large network of partner and carrier locations, through convenience-led options such as Label-Free, Box-Free (LFBF) drop-off and every other way a customer can return an item in-store.

The ISX Partner Coach, Germany owns the quality and consistency of that experience across the territory of the German network. Because returns run through thousands of independent partner sites, the experience can vary widely from one location to the next — and the core of this role is closing that gap. You will get into the field, see how returns actually happen at partner locations, coach partners and their teams to the standard customers expect, and use data to focus your time on the sites that need help most. Your mission is holistic: improving in-store returns execution across all return types, so a customer's experience is just as good at the busiest location as it is at the smallest.

This role is grounded in field execution. Alongside coaching individual sites, you will help deploy the network-wide improvements that lift the German network as a whole: in-store signage and wayfinding, store supplies and replenishment, associate support and training, and the tools partners rely on to process returns. You will feed what you learn in the field back into these programs, work with internal teams to roll them out in Germany, and surface local insight that helps improve the broader EU standards — turning on-the-ground observation into lasting improvement.

This is also a founding, build-from-scratch role. You'll be one of the first ISX Partner Coaches in Germany and one of the earliest members of the EU field team, reporting to the EU ISX Senior Manager. There's no established playbook yet — you'll help create it. We're looking for someone with drive, comfort with ambiguity, and the judgment to focus on the work that matters most while the team, tools, and standards are still taking shape.

Key job responsibilities
Deliver the in-store returns experience across your assigned German territory, ensuring returns are fast, easy, and reliable across all return types.

Get into the field and coach. Visit partner locations, observe how returns are handled, and coach partner teams to Amazon's standards for speed, accuracy, and customer experience.

Use data to prioritize. You can't be everywhere — use performance data to find the locations and partners falling furthest behind and focus where you improve the customer experience most.

Drive measurable improvement on the metrics that define a great returns experience: speed of service, processing reliability, customer satisfaction, and site readiness.

Deploy network-wide improvements. Support the rollout of scalable programs — in-store signage and wayfinding, supplies and replenishment, associate support and training, and returns-processing tools — adapting them for local sites.

Manage performance to resolution. Follow a structured coaching and follow-up cycle for underperforming sites, and partner with the right internal teams (Business Partnerships for retail, Transportation for carriers) when issues need escalation.

Help build the foundation. As a founding team member, contribute to how the EU field team audits, coaches, and reports, and feed your field insights into monthly ISX reporting.

A day in the life
Reverse Logistics Services (RLS) owns Amazon's returns journey end-to-end — everything after a customer decides to send something back, until delivery at our FC. Our purpose is simple but hard: make returns effortless and reliable for every customer, across one of retail's largest reverse-logistics networks.

Within RLS, the In-Store Experience (ISX) team focuses on where returns meet the real world — the thousands of partner and carrier locations customers walk into. Working from the field, we close the gap between the best and worst locations, coach partners to a standard customers can count on, and build mechanisms that lift the whole network.

Basic qualifications

- Speak, write, and read fluently in German
- Speak, write, and read fluently in English
- Experience in operations, field operations, retail or logistics
- Experience using data to prioritize where to focus across a multi-site, distributed, or partner environment
- Willingness to travel frequently within Germany and to work hands-on in an operational store/drop-off environment

Preferred qualifications

- In-store retail operations, field operations, retail, logistics, or program management experience
- Experience in reverse logistics, returns, last-mile, or third-party partner/carrier operations, ideally in the EU
- Experience contributing to new programs, teams, or country operations (founding-member or early-team experience)
- Experience deploying or supporting operational programs across a partner network, beyond single-site execution
- Familiarity with field auditing, coaching, and structured performance-management cycles
- Bachelor's degree or equivalent operational experience
- Experience coaching, influencing, or holding others accountable without direct authority
- Comfort operating independently in an ambiguous, build-from-scratch environment, prioritizing the highest-impact work without a fully defined playbook

title: Employee Relations Manager, Employee Relations
descriptionHtml:
The North American Employee Relations (ER) team supports Field Operations organizations across fulfillment and logistics business lines. The central objective of our team is to ensure treatment of employees that is fair, respectful, and consistent with our framework of our core business values and objectives. To support that objective, this position’s responsibilities fall into proactive and reactive categories. This position focuses initially and primarily on proactive initiatives designed to promote employee experience. The ER Manager demonstrates the ability to collaborate with and influence stakeholder including, but not limited to: field operations managers, human resources, safety, legal and contractors; to analyze multiple levels of employee and partner feedback to identify risks and gaps; to create, audit, and sustain positive workplace relations programs; and to design and conduct positive workplace relations training that drives best practices. The position also works reactively on crisis-oriented situations that may arise at a single site/station, with a geographic region, or network-wide and typically must be successfully addressed under severe time constraints. Ability to balance time between projects, proactive initiatives, and crisis-response is a critical component for success in the position.

The Employee Relations Manager will possess employee relations expertise, excellent judgment, and highly developed analytical, interpersonal, and communication skills. The Manager will be comfortable both presenting to senior leaders and communicating with frontline employees. The successful Manager will be a strong project manager, capable of independently owning large-scale, network-wide projects. The Manager will quickly become an important “source of truth” regarding whether the organization is meeting its core values and principles.

This is a full-time position that reports to an Employee Relations Principal. The successful candidate must be capable of traveling domestically at least 50% of the time with potential for additional travel when necessary, and at times with short notice. The position requires on-site presence at least three days each week, but overall location can be open.

Key job responsibilities
The ER Manager also will work reactively on crisis-oriented situations that typically can only be successfully addressed under severe time constraints. An ER Manager will work reactively on employee relations issues that may arise at a single site/station, within a specific geographic region, or network wide. Balancing time between projects and crisis-response is a critical component for success. This position will focus initially and primarily on proactive initiatives designed to promote employee experience.
• Detect and Mitigate Risks: Apply employee relations expertise to successfully identify trends, gaps, and challenges; execute solution-focused strategies and programs to mitigate risks.
• Crisis Management: Work reactively on crisis-oriented partner issues under time limitations while exercising strong judgment.
• Project Management: Independently own large-scale, network-wide projects delivered on time that improve frontline partner experience.
• Analyze and Interpret Data: Exercise strong analytical skills using data and anecdotes to develop persuasive narratives and recommendations; demonstrated ability to define and measure success of programs.

title: Lab Engineer, Avionics Test Team, Avionics - Amazon Leo
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Leo is Amazon's low Earth orbit satellite network. Our mission is to deliver fast, reliable internet connectivity to customers beyond the reach of existing networks. From individual households to schools, hospitals, businesses, and government agencies, Amazon Leo will serve people and organizations operating in locations without reliable connectivity.

 Our goal is to be Earth's most customer centric company, and we are just getting started. We seek professionals who are eager to join an ambitious project that continues to push the state of the art in satellite system design, verification test, and operations.

 We are looking for an Avionics Lab Engineer who combines superb technical capabilities with a demonstrated ability to get the right things done quickly and effectively. You will work with a team of top-notch engineers and will collaborate with multiple spacecraft design, test, and operations teams. You should be comfortable with a high degree of ambiguity and relish the idea of solving problems that haven't been solved at scale before. Along the way, we guarantee that you will learn a lot, have fun, and make a positive impact on tens of millions of people.

 Export Control Requirement: Due to applicable export control laws and regulations, candidates must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.

Key job responsibilities
Configure and maintain lab computing systems (Windows/Ubuntu)
·        Execute design verification and qualification tests, test rack and electrical enclosure design
·        Oversee lab spaces, implement 5S organization principles, order consumables, track assets and inventory, and coordinate logistics with shipping/receiving
·        Troubleshoot and repair avionics circuits
·        Read electrical schematics, interpret mechanical drawings, and install wiring for low voltage electrical and electronic devices
·        Perform soldering and identify/handle RF cables and connectors (e.g., SMA)
·        Assemble test racks, cabinets, wire harnesses, and automation equipment
·        Write work instructions, assess and improve processes, and maintain attention to detail during routine operations

A day in the life
As an Amazon Leo Lab Engineer, you will be hands-on every day — assembling test hardware, soldering RF and electrical connectors, and keeping lab spaces clean and organized. You will set up and maintain Windows and Linux based systems, perform design verification and qualification tests and troubleshoot electrical issues.

About the team
Our team designs, tests, and delivers avionics subsystems such as the flight computer, power management and delivery, RF, and sensing subsystems on the satellite bus. Our team designs and delivers the test systems that enable qualifying and acceptance testing these hardware subsystems for the satellite. We take ownership and work hard to deliver the highest quality solutions to support the long-term success of Amazon Leo. This team consists of a broad set of technical backgrounds, and we look forward to welcoming people that are excited to help us deliver broadband internet to underserved communities!

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or equivalent work experience
- Experience in the Linux environment
- 2+ years of electronics lab environments experience
- Experience testing electronics hardware

Preferred qualifications

- Experience testing RF or power conversion/distribution systems.
- Experience executing design verification tests and qualification tests on avionics hardware.
- Ability to identify issues and escalate to development teams as appropriate
- Experience constructing automated test station hardware
- Familiar with test measurement equipment used in test campaigns, including thermal chambers.
- Experience working with hardware and software teams for setting up testing, and troubleshooting prototype devices

title: Program Specialist, NCC, Network Control Center
descriptionHtml:
Customer experience is at the heart of all we do at Amazon, as we strive to be Earth's most customer-centric company. Amazon Customer Service (CS) is at the forefront of customer experience, working relentlessly to provide customers a convenient, high quality, and delightful experience — across all of our CS channels — in every interaction.

Within CS, Network Solutions is responsible for designing, planning, and operating the world's largest customer service network — building intelligent, adaptive systems that anticipate demand, match customers to optimal experiences, and continuously improve service quality. We are transforming CS from a manually operated, reactive model into an AI-native ecosystem that makes CS a growth driver and competitive advantage for Amazon.


We are seeking a Program Specialist to join the Network Control Center (NCC), Amazon's central incident management function for Customer Service. The NCC detects, manages, and resolves high-severity incidents impacting customers, associates, drivers, and brands in real time — coordinating response across dozens of teams to minimize customer impact and restore service. When systems fail at scale, contact volumes spike unexpectedly, or a service disruption threatens millions of customer interactions, the NCC takes command. You will be at the center of that response — running incidents end-to-end, driving cross-functional coordination under pressure, and ensuring leadership has the information they need to make decisions fast.

At Amazon, you'll work alongside the latest AI and GenAI tools that are increasingly woven into how teams operate: from AI-powered capabilities that accelerate decision-making, to Generative AI that helps you focus on work that truly matters. You'll have opportunities and resources to develop AI fluency at your own pace, with continuous learning built into the culture.

Key job responsibilities
- Manage high-severity incidents (Sev1/Sev2) impacting Amazon CS customers by running bridge calls and coordinating with Service Delivery, Product, Engineering, PR, Legal, and Security Operations teams to drive resolution
- Triage technical and operational incidents, assess customer impact, and coordinate with relevant teams to identify root cause and resolution path
- Initiate and manage proactive customer communications including website/app banners, IVR updates, and mass notifications to reduce anxiety contacts during known issues
- Protect contact channels by identifying known-issue volume and ensuring customers with genuine issues can reach Customer Service without congestion
- Provide regular, timely updates to senior leadership with clear customer impact assessments, resolution timelines, and status indicators
- Dive deep into incident data, identify systemic problems, and present solutions and preventive measures to leadership
- Develop, maintain, and execute Standard Operating Procedures for incident response scenarios, including coordination playbooks for cross-functional teams
- Track service health metrics and coordinate with stakeholders to mitigate customer impact during capacity constraints or system degradation

Basic qualifications

- Work flexible shifts including nights, weekends, or holidays in a 24/7/365 environment
- 2+ years of program or project management experience
- Knowledge of Excel at an intermediate level (e.g., pivot tables & charts, multiple criteria lookups, nested logical/IF formulas, data cleansing, array formulas, etc.)
- Experience in Business English skills, both verbal and written
- Speak, write, and read fluently in Japanese

Preferred qualifications

- Knowledge of Lean principles and DMAIC methodology

descriptionHtml:
The role of the Packaging Designers is to create packaging that surprises and delights Amazon's customers.

The primary role of the Packaging Designer is to develop and support the scale of fiber-based packaging designs that meet or exceed our customers’ expectations for the products that they buy yet works flawlessly through the supply chain delivering the lowest total cost and highest level of sustainability.

The candidate will work directly with the program managers, automation / machinery development engineers, our customer experience teams and experts in the field of fiber- based packaging. Co-located with our designers and scientist for materials, machinery and automation design this role will work to ensure that Amazon’s packaging is best in class through co-creation and optimization. Directly develop prototype and test new packaging designs using ArtiosCAD and SolidWorks
Create visual renderings to communicate design intent to stakeholders
Create detailed packaging specifications

This group works backwards from deep customer insights to deliver solutions that seamlessly integrate into brownfield and greenfield deployments with safety as a top priority. In addition, Sustainable Packaging solutions are a thread that impacts and connects all parts of the Amazon Stores supply chain and customer experience. title: Regional Safety Manager , Data Center Health and Safety
descriptionHtml:
Join the world-class safety culture at Amazon Web Services (AWS) and be part of supporting the largest cloud computing infrastructure team as a Regional Safety Manager. This role owns the Health and Safety function for the Germany and Sweden and supervises a team of Health and Safety professionals across both countries.

You will be part of a regional and global team that works with internal and external partners to maintain and enhance the safety of operations. Close collaboration with onsite physical security, vendors, compliance officers, risk management, and fire/life safety systems is required. Additionally, you will work with employees and contractors to achieve specific safety objectives.

You will set the vision and define the safety strategy for your regional portfolio, design the right team structure and mechanisms to meet long-term business goals, and achieve consensus on priorities with senior operations partners. The ADC portfolio is in a period of growth, expanding across established sites and new builds, so you will anticipate future capacity needs and build a workforce strategy to match.

The candidate must hold a valid Fachkraft für Arbeitssicherheit (SIFA) certification and will be responsible for ensuring compliance with all applicable German occupational safety legal obligations, including risk assessments (Gefährdungsbeurteilungen), employee safety training, Safety Committee (ASA) participation, incident reporting, and regulatory requirements under the Arbeitsschutzgesetz (ArbSchG), DGUV Regulation 1, and SGB VII, as well as ensuring full adherence to all AWS safety policies and management systems.

This role sits within the EMEA Data Center Health and Safety team, where English is the working language for all business communication, collaboration, and reporting. Interviews will be conducted in English, and advanced English proficiency (written and spoken) is required.

This role is based in Germany. Regular travel across Germany and Sweden is required.


Key job responsibilities
Strategy & Leadership

• Own the safety strategy for Germany and Sweden, translating regional and global priorities into a multi-year execution roadmap with measurable outcomes.
• Operate as a core member of the EMEA DCHS regional leadership team, contributing to regional strategy development and representing Germany and Sweden in regional and global programme forums.
• Lead the end-to-end delivery of regional and global health and safety programmes from inception through execution, ensuring consistent rollout across assigned clusters.
• Deliver MBR and QBR narratives incorporating leading/lagging indicators, trend analysis, and strategic responses to performance gaps.
• Anticipate growth and investment needs and build workforce and succession strategy to match a scaling portfolio.

Team Management & Development

• Manage and develop a team of Health and Safety professionals across Germany and Sweden, driving hiring, coaching, performance management, and succession planning.
• Recruit and retain safety talent, ensuring the team structure supports current and future operational needs.

Regulatory Compliance & Risk Management

• Ensure compliance with German occupational safety legislation (ArbSchG, ASiG, DGUV Vorschrift 2, BG requirements) and Swedish legislation (Arbetsmiljölagen, AFS provisions).
• Lead documented Gefährdungsbeurteilungen (risk assessments) per ArbSchG §5-6, including psychosocial risk assessments, and coordinate with the appointed Betriebsarzt (occupational physician) under the ASiG dual-appointment model.
• Navigate the German dual inspection system and partner with AWS compliance and legal teams on regulatory interpretations across both jurisdictions.

Operations & Continuous Improvement

• Conduct health and safety audits and inspections of data centers to ensure compliance with regulatory and life safety requirements.
• Implement safety management systems, training programmes, risk assessments, and industrial hygiene assessments that meet or exceed regulatory standards.
• Review investigation quality and own escalation decisions for high-severity events.
• Partner with construction managers to identify and mitigate risks before new capacity goes live.

Basic qualifications

- Experience working effectively across cross-functional teams and partnering well with people at all levels within an organization
- Experience working with and influencing senior level stakeholders
- Experience in a leadership role
- Speak, write, and read fluently in German and English at C1 level or above
- A bachelor's degree or equivalent qualification in accordance with the European Qualifications Framework (EQF) in occupational safety, health and safety, engineering, or a related field.
- Certification as an Occupational Safety Specialist (Fachkraft für Arbeitssicherheit / SiFa) in accordance with Section 6 of the German Occupational Safety Act (ASiG) and DGUV Vorschrift 2.
- Minimum 5 years of professional experience working within the German and/or European occupational health and safety regulatory environment.
- In-depth knowledge of European and German occupational health and safety legislation.
- Relevant experience leading a team of health and safety professionals.

Preferred qualifications

- Experience leading organizational change initiatives across multiple locations
- Experience in a fast paced, dynamic organization
- 10+ years of increasing responsibility in safety programmes in data centers, critical infrastructure, manufacturing, or equivalent operational environments.
- NEBOSH International Diploma in Occupational Health and Safety, or equivalent international qualification.
- Experience with the Swedish Work Environment Act (Arbetsmiljölagen) and Arbetsmiljöverket regulatory framework.
- Experience navigating the German Berufsgenossenschaft / DGUV system, including Unfallverhütungsvorschriften (accident prevention regulations).
- Knowledge of ISO 45001 occupational health and safety management systems.
- Experience with Betriebsrat (works council) co-determination processes on health and safety matters under the Betriebsverfassungsgesetz (BetrVG).
- Experience in remote management of safety teams across multiple countries.
- Strong strategic narrative writing skills, including QBR and operating plan inputs for Director and VP audiences.
- Experience leading and communicating with a wide range of stakeholders, including peers, employees, and senior leaders.
- High ethical standards with a proven ability to handle highly confidential and sensitive information.
- Experience defining, designing, and implementing safety programmes, processes, and procedural documentation at scale.

title: HR Business Partner
descriptionHtml:
神奈川県（平塚市）のデリバリーステーション（以下DS）にて、ハンズオンで業務遂行が可能なHRビジネスパートナー（HR Business Partner）を募集しています。

HRビジネスパートナーは、担当するデリバリーステーション（DS）で働く従業員をカスタマーと考え、DSのリーダーの戦略パートナーとしてビジネス成長に欠かせない組織・人材面の意思決定をサポートする上での重要な役割を担います。組織開発、人材育成・配置、キャリア形成の機会、組織文化の醸成など、短期・中長期にわたるさまざまなHRソリューションを人事部門の他チームやメンバーと連携・協働しながら提供します。
また、勤務地は神奈川県平塚市ですが、様々なプロジェクトを通じて全国にあるDSのNetworkに貢献する機会があります。

このポジションでは、採用、評価、配置、代謝といった一連の人事管理とDSで働く従業員の勤怠や労務環境を管理する労務管理について、ハンズオンなアプローチで責任を持って業務遂行していただきます。具体的には、ビジネスリーダーとの対話や人事データの分析を通じて組織における問題点を特定し、戦略的な人事配置や人材開発を行なったり、パフォーマンスや言動に問題ある社員対応等、Employee Relations（ER）にも問題解決までの方向性を提案、道筋を立ててマネージャーと連携することもあります。これらの業務を遂行するため、高いコミュニケーション能力とハンズオンのアプローチが必要です。また、論理的かつ分析能力に優れ、労働法、組織開発、報酬・福利厚生等における幅広い知識を持っている必要があります。

DSの従業員構成は、製造業・物流業・小売業等と類似しており、年俸制の社員に加え、時間給パートタイマーや、派遣社員・請負労働者を含みます。上記業界での経験は、目まぐるしく変化するビジネス環境に適応することに役立ちます。

このポジションでは、事業成長スピードが速い会社のHRとして、ビジネス感覚（スピード感）を鍛えることが出来ます。また、HRのエキスパートとしてビジネスリーダーや社員と向き合うので、専門性をもって働くことが期待され、責任ある業務に取り組むことになります。将来的に希望する場合は、ピープルマネジメントをするチャンスや、グローバルなプロジェクトに取り組む機会も与えられます。

我々はHR Business PartnerのDiversity拡大にも取り組んでいます。HRジェネラリストだけでなく、特定エリアのスペシャリストで、HR Business Partnerになることを目指している方も歓迎します。（例: HRコンサルタントやHRのアウトソーシング業務に携わっている方など）。このようなバックグラウンドの方々には、培ったスキルを発揮し、私たちのHR Operationをより高いレベルに引き上げていただくことを期待しています。

title: Senior Space & Radiation Effects Engineer, Amazon Leo
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Leo is Amazon's low Earth orbit satellite network. Our mission is to deliver fast, reliable internet connectivity to customers beyond the reach of existing networks. From individual households to schools, hospitals, businesses, and government agencies, Amazon Leo will serve people and organizations operating in locations without reliable connectivity.

As a Senior Radiation Effects Engineer on the Amazon Leo team, you will be responsible for ensuring avionics and payload hardware performance across our satellite constellation through the challenging LEO radiation environment. You will perform analysis, design guidance, and testing at the component, board, unit, and subsystem levels — working with a vast array of satellite electronics to ensure radiation reliability.

Export Control Requirement: Due to applicable export control laws and regulations, candidates must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.

Key job responsibilities
Amazon seeks a Senior Radiation Effects Engineer to be part of a small team focused on reliability against radiation effects.
• Candidate will define, collect, and analyze TID, heavy ion, and proton testing data to qualify components against space radiation and help build a database of electronic component test data
• Candidate will help to determine system-level impact of radiation-induced failures
• Candidate will be responsible for the qualification of a wide range of electronic components including microcontrollers, memory devices, FPGAs, and power management hardware
• Will work with an interdisciplinary team to offer guidance to electrical design engineers on the selection and proper utilization of radiation sensitive components
• Lead root-cause analysis of on-orbit radiation events. Develop tools and dashboards to organize and visualize on-orbit events.
• Develop processes for managing component and satellite hardware test results and documentation
• Develop testing and reporting standards for component and flight PCBA radiation tests
• Work with supply chain and component reliability teams to refine preferred components across programs
• Review PCN changes to ensure maintenance of radiation qualification status

About the team
At Amazon, we are working to build the world's most advanced low Earth orbit (LEO) satellite constellation to deliver fast, affordable broadband to unserved and underserved communities around the globe. Project Kuiper (Amazon Leo) will provide connectivity for tens of millions of customers who lack reliable internet access. This is an ambitious, long-term program that combines Amazon's customer obsession with latest technology in aerospace engineering.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering or a related field, or experience working in electrical engineering field
- 3+ years of experience in spaceflight avionics development, parts selection, and radiation test
- 3+ years System design and component qualification experience with radiation environments and radiation tolerant hardware
- Demonstrated understanding of the impact of SEE and TID effects on electronic systems.
- Experience with one or more standard radiation environment modeling tools, including but not limited to IRENE, OMERE, SIRE2, SPENVIS, OLTARIS, CREME96, SAPPHIRE, ESP, or PSYCHIC.

Preferred qualifications

- Master's degree or above in electrical engineering, computer science, mathematics or physics
- PhD in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, Mathematics, or a related technical field
- Experience in component selection and understanding of component reliability
- Experience with one or more radiation transport codes, including but not limited to NOVICE, FASTRAD, SHIELDOSE2, GEANT4, or MCNP.
- Experience with NASA, Defense or Commercial Space programs.
- Knowledge of any of the following: Python, LabView, AI-vibe coding.
- Experience collaborating with reliability team with vehicle-level reliability models.
- Knowledge of AWS tools such as S3 and DynamoDB.
- Proficiency with hardware blueprints/schematics and circuit functions based on designs.
- Proficiency with avionics hardware spanning integrated circuits, PCBA boards, sensors/transducers, functional troubleshooting, and defect detection

We connect customers to relevant products through engaging, timely, and contextually meaningful experiences. We continuously evolve how products are discovered by translating customer behavior, trends, and platform dynamics into content that feels native, personalized, and aligned to how customers shop today.

The Senior Product Marketing Manager, Amazon Private Brands (APB) owns paid social marketing for APB — driving performance through the intersection of creative strategy, merchandising, and channel execution. This role translates category trends, cultural moments, and customer behavior into high-performing social programs that drive efficient spend and measurable conversion across Meta, TikTok, Pinterest, and more.

This leader will drive paid social performance for Amazon Private Brands by setting the creative and merchandising strategy that fuels channel efficiency. They will establish how products are selected, positioned, and brought to life in platform-native formats — translating emerging trends, seasonal moments, and performance signals into compelling programs, while continuously evolving strategy through experimentation and data-driven iteration. This role requires a performance marketing mindset paired with strong creative judgment and merchandising instincts — someone who understands how creative and product decisions directly drive ROAS, CTR, and downstream conversion.

As an Individual Contributor, you will operate in close partnership with the Social Marketing team, Amazon Private Brands marketing team, and creative teams — ensuring creative and merchandising inputs are tightly aligned to business strategy, optimization cycles, and efficient media investment. You will stay deeply connected to customer trends, emerging brands, and evolving platform formats, using those insights to inform both near-term execution and long-term marketing strategy.

title: Revenue Cycle Analyst, AI & Process Innovation, Healthcare Finance Operations
descriptionHtml:
Join Amazon Healthcare Finance Operations Services as a Revenue Cycle Defect Analyst focused on identifying, documenting, and validating revenue cycle defects that impact financial performance. In this role, you will serve as a critical individual contributor responsible for defining defects within billing, collections, cash application, and denial management processes. You will hypothesize about potential defects, design and execute experiments to prove their existence and impact, and package findings into structured defect analyses that enable technology and operations teams to implement solutions.

Through data-driven analysis and manual review, you will identify patterns among aged receivables, analyze billing and cash receipts reports, and surface trends that contribute to revenue leakage, claim denials, and operational inefficiencies. You will leverage your knowledge of AI-assisted analytics and statistical methods to strengthen the rigor of your findings, ensuring that each defect paper provides clear evidence, quantified impact, and actionable root cause analysis.

The ideal candidate brings strong healthcare revenue cycle expertise, demonstrates exceptional analytical capabilities, possesses an eye for detail and process improvement, and has a proven ability to translate complex data into clear, evidence-based documentation. Experience with statistical methods, AI-enabled tools, and a passion for experimentation are highly valued.

The Finance Operations organization works with every part of Amazon to provide procure-to-pay, revenue-to-receipt, real-estate and facilities, operations accounting and operations excellence services with the highest level of controllership at the lowest cost to the company. We provide the backbone systems and operational processes which completely, accurately, and validly pay Amazon's suppliers, invoice our customers and report financial results. Amazon is quickly building the Finance Operations capabilities in the healthcare industry by creating the Healthcare Finance Operations Services.


Key job responsibilities
In this analytical role, you will identify and investigate revenue cycle defects across billing, collections, cash application, and denial management processes. Your primary focus will be discovering issues through data analysis, forming hypotheses about root causes, and running targeted experiments to validate your findings before packaging them into structured documentation for stakeholder action.

- Analyze coding, charge capture, billing, cash receipts, and accounts receivable reports and activities to identify defects, anomalies, and trends that impact revenue, cash flow, and operational efficiency
- Hypothesize about potential defects based on observed patterns, denial trends, and system behaviors, then design and execute experiments (through analytics or manual review) to prove or disprove defect existence and quantify impact
- Package validated defects into structured defect analyses that clearly articulate the problem, evidence, root cause analysis, quantified financial impact, and recommended resolution path for technology and operations stakeholders
- Leverage AI-enabled tools and awareness of emerging AI/ML capabilities to enhance defect detection, automate pattern recognition, and improve the speed and accuracy of analytical workflows
- Apply statistical methods and experimental design principles to ensure rigor in defect validation, including appropriate sampling, significance testing, and data-driven conclusions
- Identify trends and categories among aged receivables, denial patterns, and payer behaviors; provide clear, actionable feedback to stakeholders to improve results and prevent recurrence
- Identify trends and develop insights that ultimately reduce cost and improve revenue lift
- Analyze workflow and operational procedures to identify opportunities for improved reimbursement; document findings and present recommendations to leadership
- Produce clear, well-structured technical writing including defect analyses, root cause analyses, and process documentation that effectively communicates complex findings and processes to both technical and non-technical audiences
- Coordinate cross-functionally to analyze data drivers, develop comprehensive insights, and present clear, actionable findings to key stakeholders including technology teams, operations, and finance
- Contribute to the evaluation of AI initiatives and explore how automation, machine learning, and robotic process automation (RPA) can enhance defect detection and resolution workflows

Basic qualifications

- 3+ years of tax, finance or a related analytical field experience
- 3+ years of healthcare revenue cycle experience within registration, scheduling, billing, cash collection, cash application, or denial management/follow-up
- Medical billing experience with an understanding of healthcare reimbursement processes, third-party payer guidelines, and compliance requirements
- Demonstrated ability to analyze processes and information, identify problems and trends, and develop effective solutions and strategies
- Strong technical writing skills with the ability to clearly document findings, articulate complex issues, and communicate effectively in written form to diverse stakeholders
- Ability to work independently, handle multiple tasks, and exhibit problem-solving skills with an exceptional eye for detail

Preferred qualifications

- 4+ years of healthcare revenue cycle experience in a hospital or physician provider setting
- Coursework or applied experience in statistics, experimental design, or quantitative research methods
- Professional certifications such as CPC (Certified Professional Coder) or CRCR (Certified Revenue Cycle Representative), Certified Coding Associate (CCA), Certified Coding Specialist (CCS)
- Awareness of AI/ML tools and their application to data analysis, pattern recognition, and process automation in revenue cycle contexts
- Experience writing structured analyses, research papers, or technical documentation that translates complex findings for diverse audiences
- Extensive knowledge of critical business processes including Coding, Charge Capture, Billing, Collections, Cash Application, Dispute and Denial Management
- Knowledge of system interfaces with Accounts Receivable and experience identifying incomplete or inaccurate data and determining root causes
- Experience creating process improvements through analysis and automation
- Experience with electronic health record systems and clearinghouse platforms

Technical writing to support change management program

Regularly walk, use hands and fingers, handle or feel, reach with hands and arms, stoop, kneel, crouch or crawl, climb stairs, twist, bend, work above shoulders, grasp, carry, push and pull objects into position

Work in an environment requiring provided ear protection

Ability to travel to or commute between data center locations as needed

Willingness to temporarily work at alternative sites during training periods or until assigned facility is operational

descriptionHtml:

Amazon Optics develops and operates the critical services that Corporate and AWS data center employees rely on to protect our physical sites and preserve the trust our customers place in us. As a Systems Development Engineer II, you sit at the intersection of software and infrastructure: you build the deployment pipelines, fleet automation, monitoring, and operational tooling that let a small team run a global, safety-critical access control system with minimal manual toil. When "can't be done" isn't an accepted answer, you find the extensible, scalable path and simplify along the way.

Lead technical design for medium-to-large infrastructure initiatives, balancing complexity, scalability, security, and delivery speed.

Develop Infrastructure as Code (e.g., AWS CDK/CloudFormation) to provision and manage services and their supporting resources.

Diagnose and resolve complex issues across the stack, from service code to underlying infrastructure and device connectivity.

Improve deployment safety and release velocity through automated testing, bake/rollback gating, and reduction of change-related risk.

title: Sr. Technical Program Manager, Amazon Leo - OISL
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Leo is Amazon's low Earth orbit satellite network. Our mission is to deliver fast, reliable broadband connectivity to customers beyond the reach of existing networks. From households to small businesses, schools, hospitals, and government agencies, Amazon Leo will serve communities and organizations operating in places without dependable internet access.

We are seeking a Senior Technical Program Manager to drive flight software delivery for the OISL program. In this role, you will be the central coordination point for flight software builds, integration, test, and deployment across multiple hardware and software systems, including the spacecraft flight computer, GNC, networking, and optical subsystems. You will work at the intersection of embedded software engineering, systems integration, and cross-program coordination to ensure OISL flight software ships on time with high quality and at scale. Specifically, you will support the design, implementation, and release of software systems that control, monitor, and manage space and ground optical terminals.

This is a high-visibility role that requires deep technical fluency in software systems, strong program management fundamentals, and the ability to operate across organizational boundaries in a fast-paced, first-of-its-kind environment.

Export Control Requirement: Due to applicable export control laws and regulations, candidates must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.

Key job responsibilities
Support the end-to-end delivery lifecycle for flight software — driving release schedules, integration test campaigns, and deployment coordination across concurrent programs.

Collaborate with Software Development Managers as a peer to drive integrated delivery, resolve competing priorities, and maintain accountability across all active workstreams.

Coordinate cross-program feature development with Technical Program Managers and hardware teams — aligning interfaces, managing dependencies, and removing blockers.

Build and maintain program roadmaps, schedules, and resource plans; identify critical path risks and trade-offs and drive decisions to resolution.

Define, track, and mitigate software program risks and cross-team integration risks with clear ownership and escalation paths.

Partner with mission operations, network operations, and cross-functional stakeholders to align priorities, remove blockers, and protect team focus.

Deliver clear program status reporting across scope, schedule, quality, and risk for leadership reviews and business cadences.

About the team
You will join a multi-disciplinary team of top-notch engineers whose work spans an unusually wide aperture: embedded flight software running on satellites in orbit, cloud-based systems powering mission and network operations, automation frameworks that keep a growing constellation healthy, and AI-driven capabilities that make our optical links smarter with every orbit. descriptionHtml:

AWS ProServe engages in a wide variety of strategic projects for customers and partners, bringing together AWS customer experience, best practices, and technical expertise to help organizations accelerate innovation and business outcomes. This role will focus on advising enterprise customers on how to transform business and operational outcomes through the adoption of Generative AI, Agentic AI, and Machine Learning on AWS. As a Senior Consultant, you will act as a trusted advisor to senior business and technology leaders, shape AI and cloud transformation strategies, lead complex engagements, guide architecture best practices, and oversee the successful delivery of large-scale AI/ML and GenAI implementations with customers and partners. title: Software Development Manager, Builder Foundations GRID
descriptionHtml:
We're seeking a Software Development Manager to lead an engineering team within Amazon's Center of Excellence for Orchestration (ORCA). This role offers the opportunity to shape the future of Amazon's tier-1, multi-tenant orchestration platform that powers mission-critical business workflows across Amazon's diverse ecosystem, from Retail to Digital Services and beyond.

ORCA is built on HERD and serves as the backbone for implementing complex business processes through workflow automation. As a tier-1 service, it delivers operational excellence with automated scaling, throttling, and retry mechanisms, handling peak loads without customer intervention. The platform handles the complexity of orchestration (execution, monitoring, and fault tolerance) so developers can focus on designing business workflows. It supports synchronous request-response, asynchronous execution, time-based scheduling, and event-driven triggers while seamlessly integrating with AWS services and SDO solutions like Datapath and Sable.

Your team will build robust, scalable solutions that maintain high availability for Amazon's most critical business operations. title: Operations Manager
descriptionHtml:
Job summary
Our WW Operations network delivers millions of packages and smiles to Amazon customers every day. We are looking for motivated, customer-focused individuals who want to join our team as an Operations Manager. In this role, you will lead and develop a team of salaried and hourly talent. You will be responsible for engaging your team during their shifts to maintain the highest levels of safety, quality, attendance, and performance. To achieve this, managers are expected to provide their team with the tools needed for success while driving improvements in productivity and efficiency through data-driven decisions and analytical problem-solving. You will also play a key role in maintaining our customer expectations to ensure customer orders are delivered at the right time, to the right location.

Our Operation’s workflow has three major components: First mile - where the product is housed and ready for order; Middle mile - where the order is hauled to your area; and Last mile - when the product is delivered to the customer’s door. Please note that all workflows have slight building variations, but one thing is constant: our vision and dedication to the customer.

- Lift up to 49 pounds and frequently push, pull, squat, bend, and reach
- Stand/walk for up to 12 hours during shifts
- Work in an environment where the noise level varies and can be loud

Our fulfillment network launches new Operations sites every year, providing various opportunities for your professional growth. We hire Operations Managers based on location preference and the business’ current openings.

- 3+ years of employee and performance management experience
- Bachelor's degree or equivalent, or 2+ years of Amazon (blue badge/FTE) experience

• 設備の故障や保守、拡張等に伴う技術的な問題の調査、解決
• データセンターで使われている機器の設置や撤去

A day in the life

A day in the life
As an Investigations Expert, you will be a skilled and largely autonomous practitioner within the investigations team, managing a caseload of difficult and complex investigations while supporting the Senior Investigations Manager and contributing to team-wide quality and capability. On a daily basis, you will:

Working in partnership with our stakeholders, Security and Loss Prevention secures the Amazon supply chain end-to-end and promotes security during business conversations. The Investigations team is a support function to Security and Loss Prevention Field Operations, responsible for the management, development, and conclusion of investigative activity. Our team provides support, guidance, and direction on a broad range of investigative issues - from theft of inventory and workplace incidents to complex, sophisticated fraud involving multiple bad actors, stakeholders, and marketplaces.

title: Research Account Manager, UK Education
descriptionHtml:
Would you like to help the organisations that fund and enable UK science get more from the cloud?

The UK’s central research bodies — UKRI and its Research Councils (EPSRC, MRC, BBSRC, NERC, STFC, AHRC, ESRC), the Wellcome Trust, NIHR, the Royal Society, the British Academy, and national research facilities — collectively invest billions of pounds each year in science and innovation. They fund researchers, operate world-class facilities (from the Diamond Light Source to the Hartree Centre), define data and computing strategies for entire disciplines, and set the policy frameworks that shape how research infrastructure is provisioned across the UK. Increasingly, cloud is central to their plans.

The government has committed £1 billion to expand AI compute capacity 20× by 2030 through the AI Research Resource (AIRR). UKRI’s £129 million Digital Research Infrastructure programme is building a connected national fabric of compute, data, and skills. STFC operates national HPC services, Jisc provides shared digital infrastructure to the sector, and the Wellcome Trust is investing heavily in open data platforms and Trusted Research Environments. These organisations are not just users of technology — they are the architects of the UK’s research computing future. AWS wants to be their partner of choice.

Amazon Web Services is seeking an Account Manager to own and grow a portfolio of UK central research bodies. You will be the primary commercial relationship owner for your assigned accounts — responsible for driving revenue, building pipeline, and positioning AWS as the infrastructure platform that accelerates national research outcomes. This is not about selling to individual researchers — it’s about engaging the organisations that set strategy, allocate funding, and operate shared services for the entire UK research ecosystem.

The ideal candidate will understand how public-sector funding bodies and national research organisations operate — their governance structures, procurement frameworks, strategic planning cycles, and stakeholder landscapes. They should be comfortable engaging at senior executive level (CEO, COO, CIO, Director of Digital) while also building relationships with technical leaders responsible for national platforms and services. A background in public sector, research, or science and innovation policy would be a strong advantage.

Key Job Responsibilities

Own and manage a defined portfolio of UK central research bodies (e.g. UKRI, STFC, EPSRC, MRC, BBSRC, NERC, Wellcome Trust, NIHR, Jisc, national research facilities), driving revenue growth and AWS adoption.

Develop and execute comprehensive account plans aligned to each organisation’s strategic priorities — covering national research infrastructure, data platforms, AI compute, shared services, and cloud-first policy initiatives.

Build trusted relationships with senior decision-makers: Chief Executives, Chief Operating Officers, CIOs, Directors of Digital, Heads of Research Infrastructure, and Procurement Directors.

Understand and navigate the unique funding, governance, and procurement structures of public research bodies — including UKRI framework agreements, Wellcome Trust investment governance, and government spending controls.

Identify and qualify new opportunities across national HPC services, research data platforms, AI/ML infrastructure, Trusted Research Environments, shared cloud services, and digital transformation programmes.

Maintain a robust and accurate sales pipeline with clear next steps, timely CRM updates, and reliable forecasting.

Create and articulate compelling value propositions that connect AWS capabilities to national research outcomes — accelerating science, improving data sharing, enabling open research, and reducing operational cost.

Navigate long, complex procurement cycles involving multiple governance layers, ministerial approvals, and framework compliance (e.g. G-Cloud, CCS, JANET).

Work with AWS Solution Architects, Specialist teams (HPC, AI/ML, Analytics, Storage, Security), Partners, and Professional Services to deliver technical validation and proof-of-value engagements.

Engage with AWS policy and government affairs teams to align account strategies with broader UK government technology and research policy.

Represent AWS at sector events to build relationships and generate demand.

Track and report on pipeline, revenue, and adoption KPIs; participate in QBRs and business reviews.

About the team
The AWS UK Education team is part of UK Public Sector within Worldwide Public Sector (WWPS). We work with universities, research bodies, colleges, and education technology companies across the UK to help them innovate, reduce costs, and deliver better outcomes for students and researchers. Our team combines deep sector expertise with technical credibility — we understand how the UK research ecosystem is funded, governed, and operated, and we meet our customers where they are on their cloud journey.

Basic qualifications

- Experience building strategic relationships with stakeholders, including communicating and collaborating across teams and functions
- Experience with pipeline management skills to include utilization of Salesforce or other CRM tools
- 3+ years of experience in account management, sales, or business development — ideally in technology, public sector, or research/science organisations
- Track record of managing complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles with long procurement timelines and governance requirements
- Ability to articulate technology value propositions in the context of organisational and policy outcomes
- Experience developing and executing account plans for strategic, high-value accounts
- Understanding of the UK research funding landscape — UKRI structure (Research Councils, Innovate UK, Research England), Wellcome Trust, NIHR, and how funding flows from government to researchers
- Familiarity with cloud concepts and their application to research — HPC, object storage, data lakes, AI/ML platforms, and secure multi-tenancy

Preferred qualifications

- Familiarity with national research infrastructure: STFC facilities (Diamond Light Source, ISIS, Hartree Centre), ARCHER2, JASMIN, Jisc shared services, and AIRR (Isambard-AI, Dawn)
- Knowledge of public sector procurement frameworks (G-Cloud, CCS, Crown Commercial Service, JANET) and government spending controls
- Experience working with or within UK public sector research organisations, funding bodies, or science and innovation agencies
- Understanding of data governance requirements in research — FAIR principles, open research mandates, Trusted Research Environments (TREs), data sovereignty, and information governance

title: Tax Analyst - EU VAT - German speaker, 3P ITX Compliance
descriptionHtml:
Amazon’s vision is to be Earth's most customer-centric company; to build a place where people can come to find and discover anything they might want to buy online.

Amazon's diverse online business requires VAT filings in a number of jurisdictions across Europe and creates specific VAT compliance obligations relating to third parties (3P) that sell via our websites. These 3P obligations are the responsibility of the ITX Compliance & which is located primarily in Barcelona and Bratislava. We are looking for an energetic and enthusiastic Tax Analyst to join us at the heart of our VAT C&C team in Barcelona. This is a multiple headcount hire , which will involve working within the part of the team that is responsible for checking the VAT compliance status of our 3P sellers, providing 3P data to tax authorities, and controlling the access of 3P sellers to our websites. Work may also include some mainstream VAT compliance activities, supporting internal and external audits, and liaising with colleagues in Compliance as well as Tax and the wider business – you will need an understanding of financial systems, and technical accounting awareness for this work. You may also be involved in projects that have a VAT compliance impact. You will be expected to take ownership of your activities, identify process improvement opportunities for existing process and controls, and drive positive change across the organization.

Key job responsibilities

- Manage and control access of 3P sellers to Amazon marketplaces based on VAT compliance status and requests from tax authorities;
- Assist with VAT registrations across various jurisdictions;
- Respond to VAT compliance queries from Amazon businesses operating across Europe;
- Provide internal and external audit support, including data analysis;

title: Sr. Software Development Engineer, Agentic WorkSpaces Client
descriptionHtml:
AWS Applied AI Solutions (AAIS) is building toward a future where every business innovates with Amazon AI teammates. To get there, we build AI solutions that improve human capabilities and transform entire business functions. We create end-to-end products that surprise and delight out-of-the-box, making complex things easy and hard things possible, with no cloud experience required. We start with customers who embrace the future and build bridges to meet the rest where they are. We pursue ambitious opportunities with conviction, and we are looking for builders who share that mindset.

The mission of Agentic WorkSpaces is to enable AI agents to work the way people do. Across the industry agents are becoming digital workers. Like every team member they need identity, permissions, governance, and a trusted place to do their work. The Agentic WorkSpaces Client team builds the front door to that place: the client software people use to securely access and operate the desktop and web applications their businesses rely on and the software AI agents will use to do the same. We build the client software that runs on customer endpoints across major operating systems and browsers and we own critical parts of the connection and user experience for Amazon WorkSpaces a highly scaled system that delivers remote desktops and streamed applications to millions of end users every day. We are evolving that same client experience to carry agentic workloads which require secure access, enterprise permissions, governance, observability, and human oversight. Learn more: https://aws.amazon.com/workspaces/ We are looking for a Software Development Engineer to design build and operate customer-facing capabilities across native and web clients advancing the client that enterprise agents will work through while supporting a system that millions of people depend on today. Industry consensus points to a growing share of cloud desktop workloads becoming agentic in the coming years. We build the client software those desktops are reached through which is exactly why the Agentic WorkSpaces Client team can lead that shift. Today most of the team's work is building and running the clients our users rely on; the agentic share of the roadmap grows from there. Your work includes secure session connectivity, client lifecycle, cross-platform architecture, user experience, performance, software updates, operational telemetry, and integrations supporting human and agentic workflows. You will own features from design through production collaborate with teams across AWS solve complex issues in customer-managed environments and maintain a high bar for security reliability and operational excellence. Agentic WorkSpaces offers a combination most roles don't: the early build-out of agent infrastructure on the scale of a mature AWS service. You will not be starting from a blank page and you will not be maintaining a system in stasis. You will shape the evolution of Amazon WorkSpaces by extending a proven system rather than rewriting it. The problems span operating systems web technologies networking security and distributed services and your work will directly influence how people and AI agents securely interact with enterprise applications. We are passionate about our customers and love to solve their most critical problems. If you enjoy hard problems that span the client and the cloud and want to work with a talented inclusive team that prides itself on a great work environment join us.

About the team
Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn't followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don't let it stop you from applying.

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world's most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that's why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why flexible work hours and arrangements are part of our culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there's nothing we can't achieve in the cloud.

Here at AWS, it's in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity and AmazeCon conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

We're continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth's Best Employer. That's why you'll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Basic qualifications

- 5+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
- 5+ years of programming with at least one software programming language experience
- 5+ years of leading design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
- Experience as a mentor, tech lead or leading an engineering team

Preferred qualifications

- 5+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
- Experience leading large, fast-moving projects
- Experience handling ambiguous or undefined challenges through strong problem solving abilities
- Experience architecting, securing, and operating Amazon Web Services

descriptionHtml:

They will maintain, operate, and troubleshoot mission-critical data center facility equipment including electrical support equipment such as stand-by diesel generators and related fuel systems, 3 phase electrical systems that include but not limited to switchgear, UPS units, PDUs, and wet cell batteries and associated systems. Mechanical equipment includes CRAC units, centrifugal chillers, cooling towers/water chemical systems, air handlers and associated systems, pumps, and motors. Additional support equipment is included in the scope of the role which includes fire suppression systems, building automation systems, and general facilities equipment.

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

Effectively and efficiently manage the operations budget and expenditures

title: Applied Scientist III, Sponsored Products and Brands - Advertiser Growth - Cross-border Seller Experience (CBSX)
descriptionHtml:
The Sponsored Products and Brands team at Amazon Ads is re-imagining the advertising landscape through generative AI technologies, revolutionizing how millions of customers discover products and engage with brands across Amazon.com and beyond. We are at the forefront of re-inventing advertising experiences, bridging human creativity with artificial intelligence to transform every aspect of the advertising lifecycle from ad creation and optimization to performance analysis and customer insights. We are a passionate group of innovators dedicated to developing responsible and intelligent AI technologies that balance the needs of advertisers, enhance the shopping experience, and strengthen the marketplace. If you're energized by solving complex challenges and pushing the boundaries of what's possible with AI, join us in shaping the future of advertising.

We are looking for a Senior Applied Scientist to build the science that helps Amazon's advertisers grow — with a focus on Cross Border Sellers who face distinct barriers as they scale across multiple marketplaces, and this role is about understanding those pain points deeply and removing them: building intelligent, autonomous solutions that simplify advertising, act efficiently on the advertiser's behalf, and let advertisers accelerate their growth and success.

We expect a Senior Scientist to think innovatively about how to reduce the effort and complexity of advertising for these advertisers. Working backwards from their needs — spanning hands-off sellers and global brands with cross-marketplace operations — you will take the lead on medium-to-large, ambiguous problems where neither the problem nor the solution is well defined, invent new methods, validate them through rigorous experimentation, and deliver customer-facing products with measurable business impact. This role combines science depth, product focus, and hands-on engineering: you will raise the science bar, build consensus on approach across product and engineering partners, and mentor scientists and engineers while remaining deeply hands-on with the hardest technical problems.

Key job responsibilities
As a Senior Applied Scientist on this team you will:

- Understand the pain points of Cross border advertisers as they scale across marketplaces, and build science-driven solutions that remove barriers and accelerate their growth and success.
- Build agentic and ML systems that autonomously create, structure, and manage ad campaigns on advertisers' behalf, encoding auction and marketplace dynamics (bidding, budget pacing, targeting decisions) while balancing advertiser ROI, shopper experience, and marketplace health.
- Innovate on new, simpler ways to advertise powered by GenAI, and push the frontier of existing autonomous programs (e.g., auto-targeting, global lift-and-shift) while proposing and prototyping the next generation of campaign automation.
- Develop models across the campaign lifecycle — opportunity discovery, ranking, ad-readiness and demand prediction, and bid/budget optimization — and apply the right approach for each problem, from classical ML to LLM/reasoning methods.
- Define and curate the datasets and signals needed to train and evaluate these systems — advertiser and campaign data, cross-marketplace performance, auction and bid/budget signals, impressions, clicks, conversions, and search-term/keyword performance.
- Own core parts of the agentic architecture — planning, tool use and integration (e.g., MCP), reasoning frameworks (e.g., ReAct, CoT/ToT), and model customization — and define evaluation and safety methodology so that automated decisions are reliable and trustworthy.
- Stay deeply hands-on: write production-quality, critical-path code and build core components that take systems from prototype to launch on large-scale pipelines (Spark/EMR, Airflow) and online serving.
- Raise the science bar: mentor scientists and engineers, review designs and experiment plans, and communicate results and tradeoffs clearly to technical and business leaders.


About the team

Autonomous SP drives growth and simplifies advertising for Amazon's hands-off advertisers by creating and enhancing autonomous campaign solutions. We lead existing successful programs, including auto-targeting and global lift-and-shift, and continually innovate by building new, simpler campaign constructs powered by GenAI to act efficiently on advertisers' behalf.

Cross-border Seller Experience (CBSX) focuses on developing targeted solutions for domestic and global advertisers with multi-marketplace operations. By understanding and addressing their unique Seller Central needs, we optimize for cross-marketplace efficiency, improved performance, and streamlined advertising experiences. Our team operates horizontally, delivering impactful solutions that benefit both hands-on and hands-off advertisers globally.

Together, we sit within Sponsored Products and Brands, which is re-imagining advertising through the latest generative AI — building responsible, intelligent systems that balance the needs of advertisers, the shopping experience, and marketplace health.

Basic qualifications

- 5+ years of building machine learning models for business application experience
- PhD, or Master's degree and 6+ years of applied research experience
- Experience programming in Java, C++, Python or related language
- Experience with neural deep learning methods and machine learning

Preferred qualifications

- Experience with modeling tools such as R, scikit-learn, Spark MLLib, MxNet, Tensorflow, numpy, scipy etc.
- Experience with large scale distributed systems such as Hadoop, Spark etc.

descriptionHtml:
The International Logistics Coordinator provides administrative and operational support for international import and export activities. The role assists with shipment coordination, documentation, tracking, data entry, and communication with internal teams, vendors, carriers, freight forwarders, and customs brokers.

The Coordinator supports the successful movement of international shipments by ensuring required information and documentation are collected, accurately entered, and provided to the appropriate stakeholders in a timely manner. This is a support-focused role and does not independently make trade compliance, routing, financial, or regulatory decisions. Issues requiring business, compliance, financial, or management decisions are escalated to the appropriate team or designated owner.

Key job responsibilities
• Assists with the coordination of international import & export shipments
• Enters and maintains shipment information in applicable logistics systems & tracking tools
• Creates or assists with shipping documentation based on established procedures
• Monitors shipment statuses & provides updates to internal stakeholders
• Follows up with carriers, freight forwarders, vendors, and suppliers regarding shipment statuses and required information
• Assists with scheduling pickups, deliveries, and transportation activities
• Supports shipment exception management by identifying issues and escalating them to the
appropriate owner
• Collects required shipment information from internal teams, suppliers, and vendors.
• Assists with preparation & review of commercial invoices, packing lists, bills of lading,
certificates, and other shipping documents.
• Verifies documents are complete & consistent with the information provided
• Identifies missing or conflicting information & requests corrections before shipment processing
• Maintains electronic shipment records & documentation in accordance with company
procedures
• Supports document retrieval for audits, shipment inquiries, and internal requests
• Provides administrative support to the Import/Export & Trade Compliance teams
• Assists with gathering information required for customs clearance
• Coordinates documentation requests between internal stakeholders, customs brokers, freight
forwarders, and suppliers
• Tracks customs clearance status & communicates necessary requirements
• Escalates potential customs, export-control, documentation, or regulatory issues to the
appropriate stakeholder
• Follows established country-specific shipping and compliance procedures

About the team
Global Transportation & Logistics (GTL) is the logistics team that supports the non-inventory IT equipment moves around the world. Our mission is to deliver what our customers need, where they need it, when they need it. descriptionHtml:

title: ERP Transformation - Data management and Release Lead, Accounting Transformation Group
descriptionHtml:
Amazon is seeking a Data Migration and Release Lead to drive data migration, cutover, and release execution for a multi-year transformation of Amazon’s Finance ERP platform. This leader will work across Accounting, Finance, Product, Engineering, Solution Architecture, Internal Controls, SAP, and implementation partners to ensure financial data is accurately migrated and new capabilities are deployed in a controlled manner.

This role will translate the ERP transformation strategy into an executable data migration and release plan spanning data extraction, transformation, cleansing, mapping, validation, reconciliation, cutover, deployment, and stabilization. The Data Migration and Release Lead will establish governance, define milestones and quality criteria, manage risks and dependencies, and coordinate execution across business and technology teams.

The ideal candidate combines strong Finance ERP and accounting-data knowledge with experience delivering complex migration and release programs. They should be comfortable navigating ambiguity, identifying issues before they affect critical milestones, influencing stakeholders, and using data to drive decisions. This leader will be accountable for establishing repeatable mechanisms and ensuring migration and release activities satisfy Amazon’s controllership, financial reporting, security, and operational requirements.
The role requires knowledge of financial master and transactional data, including charts of accounts, legal entities, ledgers, balances, open items, journals, intercompany transactions, fixed assets, and other relevant financial information. Experience with SAP S/4HANA, Oracle ERP, financial data migration, and large-scale enterprise releases is highly preferred.

Key job responsibilities
• Own the end-to-end data migration and release strategy, integrated plan, governance, and execution for the Finance ERP transformation.
• Define the migration scope, sequencing, conversion approach, data-retention requirements, quality standards, and acceptance criteria.
• Coordinate data profiling, extraction, mapping, transformation, cleansing, loading, validation, and reconciliation activities.
• Partner with Accounting and Finance teams to establish business rules, ownership, sign-off requirements, and financial reconciliation controls.
• Lead migration cycles and mock conversions, using results to improve data quality, performance, processes, and cutover readiness.
• Establish metrics and reporting for data quality, conversion completeness, reconciliation status, defects, risks, and readiness.
• Develop and maintain the integrated release and cutover plan, including business and technical dependencies, resource requirements, decision points, and contingency plans.
• Coordinate release activities across Product, Engineering, Architecture, Testing, Business Readiness, Change Management, Security, Controls, and operations teams.
• Lead cutover planning and execution, including command-center governance, status reporting, escalation mechanisms, rollback criteria, and stabilization activities.
• Ensure data migration and release activities comply with accounting, audit, security, privacy, retention, and internal-control requirements.
• Identify and resolve cross-functional risks and dependencies that could affect migration quality, release timing.
• Create updates for senior leaders covering progress, risks, decisions, quality results, readiness, and required interventions.

A day in the life
You will work across Accounting and technology teams to plan and execute Finance ERP data migration and releases. Each day may include reviewing conversion results, resolving data-quality or reconciliation issues, coordinating dependencies, and assessing cutover readiness. You will partner with Accounting, Engineering, Testing, Controls, and implementation teams to drive decisions and maintain alignment. You will also monitor migration and release metrics, escalate material risks, and provide clear updates to program leaders. Your focus will be ensuring financial data is complete, accurate, controlled, and ready to support a successful deployment.

About the team
Accounting Transformation Group drives initiatives that modernize accounting processes, improve controllership, and enable scalable growth across Amazon. The team works at the intersection of accounting, finance, process design, and technology to build better mechanisms, improve financial operations, and support new business models with strong and efficient financial foundations.

Basic qualifications

- 7+ years of Experience leading data migration, conversion, deployment, cutover, or release activities for large-scale enterprise technology programs.
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

- Experience delivering SAP S/4HANA or Oracle ERP data migration and release programs.
- Knowledge of General Ledger, record-to-report, consolidation, intercompany accounting, foreign currency, subledgers, and financial reporting.
