title: Technical Program Manager, Customer Logistics Security
descriptionHtml:
Customer Logistics Security (CLS) protects the physical and digital infrastructure that moves every Amazon package. We are looking for a Technical Program Manager to drive security program execution across Operational Technology (OT) and infrastructure environments, coordinating with engineering teams, business stakeholders, and external partners to deliver outcomes that reduce risk at scale.

- You will own the day-to-day execution of cross-functional security programs, managing dependencies, timelines, and stakeholder alignment across internal and external teams.
- You will establish and run operating mechanisms that keep programs on track and leadership informed.
- You will operate in a space where security requirements intersect with industrial systems, network infrastructure, and physical operations, requiring you to build context quickly and translate between technical and business audiences.

Key job responsibilities
- Own end-to-end execution of security programs from planning through delivery, managing scope, timelines, dependencies, and risks across multiple teams.
- Establish and maintain operating mechanisms (status cadences, tracking artifacts, escalation paths) that create visibility and drive accountability.
- Coordinate with internal engineering teams and external stakeholders to align priorities, secure commitments, and unblock delivery.
- Identify and resolve cross-team dependencies and conflicts before they become blockers, escalating with data when needed.
- Translate technical security problems into structured program plans with clear milestones, owners, and success criteria.
- Drive closure on action items, decisions, and deliverables, ensuring programs maintain momentum through competing priorities.
- Communicate program status, risks, and trade-offs to leadership in a clear, concise format that enables decision-making.
- Contribute to process improvement by identifying recurring friction in program execution and building mechanisms to prevent it.

About the team
The OT & Infrastructure Security (OTIS) team is part of Customer Logistics Security (CLS). We secure the operational technology and network infrastructure that powers Amazon's fulfillment, sortation, and delivery network. Our scope includes industrial control systems, facility networks, and the security architecture that protects them. We operate at the intersection of physical operations and cybersecurity, which means the problems are tangible, the scale is massive, and the work matters immediately. The team is collaborative, direct, and outcome-oriented. We value clarity over ceremony, shipped results over activity, and people who build mechanisms that outlast any single project.

Diverse Experiences
Amazon Security values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why Amazon Security?
At Amazon, security is central to maintaining customer trust and delivering delightful customer experiences. Our organization is responsible for creating and maintaining a high bar for security across all of Amazon’s products and services. We offer talented security professionals the chance to accelerate their careers with opportunities to build experience in a wide variety of areas including cloud, devices, retail, entertainment, healthcare, operations, and physical stores.

Inclusive Team Culture
In Amazon Security, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Ongoing DEI events and learning experiences inspire us to continue learning and to embrace our uniqueness. Addressing the toughest security challenges requires that we seek out and celebrate a diversity of ideas, perspectives, and voices.

Training & Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, training, and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why flexible work hours and arrangements are part of our culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.

Basic qualifications

- Experience managing programs across cross functional teams, building processes and coordinating release schedules
- 3+ years of project management disciplines including scope, schedule, budget, quality, along with risk and critical path management experience
- 3+ years of technical product or program management experience

Preferred qualifications

- Experience with programming/scripting (Batch, VB, PowerShell, Java, C#, Chef, Perl, Ruby and/or PHP), or experience in Database like NoSQL and experience managing full application stacks from the OS up through custom applications
- Project Management Professional (PMP) or equivalent certification
- Experience in a logistics/operations environment
- Experience in security, infrastructure, or operational technology domains
- Experience managing programs with external stakeholders or partner organizations
- Experience with risk-based prioritization and trade-off analysis
- Familiarity with industrial control systems, network security, or physical security environments
- Experience writing narratives or program documents for senior leadership audiences

title: Corporate Counsel, IP, Intellectual Property
descriptionHtml:
Amazon's Global Entertainment Media (GEM) IP team manages trademark and copyright matters across Amazon's entertainment portfolio, including Prime Video, Amazon MGM Studios, Luna, Audible, Amazon Music, and related media properties. As an attorney on this team, you will work directly with business and legal stakeholders on a wide range of trademark and copyright issues at both the brand and content level, spanning film, live sports, television, gaming, podcasts, and audio entertainment globally.

This role is part of a high-performing team of IP professionals operating across multiple entertainment business lines simultaneously. The position reports to Senior IP Counsel and is based in Culver City, CA, USA.


Key job responsibilities
Responsibilities include title clearance and protection; trademark prosecution, maintenance, and enforcement; copyright protection and enforcement; deal negotiation and licensing; dispute management; developing and implementing IP processes and best practices; and counseling business teams across Amazon's entertainment verticals on IP matters.

A day in the life
Your day centers on managing trademark and copyright matters across Amazon's Global Media and Entertainment Businesses - including Amazon MGM Studios, Prime Video, Luna, Twitch, Music, and Audible. title: System I&T Engineer, Amazon Leo for Government (ALG), SEIT | MFG
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Leo is a visionary initiative within Amazon that aims to revolutionize global connectivity through the development of a state-of-the-art Low Earth Orbit (LEO) interconnected satellite communication constellation. Our mission is to bridge the digital divide by delivering high-speed, low latency, internet services to underserved and unserved communities and remote communities around the world. By leveraging cutting-edge satellite technology, we are working towards a future where everyone has access to reliable and high-quality internet connectivity regardless of their location.

The Amazon Leo for Government (ALG) Engineering organization is a multi-disciplinary technology team established to rapidly address the needs of targeted government and international customers with specific solutions that have the potential to scale. ALG Engineering leads the development and delivery of targeted and scalable solutions for custom space and terrestrial applications. ALG collaborates closely with Amazon Leo to leverage the constellation of advanced satellites to provide seamless and efficient communication capabilities to meet the needs of our customers. The ALG Engineering team is seeking highly technical and talented individuals who are passionate about creating unique solutions that result in a positive impact on a global scale.

The System Integration & Test (I&T) Engineer will engage with an experienced cross-disciplinary team to design, integrate, and test innovative product solutions. The System I&T Engineer will work closely with colleagues throughout Amazon Leo’s inter-disciplinary team and collaborate with key partners and suppliers to ensure our system exceeds customer expectations. The System I&T Engineer must be responsive, flexible, innovative, and able to succeed within a collaborative, fast-paced, and dynamic environment.

As a member of the ALG Engineering Systems Engineering, Integration, Test, and Manufacturing organization, the System I&T Engineer will be responsible for developing the architecture and executing the design, build, and validation of test systems for complex systems and subsystems. The candidate will have the capabilities to develop test procedures, test software, test scripts, APIs, and automation to enable test and verification at various products levels including but not limited to system-on-chip (SoC) calibration algorithm verification, test automation and data analysis for electronics, opto-mechanical/opto-electrical subsystems, and system level tests including environmental tests. The candidate will be responsible for ensuring the test architecture supports all aspects of the integration, test, verification, and validation of one or more of the following: the satellite bus, RF payloads, optical payloads, custom ground terminals, or custom user terminals. This includes testing, analyzing, and optimizing the test support equipment to the particular satellite or ground element being developed. Testing efforts include functional and performance testing through various environmental conditions as required and it will be the candidate’s responsibility to ensure the test systems enable efficient test execution and requirements verification.

The ideal candidate has a strong technical background in space and ground systems design, integration, and verification across the development lifecycle. This candidate should enjoy taking ownership over complex problems and delivering well-executed results of high-quality and can work in a fast-paced, dynamic environment that provides significant autonomy to be creative in devising and verifying various engineering approaches to meet technical and programmatic requirements.

Export Control : This position requires that the candidate selected be a U.S. Citizen in order to comply with U.S. government-imposed requirements related to the nature of the work and/or where it will be performed.

This position requires that the candidate selected be a US Citizen and candidates must be able to obtain and maintain a US Government security clearance of TS/SCI.





Key job responsibilities
• Provide System and Software Integration and Test leadership to one or more of the following: the satellite bus, RF payloads, optical payloads, custom ground terminals, or custom user terminals.
• Provide system-level test design technical expertise to one or more of the following products and services: satellite bus, RF payloads, optical payloads, custom ground terminals, or custom user terminals.
• Specify and develop end-to-end payload or sub-system integration and test plans and procedures to validate performance against customer and/or partner requirements
• Create test algorithms, test scripts, automation and calibration routines for test systems as part of performing lab and field evaluation of integrated satellites, bus, payloads or sub-systems
• Analyze system and software test data and engage with cross functionally with teammates, partners, suppliers, or customers to evaluate the product performance and provide proactive feedback on potential improvements.
• Architect, design, and validate test software and hardware for mechanical, optical, and electrical support equipment necessary to enable test execution and requirements verification
• Prepare reports documenting test results, test coverage, performance results and other key performance indicator (KPI) metrics, and communicate issues effectively with developers and managers
• Effectively manage and track to closure test anomalies, defects, and bugs; Debug, root-cause, and make continuous improvements of control systems in a high-rate production environment

US Citizen only: This position requires that the candidate selected be a U.S. Citizen in order to comply with U.S. government-imposed requirements related to the nature of the work and/or where it will be performed.
Clearable Roles: This position requires that the candidate selected be a US Citizen and candidates must be able to obtain and maintain a US Government security clearance of TS/SCI.
Cleared Roles: This position requires that the candidate selected be a US Citizen and must currently possess and maintain an active TS/SCI security clearance.





About the team
Amazon Leo for Government (ALG) Engineering is a multi-disciplinary technology team established to rapidly address the needs of targeted customers with specific solutions that have the potential to scale. These solutions are tailored to meet the needs of government and international customers for both space-based and terrestrial applications. The Systems Engineering, Integration, Test, and Manufacturing organization under ALG Engineering plays a vital role in the entire life cycle of the development of an engineering solution, including architecture development, requirements and interface definition through assembly, integration, and test (AI&T), verification, and post-delivery and operational support.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in engineering, physics, or equivalent
- 5+ years of experience in space vehicle, bus, RF payload, optical payload, or ground terminal integration and test or related industry experience, with focus on system and software integration and test
- 5+ years of experience developing space or communication system test requirements, plans, and procedures for system and software design verification and validation.
- 5+ years of experience developing code in C, C++, Matlab, LabVIEW, Python, Docker, Rust on Linux platforms and experience with industry standard coding practices
- 5+ years of experience building complex test systems including integrating test software
- Experience with testing satellite communications payloads, optical communications payload, spacecraft bus and constituent subsystems, space vehicle, or ground terminals
- Hands-on experience with spacecraft integration, flatsat testing, hardware-in-the-loop testing, or mission operations
- 5+ years of experience in the use of standard electronic lab test equipment (i.e. network analyzers, oscilloscopes, spectrum analyzers, function generators, multimeters, etc.)

Preferred qualifications

- Master's degree or above in engineering, physics, or equivalent
- Computational problem solving and test automation/optimization in one or more of the following: Python, Matlab, LabVIEW, C/C++, Docker, Rust on a Linux platform.
- Experience working in cloud infrastructures (AWS) with strong working knowledge of IPv4/IPv6 subnetting and L1-L6 networking
- Experience in development, integration, and commissioning of satellite communication systems
- Experience with development of automated test systems
- Experience writing end to end integration and test plans
- Experience with incoming calibration checks and developing calibration procedures

title: Software Development Engineer II — Ads Reporting, Programmatic Reporting Interfaces
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Advertising's Measurement and Data Science (MADS) organization delivers campaign measurement and reporting across the advertising business and serves as the scientific center of excellence for measurement algorithm development. Within MADS, the Programmatic Reporting (PREP) team builds the interfaces and engines that turn measurement data into consistent, accurate, and efficient reporting for advertisers and partners — through programmatic interfaces rather than dashboards. Other companies' systems talk to ours to measure and grow their Amazon advertising investment.

We operate at scale. Billions of ad impressions, clicks, and conversion events are processed and summarized every day across petabyte-scale data with millions of transactions per second. Delivering this reliably requires invention ahead of common technologies and event-driven architectures built on AWS.

This SDE II role spans two of our three tier-1 reporting surfaces and the engines behind them:

- Reporting API — the pull surface: an asynchronous API for occasional, experimental, and analytical queries, and the back end to the Unified Report Builder.
- Amazon Marketing Stream — the push surface for recurring, high-volume reporting data.
- The processing engines — including the Offline Engine (Iceberg + Spark on EMR) that computes the data those surfaces deliver.

You will own projects end to end — requirements, system design, implementation, testing, and production support — on systems built with Spark and EMR alongside AWS services including Lambda, S3, SQS, Step Functions, Kinesis, and DynamoDB. The work is high-ownership and collaborative: you will partner with senior and principal engineers on architecture, and with product managers and technical account managers to translate customer pain points into features. You will also help deliver Unified Reporting as Amazon's single programmatic reporting solution and shift high-volume, recurring consumption from repeated API polling toward Amazon Marketing Stream.

Amazon is investing heavily in a world-class advertising business, and this team is at the forefront of that growth. We are highly motivated, collaborative, and direct, with a strong bias for action and a broad mandate to experiment. We start with the customer and work backwards in everything we do. If you want to build the next generation of large-scale reporting systems on modern data and AWS technologies, we would like to hear from you.

Key job responsibilities
1. Design and build scalable, secure, and reliable features and data solutions across the Reporting API, Amazon Marketing Stream, and the processing engines — from requirements and system design through implementation, testing, and production support.
2. Deep-dive into client and server systems to optimize performance, scalability, maintainability, and extensibility, integrating data across a large number of services.
3. Collaborate with senior and principal engineers on architecture and system design for high-impact, strategic projects, and navigate ambiguity to deliver results.
4. Write clean, maintainable code and raise the bar through peer code reviews and engineering standards.
5. Propose tools, frameworks, and automation adopted across the team, and drive operational excellence through monitoring and continuous improvement.
6. Partner with product managers, technical account managers, technical program managers, and mentees to understand customer needs, elevate the team, and promote engineering excellence.

- 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
- Experience programming with at least one software programming language

Preferred qualifications

- 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience

title: Senior ATE Security Engineer, Amazon Leo Silicon Team
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Leo is an initiative to launch a constellation of Low Earth Orbit satellites that will provide low-latency, high-speed broadband connectivity to unserved and underserved communities around the world.

Come work at Amazon!

The Role
As a Senior ATE Security Engineer, you will engage with an experienced cross-disciplinary staff to deliver secure, high-quality custom silicon powering the Leo network. This role has two focuses: device security and provisioning during test, and the development of reusable ATE library and automation software that accelerates test development across the team.

You will own secure device provisioning and security algorithm test on Advantest 93K and/or Teradyne UltraFLEX platforms, including secure key and identity injection, OTP/eFuse programming, and fuse-based lifecycle management. You will also design and build reusable, well-architected library code and tooling, such as pattern search utilities, automated sub-flow generation, and auto-generation of test programs from patterns, that improve the productivity, consistency, and quality of the entire test engineering team. You must be responsive, flexible, and able to succeed within an open, collaborative peer environment, and you will influence design, DFT, security, and manufacturing teams to ensure our products are architected for security, testability, and cost-effective high-volume manufacturing.

Export Control Requirement
Due to applicable export control laws and regulations, candidates must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.


Key job responsibilities
• Own device security and secure provisioning during test, including secure boot, secure key and identity injection, cryptographic provisioning, fuse-based configuration and lifecycle management, and debug-port lockdown.
• Develop, own, and qualify OTP/eFuse programming flows, addressing challenges such as programming margin, read-back verification, repeatability, and the irreversible nature of fuse operations across process, voltage, and temperature.
• Integrate ATE flows with secure provisioning systems, HSMs, or key-management infrastructure.
• Develop and validate JTAG and debug-access flows on post-provisioned units to enable debug of RMA returns and downstream quality issues, while preserving device security posture.
• Design, build, and maintain reusable ATE library code and tooling that accelerates test development across the team.
• Develop utilities for pattern search and analysis, automated sub-flow generation, and auto-generation of test programs from patterns.
• Architect libraries and frameworks for reusability, maintainability, and scale, applying strong software engineering practices (modular design, version control, code review, and testing).
• Run firmware on DUTs to enable secure provisioning, self-test, and reduced test time.
• Partner with ASIC design, DFT, security, and firmware teams to ensure devices meet Amazon standards for secure provisioning, design-for-test, and design-for-manufacturability.
• Actively identify security, test-readiness, and software gaps throughout the product lifecycle and drive them to resolution.
• Lead technical and security reviews and set software and security best practices for the team.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or equivalent work experience
- 7+ years of experience in silicon test, security engineering, or test software development.
- Experience with device security and secure provisioning during test, including OTP/eFuse programming.
- Working knowledge of the fundamentals of encryption, cryptographic keys, and secure communication channels.
- Strong software engineering skills, including proficiency in a language such as Python and/or C/C++, and experience building reusable, well-architected code.
- Experience developing test or automation software on Advantest 93K and/or Teradyne UltraFLEX platforms.
- Strong written and verbal communication skills.
- International travel required during release-to-production phases.

Preferred qualifications

- Master's degree in Electrical/Computer Engineering or Computer Science.
- Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional technical efforts and mentor other engineers.
- Expertise in standard silicon security concerns for modem and SoC devices, such as secure boot, secure key and identity provisioning, fuse-based lifecycle management, and debug-port lockdown.
- Experience implementing cryptographic provisioning flows involving keys, certificates, and device identities in a manufacturing or test environment.
- Experience working with anti-tamper and physical security blocks in silicon, such as tamper detection, sensors, and secure-element hardening.
- In-depth understanding of OTP/eFuse programming challenges, including margin, read-back verification, repeatability, and managing irreversible operations at high volume.
- Strong software development background, with experience building reusable ATE libraries and tooling (pattern search, sub-flow generation, automated test-program generation).
- Experience with digital test of complex SoCs, including developing, debugging, and analyzing coverage for scan/ATPG, MBIST, boundary scan (JTAG), and functional tests.
- Experience developing and debugging test programs on ATE platforms such as Advantest 93K and Teradyne UltraFLEX.
- Experience with high-speed SERDES test and characterization, including equalization test and tuning (CTLE/DFE/FFE), jitter decomposition, and eye/BER analysis.
- Experience developing high-volume manufacturing test solutions and driving the full test release process across the New Product Introduction (NPI) lifecycle, from silicon bring-up, characterization, and qualification through production hand-off and ramp.
- Familiarity with I/O protocols such as I3C, SPI, and GPIO.
- Experience testing complex modem and SoC devices in advanced process nodes.

title: Sr. OEM Success Manager, Amazon Autos
descriptionHtml:
Are you passionate about building trusted relationships and driving innovation at scale?

Amazon Autos is revolutionizing the vehicle discovery and shopping experience, connecting customers with their ideal vehicle. As an OEM Success Manager at Amazon Autos, you'll have the opportunity to unleash your entrepreneurial spirit and tackle complex challenges alongside industry-leading professionals.

As an OEM Success Manager, you will be the single-threaded owner of one or more automotive brands on Amazon Autos. You are the person accountable inside Amazon for how well that brand performs. Your unit of ownership is a brand nationally — every rooftop selling it, in every market we operate — rather than a portfolio of individual dealerships. You will own the operating relationship with your manufacturer, build the plan that grows their business on Amazon, and drive the work required to deliver it.

The defining challenge of this role is that you will not own the dealerships. You own the brand outcome, which means your results come from diagnosing what is holding a brand back — and then mobilizing the teams who can fix it. Doing that well takes deep automotive fluency, the analytical rigor to separate a real brand-level pattern from a handful of rooftops, and the credibility to influence on both sides of the relationship.

Above all, you must demonstrate a high level of ownership and the ability to thrive in ambiguity. If you're ready to take on a challenging, yet rewarding role in a start-up-like environment, we encourage you to apply for this OEM Success Manager position on the Amazon Autos team.

Key job responsibilities
OEM Success Managers own program-level performance for their assigned brands and deliver it through partner teams. The key responsibilities are to:

- Own your brand's performance on Amazon end to end. Serve as the single-threaded owner for one or more manufacturers
- Build and run the operating relationship with your manufacturer. Own a weekly cadence with your OEM's point of contact and the weekly performance reporting that goes with it
- Build and execute a growth plan for your brand. Use performance data to find where the brand is under-indexed by market, model, and vehicle condition, decide what to fix and in what order, and drive it to a measurable outcome.
- Own brand-level issues and escalations end to end. Diagnose root cause rather than routing symptoms, and drive resolution with the accountable team
- Direct brand-level work through partner teams.
- Drive financing performance for your brand. Diagnose approval and conversion performance across credit tiers
- Grow buyable selection for your brand. Drive new, certified pre-owned, and used condition enablement, resolve the inventory and eligibility constraints
- Represent your brand internally. Convert what you see in the data into quantified, well-reasoned asks for Product, Marketing, and Lending, and partner with OEM Business Development
- Raise the bar on the function. Build reporting, mechanisms, and best practices that other brand owners can reuse, and help define what good OEM management looks like

A day in the life
You will run a weekly call with your OEM's point of contact, backed by performance reporting you own, and you will spend the days between those calls making the numbers move. That means digging into your brand's purchase funnel to find where it breaks and then working with the team who can fix it. You will bring specific, prioritized asks to Metro owners for the rooftops carrying your brand, escalate systemic issues to Product, Lending, or Marketing with the data to support them, and prepare Business Development ahead of executive-level manufacturer conversations. Internally you will work across several teams and present your brand's performance and plan to senior leadership.

We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

About AWS

Diverse Experiences
AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS?
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Inclusive Team Culture
AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.

Mentorship & Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.

title: Area Manager II
descriptionHtml:
Our WW Operations network delivers millions of packages and smiles to Amazon customers every day. We are looking for motivated, customer-focused individuals who want to join our team as an Area Manager. In this role, you will lead a team of hourly workforce and will be responsible for engaging your team during their shifts to maintain the highest levels of safety, quality, attendance, and performance. You will also play a key role in maintaining our customer expectations to ensure customer orders are delivered at the right time, to the right location.

Our Operation’s workflow has three major components: First mile - where the product is housed and ready for order; Middle mile - where the order is hauled to your area; and Last mile - when the product is delivered to the customer’s door. Please note that all workflows have slight building variations, but one thing is constant: our vision and dedication to the customer.

* Stand/walk for up to 12 hours during shifts
* Work in an environment where the noise level varies and can be loud
* Work in an environment that is subject to variable temperatures and weather (delivery stations include outside loading departments)
* Continuously climb and descend stairs (applies to sites with stairs)

Our fulfillment network launches new Operations sites every year, providing various opportunities for your professional growth. We hire Area Managers based on location preference and the business’ current openings.

- 2+ years of employee and performance management experience

- Industry experience in: retail, F&B, military, manufacturing, automotive, biotech, electronics, energy, instrumentation, machinery, defense/aerospace, medical, cosmetics, production or distribution environments.

title: シニアパートナーデベロップメントマネージャー、 フロンティアモデル担当、AWS
descriptionHtml:
AWSジャパンのパートナーチームでは、経験豊富なパートナーデベロップメントマネージャーを募集しています。
本ポジションは、日本におけるフロンティアモデルパートナーとのパートナーシップのシングル スレッド オーナー（STO）として、AWSとフロンティアモデルパートナーの相互成長に向けた共同GTM、パートナー戦略の策定、フロンティアモデルパートナーとの関係構築、トップディールアライメントを含む共同販売の推進、およびエグゼクティブリレーションシップの構築を担当します。

日本におけるフロンティアモデルパートナーシップの主要な窓口およびリレーションシップオーナーとして、AIスペシャリスト、パートナーテクニカルリード、AWSアカウントチームを含むクロスファンクショナルチームを調整し、お客様の成果を最大化します。本ポジションは、AWSの最大規模のAIパートナーシップと、最も急成長している顧客ワークロードの交差点に位置する大きなインパクトを役割として担います。成長機会の獲得、競合による置き換えの防御、そしてシームレスな実行を必要とする重要な役割を果たします。

理想的な候補者は、CxO/VPレベルとのエンゲージメントを可能にするビジネスバックグラウンドを有し、ダイレクトセールスやISV/テクノロジーパートナーの経験、およびAI/MLの分野、クラウドプラットフォームのエコノミクス、エンタープライズパートナーとの事業開発に関する深い知識・経験を有しています。強いビジネスセンスと問題解決能力、複数の顧客ペルソナを管理する能力、そして異なる目標を持つエグゼクティブステークホルダーを成功裏に調整する能力が必要です。強いエグゼクティブプレゼンスと、曖昧でスピード感のある状況を自律的に管理し結果を出す能力が求められます。

Key job responsibilities
● 日本におけるフロンティアモデルの共同GTMおよびパートナー戦略を策定・実行し、日本パートナープランを策定するとともに、AGS（AWSグローバルセールズ）日本リーダーシップが定める優先顧客需要シグナルに沿った日本戦略イニシアチブを定義する。
● AnthropicおよびOpenAIの国内アライアンスリードとのパートナーリレーションシップを担当し、日本カントリーレベルでの主要な窓口およびリレーションシップオーナーとして活動する。
● パイプラインの創出と共同販売モーションの実行を推進し、案件を選定からクローズまで進めるとともに、各案件のデリバリーおよびリセールにおけるパートナーのデリバリー準備を確保する。
● 日本カントリーレベルでの必勝アカウントおよびパイプラインレビューをリードし、AIスペシャリストやパートナーテクニカルリードと連携して案件のブロッカーを解除し、顧客の採用を加速する。
● 日本GSI/SI共同戦略を策定・実行し、パートナー主導のデリバリー能力を拡大し、パートナーエコシステムを多様化する。
● AWSフィールド内でビジネスチャンピオンを募集・育成し、フロンティアモデルの認知度向上と共同販売エンゲージメントを拡大する。
● EBC（エグゼクティブブリーフィングセンター）およびパートナー向けの顧客エンゲージメントをリードし、戦略的な案件を加速する。
● クロスファンクショナルチームを調整し、日本GTMの実行を管理する。AIスペシャリスト、AWSパートナーリーダーシップチーム、パートナーソリューションアーキテクト、アカウントマネージャー、パートナーセールズマネージャーと協力する。
● パートナー関連およびシステミックなブロッカーを48時間以内にAPJコアチームにエスカレーションし、案件が社内プロセスを待つことのないようにする。
● 主要指標を追跡・報告する：ARR、TCV、パイプラインカバレッジ、共同販売コンバージョン率、および日本レベルでのパートナープログラムの有効性。
● AWS Focus、ScaleおよびIndirectセールスチームに対し、フロンティアモデルのポジショニング、顧客選定基準、およびパートナーエンゲージメントモーションについてコーチングおよびイネーブルメントを行う。

A day in the life
一日は、ポートフォリオ全体をみたパイプラインデータの確認、案件の進捗状況のレビュー、ブロッカーの洗い出しから始まるかもしれません。午前中は、AIスペシャリストと協力して、主要なエンタープライズアカウントへの戦略的なGTMセールズプレイの展開に取り組みます。昼食後は、フロンティアパートナーとの共同販売機会の推進に関する通話があり、その後、AWSアカウントマネージャーグループに対して最新の共同販売プレイとパートナーバリュープロポジションのイネーブルメントを行います。午後は、セールス、ソリューションアーキテクチャ、マーケティングの点と点をつなぎ、案件を前進させます。一日の終わりには、フィールドから新しいビジネスチャンピオンを採用し、各アカウント全体でフロンティアモデルの認知度を高めることができる人材を見つけます。

- 5+ years of Go-To-Market, Business Development, Sales, or Consulting experience
- 5+ years of working with Data & AI related technologies, including, but not limited to, AI/ML, GenAI, Analytics, Database, and/or Storage experience
- Experience developing strategies that influence leadership decisions at the organizational level
- Japanese Fluency and Business level English

Preferred qualifications

- Experience interpreting data and making business recommendations
- Experience identifying, negotiating, and executing complex legal agreements
- Experience managing programs across cross functional teams, building processes and coordinating release schedules
- Experience selling enterprise software or cloud-based applications
- Experience explaining complex technical concepts to various business and technical audiences
- Experience presenting to both technical and non-technical executive audiences
- フロンティアAIモデルまたはプラットフォームパートナーシップの管理経験（例：Anthropic、OpenAI、または同様の基盤モデルプロバイダー）

title: Security Specialist, Data Center Physical Security
descriptionHtml:
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

We are looking for a detail-oriented professional to join our team as a Data Center Security Specialist (DSS) supporting our data centers across mainland Japan. In this role, you will work collaboratively with Data Center Security Managers to ensure the effective implementation and maintenance of physical security procedures. You will support Data Center Security Managers in implementing security standards and operational procedures across assigned facilities while assisting in monitoring and maintaining physical security systems and controls. Your responsibilities will include helping prepare and maintain security documentation, standard operating procedures, and participating in security system testing and maintenance activities. You will contribute to the development of security awareness training materials and assist in delivering training sessions, as well as generate and analyze security metrics and incident reports to support management decision-making. Working closely with security vendors, you will help coordinate maintenance, repairs, and operational needs while supporting security improvement projects and initiatives as directed by Security Managers. This position offers an excellent opportunity to develop expertise in data center security operations while working alongside experienced Security Managers in a dynamic, technology-driven environment. The role provides a foundation for career growth within data center security management through hands-on experience interfacing with cross-functional teams to ensure security requirements are met.


Key job responsibilities
The selected individual will be responsible for assessing and enhancing existing security programs, where security tasks, strategy, and priorities may be defined or occasionally ambiguous. They will participate in recurring site compliance audits, reviews, and testing of new security technologies. Contribute to developing strategic goals for the cluster that can impact the entire region, and adeptly adapt operational plans to evolving security scenarios. Member will make trade-off decisions and provide recommendations for enhance risk and security events. Collaborate with peers and internal stakeholders, develop solutions that help your team meet objectives. Assist in creating mitigation plans for security events or unique operational activities. Additionally, recruit and interview new team members while actively mentoring others to foster a collaborative and growth-oriented environment.

Support daily security operations and follow established procedures
Help prepare and deliver security awareness materials
Process security tickets and assist with metrics collection
Coordinate with vendors under management guidance
Learn and implement security protocols and procedures
Assist with security project documentation
Support security training sessions
Maintain clear documentation and daily reports


A day in the life
Execute established compliance processes with AWS policies, standards, guidelines and relevant legal and regulatory requirements.
Verify and approve access requests and building access requests.
Assist in procurement: Work order execution, submission of requisition request, Purchase Order (PO) issuance, and invoice validation
On-boarding (provision of Amazon laptop as needed), training and off-boarding of Security Vendor resources
Participate in security system installation project meetings with DC Security Managers, Security Vendors, DC Operations and other key stakeholders.
Oversee and coordinate security vendor work for service calls and scheduled projects
Documentation and report writing on security metrics


About the team
Diverse Experiences
AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS?
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Inclusive Team Culture
Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

Mentorship & Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

Basic qualifications

- Speak, write, and read fluently in English
- Can use Windows, Microsoft Word, Outlook, Excel, and online communication and collaboration tools
- Basic understanding of IT terminologies and principles

Preferred qualifications

- Experience collecting, analyzing, and utilizing data to drive process and system improvements
- Experience using CCTV, access control and intrusion systems

title: Shift Manager
descriptionHtml:
Als Bereichs-/Schichtleiter:in bei Amazon führst Du ein großes, diverses Team und sorgst dafür, dass Dein Geschäftsbereich stets mit der Nachfrage Schritt hält. In dieser praktischen Rolle machst Du Dich mit den komplexen Betriebsabläufen eines globalen Unternehmens vertraut und lernst, was erforderlich ist, damit alles reibungslos abläuft. Gemeinsam mit Deinen Kolleg:innen arbeitest Du daran, die Produktivität zu steigern und Herausforderungen zu begegnen. Kein Tag gleicht dem anderen.

Key job responsibilities
Förderung einer Kultur der Sicherheit und des Wohlbefindens
Analyse und Umsetzung von Korrekturmaßnahmen, um beständig hohe Qualität und Produktivität sowie das schichtübergreifende Einhalten aller Unternehmensziele sicherzustellen
Unterstützung und Führung eines Teams sowie Erledigung administrativer Aufgaben; Aufbau und Unterstützung einer starken Teamkultur
Analyse der Leistung sowie Vorschläge für Prozessverbesserungen, um die Arbeitsabläufe und den Kundenservice zu optimieren
Kollaboration mit anderen Manager:innen zur Standardisierung von Schichtprozessen

A day in the life
Du arbeitest in unterschiedlichen Schichten an einem unserer Betriebsstandorte. Dabei konzentrierst Du Dich vorwiegend auf das Einhalten der Sicherheitsstandards durch Dein Team und an Deinem gesamten Standort. Außerdem überwachst Du die Prozesseffizienz. Prioritäten in Deinem Arbeitsalltag sind unter anderem das routinemäßige Teammanagement und tägliche Betriebsaktivitäten. Neben anderen Aufgaben wie Eskalationen in Einzelfällen, Prozessverbesserungen sowie die übergreifende betriebliche Notfallplanung.
Als wichtiges Mitglied des Betriebsteams arbeitest Du mit Kolleg:innen aus anderen Teams sowie externen Partnern zusammen und sorgst dafür, dass wir die Anforderungen unserer Kund:innen ebenso wie unsere eigenen Vorgaben jederzeit erfüllen. Das beinhaltet die Analyse von Daten und Leistungskennzahlen gemeinsam mit Führungskräften in Deinem Geschäftsbereich ebenso wie die Besprechung der betrieblichen Vor- und Nachteile von technischen Verbesserungen mit dem technischen Team.

title: Praktikum im Bereich Logistik - Eggolsheim bei Bamberg - 2027
descriptionHtml:
Bitte beachte: Wir haben verschiedene Möglichkeiten in ganz Deutschland und benötigen Flexibilität bezüglich der Standorte. Wenn du dich für die Stelle bewirbst, gib bitte alle deine bevorzugten Standorte in Deutschland an.
Alle unsere Praktika finden vollständig vor Ort statt.

Amazon Operations ist das Rückgrat der Amazon-Kundenerfahrung. Mit über 50 Logistikzentren, hunderten von Zustellstationen und zehntausenden von Versandmitarbeiter:innen arbeitet das Team zusammen, um Artikel effizient an Kund:innen zu liefern. In den Logistikzentren werden jährlich Millionen von Artikeln kommissioniert und verpackt, während die Zustellteams daran arbeiten, Bestellungen pünktlich an die Kund:innen zu bringen. Sicherheit hat oberste Priorität, und die Betriebskultur ist geprägt von Teamwork, Vielfalt und einer gemeinsamen Arbeitsethik, die das Geschäft reibungslos am Laufen hält. Das Team ist stolz darauf, den Qualitätsservice zu liefern, für den Amazon weltweit bekannt ist.

Hinweis: Du musst zum Starttermin die Arbeitsberechtigung für das Beschäftigungsland haben.


Key job responsibilities
Als Amazon Operations-Praktikant:in hast du die Möglichkeit, deine analytischen Fähigkeiten in wirkungsvollen Projekten anzuwenden, die die Funktionalität und den Service von Logistikzentren, Sortierzentren und Zustellstationen verbessern. Wichtige Aspekte der Rolle umfassen:
• Abschluss von Projekten mit hoher Priorität nach höchstem Standard und Nachweis deiner Fähigkeit, Ergebnisse zu liefern
• Datenanalyse zur Identifizierung operativer Herausforderungen und Verbesserungsmöglichkeiten
• Vorschlagen und Testen von Lösungen in Zusammenarbeit mit dem Team zur Umsetzung der effektivsten Ansätze
• Entwicklung von Kommunikations- und Teamfähigkeiten durch die Zusammenarbeit mit Führungskräften, Stakeholdern und Versandmitarbeiter:innen.
• Bewegung im Gebäude, um mit verschiedenen Teams zu interagieren. Das umfasst aktives Wissenssammeln durch Teilnahme an Aktivitäten wie Vorbesprechungen, Ablaufmeetings und Diskussionen mit dem Führungsteam und Versandmitarbeiter:innen.
• Die Fähigkeit, sich im Arbeitsbereich zu orientieren und zwischen verschiedenen Bereichen zu wechseln, ist für diese Position unerlässlich.
• Flexibilität bei verschiedenen Arbeitszeiten und Schichtmustern nach Bedarf zeigen.
• Möglicher Umzug an den vorgesehenen Arbeitsort.


A day in the life
Unsere Praktika sind Bildungsmöglichkeiten, die es dir als unserer zukünftigen Führungskraft ermöglichen, zu entdecken, wie wir unsere Teams von Versandmitarbeiter:innen führen und entwickeln. Du tauchst in die schnelllebige, komplexe Welt unserer Logistikzentren, Sortierzentren und Zustellstationen ein und erlebst, wie unsere Führungskräfte ihre Teams einsetzen, um Kundenerwartungen zu erfüllen.
Dieses Praktikum versetzt dich ins Herz unserer Abläufe und ermöglicht es dir, den Weg einer Kundenbestellung zu verfolgen. Du erhältst einen realistischen Einblick in die Vollzeitchancen, die dich in unserem Unternehmen erwarten.
Du lernst, wie unsere Führungskräfte eine sichere, produktive Umgebung schaffen und das volle Potenzial ihrer Teams durch effektive Einbindung und Leistungsmanagement-Strategien nutzen. Das ist deine Chance, Fähigkeiten zu entwickeln, die dich zu einer lohnenden Karriere bei Amazon führen werden.


About the team
Praktikant:innen-Community:
• Als Amazon-Praktikant:in bist du Teil einer lebendigen, unterstützenden Community, die dein Wachstum und deine Entwicklung fördert. Du arbeitest mit Praktikant:innen aus der ganzen Welt zusammen, knüpfst Kontakte und nimmst an sozialen Veranstaltungen teil, um deinen Horizont zu erweitern. Du kannst auch spezialisierten Gruppen beitreten, die sich auf Bereiche wie Nachhaltigkeit konzentrieren, um deine vielfältigen Interessen zu erkunden.
Unterstützung:
• Das Praktikumsprogramm bietet ein robustes Unterstützungssystem, einschließlich wöchentlicher Praktikant:innen-Sprechstunden, spezieller IT- und HR-Unterstützung sowie einem Programmteam, das sich deinem Erfolg verschrieben hat. Das stellt sicher, dass du die Anleitung und Hilfe hast, die du zum Gedeihen brauchst.
Lernsessions:
• Exklusive Lernsessions werden deine Fähigkeiten weiter verbessern und dir Zugang zu Amazons modernsten Lernplattformen und der Expertise von Branchenführern gewähren. Diese strukturierten Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten bereiten dich auf den nächsten Schritt in deiner Karriere vor.
Möglichkeiten:
• Nach erfolgreichem Abschluss des Praktikums kannst du für eine Absolvent:innen-Stelle oder ein zweites Praktikum in Betracht gezogen werden, was es dir ermöglicht, deine Reise mit Amazon fortzusetzen. Zusätzlich erhältst du ein wettbewerbsfähiges Monatsgehalt, Umzugsunterstützung und Zugang zu einer Reihe von Mitarbeitervorteilen.
Praktikums-Starttermine über das Jahr:
• Wir stellen Praktikant:innen ein, die jederzeit von Januar bis Juli 2027 anfangen können. Jeden Monat führen wir 1-2 Onboarding-Tage für neue Mitarbeiter:innen durch.

Basic qualifications

- Currently in your penultimate or final year and working towards a university degree in Supply Chain, Business/Management, Engineering or another related field.
- Eligible to complete a full-time internship of 3-6 months.
- Highly proficient in both spoken and written English and the local language of the country you are applying for (Common European Framework of Reference C1).

title: Praktikum im Bereich Logistik - Regensburg - 2027
descriptionHtml:
Bitte beachte: Wir haben verschiedene Möglichkeiten in ganz Deutschland und benötigen Flexibilität bezüglich der Standorte. Wenn du dich für die Stelle bewirbst, gib bitte alle deine bevorzugten Standorte in Deutschland an.
Alle unsere Praktika finden vollständig vor Ort statt.

Amazon Operations ist das Rückgrat der Amazon-Kundenerfahrung. Mit über 50 Logistikzentren, hunderten von Zustellstationen und zehntausenden von Versandmitarbeiter:innen arbeitet das Team zusammen, um Artikel effizient an Kund:innen zu liefern. In den Logistikzentren werden jährlich Millionen von Artikeln kommissioniert und verpackt, während die Zustellteams daran arbeiten, Bestellungen pünktlich an die Kund:innen zu bringen. Sicherheit hat oberste Priorität, und die Betriebskultur ist geprägt von Teamwork, Vielfalt und einer gemeinsamen Arbeitsethik, die das Geschäft reibungslos am Laufen hält. Das Team ist stolz darauf, den Qualitätsservice zu liefern, für den Amazon weltweit bekannt ist.

Hinweis: Du musst zum Starttermin die Arbeitsberechtigung für das Beschäftigungsland haben.


Key job responsibilities
Als Amazon Operations-Praktikant:in hast du die Möglichkeit, deine analytischen Fähigkeiten in wirkungsvollen Projekten anzuwenden, die die Funktionalität und den Service von Logistikzentren, Sortierzentren und Zustellstationen verbessern. Wichtige Aspekte der Rolle umfassen:
• Abschluss von Projekten mit hoher Priorität nach höchstem Standard und Nachweis deiner Fähigkeit, Ergebnisse zu liefern
• Datenanalyse zur Identifizierung operativer Herausforderungen und Verbesserungsmöglichkeiten
• Vorschlagen und Testen von Lösungen in Zusammenarbeit mit dem Team zur Umsetzung der effektivsten Ansätze
• Entwicklung von Kommunikations- und Teamfähigkeiten durch die Zusammenarbeit mit Führungskräften, Stakeholdern und Versandmitarbeiter:innen.
• Bewegung im Gebäude, um mit verschiedenen Teams zu interagieren. Das umfasst aktives Wissenssammeln durch Teilnahme an Aktivitäten wie Vorbesprechungen, Ablaufmeetings und Diskussionen mit dem Führungsteam und Versandmitarbeiter:innen.
• Die Fähigkeit, sich im Arbeitsbereich zu orientieren und zwischen verschiedenen Bereichen zu wechseln, ist für diese Position unerlässlich.
• Flexibilität bei verschiedenen Arbeitszeiten und Schichtmustern nach Bedarf zeigen.
• Möglicher Umzug an den vorgesehenen Arbeitsort.


A day in the life
Unsere Praktika sind Bildungsmöglichkeiten, die es dir als unserer zukünftigen Führungskraft ermöglichen, zu entdecken, wie wir unsere Teams von Versandmitarbeiter:innen führen und entwickeln. Du tauchst in die schnelllebige, komplexe Welt unserer Logistikzentren, Sortierzentren und Zustellstationen ein und erlebst, wie unsere Führungskräfte ihre Teams einsetzen, um Kundenerwartungen zu erfüllen.
Dieses Praktikum versetzt dich ins Herz unserer Abläufe und ermöglicht es dir, den Weg einer Kundenbestellung zu verfolgen. Du erhältst einen realistischen Einblick in die Vollzeitchancen, die dich in unserem Unternehmen erwarten.
Du lernst, wie unsere Führungskräfte eine sichere, produktive Umgebung schaffen und das volle Potenzial ihrer Teams durch effektive Einbindung und Leistungsmanagement-Strategien nutzen. Das ist deine Chance, Fähigkeiten zu entwickeln, die dich zu einer lohnenden Karriere bei Amazon führen werden.


About the team
Praktikant:innen-Community:
• Als Amazon-Praktikant:in bist du Teil einer lebendigen, unterstützenden Community, die dein Wachstum und deine Entwicklung fördert. Du arbeitest mit Praktikant:innen aus der ganzen Welt zusammen, knüpfst Kontakte und nimmst an sozialen Veranstaltungen teil, um deinen Horizont zu erweitern. Du kannst auch spezialisierten Gruppen beitreten, die sich auf Bereiche wie Nachhaltigkeit konzentrieren, um deine vielfältigen Interessen zu erkunden.
Unterstützung:
• Das Praktikumsprogramm bietet ein robustes Unterstützungssystem, einschließlich wöchentlicher Praktikant:innen-Sprechstunden, spezieller IT- und HR-Unterstützung sowie einem Programmteam, das sich deinem Erfolg verschrieben hat. Das stellt sicher, dass du die Anleitung und Hilfe hast, die du zum Gedeihen brauchst.
Lernsessions:
• Exklusive Lernsessions werden deine Fähigkeiten weiter verbessern und dir Zugang zu Amazons modernsten Lernplattformen und der Expertise von Branchenführern gewähren. Diese strukturierten Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten bereiten dich auf den nächsten Schritt in deiner Karriere vor.
Möglichkeiten:
• Nach erfolgreichem Abschluss des Praktikums kannst du für eine Absolvent:innen-Stelle oder ein zweites Praktikum in Betracht gezogen werden, was es dir ermöglicht, deine Reise mit Amazon fortzusetzen. Zusätzlich erhältst du ein wettbewerbsfähiges Monatsgehalt, Umzugsunterstützung und Zugang zu einer Reihe von Mitarbeitervorteilen.
Praktikums-Starttermine über das Jahr:
• Wir stellen Praktikant:innen ein, die jederzeit von Januar bis Juli 2027 anfangen können. Jeden Monat führen wir 1-2 Onboarding-Tage für neue Mitarbeiter:innen durch.

title: Program Manager, II WW Credit Card Fraud
descriptionHtml:
Have you ever thought about what it takes to detect and prevent fraudulent purchases among hundreds of millions of e-Commerce transactions in different countries? What would you do to create a trusted marketplace where millions of buyers and sellers can safely transact online? What kinds of processes and systems would you build to maximize customer satisfaction? Amazon is seeking a Program Manager who is passionate about process improvements, has strong bias for action and experience leading cross functional and global teams.

Buyer Risk Prevention (BRP) designs and builds the software systems, risk models and operational processes that minimize risk and maximize trust in Amazon. Not only do we protect all aspects of the Amazon shopping experience, we also deliver services to large and small merchants hosted on the Amazon platform. In addition, we evaluate new business opportunities from across the company to determine how we can minimize the risk associated with new initiatives.

We are seeking an experienced Program Manager to support the WW Credit Card fraud vertical. In this role, you will own the global strategy for monitoring Credit Card fraud prevention and bad debt mitigation programs across the retail portfolio. You will operate at the intersection of fraud prevention, regulatory compliance (e.g., PSD2/TRA), and customer experience, ensuring Amazon maintains trust and minimizes payment risk losses across global markets.

Key job responsibilities
Own fraud and bad debt performance within the WW credit card portfolio, monitoring loss rates against VP-level goals and driving corrective action when metrics breach targets.

Develop and maintain fraud prevention mechanisms across the retail and digital cohorts including chargeback, ATO, and account-level fraud controls.

Investigate emerging fraud modus operandi (MO), size the loss exposure, and partner with data science and engineering to close detection and prevention gaps.

Drive weekly, monthly, and quarterly business reviews (WBR/MBR/QBR), leading with the key loss metric and surfacing loss drivers, gaps, and mitigation plans.

Coordinate cross-functional stakeholders across Payment Risk, engineering, data science, and partner teams to deliver fraud mitigation roadmaps.

Define and track guardrails for launches and dial-up decisions, balancing fraud exposure against revenue and customer experience.

Basic qualifications

- 3+ years of program or project management experience
- 3+ years of defining and implementing process improvement initiatives using data and metrics experience
- Knowledge of Excel (Pivot Tables, VLookUps) at an advanced level and SQL
- Experience using data and metrics to determine and drive improvements
- Experience working cross functionally with tech and non-tech teams

Preferred qualifications

- 3+ years of driving end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership experience
- 3+ years of driving process improvements experience
- Experience in stakeholder management, dealing with multiple stakeholders at varied levels of the organization
- Experience building processes, project management, and schedules

title: Data Scientist II, AWS Managed Operations Intelligence (MOI) - Data Science
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world leader in providing a highly reliable, scalable, low-cost infrastructure platform in the cloud that powers hundreds of thousands of businesses in 190 countries around the world!

Passionate about building, owning and operating massively scalable systems? Want to make a billion-dollar impact? If so, we have an exciting opportunity for you.

The AWS Managed Operations (MO) organization was founded in April 2023, with the objective to reduce operational load and toil through long-term engineering projects. MO is building the best-in-class engineering and operations team that will own the day-to-day operations for AWS Regions, improving the availability, reliability, latency, performance and efficiency to operate AWS regions.

The AWS Managed Operations Intelligence (MOI) Team is looking for a Data Scientist to lead the research and thought leadership to drive our data and insight strategy for AWS. You will be expected to serve as a Full Stack Data Scientist. You will be responsible for driving data-driven transformation across the organization. In this role, you will be responsible for the end-to-end data science lifecycle, from data exploration, ETL, model development and data visualization. You will leverage a broad set of tools and technologies, including general analytical frameworks (Spark, Airflow, etc.), AI frameworks (Hugging Face, etc.) and various machine learning frameworks, to tackle complex business problems.

Your analytics research will provide direction on the technology strategy of the Managed Operations organization. Your Decision Science artifacts will provide insights that inform AWS' Operations and Site Reliability Engineering teams. You will work on ambiguous and complex business and research science problems at scale, and you are comfortable working with cross-functional teams and systems.

By working together on behalf of our customers, we are building the future one innovative product, service, and idea at a time. Are you ready to embrace the challenge? Come build the future with us.

Key job responsibilities
- Work with large and complex data sets to solve a wide array of challenging problems using different analytical approaches
- Develop ML/AI models. Partner with software teams to productionalize these models.
- Data Pipeline and Infrastructure: design and implementation of data pipelines
- Metric Development and Monitoring: Define and develop advanced, customized metrics and key performance indicators (KPIs) that capture the nuances of the organization's strategic objectives and operational complexities. Continuously monitor and evaluate the performance of metrics

A day in the life
Why AWS?

Our team is dedicated to supporting new members. We have a broad mix of experience levels and tenures, and we're building an environment that celebrates knowledge-sharing and mentorship. Our senior members enjoy one-on-one mentoring and thorough, but kind, code reviews. We care about your career growth and strive to assign projects that help our team members develop your engineering expertise so you feel empowered to take on more complex tasks in the future.

Diverse Experiences

AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn't followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don't let it stop you from applying.

About AWS

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world's most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that's why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

AWS Infrastructure Services (AIS)

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we're the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. title: Chief Estimator, AMER Estimating and Cost Control
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. Our Data Center Planning and Delivery (DCPD) organization builds and scales the infrastructure that powers AWS. We are seeking an experienced Manager, Construction Estimating (Chief Estimator equivalent) to lead the estimating function within the AMER Estimating and Cost Control (ECC) organization.

This is a high-impact people management role. You will build and lead a team of Regional Estimating Managers aligned to AMER construction regions and Discipline Specific Technical Estimators (Electrical, Mechanical, and Civil/Structural/Architectural) — providing end-to-end construction estimating capability for a portfolio primarily focused on North and South America deliverables, but with significant Global cross functional work and opportunity. Your team will produce estimates that inform capital authorization, operating plans, and award decisions for billions of dollars in annual data center construction.

This role is foundational to ECC’s mission: Managing the end to end cost lifecycle from initial estimate through final account. Estimates improve every cycle because the team that produced them sees what actually happened.

Key job responsibilities
- Build, lead, and develop a team of estimating professionals and vendors across regional, product, and discipline lines, including hiring, performance management, and career development

- Own delivery and performance of the key ECC estimating scope areas: Basis of Design (BOD) Estimating, Design Intercept and Innovation Estimating, New Regions Planning, Project-Level Estimating (AMER), Operational Plan (OP) Support, Capital Appropriations Requests Assembly, Initial Budget Creation Support, and End-to-End Cost Planning

- Manage third-party estimating vendor contracts and deliverables, ensuring quality, timeliness, and cost-effectiveness at scale — supply capacity and performance will never be the bottleneck

- Drive the estimate-to-actual feedback loop with Cost Control, systematically benchmarking estimates against portfolio actuals to improve accuracy every cycle

- Lead estimating team inputs into the annual Operating Plan (OP) capital planning cycle alongside Preconstruction, Finance, and Cost Control — delivering estimate-anchored market-relevant forecasting

- Own the Estimating Team inputs into pre-award budget packages: CAR assembly, estimate-to-CAR handoff with Preconstruction and Techincal infrastructure Project Manager (TIPM), and initial budget creation inputs for new projects based on AMER and Global benchmarks

- Collaborate globally on Basis of Design estimates, PDCM/First of Kind/Intercept/Innovation costing, and new regions planning with Design Engineering and global estimating teams

- Develop and maintain cost databases, estimating tools, templates, and methodologies that reflect current market conditions across multiple AMER geographic markets

- Produce conceptual and detailed cost estimates for data center construction from schematic design through construction documents

- Communicate cost insights, risks, and opportunities to senior leadership, translating complex estimating data into actionable capital governance decisions

- Partner with Construction Management, Design Engineering, Finance, DCSP, and Preconstruction as the subject matter expert for all estimating matters — customer obsessed, partner first

A day in the life
You start the day reviewing estimate deliverables from your regional managers and third-party vendors — a West Coast campus civil estimate is due for review prior to being used in a CAR request, and a Central/SE region estimate needs reconciliation against recent GC RFP Round pricing. Your discipline estimators flag a PDCM intercept from Design Engineering that requires a rapid cost impact assessment for a mechanical innovation. You coach your team through prioritization, unblock vendor issues, and ensure the estimate quality meets ECC standards.

By midday, you’re in a cross-functional sync with Preconstruction and Finance discussing OP planning assumptions — your team’s estimate-anchored forecasts are the starting point for capital planning across the AMER portfolio. After lunch, you review benchmarking data from the ECC Analytics team, using actual project costs to calibrate your team’s next round of estimates. You close the day aligning with your Cost Control peers on a feedback loop for recently completed projects — the data that makes next quarter’s estimates better.

This role operates in a hyper-growth environment where data center demand is accelerating, construction markets are dynamic, and the ability to produce accurate, timely estimates directly impacts AWS’s capacity delivery and capital efficiency. You will travel periodically to construction sites and regional offices across AMER.

About the team
AMER Estimating and Cost Control (ECC) is a newly formed organization within Data Center Planning and Delivery (DCPD) that unifies Estimating and Cost Control under a single leader. ECC provides end-to-end cost lifecycle ownership — from initial estimate through final account. The team that produces the estimate and the team that proves it right or wrong report to the same leader.

ECC serves as the subject matter expert for estimating, cost and commercial management, data analytics, benchmarking, change management, risk analysis, and controllership. The organization creates a structured feedback loop between estimate and actual costs.

The Estimating pillar you will lead sits alongside Cost Control (regional managers delivering commercial management, change management, progress payments, and final accounts) and Portfolio and Analytics expertise (portfolio cost governance, benchmarking, AI/analytics, and startup support). Together, the team delivers cost optimization and governance through volume, expertise, and innovation across the AMER data center portfolio.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Construction Management, Electrical, Mechanical, Civil Engineering, or a similar technical discipline
- Experience in construction of data center delivery (design, commissioning and construction), mission critical facilities, or equivalent industrial/manufacturing facility builds
- 3+ years of people management experience
- Experience working with and managing third party vendors
- 8+ years of progressive experience in construction cost estimating, cost management, or quantity surveying in commercial, industrial, or infrastructure construction
- Demonstrated experience producing conceptual through detailed construction cost estimates for large-scale, complex projects ($500M+)
- Proficiency with cost estimating tools and databases (e.g., RSMeans, CostX, Sage/Timberline, proprietary cost databases, Bluebeam, On-Screen Takeoff, or equivalent)
- Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret construction drawings, specifications, and contract documents across multiple disciplines (MEP, civil, structural, architectural)
- Experience with multi-geography pricing — understanding regional labor markets, material escalation, and supply chain dynamics across the U.S.
- Exceptional communication skills with the ability to present cost insights to senior leadership (L8+) and translate estimating data into capital governance recommendations

Preferred qualifications

- Master's degree in construction management, Engineering, or MBA
- Experience with Basis of Design estimating, design-phase cost input, and value engineering
- Track record of building estimating programs from the ground up — establishing tools, templates, processes, and cost databases
- Experience with capital planning cycles, Budget assembly, or capital governance processes
- Experience with reverse engineering awarded contracts to validate subcontractor pricing and identify cost optimization opportunities
- Familiarity with hard bid, negotiated, and design-build delivery methods

descriptionHtml:
Job Description for Transportation Representative – NOC
NOC Overview

NOC (Network Operation Center) is the central command and control center for ‘Transportation Execution’ across the Amazon Supply Chain network supporting multiple geographies like NA, India and EU. It ensures hassle free, timely pick-up and delivery of freight from vendors to Amazon fulfillment centers (FC) and from Amazon FCs to carrier hubs. In case of any exceptions, NOC steps in to resolve the issue and keeps all the stakeholders informed on the proceedings. Along with this tactical problem solving NOC is also charged with understanding trends in network exceptions and then automating processes or proposing process changes to streamline operations. This second aspect involves network monitoring and significant analysis of network data.
Overall, NOC plays a critical role in ensuring the smooth functioning of Amazon transportation and thereby has a direct impact on Amazon’s ability to serve its customers on time.

Purview of a Trans Ops Representative:
A Trans Ops Representative at NOC facilitates flow of information between different stakeholders (Trans Carriers/Hubs/Warehouses) and resolves any potential issues that impacts customer experience and business continuity. Trans Ops Specialist at NOC works across two verticals – Inbound and Outbound operations.
Inbound Operations deals with Vendor/Carrier/FC relationship, ensuring that the freight is picked-up on time and is delivered at FC as per the given appointment. Trans Ops Specialist on Inbound addresses any potential issues occurring during the lifecycle of pick-up to delivery.
Outbound Operations deals with FC/Carrier/Carrier Hub relationship, ensuring that the truck leaves the FC in order to delivery customer orders as per promise. Trans Ops Specialist on Outbound addresses any potential issues occurring during the lifecycle of freight leaving the FC and reaching customer premises.

A Trans Ops Representative provides timely resolution to the issue in hand by researching and querying internal tools and by taking real-time decisions. An ideal candidate should be able to understand the requirements/be able to analyze data and notice trends and be able to drive Customer Experience without compromising on time. The candidate should have the basic understanding of Logistics and should be able to communicate clearly in the written and oral form.

Key job responsibilities
Trans Ops Representative should be able to ideate process improvements and should have the zeal to drive them to conclusion.
Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

· Communication with external customers (Carriers, Vendors/Suppliers) and internal customers (Retail, Finance, Software Support, Fulfillment Centers)
· Must be able to systematically escalate problems or variance in the information and data to the relevant owners and teams and follow through on the resolutions to ensure they are delivered.
· Excellent communication, both verbal and written as one may be required to create a narrative outlining weekly findings and the variances to goals, and present these finding in a review forum.

Ø Ability to communicate correctly and clearly with all customers Ø Good comprehension skills – ability to clearly understand and state the issues customers present Ø Ability to concentrate – follow customers issues without distraction to resolution Ø Work successfully in a team environment as well as independently Ø Familiarity with Windows XP, Microsoft Outlook, Microsoft Word and Internet Explorer Ø Excellent typing skills Ø Demonstrates an ability to successfully navigate websites Ø Demonstrates a proficient knowledge of email applications
