title: Software Development Engineer, AWS Quick
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Quick is building an AI-native work surface that understands what users want to accomplish and figures out how to get it done. We are looking for a Software Development Engineer III to design and deliver the third-party integrations that connect Quick to the business systems users rely on every day, enabling AI agents to take real action on their behalf. You will lead technical strategy for these connectors, working across teams to solve problems where requirements are clear but the right architecture is not. If you enjoy building systems that must work reliably at enterprise scale and want your code to directly drive product adoption, this is a role where your engineering decisions will have visible impact.


Key job responsibilities
Design and deliver third-party integrations and real-time connectors that enable AI agents within Quick to take action on behalf of users across the business systems they depend on.
Own the architectural direction for your team's integration platform, evaluating tradeoffs in scalability, performance, security, and maintainability while influencing technical decisions in systems you depend on but do not control.
Write high-quality code that sets the standard for your team in organization, clarity, error handling, and documentation, and drive adoption of consistent engineering practices.
Mentor and coach engineers on your team and across partner teams, contributing to hiring, career development, and a strong engineering culture.
Identify opportunities to simplify existing systems, reduce technical debt, and apply generative AI tools where they improve productivity and product quality.

A day in the life
You might start your morning reviewing a design for a new connector that links Quick to an external business application, offering feedback that strengthens the approach before implementation begins. Later, you pair with engineers on a partner team to align on an API contract and discuss how agents will authenticate and act within a third-party system. In the afternoon, you write code for a critical integration component, balancing near-term delivery with long-term extensibility. Between deep technical work, you check operational dashboards, refine runbooks, and spend time coaching a teammate through a tricky problem.


About the team
The Quick team is on a mission to build an AI-native work surface where users simply express what they want to accomplish and Quick handles the rest, drawing on deep knowledge of the user, their team, and their organization. Our real-time connectors are central to that vision: they drive adoption by giving Quick the breadth and reliability enterprises demand. We value collaboration, technical rigor, and open dialogue. If you want to join an inclusive team where your work directly shapes how people interact with AI at work, we would love to talk.

- 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience

title: Systems Engineer, Managed Operations
descriptionHtml:
AWS has successfully launched the European Sovereign Cloud (ESC), marking a significant development in Utility Computing (UC). To spearhead this initiative, we are actively seeking experienced systems engineers with a strong background in automation and operations. As part of the AWS Managed Operations team, you will play a pivotal role in building, operating and evolving operations and development teams dedicated to delivering high-availability AWS services, including EC2, S3, Dynamo, Lambda, and Bedrock, exclusively for EU customers. For more information on ESC please check out our blog: https://aws.amazon.com/blogs/aws/in-the-works-aws-european-sovereign-cloud/

Your responsibilities will encompass overseeing the ongoing operations and expansion of the ESC, working closely with global AWS teams, and influencing the evolution of AWS services and technology. A typical day in this role involves collaborating with technology leaders, contributing to the enhancement of day-to-day operations, and ensuring continuous improvements in availability, reliability, latency, performance, and efficiency of the ESC. You will be required to occasionally participate in “on-call” rotations to resolve incidents occurring out-of-hours.

The overarching goal is to deliver scalable services and ensure a high-availability experience for EU customers. If you are an experienced professional ready for a challenging and impactful opportunity, we invite you to join our efforts in operating and scaling a best-in-class development engineering and operations team that aligns with AWS' commitment to customer satisfaction and continual innovation.




A day in the life
Embark on a week filled with meaningful contributions to the operation and improvement of significant software systems. You dedicate a substantial portion of your time to carefully review the operational health of services within your team's responsibility. In the process, you diligently identify anomalies and craft actionable bug reports, aspiring to enhance the overall efficiency and performance of your systems.

In addition to these responsibilities, you offer constructive feedback on change management documents and work earnestly to address your team's operational backlog. Through a collaborative effort, you strive to navigate challenges and ensure the seamless functionality of your systems. Additionally, you engage in the development and testing of scripts, hoping to provide practical solutions to enhance your workflows.

Beyond the technical aspects, you assume a role as an educator, sharing insights on the complexities of the European Sovereign Cloud with service teams. It's a humbling experience for you to contribute to the collective knowledge of the team, fostering a culture of mutual understanding.

This week encapsulates your commitment to continuous learning and improvement, acknowledging that every effort, no matter how small, contributes to the collective success of your team and the reliability of your software systems.

In addition to these responsibilities, your position involves 24x7 on-call responsibility. You work as a team to root-cause issues and ensure your systems remain resilient and fault-tolerant, underscoring your commitment to maintaining operational excellence.

for customer shipments.

title: Software Development Engineer II, PACMAN
descriptionHtml:
We are seeking an experienced and motivated Software Development Engineer (SDE-2) to design, build, and operate scalable software systems that power capacity management decisions across Amazon's outbound fulfillment network in PACMAN team under SCOT organization. In this role, you will be responsible for developing robust, production-grade services that surface capacity utilization trends, detect risk patterns in real time.

The Amazon Supply Chain Optimization Technologies (SCOT) team works on some of the world's most complex supply chain challenges, at Amazon scale. Within SCOT, the Fulfillment Optimization (FO) organization owns products and services that plan and execute orders for the outbound network worldwide — from designing network topology to providing accurate customer promises and selecting optimal fulfillment paths.

What we're looking for:
- Strong foundations in data structures, algorithms, and system design.
- Experience with or passion for: Algorithms, optimizations, and generative AI.
- Ability to break down ambiguous, complex problems into elegant, shippable solutions
- Comfort operating in a fast-paced environment where you own your systems end-to-end
- Excellent communication skills and a track record of raising the engineering bar on your team

Key job responsibilities
- Design and implement software solutions across major portions of your team's systems, balancing new feature development with refactoring and operational improvements to maintain long-term code health.
- Collaborate with customers, stakeholders, and cross-functional peers to understand business requirements and deliver the right solutions, ensuring alignment between customer needs and technical direction.
- Participate actively in the full software development lifecycle, including system design, code reviews, testing, deployment, and production operations, while applying sound judgment on data structures, algorithms, and architectural trade-offs.
- Mentor and coach other engineers through code reviews and knowledge sharing, producing clear documentation so that your software can be maintained and extended by those unfamiliar with the codebase.
- Identify root causes of operational issues and drive permanent fixes, continuously improving your team's processes, reliability, and overall software quality.

A day in the life

- Collaborate with Engineering, Science, and Product teams to design and implement new capacity tracking features — owning the technical architecture from high-level design through deployment, testing and including data pipeline construction for capacity ingestion and consumption.
- Design, build, and maintain scalable backend services and APIs that power the end-to-end lifecycle of capacity tracking: from initial configuration by resource owners, through real-time consumption tracking, to detection and risk notification — ensuring low latency, high availability, and data accuracy.
- Own and improve systems that detect discrepancies between expected and actual capacity utilization across outbound resources (sort centers, delivery stations, fulfillment centers) — building automated alerting, self-healing mechanisms, and diagnostic tooling to surface and resolve mismatches proactively using generative AI.
- Partner with capacity resource owners and FO decision-system teams to translate new data requirements and into technical specifications, leading design reviews and driving implementation across the service stack.
- Investigate and resolve production issues — by performing root-cause analysis, authoring corrections of errors (COEs), and driving operational improvements to prevent recurrence.
- Ensure peak event readiness (Prime Day, holiday season) by conducting performance and load testing, identifying and mitigating system bottlenecks, hardening capacity data services for throughput spikes, and participating in operational readiness reviews (ORRs) to guarantee timely and accurate risk signals at scale.

About the team
The PACMAN (Persistence And Capacity Management) team serves as the centralized authority for capacity availability across all of Amazon's physical outbound resources. Accurate, granular, and real-time capacity tracking is foundational for FO planning and execution systems to effectively utilize first and third party resources. From generating reliable network flow plans to providing accurate customer promises on the website and selecting optimal fulfillment paths for customer shipments, capacity information is a critical input at every step of fulfillment decision making.

Basic qualifications

- 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
- 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
- 1+ years of software development engineer or related occupational experience
- 1+ years of designing and developing large-scale, multi-tiered, multi-threaded, embedded or distributed software applications, tools, systems, and services using: C#, C++, Java, or Perl experience
- 1+ years of Object Oriented Design experience
- Bachelor's degree or foreign equivalent in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field
- Experience programming with at least one software programming language

Preferred qualifications

- 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
- Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

title: Certified Pharmacy Technician, Amazon Pharmacy
descriptionHtml:
Innovation is at the core of what we do. We believe that by removing and reducing the barriers that prevent people from taking their medications, we can help customers conveniently get the medications they need when they need them and take them as prescribed. We have provided customers with the ability to find transparent and simple pricing, receive 24/7 customer service support and have their meds delivered to their doorsteps while creating programs and products that embody our mission and position ourselves in becoming the world’s safest and fastest online pharmacy.

We are looking for a Certified Pharmacy Technician to join us on our journey to make it drastically easier for customers to find, choose, afford, and engage with the services, products, and professionals they need to get and stay healthy!

This position offers a unique blend of on-the-road independence and in-pharmacy teamwork! In this role, you will be responsible for both kiosk management and working within our pharmacy operations, including driving from the Pharmacy to our Kiosk locations, refilling inventory and maintaining Pharmacy Kiosk Machines in regionalized areas. You will also be working in the physical Pharmacy location preparing orders
for customer shipments.

#everydaybetter

Key job responsibilities
-Drive from physical Pharmacy locations to our remote Pharmacy Kiosk locations with company provided vehicle
-Refill Pharmacy Kiosks with medication, paper, clean machine, and collect discarded inventory for return
-Prepare inventory shipments for Kiosk replenishment
-Assist pharmacist in filling prescription items, as permitted by the state board of pharmacy
-Maintain a safe and clean pharmacy by complying with procedures, rules and regulations
-Work daily with Leadership to ensure the right medications are put in the right orders
-Run automated machinery required to pre-sort and package medications
-Fill exception trays with appropriate medication
-Transition Amazon Pharmacy orders through different workflow stages from initial dispense through quality control
-Count and fill prescription vials and affix labels on bulk prescription items
-Pack and ship completed orders including printing and affixing appropriate labels on dispenser, shipping boxes
-Sort and triage the right boxes to ship at the right time
-Aid the Pharmacy Manager and Staff Pharmacists with receiving, shipping, counting, and packing
-Clean, and help maintain, equipment and work areas within the pharmacy.
-Package medications for dispensing and for delivery
-Work a flexible schedule - shifts will possibly start and end outside of normal site business hours

Physical Requirements:
-During shifts last up to 12 hours (standard full-time shifts are 10 hours excluding overtime, flex and part-time shifts may vary):
-Driving for long periods of time (8+hrs)
-Standing, bending, reaching above the head, kneeling, crouching and/or stretching
-Lifting and moving products up to 49 lbs in weight
-Manual dexterity of hands and wrists

Basic qualifications

- active and unrestricted Pharmacy Technician license (or equivalent trainee/assistant license) in state of employment
- National Pharmacy Technician Certification (PTCB or NHA)
- High school diploma or equivalent
- 6+ months of working with computer and web based tools experience
- Valid and active driver's license
- Must be at least 21 years old
- Ability to communicate effectively with coworkers and supervisor
- Ability to read and understand English language labeling on product cartons and prescription labels
- Clean driving record that passes Amazon’s Motor Vehicle Record (MVR) Checks (to be rechecked annually). Driving privileges will be revoked if your DMV reports indicates you have received a ticket for one or more of the following violations: Evading responsibility, Being at fault in a fatal accident, Having two or more motor vehicle accidents in the last three years, Having a motor vehicle accident resulting in greater than $5,000 in damages, Driving under the influence or in any way impaired by alcohol or drugs, Reckless Driving, Recurrent speeding violations, Recurrent driving suspensions, Three or more driving violations within the last three years

Preferred qualifications

- Experience recognizing and identifying patient medications
- Experience working in fast paced environments, and managing workload even during times of stress, or escalated activity
- Demonstrated organization skills and attention to detail
- Demonstrated ability to work as an effective team member

title: Software Development Engineer, AWS OpenSearch Service
descriptionHtml:
Imagine running search and analytics at any scale without thinking about clusters, capacity, or version upgrades. Where your queries return in milliseconds whether you're indexing a thousand documents or a hundred billion. Where the platform scales, heals, and secures itself so your team can focus on the questions, not the infrastructure.

That's what we build.

Amazon OpenSearch Service is the fully managed and Serverless AWS service that lets customers deploy, operate, and scale OpenSearch for log analytics, full-text search, application monitoring, observability, and AI-powered retrieval. We serve hundreds of thousands of customers running mission-critical workloads across every AWS region, and we are part of the AWS Database and Analytics organization.

Come join the OpenSearch Control Plane team. We are responsible for a service that:

- Reliably manages a large fleet of cloud-native OpenSearch clusters and collections, freeing customers from sizing, scaling, and patching decisions
- Guarantees high availability and durability for mission-critical search and observability workloads at the scale of the most demanding internet businesses
- Orchestrates and automates the complete lifecycle of an OpenSearch cluster or collection — from creation through scale-up, scale-out, upgrade, replication, and fail-over

The OpenSearch control plane is not just any distributed system. It orchestrates a fleet of clusters across every AWS region, detects and recovers from node failures in seconds, and serves workloads that span petabytes of customer data. Most recently, we launched **OpenSearch Serverless NextGen** — delivering ultra-fast collection provisioning and true scale-to-zero capacity, so customers pay only for what they use and get a working environment in seconds rather than minutes. We are not done; this is one of many investments raising the bar for what customers can expect from a managed search service.

OpenSearch itself is a community-driven, Apache 2.0–licensed open-source search and analytics suite built on Apache Lucene. Since launching in July 2021, the project has delivered multiple major and minor releases advancing core search, vector search, and analytics. Our next phase focuses on transforming OpenSearch into an intelligent retrieval engine — one that meets the evolving needs of customers running search, analytics, and AI-powered workloads across structured, unstructured, and multi-modal data.

We work in Java, Rust, Python, and Go. We contribute upstream to OpenSearch and Apache Lucene. We are customer-obsessed, operate with the entrepreneurial pace of a startup inside one of the world's largest cloud providers, and value strong intuition backed by metrics.

**Operations is core engineering on this team, not overhead.** Engineers operate what they build, and we treat customer-impacting incidents with the same engineering rigor we apply to feature work. Reliability and Static Stability is a forcing function for design, not a phase after launch.

Key job responsibilities
- Design, develop, and operate components of a large-scale distributed control plane — reason about failure modes, multi-tenant isolation, and blast-radius before writing code
- Look for opportunities to simplify — consolidate duplicate abstractions, remove dead code, reduce configuration sprawl, and challenge complexity that doesn't earn its keep
- Treat operations as core engineering — own the systems you build end-to-end, participate fully in incident response and RCAs, and drive operational improvements that reduce cost and maintenance burden
- Solve real problems in cluster orchestration, capacity provisioning, lifecycle workflows, multi-tenant infrastructure, query routing, and operational tooling
- Use AI coding assistants and GenAI tools effectively across the software development lifecycle — from design and prototyping through coding, testing, code review, debugging, and operations — applying engineering judgment to validate AI-generated output against Amazon's correctness, security, and operational bar
- Write robust, efficient, and maintainable code in Java, Rust, Python, or Go
- Partner with senior engineers to translate ambiguous requirements into concrete deliverables; prototype, test, and validate
- Continually challenge what exists and explore what should change to better serve customers

Basic qualifications

- 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
- 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
- 1+ years of software development engineer or related occupational experience
- 1+ years of designing and developing large-scale, multi-tiered, multi-threaded, embedded or distributed software applications, tools, systems, and services using: C#, C++, Java, or Perl experience
- 1+ years of Object Oriented Design experience
- Bachelor's degree or foreign equivalent in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field
- Experience programming with at least one software programming language

Preferred qualifications

- 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
- Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

title: Ship Clerk
descriptionHtml:
Ship Clerks play a crucial role in the Middle Mile network and are responsible for delivering our mission is to be Earth's most customer-centric company. Ship Clerks are responsible for daily management of department duties including planning loads around standard departure times, load flow control and ensuring proper trailer utilization. Ship Clerks can assign job duties, provide work direction and communicate with internal and external partners.

Ship Clerks will drive and execute standard work in areas impacting Safety, Quality, Productivity, Utilization, and On-time Performance. They will help support daily management of department duties including Load planning, Load Flow Control, Load Quality, TDR, Communicating to Upstream and Downstream Partners, Allocating Labor, Leading Meetings, and Assigning job Duties. Ship Clerks will escalate any barriers to their Operations Leaders and work with them to mitigate issues impacting safety and performance.


Key job responsibilities
• Correspond with multiple shipping companies and their contacts
• Use multiple shipping company’s software to ship and track packages
• Coordinate trailers to corresponding dock doors and cross docks using SSP
• Troubleshoot shipping problems and errors to resolution
• Ensure trailer utilization is maximized to control transportation costs
• Ensure on-time dock performance
• Assist in updating Staging POD 5s and resource allocation
• Oversee Load Flow Control for the building
• Maintain load level performance tracking for load planning, on-time dock performance, utilization, and misloads
•Coordinate with Transportation teams on Driver issues, Trailer Pool needs, Yard Move Delays, Late Inbound volume, and Load Swaps to protect customer experience.
•Comprehensive understanding of shipping requirements, rules and obligations by carrier, destination and package type
• Ensure that all safety measures and precautions are in place and being used regarding the docks and trailers
• Assisting the floor as an associate resource, training associates and verifying SOP compliance
• Ensure successful area performance, through tracking, reporting and feedback of associate performance
• Participate in Operational Excellence initiatives in some capacity
• Filling in as needed with production duties
• Fully understanding workflow and daily production goals
• Reviewing and updating SOP as required
• Assisting in keeping work area clean and organized
• Identifying and addressing safety hazards within the work area
• Participating in safety initiatives
• Referring all job injuries or safety violations immediately to Area Manager

Basic qualifications

- 1+ years of Microsoft Office products and applications experience
- High school or equivalent
- Work a flexible schedule/shift/work area, including weekends, nights, and/or holidays
- Can lift up to 49 pounds, stand/walk during shifts lasting up to 12 hours, and be able to frequently push, pull, squat, bend, and reach
- Work 40 hours/week, and overtime as required

Preferred qualifications

- Prior training, teaching or presentation experience
- Willingness to work different shifts
- Shift hours for this position may be different from the standard production shifts
- Willingness to work in different areas as required by training needs
- Excellent attendance
- Candidates must be very organized and able to handle multiple and changing projects/priorities
- Willingness to participate in and support the Operational Excellence initiatives

AWS Nitro, ENA, EFA, Graviton and F1 EC2 Instances, AWS Neuron, Inferentia and Trainium ML Accelerators, and in storage with scalable NVMe, are some of the products we have delivered, over the last few years.

AWS Neuron is the complete software stack for the AWS Inferentia and Trainium cloud-scale machine learning accelerators and the Trn1 and Inf1 servers that use them. This position is for a Software Engineer that will lead the development of machine learning tools to run, optimize, and analyze machine learning workloads. This candidate must have had experience leading machine learning tool projects, preferably starting from architecture through several generations of delivery to customers. Deep knowledge of profiling and optimization, resource management, scheduling, code generation are needed. The ideal candidate will have worked on new instruction set architectures, which may include CPU, NPU, GPU and other forms of compute.

Key job responsibilities
This engineer will lead the design and implementation of ML infrastructure platform, building systems for capacity management, workload scheduling, and fleet orchestration across ML accelerators. They will work with ML scientists, training infrastructure engineers, hardware teams, and internal customers to ensure the ML Infra service delivers seamless ML Accelerator access with low wait times, high utilization, and zero-config deployment from various environments.

A day in the life
As you design and code solutions to help our team drive efficiencies in software architecture, you’ll create metrics, implement automation and other improvements, and resolve the root cause of software defects. You’ll also:

Build high-impact solutions to deliver to our large customer base.
Participate in design discussions, code review, and communicate with internal and external stakeholders.
Work cross-functionally to help drive business decisions with your technical input.
Work in a startup-like development environment, where you’re always working on the most important stuff.

About the team
* High-impact, high-visibility: You'll directly accelerate every Neuron team's ability to ship — your work multiplies the output of 100+ engineers
* Greenfield opportunities: We're actively building new capabilities with significant design ownership for SDEs
* Small, senior team: where every person owns major components and drives architectural decisions
* AI infrastructure: Work at the intersection of Kubernetes, custom silicon, and large-scale ML workloads

We value diverse experiences and non-traditional career paths. If your career is just starting or includes alternative experiences, we encourage you to apply.

Inclusive Team Culture
Our employee-led affinity groups foster inclusion. Events like CORE and AmazeCon inspire us to embrace our uniqueness.

Work/Life Balance
We strive for flexibility as part of our working culture, supporting you both at work and at home.

Mentorship & Career Growth
We offer knowledge-sharing, mentorship, and one-on-one code reviews to help you grow as a professional.

- 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
- 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
- Experience programming with at least one software programming language

Preferred qualifications

- 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
- Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent
- 2+ years of building large-scale machine-learning infrastructure for online recommendation, ads ranking, personalization or search experience
- Strong proficiency in Go/Java, Python and working knowledge Javascript/TypeScript
- Experience building and operating large-scale distributed systems on Kubernetes
- Experience designing, deploying, and maintaining production services at scale, including on-call ownership

title: Data Center Operations Technician, Data Center Operations (DCO)
descriptionHtml:
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is growing rapidly, and we are looking for Data Center Technician to join our expanding Infrastructure Operations team.
Data Center Operations designs, installs and maintains the world’s largest Computing Infrastructure. Our scope of work includes systems, repairing, dealing with issues, handling and tracking parts and assisting in Data Center maintenance. Amazon Data Centers are large-scale high-density centers where you will help change the face of Technology in the region.


Key job responsibilities
As Data Centre Operations Engineer, you will be the primary point of contact for internal customers. There is never a dull moment as each day presents itself with different challenges. Some of the key responsibilities you will undertake are:

• You will troubleshoot technical issues on advanced hardware, ranging from servers, storage and networking devices on a 24/7 basis.
• You will maintain a high level of system reliability and availability.
• You will participate in projects to enhance operational efficiencies with opportunities to share experiences and knowledge with our global network of technical experts.
• You will share knowledge and help train less technical staff on the best practices related to all service owner issues
• You will contribute towards building a great team by getting involved in the Amazon hiring process/candidate interviews

As a successful Data Center Operations engineer, your day-to-day work will include:
• Installation and configurations on Data center Servers and Network systems
• Installation, troubleshooting and replacement of internal and external hardware parts of Servers and Network devices
• Work within a ticket-based environment and work on systematic problem resolution

title: Enablement Lead, AWS Marketing Integrated Demand Center
descriptionHtml:
Own how AWS's biggest marketing plans reach the field and wider org. The IDP Enablement Lead is the bridge between marketing strategy and the sales, specialist, and partner teams who take it to customers — equipping thousands of customer-facing Amazonians across nine solution areas with the content, playbooks, and context they need to win. If you've ever been on the receiving end of enablement and thought "I could build this better," this role is for you.

The AWS Marketing Integrated Demand Center (IDC) runs the Integrated Demand Plans (IDPs) — the connected, full-funnel plans that translate AWS marketing strategy into coordinated field and partner execution across nine solution areas (AI, Connect, Data & Analytics, Developer, European Sovereign Cloud, ISV, Migration & Modernization, Quick, and Startup). The IDP Enablement team exists to connect marketing strategy to field success: equipping the field, partner, and specialist teams who take the IDPs to customers, and building the rhythm of business that keeps the whole system aligned.

We are looking for an IDP Enablement Lead to own how the IDPs are enabled, adopted, and understood across AWS Marketing and the field. This is an individual contributor role spanning three connected pillars: enablement content and assets, field and partner activation, and operational cadence and governance. You will own the enablement engine that keeps stakeholders current on what each IDP is doing, build the playbooks and templates that let programs execute at scale, and run the cadences that keep IDP v-teams, field marketing, and specialist teams pointed in the same direction.

The ideal candidate is a structured problem-solver who thrives in ambiguity, can build operational rigor from scratch, and drives alignment across multiple stakeholder groups without direct authority. They bring strong communication skills, a bias for action, and the ability to influence cross-functional partners in a fast-paced, matrix environment — turning complex, multi-team plans into clear, usable enablement that the field can act on. This role is equally suited for candidates from sales, specialist, or field backgrounds who understand what it takes to enable customer facing teams, as it is for candidates with traditional marketing experience.


Key job responsibilities
Enablement content & assets
- Own the IDP enablement library — playbooks, templates, onboarding materials, and the team wiki — keeping it current, accurate, and aligned to the latest IDP strategy and launches.
- Own and produce the recurring IDP newsletter and stakeholder communications, leading with outcomes and pairing every update with clear business rationale.
- Build reusable frameworks, templates, and shared resources that let IDP programs execute consistently at scale.
Field & partner activation
- Serve as the single-threaded enablement partner between IDP v-teams and field, specialist, and partner teams (WWSO, PMM, AFX / WWFE, Channels, partner marketing).
- Translate IDP strategy and program plans into field-ready enablement, and drive adoption across marketing and field stakeholders.
- Gather field and stakeholder needs and feed them back into IDP planning, closing the loop between strategy and execution.
Operational cadence and governance
- Own the enablement operational rhythm — planning cadences, review forums, and governance frameworks — in partnership with central and IDP teams.
- Define and maintain governance standards so IDP enablement is consistent across all nine plans.
- Track enablement adoption and impact, and surface risks, opportunities, and insights to leadership through regular reporting cadences.
- Drive automation and AI-enabled improvements to enablement and reporting workflows to improve efficiency and scale.

A day in the life
The IDP Enablement Lead operates with significant autonomy across high-visibility, cross-functional work. You work with guidance from senior leaders on the most strategic decisions, demonstrate strong execution and emerging strategic thinking, and contribute to initiatives that improve how the entire IDP system is enabled and adopted. On any given day you might refine a field-ready playbook with an IDP v-team, run an enablement review with specialist and field stakeholders, publish the monthly IDP newsletter, and pull together an adoption read-out for IDC leadership.

About the team
The IDP Enablement team sits within the AWS Marketing Integrated Demand Center. Our mission is to connect marketing strategy to field success — making the IDPs usable, adopted, and understood by the teams who take AWS to customers. We work across all nine IDPs and partner closely with Strategy & Operations, Content Strategy, the Channels team, SCPM leadership and geo teams, and partner teams worldwide.

Basic qualifications

- 4+ years of professional non-internship marketing experience
- Experience using data and metrics to drive improvements
- Experience building, executing and scaling cross-functional programs or marketing campaigns from concept to completion
- Experience producing marketing promotional material for Owned & Operated channels

Preferred qualifications

- Experience using customer research, hard data and metrics to back up assumptions, generate forecasts, and assess the efficacy of marketing programs
- Experience driving direction and alignment with large cross-functional teams and agency partners
- Experience building launch readiness frameworks, standard work, playbooks, and scalable deployment mechanisms across multiple concurrent sites, or experience in similar environments
- Experience in technology-related sales, marketing or business development
- Experience in stakeholder and communication management
- Experience building operational frameworks from scratch in a fast-paced or ambiguous environment
- Experience leveraging AI tools and automation to improve marketing and enablement workflows

title: General Marketing Manager Intern- 2027
descriptionHtml:
Job Summary

Il existe un univers d'opportunités chez Amazon.
Chez Amazon, votre carrière ne suit pas une ligne droite. Elle s'accélère, prend des tournants et vous met au défi de manières que vous n'auriez jamais imaginées. Dès votre arrivée, vous faites partie de quelque chose de grand : créer des produits ou des services qui touchent des millions de personnes et façonner la manière dont les gens vivent, travaillent et se connectent au quotidien. C'est ici que vos idées se transforment en un véritable impact. Vous travaillerez avec des outils de classe mondiale, des plateformes internationales et des systèmes conçus pour fonctionner à une échelle extraordinaire. Vous avancerez rapidement, expérimenterez et lancerez des solutions qui comptent. Avec des opportunités infinies à explorer au sein de différentes équipes et fonctions, vous apprendrez vite, appliquerez vos connaissances et découvrirez des compétences dont vous ignoriez l'existence. C'est un environnement conçu pour les bâtisseurs qui veulent voir l'impact de leur travail dans le monde. Prêt(e) à commencer votre aventure ?

Qu'est-ce que cela vous apporte ?

Un stage chez Amazon signifie de vraies responsabilités dès le premier jour. Vous construirez, testerez et apprendrez aux côtés de personnes qui souhaitent vous voir réussir, tout en ayant un impact qui va bien au-delà du campus.


There’s a universe of opportunity at Amazon.
At Amazon, your career doesn’t follow a straight line. It accelerates, twists, and challenges you in ways you never expected. From the moment you join, you’re part of something big: building products or services that reach millions and shaping how people live, work, and connect every day. This is where your ideas turn into real impact.
You’ll work with world class tools, global platforms, and systems built to operate at an extraordinary scale. You’ll move fast, experiment and launch solutions that matter. With endless opportunities to explore across teams and roles, you’ll learn quickly, apply what you know and discover skills you didn’t know existed. This is an environment
designed for builders who want to see the impact of their work in the world. Ready to start your adventure?

What’s in it for you?
An internship at Amazon means real responsibility from day one. You’ll build, test, and learn alongside people who want to see you succeed, while making an impact that reaches far beyond campus.

Key job responsibilities
Principales responsabilités du poste

Collaborer avec des équipes transversales pour soutenir les initiatives marketing, en démontrant des compétences en gestion de projet dans un environnement commercial compétitif et dynamique.
Participer à la mise en œuvre de la stratégie de marque mondiale, en l'adaptant au marché local pour garantir sa pertinence et son impact.
Soutenir la création de contenus et de supports marketing efficaces pour engager les clients et les prospects.
Contribuer à la gestion de campagnes marketing et d'autres initiatives de croissance, en suivant les performances et en participant aux efforts d'optimisation.
Accompagner l'équipe dans la recommandation et l'exécution d'améliorations du réseau pour renforcer l'efficacité marketing.
Proposer des solutions innovantes et durables qui profitent à l'ensemble de l'équipe et génèrent un impact durable.


Qualifications de base

Parler, écrire et lire couramment l'anglais au niveau C1 ou supérieur
Être titulaire ou en cours d'obtention d'une licence (ou diplôme supérieur) en Marketing, Communication ou dans un domaine connexe
Travailler au minimum 35 heures par semaine et s'engager pour un stage de 6 mois maximum
Maîtrise avancée de Microsoft Excel, incluant : tableaux croisés dynamiques, macros, index/equiv, recherchev, VBA, liaisons de données, etc.

Qualifications souhaitées

Solides compétences en résolution de problèmes et en analyse, avec la capacité d'identifier des améliorations de processus et des solutions innovantes
Compréhension des canaux de marketing digital (tels que l'e-mail, l'affichage numérique, le SEO, le PPC) et des outils associés (incluant l'e-mail, l'analyse web, le CRM et les plateformes d'automatisation marketing)
Excellentes compétences en communication et en travail d'équipe, avec la capacité de collaborer efficacement avec les autres
Curiosité démontrée, proactivité et volonté de relever des défis dans un environnement ambigu et en constante évolution



Key Job Responsibilities

Collaborate with cross-functional teams to support marketing initiatives, demonstrating project management skills in a competitive and dynamic business climate.

Assist with implementing the global brand strategy, adapting it to the local market to ensure relevance and impact.

Support the creation of effective content and marketing assets to engage customers and prospects.

Help run marketing campaigns and other growth initiatives, tracking performance and contributing to optimisation efforts.

Support the team in recommending and executing network improvements to enhance marketing effectiveness.

Contribute innovative, long-term solutions that benefit the entire team and drive lasting impact.

A day in the life
Une journée type

Chaque jour est différent en tant que stagiaire en Marketing Général. Vous collaborerez avec des équipes transversales sur de véritables initiatives marketing qui contribuent à développer la marque Amazon et l'engagement client. Vous pourriez passer votre matinée à adapter une campagne de marque mondiale au marché local et à créer du contenu percutant, puis consacrer votre après-midi à analyser les données de performance des campagnes afin de recommander des optimisations pour une initiative de croissance en cours. Vous travaillerez aux côtés de marketeurs expérimentés, soutiendrez l'exécution d'améliorations du réseau et apporterez des idées nouvelles.

Amazon est une entreprise obsédée par le client, donc quelle que soit l'initiative que vous soutenez, une partie de votre rôle consistera à comprendre ce qui résonne auprès des clients et des prospects. Vous contribuerez à la stratégie de marque, participerez à la gestion de campagnes marketing et proposerez des solutions innovantes qui profitent à l'ensemble de l'équipe — en développant vos compétences en gestion de marque, création de contenu et marketing stratégique dans un environnement dynamique et rapide.


Every day is different as a General Marketing Manager Intern. You'll collaborate with cross-functional teams on real marketing initiatives that help grow Amazon's brand and customer engagement. You might spend your morning adapting a global brand campaign for the local market and creating compelling content, then spend your afternoon analysing campaign performance data to recommend optimisations for an ongoing growth initiative. You will partner with experienced marketers, support the execution of network improvements, and bring fresh ideas to the table.

Amazon is a customer-obsessed business, so no matter which initiative you are supporting, part of your role will involve understanding what resonates with customers and prospects. You'll contribute to brand strategy, help run marketing campaigns, and propose innovative solutions that benefit the wider team — building your skills in brand management, content creation, and strategic marketing in a dynamic, fast-paced environment.

About the team
À propos de l'équipe

Communauté des stagiaires : En tant que stagiaire Amazon, vous ferez partie d'une communauté dynamique et solidaire qui favorise votre croissance et votre développement. Vous collaborerez avec des stagiaires du monde entier, en réseautant et en participant à des événements sociaux pour élargir vos perspectives. Vous pourrez également rejoindre des groupes spécialisés axés sur des domaines tels que le développement durable pour explorer vos centres d'intérêt variés.

Accompagnement : Le programme de stage offre un système de soutien solide, comprenant des permanences hebdomadaires pour les stagiaires, un support informatique et RH dédié, ainsi qu'une équipe de programme engagée dans votre réussite. Cela garantit que vous disposez de l'accompagnement et de l'assistance nécessaires pour vous épanouir.

Sessions de formation : Des sessions de formation exclusives renforceront davantage vos compétences, en vous donnant accès aux plateformes d'apprentissage de pointe d'Amazon et à l'expertise de leaders du secteur. Ces opportunités de développement structurées vous prépareront à la prochaine étape de votre carrière.

Opportunités : À l'issue de votre stage, si celui-ci est réussi, vous pourrez être considéré(e) pour un poste de diplômé(e) ou un second stage, vous permettant de poursuivre votre parcours chez Amazon. De plus, vous bénéficierez d'un salaire mensuel compétitif, d'une aide à la relocalisation et d'un accès à une gamme d'avantages sociaux.

Dates de début de stage tout au long de l'année : Nous recrutons des stagiaires pour commencer à tout moment de janvier à septembre 2027. Chaque mois, nous organiserons 1 à 2 journées d'intégration pour les nouvelles recrues.


Intern Community:

As an Amazon Intern, you'll be part of a dynamic, supportive community that empowers your growth and development. You'll collaborate with interns from around the world, networking and participating in social events to broaden your perspectives. You can also join specialized groups focused on areas like sustainability to explore your diverse interests.


Support:

The internship program provides a robust support system, including weekly intern office hours, dedicated IT and HR support, and a program team committed to your success. This ensures you have the guidance and assistance needed to thrive.


Learning Sessions:

Exclusive learning sessions will further enhance your skills, granting you access to Amazon's industry-leading learning platforms and the expertise of industry leaders. These structured development opportunities will prepare you for the next step in your career.


Opportunities:

Upon successful completion of the internship, you may be considered for a graduate role or a second internship, allowing you to continue your journey with Amazon. Additionally, you'll enjoy a competitive monthly salary, relocation support, and access to a range of employee benefits.


Internship Start Dates across the year:

We are hiring interns to start anytime from January through September 2027. Each month, we'll hold 1-2 onboarding days for new hires.

Basic qualifications

- Speak, write, and read fluently in English at C1 level or above
- Currently has, or is in the process of obtaining, a Bachelor's degree or above in Marketing, Communications, or a related fields
- Work 35 hours/week minimum and commit to 6 month internship maximum
- Knowledge of Microsoft Excel at an advanced level, including: pivot tables, macros, index/match, vlookup, VBA, data links, etc.

Preferred qualifications

- Strong problem-solving and analytical skills, with the ability to identify process improvements and innovative solution
- Understanding of digital marketing channels (such as email, digital display, SEO, PPC.) and tools (including email, web analytics, CRM, and marketing automation platforms)
- Excellent communication and teamwork skills, able to collaborate effectively with others.
- Demonstrated curiosity, proactivity, and willingness to take on challenges in an ambiguous, fast-paced environment.

Amazon est un employeur engagé pour l'égalité des chances. Nous sommes convaincus qu'une main d'oeuvre diversifée est essentielle à notre réussite. Nous prenons nos décisions de recrutement en fonction de votre expérience et de vos compétences. Nous apprécions votre envie de découvrir, d'inventer, de simplifier et de construire. La protection de votre vie privée et la sécurité de vos données constituent depuis longtemps une priorité absolue pour Amazon. Veuillez consulter notre Politique de Confidentialité pour en savoir plus sur la façon dont nous collectons, utilisons et traitons les données personnelles de nos candidats.

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. descriptionHtml:

title: Structural BIM Designer, DC Design Engineering
descriptionHtml:
Are you an experienced Structural Designer with a passion for BIM? Are you a creative, smart, and driven individual that enjoys working on complex projects within a team environment? If this is you, we want YOU on our team!

You will be a part of highly creative and efficient multi-disciplinary BIM design team, tasked with designing challenging and complex projects with innovative solutions for Amazon-owned data center facilities. You will provide support to our Design Engineering team through the preparation of Structural BIM models and documentation, leveraging BIM data. You will influence data center design documents for: structural systems, exterior envelope design, site and civil planning, material lifecycle and sustainability, seismic considerations, and building code compliance. You will produce and maintain Structural drawing sets for our fleet of data centers.

Amazon’s data centers are industry-leading examples of innovation in the areas of space utilization, energy efficiency, and cost effectiveness. We are known for our speed to market and reliability. We are part of the US team responsible for the design and operation of critical industry leading data center facilities throughout North & South America. Our Design Team is on the forefront of creating and delivering the most innovative products to our customers; and are known for being a diverse and upbeat team that is changing the face of Cloud Computing. We continue to grow and are looking for individuals that can support our capacity delivery, enjoy a challenge, and have a desire for professional growth and continuous learning. Amazon’s work environment is unique in every aspect and offers an exceptional opportunity for the right candidate. At Amazon we highly support continued learning opportunities and focus on employee development.

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

Key job responsibilities
Daily responsibilities will include designing the Structural systems for our data centers, utilizing Revit to create and maintain BIM models. You must be able to work independently with occasional guidance, and work within a team environment to accomplish assigned tasks. This includes working with internal groups, as well as external suppliers, consultants, manufacturers, vendors, and contractors.

Your duties will include:
- Being self-motivated to work within the BIM Designer group and across other teams.
- Preparing and developing detailed Structural Revit models.
- Developing and publishing construction documentation for Structural building system designs in a fast-paced environment to meet scheduled deliverables.
- Creating and maintaining regional and global libraries, including Revit Families, Details, and Detail Components.
- Updating and modifying existing models, studies, and construction documents, as required.
- Assisting the creation and maintenance of BIM templates and enforcing BIM standards.
- Participating in design coordination meetings with other trades for clash detection and resolution.
- Working on concurrent projects in multiple geographic locations.
- Assisting information exchange processes between internal and external customers in a Common Data Environment (CDE).
- Recording and reporting key metrics to management.
- Traveling to data center sites for engineering evaluations and surveys, as required. On average: once or twice a year.
- Being positive and always offering creative, out-of-the-box solutions.
- Having fun and working hard!

A day in the life
As a Designer, you will collaborate across disciplines and teams to refine data center designs. Your work includes creating detailed models, drawings, specifications, and prototypes, and updating managers and leaders on changes to the building and site design. You engage in design discussions, review feedback from peers and collaborators, and adjust designs to ensure our data center solutions meet the highest standards of efficiency and quality.

In this role, you'll receive coaching and guidance from experienced managers and leaders who will help develop your technical and professional skills. You'll be expected to proactively seek feedback, participate in regular check-ins, and contribute to continuous improvement initiatives while maintaining open communication with all stakeholders.

About the team
Within the AWS Data Center Community, the Data Center Design Engineering team is a dynamic and collaborative group of engineers and designers dedicated to revolutionizing data center infrastructure. We pride ourselves on our expertise in designing, building, and optimizing innovative data center solutions. Together, we strive for highest level of quality, efficiency, reliability, and sustainability in data center operations.

We foster an environment of inclusion, innovation, and excellence. Team members continuously push the boundaries of what's possible in data center design and engineering. Joining our team means becoming a vital part AWS's mission to evolve the future of data center technology. If you are passionate about data center engineering, and want to make a meaningful impact in this critical field, we invite you to be part of our exciting journey.

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

title: Sr. Strategic Supply Chain Mgr, Lawn & Garden and Tools Supply Chain Team
descriptionHtml:
Are you ready to define supply chain strategy for one of Amazon's most seasonally dynamic and operationally complex categories? Amazon is seeking a Senior Supply Chain Manager to lead the end to end supply chain roadmap for our Lawn & Garden and Tools business. In this high visibility role, you will own the supply chain strategy for our most strategic vendor partners, partnering with Central Supply Chain, Operations, and Technology teams to design and scale improvements that extend beyond your category. You will use and enhance AI powered tools and workflows to drive faster, more accurate decision making, and actively experiment with how AI can reshape supply chain operations.

You will build deep strategic relationships with retail vendors, influence cross organizational teams, communicate insights and recommendations to senior leadership, and mentor supply chain managers on your team. You will balance tactical execution with strategic planning in a fast paced environment, bringing strong cross functional communication skills and the ability to define approaches uniquely tailored to the seasonal dynamics of our business. This role combines P&L ownership, vendor strategy leadership, AI driven automation, and cross functional influence for someone who thrives in ambiguity and is energized by driving operational excellence at the intersection of supply chain operations and innovation.

Key job responsibilities
- Define and own the end to end supply chain strategy for Lawn & Garden and Tools, developing inventory sourcing approaches for our most strategic vendor that account for seasonal complexity, cost targets, and customer availability goals unique to the category.
- Partner with Central Supply Chain, Operations, and Technology teams to identify, design, and implement supply chain improvements that scale across and beyond Lawn & Garden and Tools, driving operational excellence and influencing adoption through clear communication and stakeholder alignment.
- Use and enhance AI powered tools and automated workflows in partnership with product managers and tech teams, improving how the business makes faster and more accurate supply chain decisions.
- Communicate supply chain performance, insights, and strategic recommendations to senior leadership and cross functional partners, translating complex data into clear narratives that drive alignment and action.
- Build deep, strategic relationships with retail vendors, influencing their supply chain approach and collaborating on joint initiatives to improve lead times, confirmation rates, inventory health, and overall performance.
- Serve as a subject matter expert in supply chain programs and initiatives that impact beyond Lawn & Garden and Tools, mentoring and coaching team members while raising the bar on best practices across the broader organization.

A day in the life
You might start your morning reviewing cross category supply chain performance and flagging risks ahead of a seasonal peak, then lead a strategy session with central partners. Mid morning, you could be refining an AI powered workflow with a tech team or mentoring a supply chain manager to raise the bar on analytical rigor. After lunch, you might join a call with a strategic vendor to co develop a roadmap for lead time improvements. Throughout the week, you will present insights to Senior Leadership and cross functional teams, and continuously refine the processes that drive your category's performance.

About the team
Our team owns supply chain strategy and sourcing execution for Amazon's Lawn & Garden and Tools business, ensuring customers can find and receive the products they need reliably and efficiently. We are investing in profitability improvements across the category and partnering with Central Supply Chain, Operations, and Technology teams to build solutions that scale. We are a collaborative group of supply chain and product managers who work closely with vendors, category teams, and operations partners. You will gain deep experience in P&L management, vendor operations, and AI based automation, building skills that open doors to senior roles across Amazon.

- Experience leading process improvement, systems development, and project management
- 5+ years of supply chain, inventory management or project management experience
- Experience working cross functionally with tech and non-tech teams
- Experience in stakeholder management, dealing with multiple stakeholders at varied levels of the organization

title: Senior Software Development Engineer, Transactional Data Storage
descriptionHtml:
Do you want to work deep inside a database that processes billions of transactions every day across Amazon's consumer and digital businesses? Our team builds the data platforms at the core of Amazon, storing customer orders, catalog and product information, shopping carts, device data, and hundreds of other business-critical datasets. The performance and availability of our platform is critical to the reliability of the Amazon brand, and we run some of the largest fleets and highest-throughput services at the company.

We are looking for a Senior Software Development Engineer who understands distributed systems at scale and wants to shape the shared storage layer of our next-generation online transaction processing (OLTP) database. You will design how committed transactions are materialized to cloud object storage, how space is reclaimed as data is superseded, and how data nodes read back through a storage-format-agnostic contract. You will partner with Amazon Web Services (AWS) to leverage cloud-native technologies and contribute innovations back to the broader market. If you thrive on solving ambiguous, high-impact problems from design to delivery, we would love to hear from you.

Key job responsibilities
- Design, develop, and operate the distributed shared storage layer that holds the durable copy of every committed write for Amazon's mission-critical OLTP database platform.
- Collaborate with Principal Engineers and peers to define technical solutions for complex problems such as storage engine design, durability and consistency protocols, read-path caching, and backpressure under load.
- Own end-to-end delivery of features, from writing design documents and implementing production-quality code to driving operational readiness and deployment.
- Mentor engineers through design and code reviews, pairing on hard problems, and helping them take on larger pieces of the system while raising the team's quality bar.
- Build monitoring, alarming, and automation that keep our high-throughput services reliable, and participate in on-call rotations to troubleshoot issues and drive root-cause resolution.

A day in the life
You will split your time between deep individual work like writing code, reviewing designs, and prototyping storage-layer changes, and collaborative sessions with your team and partner teams. Expect regular design reviews where you debate trade-offs around durability, latency, and cost, along with weekly operational reviews that keep the platform healthy. Some weeks you will be heads-down implementing a new compaction strategy; other weeks you will pair with a teammate to debug a subtle consistency issue in production.

About the team
Our team sits within the Transact organization and is responsible for the storage engine layer that underpins Amazon's OLTP platform that powers all Amazon Stores. We are a group of engineers who care deeply about correctness, performance, and operational rigor. We partner closely with AWS service teams, sharing innovations in both directions. Our focus over the coming years is scaling the next-generation storage layer to meet Amazon's growing transaction volume while improving efficiency and reducing costs, and we are looking for engineers who want to help shape that future.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree
- Experience in professional, non-internship software development
- Experience in development in the last 3 years
- Experience programming with at least one modern language such as Java, C++, or C# including object-oriented design
- Experience leading the architecture and design (architecture, design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and current systems

Preferred qualifications

- Experience with full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations
- Experience in debugging, profiling, and implementing software engineering best practices in large-scale systems
- Knowledge of databases, storage and big data concepts
- Experience with performance and scalability testing

title: Aviation Security Control Center (ASCC) Manager, Aviation Security Control Center
descriptionHtml:
Amazon is looking for an experienced intelligence and security leader to join our Aviation Security Control Center (ASCC) in Erlanger, KY. You will report to the Sr. ASCC Manager at Amazon Air’s Network Control Center (NCC) and partner closely with NCC operations, Global Security, and AvSec field teams to enable positive security outcomes for Amazon’s aviation operations.
The ideal candidate has a strong background in intelligence analysis, security operations, risk management, or critical incident management. You will lead and grow the intelligence and risk management programs within the ASCC, driving real-time incident coordination during security events across Amazon Air, Prime Air drone operations, and Amazon Air Cargo. You will drive the identification, analysis, processing, and distribution of finished intelligence products, produce flash warnings and situation reports, lead investigations into workplace violence incidents, and apply risk management methodologies to assess emerging threats and mitigate security risks that directly impact the safety of Amazon’s global aviation network.
You will work across teams to define risk tolerance levels, develop intelligence and risk program strategies, mentor ASCC Specialists, and drive cross-functional initiatives that improve the ASCC’s security posture and operational effectiveness. Where the business problem and solution may not yet be defined, you will deliver independently, using your expertise to scope the work, identify opportunities, and recommend courses of action. This position requires shift work, including nights, weekends, and holidays. You must make sound judgments under pressure, handle sensitive information with discretion, and operate autonomously as the senior individual on shift.
If you are ready to support the intelligence and risk management mission for Amazon’s expanding aviation security operations, we want to hear from you.


Key job responsibilities
You will be part of the ASCC team providing 24/7 security coverage for Amazon’s global aviation operations. You will lead the development and growth of the ASCC’s intelligence and risk management programs, driving cross-functional projects and partners to meet defined goals. In this role, you must:
• Support security incident response and provide guidance to field teams during crisis situations, applying risk management methodologies to prevent or mitigate consequences of decisions that drive risk above tolerance levels
• Support the intelligence program: identify, analyze, and process threat-related information from multiple open-source and proprietary platforms, producing finished intelligence products that support decision-makers
• Operate autonomously during your shift as the senior ASCC representative, making go/no-go recommendations and clearing blockers without requiring escalation
• Handle sensitive information with discretion and professionalism, promoting a culture of compliance to security policies and regulations
• Make sound, timely judgments under pressure in fast-paced situations, distinguishing between important and urgent matters and accelerating progress by driving timely decisions
• Mentor and develop ASCC Specialists, improving their skills, judgment, and ability to deliver independently
• Work 10-hour shifts, including nights, weekends, and holidays
You will also:
• Gather and analyze threat-related intelligence from multiple open-source and proprietary platforms, integrating incoming information with current intelligence and investigations
• Assess the credibility and significance of incoming information and escalate or handle appropriately based on your expertise
• Identify emerging security risks and develop mitigation strategies, defining risk tolerance recommendations for partner teams based on data
• Prepare all-source intelligence products, including strategic threat assessments, trend analyses, and security incident reports; maintain accurate, systematic records
• Lead and support investigations into workplace violence incidents and security threats, documenting findings and driving risk mitigation
• Conduct vendor and customer vetting using intelligence platforms to assess risk and make recommendations based on your expertise in risk management best practices
• Drive strategic initiatives for the ASCC and broader AvSec organization, including developing new SOPs, assessment frameworks, reporting mechanisms, and process improvements that optimize cross-team efficacy
• Travel occasionally (less than 10% after initial training period)

The ideal candidate has proven experience supporting and growing intelligence, risk, or security programs. You will operate autonomously during your shifts, making decisions and solving problems where the business problem and solution may not be fully defined. At the same time, you must excel at cross-functional collaboration, ensuring smooth shift handovers, mentoring team members, and communicating effectively with operational partners and senior leadership. The ability to balance independent judgment with strong teamwork and mentoring is essential in this role.
Eligibility Qualifications
Due to the sensitive nature of this role, you must:
- Pass DHS, TSA and U.S. Customs and Border Protection security screenings
- Qualify for unescorted Airport SIDA (Security Identification Display Area) access
- Have no history of DOT drug/alcohol violations or test refusals
- Pass pre-employment drug testing
This is a safety-sensitive position requiring sound judgment to protect Amazon Air personnel, contractors, and cargo. You may be subject to ongoing drug and alcohol testing as required by DOT regulations. You may need to obtain and maintain a U.S. Government Secret security clearance for this role.


A day in the life
As an ASCC Manager, you're on the front lines of Amazon's global aviation security operations. No two days are the same, but here's what you can expect:
Your shift starts with intelligence gathering. You'll scan open-source intelligence platforms for emerging threats; geopolitical unrest, airspace closures, civil unrest, severe weather, anything that could impact Amazon Air routes, cargo operations, or Prime Air drone sites across the globe.
Then the real-time work begins. A customer needs vetting for a high-value cargo shipment to Latin America; you’ll apply your knowledge of risk assessment techniques, running them through our intelligence platforms, checking for sanctions, adverse media, and business risks, to evaluate and determine if the company should take on the shipment. A severe storm system is approaching a major hub; you'll monitor conditions, assess operational impacts, and coordinate with flight operations teams. A workplace violence incident occurs at a gateway; you'll conduct the investigation, document findings clearly, and prepare briefings for leadership.
Crisis response is where the stakes get high. When a security incident hits, a suspicious item flagged during security screening, a facility alarm, a geopolitical event affecting flight routes; you're part of the coordinated response. You'll lead Mitigation Calls and Incident Rooms, tracking action items, documenting decisions, and keeping stakeholders informed with real-time situation reports. Your analysis will inform go/no-go recommendations on flight routes.
Between incidents, you're supporting strategic initiatives. You'll contribute to risk assessments and security evaluations. You'll develop standard operating procedures that will be used across the network. You'll analyze trends from past incidents to identify systemic issues and recommend improvements to global processes and procedures.
Collaboration is constant. You'll coordinate with our Amazon Air Network Control Center on operational responses. You'll communicate with site operational leaders and field personnel regarding security matters. You'll partner with international teams to support cargo expansion into new countries. You'll provide field security teams with intelligence products and operational guidance.
This role demands sharp analytical skills, attention to detail, and the ability to shift seamlessly between tactical incident response and supporting strategic security planning. If you want a security role where your work directly impacts global operations every single day, this is it.

About the team
The Aviation Security Control Center (ASCC) is Amazon's 24/7 intelligence and operations hub protecting one of the world's fastest-growing air cargo networks and next-generation drone delivery operations, expanding rapidly into new markets across North America, Latin America, Europe, and Asia-Pacific.

As part of Amazon's Aviation Security (AvSec) organization, we're the first line of defense against threats to our aviation operations. Our team of security professionals work around the clock conducting intelligence analysis, managing crisis response, and executing security operations:

• Assess real-time threats to flight routes, cargo shipments, airport operations, and drone delivery sites across the globe
• Coordinate crisis response for security incidents affecting Amazon Air, Prime Air drone operations, and Amazon Air Cargo
• Investigate workplace violence incidents and security threats to aviation personnel and facilities, documenting findings and driving risk mitigation
• Vet high-risk customers and vendors using advanced intelligence platforms, and make recommendations based on your expertise in risk management best practices
• Monitor geopolitical events that could disrupt operations—from airspace closures to civil unrest
• Enable rapid expansion by conducting threat assessments for new routes, airports, and Prime Air launch sites

We leverage innovative technology: AI-powered screening, drone surveillance, automated vetting tools, to stay ahead of emerging threats while maintaining zero TSA/FAA enforcement actions across our network.

This isn't a typical security role. You'll collaborate across Amazon's security organizations (GSOC, Corporate Security, Physical Security) and partner with external agencies including TSA, FAA, and international aviation authorities. Your analysis is critical to go/no-go decisions on flight routes. You'll brief senior leaders during active incidents. And you'll help shape the future of aviation security at Amazon scale.

If you thrive in high-stakes, fast-paced environments where your analysis directly impacts global operations, we want to hear from you.

Basic qualifications

- Experience handling confidential information
- Experience working proactively and independently, meeting deadlines, and delivering on projects and tasks
- Experience in Incident Management, Threat Management, Corporate Investigations, Law Enforcement, Security Operations, Crisis Management or a related field
- Experience in intelligence analysis, critical incident management, commercial aviation, investigations, or drone operations
- Ability to work on defined risk projects, applying risk-management best practices and methodologies

Preferred qualifications

- 3+ years of program requirements definition and data and metrics leveraging to drive improvements experience
- Experience with research and investigation skills or equivalent
- Experience managing and coaching team members
- Project Management Professional (PMP) certification, or experience in project management
- - 5+ years of experience in security, intelligence, or risk management roles
- - 3+ years working in or supporting a security, intelligence, or emergency operations center
- - Experience managing a risk or intelligence program with cross-team scope
- - Bachelor’s degree or equivalent coursework in Intelligence, International Relations, Political Science, Criminal Justice, Crisis Management, or related field
- - Understanding of aviation security regulatory frameworks in the U.S. and globally
- - Air cargo operations experience (e.g., air carrier operations, cargo logistics, freight forwarding)
- - Military, intelligence community, law enforcement, or geopolitical risk analysis experience
- - All-source intelligence and OSINT collection experience
- - Active U.S. Government Secret or Top Secret security clearance
