descriptionHtml:
Alexa Japan Product owns the Alexa+ experience for customers in Japan. We work closely with product, engineering, applied science, business development, and marketing teams across Amazon to make sure Alexa+ works even better for Japan than it does in any other locale. The decisions you make will reach millions of customers across Japan.

Alexa+ is the next generation of Alexa, rebuilt on large language models. We are bringing it to customers in Japan, and this is a rare opportunity to shape how a world-class AI assistant works in one of the most demanding and quality-conscious markets.

We are looking for a Sr. Product Manager to own a core part of the Alexa+ experience in Japan. You will own the roadmap for your product area, decide what needs to be built and in what order, and hold the bar for what a good experience looks like for Japanese customers.

Part of holding that bar is defining it: you will build the test cases that specify how the product should behave across the range of things Japanese customers ask for. When something does not work, you will dig into it yourself — reproduce the issue, narrow down where it breaks, and work with engineers and scientists to scope the fix.

You will spend time on which problems are worth solving, how to solve them, and what is needed to convince the right stakeholders to invest. This role suits someone who is comfortable with ambiguity, fluent enough technically to hold their own in a design review, and native in Japanese. You do not need a background in linguistics or machine learning research. You do need strong product judgment and the willingness to get into technical and linguistic details.



Key job responsibilities

title: Meteorologist, WWOS Resilience
descriptionHtml:
Join an innovative team that delivers tailored products and services to protect our customers and business operations. The mission of Amazon World Wide Operations Security (WWOS) is to mitigate security and operational risks and impact to our associates, operations, assets, and brand.
Amazon is looking for a Meteorologist (London based) in support of our Global Risk and Resilience team.

The Meteorologist, a member of the WWOS Meteorology team, will be an individual contributor (IC) responsible for (1) producing tactical meteorological forecast products in support of logistics operations across the EU and Rest of the World (RoTW) regions; (2) providing weather briefing support to operations stakeholders during large-scale disruptive weather events; and (3) end-to-end management of complex weather-related projects that strategically impact Amazon's Life and Safety, Operations, and Brand.

In this role, you will proactively identify, analyse, and inform relevant weather and climate trends and translate customer requirements into scalable, actionable solutions. You will leverage OSINT, climate radar and satellite imagery, and tradecraft to identify emerging threats, and produce written and oral briefs that help customers anticipate risks and look around the corner.

The ideal candidate thrives in a fast-paced, dynamic environment that demands critical thinking, deep-dive analysis, and the ability to manage competing priorities with exceptional attention to detail. They bring a genuine passion for delighting customers, collaborating across teams, and continuously raising the bar, always seeking opportunities to refine processes, close gaps, and deliver more impactful products.

The successful candidate must have a proven record of effective leadership capabilities and demonstrate good judgment while under pressure. The candidate will also be expected to operate autonomously, use discretion when dealing with sensitive and critical information, and apply sound business principles and data analysis to identify problems and initiate actions to address them.
This position will occasionally require working outside of normal business hours.

Key job responsibilities
• Conduct comprehensive meteorological risk analysis using advanced forecasting techniques and meteorological data systems to identify potential impacts to Amazon's operations across EU and RoTW regions
• Collect, analyze, and interpret climate data, radar, and satellite imagery using statistical methods and impact models
• Proactively identify and analyze relevant threats and trends and produce written and oral briefs, in a cohesive and concise format, to serve customers across business lines
• Monitor, forecast, and effectively communicate weather, water, and climate hazards globally, providing real-time analysis and recommendations during dynamic weather-related incidents
• Provide meteorological subject matter expertise to leaders and operations stakeholders at all levels during large-scale weather events, including support to Business Continuity Management (BCM), crisis, and security management teams
• Incorporate government-issued weather and environmental alerts and warnings into tailored weather forecast products
• Analyse weather-related trends and patterns to identify long-term risks and opportunities for improved operations resilience
• Contribute to complex weather, climate, and environmental risk assessments that consider operational vulnerabilities, historical impact data, and seasonal weather patterns across diverse geographic regions
• Engage with internal customers to understand their priorities and requirements, and collaborate with global stakeholders to establish clear operational risk thresholds and escalation paths that protect people, operations, assets, and brand
• Contribute to the development and implementation of crisis management protocols and response procedures across multiple organizational levels
• Design and implement automated solutions to streamline threat monitoring, risk assessment, and notification processes
• Develop and/or maintain advanced weather monitoring systems and information dashboards to track potential threats to Amazon facilities and operations
• Train and advise teams across the organization on weather-related risk identification, preparation, and crisis management


A day in the life
A typical day starts with reviewing overnight Kepler forecasts and any government weather alerts that have come in across EU markets. If Umbrella's automated run has fired overnight, we confirm protections deployed correctly and check for silent failures or coverage gaps. On a quiet day, the focus shifts to protection efficiency analysis, SOP development, or progressing the quarterly rules review cycle. On a live day, it moves fast. WWOS Met delivers an activation recommendation, we stand up the SEM within 60 minutes, populate the tracker, pull lanes via PRECOG, schedule the call, and start coordinating across EUCX, NetOps, and site ops. Throughout the day there are ad-hoc protection requests from stakeholders, weather reporting to distribute, and the constant balancing act of protecting DEA without over-constraining speed. Tuesdays are WBR day, which means the pack needs to land by Monday EOD with the week's protection performance, attribution data, and any callouts. No two days look the same, but the thread that runs through all of it is the same question: are we protecting the right customers, in the right places, at the right time, without slowing down the network more than we need to.

About the team
WWOS Resilience (formerly BCM) is the operational continuity function within Worldwide Operations Security. For weather, the team owns the end-to-end governance of severe weather response across the EU network, from meteorological intelligence through to customer-facing delivery protection. This includes the Severe Event Management (SEM) lifecycle for weather-driven disruptions, automated and manual protection deployment through the Umbrella platform (UDD/promise pads, transit time pads, and capacity constraints), quarterly protection rules governance, proactive weather communications to CX and operational stakeholders, and site closure processes for life-threatening weather events. The team works in partnership with WWOS Met (who provide meteorological expertise and forecasting) and coordinates directly with EUCX, ATS CX, 3PCC Quality, AMZL, NetOps Control Tower, and ECFT/NFM to ensure weather-related delivery risk is identified early, protections are deployed proportionately, and customer delivery promises are maintained. The operating principle is simple: protect the customer without over-constraining the network.

Basic qualifications

- Knowledge of Microsoft Office products and applications at an advanced level
- Experience in compliance, audit or risk management
- Bachelor's degree or equivalent
- Experience with monitoring natural hazards, guiding critical incident response, and supporting supply chain decisions
- Degree in meteorology, atmospheric science, or a related field
- Experience with radar, forecasting software, and spatial data tools like Geographic Information Systems (GIS)

Preferred qualifications

- Experience leveraging technology and implementing lean principles / Six Sigma methodologies to drive process improvements or equivalent
- Master's degree or equivalent

title: Account Representative Intern, Early Career - 2027
descriptionHtml:
At Amazon, your career doesn’t follow a straight line. It accelerates, twists, and challenges you in ways you never expected. From the moment you join, you’re part of something big: building products or services that reach millions and shaping how people live, work, and connect every day. This is where your ideas turn into real impact.
You’ll work with world class tools, global platforms, and systems built to operate at an extraordinary scale. You’ll move fast, experiment and launch solutions that matter. With endless opportunities to explore across teams and roles, you’ll learn quickly, apply what you know and discover skills you didn’t know existed. This is an environment designed for builders who want to see the impact of their work in the world. Ready to start your adventure?

What’s in it for you?
An internship at Amazon means real responsibility from day one. You’ll build, test, and learn alongside people who want to see you succeed, while making an impact that reaches far beyond campus.


Key job responsibilities
Work backwards from the customer, identifying inputs to grow brands and improve their performance across Amazon's retail categories.

Support vendor managers and cross-functional teams — including in-stock, marketing, and category teams — to deliver business growth.

Build an understanding of customer pain points, requirements, and potential value that can be delivered through retail, advertising, or merchant services.

Identify target accounts using market data and industry intelligence, and learn the advertising or merchant services portfolio.

Collect, analyse, and review data to develop analytical and problem-solving skills, uncovering insights that drive business improvement.

Identify opportunities to improve products, services, processes, systems, and tools across the business.

Work with product teams and technical support teams to implement improvement projects.

A day in the life
Every day is a little different as an Account Representative Intern. Depending on your team, you might be supporting a vendor manager to grow a strategic brand within a retail category, helping account managers create compelling advertising presentations for clients, or driving new business growth across Amazon's third-party merchants. You might spend your morning analysing market data and customer insights to identify target accounts and growth opportunities, then spend your afternoon working with category or product teams to implement an improvement project.

Amazon is a customer-obsessed business, so no matter which team you join, part of your role will involve working backwards from the customer to understand their pain points and deliver value. You'll gain a deep understanding of Amazon's e-commerce retail business, advertising products, or merchant services portfolio, and partner across functions to deliver results — building your analytical, commercial, and stakeholder management skills in a dynamic, fast-paced environment.

Note: You must have the right to work in the country of employment by the start date.

About the team
At Amazon Marketplace, we take pride in enabling all our Selling Partners to be successful – whether they’re a small business or a global corporation. We provide durable solutions to promote their products and increase their sales through a great shopping experience.

As a Sales & Account Representative intern, you will be part of one of our Marketplace teams (Global Selling, New Seller Recruitment, Existing Seller Management, Amazon Pay, etc.) that identify, establish and support Selling Partners on the Amazon platform to help them thrive.

Intern Community:
As an Amazon Intern, you'll be part of a dynamic, supportive community that empowers your growth and development. You'll collaborate with interns from around the world, networking and participating in social events to broaden your perspectives. You can also join specialized groups focused on areas like sustainability to explore your diverse interests.

Support:
The internship program provides a robust support system, including weekly intern office hours, dedicated IT and HR support, and a program team committed to your success. This ensures you have the guidance and assistance needed to thrive.

Learning Sessions:
Exclusive learning sessions will further enhance your skills, granting you access to Amazon's industry-leading learning platforms and the expertise of industry leaders. These structured development opportunities will prepare you for the next step in your career.

Opportunities:
Upon successful completion of the internship, you may be considered for a graduate role or a second internship, allowing you to continue your journey with Amazon. Additionally, you'll enjoy a competitive monthly salary, relocation support, and access to a range of employee benefits.

Internship Start Dates across the year:
We are hiring interns to start anytime from January through September 2027. Each month, we'll hold 1-2 onboarding days for new hires.

NOTE: Pleas submit your CV in English

Basic qualifications

- Currently in your final year and working towards a university bachelor’s or master’s in Engineering, Commerce, Business administration or similar field
- Speak, write, and read fluently in English and Italian at C1 level or above

title: Applied Scientist, Amazon Compliance and Safety Services
descriptionHtml:
Amazon's Compliance and Safety Services (CoSS) Team is looking for a smart and creative Applied Scientist to apply and extend state-of-the-art research in NLP, multi-modal modeling, domain adaptation, continuous learning and large language model to join the Applied Science team. At Amazon, we are working to be the most customer-centric company on earth. Millions of customers trust us to ensure a safe shopping experience. This is an exciting and challenging position to drive research that will shape new ML solutions for product compliance and safety around the globe in order to achieve best-in-class, company-wide standards around product assurance.

You will research on large amounts of tabular, textual, and product image data from product detail pages, selling partner details and customer feedback, evaluate state-of-the-art algorithms and frameworks, and develop new algorithms to improve safety and compliance mechanisms. You will partner with engineers, technical program managers and product managers to design new ML solutions implemented across the entire Amazon product catalog.

- Research and Evaluate state-of-the-art algorithms in NLP, multi-modal modeling, domain adaptation, continuous learning and large language model.

- Design and plan collection of new labels and audit mechanisms to develop better approaches that will further improve product assurance and customer trust.
- Analyze and convey results to stakeholders and contribute to the research and product roadmap.

title: Software Development Engineer, Tax Engine Services
descriptionHtml:
You'll work on one of the world's largest transactional distributed systems, solving complex tax calculation challenges that impact millions of customers globally. Join a team building mission-critical services that process millions of requests per minute while maintaining accuracy and compliance across constantly evolving global tax regulations.

Imagine building systems that power tax calculations for every Amazon transaction worldwide—from physical goods to digital services. In this role, you'll tackle the intricate challenge of computing correct tax amounts thousands of times per second while ensuring audit compliance across dozens of countries. You'll collaborate with peers across Amazon's business to design and operate highly scalable, reliable systems that handle hundreds of millions of records. Whether you're drawn to solving complex distributed systems problems or using technology to address real business challenges, this is an opportunity to make a tangible impact on a platform that touches billions of transactions annually.

Key job responsibilities
- Design and implement scalable software solutions that calculate taxes accurately and efficiently across Amazon's global operations, handling millions of service requests per minute
- Collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand business requirements and translate them into technical solutions that meet tax compliance standards worldwide
- Develop, test, and deploy high-quality distributed system software using software engineering best practices and modern development methodologies
- Participate in the full software development lifecycle, including design reviews, code reviews, documentation, testing, and operational support of production systems
- Contribute to system reliability and performance by monitoring production metrics, identifying optimization opportunities, and implementing improvements to ensure our services meet demanding scale and accuracy requirements


A day in the life
As a Software Development Engineer on our team, you'll engage with the full software development lifecycle—from initial design conversations through deployment and operations. You might start your day reviewing a proposal to optimize tax calculation performance, then move into code review with teammates, discussing architectural approaches to handle increased transaction volume. You'll write and test code in our Java, Linux, and Oracle-based environment, collaborate with engineers across different Amazon business units to understand their tax requirements, and participate in on-call rotations to ensure our services remain reliable. Your work directly influences how quickly and accurately customers receive tax information at checkout, and you'll see the real-world impact of your contributions through our monitoring and metrics.

About the team
We are a group of engineers committed to building and maintaining the tax platform that serves as the backbone for tax compliance across Amazon's global operations. Our team values technical depth, collaborative problem-solving, and a shared commitment to operational excellence. We work closely with business stakeholders, finance teams, and engineers across Amazon to understand evolving tax requirements and translate them into scalable solutions. We're focused on staying ahead of complex, ever-changing global tax regulations while continuously improving system performance and reliability. When you join us, you'll work alongside talented engineers who are passionate about distributed systems, take ownership of their work, and support one another in solving challenging problems. We're building the future of tax technology at scale, and we're excited to have you contribute your skills and perspective to this mission.

Basic qualifications

- 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
- 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
- Experience programming with at least one software programming language

Preferred qualifications

- 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
- Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

title: Senior Mechanical Engineer, Manipulation Robotics
descriptionHtml:
Manipulation robots increasingly need to execute contact-rich grasping within cluttered containers, requiring compliant mechanisms that grip a wide range of items securely without damaging them. At Amazon, our end effectors must also survive continuous, high-cycle contact in facilities that run around the clock. Given the scale of our operations, these mechanisms must be simple to manufacture, deploy, and support. We are looking for a Senior Mechanical Engineer to own compliant grasping mechanisms and end-of-arm tooling from concept through production, with reliability, fatigue life, and serviceability designed in from the start.

The Manipulation Robotics team develops robotic workcells to pick, grasp, and move millions of items and packages across Amazon's fulfillment network. You will own these mechanisms end to end, and work closely with our scientists and controls engineers so the gripper's mechanical behavior is designed as part of the control strategy. These designs are judged over millions of cycles in the field, not on a first article that works in the lab.

Key job responsibilities
- Own the mechanical design of compliant mechanisms and end-of-arm tooling from concept through scale production, including sustaining support once fielded. Apply judgment about where to design for reuse and extension across applications.
- Design for high-cycle reliability, using fatigue analysis, tolerance stack-up, material selection, and failure-avoidance methods (DFMEA/PFMEA, fault-tree analysis).
- Guide a team of engineers to produce mechanisms that are serviceable, producible, and cost-effective at fleet volumes. This includes field-replaceable or modular designs, design for manufacturability and assembly, and GD&T.
- Characterize the mechanical behavior and response of compliant mechanisms, producing representative models that other disciplines can design against.
- Take designs through the full hardware cycle: requirements definition, CAD modeling, analysis, prototyping, design reviews, detailed drawings, supplier selection, verification, and production ramp.
- Partner with suppliers and contract manufacturers to select the right processes for high-volume production.
- Define durability and reliability validation for components and full mechanisms, in partnership with test engineering.
- Root-cause field failures and feed them back into design, creating mechanisms that prevent the same issue from recurring across programs.
- Mentor and develop other engineers, and raise the standard through design review and technical assessment.

A day in the life
Amazon offers a full range of benefits to support you and eligible family members, including domestic partners and children. Benefits can vary by location, the number of regularly scheduled hours you work, length of employment, and job status such as seasonal or temporary employment. The benefits that generally apply to regular, full-time employees include:
1. Medical, Dental, and Vision Coverage
2. Maternity and Parental Leave Options
3. Paid Time Off (PTO)
4. 401(k) Plan

If you are not sure that every qualification on the list above describes you exactly, we'd still love to hear from you! At Amazon, we value people with unique backgrounds, experiences, and skillsets. If you’re passionate about this role and want to make an impact on a global scale, please apply!

About the team
We are a small, high-ownership team building robotic workcells, from early-stage R&D through products fielded 24/7 in Amazon fulfillment centers. We work at the hard edge of grasping: contact-rich tasks, deformable and variable items, and mechanisms that must survive millions of cycles at fleet scale. Our people own problems end to end, and scientists work shoulder to shoulder with mechanical, electrical, software, and controls engineers in a fast-moving, highly empowered environment where research ideas turn into shipped systems.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in mechanical engineering or equivalent
- 7+ years of mechanical design experience taking electromechanical products from concept through scale production
- Extensive experience designing mechanisms that integrate actuators, sensors, and moving assemblies
- Proficiency with 3D CAD and 2D detailed drawings, including GD&T (ASME Y14.5).
- Extensive experience designing for manufacturability and assembly, and tolerance analysis.
- Experience with failure-avoidance and reliability methods such as DFMEA/PFMEA and fault-tree analysis.

Preferred qualifications

- Experience designing compliant, underactuated, or adaptive grasping mechanisms.
- Experience designing for high-cycle fatigue life and field serviceability, including modular or replaceable tooling.
- Modeling fluency for control use, including linear/non-linear FEA and low-order or pseudo-rigid-body models of compliant mechanisms.
- Experience with end-of-arm tooling, grippers, or custom mechanical interfaces for robotic systems.
- Experience owning designs from new-product introduction into sustaining engineering for fielded, high-utilization products.
- Familiarity with actuator selection and drivetrain design for compact mechanisms.

title: Program Manager II, Amazon Customs and Trade, Amazon Customs and Trade
descriptionHtml:
Are you excited by the idea of building financial systems that power global trade? As Amazon Customs and Trade (ACT) expands its global reach and technology product portfolio, it needs billing infrastructure that can keep pace with onboarding new customers across markets. We are looking for a Program Manager to own end-to-end financial automation and compliance program delivery across our customs finance operations. This role sits at the intersection of Finance, Tax, Accounting, Compliance, and Engineering, translating upstream product decisions into correctly configured, operationally ready financial systems that enable accounts payable (AP) and accounts receivable (AR) payment flows with vendors, ports of entry, and government entities worldwide.

You will manage a cross-functional program independently, own all program communication, and drive timely decisions across partner teams. The configuration work you deliver is the on/off switch for Amazon's ability to bill, collect revenue, make vendor payments, and meet financial obligations to government and legal entities. A misconfigured charge code means invoices do not generate, disbursements do not clear, and government fees go unremitted. If you thrive in high-stakes, detail-oriented environments where your work has immediate and measurable financial impact, this role is for you.

Key job responsibilities

- Lead the financial readiness lifecycle from intake through post-launch stabilization, ensuring no incomplete or non-compliant work reaches engineering and coordinating user acceptance testing (UAT) to validate system behavior before launch.
- Drive AP and AR automation execution across multiple regions in partnership with Accounting, Tax, and billing engine teams, and set up performance indicators where none exist.
- Manage onboarding of new trading partners and broker billing model migrations, including net-new legal entity standup, working with Finance, Compliance, and Engineering stakeholders to meet regulatory and financial obligations.
- Own the charge code, company code, and Standard Carrier Alpha Code (SCAC) configuration pipeline across ACT finance systems by sequencing intake, managing prioritization, and driving requests to completion.
- Build and improve program mechanisms that scale, including intake systems, SLA frameworks, handoff protocols, and measurement infrastructure to increase delivery predictability and reduce manual work.

A day in the life
You join recurring syncs with Engineering, Finance, Tax, and Accounting teams to align on open work-streams and unblock dependencies. You typically check of the configuration pipeline, triaging new intake requests and re-prioritizing based on urgency. Much of your work is proactive and roadmap-driven: you plan configuration sequences, prepare financial readiness gates for upcoming launches, and build playbooks that keep delivery on track. You also carve out heads-down time to refine intake mechanisms, analyze root causes of post-launch defects, and document process improvements. Along the way, you collaborate closely with fellow program managers to share context and coordinate across parallel efforts.

About the team
Amazon Customs and Trade (ACT) is a team of program and product managers building the customs brokerage and financial infrastructure that powers Amazon's cross-border trade operations. Our mission is to make it easy for customers to meet the regulatory requirements of international goods movement while delivering value through transparent and predictable services. As ACT expands its global footprint, you will gain deep expertise in how financial automation is applied to cross-border trade, growing your skills at the convergence of finance, compliance, and technology. We are a collaborative group that values creative problem-solving, and we are excited to welcome someone who wants to help shape the future of global trade at Amazon.

Basic qualifications

- 3+ years of program or project management experience
- 3+ years of defining and implementing process improvement initiatives using data and metrics experience
- Knowledge of Excel (Pivot Tables, VLookUps) at an advanced level and SQL
- Experience using data and metrics to determine and drive improvements
- Experience working cross functionally with tech and non-tech teams

Preferred qualifications

- 3+ years of driving end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership experience
- 3+ years of driving process improvements experience
- Experience in stakeholder management, dealing with multiple stakeholders at varied levels of the organization
- Experience building processes, project management, and schedules

title: Applied Scientist II, Cross Border Science and Analytics
descriptionHtml:
The Cross-Border (XB) Science & Analytics team is at the heart of Amazon's international marketplace expansion, powering science-driven solutions that enable customers across 20+ countries to discover and purchase products seamlessly across borders. Our work directly impacts millions in annualized business value through ML models, algorithms, and data-driven systems that solve some of Amazon's most complex cross-border challenges.

We are a lean, high-impact team of scientists working across various programs spanning search ranking, demand forecasting, pricing optimization, product recommendations, language understanding, and generative AI. We partner closely with product, engineering, and business teams across Amazon's global retail organization to take science from ideation to production at scale.

Key job responsibilities
We are looking for a passionate and technically strong Applied Scientist to join our team. In this role, you will design, develop, and deploy machine learning models and algorithms that directly improve the cross-border shopping experience for millions of Amazon customers worldwide. You will work on challenging, ambiguous problems—from improving search relevance across languages to building ML-powered pricing and recommendation systems—with significant autonomy and end-to-end ownership.

This is a hands-on, high-visibility role. You will publish your research internally and externally, collaborate with world-class scientists and engineers, and see your work go live across Amazon's global marketplaces.

A day in the life
Research & Experimentation

Analyze large-scale datasets to identify patterns, formulate hypotheses, and design experiments

Develop and iterate on ML models (deep learning, NLP, ranking, causal inference) to improve cross-border product discovery, relevance, and conversion

Design and run A/B experiments on live traffic to measure model impact against business and customer metrics

Building & Shipping

Write production-quality code (Python, Java/Scala) and work with SDEs to deploy models into real-time and batch inference pipelines

Build end-to-end ML pipelines—from data ingestion and feature engineering to training, evaluation, and online serving

Own model monitoring, performance debugging, and iterative improvements post-launch

Collaboration & Communication

Participate in weekly science syncs, design reviews, and cross-functional standups with product managers, engineers, and business stakeholders

Translate business problems into well-defined science problems, and communicate results and trade-offs to both technical and non-technical audiences

Contribute to technical documentation—architecture wikis, experiment write-ups, and model cards

Growth & Community

Present at internal ML paper reading sessions and science forums

Stay current with state-of-the-art research (NeurIPS, ICLR, ACL, KDD) and bring new ideas to the team

Mentor junior scientists and interns; participate in hiring interviews and debriefs

Publish findings in top-tier venues and file patents where applicable

- PhD, or Master's degree
- Experience in patents or publications at top-tier peer-reviewed conferences or journals
- Experience programming in Java, C++, Python or related language
- Experience in any of the following areas: algorithms and data structures, parsing, numerical optimization, data mining, parallel and distributed computing, high-performance computing

title: Buyer - Central Sourcing, Global Tail Sourcing
descriptionHtml:
As a member of the Global Procurement Central Services (GPCS) Sourcing team, you will drive proactive procurement initiatives specializing in unmanaged spend analysis, catalog expansion, and process improvement / automation opportunity identification. While supporting reactive sourcing as needed, your primary focus will be identifying and executing opportunities to reduce unmanaged spend under GPO (Global Procurement Organization) coverage, developing automation proposals to improve team efficiency. You will leverage AI-powered tools and analytical platforms to uncover spend patterns, build business cases for process improvements, and lead implementation of scalable solutions. This role supports operations across APAC (Asia-Pacific), NA (North America), and EMEA (Europe, Middle East & Africa) customer requirements.

Key job responsibilities
Lead proactive analysis of unmanaged and free text spend data to identify high-value catalog expansion opportunities — developing actionable recommendations, building business cases, and driving implementation to reduce non-compliant purchasing across regions.

Identify, propose, and implement automation opportunities within the sourcing workflow — evaluating where AI-powered tools (e.g., automated RFQ (Request for Quotation) generation, intelligent vendor matching, autonomous quote reading) can replace manual processes, reduce cycle times, and improve output quality.

Ensure alignemnt with Category Management teams on sourcing strategies for recurring spend categories, leverage preferred supplier frameworks, and expand catalog coverage to redirect free text spend into compliant / efficient channels.

Execute end-to-end competitive sourcing events for opportunities identified through proactive analysis — managing multi-supplier negotiations, evaluating total cost of ownership, and awarding to optimal suppliers.

Develop and present spend insights, automation proposals, and process improvement recommendations to leadership — using data visualization and analytical platforms to communicate impact and prioritize initiatives.

Ensure adherence to Amazon's Global Spending and Transaction Policy (GSTP) and comply with GPO procurement policies, procedures, and payment terms standards. Serve as a compliance reference point for junior team members.

Build and maintain strong stakeholder relationships with business requesters, Category Management, Site Procurement Operations (SPO), external suppliers, and cross-functional partners — proactively aligning on sourcing strategies and resolving escalated procurement challenges.

Drive delivery of key performance metrics (KPIs) including catalog coverage expansion, spend under management growth, automation adoption rates, savings opportunities, and compliance rates.

A day in the life
You'll start your day reviewing spend analytics dashboards — identifying patterns in unmanaged spend, tracking progress on catalog expansion initiatives, and prioritizing opportunities by impact. You'll develop proposals for running sourcing events to increase Procurement coverage as well as proposing new automation workflows, AI tool configurations, and present findings to your manager on where technology can eliminate manual steps. Throughout the day, you'll partner with business stakeholders to understand upcoming procurement needs, and work on building compliant sourcing solutions that prevent free text purchases before they happen (reducing unmanaged spend and reactive sourcing efforts).

About the team
The Global Procurement Central Services (GPCS) Sourcing team sits within the Global Procurement Organization (GPO) and operates as a centralized sourcing function for Amazon's worldwide operations. We take on central sourcing opportunities, providing scalable, standardized procurement execution across categories and regions. Operating from three hubs — Barcelona (Spain), San José (Costa Rica), and Hyderabad (India) — we deliver follow-the-sun coverage across NA, EMEA, LATAM, and APAC. Our team processes thousands of purchase requisitions monthly, conducts competitive sourcing events, and drives catalog expansion to deliver savings, compliance, and spend under management. We are actively scaling AI-powered automation and autonomous sourcing technologies to transform how centralized procurement is executed at Amazon.

Basic qualifications

- Speak, write, and read fluently in English
- Experience in Finance, Supply Chain Management, Business, IT or any other procurement related career
- Comfort with technology adoption and willingness to work with AI-powered tools and automation platforms

Preferred qualifications

- Hands-on experience developing procurement or business process automations using AI-powered coding assistants, scripting, or workflow automation platforms

descriptionHtml:
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

Logistics Specialists play a vital role in the success of Amazon Web Services by providing the right part, in the right place at the right time. Your contribution to this success would be maintaining the onsite parts room in AWS Data Centers, by managing the custody of computer hardware through their entire lifecycle. This involves receiving parts, safely storing parts, picking and delivering parts to hardware technicians, cycle counts, and shipping faulty hardware back to the vendor.

You will work closely with Data Centre Operations and Engineering teams to ensure reliable functioning and repair activities to support our customers, while adhering to our operational tenants of safety, security and availability.

Key job responsibilities
- Maintaining inventory to ensure that proper stock levels are managed to support build and repair activities.
- Physically receiving and issuing out of parts as needed for internal customers.
- Loading, unloading and transporting parts between different sites.
- Keeping accurate stock records for all items within our care through physical cycle counts.
- Maintaining the safety, organization, and cleanliness of all workspaces using Amazon 7S principles
Travel:
- The role may require the successful candidate to travel to other sites in the in the Melbourne metro area to assist in conducting cycle counts, receiving stock into the inventory control system, replenishing stock and returning defective stock. Travel between sites will require own transport, all travel related costs will be reimbursed.

- Amazon Operates with a principle of safety first. With this principle, we take significant care to ensure all employees operate in a safe manner and have appropriate tools to support them in undertaking their roles safely. The activities below are required with the safety principle applied.
- Loading and unloading shipments.
- Standing, sitting, and walking (including stairs) for prolonged periods of time.
- Willing and able to frequently push, pull, squat, bend and kneel.
- Reach and stretch to position equipment and fixtures while maintaining balance.
- Push or pull heavy objects of up to 16kg into position and participate in group lifts of 20kg or more.
- Coordinate body movements when using tools or equipment.
- Work with and/or around moving mechanical parts.
- Work in an office and warehouse environment where the noise level is low to moderate.

The MEL Data Center Logistics team, supports infrastructure deployment across Melbourne's data center cluster. Our culture is built on ownership, continuous learning, and bias for action. We've developed a structured training program that accelerates on boarding and equips new members to contribute quickly. Operating across multiple MEL sites, we embrace start-up challenges as opportunities to build scalable processes. Our work directly enables AWS to serve millions of customers worldwide.

title: Sr Process Safety Engineer, Global Process Safety Engineering, Workplace Health & Safety
descriptionHtml:
The Workplace Health and Safety Technical Solutions Team seeks an accomplished Senior Process Safety Engineer to lead global initiatives in Process Safety Management (PSM) and Process Safety Engineering. In this high-impact role, you will ensure compliance with international, regional, and local regulations for highly hazardous chemical (HHC) processes across Amazon’s facilities worldwide. You will play a key role in designing, constructing, and operating projects involving alternative energy sources and HHC, strictly adhering to Recognized and Generally Accepted Good Engineering Practices (RAGAGEP).

This position demands deep expertise in Center for Chemical Process Safety (CCPS) Risk-Based Process Safety (RBPS) principles, coupled with comprehensive knowledge of regulatory compliance standards, including OSHA PSM and EPA RMP (North America), the Seveso Directive (Europe), and emerging regulations in the Asia-Pacific region. As a strategic partner to technical, operational, and leadership teams, you will drive improvements in global process safety performance while fostering a robust safety culture throughout the organization.

This role also involves shaping the engineering vision and strategy to ensure consistency in managing process safety risks across Worldwide (WW) Operations, focusing strongly on hydrogen fuel usage, emerging green alternative energy sources and its associated safety considerations. You will collaborate with diverse teams to implement a systematic, scalable approach to risk identification, mitigation, and management.

Key job responsibilities
- Risk Management and Hazard Analysis: Lead or facilitate comprehensive PHAs such as HAZOP, LOPA, and FMEA across global operations. Oversee the development of risk mitigation strategies and ensure the timely execution of corrective measures.
- Risk Evaluation and Collaboration: Evaluate process safety risks, recommend effective controls, and coordinate the development of comprehensive process safety information.
- Regulatory Compliance and RAGAGEP Integration: Ensure compliance with global safety regulations, including OSHA PSM, EPA RMP, Seveso Directive, and equivalent standards, while applying Recognized and Generally Accepted Good Engineering Practices (RAGAGEP) across HHC sites globally.
- Governance and Framework Development: Develop and maintain a robust RBPS governance framework, including tools and processes that foster standardization and continuous improvement.
- Alternative Energy Process Safety: Serve as a subject matter expert in alternative energy technologies, including hydrogen, biofuels, carbon capture, and thermal systems. Drive the safe design, commissioning, and operation of these systems in collaboration with external partners and internal teams.
- Global Process Safety Management (PSM) Oversight: Spearhead the design, implementation, and continuous enhancement of global PSM systems, ensuring consistency with CCPS RBPS pillars, local regulations, corporate standards, and industry best practices.
- Performance Monitoring and Reporting: Define, track, and analyze key performance indicators (KPIs) aligned with CCPS guidance and corporate objectives. Deliver regular updates to senior leadership, highlighting progress, risks, and strategic recommendations.
- Tool Development for Compliance: Create and implement tools to ensure compliance with OSHA PSM requirements, including conducting PHAs for hazard identification, analysis, and prioritization.
- Training and Mentorship: Develop and deliver training programs on process safety topics, fostering a culture of continuous learning. Establish and report process safety metrics and share best practices across the organization.
- Leadership and Organizational Development: Provide technical mentorship to regional and site teams to build process safety expertise throughout the organization. Collaborate with cross-functional teams (Engineering, Operations, Maintenance, Procurement) to embed safety in every phase of the asset lifecycle.
- Incident Investigation and Audit Leadership: Lead or actively participate in incident investigations, risk assessments, and EHS self-assessments or audits to identify root causes and implement corrective actions.
- Workplace Health and Safety (WHS) Support: Support WHS programs and systems across the organization, including readiness to respond to emergencies when required.

A day in the life
Amazon offers a full range of benefits that support you and eligible family members, including domestic partners and their children. Benefits can vary by location, the number of regularly scheduled hours you work, length of employment, and job status such as seasonal or temporary employment.

The benefits that generally apply to regular, full-time employees include:
- Medical, Dental, and Vision Coverage
- Maternity and Parental Leave Options
- Paid Time Off (PTO)
- 401(k) Plan  

If you are not sure that every qualification on the list above describes you exactly, we'd still love to hear from you!

At Amazon, we value people with unique backgrounds, experiences, and skillsets. If you’re passionate about this role and want to make an impact on a global scale, please apply!

About the team
Our Mission: The Global PSE team’s mission is to ensure the safe design and reliable operation of facilities that contain or use Highly Hazardous Chemicals (HHCs) by adopting prevention through design methodology. Our mission is to provide the necessary support so Amazon can achieve the 2040 Climate Pledge responsibly and in a manner that safeguards the safety of our associates and the community at large.

Program Strategy: The team’s focus is on building a safety program that reduces the HHC risks at Amazon to as low as reasonably possible. To do so, we are working to establish process safety frameworks for our HHC processes: (1)Technology – Process Safety Information, Process Hazard Analysis (PHA), Safe work practices (2) Facilities – Mechanical Integrity, Pre-Start-up Safety Reviews, Management of Change (MOC) (3) Personnel – Process Safety Training, Process Safety Incident Investigations (4) Audit and Assurance – Monitor program performance and maturation

Basic qualifications

- Experience in developing functional specifications, design verification plans and functional test procedures
- Experience with fire and building codes and standards, including the National Fire Protection Association (NFPA), National Electrical Code (NEC), FM Global standards, International Fire Code (IFC) and the Comprehensive International Building Code (IBC)
- Bachelor's Degree in Chemical or Process safety Engineering
- 6+ years of Process safety engineering experience while working in Manufacturing industry with design, installation and commissioning.
- Skilled in identifying and evaluating risk across Amazon's HHC infrastructure with the aid of P&ID.
- 6+ years of experience in conducting PHA along with LOPA and FMEA with the aid of tolls like PHA Pro, PHA works etc,.
- Experience working on consequence modeling, quantitative risk analysis and dispersion analysis, specifically PHAST, ALOHA, FLACS, or equivalent
- Demonstrated experience of working with Safety Instrumented Systems engineering, including SIL determination, SIF specification, and IEC 61511 application
- Experience of working with Relief system design, including overpressure scenario development, PSV sizing, and API 521 application

Preferred qualifications

- Masters Degree in Chemical or Process safety engineering
- 10 + years of leadership experience in chemical, mechanical, electrical, or process safety engineering roles within the chemical, energy, or oil and gas sectors.
- Extensive expertise in Process Hazard Analysis (PHA) methodologies, including HAZOP, LOPA, FMEA, and FTA, with strong proficiency in process safety software and Mechanical integrity evaluation including API 510/570/653 and ASME BPVC Section VIII.
- 10+ years of experience with incident investigation methodologies such as Apollo, Tap Root, and Root Cause Analysis (RCA), complemented by expertise in auditing practices.
- Experience with the interpretation and application of global regulatory frameworks, including OSHA PSM, EPA RMP, Seveso Directive/COMAH, and equivalent standards.
- Experience of working with Alternative energy systems including hydrogen, ammonia, biofuels, and Battery Energy Storage
- Experience in developing and implementing foundational elements of Process Safety Management Systems (PSMS) in accordance with Recognized and Generally Accepted Good Engineering Practices (RAGAGEP).
- Skilled with Control system architecture review covering DCS, PLC, and ESD, Alarm management
- Demonstrated experience of Facility siting and occupied building assessment per API 752/753

title: Principal Solutions Architect - High-Tech, Electronics & Semiconductor, Hi-Tech Electronics and Semiconductor
locations: East Palo Alto, CA, United States
descriptionHtml:
We are seeking a Principal Solutions Architect to serve as the senior technical leader for a portfolio of AWS's largest and most strategic semiconductor customers. In this role, you will operate at the intersection of **Electronic Design Automation (EDA)** and **Generative AI**, partnering with C-suite and engineering leadership at the world's leading chip designers, foundries, and semiconductor IP companies to shape and accelerate their cloud transformation.

This is a builder-facing, customer-obsessed role. You will not just advise — you will architect the reference patterns, influence the AWS product roadmap, and mentor a community of Solutions Architects across the segment. Your success will be measured first and foremost by **customer outcomes**: the business problems you help solve, the workloads you help move to and optimize on AWS, and the measurable impact your customers realize.

Key job responsibilities
### Customer Impact & Outcomes

- Own the senior technical relationship for several of the largest semiconductor accounts, translating each customer's business objectives (faster tape-outs, reduced design cycle time, cost-per-wafer efficiency, time-to-market) into AWS architectures and adoption plans.

- Lead high-stakes technical engagements from discovery through production, keeping the customer's business outcome as the primary framing lens for every recommendation.

- Serve as the trusted advisor to VP/CTO-level stakeholders, earning the right to influence multi-year technology strategy.


### EDA Domain Leadership

- Architect and optimize large-scale **EDA workloads** on AWS — front-end (logic/RTL simulation, synthesis, verification) and back-end (place-and-route, physical verification, timing/signoff) flows at scale.

- Guide customers on high-throughput HPC design, elastic compute (Spot/On-Demand fleets), high-performance shared storage (FSx for Lustre, NFS appliances), scheduler integration (LSF, Slurm), and license optimization for EDA tools (Synopsys, Cadence, Siemens EDA).

- Advise on Graviton adoption for EDA tooling, cost/performance benchmarking, and hybrid burst-to-cloud patterns.


### Generative AI Leadership

- Help semiconductor customers apply **Generative AI** to their business — from design assistants, RTL/verification copilots, and knowledge-mining across design data, to GenAI-accelerated documentation, test generation, and yield/manufacturing analytics.

- Architect production GenAI solutions on **Amazon Bedrock**, agentic patterns (AgentCore), model customization, RAG over proprietary design data, and responsible-AI guardrails.

- Establish reference architectures that bridge EDA and GenAI (e.g., LLM-assisted design workflows) and evangelize them across the segment.


### Technical Influence & Scale

- Operate with **organization-wide (org+) influence** — your architectures, mechanisms, and thought leadership should scale beyond your accounts to the broader HTES segment and AWS field.

- Create reusable assets: reference architectures, whitepapers, workshops, and internal enablement that raise the technical bar for the entire SA team.

- Represent the voice of the semiconductor customer to AWS service teams; influence the product roadmap for EDA and GenAI capabilities.

- Mentor and develop SAs across the segment, contributing to hiring, calibration, and technical community-building.

Basic qualifications

- 10+ years of specific technology domain areas (e.g. software development, cloud computing, systems engineering, infrastructure, security, networking, data & analytics) experience
- Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, mathematics or equivalent
- Experience developing technology solutions and evangelising end-to-end technology roadmaps that guide IT transformations toward cloud computing
- Experience communicating across technical and non-technical audiences and at C-level, including training, workshops, publications

Preferred qualifications

- Knowledge of distributed systems design and implementation or equivalent
- Knowledge of large scale automation and workflow management or equivalent
- Knowledge of database design and implementation or equivalent
- Knowledge of presentations and whiteboarding skills with a high degree of comfort speaking with internal and external executives, IT management, and developers
- Experience architecting, migrating, transforming or modernizing customer requirements to the cloud
- Deep hands-on experience architecting large-scale HPC and/or EDA workloads (semiconductor design, verification, or manufacturing compute).
- Demonstrated expertise designing and deploying **Generative AI** solutions in production (LLMs, RAG, agentic systems, model customization).

descriptionHtml:

title: Pharmacy Technician, Fulfillment - Amazon Pharmacy
descriptionHtml:
Innovation is at the core of what we do. We believe that by removing and reducing the barriers that prevent people from taking their medications, we can help customers conveniently get the medications they need, when they need them and take them as prescribed. We have provided customers with the ability to find transparent and simple pricing, receive 24/7 customer service support, and have their meds delivered to their doorsteps while creating programs and products that embody our mission and position ourselves in becoming the world’s safest and fastest online pharmacy.

We are looking for a Pharmacy Technician to join us on our journey to make it drastically easier for customers to find, choose, afford, and engage with the services, products, and professionals they need to get and stay healthy! An active instate pharmacy technician license is required to be considered.

#everydaybetter


Key job responsibilities
• Assist pharmacist in filling prescription items, as permitted by the state board of pharmacy

• Maintain a safe and clean pharmacy by complying with procedures, rules and regulations

• Work daily with Leadership to ensure the right medications are put in the right packets

• Run automated machinery required to pre-sort and package medications

• Fill exception trays with appropriate medication

• Transition Amazon Pharmacy orders through different workflow stages from initial dispense through quality control

• Count and fill prescription vials and affix labels on bulk prescription items

• Pack and ship completed orders including printing and affixing appropriate labels on dispenser, shipping boxes

• Sort and triage the right boxes to ship at the right time

• Aid the distribution manager and distribution pharmacists with receiving, shipping, counting, and packing

• Clean, and help maintain, equipment and work areas

• Package medications for dispensing and for delivery

• Work a flexible schedule - shifts will possibly start and end outside of normal business hours

Physical Requirements:
• During shifts last up to 12 hours (standard full-time shifts are 10 hours excluding overtime, flex and part-time shifts may vary):

• Standing, bending, reaching above the head, kneeling, crouching and/or stretching

• Lifting and moving products up to 49 lbs in weight

• Manual dexterity of hands and wrists



A day in the life
Career Growth: Join the team that will be taking pharmacy to the next level. Many of our technicians have developed into Trainers, Team Leads, and Managers. The opportunities are endless!

Earn More: Eligibility for a pay increases every 6 months through our Employee Step Plan Program

Non Retail Environment: Enjoy casual dress code and non-retail environment that the pharmacy has to offer

Amazon employee discount

Amazon Health Benefits: Medical, Vision, and Dental benefits start when you do - Inclusive of domestic partners and children

Paid Time Off begins accruing immediately

401(k) Savings Plan with match

Basic qualifications

- High school diploma or equivalent
- Active and unrestricted in-state Board of Pharmacy License or ability to obtain a Pharmacy Technician
- License through the State Board of Pharmacy, if required by State Board of Pharmacy
- 6+ months of experience working with computer and web based tools
- Ability to communicate effectively with coworkers and supervisor. Ability to read and understand English language labelling on product cartons and prescription labels.

Preferred qualifications

- National Pharmacy technician Certification (PTCB or NHA)
- Demonstrated ability to work as an effective team member
- Demonstrated organization skills and attention to detail
- Ability to recognize and identify patient medications
- 6+ months of experience working with computer and web based tools
- Experience working under pressure in a fast-paced work environment while consistently meeting standards for productivity and quality.

title: Senior Manager BHP
descriptionHtml:
W Amazon potrzebujemy utalentowanych i doświadczonych osób, które pomogą nam działać bezpiecznie i wydajnie. Jako Senior Manager Workplace Health and Safety (WHS) Twoja rola jest kluczowa dla wdrażania strategicznych ulepszeń w Twoich obiektach i na poziomie regionalnym. Będziesz kierować i rozwijać swój zespół, wyznaczać agendę bezpieczeństwa i współpracować z kadrą zarządzającą, aby zakorzenić kulturę bezpieczeństwa i włączenia w swoich operacjach.

Key job responsibilities
Zarządzanie zespołami na obiekcie i współpraca międzyfunkcyjna w celu zapewnienia zgodności z przepisami BHP, wytycznymi i politykami firmy.
Wykorzystywanie wewnętrznych narzędzi raportowania do analizy danych i dostarczania kierownictwu informacji do podejmowania decyzji w zakresie bezpieczeństwa.
Opracowywanie, wdrażanie i utrzymywanie programów szkoleniowych z zakresu bezpieczeństwa, inicjatyw ergonomicznych i programów prewencyjnych w celu poprawy kultury bezpieczeństwa.
Przeprowadzanie ocen ryzyka dla nowych procesów i maszyn, przegląd zmian w procesach standardowych i aktualizacja istniejących ocen ryzyka.
Promowanie zaangażowania w działania na rzecz BHP wśród kadry zarządzającej i pracowników w celu budowania silnej kultury bezpieczeństwa.

A day in the life
To niezwykle zróżnicowane stanowisko w jednym z naszych obiektów, pozwalające bezpośrednio przyczyniać się do wielu aspektów naszej kultury bezpieczeństwa. Będziesz zarządzać standardami BHP, jednocześnie poprawiając funkcjonalność i efektywność. Będziesz również kierować swoim zespołem, pomagając we wdrażaniu zmian w odpowiedzi na opinie pracowników lub wykorzystywaniu możliwości ciągłego doskonalenia procesów. Twoja rola jest kluczowa dla zapewnienia bezpieczeństwa pracowników, zarządzania ich satysfakcją oraz nadzorowania ich dobrostanu i produktywności. Przejmiesz odpowiedzialność za BHP, aby budować kulturę bezpiecznej pracy.
Twoja rola jest kluczowa dla zapewnienia bezpieczeństwa pracowników, zarządzania ich satysfakcją oraz nadzorowania ich dobrostanu i produktywności. Przejmiesz odpowiedzialność za BHP, aby budować kulturę bezpiecznej pracy.

About the team
Zespół Workplace Health and Safety (WHS) odgrywa kluczową rolę w zapewnieniu dobrostanu psychicznego i fizycznego naszych pracowników. Nasz zespół współpracuje z kierownikami, pracownikami i lokalnymi władzami we wszystkich naszych obiektach, dbając o zgodność z politykami Amazon i przepisami prawnymi oraz zapewniając bezpieczeństwo naszych środowisk pracy. Zespół oferuje różnorodne możliwości — od Techników BHP po Kierowników Programów. Niezależnie od Twojego stanowiska, będziesz przyczyniać się do rozwoju i wdrażania strategii bezpieczeństwa w całej sieci.

Basic qualifications

- Tytuł licencjata lub równoważny poziom kwalifikacji zgodny z Europejskimi Ramami Kwalifikacji (EQF), lub wyższe wykształcenie o kierunku BHP i co najmniej roczny staż pracy w służbie BHP, lub ukończone studia podyplomowe w zakresie BHP i co najmniej roczny staż pracy w służbie BHP.
- Odpowiednie doświadczenie w przestrzeganiu lokalnych przepisów BHP.
- Odpowiednie doświadczenie w zarządzaniu zespołem.
- Biegła znajomość języka polskiego i bardzo dobra znajomość angielskiego (B2), w mowie i piśmie.

Preferred qualifications

- Preferowane kwalifikacje nie są wymagane do aplikowania na stanowisko w Amazon. Jeśli posiadasz wszystkie powyższe kwalifikacje podstawowe, chętnie poznamy Twoją kandydaturę.
- Doświadczenie z metodologiami Lean, 5S lub Kaizen.
- Doświadczenie w planowaniu lub zarządzaniu inicjatywami proekologicznymi.
- Członkostwo w organizacji zawodowej w dziedzinie bezpieczeństwa i higieny pracy.
- Doświadczenie w zarządzaniu i komunikacji z szerokim gronem interesariuszy, w tym współpracownikami, podwładnymi i kadrą kierowniczą.

title: Operations Human Resources Partner Intern (3 - 12 Months) - 2027
descriptionHtml:
Power that runs the world | Discover careers in Operations

Operations roles at Amazon put you at the center of how things move from a click to a doorstep.

You’ll help design, improve, and run systems that connect people, products, and places, at scale. You’ll take ownership early, work closely with teams to solve real-world challenges, and see the direct results of your decisions as they reach customers every day.

Here, the impact of what you build isn’t abstract, it’s visible, immediate, and meaningful - keeping one of the world’s most complex operations moving forward.

This is where your journey takes shape through action, responsibility, and the opportunity to grow in many directions.

Key job responsibilities
- Developing in-depth knowledge of HR functions within Amazon's fast-paced operations

- Assisting with internal communication efforts to align teams across multiple countries, promoting collaboration and information-sharing

- Helping develop training plans and materials to address the evolving development needs of various teams, supporting employee growth

- Learning about HR functions across the broader Amazon organization and staying up-to-date on best practices

- Providing support to Amazon employees on a range of daily queries related to attendance, engagement, compensation, and other HR matters

- Assisting HR teams with day-to-day operational routines and administrative tasks

- Participating in process reviews to identify opportunities for simplification and automation, driving efficiency improvements

- Compiling comprehensive personnel statistics, reports, and performance evaluations to inform decision-making

- Partnering closely with business leaders to align HR strategies and initiatives with organizational goals and priorities

A day in the life
Every day is a little different as an Operations Human Resources Partner Intern. This internship will immerse you in HR within a global organisation, with the opportunity to work on projects across different HR areas — from employee relations and training to compensation and workforce analytics. You might spend your morning analysing workforce data to identify trends and build recommendations for your team, then spend your afternoon supporting an employee relations case or collaborating with operations leaders on a training initiative.

Amazon's HR function is deeply embedded in the business, so no matter which project you are working on, part of your role will involve using data and analytical thinking to drive decisions. You'll apply your problem-solving and technical skills to real challenges, while developing important communication and professional soft skills through hands-on experience. With a dedicated mentor guiding your development throughout the programme, you'll gain insights into how HR partners with the business to drive growth and organisational excellence — providing a strong foundation for a career in human resources.

Note: You must have the right to work in the country of employment by the start date.

About the team
Intern Community:

As an Amazon Intern, you'll be part of a dynamic, supportive community that empowers your growth and development. You'll collaborate with interns from around the world, networking and participating in social events to broaden your perspectives. You can also join specialized groups focused on areas like sustainability to explore your diverse interests.

Support:

The internship program provides a robust support system, including weekly intern office hours, dedicated IT and HR support, and a program team committed to your success. This ensures you have the guidance and assistance needed to thrive.

Learning Sessions:

Exclusive learning sessions will further enhance your skills, granting you access to Amazon's industry-leading learning platforms and the expertise of industry leaders. These structured development opportunities will prepare you for the next step in your career.

Opportunities:

Upon successful completion of the internship, you may be considered for a graduate role or a second internship, allowing you to continue your journey with Amazon. Additionally, you'll enjoy a competitive monthly salary, relocation support, and access to a range of employee benefits.

Internship Start Dates across the year:

We are hiring interns to start anytime from January through September 2027. Each month, we'll hold 1-2 onboarding days for new hires.

Basic qualifications

- Speak, write, and read fluently in English at C1 level or above
- Currently in your penultimate or final year and working towards a university bachelor’s or master’s in HR, Business Administration, Psychology, Marketing, Social Sciences, Law or a related field (Humanities focused), or a similar discipline
- Available for a full-time internship (40 hours/week) and commit to 3 to 12 month internship maximum

Preferred qualifications

- Strong problem-solving and analytical skills, with the ability to identify process improvements and innovative solutions.
- Excellent communication and teamwork skills, able to collaborate effectively with others.
- Demonstrated curiosity, proactivity, and willingness to take on challenges in an ambiguous, fast-paced environment.

title: Installation Technician, Nights
descriptionHtml:
Transform network infrastructure by joining our dynamic team! You'll be at the forefront of developing innovative solutions that drive network stability and scalability, using your technical expertise to create automated systems that power global technological advancement.

Infra Delivery Install Technicians will collaborate with cross-functional teams, troubleshoot complex technical scenarios, and implement strategic solutions that keep our network running seamlessly. Expect to engage in hands-on technical work that requires creativity, precision, and a passion for technological innovation.

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

NOTE: Amazon does not sponsor for immigration, including for H-1B, TN, and other non-immigrant visas, for this role.

NOTE: Lump sum stipend will be provided to eligible candidates who relocate for this position.

Key job responsibilities
Key job responsibilities
- Moving and implementing large enterprise equipment
- Installing Fiber and Copper cabling and patching cabling between equipment
- Ensuring proper safety and security standards are maintained during cabling and rack installation,
- Following well established hardware installation procedures and break-fix activities
- Safely using material handling tools and equipment
- Traveling within and outside of the regional work area is required. You will be responsible for having a reliable personal vehicle and valid driver's license to travel within the regional work area, as company transportation will not be provided

Physical Requirements:
- Regularly lift and/or move up to 40 pounds; and participate in group lifts for 41+ pounds
- Ability to work in an environment that operates 24/7 with an ability to participate in primary responder rotation and provide after-hours support as needed
- Working in cramped and/or elevated and/or noisy environments
- Bending, lifting, stretching, reaching, standing and walking for up to 8+ hours a day
- Ascending and descending ladders, stairs, and gangways safely and without limitation

This role supports data centers in various operational stages. The position may be assigned to a facility still under development, which could require travel to established locations for training until your designated site becomes fully operational.

Essential Requirements:
- Ability to travel to or commute between data center locations as needed
- Willingness to temporarily work at alternative sites during training periods or until assigned facility is operational
- Travel frequency will vary based on business needs and operational status of assigned facility

Candidates must be able to travel (over 50 miles) or commute (less than 50 miles) to active data center sites as required by business needs.

Basic qualifications

- 1+ years of Computer Hardware Repair, Infrastructure Cabling, Network Deployment, or Data Center Operations experience, or experience in similar technical or vocational roles
- High School diploma or equivalent

Preferred qualifications

- industry standard certification (CompTIA, CCENT, or Network+)
- Experience with cabling infrastructure best practices and methodologies
- Knowledge of network cabling, optic types, and test equipment

title: VAT Manager, Digital and Devices Tax
descriptionHtml:
Want to get close to the business? This VAT Manager role sits at the heart of Amazon's Digital & Devices operation, advising on global expansions, cross-border digital services, and new business models. Based in London, you'll work directly with product and commercial teams — translating complex VAT questions into clear, actionable guidance.

Key job responsibilities
- You will join a team of VAT specialists covering Amazon's Digital and Devices portfolio, taking ownership of specific business lines within that portfolio. Our team supports some of Amazon's most recognised and fastest-growing businesses — including Prime Video, Amazon MGM Studios, Alexa, Kindle, Audible, Amazon Music, Twitch, Devices (Ring, Eero), Appstore, Digital Software and Games, Amazon Prime, and M&A — as well as Amazon Leo, launching low earth orbit satellite broadband service for unserved and underserved communities worldwide.
- In your business lines, you will be the go-to VAT advisor: partnering directly with business teams to understand their commercial objectives and translating these into clear, pragmatic tax solutions. Your work will span product and service expansions, business restructurings, ESS obligations for cross-border digital services, e-invoicing launches, and the full range of operational VAT questions that arise in a fast-moving environment.
- Beyond your own portfolio, you will contribute to wider VAT and indirect tax strategy, communicating effectively around what your businesses are planning and helping make sure the tax response across all disciplines is consistent and timely.

A day in the life
Your day will typically move between the technical and the commercial. You might start the morning working through the VAT treatment of a new digital service launching in a new market — reviewing place of supply rules, checking e-invoicing requirements, and turning your analysis into a clear recommendation the business can act on. By mid-morning you could be on a call with finance and legal colleagues, aligning on the indirect tax position for a content acquisition deal before contracts are signed.
Your stakeholders are the product, finance, legal, and operations teams behind the businesses you support. Your job is to understand what they are building, get ahead of the tax implications, and stay with them through to implementation.

About the team
We are a global team based across London, Luxembourg, Sao Paolo, Seattle, New York and Washington DC, supporting some of Amazon's most exciting and innovative business lines.
Our mission is to help Amazon's digital businesses launch, expand, and scale. That means partnering with the businesses we support, from advice through to implementation, and staying close as the business evolves.
The team operates with a high degree of trust and autonomy. You will own your portfolio, but never work in isolation - we collaborate closely across direct tax, transfer pricing, and compliance teams, and share knowledge openly when things get complex.

- professional tax, accounting or legal qualification (e.g., Chartered Accountant (CA), Associate Chartered Accountant (ACA), Chartered Tax Adviser (CTA), Chartered Institute of Taxation (CIOT) or similar)

Preferred qualifications

descriptionHtml:
The newest business group in AWS, Applied AI Solutions are built by AWS and AWS Partners to deliver applied AI solutions that leverage Amazon’s operational expertise and that businesses love and trust for their day-to-day success. Our ambition is to become a partner which companies can rely on to run their business every day, putting AI to work delivering better customer experience, operational excellence and speed.

We are seeking a Senior Data Engineer to design, build and maintain our next-generation data infrastructure - one that seamlessly serves both human analysts and AI systems. This role sits at the intersection of traditional enterprise data warehousing and innovative AI technologies, requiring someone who can bridge these worlds to create a unified, future-proof data ecosystem.

As a key member of our data team, you'll collaborate across organizational boundaries with data scientists, engineers, analytics teams, and business stakeholders to develop innovative and scalable solutions that push the boundaries of what's possible with our data assets.

You'll be responsible for ensuring our datasets maintain the highest levels of accuracy, consistency, and observability - implementing comprehensive monitoring, lineage tracking, and self-healing mechanisms that maintain data quality at scale. Your infrastructure will support both analysts / scientists and autonomous AI agents with equal effectiveness, requiring thoughtful interfaces, documentation, and metadata that serve both audiences.

In this role, you'll champion a forward-thinking approach to data infrastructure that anticipates the evolving needs of AI systems while maintaining the reliability and performance that business operations demand. You'll help shape our technical roadmap for data systems that will serve as the foundation for our organization's AI transformation journey.

Key job responsibilities
- 5+ years of data engineering, building and operating production pipelines and warehouses.
- Experience building data infrastructure that serves AI systems and autonomous agents, not just human analysts, including machine-consumable interfaces, metadata, and documentation.
- Experience with GenAI data patterns end to end: chunking, embeddings, and vector stores for retrieval-augmented generation.

- Experience designing data models and schemas for analytical, operational, and AI/retrieval workloads.
- Experience with workflow orchestration (Step Functions, Airflow, or Glue Workflows).

- Experience with data modeling, warehousing and building ETL pipelines
- Experience with SQL

- Experience with MPP databases such as Amazon Redshift
- Experience building/operating highly available, distributed systems of data extraction, ingestion, and processing of large data sets

- Experience implementing data quality, lineage, and observability that AI workloads depend on including validation, freshness/anomaly monitoring, and alerting at scale.
