title: Responsable d'Equipe Logistique (H/F)
descriptionHtml:
Devenez Responsable d'Équipe Logistique chez Amazon et mettez votre expérience au service de notre mission: garantir à des millions de clients la réception de leurs commandes à l'heure promise. Dans ce rôle stimulant où chaque décision compte, vous vivrez l'excitation quotidienne de piloter des opérations à grande échelle tout en ayant un impact direct sur la satisfaction de millions de clients. Vous serez un véritable moteur de transformation, contribuant à repousser toujours plus loin les limites de notre performance opérationnelle au sein de notre réseau européen.

Key job responsibilities
• Promouvoir une culture de sécurité exemplaire, en faisant de la santé et la sécurité des équipes notre priorité absolue
• Féderer et faire grandir une équipe de 50 à 100 collaborateurs, en créant un environnement où l'innovation et le développement des talents sont au cœur de votre management
• Piloter la performance de votre périmètre avec une vision stratégique, en optimisant les processus pour dépasser les attentes de millions de clients
• Concevoir et déployer des initiatives d'amélioration continue à grande échelle, en vous appuyant sur votre expertise et l'analyse approfondie des données
• Collaborer avec le réseau international d'Amazon pour partager les meilleures pratiques et porter des projets stratégiques

A day in the life
Vous travaillerez sur l’un de nos sites, en veillant à ce qu’il soit aussi productif que possible. Vous aurez pour tâche principale la gouvernance complète des changements en cours sur le site et de la conformité; Vous assurez que le site comprenne, accepte et mette en œuvre tous les changements provenant de toutes les initiatives mondiales et de l'UE et vous etes chargé des audits de progrès. Vous rendrez compte au Responsable de site et fonctionnellement à l'ACES pour les changements

About the team
Amazon Logistics, ou AMZL, s’occupe des activités de livraison du « dernier kilomètre » en partenariat avec des entreprises de distribution tierces. Nous faisons appel à la créativité et aux initiatives visant à l’amélioration continue pour acheminer des millions de produits physiques jusqu’à nos clients. Notre objectif est de rendre l’expérience de livraison de nos clients aussi fluide que possible et de déployer des solutions de livraison globales pour nos concepts les plus récents, tels qu’Amazon Fresh, Prime Now et Amazon Restaurants. Notre travail s’effectue de deux manières. Nos collaborateurs·trices « sous le toit » traitent des millions de produits avant de les envoyer à nos équipes de livraison. La dimension humaine est au coeur des activités de l’équipe. Nous jouons essentiellement un rôle de soutien, y compris de nuit. Nous nous concentrons principalement sur les opérations, avec des équipes présentes 24 heures sur 24, 7 jours sur 7 dans la plupart de nos sites. Quant à nos collaborateurs·trices « sur la route », ils travaillent avec Amazon Flex, un réseau
d’entreprises de livraison. Chaque année, nous plaçons la barre toujours plus haut en matière d’expérience client grâce à de nouveaux services de livraison. Nous recherchons de nouveaux moyens de relever les défis logistiques du secteur et de nouvelles idées pour réduire notre empreinte carbone, en nous appuyant sur un parc de véhicules (y compris des véhicules électriques) et des technologies de pointe.

Basic qualifications

- Diplôme d'ingénieur, d'école de commerce ou d'université
- Expérience en management d'équipes importantes
- Expérience en analyse de données
- Capacité à communiquer en français et en anglais (oral et écrit)

Preferred qualifications

- Certification Lean ou Six Sigma
- Expérience dans un environnement industriel, logistique ou de transport

Amazon est un employeur engagé pour l'égalité des chances. Nous sommes convaincus qu'une main d'oeuvre diversifée est essentielle à notre réussite. Nous prenons nos décisions de recrutement en fonction de votre expérience et de vos compétences. Nous apprécions votre envie de découvrir, d'inventer, de simplifier et de construire. La protection de votre vie privée et la sécurité de vos données constituent depuis longtemps une priorité absolue pour Amazon. title: Principal Product Manager, Retail Business Services, RBS: Cost To Serve
descriptionHtml:
Upstream Defect Elimination (UDE) is a Senior Leadership Team mission to remove unnecessary cost in Amazon's retail business, anchored to a shared S-Team goal of $5B Cost Out Impact (COI) in 2026, scaling to a proposed $10B in 2027. UDE requires a myriad of mechanisms and we're in search of a Principal Product Manager to lead the development of the software platform portfolio from within the Retail Business Services team to manage all defects.

Retail Business Services (RBS) is the force multiplier team for Amazon's Retail business growth worldwide through three core strategic initiatives: (1) Defect Elimination, identifying cross-all-retail defects at their root cause and driving extirpation to increase margins; (2) Selection, creating and enriching Amazon inventory data increasing gross merchandise sales growth; and, (3) Operational Excellence, to ensure Amazon's retail business is running efficiently and effectively.

RBS evolving a horizontal internal platform complete with a front-end interface to oversee our UDE program; and, we need an experienced Principal Product Manager to own product vision and lead a small, growing team of product managers as a player-coach across our tracking, reporting, identification, and extrapolation products. This role has significantly evolved in last couple of years, with additional products and capabilities expected to be either ramped up or developed.

As the Principal Product Manager, you would own the development life cycle of our UDE platform portfolio spanning defect tracking, reporting. Own the tool which uses AI for defect identification, and extrapolation to enrich defects with root cause, upstream system, and system owner built with an AI-first development philosophy. Moreover, the leader will lead efforts on simplifying underlying data architectures (with help of dedicated BIE team and central Data Engineering team) for ease of usage of these products, while leading the impact assessment capabilities. It is expected for the leader to continue pushing the envelope on thought leadership via 3YP and Annual plans, which aid not just RBS users, but larger Amazon teams in identifying defects, analyzing and root causing them, assess their impact. The leader is epected to lead a small team to begin with. RBS is investing in this space and depending on forward looking vision, we expect this to become a much larger role with larger team being managed.

Operating in ambiguity, you would define strategy and invent net-new mechanisms; the day-to-day responsibilities include but are not limited to removing org-level blockers; ensuring teams are tracking to committed timelines; defining deep product feature requirements; developing a road map; aligning with stakeholders; collaborating with partner teams; and ensuring a successful, on-time launch.

Work/Life Balance
RBS puts a high value on work-life harmony. We believe striking the right balance between your personal and professional life is critical to life-long happiness and we encourage you to find your own balance between your work and personal lives.

Mentorship & Career Growth
Our team is dedicated to supporting new members. We have a broad mix of experience levels and tenures, and we're building an environment that celebrates knowledge sharing and mentorship. Also, we provide trainings to employees through online learning platforms such as O'Reilly and also encourage them to take up AWS/ML certifications.


Key job responsibilities
Key Job Responsibilities
• Experience of managing complex business processes at scale.
• Drive end-to-end high impact and high visibility programs that impact WW Retail and hence customer experience on Amazon
• Communication and executive presence with an ability to deal with a fast-paced environment.
• Experience in defining, developing and using metrics to drive the vision and manage the business.
• Analyze data and dive deep into processes to derive insights for enhancing systems
• Ability to lead not only at the strategic level, but also tactically day-to-day by diving deeply into business and technical domains.
• Set AI/ML product strategy, prioritizing capabilities and making build-vs-buy calls across the portfolio.
• Liaise with tech, product, ops and category teams to ensure timely deliverables for key projects
• Ability to work effectively & independently in a fast-paced environment with tight deadlines.
• Influence VP/SVP/S-Team decisions and set product direction org-wide through compelling business documents
• Serve as a role model for Amazon's Leadership Principles and raise the bar for product managers across RBS


About the team
About the Team
Retail Business Services (RBS) supports Amazon's Retail business growth WW through three core tasks. These are (a) Selection, where RBS sources, creates and enrich ASINs to drive GMS growth; (b) Defect Elimination: where RBS resolves inbound supply chain defects and develops root cause fixes to improve free cash flow and (c) supports operational process for WW Retail teams where there is an air gap in the tech stack. The tech team in RBS develops automation that leverages Machine/Deep Learning to scale execution of these high complex tasks that currently require human cognitive skills

Basic qualifications

- 10+ years of product or program management, product marketing, business development or technology experience
- 10+ years of blending product and program management skills to execute strategic initiatives about process creation, standardization, and improvement experience
- Experience with feature delivery and tradeoffs of a product
- Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition
- Experience with end to end product delivery
- Experience as a product manager or owner

Preferred qualifications

- Experience owning technology products

title: Manager Sicurezza sul Lavoro, Workplace Health and Safety
descriptionHtml:
In Amazon, abbiamo bisogno di persone talentuose ed esperte che ci aiutino a operare in modo sicuro ed efficiente. Come WHS Manager, il tuo ruolo è fondamentale per guidare i miglioramenti a livello di sito e regionale. Guiderai il tuo team e aiuterai i tuoi colleghi a mantenere standard elevati, promuovendo al contempo una cultura della sicurezza e dell'inclusione nei tuoi siti.

Il contratto collettivo nazionale di lavoro applicabile a questo ruolo è CCNL per i dipendenti del settore Logistica, Trasporto Merci e Spedizione. La posizione è inquadrata al livello 1, in base alle competenze, capacità ed esperienza del/della candidato/a.La retribuzione annua lorda minima per questa posizione è indicata di seguito. La retribuzione indicata corrisponde a un impiego a tempo pieno. Per un impiego a tempo parziale, la retribuzione sarà adeguata proporzionalmente. Amazon si riserva il diritto di offrire una retribuzione e/o un livello superiore, in base alle competenze, capacità ed esperienza del/della candidato/a. Il pacchetto retributivo di Amazon può includere un bonus di assunzione e incentivi sulle vendite. Inoltre, il/la candidato/a potrebbe avere diritto a partecipare a un piano di assegnazione di azioni vincolate (RSU) gestito in modo indipendente da Amazon.com Inc. negli Stati Uniti.Il team di selezione condividerà la retribuzione finale e l'eventuale piano di azioni vincolate, se applicabile, in base alle competenze e ai requisiti.Oltre ai benefici previsti dalla legge e quelli applicabili al CCNL di riferimento, potrebbero essere previsti ulteriori benefici aziendali, soggetti a termini aggiuntivi. Italia - 48,900.00 EUR lordi annui.


Key job responsibilities
Gestire il team sul sito, collaborando regolarmente con altri team in tutta l'azienda. Utilizzare gli strumenti di reporting interni per analizzare dati e cause profonde, fornendo alla direzione le informazioni necessarie per prendere decisioni in materia di sicurezza. Fornire orientamento e disposizioni per progetti e politiche di salute e sicurezza. Guidare programmi progettati per migliorare la cultura della sicurezza in Amazon.

A day in the life
Questo è un ruolo estremamente vario, basato in uno dei nostri siti, che ti permetterà di contribuire direttamente a numerosi aspetti della nostra cultura della sicurezza. Gestirai gli standard di sicurezza e salute migliorando al contempo la funzionalità e l'efficienza. Guiderai anche il tuo team, aiutandolo a implementare i cambiamenti in risposta al feedback dei dipendenti o a cogliere opportunità di miglioramento continuo dei processi.

About the team
Il team Workplace Health and Safety (WHS) svolge un ruolo fondamentale nel garantire il benessere mentale e fisico dei nostri dipendenti sul luogo di lavoro. Il nostro team collabora con responsabili, associati e autorità locali in tutti i nostri siti, assicurando il rispetto delle politiche di Amazon e delle normative vigenti, e garantendo la sicurezza dei nostri ambienti di lavoro. Il team offre una varietà di opportunità, dai Safety Technician ai Programme Manager. Indipendentemente dal tuo ruolo, contribuirai allo sviluppo e all'implementazione della strategia di sicurezza sull'intera rete.

Basic qualifications

- Una laurea, oppure una qualifica equivalente conforme al Quadro Europeo delle Qualifiche (EQF), preferibilmente in Tecniche della Prevenzione nell'Ambiente e nei Luoghi di Lavoro, Ingegneria della Sicurezza, o in una disciplina affine.
- Certificazione ASPP o RSPP.
- Conoscenza della legislazione italiana in materia di sicurezza e salute sul lavoro.
- Esperienza pertinente nella gestione di un team.
- Padronanza dell'italiano e ottima conoscenza dell'inglese (B2), scritto e parlato.

Preferred qualifications

- Le qualifiche preferenziali non sono necessarie per candidarsi a una posizione in Amazon. Se possiedi tutte le qualifiche di base sopra indicate, saremo lieti di ricevere la tua candidatura. Esperienza con metodologie Lean, 5S o Kaizen. Esperienza nella pianificazione o gestione di iniziative attente all'ambiente. Iscrizione a un organismo professionale nel campo della salute e sicurezza sul lavoro. Esperienza nella gestione e comunicazione con un'ampia gamma di stakeholder, inclusi colleghi, collaboratori diretti e dirigenti.

title: Network Deployment Build Lead (Network Technician), AWS
descriptionHtml:
AWS Infrastructure Services (AIS) owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

We are looking to hire a NW Deployment Build Lead (Network Technician) to join our team within network infrastructure deployment. You will work with minimum supervision in a dynamic environment to drive the expansion of our next-generation networks. You should be highly autonomous, very detail oriented, possesses strong written and verbal communication skills and have experience of supporting large scale, enterprise class networks. Excellent network implementation and troubleshooting skills combined with a proven documentation methodology is also required. Strong written and verbal communication skills and an ability to interact efficiently with peers and customers are required. The desire and ability to work in a fast paced, collaborative environment is essential.

Ideal candidate should possess the below basic qualifications:

- Education & Certification: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a relevant certification, combined with hands-on experience in networking deployment and cabling infrastructure best practices.
- Technical Expertise: Strong understanding of enterprise infrastructure technologies including routers, switches, load balancers, and firewalls.
- Cabling & Tools Knowledge: Familiarity with network cabling standards, optic types, and testing tools such as VFL, power meter, and OTDR.
- Language Skills: Very good command of English, both written and spoken.


Key job responsibilities
- Scaling support of several data center locations
- Responsible for day-to-day assistance with capacity management.
- Working closely with both internal customers and external vendors to facilitate fast, smooth rollout of established designs and products.
- Deliver simple, sustainable and repeatable solutions and processes.
- Manage work and priorities through ticketing system and workflows.
- Collaborate with various stake holders to remove project obstacles.
- Troubleshooting cabling infrastructure connectivity issues, including patch panels and patch cords.
- Participate in the migration, basic configuration and rollout of new or upgraded hardware.
- Specifying Power and Cooling requirements and ensuring Hardware Racking/Stacking completed for new equipment.

A day in the life
Why AWS

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Diverse Experiences

Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Work/Life Balance

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

Inclusive Team Culture

Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

Mentorship and Career Growth

title: Case Mgr, MLOA [S], Disability and Leave Services
descriptionHtml:
This is a contractual role
At Amazon we believe that every day is still day one.
We are working to be the most customer-centric company on earth. To get there, we need exceptionally talented, bright, and driven people. If you’d like to help the Disability Leave Services (DLS) team build a best-in-class professional services program to deliver leave of absence, disability and accommodation services to Amazon employees, applicants, job seekers and candidates globally, this is your chance to make history by joining the amazing Disability & Leave Services Team.
The DLS Case Manager provides case management for all types of leave of absence and disability life events. The DLS Case Manager is highly skilled in answering questions, understanding the employee’s situation, applying the appropriate benefits, responding to changing circumstances and needs, and paves the way for a connected and trusted case management experience. Case Managers are the single point of contact for an employee throughout an entire leave of absence or disability event.
This is an individual contribution (IC) role with no direct reports.
Essential Responsibilities:
• Initiate and respond to inquiries about leave and disability events, benefits, and options available to employees
• Serve as a point of contact for assigned employees to provide holistic case management services, including reviewing medical documentation to adjudicate leaves in compliance with the corresponding leave plans, federal and state laws and benefit plans as defined by Amazon

• Critically assess and adjust the case management plan to an employee’s changing needs
• Address and respond to sensitive situations
• Troubleshoot issues and seek to remove barriers before, during, or after a leave event
• Respond to employee impacting issues that may arise during the leave event and ensure the right communication occurs
• Identify and solve problems that may arise, sometimes with limited information
• Facilitate a smooth return to work and ramp-back plan for employees returning to the workplace
• Educate managers and business partners on employee concerns and needs prior to being off or returning back to work
• Communicate regular updates to employees and stakeholders both verbally and in writing
• Ensure compliance with standard work, federal/state regulations, and company policy

• Consult, coordinate and partner with our third party administrator, HR, Safety, Legal, Payroll, Benefits, team members and other departments/systems as appropriate

- Bachelor's degree in business, HR, or a related field
- 1+ years of customer service experience, or Bachelor's degree in business, HR, or a related field
- Knowledge of Microsoft Office including Outlook, Word, and Excel
- Speak, write, and read fluently in English

Preferred qualifications

- Experience identifying and resolving complex issues
- Experience influencing multiple stakeholders and leading cross functional teams across geographies and business units
- Experience with end-to-end ownership of major project deliverables
- Experience working with and protecting confidential and sensitive HR information

descriptionHtml:
Für unseren Standort in Wenden suchen wir einen Mechatroniker / Elektroniker / Mechaniker oder vergleichbare Fachkräfte als Instandhaltungstechniker (m/w/d)!

Das Wartungs- und Instandhaltungsteam (Reliability Maintenance Engineering Team oder RME-Team) ist für unseren Betrieb von fundamentaler Bedeutung – es sorgt dafür, dass unsere technischen Systeme und Anlagen laufend funktionieren. Als Instandhaltungstechniker:in bist Du für die Wartung und Instandhaltung unserer förder- und haustechnischen Anlagen sowie Produktionsanlagen zuständig. Du hilfst, die höchsten Sicherheitsstandards im Arbeitsschutz zu gewährleisten und Maschinenausfallzeiten zu verhindern. Unser technisches Team stellt eine hohe Verfügbarkeit der technischen Anlagen sicher und verbessert die Qualität unserer Geräte.

Key job responsibilities
- Ausführung präventiver Wartungsmaßnahmen an einer breiten Vielfalt von Geräten an unseren Standorten
- Durchführung von Reparaturen und Fehlerdiagnosen
- Verwendung neuester Tools zur Maximierung der Geräteeffektivität
- Einhaltung aller Arbeitsschutzrichtlinien und -praktiken
- Unterstützung der Entwicklung und des beruflichen Fortschritts von Auszubildenden am Standort
- Arbeit an Projekten zur kontinuierlichen Verbesserung und Einführung von Best Practices an verschiedenen EU-Standorten

A day in the life
Als Instandhaltungstechniker:in bist Du vor Ort in einem unserer Logistikzentren tätig, um schnell auf technische Störungen reagieren zu können. Du führst eine Reihe geplanter präventiver Wartungsmaßnahmen an Geräten durch, um für ihren sicheren Betrieb zu sorgen. Außerdem reagierst Du als Instandhaltungstechniker:in unverzüglich auf Störungen und Ausfälle. Du untersuchst die Ursachen, findest so schnell wie möglich Lösungen und wendest sie an. Zudem machst Du Vorschläge für langfristige Verbesserungen.
In Zusammenarbeit mit leitenden Kolleg:innen nimmst Du tägliche Wartungsaufgaben wahr und kommunizierst mit Dienstleistern, falls Du externe Expertise benötigst. Du arbeitest in rotierenden Schichten, damit wir rund um die Uhr unsere Standorte unterstützen – und dafür sorgen, dass Amazon weiterhin in dem Tempo liefern kann, für das wir bekannt sind.

About the team
Die Arbeit bei Amazon Operations ist für Diejenigen, die gerne aktiv sind und alles geben. Wir arbeiten in einem dynamischen Umfeld und sind Teil eines großen Teams, das stolz darauf ist, jeden Tag die Erwartungen von Millionen von Kunden zu erfüllen. Wir sind offen, inklusiv und begrüßen Individualität und Vielfalt. Unsere Teams haben Spaß an guter Arbeit, wertschätzen sich, achten aufeinander und darauf, dass die höchsten Sicherheitsstandards gewährleistet sind. So tragen sie ihren Teil zur außergewöhnlichen Servicequalität bei, für die Amazon weltweit bekannt ist.

Werde auch Du Teil des technischen Teams von Amazon und optimiere mit uns die Technologien im globalen Logistiknetzwerk!

descriptionHtml:
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

title: EHS Specialist
descriptionHtml:
Join Amazon’s mission to become Earth’s safest place to work! At Amazon, we’ve set the ambitious goal to become the benchmark of safety excellence across all industries in which we operate. As a Workplace Health & Safety Specialist (WHSS), you'll be at the forefront of transforming workplace safety culture at one of the world's most innovative companies. Your expertise and dedication will directly protect employees, ensuring they return home safely to their families every day. You'll facilitate new approaches to safety, combining technology with human-centered solutions to create an environment where safety and productivity thrive together. This isn't just about maintaining safety standards – it's about revolutionizing how we think about and implement workplace safety, making a lasting impact on our people and operations. As your building's designated safety champion, you'll have the unique opportunity to build relationships, influence positive change, and help write the next chapter in Amazon's commitment to becoming Earth's Safest Place to Work.

Safety Program Excellence & Implementation - Drive comprehensive safety programs through data-driven strategies. Lead daily safety audits, incident investigations, and risk assessments while implementing innovative solutions to prevent injuries. Deliver engaging safety training that resonates with associates and promotes a proactive safety culture. Champion continuous improvement initiatives that enhance workplace safety while maintaining operational efficiency.

Foster a culture where safety is everyone's priority through effective communication, coaching, and positive reinforcement. title: Senior Applied AI Solutions Architect, Amazon Connect, AWS, AWS Applied AI Solutions
descriptionHtml:
The Applied AI Solutions Architecture team within AWS is seeking a hands-on, customer-obsessed Solutions Architect to accelerate customer adoption of Amazon Connect's AI capabilities. This role is part of the AI Velocity Team, a service-specific approach that assigns dedicated advisory and hands-on development resources directly to customers to achieve production-ready outcomes in weeks instead of months.

As an Applied AI Solutions Architect, you will be embedded with customers to help them prepare their Amazon Connect implementations for production by focusing on three pillars of agentic AI:
Model Selection: Guiding customers through evaluating and selecting the right foundation models (via Amazon Bedrock) for their contact center use cases, balancing latency, accuracy, cost, and compliance requirements.

Prompt Engineering: Designing, testing, and optimizing AI prompts and system instructions for Amazon Connect AI agents, including self-service agents, answer recommendation agents, and custom orchestrator agents.

Tooling: Architecting and building the tool integrations (APIs, Lambda functions, data connectors, knowledge bases) that agentic AI systems use to take actions on behalf of customers and agents. This included configuring MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers for standardized tool discovery and invocation, and enabling A2A (Agent-to-Agent) communication patterns for multi-agent orchestration across enterprise systems.

A key dimension of this role is Customer Data Readiness. Assessing, preparing, and structuring customer data assets so that AI agents can reliably access, retrieve, and act on the right information. You will help customers evaluate their data landscape, identify gaps, establish data pipelines, and ensure their knowledge bases, CRMs, and backend systems are AI-ready before agents go live.

You will work at the intersection of contact center operations and applied AI, helping customers move from proof-of-concept to pre-production for their Amazon Connect Unlimited AI deployments. This is a deeply technical, hands-on role, you will write code, build integrations, configure agents, and pair-program with customer engineering teams.




Key job responsibilities
Lead technical discovery sessions to understand customer business requirements, contact center architecture, and AI readiness, translating these into solution designs and implementation plans.

Conduct data readiness assessments across customer systems (CRMs, knowledge bases, ticketing, order management) to identify gaps, recommend remediation, and establish the data foundation for AI agent tool use and RAG-powered responses.

Design and configure agentic AI solutions within Amazon Connect, including multi-agent orchestration, prompt engineering, model selection, guardrails, and tool integration.

Deploy Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers to expose customer tools, data sources, and APIs in a standardized format for dynamic AI agent discovery and invocation.

Architect agent-to-agent communication patterns enabling multi-agent workflows across enterprise boundaries (e.g., billing, order management, IT support).

Build serverless integrations (Lambda, API Gateway, Step Functions, Python/Node.js) connecting AI agents with customer data systems and cloud-based data stores (DynamoDB, RDS, S3, OpenSearch, Kendra/Knowledge Bases for Bedrock).

Leverage agentic development environments (e.g., Kiro) to accelerate spec-driven development, MCP configuration, and AI-assisted code generation.

Guide customers through AI agent testing, evaluation, and validation against success criteria prior to production deployment.

Create reusable artifacts (reference architectures, implementation guides, prompt libraries, data readiness checklists) to scale best practices.

title: Pre Construction Manager, GES NA Pre Construction
descriptionHtml:
As a Preconstruction Manager within Global Engineering Services (GES) North America Design & Construction, you are Amazon's owner's representative during the preconstruction phase — responsible for independently managing difficult, cross-functional industrial building projects from site selection through design completion, permitting, and contract execution across your assigned region. Preconstruction services refers to the planning of a construction project before actual construction begins.

You will partner with internal and external stakeholders to ensure scope, budget, and schedule definition are established, including timely receipt of building and site permits. You are responsible as the project manager to lead planning, design, and preconstruction projects — including new built-to-suit industrial buildings, tenant improvements, extensions of existing facilities, and renovation projects — supporting Amazon's logistics network infrastructure.

You work independently within your assigned region, using your knowledge of construction and project management concepts to decide which actions to take to complete projects, and seeking guidance as needed on strategic components. You are tactical with some strategic components, utilizing well-defined processes and best practices to facilitate delivery of high-quality results. You make trade-offs between time, quality, and resources to keep projects on track.

Key competencies of this position include ensuring that contracted resources deliver work product in support of project durations, permitting,and quality documentation; managing project teams (developers, design engineers, professional consultants); influencing internal teams (Design Engineering, entittlment); contract management governance; conceptual estimating and budget oversight; and managing multiple large industrial projects in various locations simultaneously. Translating technical documents and information into clear, concise narratives with detailed risk analysis for leaders and customers is essential.

This opportunity combines construction engineering, planning, project management, real estate development, design validation, site visits, understanding of local building and fire code issues, utilities, sustainability, multi-disciplinary design management, and contract management. The Preconstruction Manager is responsible for the planning and design of scope, budget, and schedule prior to handing off to the Construction Manager — focusing on taking ownership to resolve upstream issues and supporting the construction team throughout the process.

This role requires approximately 60% regional travel within North America, with potential travel to all North America locations based on business needs.

Key job responsibilities
Interface and coordinate with Authorities Having Jurisdiction (AHJ) to ensure regulatory compliance, smooth permitting execution, and timely approvals

Review noise, traffic, and environmental studies; understand zoning, planning, fire code, and building code requirements for assigned projects

Independently manage difficult, cross-functional industrial preconstruction projects from site selection through design completion, permitting, and contract execution

Lead site selection and validation, scope development, and design management — coordinating with design teams to develop site plans and composite floor plans in compliance with Amazon's design standards and operational requirements

Manage multiple concurrent large industrial projects across various locations simultaneously

Keep scope under control and accelerate progress by driving crisp, timely decisions, identifying and clearing blockers, and escalating appropriately

Identify and resolve upstream issues proactively to support a clean handoff to the Construction Manager; remain a key support resource for the construction team throughout the project lifecycle

Assess project performance through Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) for safety, quality, cost, schedule, and sustainability

Minimize disruptions and proactively mitigate risks; plan ahead to prevent problems before they happen

Develop and manage project budgets and costs; own comprehensive schedule management and cashflow forecasting across assigned preconstruction projects

Perform conceptual estimating and pricing reviews for scope inclusions and exclusions; negotiate the cost of work with developers, general contractors, and design consultants

Contribute to the selection of external vendor partners and manage vendor procurement; oversee professional service providers to ensure their skills and competencies meet project requirements

Review and analyze design and construction contracts, related exhibits, and lease agreements; provide detailed analysis of technical matters and site-specific deal structures and terms

Partner with the Transaction team and developers to optimize schedule and strategy for entitlements and long-lead procurement

Identify and solve factors that may impede a successful permitted project handover to Amazon stakeholders; make trade-offs between time, quality, and resources

A day in the life
Navigating uncertainty, proactively unblocking project barriers, and influencing the best project decisions. You are tactical with some strategic components, working independently and interacting with leadership to resolve issues. Your day may include:

· Coordinating with architects, engineers, and design consultants on design document development, scope changes, and project status

· Reviewing site plans, composite floor plans, and design documents for compliance with Amazon's standards and operational requirements

· Negotiating contract terms with developers, contractors, and consultants

· Coordinating with AHJ on permitting status, and building code requirements

· Preparing and presenting project status and risk reports for leadership

· Partnering with Real Estate and Transaction teams on entitlement strategy and long-lead procurement

· Providing estimating support, interpreting drawings, contributing to budgets, and reviewing lease exhibits

· Updating Amazon's project management systems with current budget, schedule, and status information

· Supporting the Construction Manager on active construction projects with preconstruction expertise

About the team
At Amazon, the GES North America Design & Construction team is a diverse group of engineers, construction managers, and preconstruction professionals who deliver the physical infrastructure behind Amazon's logistics network. We are employee owners who take pride in delivering high-quality, innovative facilities — on time and on budget — for our internal customers and the communities we serve. We are committed to being Earth's best employer and to building a more sustainable future through every project we deliver.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Architecture, Construction Management, Engineering, or a related field
- Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Construction Management or an equivalent engineering science
- Experience as an Architect, Engineer, Construction Manager, Development Manager, Owner's project management representative or in other Commercial Development and Construction related disciplines
- 5+ years of project management (including scope, schedule, budget, quality, risk and critical path management) experience

Preferred qualifications

- Advanced degree or certification in Architecture, Engineering, Construction Management, or Business Administration
- Experience operating across at least two disciplines within the construction industry (e.g., General Contracting, Owner's Representation, Commercial Development, Engineering & Design, or Owner's Project Management)
- Demonstrated capability in planning, design review, implementation, and project management/control of new structures and enhancement of existing facilities
- Experience managing multi-disciplinary design incorporating industrial automation, robotics, or similar
- Strong influencing and negotiating skills.
- Demonstrated success communicating project requirements to diverse audiences (e.g., senior management, peers, fire marshals, utility providers, public officials, vendors)
- Knowledge of Building Information Modeling (BIM)
- CMIT/CMAA or PMP certification or equivalent

title: Sr Software Development Engineer, Amazon Q
locations: East Palo Alto, CA, United States
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Q is helping redefine how developers and cloud practitioners build, operate, troubleshoot, and optimize on AWS. We are building an intelligent assistant that goes beyond answering questions—combining generative AI with deep AWS context, retrieval, tools, and actions to help customers understand their environments and get work done faster.

Building this experience introduces a new class of engineering challenges. How do you ground an LLM's response in relevant, up-to-date information from a customer's AWS environment while maintaining strong security boundaries and low latency? How do you orchestrate multi-step agentic workflows that can reason, retrieve information, invoke tools, and take actions reliably and safely? How do you evaluate AI systems where quality cannot be measured by traditional software testing alone? These are the kinds of problems you will help solve.

We are looking for a Senior Software Development Engineer to help shape the next generation of Amazon Q. You will work at the intersection of generative AI, agentic systems, and large-scale distributed services to build highly visible, customer-facing capabilities used across AWS.

As a Senior SDE, you will provide technical leadership for complex and ambiguous initiatives. You will work closely with engineers, product managers, applied scientists, UX partners, and teams across AWS to define architecture, make critical technical decisions, and translate advances in foundation models, retrieval, reasoning, and agents into secure, reliable production experiences.

This role offers an opportunity to influence both what we build and how we build it—developing new architectures and engineering mechanisms for AI-powered systems while raising the technical bar across the team.

Key job responsibilities
As a Senior Software Development Engineer on the Amazon Q team, you will:

Build: Design and deliver major Amazon Q capabilities and the highly available, scalable, secure, and low-latency distributed systems that power them. Build systems that connect foundation models with customer context, AWS knowledge, retrieval systems, APIs, tools, and actions.

Solve: Tackle ambiguous engineering problems unique to production generative AI, including contextual grounding, agent orchestration, tool execution, retrieval, security boundaries, latency, reliability, and mechanisms for evaluating AI quality and effectiveness.

Own: Lead projects end to end—from requirements and architecture through implementation, launch, operations, measurement, and continuous improvement—making thoughtful trade-offs across customer experience, quality, scalability, availability, security, performance, and cost.

Lead: Define technical direction for complex initiatives, influence architecture across Amazon Q and partner teams, and simplify systems as they evolve. Drive high engineering standards across design, testing, observability, deployment, and operational excellence.

Mentor: Raise the technical bar of the organization through design reviews, code reviews, technical discussions, and hands-on development. Mentor engineers and help teams navigate complex architectural and implementation decisions.

Innovate: Work with applied scientists, product leaders, and engineering teams to bring advances in foundation models, retrieval, reasoning, and agentic AI into production. Explore new architectures and mechanisms that improve the quality, safety, reliability, latency, and usefulness of AI-powered customer experiences.

A day in the life
You'll start the day with the signals from how Amazon Q performed yesterday — satisfaction trends, latency tails, eval results — and pick up the problem that matters most. Mornings might be a design review with applied scientists on retrieval or agent orchestration; afternoons, writing the service code that ships it. You'll partner with PMs, TPMs, and AWS service teams onboarding their own capabilities into the assistant, and you'll own what you build in production. Expect to move between deep distributed-systems work, prompt and evaluation iteration, and A/B experiments that tell you whether your change actually helped a customer.

About the team
We're the team behind Amazon Q in the AWS Management Console — engineers, applied scientists, and product managers working in one loop rather than in handoffs. Our mission is simple to say and hard to do: make the assistant genuinely useful to anyone operating on AWS. We ship fast, measure honestly, and say so when the data doesn't support the idea we liked. Because the field moves monthly, we expect to rewrite our own assumptions often, and we'd rather learn from a real experiment than argue in a doc. We care about operational excellence, and about each other's time.

Basic qualifications

- 5+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
- 5+ years of programming with at least one software programming language experience
- 5+ years of leading design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
- Experience as a mentor, tech lead or leading an engineering team

Preferred qualifications

- 5+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
- Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

title: Principal Technical Program Manager
descriptionHtml:
Annapurna Labs designs the custom silicon that powers AWS's machine learning infrastructure, including the Trainium and Inferentia chip families. Our next-generation ML accelerator is a multi-die chiplet using state-of-the-art packaging technology, and it is the most complex hardware program Amazon has undertaken. We are looking for a Principal Technical Program Manager to own end-to-end program execution for this chip, from RTL freeze through tape-out and into production readiness.

This is not a status-reporting role. You will be the person who connects a sprawling set of engineering workstreams into a single coherent schedule, identifies the real critical path week to week, and drives the cross-functional decisions that keep the program on track. The program spans multiple concurrent silicon development efforts with significant interdependencies across engineering disciplines, external partners, and infrastructure.

Key job responsibilities
Own the integrated schedule and critical path analysis across multiple die tape-outs through engineering samples and production ramp. Understand dependency chains deeply enough to calculate the impact of any slip or pull-in, and update the timeline weekly with real data.
Drive the weekly chip status cadence by synthesizing inputs from RTL/DV, physical design, packaging, power, infrastructure, and post-silicon teams into a single view that tells leadership where we actually stand, including what is getting worse and what needs action.
Track verification convergence as a leading indicator by monitoring the progression from feature completion through RTL closure, bug trends, and regression pass rates by block. Recognize when convergence is stalling and drive the engineering response before downstream milestones are affected.
Manage the external design partner interface, owning the netlist delivery calendar, tracking your partner's physical design timeline, and negotiating schedule trades with a clear understanding of downstream cost.
Drive infrastructure readiness and external IP delivery by partnering with compute and EDA platform teams on capacity planning, and tracking third-party PHY, memory interface, and controller IP deliveries against consuming blocks to escalate gaps before they become tape-out critical.

A day in the life
You start your morning reviewing verification convergence dashboards and regression results, spotting a block where bug closure rates haven't flattened. You pull the DV lead and RTL owner into a quick sync to agree on a recovery plan before the weekly chip status review. In that review, you walk leadership through an updated critical path that reflects a netlist delivery shift from your external design partner, quantifying the downstream impact on tape-out timing. After lunch, you join an infrastructure capacity review to confirm that compute clusters can handle the regression load through freeze, then close out the day preparing an executive summary for an upcoming program milestone review.

About the team
The Annapurna Labs ML Accelerator team builds the Trainium and Inferentia silicon that trains and serves machine learning models across AWS. We work at the intersection of chip architecture, physical design, verification, and infrastructure to deliver products that push the boundaries of performance and efficiency for our customers. Our team values people who bring strong technical judgment, clear communication, and a willingness to get into the details. If you want to shape how Amazon builds its most ambitious hardware and work alongside talented engineers solving real problems at scale, this is the role for you.

Basic qualifications

- 10+ years of hands-on work managing complex technology projects experience
- 10+ years of working directly with engineering teams experience
- Deep working knowledge of the chip development lifecycle: RTL verification milestones, physical design convergence, DFT, and timing closure.
- Experience managing programs with external design partners and IP vendors where you don't control the resources but own the outcome.
- Demonstrated ability to build and maintain integrated schedules with real dependency modeling — not just Gantt charts, but an understanding of which paths have float and which don't.
- Strong technical communication skills: ability to present crisp status to VP-level audiences, distinguishing signal from noise, and framing decisions clearly.

Preferred qualifications

- Experience with multi-die / chiplet / advanced packaging programs (2.5D/3D integration).
- Familiarity with HBM integration, die-to-die interfaces, or high-speed serial subsystems.
- Experience with leading-edge foundry nodes and their specific flow and schedule characteristics.
- Background in ML accelerator or high-performance compute silicon.
- Experience driving infrastructure capacity planning for large-scale chip development programs.

title: QAE II, Amazon Business Operations, Amazon Business Operations
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Business customers place orders that arrive by the pallet: a school district ordering 2,000 chairs, a contractor ordering 900 boxes of fasteners, a hospital restocking a floor. Amazon Business Operations builds the systems that get those orders sourced, consolidated and delivered on the date the customer asked for. When one of these orders goes wrong it does not just degrade a page: a dock appointment is missed, an operator recovers the order by hand, and an enterprise reconsiders how much of its spend comes to Amazon.
We are building a new engineering team in Hyderabad dedicated to bulk fulfilment, and this is its first quality engineering hire. There is no existing test practice to inherit. You will decide what good looks like for every service the team launches.

Key job responsibilities
As a Quality Assurance Engineer on this team, you will:
Own feature quality end to end: design test plans, execute test cases, run bug triage, coordinate with product and engineering stakeholders, and give release sign-off.
Build and maintain automated test coverage inside the team's framework so that regression testing does not grow with the codebase.
Test operator-facing tooling and machine learning assisted decision flows, where correctness means the recommendation a human acts on is right, not only that the service returned a response.
Validate integrations with Amazon supply chain and fulfilment systems, including the data correctness that inventory, transportation and delivery promises depend on.
Set the quality bar for a new team: definition of done, quality metrics, and production monitoring that catches problems before an operator does.
You will work directly with the engineers building the service, the product manager writing the requirements, and the Amazon Business Operations teams who use what you ship. If you want ownership of quality for a product line from its first commit, this is that role.

A day in the life
You will sit with the engineers building the service, not apart from them. A typical day mixes writing and running test cases for the feature in the current sprint, extending automated regression coverage in the team's framework, and triaging yesterday's defects with the SDE who owns the code. You will review requirements with the product manager before a story enters the sprint, so acceptance criteria are testable rather than aspirational. You will spend time with the Amazon Business Operations teams who use the tooling, because they will tell you which failures actually hurt. Before a release ships, your sign-off is the gate.

About the team
Amazon Business Operations builds the systems and processes behind business buying at Amazon, from quoting a large order to landing it on a customer's dock. This is a new engineering team inside it, dedicated to bulk fulfilment, and you are joining at the start. We work in small teams with direct ownership, we measure ourselves on what changed for the customer, and we expect engineers to argue about design in writing. Expect high autonomy, close contact with the operators and customers you build for, and problems that have not been solved anywhere in Amazon yet.

Basic qualifications

- 4+ years of quality assurance engineering experience
- Experience in automation testing
- Experience in manual testing
- Experience as QA lead on medium to large sized projects
- Experience developing high quality test plans, test designs, test strategies, and test execution

descriptionHtml:

Key job responsibilities
As a Sr. Thermal & Mechanical Packaging Engineer, you design and build the systems that are the heart of the world's largest and most powerful computing infrastructure. Your work has the potential to shape the hardware that goes into our cutting-edge data centers affecting millions of AWS users.

Basic qualifications

- Experience communicating with customers, technical, regulatory, business teams, and management to collect requirements, describe product features, and technical designs

- 10+ years industry experience in mechanical design of semiconductor-based systems – silicon, packaging, and system design.
- Industry experience of working with packaging component vendors and ODMs, and internal design teams on cross-boundary triaging, debugging, and resolving issues across organization.

Hands-on experience with lab-based thermal and mechanical measurements, including instrumentation, infrared thermography, acoustic chambers, mechanical stress/strain gauges, power measurement equipment, and thermal test setups for package and system-level characterization.

- Experience with various types of technologies used for Heatsink solutions, Thermal Interface Materials (TIMs) and liquid cooling technologies - including cold plate design. Working knowledge on fans, UQDs, manifolds, and CDUs.

title: WIM Manager, AmSec WIM
descriptionHtml:
The Workplace Incident Management (WIM) Team is seeking a Manager to lead a team of investigators within the AMER Region. In this role, you will lead a team of WIM Investigators responsible for conducting investigations and threat assessments involving acts of violence, threats of violence, and the potential for violence or concerning behaviors. This is a people-management position reporting to the Regional WIM Manager, AMER Region.

As Manager, you will own the day-to-day operations of your assigned area within the AMER region, setting direction and standards while ensuring investigations are thorough, timely, and consistent. You will guide your team's decision-making, own the quality of outcomes, and build the cross-functional and law enforcement partnerships essential to keeping Amazon's workforce safe. You will lead multi-disciplinary teams comprised of cross-functional stakeholders (e.g., Human Resources, Employee Relations, Legal) and security partners (e.g., site security, intelligence analysts) to assess behavior, investigate actions, and implement appropriate resolutions. This position will require occasional travel and on-call availability for critical security incidents.



Key job responsibilities
• Lead and develop a team of AMER-based WIM Investigators, overseeing complex, highly confidential investigations and owning the quality, consistency, and timely resolution of outcomes across the region.
• Manage caseload allocation across the team, balancing workload, priorities, and resourcing across AMER.
• Personally manage a caseload of the most complex, sensitive, and high-stakes investigations, conducting threat assessments and interviews directly for these matters.
• Build and own cross-functional partnerships with Amazon Corporate Security (ACS), Data Center (DC) Security, HR, Employee Relations (ER), Legal, and security partners across AMER.
• Develop and maintain strong relationships with federal, state, and local law enforcement agencies, and appropriately escalate risks, threats, and issues as required by applicable laws.
• Own data integrity and reporting in the case management system, using a structured workflow to track cases, analyze trends, identify causation, and prevent future incidents.
• Deliver and elevate the team's fact-based reports, assessments, and presentations to executive-level leadership.
• Set and drive operational excellence standards and continuous-improvement initiatives, including innovation through AI and emerging technologies.
• Own the regional approach to workplace violence prevention training, mitigation planning, and post-incident after-action reviews.
• Coach, mentor, and lead a high-performing team, managing day-to-day operations while fostering continuous talent and career development.
• Maintain after-hours availability and lead the team's emergency on-call rotation and incident-response readiness.

About the team
Diverse Experiences
Amazon Security values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why Amazon Security?
At Amazon, security is central to maintaining customer trust and delivering delightful customer experiences. Our organization is responsible for creating and maintaining a high bar for security across all of Amazon’s products and services. We offer talented security professionals the chance to accelerate their careers with opportunities to build experience in a wide variety of areas including cloud, devices, retail, entertainment, healthcare, operations, and physical stores.

Inclusive Team Culture
In Amazon Security, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Addressing the toughest security challenges requires that we seek out and celebrate a diversity of ideas, perspectives, and voices.

Training & Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, training, and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why flexible work hours and arrangements are part of our culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.

- 7+ years of security-related professional, or 7+ years of law enforcement experience
- Experience leading cross-functional teams to establish strong partnerships with demonstrable results

- Bachelor's degree, or equivalent experience, in Business, Criminology, Social Work, Human Resources, Psychology, or a related field from an accredited college or university

descriptionHtml:
Amazon Customer Service (Amazon CS) organization is seeking a Sr Product Manager to own the end-to-end Service Design experience for Alexa products and services.

You will work backwards from customer pain points to define product vision, write strategy documents (PRFAQs, narratives, roadmaps), and drive execution across product, engineering, design, and operations teams. You will define success through measurable outcomes, distinguishing between output metrics like defects eliminated and effort reduction, and outcome metrics like customer satisfaction, engagement, and quality of experience.

As the critical intersection point for customer needs, business goals, and technical possibilities, you will lead cross-organizational initiatives that drive value with increased product engagement, or lower cost to serve by increasing operational efficiencies. You will apply one-way and two-way door judgment to high-stakes decisions, challenge assumptions, and establish strategic frameworks adoptable by other teams. You will embrace emerging technology shifts and adopt industry trends to define the best-in-class service offering to secure customer loyalty. While driving multi-year investments that reshape the CS landscape, you'll instrument new success measures where necessary as you secure cross-functional commitment to build solutions to mitigate customer pain points.

This leader earns trust and influences without authority at the Director and VP levels across Product, Marketing, Engineering, Finance, Legal, PR and Operations teams by leveraging data and grounding recommendations based on business priorities or holistic organizational needs.

Key job responsibilities
- Own the 3 to 5 year product vision, strategy, and roadmap for Alexa Customer Service, spanning Hardware, Digital Services and third-party integrations. Drive clarity where strategy is undefined, and create frameworks that enable organizational action.

Partner with design on mockups and prototypes, scrutinizing details while aligning with strategic goals. Ensure customer validation reflects diverse perspectives and drive strategic CX conversations across your area.

Present regularly to Directors and VPs, align on OP1/OP2/goals, and own executive engagement for critical issues. Amplify impact by developing others and actively recruiting PM talent.

Engage senior decision-makers to uncover non-obvious insights. Define CS requirements, hold launches to a high experience bar, and advocate for prioritization of solutions that address customer feedback drivers.

A day in the life
On any given day, you will drive strategic conversations with senior leaders, leveraging data to influence investments and priorities to enhance the Alexa device and digital product Customer Service experience - advocating for upstream defect elimination, empowering customers with self-service capabilities or optimizing our human-in-the-loop support offering. title: Head of NAMER Partner Sales Strategy, AWS Partner Sales
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is seeking a Head of NAMER Partner Sales Strategy to serve as the strategic partner to the Director of NAMER Partner Sales. This role designs and evolves the Geo-level GTM execution framework across Deep, Focus, Scale, and Indirect partner engagement motions. You will operate at Geo scale across all NAMER divisions and partner development functions, anticipate organizational evolution, identify structural gaps before they create execution friction, and work with Partner & Field Sales Operations to operationalize strategic frameworks. This is a high-impact strategic position with influence across all partner sales divisions, AMER partner sales and development leadership, and field sales organizations.


Key job responsibilities
Operating Model Design & Evolution
You will design and evolve the GTM framework that governs how NAMER partner sales operates. This includes coverage models, sales play architecture, inspection cadences, and the mechanisms that translate strategy into PSL execution. You will stress-test the operating model against organizational priorities, identify drift patterns, and propose structural changes when the model no longer serves NAMER's growth objectives. You will work with divisional Partner Sales Leaders to ensure clarity on role boundaries, inspection logic, and escalation thresholds. Your work here sets the standard for how partner sales operates across the Geo.

Critical Inputs to NAMER Inspection Cadences
You will generate the strategic analytics and performance signals that inform all NAMER inspection cadences, including WBR, IPMM, MBR, Top Deals, MFR, and Forecast. For each cadence, you will prepare decision-ready briefs that surface the information leadership needs to govern and make course corrections. You will work with Sales Operations to ensure cadence logistics run smoothly while maintaining focus on the business signals that matter. Your analytical work will enable faster, more rigorous leadership decision-making.

Cross-Functional Accountability & Governance
You will work with AMER Partner Development (Consulting and Technology) leadership to ensure shared accountability with Geo and Division revenue outcomes. You will drive partner development investment aligned to NAMER division needs, support partner business/geo account and territory planning, influence top-of-funnel pipeline campaign builds and execution, govern partner-first and partner-led sales motion interlock with field sales leadership, and ensure cross-organizational escalation accountability to remove deal blockers and accelerate win rates.

Cross-Functional Goal Design & Cascade
You will influence quota methodology, partner-attached goal design (including field sales cascade), and compensation frameworks that align PSM and field seller behavior with partner-led growth strategy. Partner Sales Operations owns execution of partner sales goal setting and cadence. You will work with Partner Sales Operations and Field Sales Operations to design the logic of how NAMER goals cascade into division expectations and how partner-attach expectations flow to field sellers who do not have direct PSM coverage. Your work here ensures that partner-led growth becomes a structural expectation of the entire field sales organization, not just a PSM responsibility.

Data Governance & Analytics Infrastructure
You will define pipeline standards, funnel definitions, forecasting methodology, and KPIs that enable faster, data-driven leadership decision-making across NAMER. You will establish what constitutes qualified partner pipeline, what stage progression signals mean, and what metrics tell leadership whether a partner motion is working at scale. You will work with Sales Operations to translate these definitions into operational reality and with divisional leaders to ensure consistent application.

Revenue Operations Partnership
You will partner with Sales Operations to operationalize strategic frameworks. You set strategic requirements and performance standards; Sales Operations executes and maintains operational responsibility for cadence logistics, data governance, and systems integrity. The two functions operate as a flywheel to ensure strategy turns into measurable execution and can be continually improved.

About the team
AWS Partner Sales is the team responsible for driving partner-led revenue across AWS's largest and most complex enterprise customers. We operate at the intersection of enterprise sales, strategic alliances, and industry specialization—helping customers solve their most critical business challenges through the AWS partner ecosystem.

This role drives strategic initiatives that expand AWS's global reach and accessibility by increasing geographic payment coverage, diversifying payment methods, and reducing friction across customer touchpoints. The position requires balancing growth-oriented product innovation with operational excellence, overseeing initiatives that span from streamlining enterprise onboarding and payment experiences to pioneering next-generation capabilities like embedded checkout and AI-powered payment solutions. The leader will guide cross-functional teams to deliver measurable business impact through improved customer conversion, enhanced payment success rates, and optimized cash flow management, while building the foundation for future autonomous payment capabilities that meet customers wherever they are in their cloud journey.

Key job responsibilities
Strategic Leadership

Define and execute the multi-year product strategy for global payment adoption and customer accessibility across AWS's expanding customer base
Partner with senior leadership across AWS Billing, Accounting, FinTech, Sales, and external financial institutions to align product roadmaps with business objectives
Establish product metrics and KPIs that balance customer adoption, payment success rates, and revenue optimization

Product Development & Execution

Lead a team of product managers responsible for the payments adoption portfolio spanning payment methods expansion, enterprise onboarding, and GenAI-powered tools
Prioritize and sequence initiatives across geographic payment coverage expansion, payment method diversification, and customer contact point optimization
Coordinate product launches across 33+ engineering teams spanning multiple organizations
Champion customer-centric solutions that reduce barriers to AWS adoption while maintaining security, compliance, and financial controls
Champion AI-driven development in the organization, including GenAI applications for payment lifecycle management

Cross-Functional Collaboration

Work closely with engineering leaders to balance technical architecture decisions with product requirements across Payments and Fraud Prevention teams
Partner with operations teams to ensure products are scalable and operationally excellent across payment processing, cash application, and collections
Collaborate with legal, compliance, and security teams to navigate regulatory requirements across global markets and emerging payment technologies
Coordinate with external partners including payment processors, financial institutions, real-time payment networks, and blockchain providers

Innovation & Risk Management

Identify emerging payment technologies (real-time payments, stablecoins, embedded checkout) and financing models that could benefit AWS customers
Drive automation and machine learning initiatives to improve payment success rates and operational scalability
Balance innovation velocity with the security, stability, and compliance requirements of financial systems serving millions of customers globally


About the team
Join a mission-critical organization of 500+ builders protecting billions in AWS revenue while enabling seamless customer experiences across global markets. Our team combines world-class engineering talent with product innovation to solve complex challenges at the intersection of payments, fraud prevention, and customer adoption—managing the complete financial lifecycle from processing payments in 14+ currencies to detecting sophisticated fraud patterns and delivering innovative financing solutions.

You'll lead product managers who ship systems processing millions of daily transactions, leverage ML for fraud detection, and create products that accelerate customer success and expand AWS's global reach. This is a team where your decisions directly impact AWS's financial health, customer trust, and competitive advantage, working alongside passionate builders who thrive on solving hard problems at unprecedented scale while maintaining the highest standards of security and operational excellence.

Basic qualifications

- 5+ years of people management experience
- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related field
- Experience in people management
- Experience contributing to engineering discussions around technology decisions and strategy related to a product
- Experience overseeing roadmap strategy and definition
- Experience with feature delivery and tradeoffs of a product

Preferred qualifications

- 8+ years of successful technology products work from ideation through launch experience
- Experience in successful technology product work from ideation through launch
- Experience delivering technology products or services in a high growth environment
- Experience shaping business strategy for technical products or services for large enterprises or partners
- Experience with cloud native technologies

title: 2027 Applied Science Internship - United States, PhD Student Science Recruiting Frontier AI & Robotics, Frontier AI & Robotics
descriptionHtml:
Are you a brilliant mind seeking to push the boundaries of what's possible with intelligent robotics? Join our elite team of researchers and engineers - led by Pieter Abeel, Rocky Duan, and Peter Chen - at the forefront of applied science, where we're harnessing the latest advancements in large language models (LLMs) and generative AI to reshape the world of robotics and unlock new realms of innovation.
As an Applied Science Intern, you'll have the unique opportunity to work alongside world-renowned experts, gaining invaluable hands-on experience with cutting-edge robotics technologies. You'll dive deep into exciting research projects at the intersection of AI and robotics.
This internship is not just about executing tasks – it's about being a driving force behind groundbreaking discoveries. You'll collaborate with cross-functional teams, leveraging your expertise in areas such as deep learning, reinforcement learning, computer vision, and motion planning to tackle real-world problems and deliver impactful solutions.
Throughout your journey, you'll have access to unparalleled resources, including state-of-the-art computing infrastructure, cutting-edge research papers, and mentorship from industry luminaries. This immersive experience will not only sharpen your technical skills but also cultivate your ability to think critically, communicate effectively, and thrive in a fast-paced, innovative environment where bold ideas are celebrated.
Join us at the forefront of applied robotics and AI, where your contributions will shape the future of intelligent systems and propel humanity forward. Seize this extraordinary opportunity to learn, grow, and leave an indelible mark on the world of technology.

Must be eligible and available for a full-time (40h/ week) 12 week internship between May 2026 and September 2026.

Amazon has positions available in San Francisco, CA and Seattle, WA.

The ideal candidate should possess:
- Strong background in machine learning, deep learning, and/or robotics
- Publication record at science conferences such as NeurIPS, CVPR, ICRA, RSS, CoRL, and ICLR.
- Experience in areas such as multimodal LLMs, world models, image/video tokenization, real2Sim/Sim2real transfer, bimanual manipulation, open-vocabulary panoptic scene understanding, scaling up multi-modal LLMs, and end-to-end vision-language-action models.
- Proficiency in Python, Experience with PyTorch or JAX
- Excellent problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and the ability to work collaboratively in a team

Apply now and embark on an extraordinary journey of discovery and innovation!

Develop novel, scalable algorithms and modeling techniques that advance the state-of-the-art in areas at the intersection of LLMs and generative AI for robotics

Collaborate with cross-functional teams to solve complex problems, and to communicate research findings clearly, leveraging your expertise in areas such as deep learning, reinforcement learning, computer vision, and motion planning

Demonstrate the ability to work independently, thrive in a fast-paced, ever-changing environment, and communicate effectively with diverse stakeholders

Leverage AI-powered tools where applicable to accelerate research, experimentation, and prototyping. Critically review and validate outputs from AI tools and automated systems.

title: Program Manager , STEP
descriptionHtml:
Are you a resourceful program manager who thrives on turning complex, cross-functional challenges into clear plans and measurable outcomes?
We are looking for a Program Manager who will be responsible for managing STEP program (Tier based Incentive Program for Sellers). You will join a high performing, learning-oriented, analytical team who are motivated to work hard, have fun, and make history.
As a program manager, you will be owning relationships with our selling partners and resolve their issues to better seller experience. You will be responsible for working closely with sellers, liaison with internal Product & Program teams, SPS and account management teams to identify improvement areas and solve for the same to improve the seller experience on the Amazon platform.


Key job responsibilities
- Own and manage program delivery from concept through launch, defining goals, setting milestones, tracking progress, and proactively mitigating risks to keep scope and timelines on track.
- Partner with cross-functional teams and stakeholders to align on priorities, secure resources, and drive crisp decisions that accelerate program outcomes.
- Identify key performance indicators and success metrics for your programs, using data to evaluate progress, surface trade-offs, and recommend improvements that benefit the customer experience and business results.
- Communicate program status, risks, and strategic recommendations clearly to audiences ranging from working teams to senior leadership, building alignment and resolving conflicting viewpoints.
- Apply process improvement methodologies to simplify workflows, remove unnecessary complexity, and increase the productivity of the teams you collaborate with.
- Perform market studies through primary and secondary research to gather insights, collaborating with product teams to drive improvements.
- Develop dashboards and statistical models to streamline operations and increase team efficiency.

About the team
STEP is a seller tiering program that influences, guides and rewards sellers to improve customer inputs. It does so by creating a framework to tier seller basis their performance against pre-defined evaluation metrics and rewarding them differentially. Over the last two years, STEP program has driven improvements across key business metrics, such as Cancellation Rate and Late Dispatch Rate that it sought to influence. Voice of Seller (VOS) has been positive and also indicates that sellers leverage STEP to monitor their performance and improve customer experience.

Basic qualifications

- 3+ years of program or project management experience
- 3+ years of working cross functionally with tech and non-tech teams experience
- 3+ years of defining and implementing process improvement initiatives using data and metrics experience
- Knowledge of Excel (Pivot Tables, VLookUps) at an advanced level and SQL

Preferred qualifications

- 3+ years of driving end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership experience
- Experience in stakeholder management, dealing with multiple stakeholders at varied levels of the organization
