title: Support Engineer, Amazon Leo Enterprise Customer Support
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Leo is delivering fast, reliable internet to customers and communities beyond the reach of traditional networks. With thousands of satellites in low Earth orbit and a full-scale constellation deployment underway, we are bridging the digital divide for households, schools, hospitals, businesses, and governments in the most remote places on the planet. Our enterprise customers rely on seamless connectivity into AWS environments, making this role critical to enabling secure, high-performance cloud integration at the edge of space. Welcome to the space industry, and internet infrastructure at a scale never attempted before.

As an escalated tier role within Amazon Leo Enterprise Customer Support, you will own the resolution of the most complex networking cases that require deep subject matter expertise, from eBGP peering failures with ISP partners to routing anomalies cascading across customer networks spanning continents. We are looking for an SME who thrives in high-pressure environments and brings the technical depth to keep a space-based global network delivering for customers worldwide.
If you have deep expertise in internet routing, strong command of troubleshooting tools, and want to solve unprecedented challenges on a network unlike anything built before, we want to hear from you.



Key job responsibilities
• Lead the resolution of complex customer cases involving routing anomalies, BGP peering issues, connectivity degradation, and internet reachability failures.
• Provide in-depth technical guidance to customers and internal teams during high-severity incidents, partnering with development and operations teams to drive rapid resolution.
• Perform detailed root cause analysis (RCA) for customer-impacting events, identifying systemic issues and collaborating on long-term fixes.
• Troubleshoot SD-WAN/SDN connectivity issues across ISP backbone and customer edge networks, identifying misconfigurations and service-impacting faults.
• Proactively identify support gaps and contribute to tooling, diagnostics, and automation that reduce time to resolution and improve customer experience.
• Develop troubleshooting playbooks, technical guides, and knowledge base articles to enhance case deflection and onboarding of new support engineers.
• Mentor junior support engineers, providing case coaching, knowledge transfer, and technical escalation support.
• Work in a rotating shift schedule, including weekdays and weekends, with the requirement to be available for on-call duties as needed to ensure continuous operational coverage.

Export Control Requirement: Due to applicable export control laws and regulations, candidates must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.

As an escalated tier role within Amazon Leo Enterprise Customer Support, you will own the resolution of the most complex networking cases that require deep subject matter expertise, from eBGP peering failures with ISP partners to routing anomalies cascading across customer networks spanning continents. - Experience in technical support
- 4+ years of experience in ISP network operations, network engineering, or internet-facing network roles with focus on system troubleshooting and technical support.
- AWS Cloud Practitioner and CCNA/JNCIA certifications
- Proficiency in network protocols (TCP/IP, BGP, OSPF, IS-IS, DNS, DHCP, HTTP/S) and internet troubleshooting tools (traceroute, mtr, tcpdump, looking glass, BGP route collectors, packet captures, flow analysis).

title: Software Development Engineer, Global From Day1
descriptionHtml:
Fulfillment by Amazon (FBA) is Amazon's service for worldwide sellers, offering access to Amazon's vast distribution network as a service. Sellers in 135 countries worldwide — from Fortune 50 companies to hundreds of thousands of small businesses and entrepreneurs — rely on our world-leading technology to grow and thrive across Amazon's marketplaces.

Global from Day 1 is a bold new program within FBA making it possible for sellers to reach customers worldwide — not someday, but immediately. Multi-country sellers earn 70% more revenue on average, yet only ~30% list in more than one country today. We're changing that.

We are building a marketplace-agnostic Global Inventory Pool at Amazon's scale — where sellers ship their product once and replenish seamlessly across all FBA regions worldwide. This means building the foundational systems that represent, track, and integrate inventory across Amazon's global fulfillment network in real time, at massive scale, connecting to every layer of the fulfillment stack — leveraging AI frontier technologies to give sellers and Amazon real-time intelligence over global inventory at a scale never done before.

Key job responsibilities
- Architect and build highly reliable, scalable, multi-tenant distributed systems that power Amazon's marketplace-agnostic Global Inventory Pool — designing services that represent, track, and integrate inventory across the global fulfillment network in real time, enabling sellers to ship once into GWD and seamlessly replenish across all FBA regions worldwide. Own the end-to-end design from the seller's experience through to every layer of the fulfillment stack, with low-latency, high-availability guarantees at massive scale.

- Drive engineering and operational excellence across the full software lifecycle — from design through implementation, testing, deployment, and operations — setting a high bar for software quality through code reviews, design reviews, and automated testing; improving CI/CD pipelines, monitoring, alarming, and incident response for mission-critical inventory systems.

- Collaborate cross-functionally with Product, Design, Operations, and Sellers to define and refine end-to-end inventory workflows, translating complex seller needs and business requirements into clean, maintainable, and well-tested system designs.

- Leverage AI and frontier technologies to build real-time intelligence capabilities over global inventory — enabling sellers and Amazon to make data-driven decisions on inventory placement, replenishment, and cross-border supply chain optimization at a scale never done before.

- Mentor and coach SDEs on the team — training teammates on how the team's distributed inventory systems are constructed, how they operate, how they integrate across the fulfillment stack, and how to produce high-quality, production-ready code through mechanisms like code reviews.

- Identify and resolve complex, ambiguous technical problems autonomously — proactively investigating system bottlenecks, proposing architectural improvements, and influencing technical direction within the team to ensure the Global Inventory Pool platform scales with Amazon's global growth.

Basic qualifications

- 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
- 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
- 1+ years of software development engineer or related occupational experience
- 1+ years of designing and developing large-scale, multi-tiered, multi-threaded, embedded or distributed software applications, tools, systems, and services using: C#, C++, Java, or Perl experience
- 1+ years of Object Oriented Design experience
- Bachelor's degree or foreign equivalent in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field
- Experience programming with at least one software programming language

Preferred qualifications

- 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
- Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent
- Hands-on interest in applying LLMs and AI-native approaches to real engineering problems

title: Financial Analyst, Customer Fulfillment Finance
descriptionHtml:
We are looking for Financial Analyst that is excited to join a tech company that is constantly improving and reimagining the logistics industry. Our candidate should be passionate about using data to solve big, complex and ambiguous problems. The ideal candidate should be eager to continuously learn and improve their skills. You should be attentive to which details make all the difference. Do you want to contribute shaping the new standard of shopping? If so, come and join the Customer Fulfillment Finance Team.

As part of the Customer Fulfillment Finance team, you will join a team that is passionate about numbers, data, and how to use them to generate insights and improve our business. We support and influence the organization by providing a holistic and financial perspective, we are the trusted business advisors. We collaborate with our partners to ensure leaders have the most up to date and reliable information, and work with them to make sure we are making the best possible decisions.

Learning opportunities:
• Autonomy to innovate and deliver new approaches that impact the operations of the business
• Learn from inspiring and diverse team
• Growth in a fast-pace environment where every day is day one;
• Learn from people with a wide variety of professional backgrounds;
• Ability to develop new skills and opportunities through lateral, geographical or functional moves.

Key job responsibilities
• Leverages Customer Fulfillment metrics to identify cost out opportunities by linking up operations and financials
• Understands the details of the cost structure to make thoughtful judgement calls in ambiguous environments where data may be difficult to procure.
• Root cause analysis and uncovering core issues using data, then assisting the Fulfillment Center improve and create new measures for site productivity
• Builds trusted relationships with your business partners to influence and support tactical and strategic business decisions that steer business improvements and cost reductions
• Works with data source providers and technology teams to ensure that key decision data is accurate, automated and timely
• Owns the Financial and operational planning processes to produce a challenging/stretch/bold yet solid operational plan

A day in the life
You will mainly focus on performance metrics of Amazon fulfillment centers in the EU. You will own daily, weekly & monthly reporting, you will be involved in productivity reviews, you will travel across Continental Europe to visit other similar Amazon sites to understand differences and based on data analysis and your gained knowledge you will steer the Senior Leadership the right direction.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree
- Speak, write, and read fluently in English
- Experience developing financial models in Excel with advanced functions (pivot tables, macros, VBA, Power Query)
- Some experience in an analytical or numbers-driven role, or a strong academic foundation in a quantitative discipline

Preferred qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in finance, accounting, business, economics, or a related analytical field (e.g., engineering, math, computer science), or MBA
- Experience working with large-scale data mining and reporting tools (i.e. SQL, MS Power Query, Python), or experience working with Excel and large-scale data mining and reporting tools such as Python, SQL, or Tableau
- Experience in root cause analysis and troubleshooting or problem solving
- Experience working in a large team or fast-paced corporate environment
- Familiarity with basic finance concepts such as forecasting, budgeting and variance analysis.
- Experience with Generative Artificial Intelligence (GenAI) in a professional or academic environment.
- Good communication and presentation skills.
- Curiosity and a desire to learn and develop.

title: Regional Environmental Manager, Environmental Assurance and Protection Team
descriptionHtml:
At Amazon, we are committed to and invested in the natural environment because it is good for business, the planet, our customers, and our communities. The Middle East, Africa & Turkey (MEATR) Environmental Assurance and Protection (EAP) Field team capitalizes on Amazon's scale, speed and ability to invent and simplify to create a better and more resilient company. We manage our environmental impacts, uphold company standards and expectations, and seek to continuously improve the tools and processes that we use in doing so.

The MEATR team is seeking an experienced Environmental Professional to join the team and lead the environmental compliance aspects of Amazon's Quick Commerce (QC) business line and third-party (3P) logistics facilities across the United Arab Emirates (UAE), Saudi Arabia (KSA), Egypt, South Africa and Turkey. These are small-format urban facilities. This role will own the environmental program across environmental media (air, stormwater and wastewater, waste, etc.) and management programs (such as Spill Response, Regulatory Interactions) and roll them out in partnership with the Operations team and support functions who execute at site level. Country Environmental Managers will provide guidance on country-specific regulatory requirements.

This role will provide strategic direction supporting the Operations team and EAP field customers to ensure that designed programs and trainings are implemented and meet each stakeholder group's needs. This role will also work with consultants and technical teams to resolve regulated environmental program barriers and provide guidance, and will support the MEATR Environmental Leader in environmental data management and business reporting for this business line to meet Amazon's high bar.

The ideal candidate must possess proficiency in environmental programs and regulations and demonstrate this expertise when partnering with teams. The successful candidate must be able to work successfully in a fast-paced environment, have a results-oriented approach, strong analytical skills, and excellent written and verbal communication skills, and experience in implementing processes and procedures across multiple regions, sites or businesses.

This position will directly report to the MEATR Environmental Leader.

Key job responsibilities
Support business line and country-specific environmental compliance programs and procedures for small-format urban facilities, including waste segregation and storage standards, hazardous waste management, spill response, etc., and ensure compliance.

Ensure the environmental requirements are embedded in third-party (3P) logistics contracts and service agreements, covering inventory waste handling and storage, licensed disposal vendors for inventory waste, manifest retention, audit rights, and related obligations.

Work with internal stakeholders, such as Operations (including ACES), Workplace Health & Safety (WHS), Facilities, Legal, Dangerous Goods, Engineering, Reliability Maintenance Engineering (RME), Procurement, Learning and Development, Real Estate and GES team for new buildings, to identify and remove barriers for successful environmental program development, deployment and process improvements, and to secure senior-level commitment to environmental requirements for this business line.

Assess and identify applicable environmental operating permits, licenses, classifications and recurring municipal reporting obligations across all five countries, maintain them in the environmental compliance platform, and drive renewal actions with the Operations team.

Conduct site assessments and environmental inspections across the portfolio to verify program adoption, identify compliance gaps, and record findings and corrective actions in the environmental compliance platform.

Roll out the program across the portfolio working with the Operations team, defining the standard, sequence, training and completion criteria, and verifying adoption.

Release network alerts to stakeholders on new developments, requirements, and updates around the programs.

Deploy and review environmental performance against applicable key performance indicators with their owners.

Support the Operations team during regulatory interactions and agency inspections at QC sites.

Support and lead the preparation and finalization of environmental business review reports for the business line.

Identify large-scale opportunities and partner with the program team to develop, integrate and implement standardized programs that maintain compliance while reducing the burden on Amazon's resources.

Supervise consultants and third-party environmental service providers hired to deliver specific products and services under the EAP scope for QC and 3PL.

A day in the life

Basic qualifications

- Experience managing multiple competing priorities simultaneously and driving goals to completion
- Experience developing and implementing environmental compliance programs including regulated waste, water, and air regulations in accordance with applicable laws
- Experience in English-language communication skills, both written and verbal
- 6+ years of experience serving as an environment manager, program specialist, or program manager.
- Experience developing and managing environmental programs for air, waste, and water.
- Experience rolling out a compliance program across a multi-site portfolio and working with multiple stakeholders
- Experience managing environmental permits and licenses, including application, renewal and regulatory inspection response.
- Bachelor's degree in safety, environmental, or equivalent field of study

Preferred qualifications

- Advanced degree or professional certification in an Environmental, Sustainability, EHS or related fields
- ISO 14000 or equivalent program development and auditing experience
- Experience with environmental compliance management platforms and site environmental risk assessment methodology.
- Written and verbal communication skills in Arabic or Turkish.

title: Sr. Software Dev Engineer, Verification Services

title: Stagiaire Partenaire Ressources Humaines Opérations (6 Mois) - 2027
descriptionHtml:
Résumé du poste

L’énergie qui fait tourner le monde | Découvrez les carrières dans les Opérations

Les postes dans les Opérations chez Amazon vous placent au cœur de la façon dont les choses circulent, d’un simple clic jusqu’à la porte du client.
Vous contribuerez à concevoir, améliorer et faire fonctionner des systèmes qui relient les personnes, les produits et les lieux, à grande échelle. Vous prendrez des responsabilités dès le début, travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec les équipes pour résoudre des défis concrets, et verrez les résultats directs de vos décisions lorsqu’elles atteignent les clients chaque jour.
Ici, l’impact de ce que vous construisez n’est pas abstrait : il est visible, immédiat et significatif — il maintient en mouvement l’une des opérations les plus complexes au monde.
C’est ici que votre parcours prend forme, à travers l’action, la responsabilité et la possibilité d’évoluer dans de multiples directions.


Key job responsibilities
Principales responsabilités du poste

- Développer une connaissance approfondie des fonctions RH au sein des opérations dynamiques d’Amazon
- Participer aux efforts de communication interne afin d’aligner les équipes de plusieurs pays, en favorisant la collaboration et le partage d’informations
- Aider à élaborer des plans et des supports de formation répondant aux besoins de développement évolutifs des différentes équipes, afin de soutenir la croissance des collaborateurs et collaboratrices
- Découvrir les fonctions RH au sein de l’organisation Amazon au sens large et se tenir informé(e) des meilleures pratiques
- Apporter un soutien aux employé(e)s d’Amazon sur diverses questions quotidiennes liées à la présence, à l’engagement, à la rémunération et à d’autres sujets RH
- Assister les équipes RH dans les routines opérationnelles quotidiennes et les tâches administratives
- Participer à des revues de processus afin d’identifier des opportunités de simplification et d’automatisation, en améliorant l’efficacité
- Compiler des statistiques du personnel, des rapports et des évaluations de performance complets afin d’éclairer la prise de décision
- Collaborer étroitement avec les responsables opérationnel(le)s afin d’aligner les stratégies et initiatives RH sur les objectifs et priorités de l’organisation


A day in the life
Une journée type

Chaque journée est un peu différente en tant que Stagiaire Partenaire Ressources Humaines Opérations. Ce stage vous plongera dans les RH au sein d’une organisation mondiale, avec la possibilité de travailler sur des projets couvrant différents domaines RH — des relations sociales et de la formation à la rémunération et à l’analyse des effectifs. Vous pourriez passer votre matinée à analyser des données sur les effectifs afin d’identifier des tendances et de formuler des recommandations pour votre équipe, puis votre après-midi à accompagner un dossier de relations sociales ou à collaborer avec des responsables opérationnel(le)s sur une initiative de formation.
La fonction RH d’Amazon est profondément intégrée à l’activité ; ainsi, quel que soit le projet sur lequel vous travaillez, une partie de votre rôle consistera à utiliser les données et la réflexion analytique pour orienter les décisions. Vous appliquerez vos compétences en résolution de problèmes et vos compétences techniques à des défis concrets, tout en développant d’importantes compétences en communication et des compétences comportementales professionnelles grâce à une expérience pratique. Avec un(e) mentor(e) dédié(e) qui accompagnera votre développement tout au long du programme, vous découvrirez comment les RH s’associent à l’activité pour stimuler la croissance et l’excellence organisationnelle — offrant une base solide pour une carrière dans les ressources humaines.
Remarque : vous devez avoir le droit de travailler dans le pays d’emploi à la date de début.


About the team
À propos de l’équipe

Communauté des stagiaires :
En tant que stagiaire Amazon, vous ferez partie d’une communauté dynamique et bienveillante qui favorise votre croissance et votre développement. Vous collaborerez avec des stagiaires du monde entier, développerez votre réseau et participerez à des événements sociaux pour élargir vos perspectives. Vous pourrez également rejoindre des groupes spécialisés axés sur des thèmes tels que la durabilité, afin d’explorer vos centres d’intérêt variés.

Accompagnement :
Le programme de stage offre un solide dispositif d’accompagnement, comprenant des permanences hebdomadaires pour les stagiaires, un support informatique et RH dédié, ainsi qu’une équipe programme engagée dans votre réussite. Cela vous garantit l’encadrement et l’aide nécessaires pour vous épanouir.

Sessions d’apprentissage :
Des sessions d’apprentissage exclusives développeront encore vos compétences, en vous donnant accès aux plateformes d’apprentissage de pointe d’Amazon et à l’expertise de leaders du secteur. Ces opportunités de développement structurées vous prépareront à l’étape suivante de votre carrière.

Opportunités :
À l’issue réussie du stage, vous pourrez être considéré(e) pour un poste de jeune diplômé(e) ou un second stage, vous permettant de poursuivre votre parcours avec Amazon. De plus, vous bénéficierez d’un salaire mensuel compétitif, d’un soutien à la relocalisation et d’un accès à une gamme d’avantages réservés aux employés.

Dates de début des stages tout au long de l’année :
Nous recrutons des stagiaires pour un début à tout moment entre janvier et septembre 2027. Chaque mois, nous organiserons 1 à 2 journées d’intégration pour les nouveaux et nouvelles arrivant(e)s.

Basic qualifications

- Actuellement en dernière année et préparant une licence ou un master universitaire en RH, administration des affaires, psychologie, marketing, sciences sociales, droit ou dans un domaine connexe (à orientation sciences humaines), ou dans une discipline similaire
- Disponible pour un stage à temps plein (35 heures/semaine) et s'engager sur un stage de 6 mois
- Parler, écrire et lire couramment l'anglais et le français à un niveau C1 ou supérieur
- Obligatoire de pouvoir signer une convention de stage avec l'université de l'étudiant(e)

Preferred qualifications

- Solides compétences en résolution de problèmes et en analyse, avec la capacité d'utiliser les données pour orienter les décisions
- Excellentes compétences en communication et en travail d'équipe, avec la capacité de collaborer efficacement avec diverses parties prenantes
- Curiosité, proactivité et volonté avérées d'apprendre et de se développer dans un environnement dynamique

Amazon est un employeur engagé pour l'égalité des chances. Nous sommes convaincus qu'une main d'oeuvre diversifée est essentielle à notre réussite. Nous prenons nos décisions de recrutement en fonction de votre expérience et de vos compétences. Nous apprécions votre envie de découvrir, d'inventer, de simplifier et de construire. title: Fire Protection Design Engineer, Data Center Engineering
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Web Services is seeking an Fire Protection Design Engineer to become part of a global engineering team, responsible for the design and continuous innovation of our rapidly expanding data center foot print.

Join our innovative team where you can shape the future of data center fire protection on a global scale. As a Fire Protection Engineer, you'll collaborate with diverse teams to design and implement safety systems that protect some of the world's most critical infrastructure.

Key job responsibilities
- Design and oversee comprehensive fire protection systems for data centers worldwide

- Collaborate with cross-functional teams to develop and implement fire safety solutions

- Review and ensure compliance with international fire protection standards

- Provide technical guidance on fire protection engineering matters

- Support continuous improvement of design standards and methodologies

A day in the life
Your day will be a dynamic blend of technical expertise and collaborative problem-solving. You'll engage with architects, engineers, and global teams to develop innovative fire safety strategies, conduct detailed analyses, and create comprehensive protection solutions that push the boundaries of technological safety.

About the team
Our Data Center Design Engineering team brings together diverse perspectives from multiple engineering disciplines. We nurture an inclusive environment where collaboration and innovation thrive. Together, we're committed to developing sustainable, secure, and efficient data centers that support global technology infrastructure.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering or a related field
- Knowledge of Microsoft Office including Outlook, Word, and Excel
- Experience in industrial or commercial engineering in mission critical facilities including but not limited to: data centers, power generation or oil and gas facilities
- Experience researching new designs, technologies, and construction methods of data center equipment and facilities
- Experience in commissioning

Preferred qualifications

- Professional Engineer License
- Experience with building codes and regulations for your region
- Experience carrying design concepts through exploration, development, and into deployment or mass production
- Experience reading, interpreting, and creating construction drawings, specifications, and submittal documents

title: Program Manager, IN Launch, GESI-IN Launch
descriptionHtml:
Are you interested in launching the next generation of Amazon sites in India? Do you want to be part of the ongoing growth and expansion of Amazon’s infrastructure? The IN-Engineering Services Team is seeking an experienced Amazon Operator or Program Manager to join the IN-Launch Team to support the expansion of operation sites in India. The Launch Program Manager is a key player in the end-to-end delivery of the complex challenge of launching new buildings, driving improvements and standards to enable new buildings to achieve benchmark rates while ramping to meet network capacity. In this role, you will influence a team comprising of General Managers, Senior Operations Managers, Operation Managers, Change Ops manager, Area Managers, Project Managers, Process SMEs, Design Engineers, Real Estate, RME, CP as well as representatives of various key stakeholder teams including Supply Chain & Transportation, WHS, WFS, L&D, ICQA, EHS, Legal, L&P, ER, Finance and many others. This role calls for an individual who is operationally knowledgeable, structured, confident and professionally and socially adept to earn credibility and trust with customers and stakeholders at various levels of the organization, keeping an open mind, sense of humor, multi-tasking, ability to manage and deal with constant change, a drive-and-ambition and ability to deal with ambiguity will help you remain innovative in our culture
In order to be successful in this position, you need to be comfortable interfacing and driving various BU’s launches, including INFC, IXD/RC, DRCC, SDC, SC, AMZL, GSF, QC & 3P launches for respective BU’s. This will be an exciting opportunity for you if you possess a high level of autonomy and integrity while managing a variety of job responsibilities. You will be part of a high functioning team that is interconnected and supportive of each other to help complete multiple, complex and high capital projects simultaneously.
The individual will be responsible for entire region (IN Network Operate in 3 Regions, “North & East”, “South & Central” and “West”). The role will be based out of 3 regions with up to 50% of time on job travel across states. This is the fusion of strategical as well as tactical during full cycle of launch.


Key job responsibilities
The successful candidate:
• Is structured and organized, to plan the use of resource to meet deadlines.
• Has strong interpersonal skills, to motivate and lead core teams working on launch.
• Has strong communication skills to build relationships and identify with stakeholders across the organization.
• Is able to use their initiative and make decisions under pressure.
• Has the ability to seek opportunities to drive year on year performance and process improvements
• Will compile, manage and report on weekly launch metrics and be responsible for leading many high-profile meetings to align on launch requirements.
• Has the ability to learn fast and adapt quickly to changing circumstances.
• Has operational skills and experience.
• Can work closely with core team from operational and construction sites.
• Setup mechanism for tracking overall launch, support function 4M and signage delivery system.
• Drive learnings and adhoc requirements through CM mechanism from respective stakeholders.
• Can work independently to solve problems and drive actions with a variety of stakeholders.
• Monitors and reports on the progress of all launch activity within the site project including significant milestones and any conditions which would affect project schedule.
• Should be able to ask “Why” and request details in regards to the impact of any changes requested by different teams.
• Is capable of taking accountability while providing status, asking for help, and immediately escalating issues and problems as necessary.
• Should be able to coordinate activities while onsite as well as from the office.
• Possesses a broad technical background and has the ability to “roll up their sleeves” and jump in to support, along with Coordinating the activities of different functions and act as the anchor or single point of contact for the launch process


A day in the life
• End-to-End project coordination, managing multiple stakeholders to ensure all Road to Launch tasks are completed as per program
• Managing Launch calls with regional teams, documenting key actionable and ensure closure of key points.
• Ensuring support function 4M cycle completion as per process.
• Ensuring all function signage cycle completion as per process.
• Ensure 5S marking BOQ closure as per site requirement.
• Coordinate with RE for site selection process as per SLA and POR NBD with SIM mechanism in place.
• Ensure TAX registration process and support seller onboarding process as per Launch tenets.
• Ensuring overall site readiness through thorough composite reviews and effective communication on in-flight changes
• Post launch lessons learned sessions to drive year-on-year improvements
• Managing continuous improvement in 4M, Playbook, Signages and launch mechanism.


About the team
Our team is focused on driving programmatic excellence across Amazon, delivering results that matter to customers and the business. We operate in a collaborative environment where new ideas are welcomed and simplification is a priority. As we continue to grow, we are investing in automation, data-driven planning, and scalable mechanisms that raise the bar on how we deliver. This is a team where your leadership will have a direct impact on both the people you manage and the programs you own.

Basic qualifications

- 5+ years of program or project management experience
- Experience using data and metrics to determine and drive improvements
- Experience owning program strategy, end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership
- Experience owning program strategy, end-to-end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership

Preferred qualifications

- 2+ years of driving process improvements experience
- Master's degree, or MBA in business, operations, human resources, adult education, organizational development, instructional design or related field

title: Fulfillment Center Supervisor
descriptionHtml:
We’re expanding our team within Amazon Operations! If you’re interested in joining a business where you can have fun, achieve amazing results and put smiles on people’s faces, this could be the role for you.

You will oversee the shift management in one of our first mile fulfillment centers, middle mile sortation centers or final mile delivery stations. Our Operations Specialists drive the pulse of our operations on the ground and play a key role in getting our customers’ orders out to them in every step of the chain.
This is a varied, challenging role and every day is different!


Key job responsibilities
• Create and cultivate a safe working environment by identifying safety opportunities across your work area
• Manage and train our Associates to help deliver the best service for our customers
• Ensure that customer orders are fulfilled in line with quality and safety guidelines
• Continuously provide critical shift related information to frontline management and operators
• Adjust labor allocation throughout your shifts to meet and exceed plans and forecasts
• Engage with support functions and/or other departments to address common issues or needs in key areas of performance e.g. process area readiness, 5S, safety, training
• Help to solve logistics and supply chain challenges through data analysis, innovation and process optimization

Basic qualifications

- 1+ years of Microsoft Office products and applications experience
- 1+ years of Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, and Outlook) experience
- high school diploma or equivalent
- High school or equivalent
- Work a flexible schedule/shift/work area, including weekends, nights, and/or holidays
- Can lift up to 49 pounds, stand/walk during shifts lasting up to 12 hours, and be able to frequently push, pull, squat, bend, and reach
- Work 40 hours/week, and overtime as required
- Work flexible schedules including weekends, nights, and holidays

Preferred qualifications

- Knowledge of Lean, Six Sigma and Kaizen techniques

title: Stagiaire Partenaire Ressources Humaines Opérations (6 Mois) - 2027
descriptionHtml:
Résumé du poste

L’énergie qui fait tourner le monde | Découvrez les carrières dans les Opérations

Les postes dans les Opérations chez Amazon vous placent au cœur de la façon dont les choses circulent, d’un simple clic jusqu’à la porte du client.
Vous contribuerez à concevoir, améliorer et faire fonctionner des systèmes qui relient les personnes, les produits et les lieux, à grande échelle. Vous prendrez des responsabilités dès le début, travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec les équipes pour résoudre des défis concrets, et verrez les résultats directs de vos décisions lorsqu’elles atteignent les clients chaque jour.
Ici, l’impact de ce que vous construisez n’est pas abstrait : il est visible, immédiat et significatif — il maintient en mouvement l’une des opérations les plus complexes au monde.
C’est ici que votre parcours prend forme, à travers l’action, la responsabilité et la possibilité d’évoluer dans de multiples directions.


Key job responsibilities
Principales responsabilités du poste

- Développer une connaissance approfondie des fonctions RH au sein des opérations dynamiques d’Amazon
- Participer aux efforts de communication interne afin d’aligner les équipes de plusieurs pays, en favorisant la collaboration et le partage d’informations
- Aider à élaborer des plans et des supports de formation répondant aux besoins de développement évolutifs des différentes équipes, afin de soutenir la croissance des collaborateurs et collaboratrices
- Découvrir les fonctions RH au sein de l’organisation Amazon au sens large et se tenir informé(e) des meilleures pratiques
- Apporter un soutien aux employé(e)s d’Amazon sur diverses questions quotidiennes liées à la présence, à l’engagement, à la rémunération et à d’autres sujets RH
- Assister les équipes RH dans les routines opérationnelles quotidiennes et les tâches administratives
- Participer à des revues de processus afin d’identifier des opportunités de simplification et d’automatisation, en améliorant l’efficacité
- Compiler des statistiques du personnel, des rapports et des évaluations de performance complets afin d’éclairer la prise de décision
- Collaborer étroitement avec les responsables opérationnel(le)s afin d’aligner les stratégies et initiatives RH sur les objectifs et priorités de l’organisation


A day in the life
Une journée type

Chaque journée est un peu différente en tant que Stagiaire Partenaire Ressources Humaines Opérations. Ce stage vous plongera dans les RH au sein d’une organisation mondiale, avec la possibilité de travailler sur des projets couvrant différents domaines RH — des relations sociales et de la formation à la rémunération et à l’analyse des effectifs. Vous pourriez passer votre matinée à analyser des données sur les effectifs afin d’identifier des tendances et de formuler des recommandations pour votre équipe, puis votre après-midi à accompagner un dossier de relations sociales ou à collaborer avec des responsables opérationnel(le)s sur une initiative de formation.
La fonction RH d’Amazon est profondément intégrée à l’activité ; ainsi, quel que soit le projet sur lequel vous travaillez, une partie de votre rôle consistera à utiliser les données et la réflexion analytique pour orienter les décisions. Vous appliquerez vos compétences en résolution de problèmes et vos compétences techniques à des défis concrets, tout en développant d’importantes compétences en communication et des compétences comportementales professionnelles grâce à une expérience pratique. Avec un(e) mentor(e) dédié(e) qui accompagnera votre développement tout au long du programme, vous découvrirez comment les RH s’associent à l’activité pour stimuler la croissance et l’excellence organisationnelle — offrant une base solide pour une carrière dans les ressources humaines.
Remarque : vous devez avoir le droit de travailler dans le pays d’emploi à la date de début.


About the team
À propos de l’équipe

Communauté des stagiaires :
En tant que stagiaire Amazon, vous ferez partie d’une communauté dynamique et bienveillante qui favorise votre croissance et votre développement. Vous collaborerez avec des stagiaires du monde entier, développerez votre réseau et participerez à des événements sociaux pour élargir vos perspectives. Vous pourrez également rejoindre des groupes spécialisés axés sur des thèmes tels que la durabilité, afin d’explorer vos centres d’intérêt variés.

Accompagnement :
Le programme de stage offre un solide dispositif d’accompagnement, comprenant des permanences hebdomadaires pour les stagiaires, un support informatique et RH dédié, ainsi qu’une équipe programme engagée dans votre réussite. Cela vous garantit l’encadrement et l’aide nécessaires pour vous épanouir.

Sessions d’apprentissage :
Des sessions d’apprentissage exclusives développeront encore vos compétences, en vous donnant accès aux plateformes d’apprentissage de pointe d’Amazon et à l’expertise de leaders du secteur. Ces opportunités de développement structurées vous prépareront à l’étape suivante de votre carrière.

Opportunités :
À l’issue réussie du stage, vous pourrez être considéré(e) pour un poste de jeune diplômé(e) ou un second stage, vous permettant de poursuivre votre parcours avec Amazon. De plus, vous bénéficierez d’un salaire mensuel compétitif, d’un soutien à la relocalisation et d’un accès à une gamme d’avantages réservés aux employés.

Dates de début des stages tout au long de l’année :
Nous recrutons des stagiaires pour un début à tout moment entre janvier et septembre 2027. Chaque mois, nous organiserons 1 à 2 journées d’intégration pour les nouveaux et nouvelles arrivant(e)s.

Basic qualifications

- Actuellement en dernière année et préparant une licence ou un master universitaire en RH, administration des affaires, psychologie, marketing, sciences sociales, droit ou dans un domaine connexe (à orientation sciences humaines), ou dans une discipline similaire
- Disponible pour un stage à temps plein (35 heures/semaine) et s'engager sur un stage de 6 mois
- Parler, écrire et lire couramment l'anglais et le français à un niveau C1 ou supérieur
- Obligatoire de pouvoir signer une convention de stage avec l'université de l'étudiant(e)

Preferred qualifications

- Solides compétences en résolution de problèmes et en analyse, avec la capacité d'utiliser les données pour orienter les décisions
- Excellentes compétences en communication et en travail d'équipe, avec la capacité de collaborer efficacement avec diverses parties prenantes
- Curiosité, proactivité et volonté avérées d'apprendre et de se développer dans un environnement dynamique

Amazon est un employeur engagé pour l'égalité des chances. Nous sommes convaincus qu'une main d'oeuvre diversifée est essentielle à notre réussite. Nous prenons nos décisions de recrutement en fonction de votre expérience et de vos compétences. Nous apprécions votre envie de découvrir, d'inventer, de simplifier et de construire. La protection de votre vie privée et la sécurité de vos données constituent depuis longtemps une priorité absolue pour Amazon. Veuillez consulter notre Politique de Confidentialité pour en savoir plus sur la façon dont nous collectons, utilisons et traitons les données personnelles de nos candidats.

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

title: Corporate Human Resources Partner Intern (6 Months) - 2027
descriptionHtml:
There’s a universe of opportunity at Amazon.

At Amazon, your career doesn’t follow a straight line. It accelerates, twists, and challenges you in ways you never expected. From the moment you join, you’re part of something big: building products or services that reach millions and shaping how people live, work, and connect every day. This is where your ideas turn into real impact.
You’ll work with world class tools, global platforms, and systems built to operate at an extraordinary scale. You’ll move fast, experiment and launch solutions that matter. With endless opportunities to explore across teams and roles, you’ll learn quickly, apply what you know and discover skills you didn’t know existed. This is an environment designed for builders who want to see the impact of their work in the world. Ready to start your adventure?

What’s in it for you?

An internship at Amazon means real responsibility from day one. You’ll build, test, and learn alongside people who want to see you succeed, while making an impact that reaches far beyond campus.

Key job responsibilities
- Manage an end-to-end project with one of Amazon's HR teams in EMEA over a 12-week period
- Collaborate with senior management and business partners, as well as cross-functional HR support teams, to gain a 360-degree view of Amazon's approach to human resources

title: Sr. Infrastructure Reliability Engineer, Infrastructure Reliability & Quality
descriptionHtml:
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

As a Senior Infrastructure Reliability Engineer you will be proactively driving the reliability risk identification, assessment and mitigation for datacenter infrastructure equipment (Example: Busduct, Tapoff Box, MV Transformers, LV SWGR, Breakers, UPS, Power Distribution Cabinets etc.). You will also be responsible for root cause analysis of critical equipment failures and drive the continuous improvements to improve datacenter availability for AWS customers. You will work closely with both internal and outside partners including suppliers to drive key aspects of product specification, risk identification plan and execution. You must be ownership minded, independent, action and results oriented to succeed in an open collaborative environment.

The candidate should have experience in using Physics-of-Failure based approach to develop and implement both analytical and empirical approaches for product quality/reliability risk identification and assessment during product design, manufacture as well as deployment stages. The individual should be able to drive AWS application-specific requirements in carrying out both lifecycle environmental and operational stress driven risk analysis, including thermal, electrical, chemical and mechanical stresses so to identify overstress and fatigue-related product weaknesses. Candidate should be capable of evaluating not only product design quality/reliability risks, but also have the skills and experiences in assessing electronics manufacture process related quality/reliability issues. Knowledge of statistical techniques and models is required to analyze test as well as field data.

At the component level, the individual will drive critical component identification and the associated vendor selection and qualification requirements. The candidate will be expected to use knowledge of process capability for electronic component production as well as system-level performance requirements to establish critical to quality and reliability metrics.
At the system level, the individual will develop datacenter system level reliability model and related reliability quantification and risk analysis for datacenter configuration optimization. The candidate will be expected to be familiar with system reliability engineering tools, such as reliability block diagram, statistical modeling and data analytics.

During sustaining stage, candidate will be responsible for monitoring product performance in the field and will be responsible to drive root cause analysis of any critical failures and the associated corrective and preventive actions. The individual should also be able to drive effective vendor auditing and quarterly review process to drive the continuous improvements of datacenter availability.

The successful candidate should be considered as an expert in the reliability engineering field and have a proven track record of success in not only product reliability leadership, as well as business negotiations and program management. Strong skill-set in problem analysis and solving as well as communication and vendor management are necessary. Candidates should also be able to travel internationally.

title: Software Development Engineer, Selling Partner Experience Core Services
descriptionHtml:
Millions of sellers list products on Amazon. You'll own the services that tell them what a valid listing needs, get their submissions live, and explain what to fix when one fails.

Selling on Amazon comes down to three things a seller has to get right: learn what a valid listing needs, get it submitted, and fix it when something goes wrong. We build for all three, in every marketplace where Amazon operates. Some of our services tell a seller what their category requires before they submit, and whether their product is already in our catalog. Others take listings in and update them, one at a time or thousands at once in a bulk feed, and carry them through to a live offer. When something breaks, ours are the services that say what went wrong, in the seller's own language, while there's still time to fix it.

You'll work on software that every seller and every seller tool passes through. The problems are API design, concurrency, event-driven processing, and data modeling over a catalog whose rules shift by product, by marketplace, and by seller. You'll own what you build, from design through production and the on-call rotation that follows, on a team cutting years of overlapping systems down to fewer and simpler ones. There's room to grow into owning a system end to end.

Key job responsibilities
- Own features end to end, from understanding what the customer needs through design, code, tests, deployment, documentation, and the operations that follow. This includes refactoring and removing software, not only writing new software.
- Design solutions to difficult problems where the goal is clear but the implementation is not. Reduce them to the simplest design that works, and review that design with senior engineers before you build it.
- Operate what you build. Take part in an on-call rotation, hold the line on the latency and availability sellers depend on, drive issues to a permanent root cause fix, and automate recurring work instead of absorbing it.
- Document how your systems are built, tested, secured, and operated, and train new engineers on them. Give useful review feedback to engineers at every level, including engineers more senior than you.
- Work with the customers and partner teams that depend on your services, and make priority calls between new features, operational work, and business commitments. Keep your tools current, including AI-assisted development, and stay accountable for the quality of everything you ship.

A day in the life
You join a team of six to twelve engineers, with a manager and senior engineers who read your designs and your code. A typical day looks like this:

- Participating in stand-ups, sprint planning, and retrospectives
- Writing, testing, and debugging code for ongoing projects
- Reviewing code and incorporating feedback from your team
- Collaborating on technical solutions in design and architecture reviews
- Working with stakeholders to understand requirements
- Monitoring existing systems and resolving production issues
- Documenting technical specifications and processes
- Learning and applying new technologies and best practices
Sellers are on the other end of all of it. A change you write this month is something a seller runs into next month, and the feedback comes back fast.

About the team
Our customers are the sellers who list products on Amazon, the software companies that build tools for them, and the internal teams that serve them. Sellers should not have to learn how Amazon works internally in order to sell on Amazon, so we absorb that complexity instead of passing it to them. Our teams together cover the full path a listing takes: creating and updating listings, defining what a valid listing requires and what already exists in the catalog, and telling sellers what is wrong and what to do about it.

Our direction for the next few years is set. Make listing simple enough that sellers bring us their whole catalog. Make selling in several stores as straightforward as selling in one. Raise the quality and completeness of the catalog underneath both, and tell a seller about a restriction before it costs them a listing rather than after. Getting there means fewer systems, not more, so we are consolidating overlapping tools, retiring the ones that no longer earn their place, and applying AI both in what we ship to sellers and in how we build it. You will own parts of that work, with room to grow into owning a system end to end.

Basic qualifications

- 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
- 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
- Experience programming with at least one software programming language
- Experience in written and oral communication, including the ability to communicate with all levels in the organization (technical, business, executive)

Preferred qualifications

- Experience with full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations
- Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent
- Demonstrated experience leveraging generative AI tools to enhance workflow efficiency and productivity, with the ability to craft effective prompts and critically evaluate AI-generated outputs in a professional setting
- Experience identifying opportunities to integrate AI solutions into products and services to drive business value

descriptionHtml:
As part of the AWS Applied AI Solutions organization, we have a vision to provide business applications, leveraging Amazon’s unique experience and expertise, that are used by millions of companies worldwide to manage day-to-day operations. We will accomplish this by accelerating our customers’ businesses through delivery of intuitive and differentiated technology solutions that solve enduring business challenges. We blend vision with curiosity and Amazon’s real-world experience to build opinionated, turnkey solutions. Where customers prefer to buy over build, we become their trusted partner with solutions that are no-brainers to buy and easy to use.

Amazon Web Services is seeking an experienced, Technical Training Specialist who thrives in a dynamic, fast-paced environment and brings a solid background working in technical environments and with technical customers. This role will act as a Global Learning Technical Training Specialist for the AWS Trust & Safety (T&S) organization and will support T&S’s transformation into a signals-intelligence organization where builders and AI agents work collaboratively. You will serve technical customers whose roles are rapidly transitioning to complex investigation work requiring AI copilot collaboration, automation oversight, cross-domain investigation, and customer engagement during incidents.
This is a technical individual-contributor role. You will develop and maintain genuine fluency in the systems your work covers - platform migrations, AI workflows, and proficiency-routing architectures - understand the design approaches and technologies used in your program area, spot risks, ask the right technical questions to ensure appropriate trade-offs are made, and simplify technical complexity. You will apply that technical judgment to design and build the training and enablement that equips technical customers to do complex work, translating system and architecture changes into clear, accurate, outcome-based learning.
Working with limited guidance, you will decide which actions to take to meet goals and design solutions for your area, partnering closely with engineering and technical teams, SMEs, and operations. You will author technical documentation, build hands-on and applied learning, measure effectiveness, and drive the adoption of AI-powered tools across the GL T&S learning lifecycle. You will apply sound program discipline - scoping, sequencing, stakeholder alignment, risk mitigation, and impact reporting - to deliver your solutions on time and to a high bar.


Key job responsibilities
1. Apply technical judgment - Develop fluency in the technical systems in your program area ; understand design approaches and technology trade-offs, spot risks in proposed solutions, and ask the right technical questions to ensure sound trade-offs are made.
2. Design and build technical training - Translate complex technical systems and architecture changes into structured, outcome-based learning for technical customers - learning paths, hands-on labs, applied exercises, and job aids that build real proficiency, not just awareness.
3. Author technical documentation - Produce and maintain clear, accurate technical documentation and content: SOPs, training architecture narratives, functional requirements, design specifications, and reference material, validated for technical accuracy with engineering and SMEs.
4. Serve as the technical liaison - Translate architecture and workflow changes into learning requirements, simplify technical complexity into deliverable solutions, and flag risks that impact scope, quality, or builder capacity.
5. Drive AI enablement - Champion adoption of AI-powered content-development tools, just-in-time delivery, and Agentic Skills frameworks to improve the efficiency, scale, and currency of technical enablement.
6. Leverage learning platforms and LMS - Deploy, track, and scale technical training through the learning management system (LMS) and learning platforms; analyze LMS data to validate learning metrics, surface gaps, and drive data-driven improvements, troubleshooting and documenting scalable solutions.
7. Measure impact and improve - Define success metrics, instrument your solutions, measure proficiency gains and adoption, and iterate based on data; optimize procedures and processes and mitigate immediate risks.
8. Ensure training compliance - Ensure technical training and certification/accreditation programs incorporate applicable compliance and regulatory requirements; monitor for changes, and escalate compliance risks with mitigation recommendations.
9. Own delivery with program discipline - Own the end-to-end delivery of the technical learning initiatives you lead: define requirements, establish milestones, prioritize intake, make trade-offs between time, quality, and resources, and clear blockers — escalating when appropriate.
10. Partner cross-functionally - Work with engineering and technical teams, SMEs, Workforce Management (WFM), Business and GL stakeholders to align technical enablement to business-critical timelines.
11. Communicate to leadership - Deliver clear status reporting, risk mitigation plans, and path-to-green documentation; participate in business reviews (e.g., WBR/MBR) and present decisions to leaders.
12. Contribute to the team - Contribute to team development, mentor where appropriate, and participate in the hiring process.

title: Sr. Product Manager - Tech, OpsTech Solutions, OTS Delivery Software Engineering (DSE)
descriptionHtml:
Every Amazon package that ships, every grocery order that is fulfilled, and every locker that opens depends on technology our teams keep running. Amazon’s OpsTech Solutions (OTS) is the IT operations and infrastructure organization for all of Amazon Worldwide Operations including Worldwide Grocery Stores (WWGS), delivering reliable technology to more than one million associates and operators across every geography and all business miles. OTS is transforming from reactive support to proactive, AI-powered service delivery. The data products powering that transformation are at the center of how the organization plans, decides, and operates.

What this role is: You will own the product strategy for the OTS Data Products portfolio, spanning four data products (Nodal Efficiency, Timesheet Adherence, Scenario Planner, and Short Term Planning) and five agentic workflow products (Printer Agent, MCM Agent, CSDA, OTS MCP, and OneVoice). You decide what gets built, what gets deprecated, and how these products become one coherent, reusable portfolio. This is the role that determines whether OTS’s data investments compound or stay siloed.
This is a platform and portfolio role. You will work across two engineering organizations, ANCHOR and Delivery Software Engineering (DSE), as well as partner analytics and program teams. An emerging ecosystem of AI agents and Model Context Protocol (MCP) services is an important part of the landscape, but your scope is the wider OTS data products estate, not any single team or service. You will define and drive the shared product strategy, standards, and access layer that these teams build on and that OTS customers consume.
Across OTS, teams have built valuable data products (forecasting services, operational metrics grounded in validated data), each proven in its own domain. The opportunity is to connect these strong point solutions across third-party platforms (ServiceNow) and in-house 1P services into one coherent portfolio, so that every new data-driven solution becomes a matter of configuration and connection rather than a net-new build. Your customers span field technicians who consume operational intelligence, program managers who configure forecasts and derive AI-driven insights, leaders who query validated metrics in natural language, and engineers who integrate with data products programmatically.

Key Highlights
• Own the product strategy and roadmap for the OTS Data Products portfolio (forecasting, science, analytics, and data tooling) across ANCHOR and Delivery Software Engineering (DSE) teams.
• Drive the reactive-to-proactive transformation by making OTS data accessible, reusable, and trustworthy through a foundational-services model: design once, deploy many.
• Shape the AI agent and MCP access layer that lets operators and leaders reach OTS data through natural-language and programmatic interfaces.
• Set the direction that multiple engineering teams build toward, backed by executive sponsorship and a clear mandate across the portfolio.
• Serve diverse customer personas across a spectrum of data latencies, from near-real-time operational needs on the front line to executive-level strategic insights.


Key job responsibilities
• Define and own a multi-year product vision and roadmap for OTS data products, unifying forecasting, science, analytics, and the AI agent and MCP ecosystem into one coherent portfolio.
• Act as the voice of the customer across OTS program teams, translating operational needs into product requirements and making disciplined trade-offs between time, effort, and feature depth.
• Partner with engineering leaders across contributing teams to shape architecture decisions, resolve overlap between services (e.g., ensuring a knowledge graph calls an existing metrics service rather than duplicating it), and drive build-vs-buy-vs-reuse decisions.
• Drive the AI agent and MCP access-layer strategy, establishing clear ownership boundaries between the common front door and supporting data services.
• Establish north-star and adoption metrics that make the foundational-services thesis measurable, and own the Monthly and Quarterly Business Review reporting standards that keep the portfolio accountable.
• Align partner engineering teams and stakeholders across competing priorities — driving adoption so teams choose to build on the shared portfolio rather than around it.
• Contribute to annual planning mechanisms (OP1/OP2) with clear, well-reasoned investment proposals, and maintain mechanisms to continuously capture voice of the customer from both internal OTS employees and operational customers.


A day in the life
Your day moves between strategy and execution. You review portfolio metrics and update roadmaps with the contributing teams, then run voice-of-the-customer sessions to make sure priorities reflect real operational pain points across personas, from a field technician relying on operational intelligence to a leader asking a natural-language question of validated metrics. You join architecture discussions to resolve how forecasting, the MCP and agent layer, and supporting data services fit together, and where boundaries between overlapping services should sit. In the afternoon, you make prioritization trade-offs with engineering leaders across teams whose roadmaps you influence but do not control, then shift to drafting strategy narratives and investment proposals for senior review.

About the team
OTS sits within Amazon’s largest support organization for Worldwide Operations, building a broader strategy to enhance support operations through technology and AI. OTS data products are how that strategy becomes actionable: forecasting and science services that help program teams plan, operational metrics grounded in validated data, and an emerging AI agent and MCP ecosystem that meets users at the point of need. The ANCHOR team is a key contributor to this landscape, delivering products such as OPAL and agentic tooling, and it partners with Delivery Software Engineering (DSE), Global Workforce Management (GWM), and the OTS and RME program teams. This role defines what the OTS data products portfolio should be across those teams; the engineering organizations deliver the how.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree
- Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition
- Experience contributing to engineering discussions around technology decisions and strategy related to a product
- Experience working with Data & AI related technologies, including, but not limited to, AI/ML, GenAI, Analytics, Database, and/or Storage
- 5+ years of technical product or program management experience
- Experience in representing and advocating for a variety of critical customers and stakeholders during executive-level prioritization and planning
- Demonstrated ability to influence and align partner engineering teams and stakeholders across competing priorities, without direct authority.

Preferred qualifications

- Experience bridging technical and business teams to collect and refine requirements, prioritize incoming work requests, and ensure all committed work is delivered on time
- MBA
- Experience with AWS technologies like Redshift, S3, AWS Glue, EMR, Kinesis, FireHose, Lambda, and IAM roles and permissions

title: Production Manager, Live Sports Production
descriptionHtml:
Come be a part of Amazon's Live Sports Production team. We are looking for an experienced Production Manager who operates at the intersection of traditional live sports broadcast production management and operations and the tech-forward, build-as-you-go environment of a global streaming platform. This role requires the field operations muscle of someone who has managed remote broadcast compounds, coordinated venue logistics, and staffed large-scale live events, paired with the builder mindset of someone who designs SOPs, dashboards and creates scalable processes in an environment where the infrastructure is still being built.

As a Production Manager, you are the operational engine across your assigned sports properties, working in lockstep with Sr. Production Ops Managers, Coordinating Producers, Technical Operations, and Production Finance to ensure every event is launch-ready and on budget. You will use your production management and field operations experience to drive new property launches and year-over-year sports property restarts. You will own event-level logistics, crewing, travel, vendor coordination, budgeting, and production communications. While much of the day-to-day execution (crewing, travel, payroll) runs through third-party Production Service Partners (PSPs), you own the outcomes and are accountable for meeting our standards. As the business evolves, you will help evaluate where functions should scale in-house versus remain with external partners.

This is an individual contributor role, but it carries a mentorship expectation. You are responsible for onboarding, training, and elevating freelancers, contractors, and production partner personnel to meet Amazon's production standards. The successful candidate builds rather than inherits, and takes ownership of the full operational picture, not just their assigned tasks.


Key job responsibilities
• Venue, Compound, and On-Site Logistics: Manage total on-site remote compound operations, serving as Amazon's boots-on-the-ground operational representative. Coordinate compound security, catering, venue and arena access, and credential submissions, working directly with leagues, teams, and venue contacts to ensure all production staff and talent are cleared in advance of air. Oversee shipping, equipment logistics, transportation, and emergency action plans. Operate on a schedule driven by the live sports calendar, which requires flexibility and extended stretches during peak seasons.

• Travel and Crew Administration: Own the end-to-end travel and accommodation process for production personnel and talent, including hotels, ground transportation, and travel and expense management. Coordinate travel logistics across overlapping production schedules, ensuring crew and talent are deployed efficiently and without conflict.

• Above-The-Line (ATL) and Below-The-Line (BTL) Staffing: Source, onboard, and evaluate local and freelance production support roles through 3P crewing providers, ensuring crew meets Amazon's production requirements and events are fully staffed across all positions across in-game and shoulder programming. Serve as the bridge between internal teams (Production Operations, Technical Operations, Editorial/Creative) and 3P crewing providers to align crew complement with show scope and budget.

• Show Budgeting and Billing: Own event-level operational budgets alongside Sr. Production Ops leads, Sr. Coordinating Producers, and Production Finance. Track expenses across vendor, freelance, and production cost categories. Process and approve invoices, review timecards, and reconcile cost reports. Flag variances and find tradeoffs when costs trend over budget.

• Production Memos and Communications: Publish production memos and dashboards detailing operational schedules, logistical event or show details, and emergency protocols across technical and production teams. Own the production management launch readiness roadmap for assigned properties, escalating risks when timelines are at jeopardy.

Work with internal partner teams and PSPs on production safety, security, insurance, and planning needs. Support league and venue relationships as the operational point of contact.

• Vendor and PSP Coordination: Serve as the primary liaison with 3P Production Service Providers and crewing vendors, ensuring the hiring, scheduling, and deployment of crew meets Amazon's production standards. Establish clear roles and responsibilities with vendor counterparts. Review production service agreements and statements of work to validate contractual terms, ensuring deliverables and billing align with operational requirements.

About the team
The Production Operations team is responsible for delivering high-quality event and studio productions on all global live sports properties to Prime Video customers worldwide. We drive production excellence through purpose-built processes and scalable operational frameworks that empower the team to work more efficiently and grow with increasing demand.

- 3+ years of producer, production manager or line producer experience
- 3+ years of overseeing and managing projects and deadlines experience
- 5+ years of editing/writing in long form audio, long form magazine, or television/film experience
- 5+ years in live sports production management or event operations, with hands-on remote and event production experience including compound and venue management. Has coordinated crewing and staffing through 3P vendors, including Above-The-Line and Below-The-Line personnel, across large-scale live broadcasts. Has managed event-level budgets including expense tracking, invoice reconciliation, and cost reporting. Knowledge of broadcast industry rates, crew structures, and market rules across domestic production environments. Has worked with production service providers and managed vendor relationships in a live production environment. Strong organizational skills with a demonstrated ability to manage multiple concurrent productions under tight deadlines.

Preferred qualifications

- Experience working directly with artists, songwriters, or other creative professionals
- Experience in a streaming or non-traditional broadcast production environment. Experience with production scheduling or workforce management platforms. title: Sr. Customer Solutions Manager , Strategic Accounts
descriptionHtml:
We are seeking a Sr. Customer Solutions Manager (CSM) to join our Strategic Accounts organization. In this new, highly visible role, you will be responsible for helping guide AWS customers along their multi-year journey to the cloud, ensuring that all AWS teams are working together effectively and efficiently to deliver outcomes for the customer.
Our team is committed to helping large industry-leading enterprise customers enable their digital transformation journeys. Our primary goal is to meet customers where they are in their cloud journey and work backwards from their industry specific needs to transform their business and their entire industry. Our team speaks the language of our customers, which means that we focus on business outcomes on behalf of our customers, whether that is how we build products and solutions, how we sell, how we deliver, or how we partner.
If you are excited about the prospect of using your cloud architecture experience to assist our most valuable customers, tackling challenging problems, have a hand in shaping the future of agentic AI and cloud adoption, enhancing and growing your own skills, and having fun, then we would love to hear from you.
You will be a critical partner to our customers, leveraging your experience with large scale agentic AI and cloud transformations and helping shepherd them through their stages of AWS adoption. Guiding the customer through the operational, educational, and governance aspects of a successful AWS cloud journey.
You will interface with customer and AWS leadership, driving collaboration between the other core account groups (Sales, Support, Solutions Architecture, and Professional Services), product/engineering teams, and customer teams, planning and supporting major workload migrations and modernizations. You will translate strategic initiatives in the account plan into executable actions, working backwards from our customers key milestones. You will manage cadence by leading the reporting and tracking functions along the way. The execution of education plans, roadmap to business outcome alignments, Executive Briefing Sessions, and technical customer engagements are a few items owned by the CSM that are critical to the success of our customer’s cloud journey.
You are encouraged to think big, invent and take ownership on customer challenges. You will not only bring the best of AWS/Amazon to our customers, you will proactively help solve the customer’s challenges through new ideas, tools and mechanisms.
Successful candidates will have a strong technical background, familiar with agentic AI/GenAI, be aware of details that matter, have excellent problem-solving abilities, and be exemplary communicators both at the executive and project team level. You will be a peer leader, have the ability to gain stakeholder buy-in, negotiate and lead virtual teams. Your enterprise cloud experience and operational excellence will influence the team’s decisions, provide insight, and help drive secure and robust solutions.
You will evangelize AWS services and influence customers for adopting them. You should be passionate about delivering a great customer experience by deploying AWS solutions and driving innovation, and also be obsessed with contributing to the day-to-day management of customers’ successful adoption of AWS.


Key job responsibilities
You will establish a deep understanding of your customer’s business vision, culture and processes, and evangelize AWS services and influence customers to adopt the right solution at the right time. Customer Solutions Managers (CSM) are responsible for four focus areas:

1/Accelerating AWS Adoption through Delivery and Execution
2/Identify & Align on Strategic Opportunities: CSMs work with the Account team to work backwards from the customer to identify and pursue strategic cloud opportunities. These strategic cloud opportunities can include but are not limited to large-scale workload migrations & modernizations, GenAI/Agentic, data and analytics, digital innovation, high performance computing, product innovation, and business agility.
3/Customer Enablement, you will serve as the customer’s cloud journey coach and be the voice of the customer within AWS, evangelizing customer needs to AWS leadership, product, and engineering teams.
4/Implement governance structures to effectively govern both our partnership with the customer, and the customer’s adoption of AWS.

These interconnected focus areas will enable CSMs to effectively drive customer cloud adoption, pursue strategic growth opportunities, and empower customer success - all of which are critical to achieving AWS’s business objectives. By aligning CSM activities, goals, and opportunities under these focus areas, CSMs ensure a disciplined, customer-centric approach that maximizes business impact and revenue realization for AWS.


A day in the life
About the team
Diverse Experiences

If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.
