title: Software Development Engineer II, CloudWatch Collectors
descriptionHtml:
Come and build the future with us as we change the way the world sees the Cloud!

CloudWatch is the observability platform of AWS, built for developers, system operators, site reliability engineers (SRE), and IT managers. CloudWatch collects monitoring and operational data in the form of logs, metrics, and events, providing a unified view of AWS resources, applications and services that run on AWS, and on-premises servers. Customers use CloudWatch to set high resolution alarms, visualise logs and metrics side by side, take automated actions, troubleshoot issues, and discover insights to optimise their applications, and ensure they are running smoothly. The CloudWatch team in Dublin is growing and we are looking for exceptional software development engineers to create the next generation CloudWatch experience.

CloudWatch is one of the largest real time data platforms in the world, processing more than 68 quadrillion metric observations per month and growing fast! This requires teams in CloudWatch to innovate at an unprecedented scale. In CloudWatch we love giving customers what they want: high quality, highly usable, highly available services. It's humbling and energizing to work with excellent, dedicated engineers to build and deliver world-leading service monitoring solutions at AWS scale.

We're looking for a new teammate who is enthusiastic, empathetic, curious, motivated, reliable, and able to work effectively with a diverse team of peers; someone who will help us amplify the positive & inclusive team culture we've been building.

Key job responsibilities
As a Software Development Engineer for the CloudWatch organisation, you will work in an agile team to design, build and maintain highly available, massively scaled systems used by millions of users worldwide. You will design and implement complex software to the highest quality for the services you and your team own, building our telemetry collection agents in Rust and Go and engaging with the upstream open-source communities, such as OpenTelemetry, that our software is built on and contributes to.

You will help expand our services across all AWS Regions, and when issues arise you will dive deep to understand the root cause and apply fixes that prevent them recurring. You will leverage GenAI and AI-powered development tools to enhance your productivity while staying current with emerging technologies, and you will also mentor junior engineers, helping grow the technical capability of the team.

A day in the life
On a typical day you might root-cause a collection issue affecting a fleet of hosts, ship a new feature in one of our agents, take a change upstream to OpenTelemetry, or design a solution to a performance or footprint problem you have never seen before. You translate customer and internal requirements into designs, weigh the tradeoffs, and break the work into incremental deliverables your team can ship. A strong community of senior and principal engineers gives direct feedback and pushes your thinking. You are surrounded by people who are passionate about observability and who believe there is still a lot of ground to cover in helping developers, SREs, and operators understand their systems.

About the team
We own telemetry collection for CloudWatch: the agents that run on millions of hosts and containers across AWS and gather the metrics, logs, and traces that everything else in CloudWatch is built on. Our software is written in Rust and Go and built on OpenTelemetry, and we contribute back to those open-source communities. We are a growing team in Dublin, and our mission is to give every AWS customer a reliable, low-overhead way to collect the telemetry their systems produce.

We invest in growing our engineers from day one. You will be paired with a buddy, work closely with senior and principal engineers.

Basic qualifications

- Experience (non-internship) in professional software development
- Experience designing or architecting (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems
- Hands on programming skills in at least one of the following: Rust, Go, Java, C++, Python

Preferred qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent
- Experience with full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations
- Open-source enthusiasm and contributions (e.g. a GitHub portfolio, or contributions to projects such as OpenTelemetry)

Customers use CloudWatch to set high resolution alarms, visualise logs and metrics side by side, take automated actions, troubleshoot issues, and discover insights to optimise their applications, and ensure they are running smoothly. The CloudWatch team in Dublin is growing and we are looking for an exceptional senior software development engineer to create the next generation CloudWatch experience.

CloudWatch is one of the largest real time data platforms in the world, processing more than 13 quadrillion metric observations per month! This requires teams in CloudWatch to innovate at an unprecedented scale. In CloudWatch we love giving customers what they want: high quality, highly usable, highly available services. It's humbling and energizing to work with excellent, dedicated engineers to build and deliver world-leading service monitoring solutions at AWS scale.

We're looking for a new teammate who is enthusiastic, empathetic, curious, motivated, reliable, and able to work effectively with a diverse team of peers; someone who will help us amplify the positive & inclusive team culture we've been building.

CloudWatch is a part of AWS Utility Computing (UC) which provides product innovations — from foundational services such as Amazon’s Simple Storage Service (S3) and Amazon Elastic Compute Cloud (EC2), to consistently released new product innovations that continue to set AWS’s services and features apart in the industry. As a member of the UC organization, you’ll support the development and management of Compute, Database, Storage, Internet of Things (Iot), Platform, and Productivity Apps services in AWS, including support for customers who require specialized security solutions for their cloud services.

Key job responsibilities
As a Senior Software Development Engineer for the CloudWatch organisation, you will lead the design and architecture of highly available, massively scaled systems used by millions of users worldwide and spanning multiple services and teams. You will shape the technical strategy and roadmap for the services you and your team own, making and documenting the key architectural decisions and tradeoffs, and you will stay hands-on — building our telemetry collection agents in Rust and Go and engaging with the upstream open-source communities, such as OpenTelemetry, that our software is built on and contributes to.

You will raise the engineering bar across the team through code and design reviews, coding standards, and operational excellence, and help expand our services across all AWS Regions. When issues arise, you will dive deep to understand the root cause and drive fixes that prevent them recurring. Above all, you will mentor and develop the engineers around you, growing the technical capability of the team, and partner with product and other engineering teams to break ambiguous problems down into deliverable workstreams. You will champion the adoption of GenAI and AI-powered development tools across the team, raising engineering productivity while staying current with emerging technologies.

Our team owns telemetry collection for CloudWatch, building and operating the agents that gather metrics, logs, and traces at AWS scale.

title: Senior Software Development Engineer, AWS Fault Injection Services
descriptionHtml:
AWS Fault Injection Service (FIS) is a fully managed service for running fault injection and chaos engineering experiments on AWS. Customers use FIS to deliberately and safely stress their applications, uncover hidden weaknesses, validate that their monitoring and alarms work, and prove that their systems recover the way they expect, all before a real incident happens. FIS experiments apply controlled faults to targeted resources, guarded by stop conditions that automatically halt an experiment the moment it moves outside safe limits.

We are looking for a Senior Software Development Engineer to own the design and delivery of the fault actions at the core of FIS. You will build the capabilities that safely disrupt production-grade AWS services, such as Amazon EC2, Amazon EKS and Kubernetes workloads, and Amazon ElastiCache, and you will drive the resilience, scalability, and safety of those systems. You will set the technical direction for your team's software, advise senior leadership on architecture and roadmap, and mentor engineers across the team.

Safety is central to this role. A fault that is too broad, or that fires against the wrong resource, can affect real customer workloads, so you will own the authorization, blast-radius controls, and operational rigor that let customers trust FIS to break their systems on purpose. If you enjoy distributed-systems problems where correctness and customer safety matter as much as scale, this is a rare place to work on them.

Key job responsibilities
Own the architecture for one or more FIS fault domains, providing a system-wide view and design guidance, and act as a key influencer on your team's technical strategy and goals.
Design, build, and release software at large scale for AWS customers worldwide, then operate it in production and keep it highly available and durable.
Build new fault actions and target types end to end: API design, authorization, execution logic, automated testing, and documentation, and safely evolve existing ones.
Identify high-impact, hard-to-reverse technical decisions early, and drive the team toward durable solutions rather than short-term workarounds, especially where customer safety and blast radius are at stake.
Raise the operational bar for your team: strong alarms and telemetry, clear runbooks, effective guardrails, and a healthy culture of incident review and continuous improvement.
Partner with the AWS service teams whose faults FIS supports to design integrations and land cross-team deliveries successfully.
Advise your management and senior leadership on technical trade-offs, and contribute to short- and long-term planning.
Actively mentor multiple engineers and champion engineering best practices that others adopt.

A day in the life
A Senior SDE on FIS is an owner of the product, not just of individual components. A typical day combines hands-on building with work that makes the whole team more effective: producing and reviewing designs for complex fault-domain problems, building and operating fault actions across the service, reasoning carefully about authorization and blast radius so an action can never exceed its intended scope, keeping a close watch on operational health, and unblocking and mentoring the engineers around you.

You will join AWS Resilience, working on a service that thousands of AWS customers rely on to make their own systems more reliable.

title: Test Development Engineer, Mechanical Dev Test & Integration
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Leo is Amazon's low Earth orbit satellite network. Our mission is to deliver fast, reliable internet connectivity to customers beyond the reach of existing networks. From individual households to schools, hospitals, businesses, and government agencies, Amazon Leo will serve people and organizations operating in locations without reliable connectivity.

We are looking for a Test Development Engineer to design and implement test infrastructure for mechanical systems in support of satellite hardware development. This is a fast-paced, intellectually challenging opportunity to work with thought leaders in multiple technology areas. You’ll have relentlessly high standards for yourself and everyone you work with, and you’ll be constantly looking for ways to improve your product’s performance, quality, and reliability.

Export Control Requirement: Due to applicable export control laws and regulations, candidates must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.

Key job responsibilities
• Design, analyze, develop, and implement test equipment and infrastructure used in satellite flight hardware development and qualification.
• Author, refine and implement validation, verification, acceptance and qualification test procedures.
• Develop test, data acquisition, and control automation.
• Participate in design reviews, and risk assessments, to contribute to the continuous improvement of satellite hardware performance and reliability.
• Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams, including design, manufacturing, systems, reliability, and quality engineers, to gather information, share findings, and develop solutions.

A day in the life
As a Amazon Leo Test Development Engineer, you will own the design and implementation of automated test equipment used to validate satellite hardware designs from initial prototypes, through functional testing, and into pilot production. You will work with design and manufacturing teams to specify test equipment requirements, design test fixtures, develop test plans, and execute test campaigns to support development and production test initiatives. The ideal candidate is self-motivated and comfortable operating in a fast-paced development environment.

About the team
This team is organized within the satellite mechanical design team to accelerate the design iteration process and ensure on-time delivery of the most stable and successful product possible. The tasks and daily focus change rapidly, and you will often take on new and exciting responsibilities as required to ensure project success. Expect to be deployed to complex problems and novel technical challenges that push you to develop new skills. You’ll be constantly looking for ways to improve your product’s performance, quality and cost.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in mechanical engineering, electrical engineering, material science, physics or equivalent
- Experience in hardware design and validation of components, subsystems and systems
- Experience with test plan development, building the necessary test bench infrastructure, developing tests and verifying the design

Preferred qualifications

- Experience in test setup automation using MATLAB, Python, or Pearl
- Knowledge of industry standard CAD & FEA design tools, industry trends, and design for manufacturability
- Experience handling ambiguous or undefined challenges through strong problem solving abilities
- Experience communicating with users, other technical teams, and management to collect requirements, describe software product features, and technical designs
- Experience that includes strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and effective communication abilities

title: Forward Deployed Engineer, AWS Forward Deployed Engineering
descriptionHtml:
A Forward Deployed Engineer II (FDE II) embeds directly inside a strategic enterprise customer to independently design, build, deploy, and run AI-powered production systems alongside the customer's engineering team. FDE IIs write production-grade software and own delivery of complete AI workstreams end-to-end — from requirements gathering through production deployment — combining the technical rigor of an AWS SDE with the urgency and ownership required to deliver measurable customer business outcomes.

FDE IIs are autonomous contributors. They deliver working features spanning the full software lifecycle. They design cohesive implementations for ambiguous problems, making design trade-offs with appropriate guidance. They take on projects where the business problem is understood but implementations are not fully fleshed out, balancing constraints and limiting short-term workarounds. They coach others on producing high-quality code and train new team members.

Key job responsibilities
Embed within customer engineering teams. Work with customers, stakeholders, and peers to understand the business and customer value of the systems you build. Understand the customer's business processes, technical architecture, and operational constraints. Translate customer requirements into technical designs for AI-enabled production systems within your workstream. Requires 30–50% travel.

Build production AI applications. Design and develop production-grade software powering AI and agentic workflows — retrieval pipelines, workflow automation, API orchestration layers, data integration. Solve difficult problems with visible risks or roadblocks, bringing clarity and identifying simple designs for solutions. Integrate foundation models, customer data sources, and existing applications into cohesive AI experiences. Optimize for latency, reliability, and cost.

Own production for your workstream. Be a significant contributor to the full software development lifecycle including scoping, design, code, testing, deployment, operations, and maintenance. Troubleshoot production incidents across AI models, distributed systems, and application services. Ensure root causes of operational issues are identified and resolved. Implement monitoring, evaluations, guardrails, and CI/CD that keep AI systems healthy. Don't settle for the status quo — routinely identify and execute on opportunities to improve operations.

Mentor and uplift. Actively mentors and trains new team members on how systems are constructed, operated, and fit into the bigger picture. Coach others on producing high-quality code through mechanisms such as code review. Be active in the code review process, providing meaningful feedback to others.

Accelerate customer adoption. Identify opportunities to expand AI adoption within your customer engagement. Codify reusable patterns and accelerators that benefit future customer deployments and feed back into AWS services. Make enhancements that improve your team's software and processes.

A day in the life
You start your morning reviewing deployment metrics from a recent release, then join a design review where you help shape the architecture for an upcoming feature. After lunch, you pair with a teammate on a tricky integration problem, walking through trade-offs together before settling on a clean approach. Later, you onboard a new team member by guiding them through how your services are constructed and operated. Your work balances building new capabilities with strengthening the foundations that keep your systems running reliably.

- Experience in professional, non-internship software development
- 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
- 2+ years of experience working in an Agile, startup, or rapidly scaling environment
- Experience communicating technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences
- Degree in Computer Science or related field, or equivalent professional experience
- Experience with agentic and spec-driven development (developing AI agents a plus)
- Experience with AI tools: eval frameworks, agent tooling, RAG pipelines, and prompt engineering

Preferred qualifications

- Experience working in customer production environments
- Experience building or deploying AI/ML applications in production environments
- Background as a founder, engineering lead, or startup builder with high ownership and urgency
- Prior experience with React, TypeScript, Python, and/or Go
- Experience interfacing with customers or leading technical projects with external stakeholders
- Experience working with teams that build and scale end-to-end production systems
- Experience with AWS services

descriptionHtml:
Amazon Protective Services' Emergency Services and Global Standards is looking for a highly motivated physical security professional to serve as Risk Lead on the Global Services & Standards team. This is a remote role with about 50% international travel.

The team runs on a Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC) model, and this role owns the Risk piece. You'll assess risk in new and existing policies, standards, technology and training across Amazon Security and Amazon's subsidiaries. You'll focus mainly on the support functions ESGS teams provide to their customers and on risks to Amazon employees, operations, assets and data. Your assessments will help senior leaders make informed decisions to protect their portfolios.

What you'll do

Build and lead risk assessments that give senior leaders clear findings they can act on.
Work with Amazon Security, Amazon Corporate Security, Amazon Fulfillment Network Security, subsidiaries and other partners to analyze real-world risk and apply the right physical security controls.
Evaluate new and emerging security technologies and practices that could strengthen Amazon's security.
Lead or support evaluations of physical security measures that Amazon Security is considering.
Help develop, analyze and improve global physical security standards, applying Amazon Global Security Policies and Standards throughout.

About you
You're an experienced security professional who works well with people at every level of the organization. You know physical security principles in depth and how to put them into practice. You have hands-on experience with Crime Prevention Through Environmental Design (CPTED), including its principles, data collection and analysis, how people behave in built environments, and presenting findings in reports and briefings. You consistently plan and deliver high-quality work for internal and external customers.

Key job responsibilities
Build programs driven by data and metrics, and agree on goals, objectives and performance outcomes with business partners.

Create and manage global risk and resilience programs that cover both preparing ahead of time and responding in proportion when incidents happen.
Run analytical deep dives to find vulnerabilities and root causes, and turn the findings into thorough risk reports.

Complete detailed threat and risk assessments, with risk treatment plans and recommendations.

Work with teams across functions to develop standards, procedures and processes that match business needs and help identify and reduce security risks.

Produce risk analysis that feeds reports for Amazon Security's most senior leaders.

Keep up with industry trends and events, and maintain relationships with key industry contacts and manufacturers.

Work independently as a self-starter.

A day in the life
No two days are the same. Some days you'll be traveling to an Amazon site somewhere in the world to run an onsite risk assessment, walking the space and talking with local security teams. Other days you'll work remotely, analyzing data, finding root causes and writing risk treatment plans. You'll work with PS teams, Fulfillment and subsidiary partners to understand their challenges. You'll turn your findings into clear recommendations for senior Amazon Security leaders, and you'll keep up with new security technologies and industry trends.

About the team
About the team R2G2 (Risk, Readiness & Resilience, Governance, and Global Partner Assessments) is part of Global Services & Standards. We're rethinking how we deliver our Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC) model to our customers. Our risk programs began with assessments and built a strong foundation.

Now we're ready to expand them to every customer we support. This is a chance to take that foundation, shape where it goes next and see the impact of your work. Join us and help us build!

Diverse Experiences
Amazon Security values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why Amazon Security?
At Amazon, security is central to maintaining customer trust and delivering delightful customer experiences. Our organization is responsible for creating and maintaining a high bar for security across all of Amazon’s products and services. We offer talented security professionals the chance to accelerate their careers with opportunities to build experience in a wide variety of areas including cloud, devices, retail, entertainment, healthcare, operations, and physical stores.

Inclusive Team Culture
In Amazon Security, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Ongoing DEI events and learning experiences inspire us to continue learning and to embrace our uniqueness. Addressing the toughest security challenges requires that we seek out and celebrate a diversity of ideas, perspectives, and voices.

Training & Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, training, and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why flexible work hours and arrangements are part of our culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree or equivalent in Information Security, Computer Science, Risk Management, Engineering, Math, Statistics, or a related discipline, or equivalent technology experience
- 7+ years of HR, privacy, legal, compliance or risk management experience
- Experience owning program strategy, end-to-end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership
- Knowledge of Microsoft Office products and applications at an advanced level

Preferred qualifications

- Experience performing and/or participating in technical assessments in direct support of a major compliance effort (e.g. ISO 27001, ISO 22301, ISO 27701, ISO 9001, PCI, SOC1/SOC 2, HITRUST)
- Experience analyzing large datasets and translating them to actionable business insight

descriptionHtml:
Amazon is investing heavily in building a world-class advertising business, delivering a collection of self-service products that drive discovery and sales, and we are responsible for ensuring that Advertisers and Partners can easily navigate our products and services. The Partner Tech organization builds innovative software solutions and owns the customer experience for Advertisers and Partners integrating with our API and MCP. Our products are strategically important to Amazon's Retail and Marketplace businesses, driving long-term growth. We deliver billions of ad impressions and millions of clicks daily and are breaking fresh ground to create world-class products. We are a highly motivated, collaborative organization with an entrepreneurial spirit and bias for action. With a broad mandate to experiment and innovate, we are growing at an unprecedented scale with a seemingly endless range of new opportunities.

Are you passionate about driving customer success and learning new technologies? Do you thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced environment? You will represent Amazon as you investigate technical issues, work with API developers to ensure compliance with our program policies and identify gaps in our technical solutions as well as patterns of API misuse. title: Partner Solutions Manager, Partner Solutions
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Ads builds the technology connections between our advertising platform — the Ads API, Amazon DSP, Amazon Marketing Cloud, and Amazon Marketing Stream — and the agencies, SaaS platforms, CDPs, and systems integrators that build on them. As a Partner Solutions Manager (PSM), you own the production life of these partner integrations: you keep them healthy, current, and performing in market, and you grow the revenue they generate over time.

Once an integration is live, you own its operational trajectory — production support, migrations, deprecations, and ongoing technical health. You are the technical owner partners rely on to keep a shipped integration running as the platform evolves, to drive migrations to completion, and to resolve production issues before they affect advertiser adoption or revenue. You handle complex, ambiguous operational problems where the goal is clear but the path is not, make pragmatic trade-offs between short- and long-term fixes, and escalate with sound judgment to clear blockers.

You coordinate across Partner Development, Amazon Ads product, and engineering teams to resolve recurring production issues and translate persistent partner friction into product feedback. You communicate clearly in writing and in technical reviews, and you are trusted to represent production health and risk to senior stakeholders. Success is measured in operational outcomes — sustained post-launch adoption, migration completion, time-to-resolution on production issues, and the revenue retained and grown across the integrations you own.

Key job responsibilities
- Own the production health of a portfolio of live partner integrations across the Ads API, Amazon DSP, Amazon Marketing Cloud, and Amazon Marketing Stream — keeping them stable, performing, and current as the platform evolves.
- Resolve production issues end to end, from diagnosis to resolution, managing time-to-resolution and preventing recurrence.
- Plan and drive migrations and deprecations to completion, keeping integrations on supported patterns with no disruption to live traffic.
- Grow the revenue the integrations you own generate, acting on optimization and expansion opportunities within live implementations.
- Run the operational cadence with each partner's engineering team — health reviews, change management, release coordination — against clear reliability and adoption targets.
- Coordinate across Partner Development, Amazon Ads product, and engineering to unblock production issues and drive cross-team fixes to closure.
- Translate recurring partner friction into prioritized, evidence-backed product feedback.
- Make pragmatic short- vs. long-term trade-offs, escalating with sound judgment to clear blockers.
- Represent production health and risk to senior stakeholders through clear written narratives and technical reviews.
- Protect proactive capacity, holding reactive load within target so most time goes to durable health, migration, and revenue work.

A day in the life
Customers: partners whose integrations are live — agencies, SaaS platforms, CDPs, SIs, ERPs, Japan — working directly with their engineering teams; advertisers are the end beneficiaries.

Internal stakeholders: Amazon Ads Product & Engineering (Ads API, DSP, AMC, Stream), PDMs, Solutions Architects, pod manager and peer PTMs.

Problems solved: keeps live integrations stable as the platform evolves; drives migrations off deprecated patterns without disrupting traffic; resolves production issues before they stall adoption; turns recurring friction into product feedback; grows revenue from live implementations.

Daily: monitor portfolio health, run partner technical cadences, drive issue resolution and migrations, escalate defects, report production health.

About the team
The Amazon Ads Partner Solutions team enables partners to build and scale innovative advertising technology solutions. Working with customer data platforms, systems integrators, agency holding companies, independent agencies, ad servers, and retail media platforms, this global team designs and delivers technical solutions that drive partner success. The team combines deep advertising technology expertise with Amazon's latest capabilities, including AI-driven features, to help partners build scalable, secure, and performant solutions. Through technical leadership and close collaboration with product teams, they influence both partner solutions and Amazon Ads product development, driving innovation across the advertising ecosystem.

Basic qualifications

- Experience analyzing and troubleshooting RESTful web API calls, or experience in development or technical support
- Experience in scripting for automation (e.g. Python) and advanced SQL skills.
- Experience writing technical documents, project plans and progress reports to leadership and to stakeholders
- 3+ years of technical work experience, or Bachelor's degree in an advanced technical program
- Speak, write, and read fluently in English, and have the ability to take direction in English
- 5+ years in a technical, customer-facing role supporting software or API-based product integrations.

Preferred qualifications

- Experience with and deep understanding of advertising technologies (i.e., ad server, DSP)
- Experience leading cross-functional teams to deliver products and projects on tight deadlines
- Experience in production, monitoring and metrics reporting
- - Experience operating or supporting AI/GenAI-enabled integrations — e.g., LLM-powered features, agentic workflows, or AI-driven reporting — in production.
- - Experience using AI tools to accelerate operational work (issue triage, diagnostics, documentation).
- - Experience supporting enterprise partners such as agency holding companies, CDPs, systems integrators, or third-party ad servers.
- - Familiarity with privacy-safe data patterns (clean rooms, 1P data).

title: Principal Security GTM, Worldwide Specialists Organization

Join the AWS Worldwide Specialist Organization for Security, Identity & Governance to define and drive how AWS takes its SIG portfolio to market worldwide to shape the strategy, mechanisms, and field-facing programs that accelerate secure cloud adoption, influence product direction, and help AWS customers be more secure.

You will operate with significant autonomy in an ambiguous, high-visibility space to set GTM priorities, design scalable programs and mechanisms, and enable the LATAM field and sales teams who carry the SIG portfolio to customers. You will translate customer and field signal into a coherent LATAM strategy, channel feedback to AWS leadership and product teams, and track measurable business outcomes across the portfolio.

title: Sr. Solutions Architect, Coalition Accelerator Builder, GNSD
descriptionHtml:
The Coalition Accelerator Builder team is the conversion layer between qualified defence-cloud demand and reusable, deliverable capability. The NSD mission threads and field identify customer challenges and generate demand; this team turns that demand into proven accelerators that ProServe, partners, and regional teams can deliver repeatedly without a specialist in the room.

The accelerator portfolio includes C2CMA (Command and Control Cloud Mission Accelerator), Trusted Secure Enclaves, and CEGA (Cloud Edge Global Access), linked together by the AMF (AWS Mission Framework) to deliver holistically for the mission rather than as isolated point solutions.

You will be one of the first builder hires into this team. Your job is to build, prove, and scale the accelerator portfolio: helping build best-practice guidance and reference architectures, hands-on in the codebase, embedded in live customer delivery, and then codifying what works into repeatable approaches that the wider field can own.

How You Work: The Prove-Then-Scale Model

Your initial validation is direct involvement in customer delivery. You embed alongside ProServe and partner engineers on live engagements, contribute code, solve real deployment problems, and understand what breaks in production defence environments. You then extract that experience into repeatable, tested patterns: infrastructure-as-code, CI/CD pipelines, demo platforms, contribution guides, and enablement collateral. The credibility of everything you produce comes from having built it against real operational need, not in a lab.

What This Role Is NOT

This is not a traditional customer-facing SA role with occasional prototyping. It is a build role. You will write code, own pipelines, and maintain a codebase. Customer exposure comes through embedded delivery, not through pre-sales presentations. If your instinct is to architect on a whiteboard and hand off to someone else to implement, this is not the right fit.

Key job responsibilities
- **Engineer and maintain accelerator codebases.** Terraform, CI/CD pipelines, container orchestration, infrastructure-as-code. You own the shared core that every deployment depends on.
- **Embed in live customer delivery.** Work alongside ProServe and partner teams on funded engagements to validate patterns, fix what breaks, and build credibility for the approaches you will later scale.
- **Build and maintain demo and reference platforms.** Standing environments that prove the accelerators work, support sales conversations, and give partners a validated starting point. This includes environments demonstrating secure-by-design patterns to customers and accreditation bodies.
- **Design and implement automated compliance validation tooling** that maps deployed infrastructure to control frameworks (NATO, NCSC, national standards) and produces auditable evidence.
- **Own contribution standards and code quality.** Define how ProServe and partners contribute to the shared codebase. Review pull requests, enforce Architecture Decision Records, maintain architectural coherence across country-specific extensions.
- **Create technical enablement collateral.** Not marketing decks. Deployment guides, runbooks, architecture walkthroughs, security runbooks, accreditation evidence templates, and hands-on workshops that make non-specialist SAs, Tech BDs, and delivery teams self-sufficient.
- **Drive roadmap delivery.** Execute against the priorities set by the Product Owner and STL. Translate demand signal from the field into shipped capability.
- **Interface across the collaboration model.** Work with ProServe, partners, regional SAs, Tech BDs, and AWS Security. You are the bridge between the team that sets direction and the teams that deliver at scale.

About the team
Coalition Accelerator Engineering sits within GNSD and governs the accelerator portfolio that underpins the AWS defence-cloud go-to-market across allied nations. The team is deliberately small and high-leverage: it builds each capability once, to a standard that holds, and it becomes a repeatable delivery vehicle. You will work directly with the STL, Product Owner, and fellow engineers, and interface daily with BD, ProServe, and partner teams across multiple countries. Each accelerator compounds: what one nation builds, the next fields rather than rebuilds.

Basic qualifications

- 3+ years of design, implementation, or consulting in applications and infrastructures experience
- 10+ years of IT development or implementation/consulting in the software or Internet industries experience
- Strong software engineering fundamentals, including version control workflows, automated testing, code review, CI/CD pipelines and containerisation (Docker, ECS/EKS)

Preferred qualifications

- Bachelor's degree
- Experience in defence, national security or government cloud environments, including multi-classification architectures, secure-by-design patterns and strict data separation, ideally with an active or recently held security clearance in a NATO nation (UK SC/DV, US Secret/TS or equivalent).
- Deep DevOps experience, including CI/CD pipeline design, GitOps, automated testing, release management and observability at scale, applied in regulated environments with audit trails and automated compliance evidence or security posture validation, ideally using generative AI or RAG for evidence extraction.
- Deep knowledge of AWS security services (GuardDuty, Security Hub, IAM Access Analyzer, KMS, Nitro Enclaves, CloudTrail), container orchestration (EKS/ECS/Kubernetes) and event-driven serverless architectures (Lambda, Step Functions, EventBridge) across cloud and edge.
- Experience with mission systems (TAK Server/ATAK, geospatial pipelines, C2) or mesh, SD-WAN and overlay networks for contested environments, deployed in field exercises or austere conditions, and a track record of building enablement (documentation, workshops, partner certification) for partner delivery teams in more than one country.

title: Area Manager II
descriptionHtml:
Our WW Operations network delivers millions of packages and smiles to Amazon customers every day. We are looking for motivated, customer-focused individuals who want to join our team as an Area Manager. In this role, you will lead a team of hourly workforce and will be responsible for engaging your team during their shifts to maintain the highest levels of safety, quality, attendance, and performance. You will also play a key role in maintaining our customer expectations to ensure customer orders are delivered at the right time, to the right location.

Our Operation’s workflow has three major components: First mile - where the product is housed and ready for order; Middle mile - where the order is hauled to your area; and Last mile - when the product is delivered to the customer’s door. Please note that all workflows have slight building variations, but one thing is constant: our vision and dedication to the customer.

* Work in an environment where the noise level varies and can be loud
* Work in an environment that is subject to variable temperatures and weather (delivery stations include outside loading departments)
* Continuously climb and descend stairs (applies to sites with stairs)

Our fulfillment network launches new Operations sites every year, providing various opportunities for your professional growth. We hire Area Managers based on location preference and the business’ current openings.

title: Engineering Operation Technician - Night Shift, DCC Communities
descriptionHtml:
Join our dynamic team and become a critical guardian of technological infrastructure! As a Data Center Engineering Technician, you'll play a pivotal role in maintaining the heartbeat of mission-critical technology infrastructure, ensuring seamless operations that power global digital experiences. Your expertise will directly contribute to maintaining an extraordinary 99.999% uptime, keeping the digital world running smoothly and efficiently.

Engineering Technicians are Amazon’s front line when it comes to hands-on electrical and mechanical equipment troubleshooting. They will maintain, operate, and troubleshoot, Data Center Operation’s Mission Critical Facilities, which includes stand-by diesel generators and related fuel systems, as well as three phase electrical systems such as: switch gear, UPSs, PDUs, wet cell batteries and associated systems, CRAC, centrifugal chillers, cooling towers/water chemical system, air handlers and associated systems, pumps, & motors.

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

NOTE: Amazon does not sponsor for immigration, including for H-1B, TN, and other non-immigrant visas, for this role.

NOTE: Lump sum stipend will be provided to eligible candidates who relocate for this position.

Key job responsibilities
- Daily building rounds to monitor and record information from electrical, mechanical, and fire/life safety equipment to ensure 24/7 reliability and availability
- Monitor Building Management Systems (BMS) and Electrical Power Management System (EPMS)
- Assist in troubleshooting of facility and rack-level events within internal Service Level Agreements (SLA)
- Perform rack installs and rack decommissioning within internal SLA
- Perform PM, troubleshooting, root cause analysis, and repair of electrical and mechanical equipment
- Technical writing to support change management program
- Monitor daily work requests and manage to resolution, and execute projects from conception to completion
- On-site support of contractors, sub-contractors and vendors, ensuring that all work performed is in accordance with established practices, procedures & local legislation
- Work schedule changes depending on specific site needs. Shifts can be up to 12 hours and may rotate on a predefined schedule. Some locations have on-call rotations.
- Role may support more than one location/site.
Physical Requirements:
- Willingness and demonstrated ability to work in the following physical conditions with reasonable accommodations:
- Regularly lift and/or move up to 39 pounds independently
- Participate in group lifts for 40+ pounds
- Maintain balance and perform construction tasks while on a ladder
- Regularly walk, use hands and fingers, handle or feel, reach with hands and arms, stoop, kneel, crouch or crawl, climb stairs, twist, bend, work above shoulders, grasp, carry, push and pull objects into position
- Work in an environment requiring provided ear protection
- This role supports data centers in various operational stages. The position may be assigned to a facility still under development, which could require travel to established locations for training until your designated site becomes fully operational.
Essential Requirements:
- Ability to travel to or commute between data center locations as needed
- Willingness to temporarily work at alternative sites during training periods or until assigned facility is operational
- Travel frequency will vary based on business needs and operational status of assigned facility
Candidates must be able to travel (over 50 miles) or commute (less than 50 miles) to active data center sites as required by business needs.


A day in the life
This role acts as Amazon’s front line when it comes to hands-on electrical and mechanical equipment preventative maintenance (PM) and troubleshooting, reporting to a site’s Data Center Facility Manager (FM). They will maintain, operate, and troubleshoot mission-critical data center facility equipment including stand-by diesel generators and related fuel systems, 3 phase electrical systems such as switchgear, UPS units, PDUs, and wet cell batteries and associated systems. Mechanical equipment includes CRAHU units, centrifugal chillers, cooling towers, water systems, air handlers and associated systems, pumps, and motors. Additional support equipment is included in the scope of the role which includes fire/life safety equipment, building automation systems, and general facilities equipment.

Basic qualifications

- 2+ years of Microsoft Office products and applications experience
- 2+ years of electrical or mechanical experience
- Ability to work on a flexible schedule including days, nights, and/or weekends.

Preferred qualifications

- Experience working in a data center or mission critical facility (example: hospital, military facility, public safety facility, etc.)
- Experience reading and writing procedures, technical documents, and engineering drawings
- Associate or higher education in related field

title: Senior Channel Team Lead, On the Road, AMZL
descriptionHtml:
※こちらのポジションは、名古屋の拠点を中心に中部エリアをご担当いただきます。
担当エリアや業務状況により、週3日程度の出張（宿泊を伴う場合有）が発生する可能性があります。

Amazonは、フルフィルメントセンターからデリバリーステーションまで一貫した物流ネットワークを構築・運営しています。デリバリーステーションは、お客様に高品質なサービスを提供するラストマイル配送を担っている部門です。

今回募集するSr. Channel Team Leadは、デリバリーステーションの成長を牽引する中核ポジションです。配送パートナーと密接に連携し、オペレーション管理、品質の継続的な改善、および複雑な課題解決を主導的かつ戦略的に実行することで、カスタマーエクスペリエンス向上・パートナーサクセスに貢献します。

物流・オペレーション未経験の方も歓迎しており、入社後はOJT・トレーニングを通じて、課題解決・プロジェクト推進など、必要なスキルを段階的に習得できる環境が整っています。


■ 業務内容 ■
①オペレーション
担当する複数のデリバリーステーション（3～4拠点）における年間目標（安全・品質・生産性）の達成に向け、改善活動の計画立案、実行、および進捗管理を一貫して行い、目標達成に対する責任を負います。

日々の配送オペレーションにおける課題（需要変動、システムトラブルなど）に対し、Amazonのポリシー・コンプライアンスを遵守しながら、配送パートナーと協働して解決を主導します。

必要に応じ、現状の包括的な分析と客観的な判断基準をマネージャーに明瞭に説明し、適切な戦略的意思決定を促進します。

②プロジェクト
プロセス・システム・テクノロジー導入プロジェクトにおいて、社内の関連部門と連携し、現場導入のプロジェクトチームの一員として役割を実行します。

また、マネージャーの支援を受けて、他部門を巻き込む改善プロジェクトのリーダーとしてプロジェクトマネジメントを行います。

③ レポーティング・情報共有
配送パートナーのパフォーマンスを現場とデータの両側面から分析し、マネージャーへレポーティングを行います。

課題・リスクを分析し、改善案を立案します。また、データドリブンな意思決定を支えるため、各種メトリクスのトレンド分析を通じて本質的な課題を抽出し、定量的な根拠に基づいた優先順位付けを行います。

④ チャネル・パートナーシップマネジメント
配送パートナーに対し、安全・品質・生産性改善のコンサルティングを行い、事業の持続的な成長と安定化を促進します。

配送パートナーのエンゲージメント向上をけん引し、リテンション改善の要となる役割を果たします。

⑤人材開発・文化形成
メンバーの成長を積極的に支援し、会社の就業規則及び各種ポリシーに関する深い理解に基づき、チームメンバーを適切に指導することで、組織の健全性を維持します。メンバーの業務上の懸念事項や課題に傾聴し、必要に応じて適切な専門部署（相談先）と連携するとともに、自律的な問題解決に取り組みます。

リーダーシッププリンシプルを深く理解し、多様性を尊重する組織文化の形成に貢献します。


■教育制度■
入社後、約2か月はAmazonのリーダーとして必要な会社のカルチャー・リーダーシッププリンシプル、Amazonの物流ネットワークに関わる知識を学ぶことができる研修の機会を提供しています。本配属後は、トレーナーのもとSr. Channel Team Leadの業務をOJTで学び、各種ツールの使用方法などを習得していく環境を整備しています。


■キャリアパス■
Sr. Channel Team Leadからキャリアをスタートし、シニアエリアマネージャー、リージョナルマネージャーとなるキャリアアップのチャンスがあります。また、Amazonでは社内公募制度があり、国内外問わず他部署や異なる職種への異動にチャレンジし、社内で多様なキャリアを築くことができます。Amazonでは自身で学び成長することを推奨し、キャリア開発できるようサポートを行っています。

title: Software Development Manager, Traffic Marketing Tech - Search
descriptionHtml:
Amazon's Stores Economics and Science organization is building the Internet's largest-scale Search Marketing systems worldwide. The team is responsible for a number of business-critical systems that generate, target, measure, and optimize hundreds of millions of search engine ad placements and organic search listings. We bring prospective customers who start their shopping journeys on search engines, and increasingly in AI assistants and agentic shopping experiences, to Amazon through our ML- and LLM-driven software and systems. We apply best-in-class digital marketing and search engine optimization (SEO) techniques to process and optimize billions of webpages, images, videos, and content snippets to improve Amazon's discoverability across both traditional search and AI-mediated discovery. We routinely solve challenges related to large-scale distributed services, applied science, big data systems, and web search. Cutting-edge technology is core to our business, from large language models, generative AI, and agentic systems to machine learning and large-scale optimization, and we build in an AI-native way, using AI tools and agents across the development lifecycle to raise our quality and velocity.

As a Software Development Manager on this team, you will lead a team of software development engineers building the technology behind tens of millions of daily search-engine shopping queries. You will own the technical direction and product roadmap for your area, partnering closely with product managers to define requirements and with peer engineering teams to unblock dependencies. With a strong research-and-development component to the work and multi-million dollar business impact, this role combines hands-on technical leadership with meaningful people management and career development.

Key job responsibilities
- Lead and grow a team of software development engineers, providing coaching, career development planning, and actionable feedback that raises the performance bar.
- Define and prioritize the team's product roadmap in partnership with product managers, translating customer and business needs into clear technical requirements and sprint plans.
- Own the operational health and quality of your team's services, establishing metrics and mechanisms that ensure reliability at scale.
- Collaborate across dependent teams to resolve blockers, align on priorities, and deliver cohesive solutions that serve shared business goals.
- Drive system design decisions and evaluate tradeoffs across scalability, maintainability, and performance, keeping your architecture simple and sustainable.

A day in the life
You start the morning reviewing operational dashboards and triaging any alerts before joining your team's standup. From there, you might spend time in a design review with your engineers, then shift to a roadmap planning session with your product manager to scope upcoming features. Afternoons often involve cross-team syncs to resolve dependencies and unblock your engineers, followed by a one-on-one where you discuss a team member's career goals. Throughout the day, you balance technical depth with people leadership, using AI-native tools and workflows that keep the team productive and learning.

About the team
The Search Marketing team within Stores Economics and Science builds the systems that connect shoppers on external search engines and AI assistants with the right products on Amazon. We operate at massive scale, processing billions of webpages and content assets through machine learning and optimization pipelines. Our work has a direct, measurable impact on how customers begin their shopping journeys.

We are an inclusive, collaborative group of engineers, scientists, and product managers who value curiosity and continuous improvement. Cross-team partnerships are central to how we operate, giving you broad influence and exposure to new technologies — including AI-native development workflows that keep the team at the forefront of modern software engineering.

Basic qualifications

- 3+ years of engineering team management experience
- 7+ years of engineering experience
- 3+ years of leading development of applications backed by AWS services or using other cloud based technologies and services experience
- Knowledge of engineering practices and patterns for the full software/hardware/networks development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, certification, and livesite operations
- Experience partnering with product or program management teams
- Bachelor's degree or foreign equivalent in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field
- Experience in written and verbal communication skills to communicate with technical and non-technical audiences, including senior leadership

Preferred qualifications

- Experience in communicating with users, other technical teams, and senior leadership to collect requirements, describe software product features, technical designs, and product strategy
- Experience in recruiting, hiring, mentoring/coaching and managing teams of Software Engineers to improve their skills, and make them more effective, product software engineers
- Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field
- Experience in development of distributed/scalable systems and high-volume transaction applications
- Experience driving adoption of AI-native engineering workflows and ability to think critically about where AI tools and agents can meaningfully improve developer productivity, software quality, and operational efficiency.

title: Security Program Manager, DC Security, AWS DC Security
descriptionHtml:
Applicants must be Australian citizens and hold or be eligible to obtain an Australian Government Security Clearance with the ability to successfully complete an Organisational Suitability Assessment. More information regarding security clearances can be found at https://www.agsva.gov.au/.

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

AWS DC Security is looking for a Security Program Manager (SPM) to join our team. This is a partially hands-on role responsible for physical security hardware across data centers and support facilities in the Melbourne region — from design and installation through to maintenance and compliance.

The Role:

You will be an individual contributor on a team of three SPMs, working directly with Data Center Security Managers (DCSMs), Data Center Operations teams, and internal and external stakeholders.

You will oversee the design, deployment, and maintenance of physical security systems including Access Control, Intrusion Detection, CCTV, and Passive and Active Barriers. This covers new data centers, expansions, support facilities, and special security programs — all consistent with AWS security standards.

You will work with limited guidance. You will lead projects, develop solutions, author security design documentation and contracts, and manage vendor relationships to ensure industry-leading systems are deployed and maintained.

Who you are:

You have a deep understanding of electronic and physical security systems. You use that expertise to make the right decisions for security projects and site sustainment. You tackle complex security problems and compliance requirements — clearing blockers and escalating when needed.

You are comfortable identifying risks, asking the right questions to the right teams, and recommending solutions that balance security requirements against operational constraints. You communicate clearly with technical and non-technical audiences, written and verbal, and you drive discussions to decisions.

Key job responsibilities

- Manage the physical security design and system installation lifecycle for new facilities, expansions, and special projects.
- Provide project management including bid packages, specifications, drawings, code compliance, budget, vendor management, change orders, and close-out documentation.
- Coordinate fault tickets and maintenance tasks with a team of vendor engineers, ensuring security devices are properly maintained.
- Own and track high value security project budgets. Manage spend, budget variance, and cost reduction targets.
- Lead system testing, acceptance, sign-off, and operational readiness validation for high-security facilities, in conjunction with other AWS teams.
- Report performance metrics including vendor service delivery, costs, fault repair rates, and security program analysis.
- Collaborate across teams to drive global, regional, and local security initiatives. Provide physical security analysis and recommend program enhancements.


About the team
The team is comprised of security professionals with a cross section of national security, law enforcement, and private sector experience, providing a range of perspectives required for creative problem solving. We value diversity of thought, creativity, and a strong Bias for Action. We believe that there are no "perfect" security solutions and we develop and iterate using a continuous improvement process.

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Diverse Experiences
AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS?
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Inclusive Team Culture
AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.

Mentorship & Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

Benefits
Learning & development — AWS training and certification support, access to internal learning platforms.
Health, income protection and life cover — Amazon subsidises private health insurance premiums, and group salary continuance and life insurance are included at no cost to you.
Military differential pay launching in Australia — Australian employees taking defence reserve leave may receive up to 52 weeks of military differential pay to help cover the difference in pay while serving.
Employee Assistance Program — Free, confidential support 24 hours a day, 7 days a week for you and your family — mental health, financial coaching, legal questions, and everyday life events.
Family-building benefit — Access to Maven for fertility treatment, adoption support, surrogacy, and parenting coaching.
Amazon Extras & employee discount — cashback and discounts across hundreds of retail, fitness, travel, and lifestyle partners.

Basic qualifications

- Experience working on physical security design and implementation of Access Control/Intrusion Detection and CCTV Surveillance systems
- Experience overseeing security operations and working with security vendors/contractors
- Experience as a general contractor and in vendor management (request for proposals, bidding, change orders, quality control, RFI/submittal tracking) associated with construction and project execution
- Experience reading and interpreting construction drawings and specifications, or experience reading and writing procedures, technical documents, and engineering drawings
- Experience in written and verbal communication with the ability to present complex technical information in a clear and concise manner to executives and non-technical leaders
- Driving licence

Preferred qualifications

- Experience working in data centers or critical infrastructure
- Knowledge of one or more of the following domains: access-control system and methodology, network security, application- and system-development security, security architecture and models, cryptography, and operations security
- Experience in application security architecture, security code reviews, security testing, incident response, or security infrastructure
- CISSP, CISA, CISM or other security certification
- Project Management Professional (PMP) certification, or experience in project management

title: Senior Product Manager, Amazon Now
descriptionHtml:
An Amazon Now customer in India orders tomatoes and milk and gets them in 10 minutes. Behind that order, someone decided what to buy, how much, from whom and when. title: Teamleiter:in Instandhaltung - RME - Winsen (Luhe), RME
descriptionHtml:
Unser Wartungs- und Instandhaltungsteam (Reliability Maintenance Engineering Team oder RME-Team) ist der Kern von Amazons Engagement für Innovation. Amazon entwickelt sich weiter und dieses Team sorgt dafür, dass dies auch die von uns verwendeten Technologien und Tools tun. Als Senior RME Technician hilfst Du uns, der Entwicklung einen Schritt voraus zu bleiben. Du setzt die neuesten Technologien ein und identifizierst neue, effiziente Arbeitsmethoden. In dieser Rolle achtest Du genau auf unsere Prozesse und trägst dazu bei, dass wir unsere höchsten Sicherheitsstandards befolgen und weiter erhöhen.

Key job responsibilities
- Sicherstellen, dass alle Arbeiten nach höchsten Sicherheitsstandards ausgeführt werden (SOPs/LOTO), inkl. Vorbildfunktion, Coaching und konsequenter Umsetzung im Team

- Steuern und Priorisieren von Störungen, Wartungen und Aufgaben innerhalb der Schicht, inkl. Eskalationsmanagement zur Minimierung von Stillständen

- Überwachen der Anlagen- und Geräteleistung durch Floor Walks, visuelle Checks, zustandsorientierte Überwachung und präventive Instandhaltung; Ableiten zusätzlicher Maßnahmen bei Bedarf

- Durchführen und Koordinieren von nachhaltigen Fehlerbehebungen (RCA/5-Why) zur Verbesserung von Verfügbarkeit, Stabilität und Anlagenperformance

- Führen, Unterstützen und Weiterentwickeln der Techniker:innen in der Schicht (Training, Feedback, Skill-Aufbau)

- Leiten und Umsetzen interner technischer Projekte (z. B. Optimierungen an Fördertechnik/Automatisierung, Sicherheits- oder Standardisierungsinitiativen) – von der Idee über Planung und Stakeholder-Alignment bis zur Umsetzung und Erfolgsmessung

- Aktives Vorantreiben von kontinuierlicher Verbesserung und Standardisierung: Identifizieren von Best Practices, Testen neuer Lösungen/Methoden und Skalierung in Zusammenarbeit mit dem EU-Netzwerk

A day in the life


Du führst während deiner Schicht ein Instandhaltungsteam und sorgst dafür, dass unsere Technik zuverlässig, sicher und effizient läuft – in einer hochautomatisierten Umgebung, die wir kontinuierlich weiterentwickeln.

- Schichtstart: KPI-Review, offene Tickets/PMs prüfen, Priorisierung und Aufgabenverteilung im Team

- On-Floor Support: Rundgänge, Safety-Checks und Unterstützung bei Störungen an Anlagen und automatisierten Systemen

- Performance im Blick: Überwachung/Analyse der Anlagenzustände (z. B. über Monitoring/SCADA) und Ableiten von Maßnahmen zur Stabilisierung

- Eskalationen & Stakeholder: Koordination mit Operations, WHS/Safety, Engineering, Controls sowie externen Partnern für schnelle und nachhaltige Lösungen

- Verbesserungen statt Firefighting: Wiederkehrende Fehler identifizieren, RCA treiben, Maßnahmen umsetzen und Standards daraus machen

- Projektarbeit: Planen und Führen interner Optimierungsprojekte, die Verfügbarkeit, Sicherheit und Effizienz messbar verbessern (z. B. Umbauten, Prozess-/Standardarbeit, Reliability-Initiativen)

- Reporting & Handover: Saubere Dokumentation, Schichtübergabe, Abgleich mit Führungskräften zu Ressourcen, Projekten und Prioritäten

About the team
Unser Reliability Maintenance Engineering Team (RME) stellt sicher, dass unsere Anlagen und technischen Systeme jederzeit sicher, stabil und leistungsfähig laufen. Wir arbeiten in einer hochautomatisierten, technologisch fortschrittlichen Umgebung – und genau das macht unsere Arbeit spannend: Wir halten nicht nur den Betrieb am Laufen, sondern entwickeln die Technik und unsere Standards kontinuierlich weiter.

Teamleiter:innen übernehmen bei uns neben der Schichtverantwortung auch interne technische Projekte, um Verfügbarkeit, Sicherheit und Performance dauerhaft zu steigern. Unsere Kultur ist geprägt von Safety first, Ownership und kontinuierlicher Verbesserung: Wir lösen Probleme nachhaltig, arbeiten datenbasiert und setzen Verbesserungen so um, dass sie skalierbar und standardisierbar sind – in enger Zusammenarbeit mit Operations, Safety und Engineering.

Basic qualifications

- Abgeschlossene technische Berufsausbildung (IHK/HWK oder gleichwertig anerkannt) oder ein abgeschlossenes Hochschulstudium im ingenieurwissenschaftlichen Bereich (z. B. Maschinenbau, Elektrotechnik, Mechatronik oder vergleichbar; auch ausländische, anerkannte Abschlüsse).
- Zusatzqualifikation als Industriemeister:in/Handwerksmeister:in/Staatlich geprüfte:r Techniker:in oder mindestens 3 Jahre einschlägige Berufserfahrung in Instandhaltung/Produktion/technischem Betrieb.
- Mindestens 1 Jahr Erfahrung in der Führung von Mitarbeitenden (disziplinarisch oder fachlich), inkl. Einsatz-/Aufgabensteuerung im operativen Betrieb.
- Mindestens 2 Jahre Erfahrung in der Instandhaltung und/oder im technischen Betrieb von automatisierten Anlagen (z. B. Fördertechnik, Sorter, Verpackungs-/Materialfluss-Systeme).
- Deutschkenntnisse mindestens B2 (Wort und Schrift) sowie Englischkenntnisse mindestens A2/B1 (Grundlagen zur Kommunikation im Arbeitsumfeld).
- Bereitschaft zur Arbeit im Schichtmodell (je nach Einsatzplan inkl. Wochenenden/Nächten möglich).

Preferred qualifications

- Erfahrung in der Steuerung und Koordination von Fremdfirmen/Dienstleistern (z. B. Wartung, Reparatur, Umbauten), inkl. Einweisung, Sicherheitsunterweisung und Qualitätsabnahme
- Grundverständnis von SPS-/PLC-basierten Steuerungen sowie Erfahrung in der Zusammenarbeit mit Controls/Automation (z. B. Fehlersuche an Schnittstellen, Lesen einfacher Signale/Diagnosen)
- Kenntnisse zu gesetzlichen und betrieblichen Compliance-Anforderungen im technischen Umfeld (z. B. Arbeitssicherheit, elektrische Sicherheit, Betreiberpflichten)
- Erfahrung im Umgang mit CMMS/Wartungsmanagementsystemen (z. B. SAP, Maximo oder vergleichbar) zur Planung präventiver Wartung und zur Dokumentation von Störungen/Arbeitsaufträgen
- Erfahrung in kontinuierlicher Verbesserung / Reliability-Methoden (z. B. RCA/5-Why, FMEA, Standard Work) und der Umsetzung technischer Optimierungsmaßnahmen

title: Sr. Program Manager - RBS Emerging Stores, Retail Business Services
descriptionHtml:
About the Team
Retail Business Services (RBS) is a tech-led business operations organization within eCF that identifies and eliminates defects across Amazon Stores' growth and efficiency. The Returns Reduction program sits within the Cost BU and is responsible for reducing customer-initiated returns (CIR) and Net Cost of Returns to Customers (NCRC) across International Emerging Stores (IES) — including BR, MX, AU, TR, IN, MENA (AE, SA, EG), ZA, and SG. The program operates across three levers: catalog defect elimination to reduce CIR, vendor-controllable return reduction through Optimize Your Cost adoption, and high-return-rate (HRR) cohort intervention.
Role Overview:
We are seeking a Sr. Program Manager to own and drive return reduction initiatives across IES markets within the RBS Returns Reduction program. This is a multi-country, multi-workstream role that requires navigating ambiguity across emerging marketplaces with varying data maturity, regulatory environments, and operational readiness. You will partner with IES country teams, WW Returns & Recommerce, Buyer Abuse Prevention (BAP), Category teams, and RBS Sciences & Tech to define, size, launch, and scale return reduction interventions — often building from scratch in markets with limited data infrastructure.
Key Responsibilities
- Own end-to-end program delivery for return reduction across assigned IES markets, including goal setting, roadmap definition, execution tracking, and reporting to leadership (MBR/QBR cadence)
- Drive cross-market and cross-organizational alignment across country teams, returns and recommerce, buyer abuse prevention, category, and supply chain teams to unblock dependencies and accelerate launches
- Size opportunities per marketplace by analyzing return patterns, return drivers, category-level signals, and vendor behavior — often requiring custom data discovery and pipeline builds in markets where mature data infrastructure does not yet exist
- Define and track key metrics including customer-initiated return rates, net cost of returns savings, concession unit reduction, optimization tool adoption rates, and treatment coverage by country
- Manage the intervention lifecycle — from defect and product identification through country-team alignment, legal approval (where required), launch, and post-launch performance monitoring
- Scale proven interventions across markets — identify patterns that work in one country and replicate across others, adapting for local constraints
- Drive adoption of vendor and seller optimization tools across emerging markets, working with in-country vendor managers and account managers to link adoption to country-level cost and return reduction goals
- Own the annual planning cycle for international returns — develop annual goals, write planning narratives, align with finance on cost savings calculation methodologies, and ensure joint goal ownership with country teams
- Build and maintain mechanisms for defect identification, impact sizing, country-level reporting integration, and upstream defect elimination signals to prevent recurrence
- Influence upstream teams (catalog, fulfillment, category, vendor management) to address root causes of returns rather than treating symptoms
- Communicate program status, risks, and asks to senior leadership through written narratives, flash updates, and escalation documents

Basic qualifications

- 7+ years of program or project management experience
- Experience using data and metrics to determine and drive improvements
- Experience owning program strategy, end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership
- Knowledge of Excel at an intermediate level (e.g., pivot tables & charts, multiple criteria lookups, nested logical/IF formulas, data cleansing, array formulas, etc.)
- Experience in complex problem solving, and working in a tight schedule environment

Preferred qualifications

- 6+ years of driving process improvements experience
- Master's degree, or MBA in business, operations, human resources, adult education, organizational development, instructional design or related field

title: Delivery Consultant - Cloud Infrastructure Architect, Professional Services
descriptionHtml:
The Amazon Web Services Professional Services (ProServe) team is seeking a skilled Delivery Consultant to join our team at Amazon Web Services (AWS). In this role, you'll work closely with customers to design, implement, and manage AWS solutions that meet their technical requirements and business objectives. You'll be a key player in driving customer success through their cloud journey, providing technical expertise and best practices throughout the project lifecycle. Possessing a deep understanding of AWS products and services, as a Delivery Consultant you will be proficient in architecting complex, scalable, and secure solutions tailored to meet the specific needs of each customer. You’ll work closely with stakeholders to gather requirements, assess current infrastructure, and propose effective migration strategies to AWS. As trusted advisors to our customers, providing guidance on industry trends, emerging technologies, and innovative solutions, you will be responsible for leading the implementation process, ensuring adherence to best practices, optimizing performance, and managing risks throughout the project.

The AWS Professional Services organization is a global team of experts that help customers realize their desired business outcomes when using the AWS Cloud. We work together with customer teams and the AWS Partner Network (APN) to execute enterprise cloud computing initiatives.
