But wait, there is more: We provide lightweight fire-resistant daily wear and composite toe safety shoes for your safety!

Here is what you can expect with the Reliability & Maintenance Engineering (RME) selection process for Mechatronics & Robotics Technicians: (Timeframe: Approximately 30-days)

Step 1: Congratulations! You successfully submitted your application!

Step 2: Amazon Recruiting will review your application and invite the most qualified candidate to complete a pre-employment assessment.

Step 3: If you meet the role qualifications, you will receive an invitation from Amazon Recruiting (do-not-reply@criteriacorp.com) to begin your Criteria assessment. You have 5 days to complete.

Step 4: Once you successfully meet the pre-employment assessment requirements, you will be invited to complete a video interview. Your video interview invitation will be from HireVue (interviews@hirevue.com) and you will have 7 days to record your interview.

Step 5: Your video interview will be reviewed by the Amazon Hiring Team and you will be notified of next steps via email within 5 business days.


Key job responsibilities
Key job responsibilities include, but are not limited to:
- You will promote a safe working environment by following all safety procedures
- You will complete preventative maintenance routines with proper documentation
- You will troubleshoot electrical and mechanical problems related to all Material Handling Equipment (MHE) which includes belts, motors, photo-eyes, relays, and more
- You will maintain a positive working relationship across all of the Amazon Operations facility
- You must be able to move up to 49lbs, stand and walk during shifts lasting up to 12 hours, climb ladders and gangways safely, and without limitation, as well as perform regular bending, lifting, stretching, and reaching both below the waist and above the head

- High school or equivalent diploma

- 2+ years of conducting predictive and preventative maintenance procedures experience
- 2+ years of reading blueprints and electrical schematics experience
- 2+ years of demonstrating safety standards experience
- 2+ years of troubleshooting and diagnostics of material handling equipment (MHE) experience

Preferred qualifications

title: Software Development Engineer, Amazon Leo GBO Engineering
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Leo is Amazon's low Earth orbit satellite network. Our mission is to deliver fast, reliable internet connectivity to customers beyond the reach of existing networks. From individual households to schools, hospitals, businesses, and government agencies, Amazon Leo will serve people and organizations operating in locations without reliable connectivity.

The Amazon Leo Global Business & Customer Operations (GBCO) engineering team owns designing, implementing, and operating the planning systems that decide where Leo can be sold, how much capacity is available in each location, and at what price. Satellite capacity is finite and varies by geography, so our systems turn raw network coverage into a trustworthy, sellable inventory plan and enforce that plan at the point of sale so the network is never oversold. We sit between the teams that model what the network can do and the teams that operate it in real time, and we bring the business context that shapes those plans. We are looking for a talented software development engineer to help scale up and optimize the planning and simulation methods at the center of that work: the algorithms and systems that decide which cells to open for service, how much capacity each will deliver, and whether the live network can deliver it. As one of our valued team members, you will be obsessed with matching our standards for operational excellence with a relentless focus on delivering results.

You will not do this alone. You will work closely with partner engineering teams across Amazon Leo. You will lead the system architecture of simulation tooling that spans multiple use cases and users, taking planning and simulation methods and making them faster, larger-scale, and production-ready, with the curiosity to engage with the substance of the problem rather than treat it as a black box.

Beyond the planning and simulation work, you will contribute across the other systems our team owns. Our portfolio spans capacity, demand, pricing, inventory, and reservations, and from time to time you will pick up work on any of them as priorities and dependencies shift, from backend services to data pipelines. You will both operate systems that produce commitments the business plans against and build new ones as Leo scales worldwide.

Key job responsibilities
* Scale up and optimize the planning and simulation methods that turn satellite geometry and demand into capacity and coverage plans, improving their performance, scale, and fidelity.
* Make large problems tractable through sound engineering: decomposition, precomputation, caching, and parallelism, proven out with measured results rather than intuition.
* Build and operate the high-performance data and compute infrastructure (large-scale data stores, columnar query, batch fan-out) that lets planning run quickly.
* Build systems that produce correct, trustworthy results, validating outputs against reference implementations and guarding the accuracy of numbers the business commits to.
* Partner with the teams that model the network's capabilities and the teams that operate it in real time to move methods from demonstration toward production.
* Contribute across the other planning systems our team owns, from backend services to data pipelines, as priorities and dependencies require.
* Utilize AWS and other Amazon technologies to build highly available, scalable software services, and provide operational excellence including monitoring, alarming, and on-call ownership.

Export Control Requirements:
Due to applicable export control laws and regulations, candidates must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.

About the team
Our team is the engineering group within Global Business & Customer Operations (GBCO) for Amazon Leo. We own the systems that connect satellite network capacity to what customers can actually buy: capacity planning, demand planning, pricing, inventory, reservations, and the data platform that ties them together. We started focused on capacity planning and have grown our scope alongside the business, so there is real room to shape new systems as Leo expands globally. We value ownership, operational excellence, and engineers who think across system boundaries.

Basic qualifications

- 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
- 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
- Experience programming with at least one software programming language

Preferred qualifications

- 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
- Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent
- Experience working effectively with science, data processing, and software engineering teams
- Experience improving the performance and scale of computationally intensive systems or algorithms.
- Exposure to optimization, simulation, or large-scale numerical or geospatial data processing, or an interest in developing depth in those areas.

title: シニアエリアマネージャー, SSD
descriptionHtml:
※このポジションの勤務地は大阪府茨木市近郊を予定しています。

私たちのグローバルオペレーションネットワークは、日々何百万もの荷物と笑顔をAmazonのお客様にお届けしています。私たちは、シニアエリアマネージャーとして私たちのチームに加わってほしいと考え、意欲的で顧客重視の人材を探しています。この役割では、複数メンバーのチームをリードし、シフト中のチームの安全性、品質、出勤率、およびパフォーマンスを最高水準に維持するため、チームに働きかける責任があります。また、お客様の注文が適切な時間に適切な場所へ確実に配送されるよう、お客様の期待に応えることにおいても重要な役割を担います。

私たちの業務の流れには3つの主要な要素があります。
商品が保管され注文に備える「ファーストマイル」、注文品をお客様のエリアまで輸送する「ミドルマイル」、そして商品をお客様の玄関先までお届けする「ラストマイル」です。各拠点で運営方法に若干の違いはありますが、一貫して変わらないものが一つあります、それは顧客を第一に考える私たちのビジョンと献身的な姿勢です。

本ポジションはAmazonの新しいエキサイティングな物流拠点で業務を行います。可能な限り最速でお客様のご自宅に商品をお届けすることでお客様のカスタマーエクスペリエンスを向上します。私たちと一緒に歴史をつくりましょう！

Amazonでは、最新のAI Tool, 生成AIを日々の業務の中に積極的に取り入れています。
AI Toolは私たちの意思決定のスピードを加速させ、私たちを本当に重要な「判断」と「議論」に集中させることを可能にしています。Amazon では学習を継続する文化が根付いているため、ご自身のペースでAIに関する知識を深めることができるリソースが用意されています。


Key job responsibilities
【具体的な業務内容】
■生産・業務計画の立案、進捗・実績・各種指標管理、人員・労務管理
想定物量を予測する部署と連携し、生産・業務計画を立案します。
配送ルートや人員配置の全体計画を立てます。
具体的には、物量に応じて必要となる人員数を算出し外部協力会社（派遣会社や業務委託会社など）との連携。
また社内システムを用いて各種計画の進捗・実績管理などを実施。現場と連携し、生産性向上を実現していきます。

■各種プロジェクト・改善活動の取りまとめ、人員育成・チームビルディング
今の生産性を維持するのではなく、改善を図って向上させるのがAmazonのシニアエリアマネージャーです。
業務改善プロジェクトなどの進行・取りまとめ役となり、最新テクノロジーの導入や工程の見直し等検討し、教育プランの策定も行います。
ミーティングはオペレーションマネージャーやエリアマネージャーと定期的に実施します。

■業務上で発生したトラブルや問題の解決
例えば、コンベアが停止した際のリカバリープランの立案・実施など。
商品が物流拠点内で滞留しないよう、トラブルに合わせて人員配置や対応方法などを検討します。


A day in the life

title: オペレーションマネージャー, SSD
descriptionHtml:
※このポジションの勤務地は愛知県内・名古屋近郊の物流拠点です。

アマゾンジャパンのオペレーション部門では、事業拡大のためオペレーションマネージャー（副センター長格）を募集しています。アマゾンは毎日多くのパッケージと笑顔をお客様にお届けし、地球上で最もお客様を大切にする企業を目指しています。

当社の「より早い配送」を実現するための最前線のオペレーションの現場を管理する責任を負います。このサイトではチームは20～300 名程度のメンバーで構成されます。数十億円の予算規模の年間の運営計画を立て、その実行責任を負います。分析スキルや問題解決スキル、チームとしてパフォーマンス実現、メンバーと良好な関係構築、コーチングやメンタリングなどの人材管理スキルの成長を期待されると同時にサポートされます。

私たちは毎年新しいオペレーション拠点を立ち上げ、ビジネスの拡大を共に体験し、プロフェッショナルとしての成長機会を提供しています。パートタイムのアソシエイトからプログラムマネージメントまで、多様なバックグラウンドを持つメンバーとの交流を通じて、新しい視点やスキルを身に付けることができます。

Amazonでは、最新のAI Tool, 生成AIを日々の業務の中に積極的に取り入れています。
AI Toolは私たちの意思決定のスピードを加速させ、私たちを本当に重要な「判断」と「議論」に集中させることを可能にしています。Amazon では学習を継続する文化が根付いているため、ご自身のペースでAIに関する知識を深めることができるリソースが用意されています。

Key job responsibilities
【キャリアパス】
オペレーションマネージャーは、大きな組織をリードし、サイトリーダーに昇格する機会や、地域統括リーダーへとステップアップする機会があります。また、アマゾンのオペレーションの様々なポジションへのステップアップを模索するオプションがあります。

【具体的な業務内容】
- 物流拠点運営、ソートおよびディスパッチオペレーションのリードおよび監督
- シフト全体の安全性、品質、パフォーマンス、カスタマーサービス向上
- 組織の方針と手順に従っての監督責任

title: Manager I, Ops, Linehaul
descriptionHtml:
Looking for a career at a company that seeks to be Earth’s most customer-centric company? If so, meet Amazon.
Over the past 20+ years, Amazon has reinvented on behalf of customers and has become the largest internet retailer and marketplace in the world. Through our entrepreneurial culture, Amazon has developed new technologies and products and enterprise services. APEX NOC (Network Operation Center) is the central command and control center for ‘Transportation Execution’ across Amazon’s transportation network. It ensures hassle-free, timely pick-up and delivery of freight from vendors to Amazon fulfillment centers (FC) and from Amazon FCs to carrier hubs. In case of any exceptions, NOC steps in to resolve the issue and keeps all the stakeholders informed on the proceedings. Along with this tactical problem solving, NOC is also charged with understanding trends in network exceptions and then automating processes or proposing process changes to streamline operations. This second aspect involves network monitoring and significant analysis of network data. Overall, Relay Ops plays a critical role in ensuring the smooth functioning of Amazon transportation and thereby has a direct impact on Amazon’s ability to serve its customers on time.
Risk and Compliance Monitoring Team (RCMT) within NOC is the centralized risk management function for RoW Surface Transportation. This team leads risk assessments across ST programs and develops tailored risk mitigation initiatives, programs, and audits to meet the needs of our business customers. RCMT is dedicated to preventing bad actors from exploiting Amazon services for illicit purposes and collaborates closely with legal, finance, and HR departments to conduct thorough investigations and take necessary actions against such actors. Our overarching vision is to ensure that bad actors never derive any benefit from Amazon by exploiting our policies. To achieve this, RCMT relies on sound judgment, technical expertise, and a robust risk management framework. We harness advanced technology to enhance our processes and develop projects, programs, and products that optimize Surface Transportation Operations across RoW countries — Brazil, Mexico, AMET (Egypt, KSA, South Africa, UAE), Japan, India, and Australia.
The role operates on a rotational shift model (including nights and rotational week-offs) to provide round-the-clock risk coverage across time zones.

Key job responsibilities
• Process Expertise & Subject Matter Leadership — Demonstrate in-depth knowledge of Surface Transportation processes and serve as a Subject Matter Expert (SME) for risk management within the assigned RoW geographies. Maintain subject matter expertise specific to job functions and general industry awareness to provide informed recommendations to leadership.
• Risk Mitigation & Process Improvement — Apply risk-management best practices and methodologies to mitigate identified risk issues. Execute against established SOPs, identify and recommend opportunities for process improvement, draft SOP revisions, and conduct risk assessments for new process implementations to ensure vulnerabilities are identified and mitigated before go-live.
• Team Management & Development — Manage and supervise investigators — including workload assignment, quality review of investigation outputs, SLA adherence monitoring, and calibration. Mentor new hires and participate in the development and delivery of risk management training.
• Trend Analysis & Financial Impact Quantification — Conduct weekly and monthly trend analysis across assigned RoW geographies, including period-over-period comparisons and concentration analysis. Own the financial impact quantification framework — tracking cost leakage, cost avoidance, and cost savings attributable to risk interventions, coordinating with finance for periodic validation.
• Proactive Risk Identification & Expansion — Proactively identify new risk patterns through systematic analysis of investigation outputs and region-specific vulnerability assessments. Drive cross-pollination of risk management learnings into adjacent operational functions and workstreams to expand the program’s impact beyond core scope.
• Business Reviews & Escalation Management — Own and drive operational review cadences including business review content preparation and escalation management. Perform deep-dive analysis and draft COE based on identified deviations and recommend appropriate solutions to ensure leadership visibility into program health and outcomes.
• Investigation Oversight & Triage — Oversee the investigation triage process — reviewing flagged cases from monitoring dashboards, determining root cause, validating operational justifications, identifying gaps in controls and processes, and managing escalations in consultation with legal where required.
• Technology Partnership & Monitoring Enhancement — Partner with automation and technology teams on dashboard enhancements, detection logic refinement, and false positive reduction to continuously improve monitoring accuracy, coverage, and program efficiencies.
• Project Delivery & Execution — Develop appropriate milestones and launch project schedules to ensure timely and successful delivery of projects and standard work (e.g., audits/reviews, licensing).
• Program Alignment & Business Understanding — Ensure program alignment with the risk strategy, regulations, policies, and team objectives. Understand the business needs and workflows owned by your team including financial risk, controls, escalation paths, data sources, metrics, testing mechanisms, key dependencies, automation/tools, and risk-assessment methodologies.
• Stakeholder Management & Risk Culture — Maintain structured stakeholder cadences with country-specific leadership, operations execution, procurement, and carrier management teams across all assigned RoW geographies. Support risk reporting and risk-aware culture initiatives across RoW countries.

Basic qualifications

- 1+ years of employee and performance management experience
- Bachelor's degree or equivalent, or 2+ years of Amazon (blue badge/FTE) experience
- Work a flexible schedule/shift/work area, including weekends, nights, and/or holidays

Preferred qualifications

- 1+ years of performance metrics, process improvement or lean techniques experience
- • Knowledge of Excel (Pivot Tables, VLookUps) at an advanced level, SQL, and MS Access
- • Knowledge of Lean principles and DMAIC methodology
- • Demonstrated analytical and quantitative skills to use data and metrics to back up assumptions and develop business cases
- • Experience in requirement gathering and ability to write clear and detailed requirement documents

title: Business Development Manager, Enterprise Support
descriptionHtml:
AWS Global Services includes experts from across AWS who help our customers design, build, operate, and secure their cloud environments. Customers innovate with AWS Professional Services, upskill with AWS Training and Certification, optimize with AWS Support and Managed Services, and meet objectives with AWS Security Assurance Services. Our expertise and emerging technologies include AWS Partners, AWS Sovereign Cloud, AWS International Product, and the Generative AI Innovation Center. You’ll join a diverse team of technical experts in dozens of countries who help customers achieve more with the AWS cloud.

AWS is one of Amazon’s fastest growing businesses, servicing customers in more than 190 countries, reshaping the way global enterprises consume information technology and powering the developers who are building the next generation of global industry leaders. AWS customers include some of the most innovative Startups like Netflix, Pinterest, Spotify, Airbnb, and Instagram as well as some of the largest global enterprises like Shell International, Unilever, Hitachi, Sharp, Bristol-Myers Squibb, and Samsung. We help global and local enterprises to use cloud to remediate their technical debt and build new innovative businesses.

AWS Enterprise Support provides our customers with one-on-one, fast-response support channel that is staffed 24x7x365 with experienced and technical support engineers; Enterprise support provides a designated technical account manager to the customer and provides entitlements such as architecture review, operations support to design, build, and operate cloud environments leveraging AWS best practices; and a designated Support Concierge for administrative and billing inquiries.

Enterprise customers rely on Support when running their business critical workloads on the AWS platform, and our technical account managers and cloud support engineers are the primary daily touch-point for those customers. Customers include very large Enterprises, Public Sector companies, as well as fast growing businesses and Internet companies. Unlike most support organizations, AWS Support is a self-standing business with revenue and P&L responsibility and one of the fastest growing businesses within AWS.

Key job responsibilities
- Engage customers, partners, and field teams to deeply understand and measure customer value and pain points in adoption of Enterprise Support
- Analyze drivers of Enterprise Support adoption and identify levers for improvement
- Identify, design and execute controlled experiments in driving Enterprise Support adoption
- Review and analyse Enterprise Support pricing and costing, ensuring savings are passed on to our customers
- Quantify impact of Enterprise Support adoption on AWS Platform adoption, estimate the ROI of Support investments in accelerating AWS platform adoption
- Develop and refine sales collateral, reference cases and value proofs for customers and partners
- Drive commercial innovation in Support, e.g. differentiated support offerings per customer segment · In conjunction with Field Enablement, create Support related training programs and material for the India field team so that they can properly articulate the Support value proposition
- Work with stakeholders across India Commercial/Public Sales, Premium Support, and Enterprise
- Prepare and present business reviews to the senior Sales and BD management team
- Drive Enterprise Support deals end to end with Sales

A day in the life
As Enterprise Support BDM, you will be part of the AWS India Enterprise Support organization. You will define the strategy and own the go-to-market (GTM) efforts for Support, with the objective to increase adoption for paid support offerings amongst Enterprise customers while maintaining target margin performance, and using Support to accelerate AWS platform adoption for the customers. You will engage our customers to understand why they need Enterprise Support (or why not), what are the pain points and obstacles in their current support offering. You will identify areas for sharpening our Support proposition (e.g. a differentiated offering, pricing) and design and execute controlled experiments driving commercial innovation. You will quantify the impact of Support in driving AWS platform adoption, estimate the ROI, and design and execute initiatives to help accelerate our customer cloud adoption journey. You will enable the sales team to drive the day-to-day interactions with prospects, selling the Support value proposition, in order to build long-term business opportunity. You will engage partners to develop and pilot new Support offerings via the partner ecosystem.

The ideal candidate will possess a keen business sense and exceptional analytical skills, is able to articulate and communicate a clear value proposition across customers, partners, and within the AWS organization, and its comfortable working across internal functions and geographies. The candidate will be naturally curious, going beyond the obvious to discover unexpected insights and translate those into tangible business value.

Diverse Experiences
AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Inclusive Team Culture
AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.

title: Tax Manager, Foreign Tax Reporting and Compliance
descriptionHtml:
Amazon's EMEA Direct Tax Reporting & Compliance team is scaling fast - and we're building the next generation of tax operations with AI-driven automation - not spreadsheets. Join us in Warsaw as a Tax Manager and help drive direct tax compliance for Amazon's portfolio in Europe, with a primary focus on Poland.

You'll own tax reporting and compliance for a portfolio of Amazon's EMEA legal entities, working directly with cross-functional partners across Accounting, Legal, and Transfer Pricing. You'll be part of a team actively deploying GenAI and automation tools to modernize how tax compliance gets done at scale. You'll gain exposure to high-complexity, high-visibility work: statutory filings, tax authority correspondence, audits, and cross-border restructuring projects

The successful candidate will be a highly organized self-starter with strong problem-solving and communication skills, a sharp attention to detail, and the ability to operate independently while working proactively across multiple functional teams in a deadline-driven environment. Beyond managing the compliance portfolio, this person is genuinely motivated to make things better - identifying inefficiencies, driving automation, and continuously raising the bar on how the work gets done. Experience leveraging technology and AI tools to deliver those improvements is highly valued.

Key job responsibilities
Working within the EMEA Foreign Reporting & Compliance team, Tax Manager will:
- Manage income tax compliance, including corporate income tax returns and income tax payments across the assigned portfolio
- Support income tax accounting and reporting under US GAAP and local GAAP and review international aspects of Amazon's worldwide income tax provision
- Manage relationships with external tax advisors and support tax controversy teams on audits
- Own process improvement initiatives - identify automation and simplification opportunities, drive reduction in in manual effort, and develop standard procedures for compliance and reporting processes
- Partner cross-functionally with Direct Tax Technology and Tax Transformation teams to resolve systemic issues and automate recurring calculations and corporate tax requirements
- Participate in special projects, including tax due diligence and integration support for M&A
- Research and document technical tax and tax accounting issues across the assigned portfolio; work with external advisors to assess the impact of new laws and regulations on Amazon's structure and business

About the team
The Amazon Tax department is a fast-paced, collaborative, high-ownership environment. The EMEA Foreign Reporting & Compliance team manages the worldwide tax-related filings and local tax reporting compliance of Amazon's foreign entities - a portfolio growing in scale and complexity as the business expands across the region.

We pair deep tax technical expertise with a strong focus on process improvement and automation, including AI, to modernize tax compliance. Team members collaborate closely with Accounting, Legal, and Transfer Pricing across multiple countries, and own their portfolio of entities and jurisdictions from day one.

Basic qualifications

- Experience a compliance focused tax role in a multinational and/or professional organization
- Experience with accounting concepts and tax regulations, laws and standards
- Experience implementing repeatable processes and driving automation or standardization
- Bachelor's degree in finance, accounting or related field
- Speak, write, and read fluently in Polish
- Strong tax operational background with a track record of managing complex, multi-jurisdiction compliance portfolios

Preferred qualifications

- Master's degree
- Polish Certified Tax Advisor (Doradca Podatkowy)
- Technical aptitude to independently build and maintain solutions — not only to identify what needs to be done, but to design and implement it; comfortable working at the intersection of tax and technology

title: Product Manager III, Amazon Business India
descriptionHtml:
About Amazon Business:
Join Amazon Business, where we're revolutionizing B2B commerce. As a rapidly growing $50 billion global business, we're building a future where businesses of all sizes can find, discover, and purchase everything they need with unprecedented ease and intelligence. Our mission: to become the world's most customer-centric company and the preferred strategic partner for smart business buying. From solo entrepreneurs to Fortune 500 companies, we serve diverse business customers across eleven countries, reimagining procurement with innovative solutions that drive efficiency and growth.
At Amazon Business, it's still Day 1. If you're passionate about solving complex challenges, creating disruptive solutions, and making history, this is your opportunity. Bring your insight, imagination, and healthy disregard for the impossible as we unlock the vast potential of B2B commerce in India.

The Role:
Are you excited about building products that transform how millions of businesses discover and adopt e-commerce?
Amazon Business India is looking for a Senior Product Manager to own the Shopping Experience and Marketing Tech charter for Amazon Business in India.

The Vision: We believe the next frontier in B2B commerce is moving from generic experiences to deeply personalized ones. Unlike B2C, Amazon Business customers register with verified business identifiers (GST, PAN), giving us rich context — industry, company size, purchase patterns — from Day 1. We intend to leverage this unique B2B advantage to deliver smarter, more relevant experiences across every customer touchpoint, both onsite and offsite.

We are seeking a talented Senior Product Manager to own the Shopping Experience and Marketing Tech charter for Amazon Business in India. This is a dual-mandate role spanning two interconnected domains:

1. Onsite Shopping Experience: You will re-imagine every aspect of the business customer's onsite journey — browse, search, selection and offer discovery and checkout. The objective is to simplify the end-to-end shopping experience with personalization and friction reduction to increase frequency and basket size of business customer purchases. You will create a north-star experience that enables customers to quickly discover the most relevant product or high-value action, and complete their purchase with the fewest steps possible.

2. Off-App Marketing Tech: You will own the marketing technology stack that powers automated, personalized outbound engagement across every customer touchpoint off-app, including:
- Organic & AI surfaces — traditional search (SEO) and emerging AI platforms
- Conversational surfaces — WhatsApp and chat-based engagement
- Outbound channels — email and push notifications
- Amazon.com and social — on-platform and social media surfaces

You will build and scale the systems and tooling that enable marketers to create, test, and optimize customer lifecycle journeys without engineering dependency — driving high-intent engagement back into the Amazon Business app and strengthening the brand across off-app surfaces.

Key job responsibilities

- Vision & Strategy: Define the long-term product vision and roadmap for both onsite shopping experience and off-app marketing tech — creating a unified engagement layer across all customer touchpoints
- Personalization: Drive the development of personalization capabilities that leverage business context and behavioral signals to deliver relevant experiences across onsite and offsite channels
- Customer Understanding: Develop deep understanding of business customer lifecycle patterns, procurement behaviors, and channel preferences to inform when, where, and how we engage customers
- Experience Design: Design and implement customer experiences that are contextual, frictionless, and consistent across the onsite journey and outbound channels
- Marketing Automation: Build and scale marketing automation systems that enable personalized, multi-channel customer journeys — from acquisition through retention — with self-serve tooling for marketing team
- Innovation: Pioneer new approaches to B2B customer engagement across emerging surfaces including AI platforms, conversational interfaces, and agentic experiences — positioning Amazon Business ahead of shifting customer behavior
- Metrics & Experimentation: Define success metrics, build a robust experimentation roadmap, and drive continuous optimization across all channels and lifecycle stages
- Collaboration: The roadmap will be a mix of India-first products and India adaptations of global product features. You will partner closely with senior stakeholders across engineering, science, marketing, UX design, and business intelligence teams across Amazon India and Amazon Worldwide


A day in the life
You start your morning reviewing key product metrics and customer feedback, identifying signals that inform your next set of priorities. By mid-morning you are in a design review, debating trade-offs on a new feature with your engineering and design partners. After lunch you draft a product requirements document, pressure-testing assumptions with data from recent experiments. Later, you connect with cross-functional partners to align on an upcoming launch plan and resolve open dependencies.

Basic qualifications

- 5+ years of end to end product delivery experience
- Bachelor's degree or equivalent
- Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition
- Experience with end to end product delivery
- Experience with feature delivery and tradeoffs of a product
- Experience as a product manager or owner
- Experience owning technology products

Preferred qualifications

- Experience in influencing senior leadership through data driven insights
- Experience working across functional teams and senior stakeholders

title: Business Analyst II, Transportation Long Term Capacity Planning
descriptionHtml:
Amazon.com strives to be Earth's most customer-centric company where people can find and discover virtually anything they want to buy online. By giving customers more of what they want - low prices, vast selection, and convenience - Amazon.com continues to grow and evolve as a world-class e-commerce platform. Amazon's evolution from Web site to e-commerce partner to development platform is driven by the spirit of innovation that is part of the company's DNA. The world's brightest technology minds come to Amazon.com to research and develop technology that improves the lives of shoppers and sellers around the world.

We are looking for a good fit to join our Transportation Long Term Capacity Planning Team, part of the larger Supply Chain Team. This team plays a crucial role in strategically planning and executing Amazon's Last Mile Transportation network topology over a 1-3 year horizon. As a Last Mile Business Analyst II, you will be at the forefront of enabling cross-functional teams to evolve our delivery network, continuously analyzing and optimizing for cost, speed, and reliability while maintaining a strong customer focus.

In this role, you will be responsible for developing analytical frameworks and capacity models that address both current and future demands, ensuring business continuity even through peak periods. Your analysis will directly contribute to our long-term strategy programs, preparing Amazon's last mile delivery network for sustained growth while striking the delicate balance between delivery speed, operational efficiency, and cost-effectiveness.

You will leverage your expertise in data analysis, long-term forecasting, and capacity modeling to generate data-driven insights that shape the future of our Last Mile operations. This position requires strong analytical skills, a strategic mindset, and the ability to collaborate effectively with diverse teams across the organization. Your insights and recommendations will be instrumental in guiding senior leadership decisions and driving the continuous improvement of our vast delivery network.

As a key member of this team, you'll have the opportunity to make a significant impact on Amazon's ability to meet and exceed customer expectations in the years to come, playing a vital role in our mission to be Earth's most customer-centric company.

You are expected to have exceptional analytical, planning, and written/verbal communication skills. You know and love working with business intelligence tools, are comfortable accessing and working with big data from multiple sources, and are enthusiastic about partnering with the business to deliver results. You are a self-starter, comfortable with ambiguity, able to think big, and enjoy working in a fast-paced environment.

Join our team and help shape the future of Amazon's last mile delivery network, contributing to our mission of becoming Earth's most customer-centric company while balancing delivery speed with efficiency and cost-effectiveness!


Key job responsibilities
- Develop and maintain long-term forecasting models for the Last Mile network, focusing on Quarterly Guidance Numbers Validation
- Build and run complex analytical models to predict network capacity requirements 1-3 years in advance
- Partner with cross-functional teams to gather data and insights for accurate long-term forecasting
- Analyze historical data, market trends, and business strategies to refine long-term forecasting methodologies
- Present data-driven insights and recommendations to senior leadership, supporting strategic decision-making
- Support the Plan of Record (POR) planning process through analytical inputs, ensuring alignment with company objectives and financial targets
- Identify opportunities for network improvements and cost optimizations through deep-dive analysis of long-term forecasting data
- Design and maintain dashboards, reports, and automated analytical tools to improve forecasting accuracy and visibility
- Develop capacity models for current and future demands, ensuring business continuity through peak periods
- Contribute analytical frameworks to long-term strategy programs that prepare Amazon's last mile delivery network for growth, balancing delivery speed with efficiency and cost-effectiveness


About the team
The Long Term Middle and Last Mile Capacity Planning Team strategically plans and executes Transportation network topology over a 1-3 year horizon. We unite teams to evolve the network, optimizing cost, speed, and reliability with customer focus. We develop capacity solutions for current and future demands, ensuring business continuity through peak periods. Our long-term strategy programs prepare Amazon's logistics for growth, balancing delivery speed with efficiency and cost-effectiveness.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree or equivalent
- 3+ years of business analyst, data analyst or similar role experience

Preferred qualifications

- 3+ years of experience working with data querying languages (e.g., SQL) and data visualization tools (e.g., QuickSight, Tableau, Excel)
- Experience with forecasting models and capacity planning methodologies
- Experience defining requirements and using data to back up assumptions and drive actions
- Experience making business recommendations and influencing stakeholders through data-driven insights

title: Senior Structural Engineer, TIPM, Global Realty Building Design & Engineering
descriptionHtml:
Amazon is seeking an experienced Structural Engineer to join our team as Senior Technical Infrastructure Program Manager (TIPM), playing a pivotal role in leading design, facility, and engineering activities within Amazon's Fulfillment Network. This role is primarily focused on the Europe (EMEA) region, with consulting support extended to the LATAM and MEATR regions. This role will be in Luxembourg or Madrid with occasional travel to operational sites or those under construction. Reporting directly to the Principal Engineering Manager of Global Building Design & Engineering in India, the successful candidate will be responsible for developing and cross-functionally managing structural engineering programs aimed at optimizing and enhancing the safety and efficiency of both existing and new facilities. Collaboration with various stakeholders will be essential to drive the development and management of design specifications, including consideration of cross-disciplinary system impact (e.g., fire protection, HVAC, etc.). The ideal candidate will possess extensive project and program management experience, practical knowledge of structural engineering, and the ability to thrive in a fast-paced, technical environment while partnering with multiple stakeholders to implement cost-saving processes and programs. You will be our Subject Matter Expert for Timber, Metal, and Concrete structures supporting the structural solutions for the prototype templates, working with other global teams such as Preconstruction, Construction, and Sustainability.

Key job responsibilities
Europe (EMEA) is the primary region of ownership; the Sr TIPM additionally acts as a consulting SME to the LATAM and MEATR regions for design specifications and standards. The Sr TIPM will be the key contributor and owner on structural design initiatives across the EU region while tracking key metrics and performance, function as consulting SME to stakeholders, be able to build a business case and market building improvements, and work across the industry to understand trends and develop scalable technologies.

A day in the life
Your morning begins with a cross-functional stand-up alongside architects, mechanical engineers, and construction managers, aligning on a new fulfillment center design. You dive into structural modeling — optimizing steel frames, analyzing seismic and equipment loads, and future-proofing for robotics. Midday brings peer design reviews where you challenge assumptions and drive cost-efficient solutions. Afternoons involve coordinating with fabricators, resolving site queries with bias for action, and developing standardized design templates that accelerate delivery across the network. You mentor junior engineers, collaborate globally, and own your designs from concept through construction. Here, you don't just design structures — you build the infrastructure powering customer delivery at unprecedented scale.

About the team
Your morning begins with a cross-functional stand-up alongside architects, MEPFS engineers, and construction managers, aligning on a new fulfillment center and other operational Building design. You dive into structural modeling — optimizing steel frames, analyzing seismic, wind, snow, and equipment loads, and futureproofing for robotics, solar installations, and other structurally-supported loads. Midday brings peer design reviews where you challenge assumptions and drive cost-efficient solutions. Afternoons involve translating field feedback and lessons learned into updates to our structural design standards and templates — owning the engineering criteria rather than site-level coordination, which remains with the Precon and Construction teams. You mentor junior engineers, collaborate globally, and own structural designs from concept through to regional template packages and standards — handing over to construction teams for site-specific adaptation. Here, you don't just design structures — you build the standard and criteria for infrastructure, powering customer delivery at unprecedented scale.

Basic qualifications

- Master's degree in Structural Engineering
- Experience owning program strategy, end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership
- Experience working with large, complex data sets
- • Experience working with large logistics park and warehouse design
- • Proficiency in structural analysis software (ETABS, STAAD Pro, SAP2000, RISA, or Tekla Structures)

Preferred qualifications

- 5+ years of experience in structural design of industrial, warehouse, or large-scale commercial buildings,Proficiency in structural analysis software (ETABS, STAAD Pro, SAP2000, RISA, or Tekla Structures),Familiarity with seismic design, dynamic equipment loads, and vibration analysis,Working knowledge of international building codes (IBC, IS, Eurocode, AS)

title: Solutions Architect, Advertising, Publishing and Information Services, UKI
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is looking for a Solutions Architect to join our Telco, Media, Entertainment, Games and Sports (TMEGS) team in the UK and Ireland, focusing on customers in Advertising, Publishing and Information Services. As a trusted technical advisor, you will help advertisers, ad tech platforms, publishers and information providers innovate and transform their business using AWS technologies, including generative AI and machine learning.

Solutions Architects work hand in hand with AWS customers to help them make the most of the Cloud. They own the overall technical relationship between customers and AWS and make recommendations on security, cost, performance, reliability and operational efficiency. They work to understand the customer's business needs and give prescriptive guidance on how to create business value with technology. To do this they collaborate with other teams such as account management, professional services, support, product teams and the AWS partner ecosystem.
AI is transforming Advertising, Publishing and Information Services. Publishers are rethinking how content is created, personalised and licensed. Advertisers and ad tech companies are reshaping targeting, measurement and creative production in a privacy-first world. Information services providers are turning large proprietary datasets into intelligent products. In this role you will get to practice your creativity, linking technology to tangible solutions and educating customers about the art of the possible. You will work closely with Account Managers to help customers achieve their outcomes using AWS technology.

We're looking for someone passionate and self-driven, who is curious about how technology shapes media and information, and who enjoys taking ownership of customer outcomes with limited guidance.
The Solutions Architecture team is a diverse group of technologists from a variety of backgrounds. Practical knowledge of the AWS platform is desired but not required, provided you have a sound technical foundation and a desire to learn.

• Own the technical relationship with your customers and operate as their trusted advisor. The best interests of the customer will shape the guidance you provide

title: Principal Program Manager - App Release & Platform Policy, Mobile App Foundations
descriptionHtml:
Amazon's mobile shopping app is used by hundreds of millions of customers worldwide and are among the most downloaded applications on both the App Store and Google Play. Behind these apps is Mobile App Foundations, a team within Rendering Foundations that owns the platform infrastructure, release operations, and app-level capabilities that enable thousands of Amazon builders to ship features to customers through a single, shared mobile application. Releasing at this scale means coordinating thousands of builder teams shipping into a single application that serves customers across dozens of global marketplaces. Each app store submission must meet evolving platform, legal, and regulatory requirements, and the cost of getting it wrong is a blocked release that affects every team, and end users at every marketplace.

As a Principal Program Manager within Mobile App Foundations, you will own the end-to-end mobile app release program and serve as Amazon's primary operational interface on app store policy matters. You will build the frameworks, relationships, and processes that make Amazon's mobile shopping apps releasable at a scheduled cadence while ensuring every submission meets various internal and external requirements across all marketplaces we serve.

Key job responsibilities
You will own the mobile release program across iOS and Android, driving the operational cadence that enables thousands of Amazon teams to ship features to customers without release delays. You will serve as Amazon's point of contact for external partner relations on policy matters, building strategic relationships with platform counterparts. You will work directly with Amazon Legal, Business Development, and feature teams that build on Amazon Shopping app to interpret platform policy changes, assess risk, and make high-judgment calls. You will develop proactive policy monitoring frameworks that identify potential submission issues before they cause rejections with a systematic approach. When platform policy conflicts arise, you will frame the tradeoffs clearly for VP-level leadership, recommend a path forward, and drive resolution across organizational boundaries.

A successful candidate brings strong program management instincts, the ability to operate in ambiguous environments, and the judgment to make calls that balance customer experience and business impact. You will influence and align multiple stakeholders across organizational boundaries, represent complex problems simply to leadership, and drive clarity under time constraints where none exists.

Basic qualifications

- 7+ years of working cross functionally with tech and non-tech teams experience
- 7+ years of program or project management experience
- 7+ years of managing, analyzing and communicating results to senior leadership experience
- Bachelor's degree
- Experience implementing repeatable processes and driving automation or standardization
- Experience defining program requirements and using data and metrics to determine improvements
- Experience operating in environments with legal, regulatory, or policy constraints that require interpretation and judgment rather than fixed rules

Preferred qualifications

- Experience delivering projects within scope, time, budget and quality
- Experience with mobile app release programs at scale (App Store, Google Play)
- Experience in industries with regulatory or platform policies (mobile, fintech, healthcare, media)

title: Mechanical / Electrical Engineer, InfraOps DCEO
descriptionHtml:
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

Amazon is seeking a collaborative electrical maintenance professional for our Amazon Web Services Team.
This engineering operations technician position serves as the on-site maintenance technician and operator for an AWS data centre.
The Data Centre Engineering Operations Technician (EOT) is responsible for operating and maintaining all electrical, mechanical, emergency generator, and fire/life safety equipment within the data centre. The EOT serves as a technical resource to support Amazon within its data centres. Data centre equipment that supports mission-critical servers must maintain better than 99.999% uptime. EOT’s are also tasked with driving innovation while reducing operational costs in the facilities.

EOT’s are Amazon’s front line responders for hands-on electrical and mechanical equipment troubleshooting and operation. This equipment includes, but is not limited to, stand-by diesel generators, switchboards/switch-gears, UPS’s, PDU’s, AHU’s, pumps, motors, VFD’s, and building automation systems. This role will not require shift work.

title: Sr. Program Manager, Customer Management & GTM, SMGS Ops - Sales Planning & Policy
descriptionHtml:
AWS Sales Planning and Compensation is the central team that designs and executes the policy, processes, and common structures and definitions that global sales planning runs on. Annual Planning is the window in which AWS implements major go-to-market changes to grow and support its customers: organizational structure changes, reviewing accounts and placing them into the right territories, with the right sales coverage and quota targets for the new year. Our job is to make those decisions early, consistently, and through governed inputs rather than disconnected assumptions, so sellers start the year with their accounts, territories, and quotas in hand. In-Year Planning is how those decisions stay current: the business does not stand still for twelve months, so the same structures have to be able to change in year, at the speed the business moves, without losing the governance that made them trustworthy at the start of it.

Customer Management & GTM is the planning mechanism that produces well-formed customers in our CRM: each customer defined consistently, attributed to a single accountable team, and carrying the customer attributes that planning depends on. Coverage segmentation, territories, and quota targets are all set against the customers this process produces, so a customer that is wrongly formed is a coverage decision made wrongly for the whole year. It runs globally, across every business unit and geography: continuously in year, and at scale through the annual planning window with a hard close date.

We are looking for a Program Manager to own the Customer Management & GTM policy and the program that delivers it. The design problem is scale. A small number of customer decisions genuinely need human judgement, and the rest should be settled by rules. Your job is to tell the two apart. You decide what the policy says, who may change a customer's accountability, on what evidence, and which decisions still require a person. Where a decision is both contested and consequential, you adjudicate, either yourself or through a review board you convene and chair.

Your mandate is to make this scale as AWS grows. With Planning Tools, you will turn policy into logic the systems enforce and build the data-driven and agentic capabilities that take manual work out of the cycle. You will sit within the One Customer Partner (OCP) program, the framework for how AWS defines, identifies, and manages its customer and partner relationships, and you will co-own its primary change vehicle with the product leader who builds it. OCP defines what a well-formed customer is; Customer Management is where that definition meets every account in the business, which makes it where the definition gets tested. With the business, you will build a mechanism with enough give for the cases it should allow: where a customer decision is genuinely non-standard, the policy names the path, the team closest to it takes the decision, and the record carries the reason. Escalation stops being the only way past a rule that was drawn too tight. The measure is the same in all three directions: more customers formed correctly the first time, with less effort, and fewer decisions needing a person at all.

Much of this work has no precedent to follow, and the right answer looks different depending on where you sit: each team is accountable for something different, so each reaches its answer in good faith and those answers do not agree. You are the one holding the wider view, in two directions: across the whole of AWS, and across what the business needs for the next ten years rather than what it wants today. Success in this role means forming a position and supporting it with data, then working it through with internal stakeholders and with customers to truth-seek what is genuinely right. Right means right for the customer and right for AWS, which is not always the conclusion any single team would come to on its own.



Key job responsibilities
- Own the Customer Management policy. Translate the OCP customer definition into operable policy: who may change a customer's accountability, on what evidence, which changes proceed automatically and which require review. Feed back the cases the definition cannot yet handle.
- Own the customer attributes that make a customer plan-able. A customer is not well formed by identity and accountability alone: it has to carry the attributes downstream planning depends on, including industry classification, size, location, and the coverage segmentation derived from them. Own the policy for those attributes, the standard each one must meet, and where they are sourced from, working with the data and third-party providers who supply them. A wrong attribute produces a wrong coverage decision just as surely as a wrong accountability does.
- Co-Own the change mechanism and the decisions that run through it. Design and run the submission, approval and escalation paths through which customer records change, in year and through the annual planning window. Hold the single view of their health and status, and be accountable for the annual window closing on schedule with the policy intact. Where a case is contested, you decide: how a customer should be defined, or which organization is accountable for it. Take the call yourself where you can; convene and chair a review board for the sensitive cases, bringing the evidence and a recommendation, and work the answer through with stakeholders to reach what is right for the customer, for the business, and for AWS as a whole.
- Design how the work gets done, and make it scale. Teams should not have to work out their own approach to Customer Management each year. Design the workstreams and jobs to be done that take a business unit through the cycle in a consistent sequence, with the data, recommendations and policy they need at each step, and measure progress through scorecards that show completion and quality by business unit and geography. Decide which decisions genuinely need a person and which should be settled by rules, specify that logic precisely enough to be built, and write the requirements for the data-driven and agentic capabilities that settle the routine cases and surface recommendations to planners. Model the effect of a policy change before it ships. You own the what and the why; Planning Tools owns the how.

title: Sr. Site Technical Manager, Devices Postponement Operations (DPO)
descriptionHtml:
The Senior Site Technical Manager (STM) is responsible for development, qualification, and validation of assembly, test, and pack out processes for Amazon’s Devices Products in a multi-product, automation-focused factory. STMs troubleshoot and resolve technical, material, and process issues, oversee assembly and packout processes, drive cost, process, and yield improvements. STMs apply lean methodologies, support site acceptance testing (SAT), and DFx (Design for Automation, Manufacturing, Cost). STMs work closely with Amazon’s Contract Manufacturer (CM) and Amazon’s product design and automation engineers.

Key job responsibilities
As Senior STM, you:
• own resolution of technical issues for multiple products in a fast-paced, automation-focused factory;
• work quickly and collaboratively with colleagues and suppliers to identify, troubleshoot, and resolve automation, material, process, and procedure issues;
• drive continuous improvements to manufacturing and automation processes, including oversight of the Contract Manufacturer’s continuous improvement program;
• identify and design required assembly and test fixtures for new and existing products;
• work with others on new product design-for-automation, create standard operating procedures and processes, and oversee the Contract Manufacturer’s operator training program to ensure readiness before production;
• identify and drive quality improvement and cost reduction goals, including oversight of the Contract Manufacturer’s incoming quality control processes;
• oversee the Contract Manufacturer’s preventive maintenance program to ensure equipment availability meets production requirements.


A day in the life
The STM will be actively engaged in managing the factory and its processes, on the floor working with suppliers and operators, monitoring the performance of packout lines, and identifying ideas for continuous improvement. As new programs are introduced to the site, the STM will play a key role in identifying the manufacturing processes to aid in scoping work and cost. And as issues arise, the STM will be the key leader to bring together all the technical resources needed to quickly diagnose, triage, contain, fix, and restore services to enable the site to meet its on-time delivery goals.

About the team
Device Postponement Operations (DPO) is Amazon Lab126’s team responsible for in-region postponement, customization, and pack-out of Amazon’s innovative devices. We finalize the assembly of devices using automated assembly and pack-out lines so that Amazon can customize products to meet just-in-time demand. We enable Amazon to deliver very quickly to our customers the right configuration of a product at low cost and high quality.
Amazon’s Lab126 began in 2004 as a subsidiary of Amazon.com, Inc., originally creating the best-selling Kindle family of products. Lab126 have produced great devices like Fire TV, the Echo Family of products, and Astro. We deliver delightfully unique Amazon experiences, giving customers instant access to everything, digital, or physical.

Basic qualifications

- Experience with the project management of technical projects
- Bachelor of Science in Mechatronics, Mechanical Engineering, or equivalent
- Experience as on-site technical lead for high-volume manufacturing and complex packout, leading issue resolution, and overseeing routine machine maintenance and monitoring
- Demonstrated experience with cycle time waterfall and line balancing, SOP generation, personnel training
- Experience developing functional specifications, design verification plans, and functional test procedures while launching programs in a phase-gate release (e.g., xVT, Ramp) and acceptance-test process (FAT, SAT); basic GD&T and DFx (Manufacturing, Cost, Test)
- Experience with Lean/Six Sigma and Kaizen methodologies
- Demonstrated knowledge and experience with quality concepts, tools, and methods such as 8D, DOE, APQP, PPAP, FMEA, Measurement Systems Analysis, fishbone diagrams, 5Whys
- Data management and analysis using Minitab; Yield reporting with Pareto, Cp/Cpk, GR&R
- Experience with precision measurement and inspection devices such as calipers, micrometers, height gages, OMM, profilometers, optical inspection devices, multi-meters, and torque wrenches
- Manufacturing knowledge and relevant work experience in Supplier Quality, Product Quality, or Product Reliability
- Demonstrated ability to resolve complex issues in creative, efficient, and effective ways, including handling ambiguous or undefined challenges
- Demonstrated ability to gain deep understanding of the business and end user needs quickly, using customer insights and data
- 10+ years' experience in operations, working with and managing OEM/CM suppliers, throughout the product life cycle from Concept to EOL with minimum 5 years experience as STM

Preferred qualifications

- Master's degree in electrical engineering, computer engineering, or equivalent
- Master's degree in Industrial, Mechanical, Mechatronics, or Electrical Engineering, or equivalent
- Lean Six Sigma Black Belt certification
- Experience working with interdisciplinary teams to execute product design from concept to production
- Experience with the project management of technical projects
- Experience with PLCs including programming and interfacing with shop floor control systems, IPC, pneumatics, and servomotors
- Experience working with automated equipment suppliers and integrators, including designing or implementing integrated automation solutions (e.g., material handling systems, high-speed packaging lines, manufacturing lines)

descriptionHtml:

All physical requirements are expected with reasonable accommodations:

• Working in cramped and/or elevated and/or noisy environments
• Bending, lifting, stretching, reaching, standing and walking for up to 8+ hours a day

You will be responsible for having a reliable personal vehicle and valid driver's license to travel within the regional work area, as company transportation will not be provided.

• Managing work and priorities through ticketing system and workflows to complete customer requests and projects
• Collaborating with various stakeholders to remove project obstacles
• Troubleshooting networking, routing and interconnectivity issues, including patch panels and patch cords

Traveling within and outside of regional work area and international is required 60% of the time. This position also is 100% onsite.

A day in the life

Providing the first level networking devices to serve our customer racks entails various tasks (the name of the game is efficiency): You will track network rack intake and delivery; work with various onsite teams to request for rack space, power, and cooling for network racks. - Experience with computer hardware troubleshooting and repair

- Can work in cramped spaces or in elevated locations while adhering to health & safety guidelines

Preferred qualifications

title: Software Development Engineer, AWS Cognito, AWS Cognito
descriptionHtml:
AWS Cognito is one of the highest-profile services in AWS Identity: it handles billions of authentication requests for thousands of companies. Our job is to make sign-in so reliable that no one thinks about it. At this scale, that's a hard engineering problem.

As agents, MCP tools, and non-human identities start acting on behalf of users, Cognito is building the solutions that let them sign in, carry scoped and verifiable authority, and be trusted the same way human identities are. If you want to help define what "agentic auth" means for AWS customers, this is the place.

We are deliberately installing a startup culture inside a foundational AWS service: small teams that own problems end-to-end, short paths from idea to production, and a bias toward shipping and learning over waiting for permission. And we are AI-native in how we build—we don't just use AI tools; we build our own agents for code review, operational investigation, and CR scaffolding, and we engage AI first on most tasks. You get the ownership and pace of a startup with the scale, customers, and impact of core AWS.

Key job responsibilities
- Design, build, and operate highly available, low-latency authentication services that real customers depend on 24/7.
- Own features end-to-end design, implementation, testing, deployment, and operations—for services in the Cognito User Auth space (sign-in, tokens, devices, and related data planes).
- Raise the bar on operational excellence: measurable availability, latency, and security improvements, and automation that removes manual work.
- Work AI-native: engage AI first, and build and extend the team's own agentic tooling for development, code review, and operational investigation.
- Dive deep on ambiguous, production-impacting problems and drive them to a root cause and a durable fix.
- Collaborate across AWS Identity teams and mentor other engineers.

A day in the life
The challenges SDEs solve for at Amazon are big and influence millions of customers, sellers, and products around the world. We are looking for individuals who are passionate about creating new products, features, and services from scratch while managing ambiguity and the pace of a company where development cycles are measured in weeks, not years.

Basic qualifications

- 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
- 2+ years of designing and developing large-scale, multi-tiered, multi-threaded, embedded or distributed software applications, tools, systems, and services using: C#, C++, Java, or Perl experience
- 1+ years of software development engineer or related occupational experience
- Bachelor's degree or foreign equivalent in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field
- Experience programming with at least one software programming language

Preferred qualifications

- 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
- Experience contributing to the architecture and design (architecture, design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and current systems
- Experience leveraging AI (Artificial Intelligence) agents for security review automation, spec-driven development practices, or adversarial red teaming

title: Software Development Engineer, Building Connectivity Engineering
descriptionHtml:
Every Amazon data center runs on networks no customer ever sees: the corporate network that engineers and tools use to reach the fleet, the segmented networks that cameras and badge readers ride on, the network for building systems, and the isolated controls networks behind power and cooling. Building Connectivity Engineering (BCE), part of AWS Networking, owns the design and operation of those fabrics in every Amazon data center, and builds them into more than 100 new sites a year. Building Connectivity Software Systems (BCSS) is the software team inside BCE.

We build the controller for these networks. It holds the intended state of every fabric as a model, computes everything a new site needs (addresses, routing identifiers, ports, cabling, device registration) before a technician plugs in the first rack, renders device configuration from the model, and drives the deployment and monitoring platforms that AWS Networking already runs. The first production release went live in September 2026 and took a site build that used to need about twenty hand-run steps down to one request. Most of the controller is still ahead of us.

We are hiring Software Development Engineers to build the next releases: a versioned model of intended network state with full history and rollback, device configuration rendered from that model instead of written by hand, and the orchestration that takes a site from a plan to live traffic with one physical touch. You will design services, write the design documents for them, build them on AWS, prove them in shadow mode against real sites, and run them in production. The network engineers who hold the fabric knowledge are your partners; your code is the engine their models run on.

Key job responsibilities
* Design and build services in AWS (Lambda, Step Functions, DynamoDB, EventBridge, CDK), modeled with Smithy and deployed through pipelines you own.
* Write the design document for what you build. Every engineer on this team writes designs; it is a core part of the job, and seniority is not the gate.
* Integrate with the systems of record in AWS Networking (IP address management, device registry, routing-policy store, configuration store and release, deployment, cabling plans), and find out what each contract actually does, against the real service, before committing to a date.
* Prove correctness in shadow mode: compute what the automation would do for a site, diff it against what engineers did by hand, and get to zero discrepancies before any cutover.
* Own what you ship in production: metrics, alarms, runbooks, and a turn in the team's on-call rotation, which covers the new services and the ones the team inherited.
* Keep fabric knowledge out of the code. New fabrics, site types and rack types arrive as models the network engineers author; your job is to make the second one cost a configuration change.
* Estimate honestly: size work by how novel it is and how many systems outside the team it touches, raise partner asks early, and say what is unknown.

A day in the life
You pick up a card to add a new reservation type to the allocation service. Before writing code you spend an hour against the real partner API in a test account and find that the contract does not do what its wiki page says, so you write that down, re-size the card, and raise the ask with the partner team that morning instead of three weeks in. The afternoon is a design review of a teammate's state machine change, where the question you keep asking is what happens on the retry, and your own code review landing with its shadow-mode diff attached. A few times a year you are the on-call engineer for a week, and the team expects that week to be your work.

About the team
BCSS, formed in May 2026. We bring software engineering practice to a problem space that has not had software developers, and we never cut corners: slow is smooth, and smooth is fast. Our stance in one line is a team tenet: we don't just make a change, we make a changer. Our software runs on AWS and operates entirely detached from production data traffic.

We work inside an operating model where network fabric teams run like software teams: they own their business logic, expose APIs, and measure outcomes. BCSS builds the software; every fabric team owns its automation roadmap and its adoption. Design reviews are open and argued; the best objection in the room wins, whoever raised it.

Basic qualifications

- 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
- 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
- 1+ years of software development engineer or related occupational experience
- 1+ years of designing and developing large-scale, multi-tiered, multi-threaded, embedded or distributed software applications, tools, systems, and services using: C#, C++, Java, or Perl experience
- 1+ years of Object Oriented Design experience
- Bachelor's degree or foreign equivalent in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field
- Experience programming with at least one software programming language

Preferred qualifications

- 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
- Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent
- Experience architecting/operating solutions built on AWS
- Experience owning and leading significant projects from concept to deployment
- Experience working with networking fundamentals or Internet protocols such as TCP/IP, UDP, SSL, DNS, HTTP/S, or equivalent
- Experience with workflow orchestration and event-driven designs (Step Functions, EventBridge or equivalents), including idempotency, retries and rollback
- Experience integrating with systems whose APIs you do not control, and designing for their failure modes
- Experience with data modeling: versioned data, graph-shaped data, or generating configuration or code from a model

title: Forward Deployed Engineer, AWS Forward Deployed Engineering
descriptionHtml:
A Forward Deployed Engineer II (FDE II) embeds directly inside a strategic enterprise customer to independently design, build, deploy, and run AI-powered production systems alongside the customer's engineering team. FDE IIs write production-grade software and own delivery of complete AI workstreams end-to-end — from requirements gathering through production deployment — combining the technical rigor of an AWS SDE with the urgency and ownership required to deliver measurable customer business outcomes.

FDE IIs are autonomous contributors. They deliver working features spanning the full software lifecycle. They design cohesive implementations for well-understood problems, making design trade-offs with appropriate guidance. They take on projects where the business problem is understood but implementations are not fully fleshed out, balancing constraints and limiting short-term workarounds. They coach others on producing high-quality code and train new team members.
*10047*


Key job responsibilities
• Embed within customer engineering teams. Work with customers, stakeholders, and peers to understand the business and customer value of the systems you build. Understand the customer's business processes, technical architecture, and operational constraints. Translate customer requirements into technical designs for AI-enabled production systems within your workstream. Requires 30 – 50% travel.
• Build production AI applications. Design and develop production-grade software powering AI and agentic workflows — retrieval pipelines, workflow automation, API orchestration layers, data integration. Solve difficult problems with visible risks or roadblocks, bringing clarity and identifying simple designs for solutions. Integrate foundation models, customer data sources, and existing applications into cohesive AI experiences. Optimize for latency, reliability, and cost.
• Own production for your workstream. Be a significant contributor to the full software development lifecycle including scoping, design, code, testing, deployment, and maintenance. Troubleshoot production incidents across AI models, distributed systems, and application services. Ensure root causes of operational issues are identified and resolved. Implement monitoring, evaluations, guardrails, and CI/CD that keep AI systems healthy. Don't settle for the status quo — routinely identify and execute on opportunities to improve operations.
• Mentor and uplift. Actively mentors and trains new team members on how systems are constructed, operated, and fit into the bigger picture. Coach others on producing high-quality code through mechanisms such as code review. Be active in the code review process, providing meaningful feedback to others.
• Accelerate customer adoption. Identify opportunities to expand AI adoption within your customer engagement. Codify reusable patterns and accelerators that benefit future customer deployments and feed back into AWS services. Make enhancements that improve your team's software and processes.


About the team
ABOUT AWS:
 
Diverse Experiences
Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
 
Why AWS
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud. 

Inclusive Team Culture
AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.

Mentorship and Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.
