title: Senior Applied Scientist, Materials and Process Development, AWS Center for Quantum Computing
descriptionHtml:
The Amazon Web Services (AWS) Center for Quantum Computing in Pasadena, CA, is looking to hire an Applied Scientist on the Materials team, focused on materials integration and process development for superconducting quantum processors. You will join a multi-disciplinary team of theoretical and experimental physicists, materials scientists, and hardware and software engineers working at the forefront of quantum computing. You should have expertise in thin-film deposition, semiconductor integration processes, and materials characterization, with a strong understanding of how device topography and process sequences constrain materials integration choices.

Candidates with a track record in materials integration for superconducting or semiconductor devices at wafer scale will be preferred. We are looking for candidates with strong scientific and engineering principles, resourcefulness and a bias for action, superior problem solving, and excellent communication skills. As an Applied Scientist at CQC, you will be expected to drive materials integration R&D from process development through hardware demonstration and stay abreast of advances in superconducting materials and semiconductor manufacturing.

Key job responsibilities
You will develop and optimize materials for superconducting quantum hardware, with an emphasis on thin-film deposition processes and materials solutions that enable integration architectures for scaling qubit density. This includes establishing process-structure-property relationships for production-relevant films and interfaces, qualifying new tools and process modules, and designing integration schemes compatible with larger wafer formats. You will coordinate with cross-functional teams to translate materials advances into production, and publish results in scientific journals when appropriate.

Basic qualifications

- PhD in mechanical engineering, electrical engineering, material science, physics or equivalent
- Expertise in thin-film deposition and process integration at 200 mm wafer scale or larger
- Expertise in thin-film characterization

Preferred qualifications

- Experience successfully delivering on projects as part of a cross-team collaboration
- Proficient in a scientific programming environment
- Familiarity with superconducting materials and their integration into device fabrication flows
- Experience developing novel materials or deposition processes for advanced device architectures
- Experience with 3D integration
- Track record of translating materials or process integration advances into improved device performance

title: Sr. Risk Manager, Regulatory Intelligence Safety and Compliance (RISC)
descriptionHtml:
Do you enjoy designing and implementing solutions to ambiguous and complex problems? Are you looking to expand your scope of impact and influence strategic decision making? Are you in the market for a new, exciting challenge where you are empowered to use your ingenuity to innovate? If so, we are looking for talented people like you to join our Regulatory, Intelligence, Safety and Compliance (RISC) solution delivery team.

The RISC team's charter is to protect Amazon customers from products that are illegal, illegally marketed, unsafe, or otherwise prohibited by Amazon policies. In this role, you will work closely with legal, business teams, selling partner experience and support teams, operational excellence, product, BI and data science/engineering teams to deliver high-impact end-to-end safety and compliance solutions. Think of this role as a non-technical "solution architect" where you will be given autonomy to develop a strategy and build effective policy enforcements to ensure product safety and compliance worldwide.

The Senior Risk Manager drives the development and implementation of new tools and programs that advance the store's global safety and compliance efforts. This role requires influencing cross-functional stakeholders, planning strategic projects with legal and business partners, securing team commitments, and developing daily, weekly, and monthly metrics while ensuring compliance with Amazon quality standards and regulatory program expectations.

Key job responsibilities
• Drive Cross-Functional Programs: Own and deliver complex, cross-cutting initiatives by partnering with legal, business, tech, and operational excellence teams—bringing structure and momentum to ambiguous, multi-stakeholder efforts.
• Influence Without Authority: Build trusted relationships across multiple organizations; align diverse stakeholders around shared goals, secure commitments, and drive decisions forward—even when you don't own the teams doing the work.
• Build the Mechanisms That Keep Us Sharp: Design and run the operating cadences (business reviews, launch readiness checkpoints, intake processes) that ensure our safety and compliance controls launch with quality and consistency every time.
• Own the Metrics That Matter: Define, develop, and maintain the daily, weekly, and monthly performance metrics that give the team and leadership clear visibility into what's working, what's not, and where to focus next.
• Find the Friction and Fix It: Identify bottlenecks, eliminate redundant work, and drive automation opportunities that free up risk managers to focus on the high-judgment, high-impact work they do best.
• Raise the Quality Bar: Establish and maintain standards for control launches and program deliverables, ensuring every enforcement we ship meets Amazon's quality expectations and regulatory requirements.
• Turn Strategy into Action: Partner with leadership to translate business priorities and legal requirements into clear project plans with milestones, owners, dependencies, and timelines that teams can actually execute against.
• Build Tools and Frameworks That Scale: Champion the development of new tools, templates, and repeatable playbooks that accelerate the team's ability to launch safety and compliance programs worldwide.
• Write with Clarity and Purpose: Author crisp, well-structured documents—SOPs, program updates, leadership narratives—that make complex information accessible and drive informed decision-making.
• Be the Operational Backbone: Keep the trains running. Maintain visibility across workstreams, remove blockers, track commitments, and create the organizational structure that makes everyone on the team more effective at their jobs.

Basic qualifications

- Knowledge of Microsoft Office products and applications at an advanced level
- Bachelor's degree or equivalent
- Experience in compliance, audit or risk management
- Experience building cross-functional partnerships and influencing stakeholders across the organization to act without having a direct reporting relationship
- Experience developing and implementing of standards, policies and programs or equivalent
- Experience managing multiple competing priorities simultaneously and driving goals to completion
- Experience in program or project management

Preferred qualifications

- Project Management Professional (PMP) or equivalent certification
- Experience leveraging technology and implementing lean principles / Six Sigma methodologies to drive process improvements or equivalent
- Master's degree or equivalent

descriptionHtml:
Are you passionate about building and maintaining the infrastructure that powers some of the world's most impactful technology? Do you thrive when diagnosing complex system issues, turning manual processes into automated solutions, and driving projects from concept to completion? As a Systems Administrator Engineer III at Amazon, you will serve as a technical leader responsible for designing, operating, and improving the systems and services that keep our operations running smoothly. You will work across multiple technology domains, including operating systems, networking, hardware, and software, to solve challenging problems and deliver reliable, high-performing infrastructure. This role blends hands-on engineering with project leadership, giving you the opportunity to plan and execute technical initiatives, mentor fellow engineers, and shape the technical direction of your team while collaborating with partners across the organization.

- Lead the design, implementation, and continuous improvement of systems and services within your team's scope, ensuring they are highly available, performant, secure, and maintainable.
- Diagnose and resolve complex technical issues across multiple technology areas, determining both short-term mitigations and long-term solutions while minimizing customer impact.
- Plan and manage technical projects end to end, including scoping work, defining milestones, tracking deliverables, and coordinating across teams to keep initiatives on schedule.
- Develop and maintain automation that simplifies operational workloads, scales infrastructure, and reduces points of failure across managed systems.

You might start your morning reviewing system health dashboards and triaging alerts before joining a project stand-up to check progress against milestones. Later in the afternoon, you shift to root-cause analysis on a performance anomaly, documenting findings and updating your project tracker before wrapping up.

title: Data Center Technician, DCC Communities
descriptionHtml:
Join our dynamic AWS team and become a critical guardian of global cloud infrastructure! You'll play a pivotal role in maintaining the heartbeat of the world's most innovative technology platform, ensuring seamless data center operations that power millions of businesses and services worldwide.

Data Center Technicians should be willing to work both independently and with a team. Work prioritization, organizational skills, effective communication, and the ability to react quickly are critical to success. In addition to hardware and network repair, candidates will install equipment, create documentation, innovate solutions, and fix problems within the data center space. This team works in an environment that operates 24/7. Traveling within and outside of the regional work area is required.

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

NOTE: Amazon does not sponsor for immigration, including for H-1B, TN, and other non-immigrant visas, for this role.

NOTE: Lump sum stipend will be provided to eligible candidates who relocate for this position.

Key job responsibilities
- Performing server rack installations, hardware break-fix on various components, troubleshooting network issues, and responding to operational incidents that impact service availability, escalating to senior technicians and management as needed/required
- Serving as a primary contact point for both internal and external stakeholders, including engineers, software developers, vendors, and contractors
- Performing on-call duties and participating in scheduled maintenance and change management activities
- Contributing to documentation and process improvement initiatives based on your analysis of operational issues
- Helping to train and onboard new team members

title: Principal Engineer & Senior Principal Engineer, AWS Infrastructure Services
descriptionHtml:
We are hiring Principal Engineers and Senior Principal Engineers to join AWS Network Services.
We meet our customers at the scale of quadrillions of transactions per second across every layer of connected applications. Our millions of customers, from single-developer startups to the largest companies in the world, rely on us to present their business to the world — seamlessly, without limits. We make use of innovative virtualization technology to make connectivity magical.
We don't build on top of the cloud. We build what the cloud is built on.

WHAT YOU'LL DO
You will work at the intersection of distributed systems, protocols, hardware, and security, and every system we ship goes straight into production, powering the world’s most demanding workloads. Nothing we build sits on a shelf.

You won't be tuning knobs on an existing system. You'll be deciding what the system is. As a Principal or Senior Principal Engineer, you'll set the technical direction for the systems that make AWS possible where microseconds matter and billions of dollars of customer workloads depend on your decisions.
Here, great products start with Engineering. Principal Engineers work in close partnership with Product Management. You’ll propose new products born from deep technical insight and help shape and sharpen ideas. The roadmap grows with its Principal Engineers, so the systems you invent become the products customers rely on.



Key job responsibilities
Among the areas we’re hiring for today:
• Compute Connectivity: Deliver scale, security, and simplicity. Enable customers to focus on their applications and maximize their compute efficiency, while the connectivity underneath just works.
• Real-Time Media: Real-Time Media: Build the infrastructure for sub-second, bidirectional video and audio delivery at global scale, spanning interactive live streaming, AI-integrated experiences, real-time AI voice agents, and physical AI
• Security & Threat Defense: Ensure that connectivity brings only good to our customers' businesses. Innovate across traffic classification, adversarial defense, and application protection so that trust in AWS is never in question.
• Moving the Bytes that Move the World: AWS connectivity solutions power the largest companies in the world and provide critical support to governments. Other AWS services rely on our solutions too and even small features can support headline-driving events.
• VPC Core — Cross-Plane Networking Architecture: Turn customer and AWS-service intent into working network state across the planes that record it, deliver it, and enforce it in hardware. Own the contracts and scale models between those planes so a change that’s right in one never breaks another and keep VPC scaling as fast as the services built on it.



About the team
Our team sits at the intersection of the most critical trends in cloud infrastructure — AI-scale infrastructure, real-time media at global scale, intelligent threat defense, and the reinvention of internet-scale identity and trust.

Our services, including Amazon Route 53, AWS Direct Connect, Elastic Load Balancing, AWS PrivateLink, Elemental Media Services, AWS Interactive Video Service, Amazon GameLift, AWS Cloudfront, AWS Transit Gateway — take on systems challenges few teams anywhere must solve.
You know these problems because you've lived them - building and operating at this scale - and now you get to define what comes next.

We foster a collaborative, inclusive environment where different perspectives drive better solutions and the best ideas win regardless of where they originate. We ship fast and iterate with purpose, and we believe work should be meaningful. You'll join a team that takes pride in building the foundation the rest of the cloud runs on.

Basic qualifications

• 15+ years of professional software development experience
• Experience owning technical architecture, end-to-end delivery, and partnering with senior leadership
• Track record of leading multiple concurrent technical initiatives and driving decisions across organizational boundaries
• Experience influencing VP/SVP-level technical and business strategy
• Deep expertise in at least one domain: real-time transport protocols (WebRTC, QUIC), DNS, distributed systems, network architecture, web security, game backend systems, large-scale packet processing, or cloud virtual networking and data-plane systems (e.g. VPC-style resource/distribution control, SmartNIC/DPU or Nitro-class pipelines)
• Strong programming skills in C/C++, Rust, Go, or Java

• Developing tools and analyses to support ITU study initiatives, international and domestic regulatory meetings, and the technical foundations for international and national satellite filings and license applications;
• Participating in ITU study groups, Regional Telecommunications Organizations, and other multilateral and regulatory bodies to advance the strategy for enabling and protecting Leo's use of radio frequency spectrum and satellite orbits;
• Analyzing information related to satellite filings, status of satellite spectrum allocations and relevant sharing studies;
• Anticipating spectrum and regulatory needs and engage with the Leo satellite and architecture design teams, licensing teams, coordination teams, and legal teams to communicate spectrum and regulatory considerations as they relate to system objectives
• Excellent communication skills with the ability to identify tradeoffs, risks, and opportunities; remove bottlenecks; and establish mechanisms to speed progress.

The ideal candidate has experience serving as a member of national delegations to ITU meetings, knowledge of the ITU Radio Regulations and domestic Satellite Regulations, knowledge of communications satellite architectures and link budgets, and experience in developing sharing studies between telecommunications services. Additionally, the candidate must have the ability to effectively communicate solutions to complex technical problems and advocate before regulatory and multilateral bodies.

A day in the life
The Sr Eng, Int'l WRC Strategy will develop analysis and simulations to model the Leo network, demonstrate compliance with international regulatory requirements, analyze and propose frameworks for spectrum and orbit use internationally, and determine sharing opportunities for co-existing with other providers of satellite services as well as with telecommunications services that use our frequency bands. You will develop, present, and defend technical studies and execute the strategy in ITU study groups, Regional Telecommunications Organizations, and other multilateral and regulatory bodies. You will work closely with the satellite and communications systems design teams and coordination teams, and business teams to ensure that the Leotechnology, business, and regulatory roadmaps are aligned.

The ideal candidate has knowledge of satellite systems and the applicable Radio Regulations, Rules of Procedure, and ITU-R Recommendations and experience conducting sharing and interference analyses.

About the team
The Global Regulatory Affairs team is responsible for enabling and protecting Amazon Leo's use of radio frequency spectrum at home and abroad, defining and leading the Amazon Leo regulatory agenda. The team operates worldwide, engaging with the International Telecommunication Union (ITU) and regional organizations, coordinating the use of spectrum with other operators, gaining country access, and promoting safety in space. The Global Regulatory Affairs team is also responsible for licensing and collaborates with associations, government agencies, and other satellite operators in order to advocate for rules and regulations in the best interest of our customers. This team works in close collaboration with the Leo technical design and business teams to optimize for spectrum sharing and customer experience as well as with Amazon’s public policy and legal teams to enhance the overall regulatory strategy.

You decide how orders are sequenced, how customers are served, and how the commercial organization scales. You are the primary point of contact for customers from first quote to final delivery.

descriptionHtml:
*Internship period: 4 Jan 2027 - 30 June 2027.

Would you like to be part of the AWS Internship Program, helping us build and run the infrastructure behind Amazon Web Services?
Are you curious about how a data center keeps its power and cooling running around the clock?
Do you want to apply what you have learned in control systems, mechanical and electrical engineering to real, live infrastructure?

Cloud computing is changing how the world uses technology. Since 2006, AWS has provided companies of all sizes with an infrastructure web services platform in the cloud. On this AWS Internship Program you will take on real projects, build skills you can use from day one, and be encouraged to build and innovate. You will be a supported member of our internship community, with access to mentoring, coaching and other learning opportunities.

As a Controls Engineering Intern, you will work alongside our engineers in Singapore on live data centers and new builds. You will learn how a control philosophy becomes a working system: how sensors, controllers and sequences of operation keep chillers, air handlers and electrical switchgear running safely. Your work will include:

You will need curiosity, attention to detail, and the confidence to ask questions and speak up when something does not look right. No prior data center experience is required. We will teach you the systems. We are looking for solid fundamentals and a willingness to learn.

CDS delivers and supports the control systems that monitor and run power and cooling in AWS data centers, including Building Management Systems (BMS) and Electrical Power Monitoring Systems (EPMS). title: Sr Structural Analysis Engineer, Leo Structural Analysis Team
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Leo is Amazon's low Earth orbit satellite network. Our mission is to deliver fast, reliable internet connectivity to customers beyond the reach of existing networks. From individual households to schools, hospitals, businesses, and government agencies, Amazon Leo will serve people and organizations operating in locations without reliable connectivity.

This senior Structural Analysis Engineer will lead the structural analysis and verification of a satellite subsystem or major structural area, with deep expertise in dynamics. They must have a strong background in spacecraft structural development and understand the balance between engineering judgment and analysis rigor, and when each is appropriate. They will be able to contribute from day one, defining the approach when requirements and interfaces are not fully defined, and raising the quality of the team's analysis through the methods, tools, and reviews they put in place.

Export Control Requirement: Due to applicable export control laws and regulations, candidates must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.


Key job responsibilities
- Lead structural analysis and verification of a satellite subsystem or major structural area, from requirements through qualification
- Define requirements, interfaces, analysis approaches, and verification strategies from incomplete or evolving direction
- Lead dynamic analysis and test planning: derive component loads and test levels from launch vehicle and system loads, determine qualification and acceptance margins, and plan random vibration, sine, shock, and acoustic verification
- Own and verify subsystem and system-level FEMs, and correlate models to test data
- Document stress analysis substantiating engineering drawings and documents, and review the analysis of other engineers for rigor and consistency
- Support test execution, analyze results, and close out verification of structural requirements
- Support production and operations through analysis of non-conformances, failure investigations, and improvements, working with MRB and liaison partners on complex dispositions
- Drive configuration development and trade studies with clear decision criteria
- Work with suppliers, manufacturing, test, and systems engineering to align on loads, interfaces, and verification
- Create and improve analysis methods, tools, and processes that reduce repeat issues across the team
- Mentor and develop engineers, and lead technical discussions in internal and external design reviews, technical interchange meetings (TIMs), and program gates (PDR/CDR)

A day in the life
This Sr Structural Analysis Engineer will be a technical leader and subject matter expert for their area of the satellite. They will balance hands-on analysis with mentoring and review: building and checking FEMs, completing classical hand calculations, performing dynamic strength analysis, correlating models with test results, and interfacing with design, test, and supplier teams. They will represent Structural Integrity and Analysis in cross-functional forums to align on structural design and verification approaches.

About the team
The Structural Analysis team is responsible for Structural Integrity of not only the spacecraft but all supporting flight and ground support hardware across the program, inside and outside of the Mechanical Engineering group.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, or an equivalent field
- 8+ years of experience with aircraft, spacecraft, or launch vehicle structures, including leading the structural analysis and verification of a subsystem or major structural area
- Proven experience in dynamic structural analysis and testing: modal analysis, random vibration, sine sweep/burst, mechanical shock, and acoustic environments; deriving component loads and test levels from launch vehicle and system loads; and test-analysis correlation and model validation
- Vehicle load path definition, development of free-body diagrams, and strength analysis (metallic and/or composite structures)
- Classical aerospace analytical sizing methods, including analysis of stability-critical structures and bolted joint calculations (preload, joint stiffness, shear-tension interaction, bearing-bypass)
- Finite element analysis codes (Femap, Nastran, Ansys, or Abaqus), including FEM modeling techniques such as boundary conditions, element types, structural idealization, bolted connections, contact, and verification methods
- Experience with system Finite Element Model (FEM) management and integrating subsystem FEMs
- Experience developing analysis tools, processes, and documentation standards that other engineers use
- Documentation of analyses through formal structural analysis reports (stress memos, substantiation reports, verification closure documents)
- Demonstrated ability to define requirements, interfaces, and verification approaches when direction is incomplete or evolving, and to mentor other engineers

Preferred qualifications

- Master's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, or an equivalent field
- Knowledge of SMC-S-016 (Test Requirements for Launch, Upper-Stage, and Space Vehicles) or equivalent military/commercial test standards, including the philosophy of qualification and acceptance test levels, durations, and margins
- Experience with force limiting and notching for vibration testing
- Experience with static load testing of structures, including test planning, instrumentation, and correlation of results to analysis
- Experience with composite and metallic damage tolerance methods (e.g., fatigue, crack growth, residual strength, no-growth approaches)
- Experience leading supplier or vendor engagements on structural analysis deliverables and FEMs
- Track record of delivering structural analysis packages on aggressive schedules in a high-rate production environment
- Experience with rapid iteration and design-for-manufacturing considerations in structural analysis
- Experience in the design of complex mechanical products and equipment at volume
- CAD experience - Siemens NX or equivalent

title: Data Engineer, Robotics Delivery and Packaging Innovation
descriptionHtml:
Are you passionate about sustainability and waste reduction efforts across Amazon's global organization? Are you interested in building the data foundation that drives solutions balancing packaging and automation to increase speed, reduce cost, and ultimately delight our customers? The Robotics Delivery and Packaging Innovation team is looking for a Data Engineer to join us in building and maintaining the end-to-end data pipelines and infrastructure that power our analytics and business decisions. This is your opportunity to be a core part of the team that reduces waste for our business and our customers.

In this role, you will design, build, and operate the data pipelines behind our "source of truth" data store and metrics for warehouse automation and customer packaging. You will develop robust, scalable ETL/ELT solutions that integrate large, complex data spanning many sources and data structures using AWS tools, enabling data-driven decisions on OEE, machine metrics, and product performance across our packaging automation, IB sortation, and other warehouse automation products.

We are looking for a builder with deep SQL proficiency, strong Python skills, and knowledge of data modeling and warehousing best practices. You will apply rigorous data quality and data security practices, including validation, deduplication, PII handling, access controls, and monitoring, so that stakeholders can trust the data and sensitive operational data stays protected as it moves through our pipelines. You'll partner closely with Business Intelligence Engineers, Data Scientists, Product, and Operations to translate raw data into reliable, well-governed datasets and actionable insights.

The ideal candidate thrives amid ambiguity, builds for the future while delivering today, and understands the importance of code development best practices. If you love hard problems with many solutions and a diverse, results-oriented environment, come join us!



Key job responsibilities
• Be hands-on with ETL/ELT to build and maintain reliable, scalable data pipelines using SQL, Python, and Spark that support automated reporting for warehouse automation and customer packaging
• Interface with other technology teams to extract, transform, and load data from a wide variety of sources spanning warehouse automation and customer packaging
• Implement data structures using best practices in data modeling, ETL/ELT processes, SQL, and Redshift, and manage our "source of truth" data stores
• Implement best practices in batch and real-time data processing to make pipelines performant
• Apply strong data quality practices (validation, deduplication, PII handling, drift detection, and monitoring) so consumers can trust the data
• Build data security and access controls into the data infrastructure, protecting sensitive operational and performance data throughout its lifecycle
• Model data and metadata for ad-hoc and pre-built reporting, and deliver high-quality datasets to support BIEs, Data Scientists, and customer reporting needs
• Manage and optimize cloud computing resources on AWS to support data infrastructure
• Use AI-assisted development tools (e.g., Amazon Q, Kiro) to accelerate pipeline development, SQL, and debugging, while validating generated output for correctness
• Create extensible, easy-to-maintain designs with a long-term vision, laying groundwork to support future machine learning and GenAI use cases
• Participate in strategic and tactical planning discussions


A day in the life
As a Data Engineer on this team, you will own the end-to-end data pipelines and infrastructure that serve as our "source of truth" for warehouse automation and customer packaging metrics. You will design, build, and operate robust and scalable ETL/ELT solutions, integrating complex data from dozens of sources to enable data-driven decisions across the Robotics Delivery and Packaging Innovation Organization.
You will partner closely with Business Intelligence Engineers, Data Scientists, Software Engineers, Product Managers, and Operations teams to translate raw requirements into reliable and scalable data pipelines producing datasets that can be used and trusted across the org. You will also champion data quality and security practices, ensuring stakeholders can trust the data while sensitive operational information stays protected throughout its lifecycle.

Preferred qualifications

title: Sr Manager, EU Next Day Speed , EU Speed and Service Programs
descriptionHtml:
**THIS ROLE CAN BE BASED IN LONDON, MUNICH, PARIS, MILAN, MADRID, BERLIN, BARCELONA & LUX***

Please refer to req 10578326 for informational request

Have you ever ordered a product on Amazon and wondered how it got delivered to you so fast, and what systems and processes power the whole operation? If so, this role is for you.

The EU Speed team is part of EU Supply Chain, Transportation Planning & Operational Excellence (STEP) organisation, which optimises the EU end-to-end transportation and transfer network.
Our mission: offer the right speed, for the right customer, on the right selection, in the most cost-efficient manner.
• Operations is at the heart of the Amazon customer experience. Each action we undertake is on behalf of our customers, as surpassing their expectations is our passion.
• We improve customer experience through continuously optimising the complex movements of goods from vendors to customers throughout Europe.
• We tackle Amazon's most complex problems, processes, and decisions. We work with fulfilment centers, transportation capacity, topology, connectivity, DEA, finance, and retail teams across EU to improve our logistic infrastructure and algorithms.
• We are obsessed with rethinking our advanced end-to-end supply chain to make our deliveries even faster. Our overall mission: we want Amazon to be the place where customers come to get goods delivered next-day.



Key job responsibilities
We are seeking a Sr. Manager to own the end-to-end strategy, execution, and performance of 1D+ Speed across EU5 and EXP8 markets. This is high-visibility leadership role accountable for speed outcomes that impact day to day our customers.
Our overall mission is simple: we want Amazon to be the place where customers come to get goods delivered next-day. This role is the senior leader who makes that happen. You will own end-to-end Next Day speed to improve customer experience across EU markets. The problem space is broad, the opportunity is not fully defined, and the strategy is yours to set. This is a people manager role: you will lead a team of Program managers and Analyst, while personally driving the multi-year vision and roadmap for Next Day speed improvement. You will distill diverse inputs from large customer segments and cross-functional stakeholders to design and drive the right long-term solution. You will own the Speed metric for 1D and 2D Speed, setting targets, identifying structural headwinds and tailwinds, and driving the cross-functional mechanisms required to close gaps at country and EU level. You deliver with independence and high judgment, distinguishing between one-way and two-way doors to move fast where appropriate and exercise caution where the stakes demand it.

A day in the life
This role requires you to:
• Set the vision and own the strategy for Next Day Speed: The problem, opportunity, and strategy are often not predefined: you identify them, frame them, and drive the organization toward the right outcome. You own Next Day Glance View Speed and are accountable for translating strategic ambiguity into a clear, executable plan.
• Lead across significantly complex, persistent programs: Own a portfolio of speed initiatives spanning multiple orgs and countries. Handle significantly complex problems, decisions, and escalations where the methodology, requirements, customer needs, and technical feasibility may not be defined. Deconstruct risks into appropriate simplicity and make trade-offs between opportunity, resources, and sustainability.
• Drive organisational influence at scale: Influence team priorities and business strategy across STEP Operations, Transportation, Network Design, Finance, Stores, and country-level operations. Partner at Director/VP level to align capacity, investment, and operational priorities with speed targets. You effectively force-multiply by working across your org to shape priorities and goals through data-driven contributions.
• Build and lead mechanisms for operational excellence: create scalable mechanisms and best practices, and educate others on them. Actively remove bottlenecks and set the standard for process improvement.
• Communicate at the highest level: Author high-quality narratives that distill complex operational data into clear, actionable insights. You are trusted to present decisions to leaders two levels above you. You ask the hard questions, decompose significantly complex problems into straightforward solutions, build consensus, and align teams toward coherent strategies across locales, roles, and functions.
• Build and develop future leaders (people manager): Hire, mentor, and grow a team of program managers and analysts. Develop future leaders and participate actively in the recruitment process. Lead by example, encouraging positive and constructive feedback in doc reviews, peer reviews, and cross-team evaluations.
• Innovate and simplify: Identify structural opportunities to improve speed at lower cost. Challenge existing assumptions, propose new approaches, and build scalable mechanisms that reduce manual effort and increase speed predictability. You acquire new knowledge and skills as needed to solve problems that do not have established playbooks.


About the team
This role demands two mindsets that set exceptional leaders apart:
• Grit: You have a clear goal and the relentless ability to move toward it despite roadblocks and challenges. When a speed target is at risk, you do not wait for conditions to improve: you find the path, rally the teams, and deliver the outcome.

title: Finance Manager, North America Transport Controllership
descriptionHtml:
Amazon is seeking a Finance Manager to support Amazon Transportation Services, a leader in the global supply chain revolution through pioneering robotics, revolutionary automation initiatives, seeking sustainable solutions such as electric vehicles, and introducing one-day delivery for millions of products, in order to deliver billions of packages to delight customers.

The Finance Manager will own Financial Reporting and Analytics and ensure financial statements are correct in the transportation space for small parcels and last mile. Experience in this team opens up several career opportunities across Amazon. You will learn to produce insightful financial reporting, build robust and repeatable financial processes, controls, and perform in-depth analysis on transportation spend numbers. Given the nature of our business, you will learn to venture into unknown territory, and learn how to succeed in a new space.

This role partners across Transportation, Fulfillment, Supply Chain, and Technology teams to improve efficiencies while improving customer experience globally. This role works with business intelligence engineers, accountants, accounting managers, data engineers, program and product managers. This role creates a “learn by doing” environment by engaging with business and technology to promote and encourage continued customer focus. You will anticipate and resolve bottlenecks while balancing business needs and escalating where appropriate.

The successful candidate has demonstrated the following abilities: ability to develop insights using activity based costing, data analysis, econometrics, and statistics, and excellent verbal and written communication. This role will work in a dynamic environment working with some of the world's largest data sets in logistics costing. As such, the Finance Manager must combine excellent business analysis skills with the ability to derive actionable cost measures for consumption across Amazon.

Key job responsibilities
- Uses solid financial knowledge and business acumen to build financial models, interpret data, draw conclusions, and make recommendations that deliver results, drive improvements, and influence leaders throughout Amazon. These decisions can have global impact.
- Delivers weekly/monthly financial close. Uses financial systems, SQL, and advanced MSExcel functions to work with large data sets. Outputs analytical dashboards and reports, plans, forecasts, budgets, and consolidations.
- Drives continuous improvement and standardization of processes, including implementation of best practices in the controllership area.
- Supports financial reporting and operating planning, demonstrating finance acumen and ability to quickly adapt to different business needs.
- Prepares concise documents, tailored to various levels of stakeholders, and collaborates with operations’ leaders and other teams.
- Uses active listening skills intuitively to communicate data (both written and verbal) in a clear, concise, and unambiguous manner. Adjusts style for various audiences to articulate complex finance issues clearly.
- Collects and analyzes quantitative data to develop relevant reports that drive cost reductions.
- Participates in hiring, developing, and mentoring peers and team members. Seeks and leverages diverse perspectives in all activities.
- Identifies opportunities to resolve defects proactively. Improves, scales, or simplifies finance tools across teams and organizations.

A day in the life
The Finance Manager blends advanced reporting, data analysis, critical thinking and project management skills while understanding and further developing financial applications. A typical day in this role provides an opportunity to resolve ambiguous problems, build analytical dashboards and reports, own month end close deliverables, work with tech partners to resolve technical issues and ensure successful accounting automation launch for month end close processes.

About the team
Transportation Controllership is a global finance team responsible for Financial Reporting activities, establishing Financial Control Frameworks and Advanced Analytics in the transportation space, including import, domestic inbound, warehouse transfer, and outbound shipments. We partner closely with transportation business units and tech teams as they work to continually refine and scale the business to keep pace with Amazon's rapid growth. Along with our partners in Accounting, we are responsible for the contractual and managerial closing of the books for Transportation spend.

Basic qualifications

- 5+ years of tax, finance or a related analytical field experience
- 5+ years of multiple finance and accounting roles experience
- 6+ years of Accounts Receivable or Account Payable experience
- 6+ years of applying key financial performance indicators (KPIs) to analyses experience
- 6+ years of building financial and operational reports/data sets that inform business decision-making experience
- 6+ years of creating process improvements with automation and analysis experience
- 6+ years of participating in continuous improvement projects in your team to scale and improve controllership with measurable results experience
- Bachelor's degree in engineering, statistics or business, or Bachelor's degree and 5+ years of quantitative role (engineering, process re-engineering, quality assurance) experience

Preferred qualifications

- 6+ years of identifying incomplete or inaccurate data, identifying the root cause and creating/implementing an escalation plan experience
- 6+ years of solving complex business challenges by delivering accurate and timely financial models, analysis, and recommendations that have a proven impact on business (e.g., financial savings, operational improvements, or customer benefits) experience
- MBA, or CPA
- Knowledge of SQL/ETL
- Experience working with large-scale data mining and reporting tools (examples: SQL, MS Access, Essbase, Cognos) and other financial systems (examples: Oracle, SAP, Lawson, JD Edwards)
- Experience delivering forecasting, budgeting, and variance analysis, and data interpretation of results

descriptionHtml:

Would you like to join one of the fastest-growing organizations within Amazon Web Services (AWS) and help customers of all industries and sizes gain the best value and service from AWS? You will provide advocacy and strategic technical guidance to help plan and build solutions using best practices and proactively keep your customers' AWS environments operationally healthy. The close relationships developed with your customers will allow you to understand their business/operational needs and technical challenges and help them achieve the greatest value from AWS. • The TAM role is not directly hands on keyboard within the customer's environment for troubleshooting customer support issues rather you will work with appropriate engineers and service teams to see issues through to resolution. More importantly you will work proactively to help craft and execute strategies to drive our customers' adoption and use of AWS services including EC2, S3, DynamoDB & RDS databases, Lambda, CloudFront CDN, IoT, and many more.

As a TAM, you will leverage your technical acumen and customer-facing skills to provide advocacy and strategic technical guidance, helping plan and build solutions using best practices and proactively keeping your customers' AWS environments operationally healthy.

descriptionHtml:
Help Us Build the Data Centers That Power the Cloud.

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. We're the people who build the data centers and keep the cloud running. Every AWS data center, and every server, storage system, network, power, and cooling unit inside it, starts with our work, so customers can count on the innovations they rely on, every second of every day. We tackle some of the toughest problems in the industry, with thousands of variables shaping the supply chain, and we want talented people who are excited to solve them with us

You’ll join a diverse team of technical program managers, design engineers, construction managers, network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

Data-driven decision-making is at the core of Amazon's culture, and people who are exceptionally talented at analyzing large sets of data to build insights are critical. Your work will directly impact the decisions and strategy of the ML Capacity Delivery organization and our customers. You will gather customer needs and insights, mine large and diverse data sets from across AWS Infrastructure, build visualizations and tools for our business partners, and generate insights to help senior leaders make critical business decisions. The successful BIE will not only possess the expertise and passion for analyzing data, designing metrics to measure the performance of the business, and building reporting capabilities and tools, but will also interact directly with business leaders and teams that rely on the metrics and analyses they produce.

The ideal candidate must be a self-starter, comfortable with ambiguity, able to think big and be creative (while still paying careful attention to detail), and enjoy working in a fast-paced, dynamic environment. Spot what others miss. Uncover patterns in the data and connect them to business outcomes.

title: Principal Engagement Manager, Professional Services (ProServe) - AWSI
descriptionHtml:
The Amazon Web Services Professional Services (ProServe) team is seeking a highly skilled and versatile Engagement Manager (EM) to join our team and lead the delivery of complex cloud solution projects. In this role you will combine technical expertise with strong project leadership skills to drive successful implementations of AWS-based solutions for our clients. You will bridge business requirements with technical solutions, facilitating technical discussions and ensuring alignment with customer outcomes. Applying AWS frameworks like Well-Architected and Cloud Adoption Framework while demonstrating technical credibility across diverse stakeholders, you will distill customer needs into clear technical requirements, decompose complex problems, and make informed trade-off decisions considering performance, scalability, security, and business impact.

Possessing strong technology and program/project management experience, you will validate technical solutions against business goals, recognize when additional technical evaluation is needed, and manage technical risks. You will be expected to achieve and maintain relevant AWS certifications, develop domain-specific expertise, and effectively communicate technical concepts to both technical and business audiences. As you progress, you’ll lead increasingly complex technical projects, shape cross-organizational technical strategies, and establish best practices in your domain. In this role you will apply your management and leadership capabilities to successfully execute project plans, proactively identify and manage risks, resolve issues, escalate when appropriate, and drive projects to successful completion, while exceeding customer expectation.

The AWS Professional Services organization is a global team of experts that help customers realize their desired business outcomes when using the AWS Cloud. We work together with customer teams and the AWS Partner Network (APN) to execute enterprise cloud computing initiatives. Our team provides assistance through a collection of offerings which help customers achieve specific outcomes related to enterprise cloud adoption. We also deliver focused guidance through our global specialty practices, which cover a variety of solutions, technologies, and industries.


Key job responsibilities
As an experienced technology program/project manager, you will be responsible for:
• Leading and managing complex cloud migration and implementation projects
• Leveraging comprehensive knowledge of AWS services, architectures, and best practices to guide technical decisions and strategic planning
• Bridging business requirements with technical solutions, facilitating engineering discussions and ensuring alignment with customer business outcomes
• Distilling customer needs into clear technical requirements and map them to business outcomes
• Decomposing complex technical problems into actionable, deliverable solutions
• Contributing to technical documentation and define documentation standards

A day in the life
• Owning delivery of complex, outcome-based cloud and AI programs end to end, accountable for customer business outcomes, delivery quality and commercial performance
• Working with sales and solution architects before signature to shape scope, define measurable outcomes and acceptance criteria, and confirm what we commit to is deliverable
• Negotiating scope, milestones and trade-offs with customer executives, and managing fixed-price engagements through disciplined change control, earned-value tracking and margin protection
• Managing engagement revenue and financial health: forecasting revenue against milestones, maintaining an accurate estimate at completion, driving timely milestone acceptance and billing, and identifying expansion opportunities that grow the customer relationship
• Leading delivery teams that use AI across the lifecycle (requirements, design, code generation, testing and operations), and applying enough technical depth to challenge AI-generated output and make informed trade-offs on security, performance, scalability and cost
• Orchestrating mixed teams of AWS builders, AWS Partner Network partners and customer-selected integrators to a single quality bar, with clear accountability, consistent acceptance criteria and automated quality gates
• Driving customer-side change management and adoption, so the organization realizes the value of what we build
• Reporting progress to senior stakeholders in terms of business value delivered, and acting on leading indicators of risk (velocity, environment stability, partner quality, team health) before they become escalations
• Contributing reusable assets, patterns and AI-enabled delivery practices that make each engagement faster and more repeatable than the last

About the team
Diverse Experiences
AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS?
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Inclusive Team Culture
AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.

Mentorship & Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.

title: Logistics Specialist, ADC InfraOps Logistics
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Web Services is seeking bright, motivated, hardworking individuals to fill Data Center Logistics positions. The ideal candidate will have a solid background in logistics with a focus of transportation, shipping receiving and inventory control and warehousing. They must possesses a strong work ethic, attention to detail, the ability to multitask and operate in a very fast paced complex environment, meet deadlines, and a commitment to Operational Excellence. Additionally offering strong customer support and the ability to remain flexible with frequent shifts in priorities.

The Logistics Specialist will process in-stock components as well as receive and process inbound shipments and coordinate and execute daily equipment deliveries to Datacenters across the region. Also be able to drive up to 10 hours a day. You will also assist with ongoing requests to ensure that proper stock levels are maintained and distributed to all locations to support build and repair activities. Working with the Logistics Manager, they create plans to optimize the flow and delivery of parts through their lifecycle; tracking inventory locations and movement. They work closely with Datacenter Operations Technicians to fulfill parts and equipment deliveries quickly and accurately. They will also work with Procurement teams to ensure that inbound equipment orders are complete and delivered to appropriate Data Center Locations.

They are responsible for accurate data entry and resolving questions from peer organizations. Additionally, the Logistics Specialist will ensure that all information associated with the deliveries such as inventory tracking and Ticket updates are accurate to ensure equipment is ready for processing by end user.

The ideal Logistics Specialist will dive deep into and the inventory they distribute to better understand the tracking, control and accuracy surrounding the components. The Specialist will be involved in, if not responsible for or limited to, decision making involving route planning, vehicle maintenance, load planning, loading and unloading equipment daily equipment deliveries, ultimately helping us to deliver on our goals of high availability and low cost. They will also maintain up-to-date metrics dashboards and or excel spreadsheets and will create reports for internal and external customer and management as required.

Logistics Specialists are expected to understand all aspects of Transportation, shipping and receiving as well as inventory control, adhere to strict safety standards, maintain very high quality, and be willing and able to work on powered equipment (i.e forklift or cherry picker).

A Valid Driver's License is required.

This position requires that the candidate selected be a US citizen and obtain and maintain an active TS/SCI security clearance with polygraph. This position requires the candidate to opt into a commensurate clearance for each government agency for which they perform AWS work.

Key job responsibilities
- Drive long distances for up to 10 hours
- Receive parts, maintain inventory, and check-out parts as needed to Data Center Technicians and Engineers
- Load and unload shipments and transport parts, racks, and equipment between different locations, including localized driving of a variety of transportation vehicles
- Attend company provided fork lift operator training
- Complete company provided training in driving box trucks up to 26’ in length
- Handle sensitive/classified client materials
- Work with and/or around moving mechanical parts
- Occasionally work is in an office environment

Perform the following tasks with with reasonable accommodations:

- Frequently push, pull, squat, bend, and reach
- Regularly walk, use hands and fingers, handle or feel, reach with hands and arms, stoop, kneel, crouch or crawl
- Coordinate body movements when using tools or equipment
- Reach and stretch to position equipment and fixtures while maintaining balance
- Push or pull heavy objects into position
- Work in a noisy environment
- Stand, sit, and walk for prolonged periods of time

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. title: Senior Treasury Analyst, EMEA Regional Treasury Center (RTC)
descriptionHtml:
In this role, you’ll drive the continued automation of our liquidity management framework, improve trade finance processes end to end, and develop standards and policies designed to scale beyond EMEA. You’ll partner with our two other regional treasury centers to shape and align global standards, while bringing a “one treasury” mindset to a region defined by growth and complexity. Working across FinOps, FP&A, Tax, Legal, and external banking partners, you’ll connect multiple workstreams and keep them moving in the same direction.

You’ll be expected to challenge the status quo: where a manual process can be automated, you’ll fix it, and where AI can make the team faster and smarter, you’ll bring it to the table. You’ll have the autonomy to make those changes happen. Reporting to the Head of EMEA Treasury in Luxembourg, you’ll work across time zones in a fast-paced, sometimes ambiguous, high-impact environment. If you thrive on complexity, want broad exposure across Treasury disciplines, and want to help shape how Amazon does Treasury, in EMEA and globally, this role is for you.


Key job responsibilities
- Liquidity Management: Drive the continued automation of liquidity management across EMEA, including cashpooling, funding optimization, and rule-based frameworks that reduce manual intervention and improve cash visibility.
- Trade Finance: Lead end-to-end improvements to trade finance processes, from digitization through credit capacity oversight, to cut manual effort and increase speed and scalability.
- Global Standards: Develop Treasury policies and standards that meet EMEA needs and scale globally, working with the two other regional treasury centers to shape and align a consistent global approach.
- Cross-Functional Partnership: Collaborate with FinOps, FP&A, Accounting, Tax, Legal, and external banking partners to deliver cross-functional initiatives with a “one treasury” mindset.
- Controllership: Embed Treasury policies, standards, and controls into day-to-day operations to maintain a strong, audit-ready control environment.
- AI & Innovation: Identify and implement practical applications of AI and automation to challenge legacy processes, eliminate manual work, and raise operational performance.
- Market Intelligence: Monitor financial market trends, regulatory developments, and the evolving banking landscape across EMEA, and translate those insights into proactive recommendations for Treasury strategy

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in engineering, statistics or business, or a Bachelor's degree and experience in quantitative role (engineering, process re-engineering, quality assurance)
- Speak, write, and read fluently in English
- Experience in tax, finance or a related analytical field
- Experience applying key financial performance indicators (KPIs) to analyses
- Experience in creating process improvements with automation and analysis
- Experience in identifying, leading, and executing opportunities to improve, automate, standardize or simplify finance or business tools and processes
- Can demonstrate strong numerical and analytical skills

Preferred qualifications

- MBA, or CPA
- Knowledge of Tableau
- Experience participating in continuous improvement projects in your team to scale and improve controllership with measurable results
- Experience developing financial models in Excel with advanced functions (pivot tables, macros, VBA, Power Query)
- Experience with ERP systems (e.g., SAP, Oracle, Workday)

title: Operations Manager
descriptionHtml:
Application deadline: Nov 3, 2026

Job summary
Our WW Operations network delivers millions of packages and smiles to Amazon customers every day. We are looking for motivated, customer-focused individuals who want to join our team as an Operations Manager. In this role, you will lead and develop a team of salaried and hourly talent. You will be responsible for engaging your team during their shifts to maintain the highest levels of safety, quality, attendance, and performance. To achieve this, managers are expected to provide their team with the tools needed for success while driving improvements in productivity and efficiency through data-driven decisions and analytical problem-solving. You will also play a key role in maintaining our customer expectations to ensure customer orders are delivered at the right time, to the right location.

Our Operation’s workflow has three major components: First mile - where the product is housed and ready for order; Middle mile - where the order is hauled to your area; and Last mile - when the product is delivered to the customer’s door. Please note that all workflows have slight building variations, but one thing is constant: our vision and dedication to the customer.

- Lift up to 49 pounds and frequently push, pull, squat, bend, and reach

- Work in an environment where the noise level varies and can be loud

Our fulfillment network launches new Operations sites every year, providing various opportunities for your professional growth. We hire Operations Managers based on location preference and the business’ current openings.

title: Senior Financial Analyst, North America Launch Finance
descriptionHtml:
Amazon seeks a highly motivated finance professional with an AI-first mindset to play a lead role in Operations Finance supporting the North America Launch Finance team. Launch Finance owns the financial planning, governance, and controllership for new fulfillment sites across the NA network from pre-launch cost planning through post-launch performance review. This is a great opportunity to work in a role with high impact and visibility to business-critical decisions, requiring regular interaction with Director and above leadership across Operations, Global Engineering Services (GES) Launch, and Finance. Everyone on the team needs to be entrepreneurial, wear many hats, and work in a highly collaborative environment that's more start-up than big company. Excellent verbal and written communication skills are critical in this role. The successful candidate has demonstrated the following abilities: they are a self-starter who proactively pursues AI-driven solutions to automate, scale, and simplify finance work; have a strong sense of ownership; collaborate with and influence business partners; support thoughtful decision-making in a rapidly-evolving and ambiguous environment; and think long-term.

Key job responsibilities
- Develop partnerships across Operations, GES Launch, and Regional Finance and use data to influence leadership decision-making on launch timing, readiness, and cost
- Own Operating Plan and Quarterly Guidance rate plans, headcount forecasts, and cost projections for new launch sites, ensuring alignment with rate planning standards and network benchmarks
- Lead pre-launch financial planning and post-launch performance reviews, including variance analysis and financial bridges for WBR/MBR/QBR reporting to senior business partners (Director and above)
- Quantify the financial impact of launch risks and provide independent Finance review of labor planning assumptions
- Apply AI and automation tools to eliminate manual work, accelerate analysis, and improve the accuracy and consistency of launch finance deliverables
- Manage competing priorities to complete both ad-hoc and strategic projects across a portfolio of concurrent launches
- Seek opportunities to resolve defects, standardize processes, and reduce cost
- Improve, scale, and simplify finance tools and standard work across teams and organizations
- Communicate financial insights (both written and verbal) in a clear and concise manner; adapt communication based on intended audience to clearly articulate complex financial considerations
- Promote a positive and collaborative culture

About the team
Amazon operates an industry-leading logistics network across the world. The North America Launch Finance team is the financial owner for every new site entering the network, partnering with GES Launch, Site Operations, and Regional Finance to plan, govern, and review launch performance. Finance is looking for individuals who enjoy tackling challenges and have a desire for professional growth opportunities. Experience on this team opens up several career opportunities across Amazon and within the broader Finance organization. Individuals in this role have advancement opportunities to support different businesses and multi-functional teams, to lead new programs and initiatives, and to manage larger teams within the company.

Basic qualifications

- 3+ years of finance, accounting, or related analytical field experience
- Experience in forecasting, budgeting, variance analysis, and interpreting financial results
- Bachelor's degree in finance, accounting or related field
- Experience using AI-assisted development tools in academic or professional settings
- 3+ years of contributing to cross-functional initiatives that drive financial performance and strategy experience
- 3+ years of dissecting financial data and identifying patterns that support business strategy experience

Preferred qualifications

- Master's degree (MBA or related discipline)
- Experience in creating process improvements with automation and analysis, or experience or equivalent experience in finance roles
- Experience working with, presenting to and influencing senior executives up to VP level
- Ability to operate independently in ambiguous, fast-moving environments

Our platform leverages machine learning, natural language processing, and GenAI to deliver context-aware policy guidance, proactive compliance recommendations, fraud detection, and sustainability intelligence embedded into employee workflows. title: Controls Technician, Data Center Capacity Delivery, Amazon Data Services, Inc
descriptionHtml:
As a member of the Global Controls Team, you will collaborate with highly motivated operators, engineers and technicians in the data center industry to maintain and optimize critical infrastructure systems. You will be responsible for troubleshooting and maintaining the Building Management System (BMS) and Electrical Power Monitoring System (EPMS) while developing new processes and standards that drive innovation in the controls space.

AWS data centers utilize sophisticated industrial control systems to automatically operate mechanical equipment, maintaining optimal temperature and pressure conditions throughout the facilities. These systems integrate and monitor multiple critical components, including generators, uninterruptible power sources, diesel generators, electrical switchgear, power distribution units, variable frequency drives, automatic and static transfer switches, air-cooled and water-cooled chillers, pumps, cooling towers, heat exchangers, Computer Room Air Handlers (CRAHs), and air economizers. Within this industrial control system infrastructure, the BMS serves as the primary control platform for all mechanical systems within the data center, while the EPMS functions as the primary monitoring platform for all electrical systems. This position offers the opportunity to work with cutting-edge technology in mission-critical environments while contributing to the reliability and efficiency of AWS's global infrastructure.

This position requires access to information that is subject to U.S. export control regulations, and applicants must be a 'U.S. Person' as defined by applicable law, which includes U.S. citizens, lawful permanent residents, refugees, and asylees.

Key job responsibilities
Primarily work in and support multiple data centers by deploying, servicing, and upgrading BMS and EPMS systems.
Mentor and train Facilities team members on the operation and control of BMS and EPMS systems.
Audit, maintain, and manage computer enterprise asset management systems for BMS and EPMS installations.
Manage small to medium-sized projects and programs.
Perform point-to-point checkouts between field devices and controllers.
Perform first-line diagnostics, troubleshooting, and maintenance of programming code and hardware associated with BMS and EPMS in data centers.
Execute provisioning processes for servers, controllers, industrial PCs, and network configurations, including communication testing between third-party devices and controllers or servers.
Install, replace, configure, and calibrate sensors.
Read and interpret electrical schematics and control panel drawings with a basic understanding of closed-loop controls, field sensor scaling, and functions typically performed by industrial controllers.
Supervise low-voltage electrical contractors performing wiring and installation of field devices in compliance with AWS requirements.
Provide commissioning and systems-level testing support.

A day in the life
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (gender diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Basic qualifications

- Associate's degree or above
- Basic understanding of Industrial controls system, knowledge of meters, devices, sensors, relays and troubleshooting utilizing standard hand tools, digital metering, or calibration/diagnostic equipment in a data center, hospitals, large commercial complex, water, power, oil & gas or similar industries.
- Ability to work non-standard hours and differing work rotations/shifts and overtime as required.
- Associate’s degree, trade school certification, or other certified training in a related technical field with 1 years of relevant industrial Controls or HVAC controls experience, OR 2 years of relevant industrial or HVAC controls experience in lieu of a degree.

Preferred qualifications

- International Society of Automation (ISA) Certified Controls System Technician (CCST) Level I or higher certification.
- Experiencing using common communication protocols (MQTT, BACnet, and/or MODBUS).
- 5+ years of experience in controls/automation, construction or related field in a technical environment.
- Demonstrated understanding of engineering documentation, electrical and mechanical diagrams, and standard operating procedures.
- Experience in data centers or mission critical environment
- Fundamental knowledge of network design and layout as well as low voltage (copper/ fiber) cabling.
- Prior AWS/Amazon experience
- 4+ Yr. Military Service

As a Senior SDE on DMR, you set the technical direction for the platform and own the architecture of our most critical systems. You take the hardest, most ambiguous problems spanning multiple services and teams, turn them into clear multi-quarter plans, and deliver them through other engineers. You are a force multiplier: your designs, standards, and judgment raise the quality of everything the team ships, and your influence reaches well beyond DMR into partner and customer teams across Networking. This is a hands-on senior IC role where your leverage comes from architecture, direction setting, and developing other engineers rather than from individual output alone.

A day in the life
A typical day moves between deep technical work and org-level influence. You review and shape the architecture for a cross-service initiative such as the Mentat global rollout or long-term storage, then meet with partner teams across Alerts, SET, CET, and NetOS/NPD to align on dependencies and sequencing. Fridays are meeting-free, so you protect that time for architecture and writing.

DMR owns and operates the Data Exchange Services for AWS Networking.
