In each fulfillment center, our teams stow deliveries, pick products, package them up and ship them out; each of these groups have played their part in taking us where we are today. These fulfillment centers are fast-paced and high reward environments, where adherence to policies and procedures is key. We need a leader that ensures we deliver as reliably as ever to our customers, while making sure our teams deliver on customer obsession.

Key job responsibilities
- Lead and supervise a team of hourly Associates (including Team Leads and Data Analyst) assigned to inventory control, quality assurance and problem solve operations within the fulfillment center
- Support safety programs and compliance to ensure a safe work environment for all associates. Work with Operations and other Support teams to establish, influence and adhere to policies and procedures
- Coordinate inventory control, quality assurance and problem solve operations in accordance to network strategies and ensuring compliance and consistency with SOX
- Conduct shift planning and forecasting, alongside assigning and directing work. Oversee projects to streamline processes, increase quality and optimize productivity
- Ensure KPIs are reviewed on a daily, weekly, or monthly basis and perform quality analysis on any behaviors/processes that could impact inventory integrity and Customer esperience
- Gain expertise in key fulfillment center process paths and its exceptions handling in order to drive processes continuous improvement alongside the operations management team
- Support in interviewing and training fulfillment center managers and associates, developing talent and hiring the next generation of managers

A day in the life
You'll work shifts at one of our fulfillment centers, overseeing inventory control, quality assurance and problem solve operations. Your day typically starts with a team huddle, where you'll review previous shift performance, set daily goals, and address any ongoing issues.Throughout your shift, you will conduct inventory discrepancies analysis, oversee the resolution of receiving issues, and coach team members on accuracy improvement.You'll regularly analyze data, looking for trends and opportunities for process improvement, collaborating with other partners in FC operations or in central teams that own Catalogue, Procurement, Supply Chain, Process Engineering, Loss Prevention and Program Management. You'll need to make quick, informed decisions to keep operations running smoothly.Throughout your shift, you'll be on the floor, observing processes, coaching team members, and ensuring safety standards are maintained in you area. You'll also dedicate time to developing your team members, providing feedback, and identifying training needs. By shift end, you'll prepare a handover for the next shift, summarizing key events, ongoing issues, and priorities. You'll leave knowing you've contributed to maintaining inventory accuracy, resolving inbound challenges, and ultimately ensuring customer satisfaction through efficient and accurate fulfillment operations.

About the team
The EU ICQA mission is to prevent and remove customer-facing defects with the goal to provide a world class service to our customers, at the lowest possible cost. The Vision of ICQA is to exceed customers’ expectations, both buyers and sellers. We drive defect-free order fulfillment by operating in the most efficient and accurate way through the creation and implementation of quality standards in our FC processes (receive, stow, count, pick, pack & ship) up to our sellers and customers. We lead with empathy to create a safer, more productive, higher performing and more diverse work environment. We commit to empower and support our team members to grow and achieve their aspirations.

- Experience using MS Office suite (particularly Excel)
- Experience leading teams
- Knowledge of advanced English at CEFR level B2/C1
- Relevant experience in performing data analysis and understanding data sets and tools

- Experience in complex problem solving, and working in a tight schedule environment

- Strong commitment to employee development, as well as an exceptional level of dedication, motivation to team management

title: Software Development Engineer, AlfBus Journal
descriptionHtml:
Ever wonder what happens when S3 processes a PUT request, when EC2 launches a new instance, when DynamoDB commits a write with single-digit millisecond latency, or when Kinesis Data Streams ingests a new record? Behind the scenes, a distributed log service is making it all possible — and you'd be building it.

The AlfBus Journal organization builds foundational distributed systems that power the largest AWS services. We specialize in high-performance, strongly consistent data systems that operate at scale. Our systems process over 4 million writes per second today and are growing fast. When we ship, the blast radius is AWS itself.

We have a multi-year roadmap packed with hard, unsolved problems: building next-generation data export services, driving large-scale migrations that will reshape Amazon's storage infrastructure, and pushing the boundaries of durability, availability, and performance in distributed log systems. This isn't incremental work — it's foundational.

As an SDE-II, you'll own systems end-to-end: from requirements and design through implementation, deployment, and production support. You'll work alongside multiple Senior and Principal Engineers on a tight-knit team of 11 that values pairing, co-ownership, and direct collaboration. You'll also mentor junior engineers and help raise the team's technical bar through design reviews and engineering best practices.

If you want to go deep on distributed systems and database internals — not just use them, but build the ones that AWS depends on — this is the role.

Key job responsibilities
- Design and build highly available, low-latency distributed log and database systems that process millions of writes per second for AWS's most critical services.
- Own end-to-end delivery of software projects — from requirements through design, implementation, deployment, and production support.
- Drive improvements to security, reliability, durability, and performance across multiple foundational services.
- Lead and contribute to multi-year, cross-team migration and integration efforts with high-profile partner teams.
- Mentor junior engineers through code reviews, design discussions, and pairing sessions.
- Establish and evolve engineering best practices and operational processes for the team.

A day in the life
AlfBus Journal engineers are constantly challenged to think of unique and innovative solutions. The quality bar is high.

As an engineer here, you will work on the engineering problems in distributed systems at a massive scale and on multiple dimensions. You will exercise your intellectual curiosity, work with motivated teams of sharp individuals, and get guidance from senior and principal engineers.

This is a hands-on position in which you will own everything from end to end: requirements gathering, designs, design reviews, implementations, code reviews, incremental feature launches, operations, mentoring, and the driving of continuous improvement.

Basic qualifications

- 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
- 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
- Experience programming with at least one software programming language

Preferred qualifications

- 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
- Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

title: Applied Scientist, Advertising Trust
descriptionHtml:
Amazon is investing heavily in building a world class advertising business and we are responsible for defining and delivering a collection of self-service performance advertising products that drive discovery and sales. Our products are strategically important to our Retail and Marketplace businesses driving long term growth. We deliver billions of ad impressions and millions of clicks daily and are breaking fresh ground to create world-class products. We are highly motivated, collaborative and fun-loving with an entrepreneurial spirit and bias for action. With a broad mandate to experiment and innovate, we are growing at an unprecedented rate with a seemingly endless range of new opportunities.

The Advertising Trust org is responsible for ensuring that ads are relevant and is of good quality, leading to higher conversion for the sellers and providing a great experience for the customers. We are also responsible for building a smooth advertiser experience, communicating advertising policies and moderation outcomes effectively and helping advertisers build complaint campaigns. We deal with one of the world’s largest product catalog, handle billions of requests a day with plans to grow it by order of magnitude and use automated systems to validate tens of millions of offers submitted by thousands of merchants in multiple countries and languages.

Key job responsibilities
In this role, you will build and develop Agentic solutions and ML models to address content understanding problems in Ads. title: Software Development Manager - Amazon Connect Customer, Amazon Connect Customer
descriptionHtml:
AWS Applied AI Solutions (AAIS) is building toward a future where every business innovates with Amazon AI teammates. To get there, we build AI solutions that improve human capabilities and transform entire business functions. We create end-to-end products that surprise and delight out-of-the-box, making complex things easy and hard things possible, with no cloud experience required. We start with customers who embrace the future and build bridges to meet the rest where they are. We pursue ambitious opportunities with conviction, and we are looking for builders who share that mindset.

Amazon Connect is an AI-powered customer experience solution that enables superior outcomes at a lower cost. Since its 2017 public launch, Amazon Connect has become an AI leader, transforming how organizations of all types interact with their customers.

Amazon Connect Customer is one of the fastest-growing product in AWS. We provide contact center technology that powers the largest enterprises on earth. Imagine it’s April 15 (Tax day in US), and millions of Americans rely on our technology to get their tax questions answered so they can file their tax returns on time. Or imagine it’s Cyber Monday, one of the largest shopping days of the year, and millions of Amazon.com customers place their calls through our systems to order gifts for their family. Those are the type of scale we handle in Amazon Connect everyday.

Our team is growing fast, and we’re looking for a Software Development Manager to help us continue to hire and grow the team and set the architectural direction into the future. As a software development manager on our team, you’ll help to establish teams to imagine and implement new features, evolve our architecture and scale, work closely with senior technical leaders within the team and across AWS. You’ll coordinate feature development across teams, ensuring new functionality fits into the broader slate of AWS services. You’ll drive a culture that values operational excellence, security, customer focus, and continuous improvement.

You will own services in Connect Customer Work Force Acceleration organization and you will be working on the design and development of the next generation of agent management, scheduling and contact routing services. You will both manage an existing high-functioning team and hire significantly to build and drive the vision going forward. With a strong leadership, and a culture of challenge, support, and feedback, you will grow your skills and talents so you can scale with the new challenges and opportunities that arise as the organization expands.

You will guide a diverse, smart, and hardworking team. We’ve worked hard to create a trusting, collaborative, diverse, and supportive atmosphere. We’re looking for a positive, enthusiastic, driven, and personable manager to continue this environment and lead this team. Come join us, and start your next challenge!


About the team
ABOUT AWS:

Diverse Experiences
Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why flexible work hours and arrangements are part of our culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

Inclusive Team Culture
Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity and AmazeCon conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

Mentorship and Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Basic qualifications

- 3+ years of engineering team management experience
- 7+ years of working directly within engineering teams experience
- 3+ years of designing or architecting (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience

title: Operations Manager
descriptionHtml:
Job summary
Our WW Operations network delivers millions of packages and smiles to Amazon customers every day. We are looking for motivated, customer-focused individuals who want to join our team as an Operations Manager. In this role, you will lead and develop a team of salaried and hourly talent. You will be responsible for engaging your team during their shifts to maintain the highest levels of safety, quality, attendance, and performance. To achieve this, managers are expected to provide their team with the tools needed for success while driving improvements in productivity and efficiency through data-driven decisions and analytical problem-solving. You will also play a key role in maintaining our customer expectations to ensure customer orders are delivered at the right time, to the right location.

Our Operation’s workflow has three major components: First mile - where the product is housed and ready for order; Middle mile - where the order is hauled to your area; and Last mile - when the product is delivered to the customer’s door. title: Mechatronic Apprentice I
descriptionHtml:
Operations is at the heart of Amazon’s business. We are known for our speed, accuracy, and exceptional service. Our buildings deliver tens of thousands of products to hundreds of countries worldwide, every day. Reliability Maintenance & Engineering (RME) are the business partners that work tirelessly behind the scenes to make it all happen. We drive continuous improvement, and maintain all of the Robotics and Material Handling Equipment (MHE) to ensure our customers are met with the Amazon smile. Come join us on our journey!
About the Role:

As a Mechatronics & Robotics Apprentice (MRA), you will learn to combine electronic, mechanical, computer and automation engineering skills at the workplace. During on-the-job learning (OJL) you will work with complex high-performance manufacturing systems and will learn to analyze, troubleshoot, and repair systems to maintain process efficiency. The focus of your role will be to learn the skills and abilities to ensure safety regulations and policies are adhered to, assist in the installation, maintenance, and repair of the automated packaging and distribution equipment, ensure preventative maintenance is conducted on time to a high standard, and provide high levels of equipment availability through continuous improvement.

You will be paired with journey workers to carry out their work at various facilities, including high automation and robotics facilities in connection with service operations. You will be expected to complete work based on technical documents and instructions and carry out your work in compliance with the relevant provisions and safety regulations.

You should be an effective communicator, work well in a team, and be self-motivated. You must have the ability to work collaboratively and coordinate your activities with upstream and downstream operations partners. In addition to developing your skills, you will be mentored by senior technicians to grow in your role.


Key job responsibilities
Key job responsibilities include, but are not limited to:
• You will perform preventative/predictive maintenance of conveyance equipment using the appropriate job plans, procedures, and manuals.

• You will conduct maintenance and basic troubleshooting of robotics and robotic work cells.

• You will troubleshoot electrical and mechanical problems related to all material handling equipment components.

• You will maintain and troubleshoot motors, photo eyes, relays, proximity sensors, solenoids, motor starters, tachs, etc.
• You must be able to move up to 49lbs, stand and walk during shifts lasting up to 12 hours, climb ladders and gangways safely, and without limitation, as well as perform regular bending, lifting, stretching, and reaching both below the waist and above the head

Program Requirements:
• Flexible to relocate after completion of the program

• Able to enroll in and attend a 9-week training at one of four designated training providers (Location to be determined post-interview)

• Meet the minimum qualifying score on a Mechanical Aptitude Test

Please note that while we strive to accommodate employees' preferences for shift assignments, due to operational requirements and scheduling constraints, we cannot guarantee a specific shift assignment.

Basic qualifications

- High School Diploma
- 1+ years of PC software experience including Microsoft Word, Excel and Outlook experience
- vocational/technical training or an associate degree or above, or 1+ years of Amazon RME (Reliability Maintenance Engineering) experience
- Experience troubleshooting and repairing operational items
- Knowledge of mathematics
- Experience measurement reading and interpretation
- Work flexible schedules including weekends, nights, and holidays

Preferred qualifications

- 4+ years of military experience
- Experience conducting predictive and preventative maintenance procedures
- Experience troubleshooting and diagnosing material handling equipment (MHE)
- Experience implementing safety standards
- Experience reading blueprints and electrical schematics

descriptionHtml:
Join Amazon’s mission to become Earth’s safest place to work! At Amazon, we’ve set the ambitious goal to become the benchmark of safety excellence across all industries in which we operate. The Amazon Workplace Health & Safety (WHS) team sets the strategic direction to provide resources, best practices, and safe environments to proactively manage the health and wellbeing of our workforce. To support these goals, Amazon is seeking an experienced and dynamic Onsite Medical Representative (OMR) to join our team. In this position, you will work closely with the WHS Site Manager, WHS Specialist, and occasionally the Injury Prevention Specialist (IPS). This includes attending weekly associate safety committee meetings, greeting all new hires for the site or through daily one-on-one interaction. Additionally, the OMR will participate in weekly case management review meetings as necessary.

As an OMR, you will independently assess and administer first aid as well as offer guidance to Amazon Associates (AAs) on both occupational and non-occupational injuries or illnesses. You should be passionate about learning and advocating health and wellness principles to consistently support AAs on a daily basis. You will refer care to outside medical providers as needed, and learn about OSHA regulations, risk, and analysis.

The OMR will function as a part of the larger team onsite, assisting with all first aid needs and support safety operations as needed.

Responsibilities include but are not limited to:
- Provide first aid support and make referrals to outside medical providers as necessary.
- Minimize the AA risk of injury through awareness, education, and proactive engagement.
- Maintain all records of care provided to AAs.
- Coordinate and maintain the workers’ compensation and return to work programs for AAs with work-related injuries.
- Provide daily activity logs and end of shift reports.
- Engage with AAs and leadership on operations floor to provide coaching regarding observed at-risk work habits.
- Maintain a clean working environment and ensure appropriate medical supply inventory is maintained.
- Participate in training and certification to facilitate first aid, CPR and AED certifications classes.
- Maintain all first aid, CPR, AED credentials.
- Work flexible shifts which could include days, nights, holidays, and/or weekends.

- Current active Athletic Trainer Certification, by either the Board of Certification (BOC) or equivalent State Certification.

- Certified to teach first aid, CPR, and AED training from American Heart Association or American Red Cross
- Proficient in Microsoft Office
- Experience with an industrial wellness program

title: Software Dev Engineer, Amazon Leo Customer Terminal Software
descriptionHtml:
Project Leo is an initiative to increase global broadband access through a constellation of 3,236 satellites in low Earth orbit (LEO). Its mission is to bring fast, affordable broadband to unserved and underserved communities around the world. Project Leo will help close the digital divide by delivering fast, affordable broadband to a wide range of customers, including consumers, businesses, government agencies, and other organizations operating in places without reliable connectivity.

You will design, craft, and deploy reliable embedded software for large quantity of consumer electronic products. Leo is breaking new ground with every device we design, and you will be an integral part of bringing this family of products to customers.

Key job responsibilities
· Develop embedded software for Customer Terminal devices within the Project Leo system.
· Participate in all phases of SDLC including requirements gathering, design, code, test, and code/test coverage.
· Developing embedded software in C, C++, Rust, Python or other languages
· Have experience with real-time embedded software philosophies and practices
· Have expertise with Linux and/or RTOS
· Review schematics, logic analyzer, and embedded software trouble-shooting techniques.

Export Control Requirement: Due to applicable export control laws and regulations, candidates must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.


A day in the life
As part of our Leo Customer Terminal Software Team, you will design and implement embedded software used in the Project Leo products. You will work in a collaborative environment with teams inside and outside of Amazon. You will craft your software from requirements, designs, code, test, to product deployment. You need to be flexible and responsive to changing priority issues.

About the team
The Leo Customer Terminal Software Team supports the devices that connect our customers to the Leo network. We provide software for both applications and the underlying Linux system. We work hand in hand with hardware, product and operations teams to deliver a great experience for our customers.

Basic qualifications

- 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
- 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
- 1+ years of software development engineer or related occupational experience
- 1+ years of designing and developing large-scale, multi-tiered, multi-threaded, embedded or distributed software applications, tools, systems, and services using: C#, C++, Java, or Perl experience
- 1+ years of Object Oriented Design experience
- Bachelor's degree or foreign equivalent in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field
- Experience programming with at least one software programming language

Preferred qualifications

- 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
- Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

title: Operations Manager
descriptionHtml:
Our WW Operations network delivers millions of packages and smiles to Amazon customers every day. We are looking for motivated, customer-focused individuals who want to join our team as an Operations Manager. In this role, you will lead and develop a team of salaried and hourly talent. title: Principal Solutions Architect, Retail, Consumer Goods & Restaurants, AWS
descriptionHtml:
Solutions Architects work hand in hand with AWS customers to help them make the most of the Cloud. They are at the crossroads of business and technology and engage with organizations at all stages of cloud adoption. Solutions Architects are responsible for creating and presenting technical content and sharing best practices.

Solutions Architects are responsible for the overall technical relationship between customers and AWS and make recommendations on security, cost, performance, reliability and operational efficiency. They work to understand the customer's needs and give prescriptive guidance on how to create business value with AWS technology. Solutions Architects lead activities such as architecture reviews, white-boarding sessions, demos and technical workshops. They collaborate with other teams such as account management, professional services, support, product teams and the AWS partner ecosystem.

As a Principal Solutions Architect you serve as the senior technical leader for one or more strategic customers, while extending your influence and technical depth across the broader customer portfolio. You set technical direction that others follow, resolve the hardest architectural and organizational problems, and influence the decisions of senior customer executives and AWS leadership. You work with minimal guidance on ambiguous, high-stakes problems where the right answer is not yet defined, and you look for patterns and trends that can be applied broadly across a customer segment to accelerate innovation. You are an externally recognized thought leader and an internal role model who delivers bar-raising guidance to the broader Solutions Architecture team.

In this role you will get to practice your creativity, linking technology to tangible solutions and educating AWS customers about the art of the possible. You will have the opportunity to define or invent cloud-native reference architectures for a variety of use cases (e.g. Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Serverless and Container based architectures, Analytics and Big Data, DevOps or Security). The Solutions Architecture team is a diverse group of technologists from a variety of backgrounds. Deep, demonstrated expertise on the AWS platform is expected at this level, along with a track record of applying it to large-scale, complex environments.

You will have the support to grow your expertise in industry and technology areas of depth, and you will be expected to raise the technical bar of the SAs and teams around you. Every day you will learn something new from your customers, your peers and your own experiments.

At Amazon you will be encouraged and rewarded for doing what is right for the long-term success of the customer. We value your passion to discover, invent and build on behalf of customers.


Key job responsibilities
- Own the technical strategy for a portfolio of customers or a technology domain, and drive multi-year architectural direction that spans multiple teams and customers
- Build technical relationships with customers and operate as their trusted advisor. The best interests of the customer will shape the guidance you provide.
- Engage and influence senior customer stakeholders (Director, VP, CTO, CIO level) on technical strategy and investment decisions
- Identify patterns and trends that can be applied broadly across a customer segment, and use them to accelerate innovation
- Share the voice of the customer to inform the roadmap of AWS features, and proactively work within the organization to influence the evolution of the platform
- Set the technical direction and standards that other SAs adopt, and lead the definition of reusable reference architectures used across the organization
- Contribute to the growth of the Solutions Architecture organization by interviewing candidates and having a voice in hiring decisions. You will also be helping others develop new skills by mentoring team members
- Act as a force multiplier across the organization: formally mentor senior SAs, raise the hiring bar, and develop the technical depth of the broader team



About the team
Why AWS?
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Diverse Experiences
AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Inclusive Team Culture
Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (gender diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

Mentorship & Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

- 10+ years of specific technology domain areas (e.g. software development, cloud computing, systems engineering, infrastructure, security, networking, data & analytics) experience
- Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, mathematics or equivalent
- Experience developing technology solutions and evangelising end-to-end technology roadmaps that guide IT transformations toward cloud computing
- Experience communicating across technical and non-technical audiences and at C-level, including training, workshops, publications

Preferred qualifications

- Knowledge of distributed systems design and implementation or equivalent
- Knowledge of large scale automation and workflow management or equivalent
- Knowledge of database design and implementation or equivalent
- Knowledge of presentations and whiteboarding skills with a high degree of comfort speaking with internal and external executives, IT management, and developers
- Experience architecting, migrating, transforming or modernizing customer requirements to the cloud

title: Recruiting Coordinator, Recruiting Operations Center
descriptionHtml:
This is a full-time, in-person (not virtual), permanent role based in BNA24 building in Nashville, TN and does not offer relocation benefits.

The Recruiting Coordinator (RC) serves as one of the very first impressions for candidates when applying to Amazon and plays a crucial role in managing high-volume interview scheduling and serves as the main point of contact between candidates, recruiters and interviewers when applying to Amazon. This position requires multi-tasking and case-management abilities to coordinate interviewer and candidate agendas across multiple time zones while maintaining a seamless and positive experience throughout the hiring process.

In this fast-paced role, the Recruiting Coordinator must maintain clear and constant communication with candidates, hiring managers, and interview panels. They are responsible for sending detailed interview-related information, managing last-minute schedule changes, and ensuring all participants have the necessary information to connect to their job interview. A successful Recruiting Coordinator demonstrates attention to detail while managing multiple concurrent scheduling requests, maintaining accurate records, and generating reports on interview metrics and efficiency.

The selected RC should possess process orientation, written and verbal communication skills and problem-solving experience, how and what to prioritize, flexibility to adapt to changing circumstances, capability to work under pressure while maintaining accuracy and a team-culture collaboration mindset.

Performance in this role is measured through various metrics, including interview scheduling accuracy, response rate requests, candidate satisfaction scores, and the volume of interviews successfully coordinated. The Recruiting Coordinator must be process-oriented yet flexible, maintaining a positive attitude while managing competing priorities in a high-stakes environment.

Key job responsibilities
Scheduling virtual and in-person interviews and debrief events.
Working directly with candidates, hiring managers, business stakeholders and in some cases arranging travel for candidates located outside of the city of the role, if required.
Partner with Recruiters on SLAs (Service Level Agreements) to respond successfully to business demands.
Providing follow-up correspondence to candidates on interview status.
Identifying opportunities for improving candidate experience, automation and scheduling efficiency.
To provide training/onboarding support to new peers in the role.
Assisting in the coordination of other recruiting activities as needed.

A day in the life
The day begins by reviewing the queue of interview scheduling requests and prioritizing based on SLAs. Work involves coordinating with candidates across multiple time zones, sending professional communications about upcoming interviews while ensuring they feel supported throughout the process. The role requires juggling interviewer's availability and managing last-minute reschedules with efficiency and accuracy. Internal and External tools are used to set up virtual interviews, while also preparing for in-person candidate visits.

About the team
The Global Talent Acquisition (GTA) Recruiting Operations Center is dedicated to transforming the interview scheduling experience into something truly exceptional. As the backbone of recruiting at Amazon, we delight customers worldwide by integrating cutting-edge technology with operational expertise. Our mission is to set new standards in efficiency and excellence, ensuring that every interaction throughout the hiring process is smooth, effective, and remarkable.
Prior applying, please consider the following:
Selected candidate(s) will be required to work 5x days per week from the BNA office in Nashville, TN.
Only schedule(s) available are Mon-Fri only: 9:00am-5:30pm

Basic qualifications

- 1+ years of recruiting, coordination, administration, logistics, HR or equivalent experience
- Bachelor's degree or equivalent
- Experience with basic web-based tools and products like Outlook, Excel, Word and SharePoint

Preferred qualifications

- Degree or diploma in HR or any related field
- Experience working in a fast paced, quickly changing or international environment
- Experience with technical tracking systems / softwares (like ATS)

title: Specialista Sicurezza sul Lavoro, EU AMXL WHS
descriptionHtml:
In Amazon, la sicurezza e il benessere dei nostri dipendenti è una priorità assoluta. I nostri Specialisti della Sicurezza svolgono un ruolo fondamentale per renderlo possibile. In questo ruolo, metterai in atto le misure necessarie per garantire che tutte le persone del tuo sito lavorino in un ambiente sicuro e salutare. È un'opportunità concreta per fare la differenza nella vita delle persone ogni giorno. Mantenendo proattivamente la loro sicurezza, li aiuterai anche a sentirsi sicuri nel proprio ruolo e motivati a dare il meglio.

Il contratto collettivo nazionale di lavoro applicabile a questo ruolo è CCNL per i dipendenti del settore Logistica, Trasporto Merci e Spedizione . La posizione è inquadrata al livello 2 o superiore, in base alle competenze, capacità ed esperienza del/della candidato/a.


Key job responsibilities

- Monitorare le prestazioni del sito rispetto ai KPI stabiliti e creare piani di miglioramento dei processi.
- Implementare programmi di sicurezza e salute sul lavoro e organizzare sessioni di formazione.
- Analizzare le metriche di sicurezza e le tendenze degli incidenti per aiutare i colleghi a pianificare le risorse appropriate nelle aree a maggior rischio.
- Effettuare audit per verificare la conformità del sito alla legislazione vigente in materia di sicurezza e salute e implementare soluzioni dove si identificano rischi.


A day in the life
Lavorerai in sede presso uno dei nostri siti, che può essere un centro di distribuzione, un centro di smistamento o una stazione di consegna. Essere sul posto ti permette di tenere sotto controllo i processi. Oltre ad aiutarci a mantenere la conformità in materia di sicurezza e salute, individuerai potenziali problemi e opportunità di miglioramento. Questo significa lavorare a stretto contatto con le persone di tutta l'azienda per conoscere i rischi che affrontano e raccogliere dati per identificare modi più intelligenti e sicuri di lavorare. Organizzerai anche programmi di formazione per aiutare tutti a seguire i nuovi processi di sicurezza e raggiungere nuovi standard.


About the team
Il team Workplace Health and Safety (WHS) svolge un ruolo fondamentale nel garantire il benessere mentale e fisico dei nostri dipendenti sul luogo di lavoro. Il nostro team collabora con responsabili, associati e autorità locali in tutti i nostri siti, assicurando il rispetto delle politiche di Amazon e delle normative vigenti, e garantendo la sicurezza dei nostri ambienti di lavoro. Il team offre una varietà di opportunità, dai Safety Technician ai Programme Manager. Indipendentemente dal tuo ruolo, contribuirai allo sviluppo e all'implementazione della strategia di sicurezza sull'intera rete.

title: Planning and Ops Manager, Account Management Excellence
descriptionHtml:
Amazon is looking for an experienced Inventory Planner with a background in inventory or supply-chain disciplines. In Stock Managers (ISM) manage customer inputs and work to remove inefficiencies in the supply chain. They will manage a team of associates to manage and help sellers grow their sales on Amazon, by building and nurturing a partnership to help support the sellers inventory, fulfillment and logistics requirements. They are also responsible for automating and building scale for processes that otherwise require manual inputs and effort. ISMs work with internal and external stakeholders to build the right processes and mechanisms to improve operational supply chain metrics. This position is responsible for developing and executing sales and inventory strategies to optimize availability and inventory turns. In this role, you will have end to end ownership of managing inventory and driving replication and speed initiatives. You will also build strong partnerships with sellers, merchandising, transportation, FBA and operations teams to drive toward common goals. To succeed in the role, you must possess the ability to operate from a company-wide perspective and will need to encourage cross-functional and cross-business project development. Responsibilities include:

Define key in-stock metrics, establish priority of metrics and works with sellers and internal speed stakeholder teams to achieve goals for the same
Establish framework to manage unhealthy inventory on an ongoing basis
Participate in seller reviews; drive operational improvement through measurement and process improvement
Take up additional in-stock related projects/initiatives such as trans-shipment for each category; supply chain projects to drive speed
Interact with operations teams and drive efficiencies through team collaboration
Develop annual in-stock strategy and channel strategy such as moving maximum units to flex vs. FCs based on category priorities
Manage peak inbound during Diwali, ART inbound strategy
Define and achieve the inventory turn goal for each category to maintain healthy inventory (in collaboration with the FBA team) Achieve and maintain high in stock rates on replenishment programs
Build automated templates for demand estimation taking into account category nuances; Streamlining of appointments
Drive tools to automate forecasting for sellers
Works with key sellers to drive processes to ensure in-time replenishment, streamlined replication & inbound processes for the sellers
Establish mechanisms to reduce costs across the supply chain through processes such as reduction in long zone shipments

Basic qualifications

- 2+ years of sales experience
- Experience analyzing data and best practices to assess performance drivers

Preferred qualifications

- Experience meeting revenue targets and quotas
- Experience in e-commerce
- Experience working in a fast-paced and highly cross-functional organization

The ideal candidate has already architected real D2D, NTN, satellite-to-cellular, or closely related systems and understands how architecture decisions in one domain affect the others. This is not a role focused on a single engineering discipline. We are looking for someone who can define the complete system, drive cross-domain decisions and trade-offs, and keep the solution technically coherent as requirements, customer needs, and subsystem designs evolve.

The successful candidate will combine broad cellular and service knowledge with strong customer and partner skills, strong ownership, and the ability to lead in a fast-moving, international environment.

Export Control Requirement: Due to applicable export control laws and regulations, candidates must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.


Key job responsibilities
• Own the end-to-end D2D technical architecture and the technical plan of record.
• Translate customer, MNO, and business needs into the system architecture, working closely with Business, Product, and Solutions Architecture.
• Drive cross-domain architecture decisions and trade-offs across core, RAN, satellite payload, devices, spectrum, regulatory, and service, and document their rationale.
• Assess technical feasibility of proposed solutions and support customer and MNO engagements, so that commitments are clear, achievable, and aligned with system capabilities.
• Partner with Systems Engineering to turn the architecture into requirements, interfaces, and acceptance criteria that Development can build and test against.
• Maintain end-to-end technical coherence as requirements, customer needs, and subsystem designs evolve, and resolve cross-domain conflicts between development teams.
• Bring ecosystem requirements and findings (MNO, OEM, chipset) back into the architecture, working with Telco Service Development.
• Define the evolution path of the architecture, including new features, markets, device categories, and next-generation satellites.
• Act as the subject matter expert for the end-to-end D2D architecture, and represent the architecture with leadership, customers, partners, and vendors.
• Work effectively across geographically distributed, international and multicultural engineering, business, and customer organizations.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in a related field
- 8+ years of relevant professional experience in satellite or cellular systems, including at least 3 years architecting Direct-to-Device (D2D), NTN, or direct satellite-to-cellular systems.
- Demonstrated end-to-end knowledge of D2D architectures, including satellite payload and ground segment, RAN, 5G core, and commercial devices.
- Experience making and documenting cross-domain architecture decisions and trade-offs in complex systems involving multiple engineering teams.
- Working knowledge of 3GPP NTN standards, mobility, and interworking with terrestrial networks
- Experience working directly with mobile network operators, device OEMs, or chipset vendors on D2D solutions.

Preferred qualifications

- Experience with satellite-based RAN architectures for NTN.
- Experience with voice over NR (VoNR/IMS), messaging, and emergency services.
- Experience with device interoperability testing and certification programs.
- Strong communication skills with demonstrated ability to work effectively across engineering teams, vendors, partners, and leadership organizations.
- Experience with spectrum and regulatory aspects of satellite services (spectrum, PFD and emission limits, licensing).
- Experience with system budgets and analysis (link, power, capacity, availability) for satellite systems.
- Experience translating business and commercial models into technical architecture.
- Strong communication skills with demonstrated ability to work effectively across engineering teams, business, customers, partners, and leadership organizations.

title: Safety Technician
descriptionHtml:
Keeping our people safe and well at work is a top priority at Amazon. Our Safety Technicians play an essential role in making this happen. This role is an opportunity to start your career in workplace safety and develop through a global company. You’ll work closely with our experts to monitor your site, which means you’ll get to see the difference that you make to people’s well-being every day.





Key job responsibilities
- Carry out risk assessments and audits
- Monitor the site to make sure processes are in line with Amazon’s safety procedures
- Create and update reports on safety metrics for colleagues to review
- Work with colleagues in Operations and across the business on safety-related tasks and offer guidance on processes
- Support in putting new safety measures in place

A day in the life
You'll be based at one of our sites. This means that you can closely track what's happening and people can easily ask you any questions throughout their shifts. This role is all about spotting potential issues before they happen. You'll spend a lot of time checking the site and getting to know the way that people use equipment. By understanding how every task and machine works, you'll be able to think about the best way to keep processes safe. You'll also be one of the people to put safety changes into action, which means you'll get to work closely with lots of people. Alongside your daily and weekly tasks, you'll offer support to our Operations team on ad-hoc safety-related work. Safety is so important to Amazon, and you'll help us gather the vital data that keeps us on top of our processes and ahead of any issues. You'll also share that data with people across the business and work with other teams to make sure they're putting safety first.

About the team
The Workplace Health and Safety (WHS) team plays a crucial role in keeping our people mentally and physically well at work. Our team works with managers, associates and local governments across our sites, ensuring compliance with Amazon's policies and legal regulations, and guaranteeing the safety of our work environments. The team offers a variety of opportunities, from Safety Technicians to Programme Managers. Regardless of your role, you'll contribute to the development and implementation of the safety strategy across the entire network.

Basic qualifications

- A Health and Safety NVQ Level 3 or NEBOSH National General Certificate (or equivalent)
- Experience running metrics reports, analyzing data to identify problems and using data analysis to generate and explain metrics
- Knowledge of UK Health & Safety Legislation and pertinent regulations
- Speak, write, and read fluently in English

Preferred qualifications

- Preferred qualifications are not required to apply for a position at Amazon. If you have all the basic qualifications above, we'd love to hear from you.
- Experience with Lean, 5S or Kaizen methodologies.
- Experience planning or managing environmentally conscious initiatives.
- Ability to work independently and as part of a team.

descriptionHtml:
About Maintenance at Amazon

Operations is at the heart of Amazon’s business. We are known for our speed, accuracy, and exceptional service. Our buildings deliver tens of thousands of products to hundreds of countries worldwide, every day. Reliability Maintenance & Engineering (RME) are the business partners that work tirelessly behind the scenes to make it all happen. We drive continuous improvement and maintain all of the Robotics and Material Handling Equipment (MHE) to ensure our customers are met with the Amazon smile. Come join us on our journey!

As a Mechatronics & Robotics Technician, you will use your skills to support the Operations Maintenance team in repairing and maintaining material handling equipment and pneumatic systems throughout the building. You will have the opportunity to install, maintain, and repair automated packaging and distribution equipment. In addition to developing your skills, you will mentor junior technicians to grow in their roles.

Amazon offers competitive compensation packages including comprehensive healthcare benefits starting on Day 1, matching 401(k) program, and up to 20 weeks of paid parental leave. But wait, there is more: We provide lightweight fire-resistant daily wear and composite toe safety shoes for your safety!

Here is what you can expect with the Reliability & Maintenance Engineering (RME) selection process for Mechatronics & Robotics Technicians: (Timeframe: Approximately 30-days)

Step 1: Congratulations! You successfully submitted your application!

Step 2: Amazon Recruiting will review your application and invite the most qualified candidate to complete a pre-employment assessment.

Step 3: If you meet the role qualifications, you will receive an invitation from Amazon Recruiting (do-not-reply@criteriacorp.com) to begin your Criteria assessment. You have 5 days to complete.

Step 4: Once you successfully meet the pre-employment assessment requirements, you will be invited to complete a video interview. Your video interview invitation will be from HireVue (interviews@hirevue.com) and you will have 7 days to record your interview.

Step 5: Your video interview will be reviewed by the Amazon Hiring Team and you will be notified of next steps via email within 5 business days.


Key job responsibilities
Key job responsibilities include, but are not limited to:
- You will promote a safe working environment by following all safety procedures
- You will complete preventative maintenance routines with proper documentation
- You will troubleshoot electrical and mechanical problems related to all Material Handling Equipment (MHE) which includes belts, motors, photo-eyes, relays, and more
- You will maintain a positive working relationship across all of the Amazon Operations facility
- You must be able to move up to 49lbs, stand and walk during shifts lasting up to 12 hours, climb ladders and gangways safely, and without limitation, as well as perform regular bending, lifting, stretching, and reaching both below the waist and above the head

Please note that while we strive to accommodate employees' preferences for shift assignments, due to operational requirements and scheduling constraints, we cannot guarantee a specific shift assignment.

Basic qualifications

- High school or equivalent diploma
- 1+ years of Microsoft Office products and applications experience

- 2+ years of conducting predictive and preventative maintenance procedures experience
- 2+ years of reading blueprints and electrical schematics experience
- 2+ years of demonstrating safety standards experience
- 2+ years of troubleshooting and diagnostics of material handling equipment (MHE) experience

Preferred qualifications

- Experience with robotic operation and maintenance
- 2+ years of electrical and electronic principles experience
- Associate's degree in Mechnical or Electrical

title: Program Manager II, NAST GoCarts Management , Scheduling Transfers And Reusables
descriptionHtml:
Come build the version of GoCarts logistics that schedules itself. Every day, our network moves tens of thousands of GoCarts between fulfillment, sortation, and repair sites, and every one of those moves is a promise, that the right GoCarts show up at the right site before it runs short. When that promise is at risk, the GoCarts scheduling team is the one that catches it. We're good at catching. We need a Program Manager to help us build for the day we don't have to.

GoCarts scheduling is the layer that keeps the network solvent in reusable assets. We own the proactive planning that places GoCarts before sites feel the gap, the reactive intervention that resolves shortages in real time, and — this is the part that matters — the mechanisms that make those interventions unnecessary. Our hardest problems aren't scheduling problems. They're throughput, visibility, and signal problems, and we're moving the whole program from reactive execution to proactive, data-driven decision-making.

In this role you will:

Own outcomes, not status decks.
Build mechanisms, not workarounds.
Automate what you touch.
Turn bottlenecks into asks leadership can act on.


Key job responsibilities
- Own the end-to-end health of the GoCarts scheduling program across proactive and reactive tracks, and the metrics that define it: asset solvency, defective-asset rate, trailer dwell, and fill rate.
- Drive peak-season readiness, including solvency targets, defective-asset reduction, injection plans, and contingency strategy, and manage the tradeoffs between them.
- Diagnose true network constraints, separating the real bottleneck (for example, repair throughput) from the symptom (scheduling), and build the data and business case to resolve it with the right owners.
- Manage cross-functional dependencies with repair and capacity partners, holding partner commitments to committed dates and escalating risk clearly and early.
- Close data-visibility gaps with partner data teams, improving scan compliance and site-level inventory signals so scheduling runs on actuals rather than assumption.
- Partner with science and automation teams to advance the roadmap toward continuous demand-versus-inventory detection, alerting, and model-driven resolution.
- Author crisp, data-backed narratives for senior leadership that frame risk, ownership, the ask, and the plan forward.
- Develop and own KPI reporting across the program portfolio, with clear visibility into milestones and performance.

Basic qualifications

- 3+ years of program or project management experience
- Experience working cross functionally with tech and non-tech teams
- Experience using data and metrics to determine and drive improvements
- Knowledge of Excel at an intermediate level (e.g., pivot tables & charts, multiple criteria lookups, nested logical/IF formulas, data cleansing, array formulas, etc.)
- Experience with advanced use of SQL for data mining and business intelligence, or experience troubleshooting problems and offering solutions to streamline complex challenges

Preferred qualifications

- 3+ years of driving end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership experience
- Master's degree, or MBA in supply chain management, operations, engineering, analytics or related field
- Experience with advanced use of SQL for data mining and business intelligence, or experience in creating process improvements with automation and analysis
- Experience working in a fast-paced and ambiguous environment, or experience in building financial and operational reports/data sets that inform business decision-making

descriptionHtml:
Você está em busca de uma carreira com grandes desafios? Possui curiosidade e persistência? Você quer se desenvolver em um ambiente inovador, onde experimentamos coisas novas e sonhamos grande? Quer fazer parte do futuro da computação em nuvem com uma equipe obcecada por ajudar os clientes?

Se sim, junte-se à nossa equipe AWS no Brasil como Arquiteto(a) de Soluções e ajude nossos clientes a mudarem o mundo! A AWS é a plataforma de nuvem mais adotada e mais abrangente do mundo, suportando milhões de clientes, incluindo startups, grandes empresas e órgãos governamentais.





Key job responsibilities
As equipes de Arquitetura de Soluções possuem 4 responsabilidades principais:
1. Atuar de forma consultiva para clientes. Em parceria com a equipe de contas, formular e executar uma estratégia para viabilizar o sucesso do cliente. Ajudar clientes a adotar os serviços da AWS e fazer o melhor uso deles, gerando receita como resultado. Educar clientes sobre a proposta de valor da AWS e participar de discussões de arquitetura para garantir que as soluções sejam desenhadas para uma implantação bem-sucedida na nuvem. Criar confiança com equipes técnicas dentro de clientes para que sejam cloud advocates.
2. Ser referência técnica. Transferir conhecimento para clientes. Capturar e compartilhar conhecimento e boas práticas na comunidade de arquitetura de soluções da AWS. Contribuir com publicações para o cliente da AWS, como whitepapers, postagens ou blogs. Apresentar e contribuir em workshops, grupos de usuários, vídeos online e conferências.
3. Estar em crescimento profissional contínuo. Manter a curiosidade e o aprendizado. Demonstrar seu aprendizado através das Certificações da AWS. Trabalhar com outras pessoas para ajudá-las a entregar mais. Participar de encontros e conferências.
4. Desenvolver e executar melhorias organizacionais. Atuar como um elo técnico entre clientes e equipes de engenharia de serviços para melhorar os serviços e recursos da AWS. Contribuir com suas ideias para inovação para times internos e clientes. Simplificar processos que podem ser simplificados. Ajudar a contratar e desenvolver talentos.



A day in the life
Nesta função, sua criatividade conectará tecnologia a soluções tangíveis. Você trabalhará todos os dias para ajudar os clientes a aproveitar ao máximo os serviços da AWS, para que possam inovar, prosperar e transformar nosso país. Você terá a oportunidade de aprender novas habilidades e aprimorar as suas existentes. Você criará e compartilhará conteúdo técnico, arquiteturas de referência e práticas recomendadas. Você divulgará e educará sobre a tecnologia da AWS.
Esperamos de você motivação, trabalho em colaboração com pessoas ao redor do mundo, disposição para enfrentar desafios, paixão pelo que faz e se divertir ao fazê-lo. Você deve gostar de treinar, desenhar e criar soluções em nuvem para um conjunto diversificado e desafiador de clientes.

About the team
Aqui na AWS, abraçamos nossas diferenças. Estamos comprometidos em promover nossa cultura de inclusão. Temos 13 grupos de afinidade globalmente, que reúnem os funcionários da Amazon entre organizações e países ao redor do mundo. No Brasil, alguns exemplos incluem o Women at Amazon, o Glamazon (LGBTQIA+) e o Black Employee Network (BEN). A cultura de inclusão da Amazon é reforçada em nossos 16 Princípios de Liderança, que lembram as pessoas a buscar perspectivas diversas, aprender, ter curiosidade e ganhar confiança.

Experiências Diversas
A AWS valoriza experiências diversas. Mesmo que você não atenda a todas as qualificações e habilidades preferenciais listadas na descrição do cargo, incentivamos os candidatos a se candidatarem. Se sua carreira está apenas começando, não seguiu um caminho tradicional ou inclui experiências alternativas, não deixe que isso o impeça de se candidatar.

Por que a AWS?
A Amazon Web Services (AWS) é a plataforma de nuvem mais abrangente e amplamente adotada do mundo. Fomos pioneiros na computação em nuvem e nunca paramos de inovar — é por isso que os clientes, desde as startups mais bem-sucedidas até as empresas da Global 500, confiam em nosso robusto conjunto de produtos e serviços para impulsionar seus negócios.

Cultura de Equipe Inclusiva
Aqui na AWS, está em nossa natureza aprender e ser curiosos. Nossos grupos de afinidade liderados por funcionários promovem uma cultura de inclusão que nos permite ter orgulho de nossas diferenças. Eventos e experiências de aprendizado contínuos nos inspiram a nunca parar de abraçar nossa singularidade.

Mentoria e Crescimento Profissional
Estamos continuamente elevando nosso padrão de desempenho enquanto nos esforçamos para nos tornar o Melhor Empregador da Terra. É por isso que você encontrará aqui compartilhamento de conhecimento sem fim, mentoria e outros recursos para o avanço da carreira para ajudá-lo a se desenvolver como um profissional mais completo.

Equilíbrio entre Trabalho e Vida Pessoal
Valorizamos a harmonia entre trabalho e vida pessoal. Alcançar o sucesso no trabalho nunca deve vir às custas de sacrifícios em casa, por isso buscamos flexibilidade como parte de nossa cultura de trabalho. Quando nos sentimos apoiados no local de trabalho e em casa, não há nada que não possamos alcançar.

descriptionHtml:
re:Cycle Reverse Logistics is an electronics processing, reuse, and recycling company that works to extend the life of used electronic equipment through reuse, repair, and recycling. re:Cycle Reverse Logistics is looking for a talented, driven, and analytically focused Business Analyst in support of our Reverse Logistics (RL) program. As a Reverse Logistics Business Analyst you will be responsible for developing metrics and dashboards to support multiple initiatives within our global network. Our mission is to manage and scale information technology asset disposition (ITAD) services for used electronics and electronic equipment (UEEE) through secure and environmentally sustainable practices supporting asset recovery, reuse, recycling, and other circular economy initiatives.

In this role, you will be responsible for designing and building the data pipelines, tables, and automated reporting systems that enable our Planning, Operations, and Finance teams to make faster, more accurate decisions. title: Principal WW Partner Growth Specialist, Life Sciences, Partner Growth & Strategy(PG&S), Industry team
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Web Services (AWS) serves millions of customers in more than 190 countries, reshaping the way global enterprises accelerate business capabilities using information technology and powering the next generation of global industry leaders. Would you like to be part of a team focused on helping customers realize new value by transforming how they discover, develop, and deliver life-changing therapies and precision medicine?

AWS is seeking a Worldwide (WW) Partner Growth Specialist to accelerate our Life Sciences partner ecosystem across the full biopharma value chain — from genomic discovery and drug development through clinical trials, manufacturing, regulatory, and commercialization. This role is part of the Partner Growth & Strategy (PG&S) organization, which operates a dual motion model: Depth (deep engagement with named strategic partners) and Growth (scaling the broader ecosystem to drive net-new capability, revenue, and customer outcomes).

This is not a follow-the-playbook role. You will be building the growth engine for Life Sciences partners( Consulting and Technology) in a team that formed in 2026 and is actively defining its operating model. The strategy is clear — proactively sense demand, recruit the right partners, co-invest in capability, land with anchor customers, and scale — but how you execute will be shaped by your judgment, industry instinct, and ability to navigate ambiguity across a matrixed organization. If you need every process documented before you act, this is not the right fit. If you energize at the intersection of industry depth, partner economics, and senior leader influence — and you are comfortable being the one who writes the playbook — this is for you.


Key job responsibilities
Demand Signal Identification & Alignment
- Proactively identify, validate, and align industry demand signals across AWS , Industry & Specialist (I&S), Industry BUs, market trends, and key partners. Translate converging forces (agentic AI, federated data, precision medicine, regulatory change) into actionable partner investment theses that connect partner capability to customer urgency.
Plan Partner Capability — Recruit, Win P&L Owners, Co-Invest
- Identify and recruit the right partners to across the Life Sciences portfolio (9 solution areas ). Build executive-level relationships with partner P&L owners. Structure and execute co-investment in net-new capability, offerings, and solutions — from GSIs building agentic platforms to niche ISVs delivering specialized R&D tools.
Drive Revenue — GTM Packages, Anchor Customers, Field Handover
- Deliver and Guide end-to-end GTM packages: from solution definition and reference architectures through anchor customer engagements. Land lighthouse wins, then scale through campaigns, AWS Marketplace listings, and an agentic context/findability layer for field teams. Hand over successfully launched solutions to Partner Development Specialists/Managers for ongoing management.
Portfolio Management — Lifecycle, Relevance & Revenue
- Own the ongoing lifecycle of partner solutions in the Life Sciences portfolio. Monitor relevance, quality bar adherence, revenue contribution (LARR, pipeline, GenAI LARR), and APT attach rates. Make invest/scale/retire decisions using data. Ensure operational hygiene( AWS Solution Repository) so solutions are findable by field teams.
AWS Applied AI Service Interlock
- Serve as the industry connective tissue between AWS Applied AI services (Amazon Bio Discovery, HealthOmics, HealthLake, HealthImaging, Connect Health) and the partner ecosystem. Ensure partner build readiness for newly launched services, escalate feature requests, and champion partner integration as the last-mile for customer adoption.
Competency & Quality Bar Ownership
- Own Life Sciences Competency bar-raiser standards and Alchemy(AWS Internal solun. repository) quality gates. Validate partner offerings meet technical and industry requirements. Ensure the right partners are findable, qualified, and recommended to customers by field teams and agentic systems.
Scale Beyond Direct Coverage
- Design and execute mechanisms to extend impact from ~92 directly managed partners to 10,000+ through programmatic motions: Marketplace, field campaigns, startup/VC partner pathways, and agentic findability. Build self-service enablement that reduces dependence on direct human coverage for the long tail of the ecosystem.


A day in the life
In this role, a typical week might include: facilitating an Executive Briefing Center (EBC) session between a top pharma account and a GSI partner; pressure-testing a partner's agentic AI solution demo with specialist SAs; presenting a partner investment thesis to HCLS IBU leadership; recruiting a niche ISV into the Bio Discovery partner ecosystem; and troubleshooting a metadata/tagging gap that is blocking field findability for a high-value solution. No two weeks look the same — and that is intentional.

About the team
This position is part of the PG&S Team within the AWS Specialist and Partner Organization (ASP). Specialists own the end-to-end go-to-market strategy for their respective technology domains, providing the business and technical expertise to help our customers succeed. Partner teams own the strategy, recruiting, development, and growth of our key technology and consulting partners. Together they provide our customers with the expertise and scale needed to build innovative solutions for their most complex challenges.

Diverse Experiences

AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS?

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Inclusive Team Culture

AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.

Mentorship & Career Growth

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.

Basic qualifications

- Experience in direct customer engagement, with a focus on support to senior executives (Vice President and C-level)
- 7+ years working across the Life Sciences value chain — spanning at least 2 of: R&D/Drug Discovery, Clinical Development, Regulatory Affairs/Manufacturing, and Commercialization — with demonstrated ability to translate industry dynamics into partner and business strategies
- 5+ years in Partner Management, Business Development, Strategic Alliances, or Consulting in Life Sciences or a related regulated industry — ideally in a matrixed organization where you influenced outcomes without owning every resource
- Demonstrated ability to thrive in ambiguity: experience building new functions, programs, or coverage models from scratch — defining playbooks rather than inheriting them — in environments with evolving priorities, organizational change, and limited precedent
- Experience developing strategies that influence leadership decisions at the organizational level and holding your own in rooms with senior leaders who challenge assumptions
- Comfort presenting to both scientific/technical audiences (CSOs, Heads of R&D, VP Informatics) and business/commercial audiences (CFOs, P&L owners, Chief Strategy Officers)

Preferred qualifications

- Experience working with global teams and diverse partners
- Familiarity with agentic AI architectures and generative AI applications in life sciences — understanding how partner ecosystems deliver AI-native solutions at enterprise scale (e.g., clinical operations agents, commercial intelligence, regulatory automation)
- Experience with AWS HCLS Applied AI services (Amazon Bio Discovery, AWS HealthOmics, AWS HealthLake, AWS HealthImaging, Amazon Connect Health) or comparable cloud-based life sciences platforms
- Track record managing partner portfolios with a Depth vs. Growth segmentation lens — knowing when to double down, when to recruit, and when to retire
- Experience with Strategic Collaboration Agreements (SCAs), AWS Partner Transformation (APT), or similar joint investment vehicles with large consulting/technology partners
- Understanding of regulatory and compliance requirements in life sciences (GxP, HIPAA, 21 CFR Part 11, ICH guidelines)
- Understanding of partner economics — how to win a partner's P&L owner and structure co-investment that aligns incentives and drives mutual accountability
- Experience interpreting data to make portfolio investment decisions (LARR analysis, pipeline attribution, attach rate optimization)

descriptionHtml:
Data Lake and Analytics Specialist Solutions Architects are technical contributors who combine solid business understanding with strong technical skills to drive data, analytics, and AI conversations with Healthcare and Life Sciences (HCLS) customers. They work with customers to architect well-designed solutions to complex technical problems, translating business requirements into scalable architectures grounded in AWS best practices. They operate in environments where business objectives may not be fully defined, and they help customers clarify requirements and identify the right technical path forward.

What You Will Do

You will serve as a trusted technical advisor to customer engineering and architecture teams, helping them design and implement data lake, analytics, and semantic layer solutions on AWS. You will lead technical discussions around data platforms, analytics architectures, and AI readiness, and you will be comfortable diving deep into the details of services like S3, Lake Formation, Glue, Redshift, Athena, SageMaker, and Bedrock while also understanding how these fit into a customer's broader data strategy.

descriptionHtml:
Are you ready to transform Return Logistics operations at scale? We're seeking a strategic program leader who thrives on solving complex operational challenges while building high-performing teams. In this role, you'll act as a business owner directly impacting Amazon's profit and loss, driving process excellence across Return Logistics sites while reducing operational defects year over year. You'll lead initiatives that improve cost to serve and recovery metrics while developing talent through innovative adoption of AI skills.

As a single-threaded Program Management Office leader, you'll influence product roadmaps, make critical prioritization decisions that affect daily operational performance, and collaborate across 10+ stakeholder teams. Your analytical depth and program excellence will drive measurable business outcomes, from automation design for item-level sortation to seamless integration of new process flows. This role offers the unique opportunity to shape the future of Return Logistics operations across North America, Europe, and beyond.

Key job responsibilities
- Lead and develop a high-performing program management team, coaching members to balance long-term strategic initiatives with tactical execution while advancing AI capabilities and modern program management practices
- Own end-to-end program delivery for automation and process excellence initiatives across Return Logistics sites, coordinating resources, mitigating risks, and tracking progress to achieve measurable improvements in gross recovery metrics and operational defects
- Influence and align 10+ cross-functional stakeholder teams to drive consensus on product roadmaps and process changes, adapting communication approaches based on stakeholder backgrounds and managing expectations effectively
- Analyze complex operational data and performance patterns to identify improvement opportunities, evaluate alternatives, and implement solutions that reduce problem-solve defects while improving cost to serve for Return Logistics operations
- Drive the design and implementation of business configuration tools and low-code solutions that create hands-off-the-wheel capabilities, raising the bar on operational workflows while making it easier for associates to execute correctly

A day in the life
Your day starts by reviewing operational metrics and identifying trends that need attention. You'll lead strategic planning sessions with your program management team, discussing priorities for automation design initiatives and process improvements across Return Logistics sites. Mid-morning, you're facilitating alignment meetings with cross-functional stakeholders—from operations teams to product managers—influencing roadmap decisions that balance customer experience with associate needs. In the afternoon, you're analyzing data to evaluate solutions for reducing operational defects, then coaching a team member on stakeholder management techniques. You'll wrap up by reviewing progress on your hands-off-the-wheel tooling initiatives and planning next steps for continuous improvement projects.

About the team
The Reverse Logistics Operations Integration (RLOI) team drives innovation across all aspects of Return Logistics Under The Roof operations, including Customer Returns, Amazon Resale, Specialty, External Repairs, and Box on Demand. We focus on driving performance efficiencies while maintaining or raising the quality bar in everything we do. Our team culture balances developing scalable long-term processes with implementing scrappy, quick wins for pilots and continuous improvement initiatives.

We're problem solvers who challenge conventional approaches and thrive in fast-paced environments. Working across multiple business units, we design and implement solutions that drive meaningful operational improvements. Join us to influence the future direction of Return Logistics operations across North America, Europe, and beyond, while working with a team that values innovation, collaboration, and continuous learning.

- Bachelor's degree in supply chain, business, engineering, finance or related technical or quantitative field
- Knowledge of Microsoft Excel (macros, pivots, lookups) at an advanced level

- Experience implementing repeatable processes and driving automation or standardization
- MBA

- Knowledge of lean techniques and Six Sigma tools

Communication skills are crucial, as they interact with various stakeholders including customers, suppliers, and internal teams. The role requires strong leadership to motivate and coordinate teams towards achieving project goals while maintaining a focus on quality, efficiency, and adherence to timelines.

Overall, the role demands strategic thinking, effective leadership, and meticulous oversight to drive satellite manufacturing projects forward successfully. You should be comfortable with a high degree of ambiguity and relish the idea of solving problems that haven't been solved at scale before.
