descriptionHtml:
The World Wide Grocery Private Brands team is looking for a Packaging Manager to join our team. This role serves as the technical owner and packaging authority for a set of categories within our PB business. In this role, you will own the end-to-end packaging strategy for your categories across both Amazon and Whole Foods Market (WFM) branded products, with limited guidance. You will be the end-to-end packaging owner for your assigned food categories, responsible for new product commercialization, cost reduction, sustainability, and omnichannel performance. Our product packaging must work across all Grocery channels, including WFM stores, Amazon Fresh, and Same Day Grocery. You will work backwards from customer needs to optimize packaging that protects product quality, reduces damage, and meets financial targets.

You will develop deep expertise in the materials within your categories, and build relationships with Private Brand suppliers and their packaging partners. You will work within supplier capabilities to optimize packaging solutions, partnering with Sourcing Managers to influence decisions and drive improvements over time.

As this role supports both Whole Foods Market and Amazon Private Brands, you must be a strong champion for both brands' distinct missions and values. This means being passionate about WFM's commitment to nourishing people and the planet, while embracing Amazon's mission to make delicious food accessible and affordable for everyone.


Key job responsibilities
Category Ownership & Commercialization
- Own packaging deliverables for your assigned category portfolio (e.g., Snacks; Beverages & Meals; or Meat, Seafood & Frozen), including specification development, sample coordination, and testing for new product launches.

- Build relationships with Private Brand suppliers and their packaging partners to understand capabilities, identify opportunities, and drive improvements.
Omnichannel Performance

- Ensure packaging performs across all Grocery channels (Whole Foods Market stores, Amazon Fresh delivery, and Core e-commerce fulfillment) so products can be sold omnichannel.
- Evaluate and improve existing packaging formats with suppliers to reduce damage, lower shipping costs, and improve the customer experience.
- Assess and improve outer packaging and shippable containers appropriate for e-commerce, reducing shipping costs, ensuring undamaged product, and minimizing waste for consumers.
Cost Reduction & Sustainability
- Leverage deep material and substrate expertise within your categories to identify cost reduction and plastic reduction opportunities.
- Continually find ways to drive cost out of our packaging efforts while maintaining product quality and customer experience.

Quality & Continuous Improvement

- Perform lab testing with the ability to translate and articulate overall impact and opportunities that drive value for the business.
- Analyze customer needs and feedback to develop optimal product packaging, leveraging the unique opportunities being an online brand can provide.
- Maintain accurate packaging specifications across your category portfolio.
Cross-Functional Partnership
- Provide packaging expertise across cross-functional teams, evaluate supplier packaging proposals, and advise senior management on packaging trends and solutions.
- Influence packaging decisions across the Sourcing Organization without direct authority.

descriptionHtml:
At Amazon, Principal Engineers are both organizational leaders and hands-on builders. As Amazon’s most senior individual contributors, Principal Engineers work on our hardest problems, help establish technical standards and drive the overall technical architecture, engineering practices, and engineering methodologies for products that delight our customers. While many companies this size take their foot-off the gas pedal, at Amazon, it’s still Day 1. This startup mentality, does not admit the luxury of a conservative approach.

Amazon Elastic Compute Cloud (Amazon EC2) is one of the foundational services of Amazon Web Services (AWS) and a cornerstone of modern cloud computing. Since launching in 2006, EC2 has provided secure, resizable compute capacity in the cloud — giving customers virtual servers ("instances") with complete control over their computing resources and the broadest choice of processor, storage, networking, and operating system configurations.

Today, EC2 operates at extraordinary scale, serving millions of customers worldwide — from individual developers to the largest enterprises and public-sector organizations. It offers thousands of instance types optimized for virtually every workload, spanning general-purpose, compute-, memory-, storage-, and accelerator-optimized use cases across multiple CPU architectures (including AWS's own Graviton processors) and GPU-powered instances for large-scale AI and machine learning.

What the EC2 Organization Builds
Engineers in the EC2 organization work on some of the most technically challenging and high-impact systems in the industry, including:

Compute & virtualization — the virtual server platform that powers a vast portion of the internet, including the AWS Nitro System, AWS's custom hardware and lightweight hypervisor technology that delivers performance, security, and isolation at hyperscale.
Networking — high-performance networking infrastructure and services that move enormous volumes of traffic securely, reliably, and efficiently across the AWS cloud.
Custom silicon & hardware — purpose-built chips and hardware (such as Graviton and Nitro cards) that advance performance, efficiency, and cost-effectiveness.
AI & accelerated computing — next-generation instances engineered for training and serving large-scale AI models, with cutting-edge networking and GPU/accelerator capabilities.
Scalability, availability & operational excellence — the systems and tooling that keep these services fault-tolerant, highly available, and continuously improving at global scale.

If you have a background in developing large-scale distributed systems, or are a specialist in any of the following areas, we would love to review your application: compute virtualization, server provisioning and fleet management, high-performance data plane engineering, control plane and orchestration systems, networking, and cloud infrastructure at scale.

Key job responsibilities
As a Principal Software Engineer, you will:

Serve as a technical leader on our most demanding, cross-functional projects.
Functionally decompose complex problems into simple, straight-forward solutions.
Fully and completely understand system inter-dependencies and limitations.
Possess expert knowledge in performance, scalability, enterprise system architecture, and engineering best practices.
Assist in the career development of others, actively mentoring individuals and the community on advanced technical issues and helping managers guide the career growth of their team members
Exert technical influence over multiple teams, increasing their productivity and effectiveness by sharing your deep knowledge and experience. You are a leader, builder and an operator.
Balance technical leadership and savvy with strong business judgment to make the right decisions about technology choices.

About the team
EC2 is foundational infrastructure that a significant share of the digital world depends on. The organization combines the pace and ownership of a startup with the scale and reach of AWS, giving engineers the rare opportunity to make decisions that impact customers globally. It's an environment built for people who want to solve hard, ambiguous problems in distributed systems, virtualization, networking, security, performance, and AI infrastructure — and to see their work operate at a scale few other places can offer.

Basic qualifications

12+ years of hands-on professional engineering development experience
Technical leadership and mentorship experience of engineering teams

Preferred qualifications

Deep hands-on technical expertise in at least one major technical area: large scale full stack development, building distributed systems, designing massive global networks, embedded systems or complex hardware

title: ML Compiler Engineer, Neuron Kernel Interface
descriptionHtml:
AWS Machine Learning accelerators are at the forefront of AWS innovation. Trainium delivers best-in-class ML training performance with the most teraflops (TFLOPS) of compute power for ML in the cloud. This is all enabled by the AWS Neuron Software Development Kit (SDK), which includes an ML compiler, the Neuron Kernel Interface (NKI) compiler, and a runtime that natively integrates into popular ML frameworks such as PyTorch and JAX.

Neuron Kernel Interface (NKI) is a bare-metal language and compiler for directly programming AWS Trainium instances. You can use NKI to develop, optimize, and run new operators directly on hardware while making full use of available compute and memory resources.

Explore NKI:
- https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/nki/index.html

AWS Neuron is used at scale by customers such as Epic Games, Snap, Airbnb, Autodesk, Amazon Alexa, and Amazon Rekognition, along with many others across a range of segments.

Amazon's Annapurna Labs is responsible for building innovative silicon and software for AWS customers. We are at the forefront of innovation, combining cloud scale with the world's most talented engineers. Our team covers multiple disciplines including silicon engineering, hardware design and verification, software, and operations. With such breadth of talent, there is opportunity to learn all the time. We operate in spaces that are very large, yet our teams remain small and agile. There is no blueprint. We're inventing. We're experimenting. When you couple that with the ability to work on so many different products and services, it makes for a unique learning culture.

Learn more about our history:
- https://www.amazon.science/how-silicon-innovation-became-the-secret-sauce-behind-awss-success

Explore the Product:
- https://aws.amazon.com/machine-learning/neuron/

As an ML Compiler Engineer with the Annapurna Neuron team, you develop and scale compilers to handle the world's largest ML workloads on AWS Trainium. You design and ship features across the compiler stack, work directly with Amazon ML partner teams to unblock their workloads, and grow your skills alongside senior engineers. You want to work close to the hardware, help bring new products and features to market, and ship high-quality code.

A background in Machine Learning, AI accelerators, or Kernel performance is helpful, but not required.

In order to be considered for this role, candidates must be located near or willing to relocate to Seattle or Cupertino.

Key job responsibilities
- Design and build compiler features for the Neuron compilers. Your work may span the frontend, intermediate representations, optimization passes, and code generation for the hardware.
- Own features from design through production: design, implement, test on hardware and simulation, and support customers.
- Work with Amazon ML teams (PyTorch, JAX, and internal model teams) to understand their workloads and unblock them.
- Give hardware teams compiler and programmability feedback on upcoming chips.
- Review code and designs, and mentor newer engineers.

A day in the life
You start the day reviewing a teammate's code for a new compiler feature, leaving feedback before it merges. Mid-morning, you work with a model team whose kernel isn't reaching peak performance on Trainium, and you trace the bottleneck through the compiler's passes. After lunch, you write and test the feature you designed last week, then run it on hardware to confirm correctness. The team moves quickly and you are always in the details.

About the team
We are the compiler teams behind AWS Neuron, the software that runs machine learning models on Amazon Trainium. Our ML compiler takes a full model from PyTorch or JAX and compiles the graph to run across the chip. The Neuron Kernel Interface (NKI) is a bare-metal language and compiler that lets customers program Trainium directly, down to the compute and memory, for a new operator or a faster kernel. Together we own the path from framework model to silicon. Our mission is to make Trainium fast and fully programmable.

Our teams are small and agile, and there is opportunity to learn all the time. We work closely with the hardware, runtime and framework teams, and with the Amazon ML teams who use our compilers.

Basic qualifications

- 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
- 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
- 1+ years of software development engineer or related occupational experience
- 1+ years of designing and developing large-scale, multi-tiered, multi-threaded, embedded or distributed software applications, tools, systems, and services using: C#, C++, Java, or Perl experience
- 1+ years of Object Oriented Design experience
- Bachelor's degree or foreign equivalent in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field
- Experience programming with at least one software programming language

Preferred qualifications

- 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
- Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

title: Sr. Specialist Solutions Architect, Containers & Application Modernization, Korea
descriptionHtml:
Containers now run some of the most demanding systems on AWS, from real-time payment processing to large-scale AI inference. As more companies move production workloads onto Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS), Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (Amazon EKS), AWS Fargate, and Amazon Elastic Container Registry (Amazon ECR), they face harder questions about scaling, cost, and security. They need architects who go deep. In this role you will help organizations answer those questions, and you will shape the container services they depend on.

You will reach customers and partners primarily through scale: workshops, reusable content, and enablement that help many organizations at once. Through these motions you will work closely with customers and partners, learning their requirements firsthand and turning them into production-ready architectures. You will bring that real-world feedback and usage data to product teams to influence feature development and future roadmaps. As a strategic technical leader in the field, you will provide architectural guidance that accelerates partner engagements while guiding an internal community of container subject matter experts.

Key job responsibilities
- Serve as a trusted technical advisor on containers, helping customers and partners design, build, and run production workloads on Amazon EKS, Amazon ECS, AWS Fargate, and Amazon ECR with a focus on security, cost efficiency, and reliability.
- Channel customer feedback and usage data to product teams to shape feature development and product roadmaps.
- As part of the container APJ go-to-market team, apply deep technical expertise to unblock customers' largest and most critical business challenges.
- Guide and support an AWS internal community of technical subject matter experts aligned to the containers domain.
- Develop reference architectures, guides, and workshops as repeatable, practical resources that scale enablement across the field and partners.

A day in the life
You will start your day reviewing a customer's current architecture and preparing recommendations for an upcoming design session. From there, you might lead a technical deep-dive with a customer's engineering team, walking through trade-offs for a migration strategy or evaluating how to integrate generative AI capabilities into their workflows. In the afternoon, you could be collaborating with internal teams to refine a proof of concept, mentoring a teammate on solution design patterns, or developing a workshop that helps customers adopt new services more effectively.

About the team
The Worldwide Specialist Organization (WWSO) is part of the AWS Specialist and Partner Organization. Specialists own the end-to-end go-to-market strategy for their respective technology domains, providing the business and technical expertise to help our customers succeed. Container adoption on AWS across APJ continues to accelerate, and the team is focused on expanding reference architectures, partner integrations, and field enablement programs to meet that demand. You will join a collaborative, technically deep group where your work directly shapes how customers run their most important workloads.

Basic qualifications

- 6+ years of infrastructure architecture, database architecture and networking experience
- 3+ years of design, implementation, or consulting in applications and infrastructures experience
- 6+ years of IT development or implementation/consulting in the software or Internet industries experience
- Korean fluency and Business level English

Preferred qualifications

- 5+ years of specific technology domain areas (e.g. software development, cloud computing, systems engineering, infrastructure, security, networking, data & analytics) experience
- Experience working with end user or developer communities
- Experience with presentations and speaking with executives, IT, management, and developers

title: Sr. Digital Supply Chain Associate, PV Publishing Ops
descriptionHtml:
We are looking for an Image Associate to join our team, specializing in image correction, editing, retouching, and quality assurance. The ideal candidate will have the ability to deliver clean, web-ready image assets based on existing style guides and brand guidelines in a fast-paced production environment.
This position requires strong image editing skills, color correction expertise, acute attention to detail, and an understanding of digital image optimization for web, mobile, and big-screen platforms. The ability to manage multiple projects and handle high-volume image queues is essential.
The candidate will have a comprehensive understanding of image correction processes and software - specifically Adobe Creative Suite (with a focus on Photoshop) along with experience in digital production workflows. A keen eye for visual quality and consistency, and excellent communication skills are a must. An online portfolio demonstrating image editing and correction work is required.

Key job responsibilities
• Perform image correction, retouching, color grading, exposure adjustment, and cropping to meet brand standards.
• Edit and enhance key art, promotional graphics, and product imagery for digital platforms.
• Optimize digital images for web, mobile, and big-screen display ensuring proper resolution, file format, and compression.
• Ensure all image deliverables adhere to product/project guidelines and brand style guides.
• Follow and apply graphic templates, style guides, and image specifications consistently.
• Manage high-volume image queues and fulfill multiple project requests while meeting tight deadlines.
• Conduct quality checks on all image assets to ensure visual consistency and accuracy across deliverables.
• Demonstrate a command of image editing methods, tools, communication, and presentation skills.

About the team
Prime Video is changing the way people watch movies and TV shows. From one service, we deliver versatility in numerous ways to watch hundreds of thousands of titles on the web, mobile devices, and hundreds of Internet-connected TVs, Blu-ray players, and set-top boxes.
Our mission is to be the premier destination for entertainment, offering customers an unmatched viewing experience across every screen and device.

Basic qualifications

- 1 to 3+ years of work experience in image editing, photo retouching, or graphic production in a creative agency or production environment.
- Bachelor’s degree in graphic design, Photography, Visual Arts, or equivalent professional experience.
- Proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite, with a strong focus on Adobe Photoshop.
- Solid understanding of image file formats (JPEG, PNG, TIFF, PSD) and web optimization techniques.
- Knowledge of color theory, image composition, and visual hierarchy.
- A portfolio demonstrating experience with image correction, retouching, and production-quality editing.
- Strong attention to detail with the ability to spot inconsistencies and quality issues.

Preferred qualifications

- Expert-level Adobe Photoshop and Lightroom skills with advanced retouching and compositing capabilities.
- Experience with batch image processing, automation (e.g., Photoshop Actions, scripting), and asset management workflows.
- Thorough knowledge of image correction workflows including color grading, skin retouching, background removal, and compositing.

You will have the opportunity to work on innovative, large-scale projects that push the boundaries of what's possible in sports content delivery and engagement. Your expertise will be crucial in tackling complex challenges such as information retrieval, sequential modeling, real-time model optimization, utilizing Large Language Models (LLMs), and building advanced recommender systems.

As a technologist, you will also drive the publication of original work in top-tier Machine Learning and Recommender Systems venues.

About the team
We're the Sports Science team behind personalization for live sports on Prime Video. We build custom deep learning models that predict what each customer wants to watch across live and upcoming events -- powering relevance and ranking at scale for one of the most dynamic, real-time personalization problems at Amazon. Our work spans the full stack: engineering, Transformer-based architectures, calibration, and low-latency serving in production. We own our models end to end, from research to deployment. title: Head of Programming Strategy, Prive Video Japan
descriptionHtml:
Prime Video is seeking a Head of Japan Programming Strategy to own the end-to-end programming strategy for one of Prime Video's largest and most strategically important streaming markets. Japan is a priority locale with a deep local slate, a distinctive competitive landscape, and globally significant content categories — most notably Anime — that reach audiences far beyond the domestic market.
This is a senior, strategy-led leadership role with a mandate to innovate. Its center of gravity is insights-led, forward-looking slate health planning — not just day-to-day scheduling. Your team will decide what Japan should be programming and investing in over the next 3–5 years and why, using audience and performance insights to steer the slate. Equally important, you will look for new ways to expand the reach of Japan programming — new audiences, categories, formats, and distribution and promotional approaches — and reinvent how the team works internally, adopting automation and AI-assisted tooling so the team spends its time on strategy rather than routine execution.
You will be the single-threaded owner for Japan programming, leading a team based in Japan and operating with a high degree of autonomy while ensuring Japan's work is tightly aligned to Global and APAC-wide mechanisms, standards, and priorities.


Key job responsibilities
Own the Japan programming strategy, weighted toward insights-led slate decisions — moving the team from "what airs when" to "what we should invest in and why."
Find new ways to expand the reach of Japan programming — identifying new audiences, categories, formats, and promotional and distribution approaches that grow engagement beyond the current slate and surface Japanese content to wider domestic and global audiences.
Innovate how the team works internally — reinventing programming workflows, mechanisms, and tooling (including automation and AI-assisted approaches) so the team shifts its time from routine reporting and coordination toward high-value strategy and insight.
Own slate health as a portfolio — balancing genres, categories, and title types to sustain engagement and retention, and proactively identifying gaps and over-indexes before they affect performance.
Map the Japan slate on a 3–5 year horizon, not just near-term calendar planning — enabling earlier, better-informed content and investment decisions and tighter alignment to global title strategy.
Drive rapid strategic pivots, re-orienting Japan's programming priorities and long-range strategic direction quickly as market dynamics, competitive moves, or global signals shift.
Fill calendar and slate gaps with hub programming solutions, drawing on APAC regional and global content (imports, worldwide categories such as Anime, cross-locale titles) to turn gaps into growth opportunities.
Lean into Anime and title-travelability ownership, aligning the team on travelability to drive measurable improvement in local Anime performance.
Partner cross-functionally — with Content/Studios, Marketing, Product, Customer Insights, Business Intelligence, and Finance — to align programming with launch, campaign, and business goals.
Define and track the KPIs that measure programming and slate-health effectiveness for Japan, and own regular performance reporting and the quarterly slate-health plan-of-record.


About the team
Prime Video Japan is one of Prime Video's largest and most strategically important markets in Global, with a deep local slate, a passionate and distinctive audience, and globally significant content categories — most notably Anime — that resonate far beyond Japan. The Japan programming team shapes what Japanese customers watch and discover, combining strong local expertise with a direct connection to regional and global programming initiatives. As Head of Japan Programming Strategy, you will lead a team as it evolves from an execution-focused group into a strategy-led, innovation-minded organization — deepening its use of audience insights, owning the long-range health of the Japan slate, finding new ways to grow programming reach, and reinventing how the team works day to day.

Basic qualifications

- Experience in managing and developing teams
- Bachelor's degree in a relevant field or equivalent work experience
- Speak, write, and read fluently in Japanese at a business level or above (N1+)
- Speak, write, and read fluently in English
- 10+ years of experience in programming, content strategy, slate planning, or a closely related media/streaming/strategy planning discipline.

Preferred qualifications

- Experience in audience segmentation and targeting
- Experience working with global and cross-functional teams across business development, marketing, operations, product development and legal
- Experience influencing multiple stakeholders and leading cross functional teams across geographies and business units
- Experience with long-range (multi-year) content or slate strategy, not solely near-term scheduling.
- Deep familiarity with the Japan media/entertainment market and audience.

title: Senior Product Manager Tech, PV Partner Experience
descriptionHtml:
Prime Video is a first-stop entertainment destination offering customers a vast collection of premium programming in one app available across thousands of devices. Prime members can customize their viewing experience and find their favorite movies, series, documentaries, and live sports – including Amazon MGM Studios-produced series and movies; licensed fan favorites; and programming from Prime Video add-on subscriptions such as Apple TV+, Max, Crunchyroll and MGM+. All customers, regardless of whether they have Prime membership or not, can rent or buy titles via the Prime Video Store, and can enjoy even more content for free with ads.

Are you interested in shaping the future of entertainment? Do you want to invent, disrupt and redefine what entertainment means for fans, creators, and communities all around the globe?

As part of the Prime Video team, you’ll get to work on projects that are fast-paced, challenging, and varied. Also, you’ll get to experiment with new possibilities, take risks, and collaborate with remarkable people.

We’ll look for you to bring your diverse perspectives, ideas, and skill sets to make Prime Video even better for our customers. With global opportunities for talented creatives, technologists, marketing professionals and so much more, you can decide where a career with Prime Video takes you!

Prime Video's Partner Experience team builds the platform that 10,000+ content partners depend on to deliver, promote, measure, and grow on Prime Video. We're looking for a Technical Sr. Product Manager to identify and own our highest-leverage partner-facing product opportunities, from zero to one.

This is a high-autonomy role for someone who thrives in ambiguity. You define the roadmap. You'll find the biggest unsolved problems for partners and customers, build conviction around the solution, and ship it. One quarter that might mean defining how partners monetize and measure content through ads; the next, extending platform capabilities to entirely new partner verticals. What stays constant is the expectation you move fast, go deep, and deliver outsized impact.

You are deeply curious, the kind of product leader who digs into partner economics, content supply chains, and ad tech with equal enthusiasm. You're comfortable representing Prime Video directly to senior partner stakeholders and translating their needs into products that scale.



Key job responsibilities
Meet directly with content partners to understand their business models, pain points, and growth ambitions; then translate insights into scalable product strategies.

Operate as a "builder PM": conduct deep partner discovery, frame the opportunity, define the product vision, build and test user experiences, drive cross-functional execution from 0 to 1.

Speak the language of developers; dive into data, logs, or basic code concepts to unblock your team and accelerate delivery.

Define success metrics, instrument them, and use data to iterate rapidly and make crisp prioritization decisions.

Represent Prime Video externally at partner meetings, industry forums, and executive reviews; positioning us as the most innovative and transparent distributor in streaming.

Leverage AI/ML and emerging technologies to accelerate discovery, prototyping, and delivery.

Influence product and engineering roadmaps without direct authority, building alignment through compelling narratives and data-driven proposals.

Basic qualifications

- Experience contributing to engineering discussions around technology decisions and strategy related to a product
- 5+ years of technical product or program management experience
- 3+ years of end to end product delivery experience
- Bachelor's degree
- Experience with feature delivery and tradeoffs of a product
- Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition
- Experience managing technical products or online services

title: Program Manager, Central Operations Standardization and Cost Out (COSC) team
descriptionHtml:
Central Operations (Ops) JP is looking for a Program Manager with a strong record of achieving results, to execute and scale the Cost Out framework for the Central Operations Standardization and Cost Out (COSC) team. The COSC team is dedicated to driving operational excellence across Central Operations by establishing robust mechanisms, delivering data-driven insights, and accelerating high-impact programs.

You will execute the Cost Out framework that turns CO's program impact into registered, auditable dollar value in partnership with Finance. You will help close this gap by driving entitlement calculation standardization, partnering directly with Finance counterparts for regular reviews, and enabling 50+ program managers to self-adopt entitlement practices through toolkits and guidance.

You will work cross-functionally with stakeholders across CO functions and Finance to understand, implement, and improve cost-out programs and financial governance. This role offers the opportunity to partner closely with multiple functions and teams including program management, finance, delivery station operations, last mile tech, planning, ACES, and more in Amazon Logistics (AMZL). Such exposure and collaboration with a variety of teams allow opportunities for further career growth within Amazon and beyond.

You will actively solve problems ranging from immediate challenges to long-term programs. You will manage multiple workstreams, own schedules, outline key milestones, and ensure deliverables are met. The work balances between working independently and influencing other stakeholders to drive alignment and execution.

At Amazon, you'll work alongside the latest AI and GenAI tools that are increasingly woven into how teams operate: from AI-powered capabilities that accelerate decision-making, to Generative AI that helps you focus on work that truly matters. You'll have opportunities and resources to develop AI fluency at your own pace, with continuous learning built into the culture.

Key job responsibilities
- Execute the entitlement framework inside CO covering three phases of each initiation: entitlement calculation standardization, commitment (Finance and ACES sign-off), and measure & report (actual vs. planned tracking with PVA monitoring)
- Partner directly with Finance counterparts: prepare and drive bi-weekly review sessions to centralize new/ad-hoc entitlement topics, avoiding siloed communication between CO functions and Finance
- Develop, launch, and maintain the entitlement calculation toolkit that enables program managers to self-adopt — translating program metrics to DPH/TPPH and then to dollar value based on Finance guidelines
- Support entitlement calculation standardization across CO, coaching functional PMs on consistent methodology and addressing gaps where different PMs use different logic
- Own post-launch tracking of entitlement, ensuring realized cost savings are monitored against planned values and lessons learned are captured as a knowledge pool
- Drive the registration of CO's cost savings in financial reports by preparing documentation, coordinating with Finance for validation, and maintaining accurate records
- Support OP-level entitlement reviews during OP finalization phases, ensuring all program entitlements are documented and validated with Finance
- Identify, assess, and mitigate risks in cost-out workstreams; escalate critical issues proactively and propose corrective actions to keep initiatives on track
- Recommend data-driven solutions, lead pilot tests to assess program impact, and expand refined SOPs to operational teams

A day in the life
You prepare the agenda and materials for the bi-weekly Finance review meeting, consolidating new and ad-hoc entitlement topics from across CO's functions. You partner with a functional PM to walk through their program's entitlement calculation, coaching them on how to translate their routing improvement metrics into dollar value using the standardized framework. You deep-dive into a post-launch PVA gap, investigating why a program's realized savings differ from the planned entitlement and documenting the lesson learned in the knowledge pool. You update the entitlement tracking dashboard to ensure leadership has accurate visibility into registered vs. unregistered cost savings. You coordinate with ACES and Finance during OP finalization to ensure all program entitlements are reviewed and documented. You will continuously find new problems to solve and be required to partner with teams across Japan and the globe to deliver for our customers. You take business trips within and outside Japan on a need basis to build your skills, network, and to gain insights from other regions and bring and export best practices to and from Japan.

About the team
About Central Ops JP team:
The Central Ops JP team is a back office team remotely supporting AMZL, SSD, AMXL, and Quick Commerce operations across Japan. Our four pillars are standardization, optimization, centralization, and innovation. We offer a variety of services such as route plan, scheduling, volume adjustment, on-road management, system configuration, and risk mitigation. We remove the gemba's burden so they can focus on what matters most under the roof for station associates and on the road for our drivers. We are a diverse and inclusive team offering great opportunities for career growth.

About COSC team:
The Standardization and Cost Out (COSC) team exists to drive operational excellence across Central Operations by establishing robust mechanisms, delivering data-driven insights, and accelerating high-impact programs. COSC operates across three pillars — Metrics & KPI, Cost Out, and Program Standardization & Tech — serving as the backbone that ensures CO's 50+ program managers perform with a high bar, CO's impact is measured and registered in financial reports, and CO's operations are guided by clear, controllable metrics connected to AMZL goals.

Basic qualifications

- 2+ years of program or project management experience
- Experience working in an analytical environment with cross-functional teams
- Bachelor's degree or equivalent
- Speak, write, and read fluently in English

Preferred qualifications

- Experience with SQL
- Speak, write, and read fluently in Japanese

title: EasyShip プログラムサポートスペシャリスト, Easy Ship, AMZL
descriptionHtml:
[English followed by Japanese]

役割概要

プログラムマネジメント（PM）チームの日常的な業務運営、事務管理、レポーティング、データ分析、およびデータ管理活動をサポートし、細部に注意を払い、主体的に行動できるプログラムサポートスペシャリストを募集しています。本ポジションは、PMが戦略的なプログラム推進に集中できるよう、チームの業務およびデータ基盤を管理する重要な役割です。

主な職務内容
レポーティング＆データサポート
PMチーム向けの週次/月次ビジネスレポートおよびダッシュボードの作成、維持、配信
複数のソースからデータを収集、クリーニング、整理を行い、プログラムのトラッキングおよびレビューをサポート
プログラムのマイルストーン、成果物、アクションアイテムに関するトラッカー（Excel、Quip、社内ツール等）の構築および維持管理の支援
PMの要望に応じた臨時データ抽出およびサマリーの作成

データ分析
プログラムおよび業務データにおけるトレンド、パターン、異常値を特定するための初級～中級レベルのデータ分析の実施
ビジネスレビュー（WBR、MBR、QBR）に向けたデータに基づくインサイトの準備においてPMを支援
ピボットテーブル、チャート、ビジュアルサマリーを作成し、生データを実用的なインサイトに変換
データの不整合に対する根本原因分析を実施し、PMに問題を先回りして指摘・エスカレーションする
定期レビューサイクル向けの標準化された分析テンプレートの構築および維持管理
複数のソースからデータを収集・統合し、構造化された形式で調査結果を提示することで、ディープダイブ分析を支援

データ管理
チームレベルのトラッカー、データベース、共有リポジトリにおけるデータの正確性・整合性の維持に一貫して責任を持つ
チームファイル全体にわたるデータ入力基準、命名規則、バージョン管理プロトコルの策定および徹底
重複、欠損、不整合を特定するための定期的なデータ監査の実施
共有データフォルダ、Wiki、ナレッジリポジトリのアクセス権限管理および整理
PMの指示に基づくデータ移行、統合、およびアーカイブ作業の支援
主要プログラムメトリクスおよび業務データの信頼できる唯一の情報源（Single Source of Truth / SSOT）の維持管理
プログラムトラッキングのためのタイムリーかつ正確なデータ入力を確保するための部門横断チームとの連携

事務サポート
定例会議（WBR、MBR、プログラムレビュー）のスケジュール調整、運営管理（アジェンダ作成および議事録を含む）
チームドキュメント、Wiki、共有ドライブの整理整頓および最新状態の維持管理
新規チームメンバーのオンボーディングロジスティクス支援（アクセス申請、ツールセットアップ、オリエンテーションのスケジュール調整）
必要に応じた発注書、調達申請、ベンダー関連書類の処理
チームレベルのコミュニケーション、配信リスト、カレンダー調整の管理

プログラム運営サポート
レビューからのオープンアクションアイテムをトラッキングし、期限超過アイテムをPMにエスカレーション
複数のワークストリームにわたるプログラムタイムラインおよびステータス更新の維持管理
ビジネスドキュメント（BRD、ステータスアップデート、ステークホルダー向けプレゼン資料）の作成およびフォーマッティングの支援
ステークホルダーへのフォローアップによる、プログラム成果物に対する部門横断インプットの調整

ビジネス＆プロセス改善
繰り返し発生するプロセスの効率化機会を特定し、シンプルな自動化またはテンプレートソリューションを提案
チームSOP、テンプレート、レポーティングフォーマットの標準化を支援
チームイベント、オフサイト、ナレッジシェアリングセッションの企画運営を支援

Role Summary:
We are looking for a detail-oriented and proactive Program Support Specialist to support the Program Management team, in day-to-day operational, administrative, reporting, data analysis, and data management activities. This role is critical in enabling PMs to focus on strategic program delivery by managing the operational and data backbone of the team.

Key Responsibilities:
Reporting & Data Support:
• Prepare, maintain, and distribute weekly/monthly business reports and dashboards for the PM team.
• Collect, clean, and organize data from multiple sources to support program tracking and reviews.
• Assist in building and maintaining trackers (e.g., Excel, Quip, internal tools) for program milestones, deliverables, and action items.
• Generate ad-hoc data pulls and summaries as requested by PMs.

Data Analysis:
• Perform basic to intermediate data analysis to identify trends, patterns, and anomalies in program and operational data.
• Support PMs in preparing data-backed insights for business reviews (WBRs, MBRs, QBRs).
• Create pivot tables, charts, and visual summaries to translate raw data into actionable insights.
• Conduct root cause analysis on data discrepancies and flag issues proactively to PM owners.
• Build and maintain standardized analysis templates for recurring review cycles.
• Support deep-dive analysis by compiling data from multiple sources and presenting findings in a structured format.

Data Management:
• Own the end-to-end data hygiene and integrity of team-level trackers, databases, and shared repositories.
• Establish and enforce data entry standards, naming conventions, and version control protocols across team files.
• Perform regular data audits to identify duplicates, missing entries, and inconsistencies.
• Manage access permissions and organization of shared data folders, wikis, and knowledge repositories.
• Support data migration, consolidation, and archival activities as directed by PMs.
• Maintain a single source of truth (SSOT) for key program metrics and operational data.
• Coordinate with cross-functional teams to ensure timely and accurate data inputs for program tracking.

Administrative Support:
• Schedule, coordinate, and manage recurring meetings (WBRs, MBRs, program reviews) including agenda preparation and meeting notes.
• Maintain team documentation, wikis, and shared drives in an organized and up-to-date manner.
• Support onboarding logistics for new team members (access requests, tool setup, orientation scheduling).
• Process purchase orders, procurement requests, and vendor-related paperwork as needed.
• Manage team-level communications, distribution lists, and calendar coordination.

Program Operations Support:
• Track open action items from reviews and escalate overdue items to the PM owners.
• Maintain program timelines and status updates across multiple workstreams.
• Support the creation and formatting of business documents (BRDs, status updates, stakeholder decks).
• Coordinate cross-functional inputs for program deliverables by following up with stakeholders.

Business & Process Improvement:
• Identify opportunities to streamline repetitive processes and propose simple automation or template solutions.
• Support standardization of team SOPs, templates, and reporting formats.
• Assist in organizing team events, offsites, and knowledge-sharing sessions.

Basic qualifications

- プログラムマネジメントまたはオペレーション環境での1年以上の実務経験
- データ抽出およびデータ処理における1年以上のハンズオン経験
- Microsoft Excelの熟練（ピボットテーブル、VLOOKUP、条件付き書式、基本関数、チャート）
- データクリーニング、データ整理、構造化されたデータセットの維持管理の実務経験
- 優れた文書および口頭でのコミュニケーション能力
- 複数のタスクを同時に管理し、期限を遵守する能力
- データ処理およびレポーティングにおける高い注意力と正確性
- 日本語ビジネスレベル（JLPT N2相当）必須（日本拠点向け業務のため）

title: Operations Manager, Fulfilment Center Operations
descriptionHtml:
Our WW Operations network delivers millions of packages and smiles to Amazon customers every day. We are looking for motivated, customer-focused individuals who want to join our team as an Operations Manager. In this role, you will lead and develop a team of salaried and hourly talent. You will be responsible for engaging your team during their shifts to maintain the highest levels of safety, quality, attendance, and performance. To achieve this, managers are expected to provide their team with the tools needed for success while driving improvements in productivity and efficiency through data-driven decisions and analytical problem-solving. You will also play a key role in maintaining our customer expectations to ensure customer orders are delivered at the right time, to the right location.
Our Operation’s workflow has three major components: First mile - where the product is housed and ready for order; Middle mile - where the order is hauled to your area; and Last mile - when the product is delivered to the customer’s door. Please note that all workflows have slight building variations, but one thing is constant: our vision and dedication to the customer.

Key job responsibilities
- Support, mentor, and motivate your leadership across different levels
- Lead large-scope projects with site and regional impact
- Build and execute productivity plans through forecast reviews, determining productivity requirements, and partnering with other Leaders to load balance
- Manage safety, quality, productivity, and customer delivery promises
- Collaborate with all support teams including Safety, Engineering, Loss Prevention, Quality Assurance, Human Resources to develop plans to meet business objectives

A day in the life
As an Operations Manager, you will play a critical role in driving your team’s success. You’ll oversee performance across your department, setting clear expectations and ensuring each team member has the right tools and resources to achieve their goals. Your role goes beyond day-to-day execution — you’ll partner with site leadership, regional stakeholders, and support teams to remove obstacles, influence decisions, and deliver results at scale. This is an opportunity to lead with impact, empower your team, and shape the future of our operations.

About the team
A home grown leadership team, built on strong Amazon standards and driven by a high bar of excellence. We operate as one team, united in our mission to build a best-in-class Center of Excellence in operations. Together, we foster an environment of trust, collaboration, and ownership, where leaders and associates can thrive. As we continue raising the bar, we remain committed to Amazon’s vision of becoming Earth’s Best Employer.

Basic qualifications

- 3+ years of employee and performance management experience
- Bachelor's degree or equivalent
- 3+ years of defining and implementing process improvement initiatives using data and metrics experience
- Work flexible schedules/shifts/areas, including weekends, nights, and/or holidays

Preferred qualifications

- Experience leading large-scale programs/projects
- Master's degree, or MBA in supply chain management, operations, engineering, analytics or related field

title: シフトアシスタント
descriptionHtml:
※このポジションの勤務地は東京都府中市を予定しています。

私たちのグローバルオペレーションネットワークは、日々何百万もの荷物と笑顔をアマゾンのお客様にお届けしています。私たちは、シフトアシスタントとして私たちのチームに加わってほしいと考え、意欲的で顧客重視の人材を探しています。この役割では他業種・職種も含めこれまでの経験、スキルを活かし、改善点を模索しながら、より便利でお客様に満足いただける高い品質のサービスを提供できるビジネスをつくる事、安全・快適・楽しい職場環境の構築を行う、将来の組織のリーダーを目指していただける事を期待しています。また、お客様の注文が適切な時間に適切な場所へ確実に配送されるよう、お客様の期待に応えることにおいても重要な役割を担います。

私たちの業務の流れには3つの主要な要素があります。
商品が保管され注文に備える「ファーストマイル」、注文品をお客様のエリアまで輸送する「ミドルマイル」、そして商品をお客様の玄関先までお届けする「ラストマイル」です。各拠点で運営方法に若干の違いはありますが、一貫して変わらないものが一つあります、それは顧客を第一に考える私たちのビジョンと献身的な姿勢です。

本ポジションはアマゾンの新しいエキサイティングな配送拠点で業務を行います。可能な限り最速でお客様のご自宅に商
品をお届けすることでお客様のカスタマーエクスペリエンスを向上します。私たちと一緒に歴史をつくりましょう！


■業務内容■
具体的にはマネージャーのサポートのもと、以下の業務に責任をもち遂行いただきます。

① 安全・品質・作業効率の向上
安全安心な作業環境の維持・向上のため、日々の安全活動、品質チェックに加え、標準作業手順書の作成や多岐にわたる問題解決・改善活動を行います。

② 日々のオペレーション対応
商品を入荷、在庫として管理し、注文があった商品を出荷するという一連の流れを各工程間で連携をとりながら、業務を円滑に進める事が求められます。お客様とお約束した期日までに商品を迅速かつ正確にお届けするため、時間ごとの計画に沿ってオペレーションを実施することに責任を持ちます。

③ 新規プロジェクトの導入・セール時など、オペレーション拡大時の準備
新しいサービスやシステムの導入に備え、現場での手順変更・導入方法を検討し円滑な導入に向けて準備を行います。また、新規入職者でもAmazonの標準作業に則った手順がスムーズに身につくためのトレーニング構築やマニュアルを作成します。

④ イレギュラーへの対応
作業で発生する様々な課題の原因を追求し問題解決を行います。また、再発防止策案の検討、実施を行います。
※上記業務はマネージャーやチームのサポートのもと実施していただきます
※配送ステーション内での配送を通じて、物流の仕組みやマネジメントについて学ぶことができます
※社内公募により、マネージャーへのキャリアアップや他部署への異動機会もあります
※勤務は交代制（夜勤あり）です
※1日の流れ：以下ページをご参照ください。
先輩社員インタビュー

■福利厚生■
下記ページをご確認ください。
福利厚生 | アマゾンジャパンキャリアサイト

■教育制度■
入社後、約1週間はAmazonのリーダーとして必要な会社のカルチャーや、配送拠点の基本的な業務を一通り学ぶことができる座学の機会を提供します。各部署へ配属後は、トレーナーのもと、OJTで工程知識やツールの使用方法など基礎知識を学んでいきます。トレーニング資料も完備しており、相互に進捗を確認しながら独り立ちまでしっかりとサポートしますので、未経験者も安心してスタートができる環境です。
最先端の物流システムを学ぶことはもちろん、年齢・性別・国籍問わず様々な仲間と日々の業務を通して、次のステップとなるピープルマネージメントやビジネススキルを学ぶことができます。

■キャリアパス■
シフトアシスタントからキャリアをスタートし、チームマネージャー、統括マネージャー、そして配送拠点の拠点長となった実績も多数あります。また、Amazonでは社内公募制度があり、国内外問わず他部署や異なる職種への異動にチャレンジし、社内で多様なキャリアを築くチャンスもあります。Amazonではご自身で学び成長することを推奨し、キャリア開発できるようサポートを行っています。
キャリアアップストーリー

■会社のカルチャー■
Amazonでは全員がリーダーです。個人の裁量に任される部分が多く、社員の個々の可能性を最大限に伸ばす事を重視しています。様々なバックグラウンドを持った社員が前職で培った多様な経験やスキルを活かして職位や役割に関わらず誰もがチャレンジできる環境です。
また年次有給休暇の取得を積極的に推進しており「働く」、「プライベート」も充実できる環境です。
失敗に寛容な文化：まずは試してみることにこだわります。好奇心を持って学びます。時にはリスクを取り、計画通りいかなかったとしても、よりよい成果に繋げられることが私たちの強みだと信じています。

最後に、募集しているポジションや組織、お仕事の詳細については以下のリンクよりご確認いただけます。

・配送拠点で働くリーダーのインタビュー：インタビューをご覧ください。

title: Bereichsleiter Logistik, Last Mile - Operations
descriptionHtml:
Der operative Geschäftsbereich ist das Herz von Amazon. Dieser wesentliche Teil unseres Unternehmens sorgt dafür, dass wir Bestellungen effizient versenden, damit unsere Kund:innen ihre Artikel rechtzeitig erhalten. Als Area Manager:in sorgst Du dafür, dass alle Abläufe an Deinem Standort so reibungslos wie möglich funktionieren, damit wir die Kundennachfrage erfüllen können. Du führst ein Team, das für die Sicherheit, Effizienz und erstklassige Qualität unserer Betriebsabläufe sorgt. Zusätzlich leitest Du eine Reihe von Projekten in unserem gesamten Netzwerk, um die Produktivität zu fördern.

Key job responsibilities
- Erschaffen, Beaufsichtigen und Fördern einer Kultur der Sicherheit und des Wohlbefindens
- Analyse und Umsetzung von Änderungen, um fortlaufend hohe Qualität und Produktivität zu gewährleisten
- Beaufsichtigung von Projekten zur Verschlankung von Prozessen, Optimierung der Produktivität und Verbesserung der Servicequalität für Kund:innen in Deinem Verantwortungsbereich
- Analyse der Schichten laut Unternehmensvorgaben und Umsetzung von Maßnahmen zur Verbesserung unserer Operational Excellence
- Zusammenarbeit mit Kolleg:innen auf Führungsebene, um Schichtverfahren zu vereinheitlichen

A day in the life
Du arbeitest im Schichtbetrieb an einem unserer Standorte und sorgst dafür, dass die dortigen Abläufe so produktiv wie möglich sind. Schwerpunkt Deiner Tätigkeit ist die Leitung und Förderung einer Sicherheitskultur sowie die Aufrechterhaltung der Qualität und der Leistungsstandards der Arbeitsschichten. Du beaufsichtigst außerdem die Prozessverbesserungen in Deinem Bereich und organisierst die Umsetzung. Ein typischer Arbeitstag kann ganz unterschiedlich aussehen und umfasst sowohl routinemäßiges Teammanagement und tägliche Betriebsaufgaben als auch Prozessverbesserung und weitreichende operative Aufgaben für den Eventualfall. Außerdem agierst Du als Vorbild und Mentor für neue Manager:innen.

About the team
Amazon Logistik (AMZL) ist für die Auslieferung von Millionen von Produkten unserer Kunden und Kundinnen direkt an die Haustür verantwortlich. Die „Last-Mile-Logistik" liefert unsere Pakete in Partnerschaft mit Drittanbietern und realisiert zahlreiche Initiativen zur kontinuierlichen Verbesserung, um Millionen von Kunden zufrieden zu stellen.

Unser Ziel ist es, das Liefererlebnis für unsere Kund:innen so reibungslos wie möglich zu machen und globale Lieferlösungen für unsere neuesten Angebote einzuführen, darunter Amazon Fresh, Prime Now und Amazon Restaurants.

Unsere Arbeit lässt sich in zwei Sparten unterteilen. „Under the Roof" betrifft alles was innerhalb unserer Logistikstandorte passiert und „On the Road" alles was in den Liefergebieten auf der Straße stattfindet. Unsere Mitarbeitenden bereiten die Pakete in entsprechenden Schichten (Nacht, Früh, Spät) auf den täglichen Versand an unsere Lieferteams vor und kümmern sich um Retouren, die nicht ausgeliefert werden konnten.

Jedes Jahr setzen wir neue Maßstäbe in puncto Kundenerlebnis und bieten neue, innovative Lieferdienste an. Wir suchen nach neuen Möglichkeiten, um branchenweite Logistikherausforderungen zu überwinden, sowie nach neuen Ideen, um unseren CO2-Fußabdruck zu reduzieren. Ein Fuhrpark innovativer Fahrzeuge (einschließlich E-Fahrzeugen) und modernste Technologie unterstützen uns dabei.

Basic qualifications

- Studienabschluss oder gleichwertige Qualifikation
- Erfahrung in der Führung und Entwicklung von Teams in einem operativen oder vergleichbaren Umfeld
- Erfahrung in der Kommunikation mit verschiedenen Stakeholdern, einschließlich funktionsübergreifender Teams und Führungskräfte
- Erfahrung in der Nutzung qualitativer und quantitativer Daten zur Unterstützung geschäftlicher Entscheidungen
- Englisch und Deutsch jeweils auf C1-Niveau (CEFR — Gemeinsamer Europäischer Referenzrahmen) in Wort und Schrift

Preferred qualifications

- Erfahrung in der Arbeit mit Lean, SixSigma und Kaizen-Methoden
- Erfahrung mit der Arbeit in einem anderen Logistikumfeld
- Erfahrung in der Arbeit mit der MS Office Suite (Word, Excel, Outlook) im beruflichen Umfeld

title: E2E L&TD-Learning Exp Manager, Learning and Talent Development (E2E L&TD)
descriptionHtml:
➣ 職務概要
Amazonのミッションは、地球上で最もお客様を大切にする企業になることです。E2E Learning and Talent Development (E2E L&TD) チームでは、Associate Trainingをリードする、Learning Experience Managerを募集しています。

➣ 求められる人物像
・オペレーションを深く理解している。
・自分だけで決定できる権限がなくても、業務をリードすることに抵抗がない。
・People Managerとして、遠隔地で勤務するチームメンバーの目標設定や支援ができる。
・口頭および文書でのコミュニケーションを効果的にまとめ上げ、それぞれにおいて適切な意見交換の場を設けることができる。
・複雑な情報を簡素化し、実行可能な計画を組み立てられる。
・個人とグループの能力開発におけるニーズを、評価することができる。
・複数業務の両立を図り、優先順位をつけることができる。
・カスタマーやステークホルダーに対し、積極的な態度と存在感を維持することができる。
・複数のチーム間で目標や目的を定め、伝達することができる。
・効果的にフィードバックを与えると同時に、受けることができ、円滑にコミュニケーションができる。
・ビジネスレベルの日本語力

➣ 役割について
Learning Experience Managerは、オペレーションをサポートし、日々の学習体制が問題なく運営されているかを監督します。ネットワーク標準学習プログラムが、確実に実施され、一貫して活用されるようにします。Learning Experience Managerは、定められたベンチマーク基準の達成、パフォーマンスを維持・向上させるための行動の監査・実施をリードします。このポジションは、最寄りの拠点をベースとし、必要に応じて各拠点に出張 (25-50%)して業務にあたります。
責任範囲の担当拠点は、着任後に決めますが、日本全国に部下となるメンバーが所属しているため、拠点間を巡回しながらサポートを提供します。

具体的な業務は、以下の通りです。
・アソシエイトのオンボーディング教育、トレーニング、指導のレベルを引き上げ、成功に導く。
・Amazon Flex デリバリーパートナーが配達に慣れるよう、オンボーディングプロセスを改良し、成功に導く。
・学習体験をより良くするために、データを追跡し、傾向を分析し、理解する。
・チームの重要な指標を担当地区で管理・推進する。
・日々の生産目標を理解し、学習体制を足掛かりとして活用して、安全・品質・生産性を向上させる標準作業を実施する。
・主要なステークホルダー（オペレーション）から意見を収集し、結果をまとめ、報告をする。
・担当地域のトレーニングプログラム（LogOn）が遂行されているか、管理する。
・チームが作成したトレーニングプログラムの実施に際して、現場でサポートする。
・必要に応じて、トレーニングセッションを調整・推進する。
・安全道場とトレーニング領域の監査、オンサイトでの立ち上げサポートのためのラーニング要件の確認・実行補助。
・E2E L&TD組織全体が強みと機会を特定できるよう、フィードバックを収集するための方法を管理する。

Amazonでは、最新のAI Tool, 生成AIを日々の業務の中に積極的に取り入れています。
AI Toolは私たちの意思決定のスピードを加速させ、私たちを本当に重要な「判断」と「議論」に集中させることを可能にしています。Amazon では学習を継続する文化が根付いているため、ご自身のペースでAIに関する知識を深めることができるリソースが用意されています。

Basic qualifications

- ・ビジネスレベルの日本語
- ・3-5年以上のPeople Managementの経験
- ・定量データをベースに改善したことがある経験

Preferred qualifications

- ・ビジネスレベルの英語
- ・遠隔拠点で活躍する部下を育成した経験
- ・ステークホルダーマネジメントの経験

descriptionHtml:

The ideal candidate possesses strong attention to detail, efficiently prioritizes tasks, demonstrates a willingness to learn, and maintains a commitment to delighting our customers.

What it’s like at our site(s):
1. Safety. Your safety is important to us, so we provide safe working conditions.
2. Surroundings. You'll be working in retail warehouse environment with various equipment– shopping carts, pallet jacks, stock dollies, and a variety of products, including food and alcoholic beverages. You'll also interact with our digital shopping technology.
3. Activity. Work involves frequent movement between different areas, standing while conducting most tasks, and some lifting. You may need to reach into coolers or freezers.
4. Noise level. Sound levels are minimal, what one would expect in a retail warehouse environment.
5. Dress code. Relaxed, with a few rules to follow for safety. Comfortable, slip-resistant, closed-toe shoes are also required for safety. Additional protective and visibility gear may be required.
6. New site opening: If you’re applying to a site that hasn’t opened yet, you’ll help prepare the team for its first customer orders. This may include tasks like setting up shelving and unloading product deliveries. You’ll also have an extended training and onboarding period, which may be at a nearby Amazon site.

title: Site EHS Manager II
descriptionHtml:
Join Amazon’s mission to become Earth’s safest place to work! At Amazon, we’ve set the ambitious goal to become the benchmark of safety excellence across all industries in which we operate. We're seeking a dedicated Workplace Health & Safety (WHS) Manager to join our mission of creating the world's safest work environment. This role offers an exciting opportunity to directly impact associate well being while driving operational excellence.

As a WHS Manager, you'll be the site's safety champion, leading our Global WHS Program implementation. You'll combine hands-on safety management with strategic thinking to protect our most valuable asset – our people. Your role bridges the gap between safety requirements and operational success, requiring both technical expertise and strong interpersonal skills. Working closely with Operations leadership, you'll drive safety initiatives that make a real difference. You'll conduct comprehensive risk assessments, analyze safety data, and implement practical solutions that protect associates while supporting productivity. Your ability to build relationships and influence positive change will be essential as you help shape our safety culture. You'll lead safety compliance efforts, conduct thorough site audits, and analyze incident trends to target improvements where they matter most. Managing our first aid program and emergency response capabilities, you'll ensure immediate care is always available. Your analytical skills will transform safety data into actionable insights, while your leadership abilities will help engage associates in our safety mission.

Core Impact Areas:
Safety Leadership & Innovation - Transform safety culture through leadership and innovative solutions. Drive continuous improvement initiatives that set new benchmarks in workplace safety. Leverage technology and data analytics to drive preventive safety measures that protect our associates while enhancing operational excellence. Develop leadership plans, communicate expectations, and drive initiatives to create a safe work environment. Measure performance against WHS policies, analyze metrics, and conduct site audits to address non-compliance issues.

Strategic Partnership & Influence - Build partnerships with Operations leadership to integrate safety into every aspect of our business. Use compelling data analysis and risk insights to influence positive change and drive strategic decision-making. Establish yourself as a trusted advisor who balances safety excellence with operational demands. Oversee recordkeeping, workplace organization, and WHS training programs.

Additional Job Elements include:
- Lift up to 49 pounds and frequently push, pull, squat, bend, and reach
- Stand/walk for up to 12 hours during shifts
- Work in an environment where the noise level varies
- Work in an environment that is subject to variable temperatures and weather (delivery stations include outside loading departments)
- Continuously climb and descend stairs (applies to sites with stairs)
- Maintain effective care delivery in emergencies and assist emergency response at the site

For those that do not have an adult First Aid, CPR, AED certification from the American Heart Association or American Red Cross, must obtain within 3 weeks of start date.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree, or 2+ years of Amazon (blue badge/FTE) experience
- 3+ years of increasing responsibilities in WHS and/or environmental programs in manufacturing, production, or service operations
- 3+ years of increasing responsibilities in people and performance management, or 2+ years of Amazon Safety (blue badge/FTE) experience

title: Software Development Manager, GREF Tech
descriptionHtml:
The Amazon Travel & Events (AT&E) Tech team, part of Finance Automation, is driving a multi-year transformation of the end-to-end Travel & Expense experience for over 500,000 Amazon employees across 64 countries. We are consolidating previously fragmented travel, events, payments, and expense systems into a unified, AI-powered experience within AtoZ, organized around four interconnected modules: Plan, Book, Pay, and Expense. Our platform leverages machine learning, natural language processing, and GenAI to deliver context-aware policy guidance, proactive compliance recommendations, fraud detection, and sustainability intelligence embedded into employee workflows. The transformation eliminates significant administrative burden across the organization while delivering substantial cost savings and recovering employee productivity at scale.

We are seeking a Software Development Manager (SDM) to lead the development of new services that power the end-to-end travel and expense experience for Amazonians worldwide. You will build and ship solutions across the Plan, Book, Pay, and Expense modules — integrating AI capabilities such as intelligent policy guidance, automated expense categorization, and GenAI-driven workflows into production systems that must work reliably across 64 countries, multiple currencies, and diverse regulatory environments.

You will partner closely with Product Managers, Software Development Engineers (SDEs), Front-End Engineers (FEEs), and Applied Scientists to translate the platform vision into scalable, high-quality services that simplify how employees travel, host events, and manage expenses.

The ideal candidate will have extensive experience building and leading teams of software engineers, front-end engineers, and technical program managers, with a proven track record of delivering enterprise-level systems at scale. They will be a strategic thinker who hires and develops exceptional talent, sets clear goals tied to organizational impact, and independently manages both day-to-day execution and long-term roadmap priorities — fostering a high-performance, team-oriented culture.

Key job responsibilities
As a Software Development Manager, you will:

Technical Leadership & Innovation Shape architectural decisions for next-generation Travel & Expense systems and services that process sensitive financial and employee data across 64 countries Drive adoption of AI technologies — including agentic AI, LLMs, and ML-powered pattern detection — to transform manual travel and expense operations into intelligent, autonomous workflows Design scalable, secure systems with enterprise-grade controls, observability, and auditability built in from day one Build flexible integration patterns that bridge modern and legacy transactional systems across the Plan, Book, Pay, and Expense modules Partner with AWS teams to evaluate and adopt emerging AI capabilities and primitives.

Team Leadership Lead a high-performing engineering team building solutions that support Travel & Events operations and transactions at massive scale Hire, develop, and retain exceptional engineering talent across backend, frontend, and program management disciplines Set clear goals tied to measurable organizational impact and independently manage both day-to-day execution and long-term roadmap priorities Foster a culture of continuous improvement through data-driven insights, rigorous testing, and robust governance frameworks.

Impact Transform how 500,000+ Amazonians plan travel, book events, manage payments, and submit expenses — replacing fragmented, manual processes with a unified AI-powered experience that scales globally Drive measurable operational efficiencies by reducing cycle times, manual touchpoints, and error rates in complex travel and expense workflows Influence the automation and AI strategy for one of Amazon's largest employee-facing platforms.

A day in the life

Basic qualifications

- 3+ years of engineering team management experience
- 7+ years of engineering experience
- 8+ years of leading the definition and development of multi tier web services experience
- Knowledge of engineering practices and patterns for the full software/hardware/networks development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, certification, and livesite operations
- Experience partnering with product or program management teams
- Experience designing or architecting (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems

Preferred qualifications

- Experience in communicating with users, other technical teams, and senior leadership to collect requirements, describe software product features, technical designs, and product strategy
- Experience in recruiting, hiring, mentoring/coaching and managing teams of Software Engineers to improve their skills, and make them more effective, product software engineers

title: Senior Engagement Manager, Professional Services
descriptionHtml:
Would you like a career that gives you opportunities to help customers and partners use cloud computing web services to do big new things faster , at lower cost? Do you want to be part of history and transform businesses through cloud computing adoption? Do you like to work on-site in a variety of business environments, leading teams through high impact projects that use the newest cloud infrastructure and platform technologies? Would you like a career path that enables you to progress with the rapid adoption of cloud computing?
At Amazon Web Services (AWS), we’re hiring a technical Engagement Manager to lead AWS consultants, partners and client teams. Engagement Managers manage and deliver AWS cloud products and services that enable our customers to realize their business objectives. These professional services engagements focus on the full platform of AWS customer solutions to help our customers and partners remove constraints and accelerate their journey to AWS.

Key job responsibilities
As Engagement Manager you will manage projects independently and also deliver as part of larger teams.
You will own work streams end to end, starting by understanding the customer required outcomes, then leading the team through delivery, managing customer expectations, proactively handling risks and following an effective governance structure, in order to deliver solutions tied to the customer business objectives. You will communicate in an effective way with AWS team members and stakeholders, as well as with customer counterparts. Achieving customer satisfaction will be a relevant driver of your work.
As an Amazonian leader you will embrace and apply the Amazon Leadership Principles, proactively engaging other teams to learn and share, and participating actively in the recruitment and onboarding of future team members.
This is a customer facing role. You will be required to travel to client locations and deliver professional services when needed.

A day in the life
AWS Professional Services engage in a wide variety of projects for customers and partners, providing collective AWS customer experience, best practices, and obsessing about strong success for the Customer. Our team collaborates across the entire AWS organization to bring access to product, service, and training teams, to deliver the right solutions and drive feature innovations for our customers across all industries. Engagement Managers help Customers make decisions to meet their technical and business objectives by providing best practices, proactively identifying and closing project gaps.
Amazon aims to be the most customer centric company on earth. Amazon Web Services (AWS) provides a highly reliable, scalable, low-cost infrastructure platform in the cloud that powers critical applications for hundreds of thousands of businesses in 190 countries around the world.

About the team
Diverse Experiences
AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS?

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Inclusive Team Culture

Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (gender diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

title: Security Incident Response, Security Engineer, US Amazon Dedicated Cloud Security
descriptionHtml:
Amazon's Security team is looking for a Security Incident Response Analyst to detect, investigate, and respond to threats against a U.S. Government program building a purpose-built, classified AI Factory. We are obsessed with protecting customer trust, and on a fully air-gapped platform with no commercial cloud control plane we build our detection and response capability from the ground up. In this role you monitor security telemetry, triage and investigate alerts, drive incidents through containment, eradication, and recovery, and turn every event into better detections and playbooks. You will work in the trenches with detection engineers, SOC analysts, forensics, and our Government counterparts to keep a high-value classified system defensible around the clock. If you like being the person who runs toward the alarm and closes the loop, this role is for you.

This position requires that the candidate selected be a US Citizen and must currently possess and maintain an active TS/SCI security clearance with polygraph.

Key job responsibilities
• Monitor security telemetry and triage, investigate, and escalate alerts on the disconnected platform.
• Drive incidents through the full response lifecycle: containment, eradication, recovery, and after-action.
• Develop and tune detection content and response playbooks from incident learnings.
• Coordinate incident reporting and handoffs with the ISSM and Government counterparts.

title: Infra-Delivery Install Technician, Infrastructure Delivery
descriptionHtml:
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

Amazon is looking for an Infrastructure Delivery Installation Technician to join our growing team within infrastructure operations. You will work with minimum supervision in a dynamic environment to drive the stability and sustainability of our next-generation networks and assist in the development of innovative ways to automate and scale our network.
To be successful in this role you should possess technical aptitude, written and oral communications skills and the ability to deal effectively with people in a wide variety of situations. In addition, you must possess strong analytical skills with demonstrated problem solving ability. You will be able to leverage your experience exercising high levels of initiative, judgment, and diplomacy.

Additionally, all candidates should be willing to work both independently and with a team. Work prioritization, organizational skills, effective communication, and the ability to react quickly are critical to being successful.

Physical Requirements:
All physical requirements are expected with reasonable accommodations:
- Regularly lift and/or move up to 40 pounds; and participate in group lifts for 41+ pounds
- Ability to work in an environment that operates 24/7 with an ability to participate in primary responder rotation and provide after-hours support as needed
- Working in cramped and/or elevated and/or noisy environments
- Bending, lifting, stretching, reaching, standing and walking for up to 8+ hours a day
- Ascending and descending ladders, stairs, and gangways safely and without limitation

NOTE: Amazon is not able to provide sponsorship now or in the future for these positions. Eligible candidates must have work authorization without employer intervention to be considered.

Amazon does not sponsor for immigration, including for H-1B, TN, and other non-immigrant visas, for this role

Key job responsibilities
- Moving and implementing large enterprise equipment
- Installing Fiber and Copper cabling and patching cabling between equipment
- Ensuring proper safety and security standards are maintained during cabling and rack installation,
- Following well established hardware installation procedures and break-fix activities
- Safely using material handling tools and equipment

Traveling within and outside of regional work area is required. You will be responsible for having a reliable personal vehicle and valid driver's license to travel within the regional work area, as company transportation will not be provided.

Basic qualifications

- 1+ years of Computer Hardware Repair, Infrastructure Cabling, Network Deployment, or Data Center Operations experience, or experience in similar technical or vocational roles
- High School diploma or equivalent

Preferred qualifications

- industry standard certification (CompTIA, CCENT, or Network+), or experience in a relevant field (e.g., Computer Science, Networking Engineering)

title: Associate Solutions Architect Internship 2027
descriptionHtml:
Join Amazon Web Services (AWS) as an Associate Solutions Architect Intern and launch your career in cloud computing. Available to work full-time for either 3 or 6 months during 2027, you'll gain hands-on experience designing cloud and generative AI solutions, learning from experienced architects, and working on real AWS projects that impact millions of customers worldwide.

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world's leading cloud computing platform, helping millions of customers — from startups to global enterprises — build and run applications without managing physical servers. We're seeking motivated individuals for our Associate Solutions Architect Intern program, a structured learning experience designed to develop the next generation of Cloud Solutions Architects.

This internship serves as a pathway to our Solutions Architect Graduate Program, offering you the opportunity to build foundational knowledge in cloud computing, AWS services, and solutions architecture principles in a supportive, education-first environment. You'll learn to understand customer requirements, build working cloud and AI solutions, and communicate technical recommendations effectively while being mentored by experienced Solutions Architects.

Key job responsibilities
Complete a structured training curriculum to build cloud architecture foundations and develop expertise in AWS services
Analyze customer requirements and learn to translate them into technical solution recommendations
Participate in solution design sessions and observe customer engagements with experienced Solutions Architects
Work on a real AWS project, applying architecture principles and building hands-on experience with AWS services
Develop communication skills by learning to present technical concepts effectively to diverse audiences

A day in the life
As an Associate Solutions Architect Intern, you'll engage in a mix of structured learning and practical application. Your day might include attending training sessions on AWS services and the Well-Architected Framework, then applying those concepts to a real project you're building on AWS. You'll participate in solution design discussions, observing how experienced architects translate customer needs into technical recommendations. You might shadow customer engagements to see how solutions are presented to diverse audiences, then return to work on your own project, experimenting with AWS services and architecture principles. Throughout your internship, you'll develop presentation skills by communicating technical concepts to colleagues and mentors, receiving feedback that helps you grow as a solutions architect.

About the team
We are the EMEA Student Programs Team within AWS, dedicated to nurturing emerging talent in cloud computing. Our team collaborates across the organization to create meaningful internship experiences that bridge the gap between academic learning and real-world cloud architecture. We work with experienced Solutions Architects who are committed to mentoring the next generation of cloud professionals. Together, we're building a community of architects who understand how to solve complex business problems through innovative cloud solutions. When you join us, you'll be part of a team that values your growth, supports your learning journey, and helps you develop the skills needed to succeed in cloud consulting and solutions architecture.

Basic qualifications

- Currently enrolled in penultimate or final year of a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related technical field, graduating in 2027 or 2028
- Speak, write, and read fluently in English at C1 level or above
- Speak, write, and read fluently in German at C1 level or above
- Experience with at least one modern programming language (such as Python, Java, C++, or JavaScript)
- Understanding of basic IT systems, software development, or system architecture concepts
- Right to work in Germany for the duration of the internship

Preferred qualifications

- Knowledge of networking fundamentals, including security, storage, or databases (relational and/or NoSQL)
- Understanding of operating systems (Unix, Linux, and/or Windows)
- Interest in or experience with generative AI, for example building with LLM APIs, agents or AI coding assistants
- Experience with systems administration (Linux/Windows), network administration (DNS, IPsec, BGP, VPN, load balancing), or programming (Node.JS, Java, Ruby, C#, Python, or PHP)
- Experience completing complex tasks quickly with little to no guidance and react with appropriate urgency to situations that require a quick turnaround, or experience in a fast-paced, high-tech company
