title: Sr. Marketing Communications Manager, DSP Experience, Americas DSP Marketing Communications
descriptionHtml:
Do you want to support Amazon’s mission to build the world’s safest, most efficient, and sustainable delivery network by helping our Delivery Service Partners (DSPs) build safe, quality businesses while retaining teams of satisfied and engaged drivers? We are looking for a Senior Marketing Communication Manager, DSP Experience who works to support 2,500+ DSPs who employ 175,000+ Delivery Associates (DAs) operating Prime-branded vehicles on road, delivering tens of millions of packages per week through our Last Mile delivery network.

Specifically, this candidate will work across multiple stakeholders and use communication strategies to bring to life all the ways that Amazon is investing in the DSP and DA experience. You will thrive in ambiguity to translate technical and operational information via the Change Management process into user-friendly resources and communications to make it convenient and seamless for DSPs to manage their business.

You’ll also help shape the team’s emerging Marketing Communications initiatives, helping ensure that we not only get the right candidates in the top of our marketing funnel so they apply for the program, but keep them engaged when they go to the bench to wait for the right opportunity to launch their DSP business. You’ll help build ongoing engagement and field marketing initiatives that are deployed to DSPs once they launch their business, supporting them through various marketing communication tactics across their full lifecycle.

In addition, you’ll serve as a primary liaison for the DSP Org to the broader transportation organization’s Day 1 initiatives, helping ensure that our VP’s entire organization remains plugged in and active to these initiatives to drive employee engagement and culture.
The ideal candidate must be a strong communicator with strategic communications and/or marketing communications experience, business acumen, and excellent writing ability – one who is able to flex between internal and external communication modalities. Not only will you need to help strategize on plans, you’ll need to help program manage them from ideation to execution to keep things on track. You will be a thought leader who indexes high on emotional intelligence and professionalism as you’ll be interacting with leaders at the highest levels. You’ll have to be comfortable with testing, learning, and rolling up your sleeves. Our environment is fast-paced and requires a candidate who isn’t afraid to innovate and propose disruptive ideas. You’ll also have a passion for fostering a collaborative and engaged culture and be a catalyst in bringing that to life. You’ll need to be able to influence teammates up, down, and across to buy-into the mission and prioritize it among the other day-to-day responsibilities.

This role can be based in Nashville, TN or Bellevue, WA.

Key job responsibilities
• Develop a multi-channel strategy, including written communications and executive messaging
• Translate complex messaging into simple and easy-to-understand content to help launch new programs and products
• Identify emerging topics and develop proactive plans with stakeholders
• Drive creative campaigns to both solve business needs and instill passion among the DSP community
• Partner with stakeholders to ingest customer listening data and use it to inform a communication strategy
• Monitor and measure the effectiveness of communications and other engagement tactics
• Partner with agencies and internal creative teams to develop compelling content and partner engagement strategies – both for acquisition and ongoing lifecycle purposes
• Develop team culture and employee engagement opportunities aligned to a broader org strategy

A day in the life
We write a lot and "are right a lot!” We respond to business needs and develop messaging for change announcements. We also interview DSPs and DAs to build compelling spotlight and advocacy stories. We own multiple channels by which we communicate to DSP Owners and their teams of DAs, partnering across our DSP Experience (DSPX) team to turn the flywheel that attracts, engages, equips, empowers, advocates, and inspires.

About the team
The Americas DSP Marketing Communications team is made up of 20+ high performing leaders. Even though we are based in different cities across the U.S., Canada, and LATAM, we have a highly inclusive and collaborative culture. We approach each other with respect and humility and have fun every day by answering Questions of the Day (QOTD) in Slack to stay connected across multiple locations, sharing memes, and hosting interactive team building events. DSPs & DAs count on us to provide helpful and trustworthy information so they can operate their business efficiently and focus on what matters most to them, i.e., building a safety-first culture, developing their team and delivering millions of smiles in their communities.

Basic qualifications

- 8+ years of professional non-internship marketing experience
- Experience using data and metrics to drive improvements
- Experience building, executing and scaling cross-functional marketing programs
- Experience communicating results to senior leadership

Preferred qualifications

- Experience driving direction and alignment with large cross-functional teams and agency partners
- Experience designing and executing joint marketing plans with strategic alliance partners with global footprint
- Experience executing scaled marketing campaigns through email or social media
- Experience with test and learn, marketing optimization, and experimentation

title: Senior Specialist, Program Management, ATS Linehaul Carrier Management
descriptionHtml:
Amazonは「地球上で最もお客様を大切にする企業になること」をビジョンに掲げており、日本国内においてもさらなるカスタマーエクスペリエンスの向上のため、最高水準の配送サービスを提供すべく、自社で輸配送ネットワークを構築し、進化させています。

Sr. Specialist, Program Managementは全国の拠点間輸送を担う幹線運送会社（キャリア）およびアマゾン社内関連部署（計画/物流拠点/システム/財務等）と連携し、幹線輸送における様々なプログラムマネジメントを通じて輸送キャパシティの拡大と効率化に取り組みます。
具体的には以下のような業務を遂行していただきます。

■各種プログラムマネジメント
アマゾンの幹線輸送ネットワークは常に進化し続けており、多様な輸送モードによりお客様にご購入いただいた商品をより早く・安全にお届けしています。主力となる大型・中型トラックによる輸送に加えて、小型トラックを活用した輸送・集荷サービス、家具・家電などの大型商品輸送、日用品をいち早くお客様にお届けするための拠点間在庫移動など様々なプログラムが拡大を続けています。本ポジションにおいては、これらのプログラムを社内関連部門と連携して管理・発展させていくことに責任を負います。また、各プログラムの取扱いボリュームや対象エリアの拡大に合わせて、規模・コスト・品質などの観点から最適なキャリアを選定し、安定的に必要なキャパシティを確保し続けるための施策の立案・実行・検証を行います。また、プログラム単位の最適化を追求するだけではなく、それらを横断した輸送キャパシティの相互活用についてもイニシアチブを持って取り組みます。

■テクノロジーを活用した業務プロセス企画・改善
Amazonのビジネスの成長に伴う輸配送ネットワークの拡大・進化のスピードは圧倒的であり、これを支えているのが、システムやデータを活用し最適化したネットワーク設計・需要予測・配送計画の策定や、キャリアへの受発注や業務品質の可視化プロセスです。「より確実に、無駄なく、柔軟に」輸送キャパシティを確保できるよう、キャリア業務や中長期的な市場動向、併走する複数のシステム/プロジェクトへの理解を基に、新規プロジェクト又は既存業務の改善提案をリード又は参画し、関係各所との連携を取りながら戦略を立案・実行します。

■各プログラムにおけるピークキャパシティ確保のための戦術の立案・実行
アマゾンには年に数回大型セールを実施しており、期間中は通常期と比較して取扱いボリュームが大幅に増加します。各プログラムにおいても同様であり、毎年過去最高を更新し続ける取扱いボリュームをカバーするキャパシティをどのように確保するのか、本ポジションでは関連部署と連携してプロキュアメント方法についての戦術立案と実行を担います。また、安全・確実な輸送の実現のためにはキャリアの品質マネジメントが非常に重要であり、ピーク時には多くの新規キャリアが参入するため、事前の各種オペレーションの周知徹底と業務・運行品質の高位平準化にも、アカウントマネジメントチームと連携して取り組みます。

上記の通り、各プログラムやシステム活用において課題を抽出・分析し、柔軟かつデータドリブンな思考に基づいて改善アクションを立案・実行し、リーダーシップを発揮できる人材を募集します。
また、各プログラムやシステム検討などは基本的に英語でのミーティングが中心となるため、ビジネスレベルの英語力（会議でディスカッションできるレベル）があることが望ましいです。

Amazonでは、最新のAI Tool, 生成AIを日々の業務の中に積極的に取り入れています。
AI Toolは私たちの意思決定のスピードを加速させ、私たちを本当に重要な「判断」と「議論」に集中させることを可能にしています。Amazon では学習を継続する文化が根付いているため、ご自身のペースでAIに関する知識を深めることができるリソースが用意されています。


Key job responsibilities
1.[60%]各種プログラムマネジメント
2.[20%] テクノロジーを活用した業務プロセス企画・改善
3.[20%]各プログラムにおけるピークキャパシティ確保のための施策の立案・実行

A day in the life

※コアタイム無し・実働8時間/日となりますが、業務時間帯はマネージャーと相談の上、業務および個人の都合に応じて変更が可能となる場合があります。
例えば、個人の事情で日中の勤務が難しい場合は他時間帯に振り分ける等、ワークライフバランスを重視した働き方が可能です。

About the team

- 中級以上のPCスキル（Word, Power Point, Excel(集計関数やピボットテーブルを使った分析) ）

This role offers opportunities to combine strong analytical skills with managing ambiguity in a fast-paced environment, while driving the development of Amazon's gigantic supply chain network.
Join us to shape the future of one of Japan's largest logistics networks and contribute to Amazon's mission of being Earth's most customer-centric company!

title: Senior BMS Specialist, Global BMS Technical Services
descriptionHtml:
Global BMS Technical Services (GBTS) is Amazon's centralized Building Management System (BMS) technical support organization. GBTS operates within the Global Energy, Sustainability & Automation (GESA) division, which is part of OPS - GEMS (Global Engineering, Materials & Sustainability). OPS - GEMS is the enterprise responsible for driving engineering excellence, materials innovation, and sustainability initiatives across Amazon's global operations infrastructure.

OPS - GEMS leads the design, deployment, integration, and lifecycle management of building automation platforms, energy infrastructure, and sustainability technologies across Amazon's worldwide operations network. This includes HVAC sequence of operations, environmental controls, energy metering, power distribution, and carbon reduction strategies.

Within this mission, GBTS serves as the frontline technical arm. We ensure that every facility's BMS operates at peak performance while advancing Amazon's Climate Pledge commitment.

GBTS is a destination for engineers and technical professionals who excel in high-impact, operationally demanding environments. We operate at the intersection of building science, automation engineering, and sustainability, tackling complex technical challenges at scale.

We foster an open and inclusive culture that values diverse perspectives and technical expertise. Our strength lies in deep cross-functional collaboration: controls engineers partnering with energy analysts, sustainability specialists aligning with program managers, and field technicians providing critical insights that shape platform architecture. We are committed to operational excellence, uphold the highest standards of safety and quality, and are driven by the understanding that the systems we design, build, and maintain directly enable Amazon to deliver on its commitment to customers and the planet.

Join us and be part of the team that powers, optimizes, and sustains Amazon's global operations infrastructure, ensuring every facility runs smarter, safer, and more sustainably.

Key job responsibilities
We are seeking an experienced Senior Building Management System (BMS) Specialist to join an existing team that supports post-project activities across one of the largest BMS portfolios in the world. This role requires a dynamic individual with a strong technical foundation in BMS programming, HVAC controls, commissioning, and troubleshooting. The successful candidate will maintain, enhance, and optimize our global services, ensuring seamless BMS functionality and delivering unparalleled customer experiences.

1. Support the development and execution of a comprehensive strategy for maintaining, improving, and expanding our global support services
2. Collaborate closely with GRBD&E, D&C, Sustainability, RME, and other stakeholders to understand customer requirements, business objectives, and operational needs
3. Design, implement, and manage BMS standard operating procedures, policies, and processes that are scalable across the globe
4. Maintain and optimize BMS technologies, IoT platforms, and data analytics tools
5. Monitor and maintain ticket and work order queues, ensuring customer care and quality meet the high bar
6. Ensure compliance with change management processes
7. Monitor and analyze BMS data to proactively identify and action opportunities for optimization, energy efficiency, and cost savings
8. Establish and maintain strong relationships with internal stakeholders and vendors, ensuring a customer-centric approach
9. Provide strategic insights and recommendations to management on BMS trends, improvements, issues, root causes, team skillsets, industry best practices, and emerging technologies
10. Take ownership of BMS initiatives, develop technical documentation, manage timelines, and coordinate with stakeholders
11. Lead training sessions and development programs to continuously enhance the capabilities and technical skills of field RME teams and BMS Specialists
12. Drive a culture of innovation, continuous improvement, and knowledge sharing within the team
13. Willingness to work flexible shifts to provide 24/7 BMS support across global time zones

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in electrical or mechanical engineering, engineering technology or equivalent
- Ability to integrate multiple communications protocols such as BACnet, LON, Modbus, and SNMP to a single platform with normalized data for standard visualization.
- Ability to remotely troubleshoot BMS communication issues, including fieldbus (BACnet, LON, Modbus via RS485), Network Gateways and IP-based protocols (Niagara Fox, MQTT, BACnet/IP, Modbus TCP, SNMP).
- Exceptional interpersonal and communication skills to collaborate effectively with diverse stakeholders.
- Deep understanding of HVAC, lighting, Utilities, field devices, and other building systems, as well as energy management principles.
- Demonstrated ability to manage and prioritize initiatives in a dynamic environment.
- Strong problem-solving skills with a strategic and innovative mindset.
- Organized and self-motivated to take ownership of complex tasks.

Preferred qualifications

- Experience with Industrial control systems, both hardware and software
- Experience working in cross-regional BMS projects with multicultural teams
- Proficiency in cloud-based IoT platforms, data analytics, and visualization tools
- Certification in relevant programming languages or BMS systems
- Certification with Tridium Niagara
- Certification with Distech Controls
- Strong customer relationship management skills
- Experience and understanding of facility management and relevant electrical and mechanical aspects of BMS equipment
- Proficiency in additional spoken languages

title: Japan Lead, Scaled Vendor Management, Retail Business Services (RBS)
descriptionHtml:
About Amazon.com
Amazon.com strives to be Earth's most customer-centric company where people can find and discover virtually anything they want to buy online. By giving customers more of what they want - low prices, vast selection, and convenience - Amazon.com continues to grow and evolve as a world-class e-commerce platform. Amazon's evolution from Web site to e-commerce partner to development platform is driven by the spirit of innovation that is part of the company's DNA. The world's brightest technology minds come to Amazon.com to research and develop technology that improves the lives of shoppers and sellers around the world.

About the Role
We are seeking a customer-obsessed senior leader to own the end-to-end strategy and execution for Amazon Japan's Managed Vendor Relations (MVR) program. This role serves as the Country Lead for JP MVR, managing a team of 5+managers — who in turn lead Account Managers — across VSP (vendor success program) and RVR (retail vendor recruitment). The candidate will set the long-term strategic direction, define the vision and tone for the organization, and drive business growth, vendor satisfaction, and operational excellence across a team of 30+ direct and indirect reports.
This leader will be responsible for shaping the multi-year roadmap for JP MVR, partnering with JP Retail category teams, RBS leadership, and cross-functional stakeholders to unlock selection, merchandising, and revenue opportunities at scale. They will own end-to-end vendor performance — from recruitment and onboarding through joint business planning and execution — while managing complex stakeholder relationships. The ideal candidate thinks long-term, operates as a strategic business owner who can identify growth levers and translate them into scalable programs, and navigates ambiguity with confidence. They excel at influencing without authority, building high-performing leadership teams, and delivering exceptional customer and vendor outcomes across site merchandising, buying, inventory management, finance, operations, and marketing. They are at their best when setting organizational direction, developing leaders, and driving transformational results at country scale.

Key job responsibilities
1. Lead a team of managers (managing Account Managers) across VSP (vendor success program) and RVR (retail vendor recruitment) — setting strategic direction and operating rhythm for 30+ direct and indirect reports.
2. Own the long-term JP MVR strategy, identifying growth levers across the full vendor lifecycle to accelerate GMS and improve customer experience.
3. Define and execute the multi-year JP MVR roadmap — driving selection, merchandising, and operational improvement at country scale.
4. Partner with JP Retail, RBS leadership, and cross-functional teams to align on marketplace priorities and execute growth strategies across the vendor portfolio.
5. Establish success metrics (GMS, NPS/CSAT, recruitment yield, operational health) and build mechanisms for accountability and continuous improvement across all programs.
6. Develop scalable processes and guardrails to manage vendor complexity and drive consistency across workstreams.
7. Serve as the strategic voice for JP MVR — influencing organizational strategy, shaping the vendor management roadmap, and representing JP MVR to senior leadership.
8. Drive recruiting, talent development, and team culture — building a leadership bench, coaching managers, and raising the bar on performance and operational standards

About the team
The vision of RBS MVR team is “To unlock the full potential of every vendor on Amazon through an intelligent scaling engine, that transforms how we recruit, launch, and grow our partners to deliver unparalleled selection and value to customers worldwide".

-Experience using analytical, account management, and productivity tools, such as, Oracle Business Intelligence, SalesForce, Tableau, or similar
-Experience with Doubleclick (XSM, DFP), AdJuster or Salesforce

-5+ years of hiring and retaining digital advertising teams experience

title: Engineering Manager - Software/Cloud, RIVR
descriptionHtml:
RIVR, part of Amazon is a robotics team pioneering Physical AI through real-world deployment and doorstep deliveries. Founded in 2024 as an ETH Zurich spin-off, RIVR developed wheeled-legged robots designed to operate in complex, unstructured environments such as stairs, gates, doors, and uneven urban terrain. We believe that achieving general physical intelligence requires solving real customer problems in the real world, where robots can learn by gathering rich operational data at scale.

Key job responsibilities
● Design and implement a production-grade Linux distribution from scratch using Yocto/OpenEmbedded.

● Develop and maintain custom Yocto layers, write and patch bitbake recipes, and configure Linux kernels to support specific hardware peripherals.

● Hardware enablement for critical robotics sensors, including GMSL cameras, GPS/GNSS modules, IMUs, and LiDAR.

● Implement and manage robust Over-the-Air (OTA) update solutions to ensure safe and atomic fleet-wide deployments.

● Work closely with hardware engineers to bring up new boards, modify Device Trees, and debug low-level interfaces (I2C, SPI, CAN, UART).

● Profile and optimize the system for boot time, memory footprint, and interrupt latency.

Basic qualifications

- 4+ years of experience formally leading engineering teams, managing sprints, and coaching developers.
- 7+ years of professional experience building and operating large-scale backend systems in a Service-Oriented Architecture (SOA) or microservices context.
- Proven experience architecting solutions on AWS.
- Proven experience operating a complex SOA architecture at scale. Deep familiarity with failure modes in distributed systems and mechanisms to reduce the blast radius of outages and regressions.
- Experience with building and operating ML training infrastructure, integrating it in the SDLC. Experience with handling sensitive data and ensuring its safety and compliance.
- Proven ability to delegate and grow, yet remain connected to the technology details.
- Strong judgement: you identify and call-out one-way doors, you can independently check Senior Engineers’ assumptions and designs, you anticipate the impact and future cost of shortcuts and weight them against your immediate priorities.
- A deep sense of Ownership, a relentless drive to Earn Trust, and a passion for Developing the Best talent.

title: Chip Design Engineer, Nitro Team
descriptionHtml:
Annapurna Labs, an Amazon team, designs and delivers high-end, custom silicon at the heart of AWS. Our chips don't just support the cloud; they define it. From Trainium, the purpose-built ML accelerator driving the next wave of AI innovation, to Graviton, the Arm-based server processor redefining price-performance for compute workloads, to Nitro, the advanced network and cloud management controller that underpins every AWS instance — Annapurna's products set the standard for the industry.

We're looking for a talented Chip Design Engineer to join our Nitro team in Tel Aviv and help shape what comes next.

What you'll do:
*Take an active, hands-on role in developing the next generation of the Nitro platform https://aws.amazon.com/ec2/nitro/
*Own critical IP blocks end-to-end — from architecture through tape-out
*Collaborate with a world-class, fast-moving design team and see your work deployed at a scale no other platform can match, powering hundreds of thousands of businesses across 190 countries

If you want to build silicon that leads the cloud world, this is where it happens.

Key job responsibilities
As a Chip Design Engineer on the Nitro team, you will take full end-to-end ownership of one or more critical IP blocks within the product, guiding them from micro-architecture definition through RTL design, debug, synthesis, timing closure, and final sign-off before tape-out. Your work will ship in silicon that powers AWS at global scale.
You'll partner closely with the Verification and Emulation teams to shape test plans, review coverage, and close gaps early in the design cycle. Beyond your own IP, you'll collaborate across disciplines with Product Definition, Software, Physical Design, and Verification teams to deliver a fully integrated, production-ready chip.

Basic qualifications

- B.Sc. in Electrical Engineering/Computer Engineering
- 5+ years of experience in Chip Design
- Experience working with data paths

Preferred qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent
- Experience with large scale IPs (Millions of gates)
- Experience with a full design cycle – RTL/Verification/Synthesis and timing closure/CDC/ Lint.
- Experience with Networking layers

title: Senior Engineer, JP Ops Eng, JCFS, JP Ops Eng, JCFS
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Japan はビジネスの成長をサポートする新しいフルフィルメントセンター,インバウンドクロスドック,アウトバウンドソートセンターなどFirst Mile/Middle Mileの新規サイト立ち上げおよび数十の既存サイトにおける改造プロジェクトにおいて、設置されるマテハン機器や自動化設備の安定稼働に向けて設備の安全性や品質、信頼性、生産性の改善を技術的にリードする Senior Engineer を探しています。本ポジションは、アマゾンのグローバルチームや国内外のサプライヤーと協力し共に成長しながら技術的なリーダーシップを発揮し、安全性やコストバランスを維持しつつ設備およびプロセスの能力と品質を最大化させます。また、オートメーションを含む最新鋭の搬送設備の導入に伴い新たに発生する技術課題に対しても状況に応じて最適なソリューションを提案し、関係するステークホルダーとの合意形成をとりながらタイムリーに解決へ導くことで新規ソートセンターの立ち上げを成功させ、日本のお客様へお届けする商品のリードタイム短縮と輸送コスト削減に貢献します。そして幅広い技術力や経験知を指導することでチーム全体の技術力を底上げし、さらに設備仕様や業務プロセスの標準化へつなげていくことで技術のスケールアップにも貢献します。下記が主な業務となります。
- 日本のオペレーションが計画する中期および年次計画に基づいてフルフィルメントセンターおよびソートセンターの立ち上げを実現すること。
- 設備の技術問題に対して重大性や影響度を迅速かつ正確に捉え、状況に応じて安全、日程、品質、コストの全体最適となるソリューションを提案し解決させること。
- 既存のコミュニケーションチャネルとワークプロセスの更なる改善を行い、社内外のステークホルダーとの信頼関係を構築しながらコンフリクトを解消し合意形成に結び付けるようマネージすること。
- グローバルのエンジニアリングチームと連携し、最先端の設備や業務プロセスを日本に導入して、入出荷能力の向上や業務効率化を図ること。また、日本のベストプラクティスはグローバルへ提案し標準化すること。
- 国内外の協力会社と連携するだけでなく、継続的にそれら協力会社の能力を高め、安全性・品質の向上と低コスト化を推進すること。
- 安全基準とエンジニアリング指針に則り、標準作業作りなどを通してメカニズムを構築し安全な職場を実現すること。

Amazon Japan is seeking an Senior Engineer to manage the construction of the material handling equipment and automation equipment, verify the operational capability, and start up the new fulfillment center/IB cross-dock/OB sort center that handles First mile/Middle mile delivery. This position will demonstrate technical leadership while working and growing with Amazon's global team and domestic and international suppliers to maximize facility and process capability and quality while maintaining safety and cost balance. In addition, we propose optimal solutions for new technical issues that arise with the introduction of state-of-the-art transportation equipment, including automation. By guiding them, we will successfully launch a new sort center and contribute to shortening lead times and reducing transportation costs for products delivered to Japanese customers. In addition, by teaching a wide range of technical skills and empirical knowledge, we will raise the technical skills of the entire team, and furthermore, we will contribute to the scale-up of technology by leading to the standardization of equipment specifications and business processes.
The following are the main duties.
- Realize the launch of fulfillment centers and sort centers based on the mid-term and annual plans planned by the Japanese operations.
- Quickly and accurately grasp the severity and impact of technical problems with equipment, and propose and resolve solutions that optimize overall safety, schedule, quality, and cost, depending on the situation.
- Further improve existing communication channels and work processes, build relationships of trust with internal and external stakeholders, resolve conflicts, and manage to build consensus.
- Collaborate with global engineering teams and introduce new technology and processes to Japan to improve shipping and receiving capabilities and improve business efficiency. In addition, Japan's best practices should be proposed globally and standardized.
- In addition to collaborating with partner companies in Japan and overseas, continuously improve the capabilities of these partner companies, and promote improvements in safety and quality as well as cost reductions.
- According to safety standards and engineering guidelines, create a mechanism through the creation of standard work, etc., and realize a safe workplace.
More Information (Japanese Only)
- Department: Japan Customer Fulfillment Solutions
- Job:Engineer
- Location:Tokyo Office

Amazonでは、最新のAI Tool, 生成AIを日々の業務の中に積極的に取り入れています。
AI Toolは私たちの意思決定のスピードを加速させ、私たちを本当に重要な「判断」と「議論」に集中させることを可能にしています。Amazon では学習を継続する文化が根付いているため、ご自身のペースでAIに関する知識を深めることができるリソースが用意されています。


Key job responsibilities
- マテリアルハンドリングや各種自動化設備の設置から試運転テストそして検収プロセスをリードする。
- Amazon 社内関係者や外部ベンダーとの信頼関係を構築しながら安全と品質、コストの全体最適を考慮した上で技術的課題やコンフリクトを解決し、計画どおりのプロジェクト遂行をリードする。
- グローバルのエンジニアリングチームと協力して、新しい安全・品質の管理プロセスまたは標準を日本に導入し、また日本のベストプラクティスをグローバルチームに提案して展開します。
- 工事安全や品質に関わる事象と原因を深く掘り下げて本質的課題を特定・解決し、再発防止につながる仕組みや基準を構築する。
- 最高の価値と競争力を実現するために、調達やその他ビジネス パートナーへの設備仕様と技術サポートを提供する。

- Lead the installation of material handling and various automated equipment, commissioning tests and acceptance inspection processes for both new site launch and also legacy site retrofit/expansion.
- Resolve conflicts after considering overall optimization while building trusting relationships with Amazon internal stakeholders and external vendors, and lead the project in a short period of time with high quality and low cost.
- Collaborate with global engineering teams to introduce new safety and quality management processes or standards to Japan, and propose and deploy the best practices in Japan to global teams.
- Dive deep on technical details to identify and solve the technical problems and to build a mechanism or standard that leads to recurrence prevention.
- Assist in providing equipment specifications and technical support to procurement and other business partners for best value and competition.

A day in the life
一週間に 3~4 日を工事中のサイトで勤務し現場の工事安全を統括リードし、各ベンダーや関係部署にまたがる複雑な技術課題の解決をリードします。グローバルチームメンバーと協業しながら業務プロセスや標準の改善に向けてドキュメントを作成し提案、実行します。業務を進めるうえで何か迷うことがあれば、チャットや F2F の会話を通して気軽に相談しながら、チーム全体でサポートし合います。フレックスが基本ですが、原則 18 時以降は会議やメールは行いません。有給休暇の取得率も高く長期休暇も、もちろん取得可能です。

An acting site lead works 3 to 4 days per week in a site under construction, leading safety management and solving complex technical issues that cross vendors and other departments. Propose, and implement documents to improve work processes and standards while collaborating with global team. If they have any questions while working, feel free
to consult other members through chat or F2F conversations, and the entire team will support each other. Flextime is the norm, and generally there are no meetings or emails after 6pm. We have a high rate of paid vacations, and of course they can take long vacations.

About the team
チームメンバーは総勢36名で、年間 2～4サイトの新規サイト立ち上げるおよび数十の既存サイトにおける改造プロジェクトにおいて、現場リード 1 名と施工管理者複数名が着工から稼働までプロジェクトを指揮します。 チームメンバーは機械・電気工学から建設の分野までさまざまなバックグラウンドを持っていますが、定期的なチームミーティングや現場レビューを通じてお互いの知識や経験を共有し、オープンな議論を行っています。 そうすることで個人のスキル向上を促しながら、チームとしての成長を目指しています。

There are 36 members in the team, and in order to launch 2 to 4 new greenfield sites and multiple legacy site retrofit projects per year, a site deployment lead and multiple construction managers per site will lead the project from the start of construction to go live. Team members have various backgrounds ranging from mechanical and electrical engineering to architectural design, but through regular team meetings and on-site reviews, they share their knowledge and experience and engage in open
discussions. By doing so, we aim to grow as a team while improving individual skills.

Basic qualifications

- 大学の学士 または工学の修士号
- 建設プロジェクトなどの大規模エンジニアリング プロジェクトにおける 5年以上の技術的リーダーシップおよびプロジェクト管理の経験、または同等レベルの設備(MHE、オートメーション、生産など) の技術知識

title: Operations Manager, UKIE AMZL, AMZL
descriptionHtml:
Operations is the beating heart of Amazon. This key part of our business makes sure we fulfil and dispatch orders efficiently so that our customers get their items on time. It’s driven by Operations Managers who bring the team together to push excellence in safety, quality and productivity across our sites. At your site, you’ll lead other managers and create the operational plan that helps your teams meet their targets. This role is all about driving operational excellence to create the Amazon of tomorrow.

Key job responsibilities
- Manage and develop a team of Area Managers
- Lead operational teams on a shift, deal with issues, and positively impact site performance
- Analyse shift performance against relevant business objectives, and put in place actions to improve our operational excellence
- Work closely with other support teams, including HR, Finance, Health and Safety, and Security
- Design and deliver initiatives across the sites to improve operational performance

A day in the life
You’ll lead shifts at one of our operational sites. You’ll also be the key link between a number of teams, including finance, safety and operations integration teams. That means you’ll be close to the day-to-day operations at your site but also contribute to new ways to innovate at your site.

A typical day will involve meetings with different areas of the business, deep diving into performance and risk metrics for sites, and looking ahead to prepare for different levels of demand. Every day will also involve mentoring and coaching your team. You’ll be a source of leadership and support your team to be the best managers they can be.



About the team
About the team
Amazon Logistics, or AMZL, handles ‘last mile’ delivery duties in partnership with third-party distribution businesses. We utilise creative thinking and continuous improvement initiatives to get millions of physical products into the hands of our customers. Our goal is to make our customers’ delivery experience as smooth as possible and roll out global delivery solutions for our newest concepts, like Amazon Fresh, Prime Now and Amazon Restaurants.

There are two sides to what we do. Our ‘under the roof’ associates process millions of products for dispatch to our delivery teams. Our team is people-focused and supportive, particularly as lots of our people work through the night. We focus mostly on operations, with 24/7 shifts in most of our locations.

Meanwhile, our ‘on the road’ people work with Amazon Flex - a network of delivery contractors. Every year, we continually raise the bar for customer experience with new, innovative delivery services. We look for new ways to overcome industry wide logistics challenges and new ideas to reduce our carbon footprint, supported by a portfolio of vehicles (including Electric Vehicles) and technology to help us do just that.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree, or Master's degree
- Experience within a distribution center, logistics, or manufacturing environment
- Experience working with multiple groups of stakeholders
- Advanced proficiency in verbal and written English and upper intermediate proficiency in the local language

Preferred qualifications

- Preferred qualifications are not required to apply for a position at Amazon. If you have all the basic qualifications above, we’d love to hear from you.
- A bachelor’s, advanced or master’s degree in engineering, supply chain, logistics, or manufacturing
- Experience in managing third-party relationships
- Experience of applying Lean, Six Sigma, and Kaizen methodologies

title: Chip Design Engineer, Graviton Team
descriptionHtml:
Annapurna Labs, a fabless semiconductor company, was established by semiconductor industry veterans and is developing leading-edge products manufactured on state-of-the-art technologies. We are looking for talented engineers to help us develop a semiconductor platform based on a revolutionary architecture.
Take part in the development of state-of-the-art products within a disruptive system architecture. You will have the opportunity to work on the technologies that power the world's largest cloud provider, in a dynamic, open, and fast-paced environment. AWS provides a highly reliable, scalable, low-cost infrastructure platform in the cloud, which powers hundreds of thousands of businesses in 190 countries around the world.

AWS Graviton is a family of innovative processors designed to deliver the best price performance for cloud workloads running in Amazon Elastic Compute Cloud (Amazon EC2), the world's largest leading Cloud vendor.
The Graviton is our own internal home grown solution that re-shaped EC2 offering to AWS customers, and the preferable solution for cloud compute by customers.

We are looking for talented engineers to join our Chip Design team, working on the Graviton product line. Our chip design team is in charge of defining the product's features and working on their architecture and development. Our team members collaborate with multiple teams from different disciplines such as product definition, pre and post silicon validation, physical design, software and others contributing to a full cycle of chip development from idea to mass production. Your design will be integrated into the Graviton products, an important part of the AWS data centers worldwide. This is an opportunity to have a large-scale impact.

Join our innovative team at Annapurna Labs and play a pivotal role in developing next-generation semiconductor platforms that power the world's largest cloud infrastructure. Your expertise will directly contribute to creating transformative chip technologies that shape the future of cloud computing.

Watch these videos to learn more about Annapurna Labs and the Graviton project:

* AWS re:Invent 2025 - Keynote with Peter DeSantis and Dave Brown: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=JeUpUK0nhC0
* AWS re:Invent 2025 - AWS Graviton: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=haSHl2BLhm8



Key job responsibilities
* Drive SoC development from micro-architecture definition through tape-out
* Design and implement RTL blocks within a complex semiconductor platform
* Perform system-level debugging and performance analysis
* Lead pre and post-silicon verification activities for your design areas
* Define and execute IP integration strategies
* Ensure quality and reliability standards across your deliverables
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams including Product Definition, Verification, Physical Design, and Software Engineering

A day in the life
Your day will be filled with technical challenges and collaborative problem-solving. You'll dive into semiconductor architecture, working on design challenges that require both creative thinking and precise technical execution. Expect to engage with cross-functional teams, prototype innovative solutions, and contribute to chip development that impacts global cloud infrastructure.

About the team
Annapurna Labs started in 2011 as a fabless chip start-up focused on bringing innovation to cloud infrastructure. Acquired by AWS in 2015, we have since developed AWS Nitro technology, AWS Graviton processors, AWS Inferentia & Trainium, and more. Our chip design team defines product features and drives their architecture and development through the full cycle — from concept to mass production.
We combine the agility of a startup with the resources of AWS. Our team collaborates across disciplines — product definition, pre and post-silicon validation, physical design, and software — in a dynamic, open, and fast-paced environment.

Basic qualifications

- BSc in Electrical Engineering / Computer Engineering / Computer Science
- Knowledge of digital logic systems and computer architecture
- Please include your CV and a grade sheet in a single PDF file

Preferred qualifications

- Background in processor or fabric design architectures
- Familiarity with Verilog/System Verilog programming
- Knowledge of communication protocols (AXI, CHI, PCIe, UCIe, DDR)
- Knowledge of CPU architecture
- Familiarity with IP integration concepts
- Fluent English

title: Technical Program Manager, Global Procurement Technology
descriptionHtml:
Amazon’s Global Procurement Organization is transforming how procurement operates at Amazon scale, and we are looking for a Technical Program Manager to drive that transformation. This role owns the programs that move procurement from individual AI-assisted productivity toward an operating model where AI agents carry processes end to end and people verify, orchestrate, and govern. It sits at the intersection of technology, business process redesign, and organizational change, where your work shapes not just the tools procurement uses but how the work itself is structured.

Key job responsibilities
• Define and manage the end-to-end lifecycle of complex, cross-functional technology programs, from problem definition and design through build, launch, and iteration.
• Stand up and operate new delivery team structures for AI transformation initiatives, from team charter and composition through to solutions running in production.
• Define how transformation success is measured and establish baselines before changes land, so that claimed gains can be verified rather than argued.
• Design and run program decision gates, including the criteria for continuing or stopping an initiative, the evidence required at each gate, and the escalation path when something is not working.
• Partner with business leaders to redesign processes, targeting the coordination effort that becomes unnecessary once supplier, commercial, risk, and policy information is maintained as a shared capability.
• Drive architecture and design discussions, applying working knowledge of AI and AWS services to evaluate trade-offs and ensure solutions are scalable, secure, and operationally sound.
• Build the mechanisms the program depends on, including team and charter registries, playbooks for standing up new teams, and the feedback loop that carries learning between business areas.
• Independently identify and resolve structural blockers across teams, including governance gaps, duplicated solutions, missing orchestration between existing tools, and unclear ownership.
• Manage program roadmaps, milestones, and dependencies across multiple engineering teams, proactively identifying risks and removing barriers to keep delivery on track.
• Facilitate business and technical meetings, driving crisp decisions and ensuring the right people are in the room at the right time.
• Communicate program status, risks, trade-offs, and outcomes to stakeholders from engineering teams through Directors and VPs, in clear written narratives and verbal updates.



About the team
Global Procurement Technology builds the systems behind Amazon’s procurement function, from how suppliers are brought on and assessed to how commercial terms, risk signals, and policy are applied across the company. We set the technology strategy for the business and lead its AI transformation, embedding intelligent automation and data-driven capability into the procurement experience rather than layering tools on top of unchanged processes.
The ideal candidate has hands-on experience with AWS services and cloud-native architectures, and can hold their own in design reviews and technical deep dives. You have a strong grasp of AI and machine learning technologies and understand how to apply them to solve real-world operational problems. You are comfortable operating in ambiguity, bringing structure and clarity where none exists, and you have a bias for action that keeps programs moving forward. Above all, you are customer-obsessed, always working backwards from the needs of the business and the end user.

Basic qualifications

- Experience managing programs across cross functional teams, building processes and coordinating release schedules
- 2+ years of software development experience
- 4+ years of technical program management working directly with software engineering teams experience

- Experience working with AI systems, including large language models and agent-based workflows, strong enough to assess feasibility and challenge proposed designs

- 3+ years of project management disciplines including scope, schedule, budget, quality, along with risk and critical path management experience
- Experience defining KPI's/SLA's used to drive multi-million dollar businesses and reporting to senior leadership
- Experience leading highly technical programs involving infrastructure, complex systems, systems engineering

title: Data Center Controls Engineer, Controls Deployment Service
descriptionHtml:
As part of the global controls team, you will work with highly motivated experts and innovators in the data center industry. You will be responsible for troubleshooting, project management, and maintaining the building management system (BMS) and electrical power monitoring system (EPMS). Using Amazon leadership principles, you will develop new processes and standards while innovating in the controls space. AWS Data centers have multiple components such as generators, uninterruptible power sources, diesel generators, electrical switchgear, power distribution units, variable frequency drives, automatic/static transfer switches, chillers [air-cooled and water-cooled], pumps, cooling towers, heat exchangers, CRAHs, air economizers, etc. All these components have local control systems that interact with each other via open and/or proprietary communications protocols. The BMS is the primary method of control of all mechanical systems within a data center. The EPMS is the primary method of monitoring all electrical systems within a data center.

This position requires access to information that is subject to U.S. export control regulations, and applicants must be a 'U.S. Person' as defined by applicable law, which includes U.S. citizens, lawful permanent residents, refugees, and asylees.

Key job responsibilities
Train and assist internal customers and stakeholders with the creation, design, configuration, validation, installation, commissioning and operation of BMS and EPMS systems.

Provide technical assistance and support to operations during life cycle of the data center.  Review results and action items from the quarterly maintenances for BMS and EPMS and take actions to get them resolved.

Develop BMS & EPMS projects scope of work, schedule, budget, and level of efforts (LOE) to projects requested by customers and stakeholders.

Manage scope, schedule, finance and execution of BMS and EPMS improvement projects in AWS data centers.

Assist in procurement related activities including request for quotation/proposals, responding to request for information, review of vendors proposal and issuance of purchase orders.

Participate in AWS global on-call schedule to provide immediate BMS and EPMS technical support to in-service data centers.

Attend project related meetings, coordinate with project leaders and regularly report status to Controls and stakeholders’ management.

Support Controls projects related commissioning activities in the data centers.

Review, implement, troubleshoot and iterate on the controls sequence of operation (SOO) and provide necessary feedback to the design team.

Develop and modify controls logic programming and graphical user interfaces.

Manage multiple stakeholder deliverables, requirements and navigate challenging situations.

Financially manage BMS and EPMS service contracts.

Frequently visit (locally) assigned in-operation and/or under construction data centers to troubleshoot, meet customers, supervise vendor’s work to ensure compliance with the scope, design, SOO and applicable local codes.

[Option for New Region] Travel required: 50% to 75% travel to construction job sites across United States, Canada, and Latin American countries to support construction and data center product delivery. Must have valid passport, be able to obtain visas, and be able to meet travel, entry, and re-entry requirements for travel between the United States and destination countries.

A day in the life
As a Data Center Controls Engineer, your primary customers are Data Center Engineering Operations (DCEO), who depend on you to deliver reliable, well integrated Building Management Systems (BMS) and Electrical Power Monitoring Systems (EPMS). The problems you solve are technical: modifying controls logic to address operational issues, developing Methods of Procedure (MOPs) for firmware upgrades, or investigating complex alarm discrepancies across monitoring systems. For new builds, you own the controls scope from vendor submittal review through commissioning and turnover. You manage vendor relationships, budgets, and schedules for both service contracts and capital projects. Your internal stakeholders include your Controls Manager, Controls Technicians you provide technical direction to, and partner teams (Construction, Critical Projects Implementation, Commissioning, DCEO).

About the team
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

Why AWS

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Diverse Experiences

Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Work/Life Balance

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

Inclusive Team Culture

Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (gender diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

Mentorship and Career Growth

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Basic qualifications

- Experience with Industrial control systems, both hardware and software
- Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or an equivalent engineering science plus 3+ years of relevant controls experience, OR 8+ years of relevant controls experience in lieu of a degree.
- 3+ years of experience with industrial controls in critical environment (data center, pharmaceutical, oil & gas, petrochemical, laboratory, power, water etc.).
- 2+ years of general project or vendor management experience (request for proposals, bidding, change orders, quality control, and RFI and submittal tracking) associated with construction and project execution.

Preferred qualifications

- Master's degree or above in Mechanical or Electrical Engineering
- Experience designing, configuring, programming, installing, troubleshooting or servicing HVAC Controls or Electrical SCADA systems application specific controllers, software and networks.
- Experiencing using common industrial communication protocols (MQTT, BACnet and/or MODBUS).
- Demonstrated understanding of engineering documentation, electrical and mechanical diagrams, and standard operating procedures.
- Ability to manage multiple stakeholder deliverables, requirements, and navigate difficult situations.
- Experience designing data centers or critical MEP infrastructure
- Registered as a Professional Engineer (PE), or certified Project Management Professional (PMP).
- Prior AWS/Amazon experience
- 4+ Yr. Military Service

title: Operations Intern
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Operations is the backbone of the Amazon customer experience. With over 50 fulfilment centres, hundreds of delivery stations, and tens of thousands of employees, the team works together to efficiently deliver items to customers. In the fulfilment centres, millions of items are picked and packed annually, while delivery teams work to get orders to customers on time. Safety is the top priority, and the operations culture is defined by teamwork, diversity, and a shared work ethic that keeps the business running smoothly. The team takes pride in delivering the quality service Amazon is known for globally.
Note: You must have the right to work in the country of employment by the start date.

Key job responsibilities
As an Amazon operations intern, you'll have the opportunity to apply your analytical skills to impactful projects that enhance the functionality and service of Fulfillment Centers, Sortation Centers, and Delivery Stations. Key aspects of the role include:
• Completing high-priority projects to the highest standard, demonstrating your ability to deliver results
• Analyzing data to identify operational challenges and opportunities for improvement
• Proposing and testing solutions, collaborating with the team to implement the most effective ones
• Developing communication and teamwork skills by working with managers, stakeholders, and frontline associates.
• Be on the move within the building to engage with various teams. This includes actively gathering knowledge by participating in activities such as pre-briefs, flow meetings, and discussions with the leadership team and associates.
• Ability to navigate the workspace and move between different areas is essential for this position.
• Displaying flexibility to work various schedules and shift patterns as required.
• Potential relocation to the designated work location.

A day in the life
Our internships are educational opportunities that allow you, our future managers, to discover how we lead and develop our teams of associates. You'll immerse yourself in the fast-paced, complex world of our Fulfillment Centers, Sortation Hubs, and Delivery Stations, witnessing how our managers engage their teams to fulfill customer expectations.
This internship will place you at the heart of our operations, enabling you to trace the journey of a customer order. You'll gain a realistic job preview of the full-time opportunities awaiting you within our organization.
You'll learn how our managers cultivate a safe, productive environment, harnessing the full potential of their teams through effective engagement and performance management strategies. This is your chance to develop skills that will propel you towards a rewarding career with Amazon.

Basic qualifications

- Currently in your penultimate or final year and working towards a university degree in Supply Chain, Business/Management, Engineering or another related field.
- Eligible to complete a full-time internship of 3-6 months.
- Highly proficient in both spoken and written English and the local language of the country you are applying for (Common European Framework of Reference C1).

Preferred qualifications

- Strong problem-solving and analytical skills, with the ability to identify process improvements and innovative solutions.
- Excellent communication and teamwork skills, able to collaborate effectively with others.
- Demonstrated curiosity, proactivity, and willingness to take on challenges in an ambiguous, fast-paced environment. Amazon is an equal opportunities employer

title: Onsite Medical Representative
descriptionHtml:
Join Amazon’s mission to become Earth’s safest place to work! At Amazon, we’ve set the ambitious goal to become the benchmark of safety excellence across all industries in which we operate. The Amazon Workplace Health & Safety (WHS) team sets the strategic direction to provide resources, best practices, and safe environments to proactively manage the health and wellbeing of our workforce. To support these goals, Amazon is seeking an experienced and dynamic Onsite Medical Representative (OMR) to join our team. In this position, you will work closely with the WHS Site Manager, WHS Specialist, and occasionally the Injury Prevention Specialist (IPS). This includes attending weekly associate safety committee meetings, greeting all new hires for the site or through daily one-on-one interaction. Additionally, the OMR will participate in weekly case management review meetings as necessary.

As an OMR, you will independently assess and administer first aid as well as offer guidance to Amazon Associates (AAs) on both occupational and non-occupational injuries or illnesses. You should be passionate about learning and advocating health and wellness principles to consistently support AAs on a daily basis. You will refer care to outside medical providers as needed, and learn about OSHA regulations, risk, and analysis.

The OMR will function as a part of the larger team onsite, assisting with all first aid needs and support safety operations as needed.

Responsibilities include but are not limited to:
- Provide first aid support and make referrals to outside medical providers as necessary.
- Minimize the AA risk of injury through awareness, education, and proactive engagement.
- Maintain all records of care provided to AAs.
- Coordinate and maintain the workers’ compensation and return to work programs for AAs with work-related injuries.
- Provide daily activity logs and end of shift reports.
- Engage with AAs and leadership on operations floor to provide coaching regarding observed at-risk work habits.
- Maintain a clean working environment and ensure appropriate medical supply inventory is maintained.
- Participate in training and certification to facilitate first aid, CPR and AED certifications classes.
- Maintain all first aid, CPR, AED credentials.
- Work flexible shifts which could include days, nights, holidays, and/or weekends.
- Assist with random saliva drug testing protocols.
- Maintain effective care delivery in emergencies and assist emergency response at the site.

Additional Job Elements include:
- Lift up to 49 pounds and frequently push, pull, squat, bend, and reach
- Stand/walk for up to 12 hours during shifts
- Work in an environment where the noise level varies
- Work in an environment that is subject to variable temperatures and weather (delivery stations include outside loading departments)
- Continuously climb and descend stairs (applies to sites with stairs)

For those that do not have an adult First Aid, CPR, AED certification from the American Heart Association or American Red Cross, must obtain within 3 weeks of start date.

Basic qualifications

- High school or equivalent diploma
- Current valid Basic Life Support (BLS) certification by an approved emergency cardiac care (ECC) provider; AND must have one of the following:
- Current valid Emergency Medical Technician (EMT) OR Paramedic Certification from the Department of Health OR the National Registry of Emergency Medical Technicians (NREMT); OR
- Current active Athletic Trainer Certification, by either the Board of Certification (BOC) or equivalent State Certification.

Preferred qualifications

- Certified to teach first aid, CPR, and AED training from American Heart Association or American Red Cross
- Proficient in Microsoft Office
- Experience with an industrial wellness program
- Experience managing musculoskeletal disorders, ergonomics, and coaching on body mechanics
- Demonstrated work experience with OSHA regulations and Workers Compensation
- Proficient in digital recordkeeping
- In the last year, six months job experience in the Military as a Combat Medic (U.S. Army), Field Medic (U.S. Army), Healthcare Specialist (U.S. Army), Hospital Corpsman (U.S. Navy), or Aerospace Medical Service Technician (U.S. Air Force)

title: Brand Designer, Devices Brand Studio
descriptionHtml:
Device Brand Studio, an internal agency within the Devices group at Amazon, is seeking a talented Brand Designer to help bring new Amazon offerings to market, products, services, and features within our devices portfolio. The Brand Designer will execute brand identity and creative assets for product lines and campaigns within Amazon Devices, working within established brand systems and creative direction.

The ideal candidate has a strong foundation in visual design, typography, and brand systems, and the ability to take creative direction and translate it into polished, on-brand work across a range of formats. You will work closely with creative directors, art directors, and copywriters to bring concepts to life, iterating quickly based on feedback and factoring in customer and business requirements. You should be comfortable presenting your work to peers and leads, taking direction well, and knowing when to ask questions versus when to execute. You should have working knowledge of brand guidelines and creative briefs at a top consumer-facing brand like Amazon.

Because the work is varied and fast-paced, you should have strong craft fundamentals and the ability to manage your own time across multiple projects. You will partner with creative directors, art directors, copywriters, and production to deliver design work across product detail pages, merchandising assets, retail fixtures, and packaging.

This role is for a design-forward contributor who executes with precision, takes direction well, and is looking to grow their craft within a fast-moving in-house creative team.

Key job responsibilities

title: 2027 Applied Scientist Internship – PhD, Amazon University Talent Acquisition
descriptionHtml:
We're building systems that turn research into real-world impact — developing AI-driven detection systems that identify and remediate security access violations across Amazon's global operations, and building ML solutions that leverage product images, text, and tabular data to improve safety and compliance mechanisms across Amazon's entire product catalog. If this sounds interesting to you then we have a range of opportunities for you to explore.

We're looking for PhD students across multiple research domains to invent, design, and implement state-of-the-art solutions for never-before-solved problems. Your work here won't just stay in a notebook — it ships to production and reaches customers worldwide.

Check out the details below including the job responsibilities, team details, and basic qualifications before submitting your application.

You can find more information about the Amazon Science community as well as interview preparation tips via the links below;

- https://www.amazon.science/
- https://amazon.jobs/content/en/career-programs/university/science
- https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/university-roles/applied-science

Key job responsibilities
As an Applied Science Intern, you will own the design and development of end-to-end systems. You'll have the opportunity to write technical white papers, create roadmaps and drive production level projects that will support Amazon Science.

You will work closely with Amazon scientists and other science interns to develop solutions and deploy them into production. You will have the opportunity to design new algorithms, models, or other technical solutions whilst experiencing Amazon's customer focused culture.

The ideal intern should have the ability to work with diverse groups of people and cross-functional teams to solve complex business problems.


A day in the life
You'll spend your first weeks scoping your project with your mentor, then own the research and implementation end-to-end.

Your work could involve building graph-based ML models and knowledge graphs that detect and remediate access violations at global scale, developing behavioral pattern clustering and automated reasoning systems for security operations, or researching multimodal and computer vision approaches on product catalog data to improve safety and compliance mechanisms — depending on the team you're matched with.

Many interns publish at top-tier conferences or see their work deployed to production before the internship ends. Interns may also be considered for a return offer at the end of their internship, subject to performance evaluation and headcount availability.

Further benefits of an Amazon Science internship include;

- All of our internships offer a competitive salary
- Interns are paired with an experienced manager and mentor(s)
- Interns get invited to different intern program or office events
- Interns can build their professional and personal network with other Amazon Scientists
- Interns can potentially publish work at top tier conferences

About the team
We generally hire interns for multiple teams in Romania, including but not limited to;

• CoSS — Research and develop ML solutions that improve safety and compliance across Amazon's entire product catalog working with tabular, textual, and product image data using deep learning, computer vision, LLMs, and multimodal models

• Monitored Access Detection — Build AI-driven detection and remediation systems that identify global access violations across Amazon — leveraging knowledge graphs, graph modeling, behavioral pattern clustering, generative AI, and reinforcement learning to create a self-improving, closed-loop security system.

You'll submit a single application and we'll match you with science teams best aligned with your research interests.

Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis, and your application stays active until we find a team match or confirm there are no matches available.

Start dates are available throughout the year for durations of between 3–6 months. Please note, each team has different start date and duration preferences — your recruiter will confirm the preferences of the team you're matched with prior to interviewing.

We offer science internships in multiple locations across the EMEA region and you can indicate your interest in all these locations by applying here (Austria, Estonia, France, Germany, Ireland, Israel, Italy, Jordan, Luxembourg, Netherlands, Poland, Romania, South Africa, Spain, Sweden, UAE, and UK).

Please note we do not offer remote internships.

Basic qualifications

- Are enrolled in a PhD in computer science, machine learning, engineering, or related fields
- Experience programming in Java, C++, Python or related language
- Speak, write, and read fluently in English

Preferred qualifications

- Have publications at top-tier peer-reviewed conferences or journals
- Experience in solving business problems through machine learning, data mining and statistical algorithms
- Experience in designing experiments and statistical analysis of results
- Experience implementing algorithms using both toolkits and self-developed code

descriptionHtml:
We are seeking Applied and Research Scientists to join the Safe Autonomy Frontiers (SAF) Lab. In this role, you will develop and deploy the science of safe autonomy on highly dynamic robots, advancing the frontier through both foundational research and realization on hardware. You will contribute to achieving safe autonomy across three key areas: control barrier function (CBF) theory for robust and performant safety on hardware; safe reinforcement learning for agile whole-body control; and layered safety filters that interface with learning, perception, and semantic reasoning systems. You will validate your work experimentally on state-of-the-art robotic platforms — removing bottlenecks to deployment and enabling robots to safely operate around humans. You will work with the inventor of CBFs, as well as top scientists and engineers at Amazon developing the next generation of safe autonomy.

Key job responsibilities
-Advance the science of safe autonomy from formal foundations to the integration with learning and perception to validation on hardware — with particular emphasis on methods that bridge these domains.
-Test and validate hardware, with a focus on next generation robotic systems. Including locomotion, manipulation and loco-manipulation.
-Leverage the deployments on hardware to validate the underlying science, identifying gaps between theory and practice that drive the next cycle of research. hardware to validate the underlying science, identifying gaps between theory and practice that drive the next cycle of research.
-Publish research at top-tier robotics, control, and ML venues, and contribute to Amazon’s scientific reputation in advanced robotics.
-Collaborate with SAF Lab and Amazon production teams to move research into robots deployed at Amazon scale.

About the team
The Safe Autonomy Frontiers (SAF) Lab is the first industry research lab dedicated to safe autonomy, founded by the inventor of control barrier functions. We are developing a universal safety layer for the next generation of robotic systems: mobile robots, manipulators, quadrupeds, and humanoids. Here you will advance performant safety for highly dynamic robots — CBF theory integrated with perception and learning, evaluated on next-generation platforms — and your work will underpin robots operating alongside people at Amazon’s unprecedented scale.

Basic qualifications

- PhD or equivalent research experience
- Master’s degree and 3+ years of applied science, research, or robotics engineering experience — OR a PhD — in computer science, robotics, control, mechanical engineering, electrical engineering, or a related field.
- Hands-on experience developing and deploying control algorithms and/or learning policies on physical robotic hardware in a research or production setting (not simulation-only).
- Working knowledge of safety-critical control, including control barrier functions and safety filters.
- Proficiency in C++ and Python, with a track record of implementing control algorithms and/or learning policies in real systems.
- Experience with physics simulators for robotics (e.g., Isaac Gym/Sim, MuJoCo, PyBullet).
- Demonstrated technical impact through shipped systems, patents, or publications at top-tier venues (e.g., CDC, ACC, L-CSS, ICRA, IROS, RSS, RA-L, Automatica, TAC, TRO).

Preferred qualifications

- Experience in professional software development, including production code quality, testing, and deployment practices.
- Experience taking robotics or autonomy research from prototype to deployed product, including collaboration with hardware, product, and operations teams.
- Understanding of autonomous systems, reduced-order models, layered control architectures, nonlinear control, reachability methods, legged locomotion, and whole-body control.
- Knowledge of learning-based approaches to robotics (e.g., reinforcement learning, diffusion, VLAs, VLMs, world models).
- Exposure learning-based approaches for CBF synthesis (e.g., neural CBFs, data-driven barrier functions) and the integration of CBFs into learning (e.g., CBF-RL).
- Understanding of control systems engineering, with a focus on layered architecture in robotic systems (high-level planning, mid-level trajectory generation, low-level feedback control).
- Experience with perception on robotic systems (e.g., depth-camera and LiDAR-based sensing, sensor fusion, semantic tagging), together with mapping and navigation.
- Familiarity with Hamilton-Jacobi reachability analysis and its relationship to CBF-based approaches.
- Knowledge of safety-constrained RL (e.g., constrained MDPs, Lagrangian methods, shielding, CBF-based policy filtering).
- Experience with model-based control (MPC, whole-body QP controllers, operational space control) and/or simulation-based predictive control (MPPI).
- Experience with hierarchical RL, skill composition, distillation, and multi-task policy architectures for locomotion.
- Familiarity with real-time deployment constraints (latency budgets, onboard compute limitations, control-loop frequencies).
- Experience building or contributing to large-scale RL training infrastructure (distributed training, GPU clusters).
- Strong communication skills and ability to work across disciplinary boundaries (ML, controls, mechanical engineering).

title: Principal CSM-T, EC2 Capacity
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform, and Amazon Elastic Compute Cloud (EC2) is its largest and most consequential service. As customers accelerate workloads spanning generative AI training and inference, large-scale analytics, and mission-critical production systems, AWS’s ability to plan, commit, and deliver compute capacity at scale is a defining competitive advantage. As an AWS Principal Customer Solutions Manager-Tech (Principal CSM-T) in the EC2 Capacity Customer Experience organization, you will lead the most strategic capacity engagements for AWS’s largest global compute and ML customers, owning the strategic planning of their long-range capacity solutions and creating sustained business value through the reliable delivery of compute at scale.

You identify and solve the most intrinsically complex business and technical problems in capacity across multiple business units, geographies, and customers, with solutions that are as simple as possible. You lead and execute engagements in highly undefined and rapidly evolving environments, creating and shaping long-range capacity strategies where information is incomplete or conflicting, and creating structure and clarity for customers, partners, executives, and internal teams. Using exceptional judgment and deep technical acumen, you drive these initiatives from ambiguity to measurable results and value realization. You bring focus and strategic direction across enterprise-wide capacity initiatives and cross-organizational teams, aligning entire organizations around shared outcomes measured in billions of dollars of customer workload.

You orchestrate execution across enterprise workload portfolios by aligning business and technical priorities with internal and external stakeholders, ensuring long-term value realization. You translate significantly complex technical and supply concepts into clear recommendations and strategies that change how organizations plan and commit capacity at scale. You apply advanced technical expertise and rapidly adopt emerging technologies, including AI, to navigate complexity and make the critical decisions that keep multi-quarter and multi-year capacity plans on track. You earn customer trust as a strategic advisor through solving their most complex capacity challenges, and you demonstrate exceptional communication skills across all organizational levels, up to and including the C-suite, independently presenting to executive audiences. Every initiative you deliver is measured not only by its immediate success but by the mechanisms and best practices it leaves behind, raising the bar for what AWS and customers can jointly achieve.



Key job responsibilities
As a Principal Capacity CSM-T, you will:
• Lead the most strategic, enterprise-wide capacity engagements for AWS’s largest global compute and ML customers, identifying and solving highly complex business and technical problems across multiple business units, geographies, and partner organizations.
• Own and drive long-range (multi-quarter and multi-year) capacity and scaling plans that translate customer growth forecasts into concrete infrastructure commitments, and own the end-to-end accountability for delivering against them.
• Serve as a trusted advisor to senior executive stakeholders, up to and including the C-suite, shaping long-term capacity, cloud, and AI strategy and influencing critical capital-allocation decisions.
• Organize complex demand signals into supportability scenarios that enable VP+ leaders to make informed capital allocation decisions, partnering with Supply Chain and Finance to quantify trade-offs and recommend positions.
• Orchestrate execution across large, complex workload portfolios, aligning business and technical priorities across internal and external stakeholders to ensure long-term value realization.
• Architect scaling mechanisms, review cadences, and best practices that improve forecast accuracy, delivery fidelity, and operational efficiency across the customer’s organization and across AWS, not just within a single engagement.
• Influence product, engineering, and supply roadmaps based on patterns observed across strategic customers, and partner with engineering to build the tooling and simulation that improve demand forecasting, commitment tracking, and delivery visibility.
• Develop and mentor other team members, extending your influence and best practices across the capacity and customer solutions management community.


A day in the life
A typical day starts by checking in on the long-range initiatives you’re driving, whether that’s an upcoming executive briefing, a major GPU or ML buildout milestone, or a planning workshop with a customer’s infrastructure leaders. You might spend the morning with a customer’s VP of Infrastructure, walking through a multi-year scaling plan and pressure-testing forecast assumptions, then move into a room with EC2 Supply Chain and Finance leaders to present supportability scenarios for a significant capacity expansion and drive alignment on which to fund. Some days you are deep in a technical discussion on how a customer’s ML roadmap maps to Trainium and GPU supply; other days you are pulling together a business case, prepping a leadership review, or coaching a teammate through a complex customer situation. Given the size and complexity of these relationships, you will often be pulled into problems that have no obvious playbook, and that is part of what makes the role interesting.

Basic qualifications

- 10+ years of senior customer facing role experience
- 15+ years of leading complex, large-scale, IT, technical or engineering programs experience
- Bachelor's degree in Science, Technology, Engineering, Math, or a related field
- Experience in a senior customer-facing role
- Experience in leading complex, large-scale, IT, technical or engineering programs
- Experience working with current technologies (especially cloud)

Preferred qualifications

- PMP/SCRUM/Agile certification or are you SAFe certified
- Knowledge of key technology and market trends
- Knowledge of the software development/engineering lifecycle from conception to delivery
- Experience implementing AWS/cloud services
