title: Energy Analytics, TPM, Global Energy, Sustainability and Automation
descriptionHtml:
The Energy Analytics, Technical Program Manager (TPM) will scale power monitoring, insight generation, and energy and carbon reduction initiatives across Amazon's North America fulfillment operations. In this hands-on technical role, you will deploy and generate analysis from power metering infrastructure and implement load flexibility and energy optimization roadmaps that deliver measurable cost savings and carbon reductions. This work directly supports Amazon's demand-side power requirements and Climate Pledge commitments.

You will operate as an individual contributor, owning the delivery of defined and ambiguous work-streams while partnering with engineering, controls, data, operations and deployment teams to implement changes. You will influence cross-functional partners without authority, primarily at the team and management level, using data to drive decisions. You will integrate and analyze power metering information, providing load forecasts and generating cost and energy savings opportunities. Utility rate structures, time of day, demand ratchets and power factor penalties will influence your strategies. Technical assets influenced can include material handling, robotics, powered industrial trucks, lighting, heating ventilation and air conditioning, plug loads, electrical metering and more. Developed projects will be scaled across hundreds of facilities across the network, producing energy, cost and carbon benefit.

Key job responsibilities
● Build and execute technical solutions for energy and carbon reduction from pilot, data collection, through scaled implementation and measurement & verification (M&V) of results.  Energy and load optimization via control systems is a technical requirement: energy-conservation/standby modes, variable speed applications, and equipment scheduling.
● Drive continuous monitoring and energy efficiency improvements with Amazon's energy consuming assets.  Integrate power metering into our data sets, and develop analytics to identify opportunities, assess trending consumption changes, and measure benefits of conservation efforts.
● Prepare written analysis of feasibility studies and recommendations for various energy monitoring and power flexibility strategies.  Own metering data quality programs, check readings for completeness, outliers, and flag actionable improvements, and reconcile against known loads to ensure trusted insight generation.
● Develop metrics, baselines, and roadmaps that translate technical work into quantified outcomes (energy savings, cost savings or utility tariff arbitrage, load forecast, reliability, carbon reduction).
● Define and own technical approach and cross-system architecture for data configuration, standards and mechanisms for scalability and enforcement of key energy savings mechanisms. Decide how to build and prove new approaches managing tradeoffs for necessary business needs, rather than executing a defined scope.
● Manage projects against plans and objectives to ensure commitments are met, delivering against our power and Climate Pledge goals.
● Deep diving (troubleshooting) and unblocking issues that are prohibiting teams from pursuing energy reduction initiatives.
● Work with critical stakeholders on developing mechanisms for design standard integration for launching facilities that incorporate energy optimization procedures from Day 1.
● Analyze and communicate the financial impact of projects and initiatives (payback, return on investment, net present value)
● Serve as a technical reviewer for peers and partner engineers — reviewing control logic, metering architecture, and design-standard changes, and improving them on technical merit
● Quantify and own value add of energy savings mechanisms and how they reduce equipment runtime and increases reliability and lifespan.
● Calculate and report energy, water and carbon savings using International Performance Measurement and Verification Protocol methodologies.
● Manage multiple, complex projects simultaneously.
● Produce clear documentation, playbooks, and reporting that make work-streams repeatable.

A day in the life
You might spend the morning querying newly integrated power-metering data and validating it against the distribution-panel hierarchy — resolving a data-quality gap — then analyzing load profiles and build an energy-savings or peak-shaving model that quantifies the opportunity by equipment class. You then define network rollout suitability and prioritize these opportunities across sites. In the afternoon you develop control logic changes to implement an efficiency opportunity, propose updates to a design standard, or define a measurement method for implemented energy and cost savings to your stakeholders. You balance trade-offs between energy savings, technical complexity, equipment reliability, and cost — bringing well-reasoned recommendations and escalating the most ambiguous decisions for alignment.

About the team
The Global Energy, Sustainability and Automation (GESA) Energy team is dedicated to delivering energy efficiency, cost savings, and demand flexibility within Amazon's fulfillment network. We partner closely with design, controls, data, procurement, operations, field engineering, and deployment teams — as well as external vendors — to ensure our energy consumption is monitored and optimized. Our focus in the coming years is scaling our energy monitoring and analytics programs, expanding behavioral and retrofit programs, expanding load flexibility for power resilience and cost arbitrage benefit, and enhancing asset reliability and lifespan through efficient operation. If you are energized by large-scale technical challenges and want to make a tangible impact on energy use, this is the team for you.

Basic qualifications

- 5+ years of technical product or program management experience
- Bachelor's degree in engineering, computer science or equivalent
- Experience in SQL Server/MySQL, or experience in Redshift and experience in any Bigdata architecture
- Experience working with existing and emerging technologies related to building energy (i.e. power metering, conveyance, robotics, controls, HVAC, charging infrastructure)

Preferred qualifications

- Experience managing cross-functional programs and release schedules
- Familiarity with automation engineering and controls engineering concepts.
- Industry certifications: Certified Energy Manager, Certified Measurement & Verification Professional, Professional Engineer.

- Supportare e formare il personale affinché assicuri un servizio d’eccellenza e supervisionarlo nello svolgimento delle mansioni quotidiane.

title: Account Manager, Startups
descriptionHtml:
Trusted by more startups around the world, AWS makes the power of cloud computing accessible for all by giving founders everywhere access to the same technology that powers the world’s largest companies. With nearly 20 years experience gained from supporting hundreds of thousands of startups that have come before, we help founders prove that their world-changing ideas are possible, at any stage of growth or level of funding. This is why more startups, and over 80% of unicorns, build on AWS.

As AWS continues to rapidly grow, we seek a Startup Account Manager to earn trust and help drive growth amongst a set of well-funded, high-potential startups.

Startups represent a critically important subset of customers to AWS. These companies have unique needs, technical considerations, sales cycles, and growth trajectories that distinguish them from traditional companies. These businesses require different engagement strategies and sales motions from sellers to effectively acquire, grow, and retain them on the AWS platform long-term.

The ideal candidate possesses strong sales acumen, knowledge of the startup ecosystem, and a passion for (and familiarity with) Cybersecurity. You will be working with startups building innovative solutions, so extensive collaboration with both external and internal teams will be key to build and execute on plans to meet and exceed sales quota. Your responsibilities will include driving revenue, accelerating innovation through service adoption, and ensuring these startups select AWS as their primary cloud provider. You will work closely with product and service teams, business development, marketing, solution architecture and partner teams to drive customer outcomes.

title: Supply Chain Manager II, Technology Materials Planning
descriptionHtml:
The OpsTech Solutions - Supply Chain (OTS-SC) team plays a critical role in supporting Amazon's Worldwide (WW) Stores business by overseeing planning, purchasing, procuring, provisioning, assembling, shipping, deploying, and managing IT equipment. This team is responsible for facilitating new site launches, retrofits, expansions, relocations, colocations, decommissions, customer programs, and lifecycle programs.

Within this dynamic environment, the Supply Chain Mgr will play a crucial role for executing integrated planning activities across demand planning, supply planning, and production scheduling. The role requires hands-on ownership of planning processes to ensure equipment is available and deployed on time, in full (OTIF), and in alignment with evolving business needs.

The ideal candidate brings a strong mix of supply chain expertise, data fluency, and technical acumen. This includes leveraging AI/ML models to enhance forecast accuracy and optimize planning decisions, while driving process automation and systems integration at scale. Acting as a cross-functional bridge between business, operations, and technical teams, the Supply Chain Mgr will play a pivotal role in shaping how OTS-SC anticipates and meets demand with speed, precision, and agility.


Key job responsibilities
- Own and execute end-to-end supply chain planning across demand forecasting, supply planning, and production scheduling to ensure on-time, in-full (OTIF) delivery of IT hardware and infrastructure.
- Translate demand signals and business requirements into executable supply and production plans, collaborating closely with procurement, capital planning, and deployment teams.
- Develop and maintain data-driven forecasting models that integrate historical trends, project inputs, and operational constraints.
- Identify and mitigate planning risks including demand variability, supplier lead times, and production capacity limitations through proactive scenario planning and cross-functional alignment.
- Lead the development and enhancement of internal planning tools and applications that improve forecast accuracy, material visibility, inventory management, and automation of planning processes.
- Act as the functional owner and product lead for key supply chain systems—gathering requirements, defining roadmaps, and ensuring tools meet the evolving needs of users and stakeholders.
- Collaborate with technical teams (data engineering, software developers, BI/analytics) to build scalable solutions that integrate ERP, supply chain, and procurement systems.
- Drive the development and deployment of planning tools and dashboards using platforms such as Redshift, PowerBI, Quicksight, or Tableau to enable real-time visibility and decision-making.
- Leverage AI/ML models to enhance demand forecasting, anomaly detection, and exception-based planning to reduce manual workload and improve decision-making.
- Conduct user testing, implement feedback loops, and continuously iterate on tools and features to drive adoption and maximize impact across planning workflows.
- Partner with cross-functional stakeholders (Product, Operations, Finance, Engineering) to align tool development and planning strategies with broader business objectives.
- Monitor key planning and system adoption KPIs (forecast accuracy, fill rate, inventory turns, tool usage) and report findings in regular business reviews.

Our team supports a wide range of initiatives, including new site launches, retrofits, data center expansions, relocations, and lifecycle management programs. OTS-SC thrives on solving complex challenges with speed, precision, and creativity. Collaboration is at the heart of everything we do—working cross-functionally with engineering, finance, program management, and operations teams to ensure success from plan to deployment.

title: Senior Program Manager, Technology Supply Chain Organization Program Enablement
descriptionHtml:
Amazon's Technology Supply Chain is scaling, and the hardest part of that growth is getting an entire organization to change how it works. We are looking for a Senior Program Manager to own the change management discipline across Technology Supply Chain and make new ways of working the way the organization operates by default. You will design adoption approaches grounded in established change management methodologies such as Prosci/ADKAR and Kotter's 8-Step, build the communications that move behavior, and decide what to do when adoption stalls. You are comfortable in ambiguity and able to influence leaders and teams you do not manage. Success in this role is adoption: the standards you introduce become how teams actually operate. You will start with changes already in flight and build a discipline that applies to whichever change the organization adopts next. Over time the role grows. You will deepen expertise in change management and AI-assisted operations, and your scope will widen from driving individual changes to shaping how the whole organization absorbs change.

Key job responsibilities
- Own the change management discipline across Technology Supply Chain, partnering with leadership to shape the change strategy and owning its execution. Apply stakeholder analysis, readiness assessment, and resistance management to determine goals and design adoption approaches in ambiguous situations where the problem is not yet fully defined.
- Build adoption frameworks, playbooks, communications, and enablement materials that take each new way of working from something that exists to something the organization does by default, drawing on established change frameworks such as Prosci/ADKAR and Kotter.
- Partner with reporting, governance, and tooling teams to drive adoption of shared ways of working across all customer groups, influencing leaders and teams you do not directly manage to align on how the organization operates.
- Establish adoption measurement and reporting so progress and risk are visible before a change fails, own the judgment on how to respond when adoption stalls, and build the documentation and processes that make new ways of working durable beyond any single individual.

A day in the life
You spend your day building the organization's capacity to change. You partner with leadership to shape the change strategy, then own how it comes to life: assessing why change stalls and fixing it at the root rather than rescuing one rollout at a time. You coach leaders to be effective sponsors of the changes they own, because that is where change succeeds or fails. You sequence a portfolio of concurrent changes so the organization adopts them without saturating, and build the methodology and standards that let every team run change well. You work across every Technology Supply Chain group and influence leaders you do not manage. Your real product is not any single rollout. It is an organization that can change without breaking.

About the team
Technology Supply Chain delivers the full lifecycle of technology fulfillment for Amazon, sourcing, delivering, and deploying the hardware, infrastructure, and equipment that Amazon's Worldwide Stores operations and AWS data centers run on. As Amazon's technology footprint grows, Technology Supply Chain is the organization that keeps the supply chain behind it ahead of demand. Our team is the central program management and business operations function within Technology Supply Chain. Our principle is "enable rather than simply do": we take recurring programmatic work off every team through shared standards, processes, and tooling so each team can focus on the specialized work only it can do, and we build our own automation to do it.

Basic qualifications

- 5+ years of program or project management experience
- Experience using data and metrics to determine and drive improvements
- Experience owning program strategy, end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership

Preferred qualifications

- 2+ years of driving process improvements experience
- Master's degree, or MBA in business, operations, human resources, adult education, organizational development, instructional design or related field
- Knowledge of general AI tools
- Experience designing, implementing, and scaling upskilling, apprenticeship, or workforce development programs across large-scale operations or corporate environments, including forecasting workforce needs and leveraging analytics to drive program decisions

descriptionHtml:

Bei Amazon setzt du dein Wissen direkt in der Praxis ein. Du arbeitest an Anlagen, die Produkte durch eines der komplexesten Logistiknetzwerke der Welt bewegen. title: Senior Systems Engineer, Amazon Special Projects
descriptionHtml:
Innovators wanted! Are you an entrepreneur? A builder? A dreamer? This role is part of an Amazon Special Projects team that takes the company’s Think Big leadership principle to the highest levels. We focus on creating entirely new products and services with a goal of positively impacting the lives of our customers. No industries or subject areas are out of bounds. We launched products such as Comprehend Medical, Echo Frames and Amazon Explore. If you’re interested in innovating at scale to address big challenges in the world, this is the team for you.
As the Sr. Systems Engineer, you will own the agent daemon that runs on compute nodes, the runtime sandbox that isolates workloads, and the local storage and caching layer that determines which assets are resident and ready to serve. You will build the detection logic that manages node availability, and the GPU capability reporting that tells the scheduler exactly what each node can handle. Your work directly determines whether the platform can deliver low-latency ML inference — and whether it can do so reliably at scale.

Key job responsibilities
- Design and implement the agent daemon on Linux, including GPU discovery, availability detection, and sandboxed container execution for ML inference workloads.
- Architect the local caching system — eviction policies, versioned manifests, disk budget management, and efficient update mechanisms that minimize data transfer for large model files.
- Build VRAM management and graceful workload migration logic.
- Integrate hardware attestation with the security engineer and support diverse hardware configurations and fleet onboarding automation.

About the team
Amazon Special Projects is a small, high-autonomy team building new-to-Amazon infrastructure from scratch. The systems component is where software meets hardware: you will build the on-node runtime — the agent, sandbox, GPU manager, and local storage layer — that makes a compute node reliable, secure, and performant. This is systems engineering at its most tangible — your code runs on real hardware and must be resilient to everything the real world throws at it.

Basic qualifications

- 6+ years of programming with at least one modern language such as C++, C#, Java, Python, Golang, PowerShell, Ruby experience
- 6+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
- 6+ years of designing or architecting (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
- Experience leading the design, build and deployment of complex and performant (reliable and scalable) software solutions in production
- 6+ years of systems design, software development, operations, automation, and process improvement experience
- 7+ years of experience in systems programming (Rust, Go, or C++)
- Deep knowledge of Linux internals, including process scheduling, memory management, and storage subsystems
- Hands-on experience with container runtimes (Docker, containers, or custom sandboxes)
- Experience with GPU tooling and management (nvidia-smi, NVML, CUDA runtime)
- Demonstrated ability to build software that runs reliably on heterogeneous hardware

Preferred qualifications

- Knowledge of engineering practices and patterns for the full software/hardware/networks development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, certification, and livesite operations
- Experience taking a leading role in building complex software or computing infrastructure that has been successfully delivered to customers

title: Network Development Manager, Amazon Dedicated Cloud (ADC) Networking
descriptionHtml:
Application deadline: Applications will be accepted on an ongoing basis

Amazon's network is a key differentiator for AWS, enabling the global operation of thousands of applications across hundreds of thousands of servers worldwide. Amazon Dedicated Cloud (ADC) extends that platform to the U.S. Government's most sensitive workloads, delivering AWS inside air-gapped, classified regions where the bar for reliability, security, and operational rigor is at its highest.

We are looking for a Network Development Manager to hire, manage, and develop a team of Network Development Engineers responsible for the end-to-end operational health of the ADC network. You will own capacity management and forecast planning, implementation, automation, change control, process management, and continuous improvement across the classified partitions. You will represent networking to service teams, infrastructure partners, and government stakeholders, ensuring we meet their needs for innovation, delivery, and safe operations in an environment where the margin for error is small and much of the tooling and telemetry commercial teams rely on has to be built.

At Amazon, we ask our technical leaders to be strong engineers who dive deep and help their engineers make sound decisions and deliver quality solutions. You will maintain a solid technical understanding of routing, switching, optical transport, and network automation, and ensure the right expertise exists on the team. You will also be a thoughtful people manager who mentors your engineers and builds an environment of mutual trust and respect, which matters even more in ADC where teams are smaller, more isolated, and carry a heavier operational load per person. The ideal candidate has a track record of driving operations and continuous improvement for large-scale, mission-critical networks, a passion for operational excellence, and the judgment to safely implement change, measure performance, and respond to events so the network always operates as intended.

The candidate selected must obtain and maintain a security clearance at the TS/SCI with polygraph level. Upon start, the selected candidate will be sponsored for a commensurate clearance for each government agency for which they perform AWS work.

Key job responsibilities
- Own the end-to-end operational health of the ADC network across the classified partitions: availability, performance, change control, and continuous improvement.
- Hire, develop, and retain a team of Network Development Engineers; own onboarding, career growth, 1:1s, and mentoring.
- Run a sustainable on-call rotation that honors SLAs without burning out a small classified-region team.
- Ensure network changes are designed, reviewed, and executed safely at scale under ADC's access and change-control constraints.
- Drive incidents and availability risks to resolution, and own Correction of Error (COE) follow-through so problems do not recur.
- Manage operations with data, metrics, and dashboards; build the monitoring, automation, and tooling ADC has historically lacked.

A day in the life
You lead a team of Network Development Engineers operating AWS's network inside classified regions. A typical day mixes 1:1s and career coaching with reviewing network changes, walking through an incident or COE with an engineer, and unblocking cross-team dependencies. You spend time on the metrics that show where the network and the team need attention, and on the tooling, automation, and monitoring ADC is still building. You balance day-to-day operations against longer-term parity and capacity goals, and you represent networking to service, infrastructure, and government partners. You also participate in a management on-call escalation rotation.

title: Software Development Manager, Digital Acceleration
descriptionHtml:
Want to define the next generation of financial record keeping products for Amazon businesses? Excited to build products that manage billions of dollars of transactions? Ready to rise to the challenge of enabling an ever-growing set of businesses across the company looking for automation of their accounting models?

The Financial Record Keeping (FRK) organization within Digital Acceleration is reimagining accounting automation with AI: simplifying and speeding up end-to-end accounting automation through a new architecture and AI augmented accounting automation capabilities. As a Software Development Manager, you will independently lead a team of software engineers while shaping the technical direction of next-generation financial automation programs. You will influence architecture decisions across multiple teams, partner with business stakeholders, and drive product direction in a space where complex problems meet real customer impact. If you enjoy working through ambiguity, defining strategic paths, and building systems at massive scale using AWS and big data technologies, this is the role for you.

Key job responsibilities
- You will define and manage a product roadmap to build specialized AI tools to manage accounting automation for Amazon.
- Define and drive the technical vision and architectural direction for financial record keeping systems that support Amazon's digital businesses at scale.
- Lead and grow an inclusive team of software development engineers — recruit top talent, coach and develop engineers at multiple levels, and create an environment where the team delivers successfully and sustainably.
- Contribute to system design discussions, evaluate tradeoffs across scalability, maintainability, and performance, and guide your team through deep-dive troubleshooting and root-cause analysis of complex issues.
- Collaborate with cross-functional partners — including product management, peer engineering teams, and business stakeholders — to align priorities, resolve dependencies, and deliver cohesive solutions.
- Establish operational excellence practices, publish meaningful metrics, and build mechanisms that improve software quality, reduce repeated work, and enhance the customer experience over time.

A day in the life
Your morning might start with a design review where your engineers walk through a proposed architecture for a new accounting automation service, and you help the team pressure-test assumptions and tradeoffs. After that, you join a cross-team sync with product and business partners to align on upcoming roadmap priorities. In the afternoon, you spend time in a one-on-one with a direct report, discussing their career growth plan and identifying stretch opportunities. Later, you review operational metrics for your services and work with the team to triage an emerging trend before it becomes a customer-facing issue.

About the team
The Digital Acceleration FRK team builds the financial record keeping systems that power Kindle eBooks, Prime Video, Amazon Appstore, Amazon Music, Digital Software and Video Games, and a growing list of Amazon's digital businesses. title: Sr. Power Electronics Engineer, Prime Air Electric Propulsion Subsystem
descriptionHtml:
We are seeking a Sr. Power Electronics Engineer to join our Electric Propulsion Subsystem team. In this role, you will be a significant and autonomous contributor, solving difficult hardware engineering problems related to high-power electronics systems. You will design, develop, and validate power electronics boards from concept through production, working on 10KW+ high-voltage DC systems that push the boundaries of performance, reliability, and efficiency.

This position requires an engineer who demonstrates strong technical depth in power electronics while also exhibiting the system-level thinking and influence characteristic of our most impactful contributors.

Key job responsibilities
• Design, develop, and test multi-layer power electronics board layouts for high-voltage DC systems (10KW+), from initial concept through volume production release.
• Define and execute power electronics component architecture, including topology selection, component specification, and thermal management strategies.
• Lead the development of test plans that validate designs against DO-160 and DO-274 standards, ensuring electromagnetic compatibility, environmental resilience, and functional safety.
• Ensure designs meet appropriate IP (Ingress Protection) ratings for target deployment environments.
• Apply system-level thinking to understand how power electronics subsystems integrate with and influence the broader product architecture.
• Partner effectively with cross-functional peers, suppliers, and contract manufacturers to build and validate designs, driving alignment on technical trade-offs.
• Deliver accurate time-based estimates for engineering tasks and manage design milestones through the product development lifecycle.
• Create and maintain high-quality design documentation including schematics, specifications, analysis reports, and test results.
• Contribute to design reviews, providing constructive technical feedback to teammates and cross-functional partners.
• Identify risks and defects early in the design phase and proactively propose solutions that balance performance, cost, and schedule.
• Improve team processes, tools, and methodologies; develop firmware, software, or scripts that aid development or testing of power electronics hardware.



A day in the life
You independently drive the design and delivery of power electronics hardware, making sound trade-offs between performance, cost, manufacturability, and schedule. Your test plans thoroughly validate designs and efficiently address system integration challenges. You think in terms of the system, not just individual components, and proactively work to improve the overall product architecture. Your work is consistently high quality, meeting safety, regulatory, and reliability standards. You influence your team's technical direction and are recognized as a go-to resource for power electronics expertise.

About the team
The New Experimental Technology (NEXT) Electric Propulsion Subsystem (EPS) organization conducts technology research, design and development of the power system for Prime Air’s drones. We are responsible to deliver an EPS and hardware components that safely supports 15-minute drone delivery and is certifiable by the FAA and EASA regulators.
Our work spans the full product lifecycle, from early-stage research and concept development through detailed design, prototyping, testing, and certification support. The EPS is a critical system enabling Prime Air’s autonomous delivery operations, providing the electrical power generation, storage, distribution, and propulsion capabilities required for safe and reliable flight.

Basic qualifications

- Experience working with interdisciplinary teams to execute product design from concept to production
- 7+ years of hands-on experience with multi-layer power electronics PCB layout and design.
- 7+ years of experience working on high-voltage DC power systems rated at 10KW or above.
- Demonstrated experience developing power electronics boards from concept through production.
- Proficiency with power electronics design tools (e.g., Altium, OrCAD, ECAD tools, MATLAB/Simulink for power system modeling).

Preferred qualifications

- Master's degree or Ph.D. degree in Electrical Engineering or related field
- Experience leading vendor engagements and manufacturing partner discussions for power electronics assemblies.
- Familiarity with thermal simulation, power integrity analysis, and high-voltage creepage/clearance design rules.
- Experience with rapid prototyping techniques and low-volume manufacturing of power electronics hardware.
- Track record of delivering stable, performant hardware solutions that meet cost and quality targets.
- Ability to decompose complex power system challenges into well-defined component-level design tasks.
- Experience with reliability testing, HALT/HASS, and failure analysis of power electronics systems.
- Demonstrated ability to influence technical decisions across teams and communicate complex trade-offs to non-technical stakeholders.
- Contributions to intellectual property (patents, trade secrets) in the power electronics domain.
- Working knowledge of DO-160 and DO-274 design and test standards.
- Understanding of IP (Ingress Protection) rating requirements and design-for-environment principles

descriptionHtml:

You will engage with product owners to influence product direction and help our customers tap into new markets by utilizing GenAI along with AWS Services.

The ASPI Energy & Utilities Specialist Team is seeking an experienced and deeply technical Data and AI Solutions Architect to accelerate AI adoption across Global energy and power customers. descriptionHtml:
Amazon's CloudTune organization is seeking a Senior Software Development Engineer to join the Scaling Efficiency team. CloudTune ensures that Amazon's infrastructure is right-sized at the right time, powering capacity decisions for thousands of EC2-based services across Amazon. title: Sr. Software Development Engineer, Neuron Explorer
descriptionHtml:
Annapurna Labs designs silicon and software that accelerates innovation. Customers choose us to create cloud solutions that solve challenges that were unimaginable a short time ago—even yesterday. Our custom chips, accelerators, and software stacks enable us to take on technical challenges that have never been seen before, and deliver results that help our customers change the world.

AWS Neuron is the complete software stack for the AWS Trainium and Inferentia cloud-scale machine learning accelerators and the Trn3/Trn2/Trn1 and Inf2/Inf1 servers that use them. This role is for a Sr. Software Development Engineer on the Developer Experiences (DevEx) team within AWS Neuron, based in Toronto.

The Neuron Explorer team makes AWS Trainium performance visible. We own Neuron Explorer, the tool for profiling, debugging, and optimizing machine learning workloads on Trainium and Inferentia. We build profiling, debugging, and analysis tools that let engineers see how efficiently models and kernels use the hardware, pinpoint bottlenecks, and decide what to optimize next. Neuron Explorer traces execution from source code down to hardware operations across both single-node and distributed applications. Our goal is to cut through complex execution data so customers can optimize faster and reach higher performance on Trainium.

As a Sr. Software Development Engineer for the Neuron Explorer team, you will design, build, and operate the full stack behind Neuron Explorer — from low-level performance data collection and analysis engines to interactive visualizations and developer workflows. You will own features end to end, spanning the backend processing pipeline, the web UI, and the CLI, and you will help push our AI-powered recommendation and analysis capabilities that automatically surface bottlenecks and guide optimization.

Key job responsibilities
- Design and build performance data collection pipelines and analysis engines that transform raw hardware execution data into actionable insights for Neuron Explorer users.
- Develop interactive visualizations and developer workflows that make complex profiling data understandable, helping customers pinpoint bottlenecks across single-node and distributed training workloads.
- Own features end to end across the full software development lifecycle — from scoping and design through implementation, testing, deployment, and operations — ensuring reliability and maintainability.
- Collaborate with compiler, runtime, and chip architecture teams to surface the right performance information so internal and external customers can optimize AI workloads on Trainium and Inferentia hardware.
- Evaluate and integrate generative AI capabilities into Neuron Explorer's recommendation engine, building features that automatically identify optimization opportunities and guide customers toward higher performance.

A day in the life
You will work across the backend processing pipeline, the web UI, and the CLI that make up Neuron Explorer, partnering with compiler, runtime, and chip architecture teams to expose the data customers need to optimize their models. You will work with senior technical leaders and management to define product direction and deliver it to customers, including teams bringing massive-scale multi-modal large language models to peak performance on Trainium. We build the full stack of software, servers, and chips to accelerate machine learning at the highest scale.

About the team
Inclusive Team Culture

Here at Amazon, we embrace our differences. We are committed to furthering our culture of inclusion. We have ten employee-led affinity groups, reaching 40,000 employees in over 190 chapters globally. Our team puts a high value on work-life balance. It isn't about how many hours you spend at home or at work; it's about the flow you establish that brings energy to both parts of your life. title: Sr. Software Dev Engineer, AWS PrivateLink
descriptionHtml:
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion

AWS PrivateLink carries private connectivity for roughly 200+ AWS services and third-party providers, without traffic crossing the public internet. For many customers it sits on their critical availability path, and for those whose policies prohibit public egress it is the only route.

We are hiring a Senior SDE to build the next generation of PrivateLink: a control plane engineered for 20x our current tens of thousands of TPS, a data plane to match, and the product vision behind both.

The goal is private connectivity that keeps pace with AI. Inference platforms, agentic systems, and ML pipelines now provision and reconcile connectivity continuously, at machine speed, and move far more data over it. The limits in our way are structural, not numbers we can raise. The read path, the tenant isolation model, the provisioning architecture, and how bandwidth scales with demand are all open decisions, and you will make several of them.

We have built real agentic tooling for migration, test generation, and operational analysis. You will use it and extend it.

Key job responsibilities
* Shape the product vision for private connectivity in AI-native environments, working directly with AWS service teams and large external partners on what they need from us next.
* Own the architecture and delivery of core components of the next generation of PrivateLink, across both the control plane and the data plane, targeting 20x current scale.
* Make the foundational design decisions that are still open, and bring AWS service teams and senior engineers along with them.
* Build for multi-tenant isolation and fairness, and scale capacity with demand rather than manual intervention, so one customer's growth never becomes another customer's latency.
* Execute against live production traffic with no maintenance window, operate what you build, and extend the team's agentic tooling for migration, test generation, and operational analysis.

About the team
The AWS PrivateLink team builds and operates the technology that enables customers to securely access AWS services, third-party applications, and their own services over the Amazon VPC network—without exposing traffic to the public internet. As a Sr. SDE on this team, you'll design and scale highly available, low-latency networking infrastructure that powers private connectivity for millions of endpoints worldwide. You'll tackle complex distributed systems challenges, drive architectural decisions, and mentor engineers—all while helping customers simplify their network security posture at cloud scale.

Basic qualifications

- 5+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
- 5+ years of programming with at least one software programming language experience
- 5+ years of leading design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
- Experience as a mentor, tech lead or leading an engineering team

Preferred qualifications

title: Software Development Engineer II, Display Protocols
descriptionHtml:
We are the Display Protocols team behind Amazon WorkSpaces Personal and Applications, the cloud desktop platform that lets millions of users provision secure Windows or Linux desktops and access them from any device or browser. If you like working on problems where latency, security, reliability, and scale all collide at once, this is your kind of role.

You'll be joining the AWS Applied AI Solutions organization, where our mission is to build intuitive, differentiated business applications — powered by Amazon's real-world experience — that millions of companies use to run their day-to-day operations. We build opinionated, turnkey solutions that customers choose to buy over build, and we aim to be the trusted partner they don't have to think twice about. The End User Computing market is growing at an incredible pace right now, which means you'll be solving some of the most interesting problems in providing secure, fast, highly scalable streaming infrastructure — while working across industry-leading AWS services. Our team is innovating across multiple areas to deliver the best-in-class interactive streaming platform, and as an SDE you'll own features end-to-end, ship to real enterprise and ISV customers, and have a direct hand in shaping what world-class application streaming looks like next.

We are looking for passionate SDEs who want to build their career in End User Computing. If this sounds interesting to you, talk to us!

Key job responsibilities
As an SDE on the Display Protocols team, you'll design and build features for our cloud desktop and interactive streaming platform — end to end, from scoping through production. You'll write clean, maintainable code that runs at scale, optimize real-time streaming paths for latency and reliability, and operate what you ship (including on-call). You'll work across multiple AWS services to deliver secure, highly available infrastructure that enterprise and ISV customers depend on daily. Expect to dive deep into performance — profiling, benchmarking, identifying bottlenecks — and collaborate with senior engineers on system design and architecture decisions. You'll participate in code reviews, raise the bar on engineering standards, and contribute to operational excellence across the team. When something's broken or could be better, you take initiative and fix it. You'll also help us figure out how to scale — both technically (millions of concurrent desktops) and as a team (mentoring, improving processes, writing useful documentation). The End User Computing space is evolving fast, so you'll frequently evaluate new approaches and help decide where we invest next to keep our streaming platform best-in-class.

A day in the life
On a typical day, you'll balance executing on our long-term roadmap with responding to emerging customer issues and finding inventive ways to satisfy new customer needs. You'll work closely with engineers, product managers, and partner teams across AWS like networking and security. Your customers are enterprise IT organizations and ISV partners who need desktops that are reliable, secure, and fast — so the feedback loop is tight and the problems are real. Beyond regular engineering work, there's always room to stretch into areas like mentoring or shaping team direction.

title: Business Analyst, Customer Experience, Amazon Air
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Air operates more than 100 flights a day across North America and is growing fast. The Customer Experience (CX) team owns the analytical frameworks that connect fleet performance, network operations, and on-time delivery outcomes for customers.
We are looking for a Business Analyst who can work on complex, ambiguous problems and turn operational data into clear, actionable insights. You will build and maintain the metrics, dashboards, and data pipelines that drive daily and weekly decision-making across the Amazon Air network. Your work will directly shape how the team understands and improves delivery performance for customers.


Key job responsibilities
• Own the design, development, and maintenance of operational dashboards and performance metrics that track delivery quality across the Amazon Air network, including DEA (Delivery Experience Attainment) and related indicators.
• Identify and investigate delivery performance gaps by diving deep into large, complex datasets across multiple data sources including Redshift, Andes, PerfectMile, and DataCentral.
• Build and maintain ETL pipelines and automated reporting solutions that reduce manual effort and improve the speed and accuracy of operational insights.
• Own the Misbucketing AIR process — identifying packages incorrectly attributed to Air operations and driving corrections through data — and continuously improve the intake and classification workflow.
• Support the AirWatch program by maintaining and improving dashboards that provide visibility into aircraft out-of-service events and their downstream impact on delivery performance.
• Partner with supply chain managers and operations leaders to translate business questions into analysis requirements, and present findings to senior stakeholders.
• Recognize and adopt best practices in reporting and analysis: data integrity, test design, analysis validation, and documentation — ensuring pipelines and dashboards can be independently maintained by others.
• Apply generative AI tools to accelerate insight generation and automate routine monitoring and reporting workflows.


A day in the life
On Monday, a delivery performance gap surfaces overnight. You pull the data, trace it to a root cause in the misbucketing pipeline, and have a draft fix to the data engineering team before the morning stand-up.
On Wednesday, an ops leader needs to understand why one gateway is running 15% above its defect target. You build the breakdown, identify the two drivers, and present a one-page summary that gets acted on the same day.
By Friday, you have pushed an updated dashboard to production, cutting a three-hour manual reporting process to fifteen minutes. The team uses it in Monday's business review.
No two weeks look the same.


About the team
Amazon Air's Customer Experience team sets the course for delivering more promises on time across a fast-growing network. We spot risks before they hit customers, and we build the mechanisms that turn a single root cause fix into a lasting improvement across the network.
We work directly with flight planning, linehaul, and data science teams to turn operational insight into action. We use GenAI to automate manual work so we can spend more time solving the next problem instead of reporting on the last one.
We are a small, hands-on team. Every person owns real outcomes, not just analysis.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree or equivalent
- 3+ years of tax, finance or a related analytical field experience
- 5+ years of Excel (including VBA, pivot tables, array functions, power pivots, etc.) and data visualization tools such as Tableau experience
- Experience with SQL
- Experience making business recommendations and influencing stakeholders

Preferred qualifications

- Experience partnering with executive-level leaders to identifying and solving business issues
- Experience with SQL and database technologies such as AWS Redshift and expertise in performance tuning and scaling in a DWH environment
- Experience in ETL management/data pipeline
- Experience utilizing R or Python
- Experience in program management, logistics, operations, supply chain, transportation, or a related field
- Experience applying generative AI tools to automate analytical or reporting workflows

title: Sr Software Engineer- Simulation, Fauna
descriptionHtml:
Fauna uses simulation to train robots, evaluate their behavior, and develop new capabilities before deploying them in the real world. We’re looking for a Simulation Software Engineer to build the environments, tools, and systems that make this possible—from generating diverse virtual worlds to testing robot behavior and running simulation at scale.

You’ll partner with scientists, robotics engineers, and technical artists to expand what robots can experience in simulation and what our teams can build with it. Your work could span procedural scene generation, automated evaluation, interactive experiences, and remotely hosted simulation. We welcome backgrounds in robotics, real-time systems, simulation, and scalable data infrastructure.

Key job responsibilities
- Develop workflows for generating, configuring, and managing diverse scenes, assets, and scenarios.
- Extend simulation to support robot capabilities and interactions among robots, people, and dynamic environments.
- Make simulation experiments reproducible and easy to inspect, with tools for automated evaluation, debugging, and regression testing.
- Build reliable pipelines for generating, processing, and managing simulation data.
- Scale simulation through automation, workload orchestration, and remote hosting, supporting both batch workloads and interactive use.
- Partner with scientists and technical artists to improve simulation performance, usability, and fidelity to real robot behavior (sim2real).

About the team
Fauna Robotics, an Amazon company, is building capable, safe, and genuinely delightful robots for everyday life. Our goal is simple: make robots people actually want to live and interact with in everyday human spaces.

We believe that future won’t arrive until building for robotics becomes far more accessible. Today, too much effort is spent reinventing the fundamentals. We’re changing that by developing tightly integrated hardware and software systems that make it faster, safer, and more intuitive to create real-world robotic products.

Our work spans the full stack: mechanical design, control systems, dynamic modeling, and intelligent software. The focus is not just functionality, but experience. We’re building robots that feel responsive, expressive, and genuinely useful.

At Fauna, you’ll work at the frontier of this space, helping define how robots move, manipulate, and interact with people in natural environments. It’s an opportunity to solve hard problems across hardware and software with a team focused on making robotics accessible and joyful to build.

If you care about making robotics real for everyone and building systems that are as delightful as they are capable, we’d like to hear from you.

Basic qualifications

- 5+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
- 5+ years of programming with at least one software programming language experience
- 5+ years of leading design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
- Experience as a mentor, tech lead or leading an engineering team
- Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent
- Experience developing robotics software, simulation systems, real-time applications, or scalable data pipelines.

Preferred qualifications

- 5+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
- Experience with robotics simulation frameworks or real-time 3D engines, such as Isaac Sim, Isaac Lab, MuJoCo, Unreal Engine, or Unity.
- Experience with procedural scene generation, asset management, sensor simulation, or rendering.
- Experience with distributed systems, cloud-hosted simulation, or infrastructure for model inference and evaluation at scale.
- Experience building evaluation frameworks or tools for inspecting, replaying, and testing complex system behavior.
- Familiarity with sim2real transfer, domain randomization, or evaluating robot capabilities across varied environments.
- Working knowledge of 3D math, including coordinate transforms, quaternions, and camera models.

title: Area Manager, EF Operations
descriptionHtml:
アマゾンジャパン オペレーションズ部門のEF（External Fulfillment）オペレーションチームでは、チームをリードし、EF拠点のオペレーション管理・改善を行うマネージャーを募集します。
EFチームは、Amazonのお客様が注文した商品の注文処理・配送業務を自社の物流拠点（FC、フルフィルメントセンター）ではなく、メーカー/ 卸売企業の倉庫内や協力会社（以下3PL）の運営する倉庫で行うExternal Fulfillment（外部サイトから顧客への直接出荷）のサービスを拡張することによって、コスト削減、配送スピードの向上、セレクションの拡充、そしてお客様の満足度の向上に貢献しています。
このポジションでは、アマゾンの出荷・在庫能力の一翼を担うEF拠点の運営管理・改善、ピープルマネジメントを通じたメンバー育成が主要な業務になります。マネージャーとして多様なメンバーが能力を発揮できる組織の仕組み作りやカルチャーの醸成を推進いただける方を求めています。

【業務内容】
1．外部委託するオペレーションの標準化を行い、管理指標に基づいた安全な職場環境作り、品質管理、在庫・出荷計画の遂行に責任を持ちます。
2. プロジェクトメンバーとして社内外の取り組みに参加します。案件によっては、プロジェクトオーナーとして広く部門・チーム横断的な取り組みをリードします。
3. マネージャーとしてチームメンバーの育成に責任を持ちます。またチーム全体のDEI文化の醸成に向けた取り組みにも参加して頂きます。

年次、月次、週次で作成されたマスタープランに基づき、達成するべき要件（安全、品質、入荷・出荷の能力、在庫キャパシティ、コスト）毎に個別計画を明確にし、3PL各社のオペレーションが円滑に遂行されることに責任を負います。
また日々のオペレーションを管理するだけでなく、新しいサービスやプログラムの導入、新規拠点の立ち上げなど、3PL各社との調整のみならず、広く社内の他部門（リテールビジネス、セラービジネス、配送オペレーション、ファイナンス、リーガル、人事など）ともコミュニケーションを取り、プロジェクトの立上げから管理運営を行います。

Essential Functions [% of Time]
1.　25%:　EF拠点の管理運営
2.　25%:　指標管理と関係部署との調整
3.　25%:　新規プロジェクト等の取り組み
4.　25%:　チームメンバーの育成・管理

【ポジションの特徴】
・スピード感のある業務
この仕事の最も重要なポイントは、迅速に変化に対応しリードしていく事にあります。EFチームは、３PL各社との協業により、自社の物流拠点（FC）では対応が難しい新しいビジネスや商材にも高い柔軟性をもって取り組み、またスピーディにEF拠点を立ち上げることでAmazonのビジネスの成長戦略を支え、お客様の満足度の向上に貢献しています。
・業務領域の広さ
社内外に広くステークホルダーを持ち、アマゾンのサプライチェーン全体を意識しながら、広い視点を持って業務に取り組める業務領域の広さが特徴です。

【働き方について】
勤務時間は、原則、9：00～18：00で、月1-2日土日勤務あり(代休取得)
プロジェクト対応や現場確認など業務上の必要性から出張もありますが、メリハリをつけて業務に取り組める環境です。

title: Data Quality Specialist - Swedish, AGI Data Services - G T Quality
descriptionHtml:
Quality Specialists play a vital role in establishing and maintaining comprehensive quality frameworks across our operations. Their primary responsibility begins with developing robust quality strategies in collaboration with customers and CPMs, encompassing metrics, audit approaches, and specific targets for each workflow. When quality issues arise, these specialists create prescriptive actions, examining data patterns to formulate effective solutions. They maintain a continuous improvement cycle by managing a critical feedback loop between operations and customers, drawing insights from multiple sources including quality auditors, side-by-side observations, and metric analysis. Through regular side-by-side sessions, they identify opportunities for workflow enhancement and quality improvements. The specialists serve as key escalation points for customer concerns, providing strategic recommendations based on their deep understanding of processes. They consistently evaluate quality tools, suggesting refinements to enhance effectiveness, while simultaneously maintaining and updating process documentation to ensure standardization and clarity across all workflows. This comprehensive approach ensures quality remains at the forefront of our operational excellence.

Key job responsibilities
* Define and implement quality metrics for established workflows
* Create prescriptive actions for quality issues
* Partner with customers, operations and internal support teams to optimize workflow quality
* Conduct side-by-sides to identify opportunities for workflow enhancement and quality improvements
* Analyze data trends and develop solutions
* Monitor quality performance and coach operations teams
* Create and maintain quality metrics reports
* Handle customer escalations and recommendations
* Evaluate and suggest improvements for quality tools
* Support process documentation and implementation

A day in the life
Your day starts by checking quality dashboards for your assigned workflows — reviewing audit scores, appeal rates, SLA status, and any overnight escalations. You will spend approximately 30% of your time on analysis: reviewing data trends, investigating root causes of quality dips, and creating prescriptive actions for operations teams.

Another 30% goes to stakeholder communication: leading weekly customer meetings, preparing quality reports, and handling escalations. The remaining time is split between process work (updating SOPs, refining audit rubrics, conducting side-by-sides) and calibration activities (aligning audit standards with Senior Quality Auditors and operations teams).

You are measured on: SLA metrics (appeals and batch completion), customer satisfaction, quality improvement trends for your workflows, and documentation quality.

About the team
The Quality Operations team within FAI Data Services ensures that labeled training data meets accuracy and consistency standards before it is used to train Amazon's AI models. Quality Specialists own the quality strategy for assigned workflows, bridging the gap between operations execution and customer expectations.

Basic qualifications

- Speak, write, and read fluently in Swedish
- Intermediate-level proficiency in English (B2+ or equivalent fluency by CEFR standards)
- 1+ years of experience in a quality assurance, quality control, or data quality role
- Experience defining, tracking, and reporting quality metrics or KPIs
- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to identify root causes and develop prescriptive actions
- Experience working with data to identify trends, patterns, and quality issues
- Ability to create and maintain process documentation, SOPs, or quality guidelines

Preferred qualifications

- Experience leveraging technology and implementing lean principles / Six Sigma methodologies to drive process improvements or equivalent
- Experience communicating with a wide range of stakeholders, including colleagues and leadership, or experience with external customer interaction
- Knowledge of at least one data-focused technology tool, such as Python, SQL, Alteryx, Amazon QuickSight, or similar
- Bachelor's degree in a relevant field (e.g., Linguistics, Data Science, Business, or related discipline)
- Demonstrated ability to build or improve quality frameworks, audit processes, or feedback loops
- Experience coaching or providing quality feedback to operations or associate-level teams
- Ability to adapt to fast-paced environments with evolving workflows, priorities, and quality targets
- Experience in machine learning data operations, annotation quality, or content review workflows

title: Principal Engineer, Amazon Software Builder Experience (ASBX)
descriptionHtml:
As a Principal Engineer in Amazon Software Builder Experience (ASBX), you will be one of the most senior technical leaders in the organization, setting technical direction for platforms and services that thousands of Amazon builders depend on. You will tackle ambiguous, large-scale problems that span multiple teams and systems, and translate them into clear, durable technical strategies.

Principal Engineers at Amazon are hands-on technologists and force multipliers. You will combine deep technical expertise with broad influence — writing and reviewing designs, raising the engineering bar, mentoring senior engineers, and partnering with engineering leaders to make the right long-term architectural and investment decisions. Your work will directly shape developer experience, software quality, delivery velocity, and operational safety at Amazon scale.

Key job responsibilities
- Set and drive technical strategy for complex, high-impact platforms and services used broadly across Amazon's engineering community.
- Decompose ambiguous, large-scale problems into simple, scalable, and maintainable solutions, and define multi-year technical roadmaps.
- Lead the design and architecture of distributed systems that operate reliably at massive scale.
- Raise the engineering bar through design reviews, code reviews, operational excellence practices, and mentorship of senior and principal-track engineers.
- Partner with engineering, product, and science leaders to align technical direction with organizational goals and customer needs.
- Identify and prioritize the highest-leverage opportunities to improve how Amazon builders develop, build, test, deploy, and operate software — including opportunities created by Generative AI and agentic development.
- Influence engineering standards and best practices across team and organizational boundaries.
- Balance long-term transformation with incremental, measurable delivery of value.

A day in the life
You spend your time where the hardest technical problems are. You dive deep into architecture, write and critique design documents, and get close to the technology to understand root causes. You are frustrated by inefficiencies that make building software unnecessarily difficult, and you channel that into durable solutions. You move fluidly between hands-on technical work and high-leverage influence — unblocking teams, aligning stakeholders, and mentoring the next generation of technical leaders. You think in terms of systems and in terms of the builder's experience, and you consistently simplify complexity rather than add to it.

About the team
Amazon Software Builder Experience (ASBX) is the AWS organization dedicated to improving the experience of software builders across Amazon. ASBX owns the foundational platforms, tools, and services that Amazon's engineering community uses to design, build, test, deploy, and operate software — at a scale measured in millions of operations every day.

Amazon builders are both our customers and our proving ground: the systems ASBX creates are used by thousands of engineers to ship features for Amazon's customers worldwide. Our teams work across the full software development lifecycle — source control, build systems, continuous integration and delivery (CI/CD), testing and verification, developer tooling, and the broader developer productivity ecosystem.

We are operating at an inflection point. Generative AI and coding agents are fundamentally reshaping how software is created, reviewed, and released. ASBX is at the forefront of reimagining developer tooling for an AI-native future — where both human and AI builders collaborate to produce software faster, more safely, and at greater scale than ever before. This creates a rare opportunity to influence the direction of software engineering practice across one of the world's largest and most sophisticated development communities.

Basic qualifications

- Extensive professional software development experience, including significant experience designing and architecting new and existing large-scale systems.
- Demonstrated experience designing and building large-scale, multi-tiered, distributed, or highly concurrent software systems and services.
- Deep expertise in software design patterns, reliability, scalability, and operational excellence.
- Proficiency in one or more modern programming languages (e.g., Java, C++, C#, or similar).
- Experience leading technical direction across multiple teams and influencing engineering decisions beyond a single team's scope.
- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

Preferred qualifications

- Experience as a Principal Engineer or equivalent senior technical leadership role at scale.
- Experience building developer-facing platforms, tools, or services (e.g., source control, CI/CD, build systems, testing/verification, or developer productivity tooling).
- Experience applying Generative AI or agentic approaches to software development, tooling, or developer productivity.
- Experience building services on AWS.
- Track record of mentoring senior engineers and growing technical leaders.
- Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to make complex technical trade-offs clear to both technical and non-technical audiences.

descriptionHtml:
Amazon.com – a place where builders can build. We hire the world's brightest minds and offer them an environment in which they can invent and innovate to improve the experience for our customers. A Fortune 100 company based in Seattle, Washington, Amazon is the global leader in e-commerce. Amazon offers everything from books and electronics to apparel and diamond jewelry. We operate sites in Australia, Brazil, Canada, China, France, Germany, India, Italy, Japan, Mexico, Netherlands, Spain, United Kingdom and United States, and maintain dozens of fulfillment centers around the world which encompass more than 26 million square feet.

We want you to help share and shape our mission to be Earth's most customer-centric company. Amazon's evolution from Web site to e-commerce partner to development platform is driven by the spirit of invention that is part of our DNA. We do this every day by inventing elegant and simple solutions to complex technical and business problems. We're making history and the good news is that we've only just begun.

About the Role Program Manager
We are looking for high-potential, flexible, innovative, and forward-thinking professional to join Amazon. Are you ready to drive high-visibility and strategic programs as well as leverage Lean methodologies to lead process improvement initiatives? Are you equally comfortable digging into business requirements as you are driving operational efficiencies?

Join Amazon Transparency team as a Program Manager, we are looking for candidates with a strong record of owning and executing strategic, cross-functional projects as well as partnering with other teams to drive key process improvement programs.

This role requires working with business teams across the company to provide data driven operations support key to the success of the initiative. You will also analyze operations’ data and processes to identify key customer issues/challenges that will help us improve our processes and provide higher value to our customers. This is an opportunity that requires a critical thinker with strong organizational, problem-solving, and communication skills. At the core of the position is passion for protecting Amazon’s reputation and the customer experience and trust.

Key job responsibilities
· Work with product management teams to understand program requirements and jointly develop a solution which solves a larger business problem

· Develop team goals and metrics that allow for accurate measurement and traction towards solving a business problem, achieve buy-in from a broad spectrum of stakeholders and actively report progress on the goals

· Continuously perform data based analysis to identify issues and report key insights, subsequently building data backed business cases

· Use industry proven tools such as lean/six sigma to drive operational efficiencies and quality improvement in the operations team under your purview

· Develop and maintain key relationships with internal stakeholders locally and around the world

· Own, help set up and scale new operations’ programs/launches, defining processes, KPI, goals, governance and reporting

· Experience working cross functionally with tech and non-tech teams

- Bachelor's degree in relevant field, or 2+ years of Amazon RME (BB/3P) full time experience

- Experience in MS Access and SQL
- Experience with Six Sigma tools and Lean techniques

descriptionHtml:
NOC (Network Operations Center) is the central command and control center for ‘Transportation Execution’ across the Amazon Supply Chain network supporting multiple geographies like NA, India and EU. It ensures hassle free, timely pick-up and delivery of freight from vendors to Amazon fulfillment centers (FC) and from Amazon FCs to carrier hubs. In case of any exceptions, NOC steps in to resolve the issue and keeps all the stakeholders informed on the proceedings. Along with this tactical problem solving NOC is also charged with understanding trends in network exceptions and then automating processes or proposing process changes to streamline operations. This second aspect involves network monitoring and significant analysis of network data.
Overall, NOC plays a critical role in ensuring the smooth functioning of Amazon transportation and thereby has a direct impact on Amazon’s ability to serve its customers on time.

Purview of a Trans Ops Specialist
A Trans Ops Specialist at NOC facilitates flow of information between different stakeholders (Trans Carriers/Hubs/Warehouses) and resolves any potential issues that impacts customer experience and business continuity. This role is a part of the centralized Network Operations Centre (NOC) org part of Amazon India. This role is based in Dalian, China and will be required to work for Amazon Japan.


Key job responsibilities
· Communication with external customers (Carriers, Vendors/Suppliers) and internal customers (Retail, Finance, Software Support, Fulfillment Centers)
· Ability to pull data from numerous databases (using Excel, Access, SQL and/or other data management systems) and to perform ad hoc reporting and analysis as needed is a plus.
· Develop and/or understand performance metrics to assist with driving business results.
· Ability to scope out business and functional requirements for the Amazon technology teams who create and enhance the software systems and tools are used by NOC.
· Must be able to quickly understand the business impact of the trends and make decisions that make sense based on available data.
· Must be able to systematically escalate problems or variance in the information and data to the relevant owners and teams and follow through on the resolutions to ensure they are delivered.

title: Senior Systems Engineer, Sarsen
descriptionHtml:
Would you like to help implement innovative cloud computing solutions and solve the most complex technical problems? Are you excited by the prospect of building and running the world's largest cloud computing infrastructure to provide a better world for future generations?

Amazon Web Services (AWS) builds and operates some of the largest internet infrastructure on the planet; providing companies of all sizes with an infrastructure web services platform in the cloud. With AWS, customers provision compute power, storage, database, and other cloud resources as their business demands them. To meet the growing demand for AWS Services around the globe, we need exceptionally motivated people who are driven by learning and innovation.

Key job responsibilities
Amazon has a collaborative, purposeful and enthusiastic environment where we “Work Hard, Have Fun, Make History.” On a typical day engineers might dive deep into understanding the root cause of a customer issue, investigate why a metric is trending the wrong way and consult with the top engineers at Amazon. We own our services and believe in making out-of-hours support as painless as possible. To achieve this, we implement Operational Excellence best practices and strive to automate manual processes.

Our Senior Systems Engineers are considered technical leaders for their team and become subject matter experts in multiple services. They work efficiently and routinely deliver the right things with limited guidance. They use technology to solve complex problems. They are able to improve and/or drive improvements to these services and features for their team. They understand how their work impacts multiple teams. They are able to take a project, when the problem is not defined and deliver on schedule, applying appropriate technologies and industry systems-engineering best practices. They make effective implementation trade-off decisions and are able to assist others with trade-off decisions.

Our Senior Systems Engineers identify when implementations are not highly available, performant, secure, stable, maintainable, or have defects; and are able to determine short- and long-term mitigations. They have a depth and breadth of understanding in multiple areas of technology and they are excellent diagnosticians. They utilise their Linux expertise to troubleshoot, innovate fixes and workarounds, keep software up-to-date and provide data and metrics that help manage the capacity and efficiency of services.

Our Senior Systems Engineers are able to lead team design, scoping, and prioritization discussions. They understand how technical decisions impact their team, and other, teams’ services and recommend opportunities and solutions for these problems. They optimize and/or automate team processes, ensuring they meet organisation goals. They lead implementation reviews (e.g., designs, code, operational readiness, deployment plans, system changes, etc.). They anticipate and mitigate patterns that affect the performance, reliability, or availability of their team(s) systems to create automation that simplifies workloads that scale operations.

Our Senior Systems Engineers drive SOP, documentation, and runbook creation, reviewing them for accuracy; they drive the use of best practices. They actively recruit and interview for their team and help others leverage their own expertise, by coaching and mentoring. They communicate clearly and collaborate with others to deliver results. They are self-starters, comfortable dealing with ambiguity and change. They are customer-obsessed, always looking to understand customer pain points and find resolutions quickly and completely.

A day in the life
On a typical day engineers might work to build infrastructure and services for our customers. They will dive deep into understanding the root cause of a customer issue, investigate why a metric is trending the wrong way and consult with senior engineers at Amazon. We believe in making out-of-hours support as painless as possible. To achieve this, we implement Operational Excellence best practices and strive to automate manual processes.

If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS?
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Inclusive Team Culture
AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.
