title: Safety Engineering & Continuous Improvement Manager, WHS Design & Engineering
descriptionHtml:
At Amazon, safety is our top priority. We are looking for a WHS Risk Engineer to own machinery safety across multiple sites. In this role you will lead machinery safety inspections and risk assessments, apply the EU Machinery Directive and harmonised standards, and influence engineering and operations leaders to build safe-by-design into our equipment and processes. You'll turn machinery-safety findings into consistent standards that protect our people across the network.


Key job responsibilities
Lead machinery safety inspections and risk assessments across multiple sites.

Apply and interpret the EU Machinery Directive (2006/42/EC) and associated harmonised standards.

Identify machinery and MHE risks and drive the implementation of effective control measures.

Engage and influence functional leaders to build buy-in to Health & Safety standards and change.

Use data and metrics to identify gaps and drive improvements across sites.



A day in the life
You work across several sites, moving between machinery inspections, risk assessments and working sessions with engineering and operations leaders. You dig into how equipment and MHE is designed, installed and used, spot risks that others miss, and drive agreement on the control measures needed. You use data to see patterns across sites and to prioritise where safety effort has the biggest impact. A large part of your day is influencing — helping functional leaders understand machinery risk and building buy-in to the Health & Safety standards and changes you recommend.

About the team
The Workplace Health and Safety (WHS) team plays a crucial role in keeping our people mentally and physically well at work. Our team works with managers, associates and local governments across our sites, ensuring compliance with Amazon's policies and legal regulations, and guaranteeing the safety of our work environments. The team offers a variety of opportunities, from Safety Technicians to Programme Managers. Regardless of your role, you'll contribute to the development and implementation of the safety strategy across the entire network.

Basic qualifications

- Experience in English-language communication skills, both written and verbal
- A Bachelor's degree, or equivalent level of qualification in-line with the European Qualifications Framework (EQF) in electrical, mechanical, civil or industrial engineering.
- Practical understanding and application of WHS risk assessment and safety standards.
- Experience conducting machinery safety inspections and risk assessments across multiple sites, applying the EU Machinery Directive (2006/42/EC).
- Experience engaging and influencing functional leaders to build buy-in to Health & Safety standards.

Preferred qualifications

- Experience with Lean, 5S or Kaizen methodologies and continuous improvement.
- Experience using data and metrics to identify gaps and drive improvements.
- CMSE (or equivalent Machinery Safety certification), or experience working for/with a Notified or Approved Body for Machinery Safety.
- NEBOSH certificate (or equivalent safety certification).

title: Superviseur/euse des Operations
descriptionHtml:
Les opérations sont au cœur de toutes les activités d’Amazon. L’efficacité de nos fonctions opérationnelles nous permet de traiter nos commandes et d’expédier les articles à nos clients en temps voulu. En tant que superviseur des opérations, vous verrez comment nous assurons le fonctionnement de nos différentes fonctions opérationnelles et vous jouerez un rôle dans leur bon déroulement.
Vous serez le premier point de contact des membres de l’équipe pendant leur service et les aiderez à suivre les processus mis en place par vos supérieurs. Il s’agit d’un rôle de terrain, qui vous permettra d’acquérir de l’expérience dans l’utilisation des outils et des systèmes essentiels au succès de nos opérations.

Key job responsibilities
Mesurer et contrôler les flux de travail, suivre les performances sur site et fournir aux responsables de terrain les données nécessaires et relatives aux postes/équipes afin de nous aider à atteindre notre objectif d’excellence opérationnelle
Soutenir et former les collaborateurs pour qu’ils donnent le meilleur d’eux-mêmes et les superviser dans leurs tâches quotidiennes
Soutenir le responsable d’équipe/de secteur pour améliorer les processus, cultiver un environnement de travail sûr et accroître l’engagement des collaborateurs
Travailler avec d’autres services pour trouver des solutions aux problèmes fréquents ou aux besoins en matière d’appui opérationnel dans les secteurs clés
Analyse les données pour identifier les solutions qui nous permettront d’optimiser la sécurité, la qualité et la productivité

A day in the life
En tant que superviseur des opérations, vous serez basé·e sur l’un de nos sites opérationnels. Vous aiderez votre chef d’équipe/de secteur à mettre en pratique le plan de travail de l’équipe. Vous participerez aux réunions d’avant-poste avec votre équipe. Vous vous assurerez que chacun respecte les règles de sécurité et les processus de qualité en place et effectue les tâches selon le degré de priorité de chacune.
Vous ferez remonter les problèmes à votre supérieur, mais vous serez parfois la personne la plus gradée de l’équipe et vous donnerez aux collaborateurs les instructions dont ils ont besoin pour mener à bien leurs tâches. À d’autres moments, vous aiderez votre chef d’équipe/de secteur à planifier les rotations d’équipes afin d’avoir un personnel suffisamment nombreux pendant les périodes de pointe.

About the team
Amazon Logistics, ou AMZL, s’occupe des activités de livraison du « dernier kilomètre » en partenariat avec des entreprises de distribution tierces. Nous faisons appel à la créativité et aux initiatives visant à l’amélioration continue pour acheminer des millions de produits physiques jusqu’à nos clients. Notre objectif est de rendre l’expérience de livraison de nos clients aussi fluide que possible et de déployer des solutions de livraison globales pour nos concepts les plus récents, tels qu’Amazon Fresh, Prime Now et Amazon Restaurants.
Notre travail s’effectue de deux manières. Nos collaborateurs·trices « sous le toit » traitent des millions de produits avant de les envoyer à nos équipes de livraison. La dimension humaine est au cœur des activités de l’équipe. Nous jouons essentiellement un rôle de soutien, y compris de nuit. Nous nous concentrons principalement sur les opérations, avec des équipes présentes 24 heures sur 24, 7 jours sur 7 dans la plupart de nos sites.
Quant à nos collaborateurs·trices « sur la route », ils travaillent avec Amazon Flex, un réseau d’entreprises de livraison. Chaque année, nous plaçons la barre toujours plus haut en matière d’expérience client grâce à de nouveaux services de livraison. Nous recherchons de nouveaux moyens de relever les défis logistiques du secteur et de nouvelles idées pour réduire notre empreinte carbone, en nous appuyant sur un parc de véhicules (y compris des véhicules électriques) et des technologies de pointe.

Basic qualifications

- Bonne maîtrise de la suite MS Office (Word, Excel, Outlook) dans un environnement professionnel
- Vous possédez le diplôme du baccalauréat
- Parfaite maîtrise du français, à l’oral et à l’écrit

Preferred qualifications

- Les compétences dites « souhaitables » vous aideront à tirer votre épingle du jeu mais elles ne sont pas nécessaires pour postuler à une offre chez Amazon. Si vous possédez toutes les compétences requises listées précédemment, contactez-nous sans plus tarder.

- Maîtrise de l’anglais

title: Principal ProServe Cloud Architect, AWS Strategic Accounts
descriptionHtml:
AWS Professional Services (ProServe) is seeking a ProServe Cloud Architect (PCA) specializing in the Strategic Accounts - Software and High Technology vertical. You will engage directly with Hardware and Software leaders to design and deliver cloud solutions tailored to this industry.
As a PCA you operate as the conduit between ProServe Account Executives and Shared Delivery Teams (SDT), ensuring solutions are realistic, achievable, and maximize customer business outcomes (CBOs). You serve as a trusted advisor on industry trends, emerging technologies, and the regulatory landscape.
This is a role for a Technical Architect who understands how devices, services are created using AI based services, and how cloud infrastructure underpins device design, verification, and high-volume manufacturing. That business fluency, combined with cloud architecture expertise, is what makes this role distinct.
Your success will be measured by SOW signings, successful solution delivery, and customer satisfaction (CSAT).


Key job responsibilities
As an experienced technology professional, you will be responsible for:
• Designing scalable, secure AWS solutions for Strategic Accounts - Software and High Technology Customers, accounting for Agentic Solutions, Data context, migrations and modernization.
• Providing technical guidance during pre-sales and implementation, translating hi-tech business structures into solution architectures
• Leading modernization-at-scale of workloads to AWS and Cloud Ops/FinOps best practices for moving customers past POC and benchmarking paralysis into production scale
• Collaborating with Account Managers and SDTs to ensure proposals address IP protection, and data privacy obligations unique to hi-tech design and manufacturing customers.
• Advising customers on emerging technologies: Agentic use cases, High Performance Compute and resilient architectures
• Sharing knowledge through mentoring, training, and reusable artifacts that capture the regulatory and business patterns unique to this vertical


A day in the life
As a PCA in the Strategic Accounts - Software and High Technology vertical, no two days look the same, but your time centers on customers, partners, and solving real problems:
• Engaging directly with customers to understand their business and technical roadmap and identify pain points, and scope solutions that deliver measurable value
• Partnering closely with ProServe Account Executives (PAEs) to align on opportunity strategy, develop statements of work, and drive deals through the pipeline
• Deep diving into customer environments to assess level of effort for workload migration or modernization initiatives, define solution architectures, and build business cases that articulate the ProServe value proposition
• Delivering opportunity scoping and solution design focused entirely around the customer, solving their specific problems rather than selling generic services
• Working across organizational boundaries with Solution Architects, WWSO, Account Executives, and delivery teams both inside ProServe and across the broader AWS sales organization
• Engaging directly with C-suite executives, CTOs, Engineering technical leads, and manufacturing operations executives inside each organization to build trust and drive outcomes


About the team
About AWS
Diverse Experiences
AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
Why AWS?
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. descriptionHtml:
The Data Center Engineering Operations Technician (EOT) is responsible for delivery of best practice systems and problem resolution on all data center electrical and mechanical infrastructure (UPS, MV electrical systems, generators, cooling systems etc.) within the data center environment in a specific location. The role requires a highly driven, self-managed individual who demonstrates initiative and proactively seeks solutions to complex technical problems. This position requires frequent site interventions, critical switching activities, along with troubleshooting and fixing infrastructure issues. The role would suit someone who enjoys working in a ‘hands on’ capacity on Mechanical and Electrical (M&E) infrastructure such as diesel generators, switchgear, UPS’s, PDU’s, AHU’s, fire detection systems and building automation systems. - Collaborating effectively with internal & external stakeholders to deliver operational excellence for all AWS customers

- Participation in the successful delivery of build-out and retrofit of Data Center infrastructure
- Ensuring organizational capability to react & respond appropriately to any potential customer-impacting event on any component of electrical or mechanical infrastructure.
- Reviewing incident reports, documenting periodic trend summaries, and providing updates and recommended actions to management
- Draft, update & maintain method statements, standard operating procedures, emergency response procedures, preventive maintenance programs, and all technical documentation pertaining to DCEO

descriptionHtml:
Our WW Operations network delivers millions of packages and smiles to Amazon customers every day. We are looking for motivated, customer-focused individuals who want to join our team as an Area Manager. Our fulfillment network launches new Operations sites every year, providing various opportunities for your professional growth. We hire Area Managers based on location preference and the business’ current openings.

Work includes implementation of inference optimization techniques like Speculative decoding, Disaggregated Inference and CUDA kernel tuning.

As part of the team, you will own price-performance of amazon LLM inference on Sagemaker, Hyperpod and Bedrock. You will be working in a fast-paced, cross-disciplinary team of engineers and researchers who are leaders in the field. You will take on challenging problems, distill real requirements, and then deliver solutions that either leverage existing academic and industrial research, or utilize your own out-of-the-box pragmatic thinking. In addition to coming up with novel solutions and prototypes, you will deliver these to production in customer facing products.

Inclusive Team Culture
Here at AWS, we embrace our differences. We are committed to furthering our culture of inclusion. We have ten employee-led affinity groups, reaching 40,000 employees in over 190 chapters globally. We have innovative benefit offerings, and host annual and ongoing learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (gender diversity) conferences.

Work/Life Balance
Our team puts a high value on work-life balance. It isn’t about how many hours you spend at home or at work; it’s about the flow you establish that brings energy to both parts of your life. We believe striking the right balance between your personal and professional life is critical to life-long happiness and fulfillment. We offer flexibility in working hours and encourage you to find your own balance between your work and personal lives.

Mentorship & Career Growth
Our team is dedicated to supporting new members. We have a broad mix of experience levels and tenures, and we’re building an environment that celebrates knowledge sharing and mentorship. We care about your career growth and strive to assign projects based on what will help each team member develop into a better-rounded engineer and enable them to take on more complex tasks in the future.

Key job responsibilities
As a MLE in Inference Optimization team you will be responsible for the major portion of existing and/or new inference software. List of responsibilities includes but is not limited to developing model servers, developing CUDA kernels in vLLM, SGLang, developing services for GenAI optimization and benchmarking, creating and modifying a mid-size application, or service.

Basic qualifications

- 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
- 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
- 1+ years of software development engineer or related occupational experience
- 1+ years of designing and developing large-scale, multi-tiered, multi-threaded, embedded or distributed software applications, tools, systems, and services using: C#, C++, Java, or Perl experience
- Bachelor's degree or foreign equivalent in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field
- Knowledge of Machine Learning and LLM fundamentals, including transformer architecture, training/inference lifecycles, and optimization techniques

Preferred qualifications

- 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
- Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

title: Amazon Finance Rotational Program (AFRP) - Business Unit Finance, Early Career - 2027
descriptionHtml:
There’s a universe of opportunity at Amazon.

At Amazon, your career doesn’t follow a straight line. It accelerates, twists, and challenges you in ways you never expected. From the moment you join, you’re part of something big: building products or services that reach millions and shaping how people live, work, and connect every day. This is where your ideas turn into real impact. You’ll work with world class tools, global platforms, and systems built to operate at an extraordinary scale. You’ll move fast, experiment and launch solutions that matter. With endless opportunities to explore across teams and roles, you’ll learn quickly, apply what you know and discover skills you didn’t know existed. This is an environment designed for builders who want to see the impact of their work in the world. Ready to start your adventure?

What’s in it for you?
With teams across the Amazon universe, you don’t have to choose one path too early. You’ll take ownership, build new skills, and shape a career that evolves as you do.

The Business Unit Finance (BUF) Program is a part of the broader Amazon Finance Rotational Program (AFRP). The AFRP – Business Unit Financial Analyst role is a two-year rotational program that starts aspiring leaders within the Finance Global Business Services (FGBS) organization. The AFRP - BUF program has (2) yearlong rotations across business units. Participants will develop technical skills while partnering with their business teams to drive process improvements, new business growth, and/or cost out opportunities. At the end of 2 years, participants will be positioned to take on higher responsibility with a broad scope of roles available. Responsibilities include preparation and reporting of financial performance for weekly, monthly, and annual reviews, producing meaningful operational metrics to help drive performance and achieve business objectives, and applying financial acumen and technical understanding to provide insights on growth, profitability, capital investment, and cash flow. Successful candidates will bring diverse perspectives and varied experiences (whether from school, life, or past jobs).

This role is based in Seattle, WA (relocation assistance provided, if eligible), and requires the ability to begin full-time employment on August 9, 2027.

Please note that we are unable to offer visa sponsorship for this role.

Key job responsibilities
- Diving deep into data to support a recommendation and driving resolutions
- Conducting financial analysis to help identify capital investment requirements and/or cost reduction opportunities
- Designing and maintaining insightful reporting to enable business partners to take action
- Interpreting and communicating project results and standard work to finance and business partner leadership

Basic qualifications

- Are 18 years of age or older
- Currently has, or is in the process of obtaining, a bachelor's degree or higher in finance, economics, accounting, business administration and management, or a related field

Preferred qualifications

- Intermediate (e.g., xlookup)/advanced Excel skills (e.g., Write/edit VBA)
- Work, internship, or other leadership experience in a professional environment
- Strong academic, leadership, and/or extracurricular record
- Understanding of business fundamentals and accounting concepts
- Effective interpersonal, written, and oral communication with a keen focus on delivering business results
- Demonstrated track record in using data and metrics to make decisions and build scalable solutions
- Ability to influence across all levels of an organization
- Ability to act strategically and make decisions under ambiguity
- Strong organizational and time management skills

title: Network Engineer, IT Services
descriptionHtml:
Are you a Network Engineer eager for more challenging and impactful work? Do you thrive on solving complex technical problems and putting customers first? If so, Amazon has the perfect opportunity for you.

We are currently hiring for a Network Engineer to work within our Corporate Infrastructure Services (CIS) business unit. The role is part of the Office Infrastructure Deployment (OID) team that is a follow-the-sun global team of network infrastructure deployment engineers that works on the turn-up of new Amazon corporate offices, post-occupancy projects like office expansions or decommissions, life cycle replacement projects (hardware & software refreshes) and strategic security networking initiatives that will impact and touch every Amazon employee working in a corporate office environment.

All of OID’s work is executed remotely and you will collaborate with other teams within Amazon like AWS Networking, IT Services, Technical Program Managers and Low Voltage Contractors (LVC’s). The role will require you to work from our corporate office in Cebu, Philippines.

We value our engineers and their growth. In addition to other Amazon benefits, we also offer our engineers 12 days of formal training opportunities in a calendar year to pursue your interests to improve and sharpen your professional skills.

Key job responsibilities
- Create and implement configuration changes on the network, during scheduled change management windows.
- Troubleshoot networking, routing and inter connectivity issues, including troubleshooting of network device configurations.
- Collaborate with our partners within Amazon like AWS Networking, IT Services, Technical Program Managers and Low Voltage Contractors (LVC’s) to deploy changes.
- Create and review documentation and process regarding network implementation/deployments, recurring issues, new standard operating procedures, knowledge transfer material, etc.

Basic qualifications

- BS/BE/BTech in Information Systems, Computer Science or other Engineering disciplines or similar relevant educational background.
- 3+ years of enterprise experience as a technician or engineer; or an equivalent combination of education and experience.

Preferred qualifications

- Experience as a network engineer in a corporate office environment, experience with physical infrastructure installations and basic troubleshooting skills.
- Understanding of infrastructure technologies, including Routers and Switches as well as an understanding of common networking protocols (BGP, OSPF, VRF)
- Experience working with Cisco routers/switches/firewalls and deploying or supporting Cisco wireless network equipment.
- Basic scripting/programming with Python (preferred) and fundamental knowledge in version control (preferably Git Framework).
- CCNA or equivalent level networking certification

title: HR Partner, AWS, BEXT
descriptionHtml:
The HR Partner role in our Builder Experience Team (BeXT) focuses on the Builder experience.
You can expect to do the following in your day-to-day:
• Influence change and foster an environment of inclusion for our Builders
• Problem solving and influencing in diverse populations
• Working in a fast-paced and complex changing environment driven by continuous innovation
• Application of HR fundamentals
• Partnering with leaders at multiple levels of the organization to develop forward looking strategies and goals focused on the Builder experience.

Key job responsibilities
BeXT delivers personalized people support to AWS Builders to amplify the voice of the Builder. In this role, you will collaborate with AWS business leaders and other HR teams to innovate, implement, and deploy HR strategies from talent and performance management, compensation, employee relations and other HR functions. You will also represent the company with applicable employee resource boards, attending meetings, preparing information, and working closely with internal teams to ensure effective resolution. In addition, you will provide support to our Builders and their leaders aligned to an AWS business line or region, calling on HR expertise and empathy. To thrive, you will need a flexible skill set, including the ability to pivot through various scenarios utilizing HR expertise, consulting skills, as well as the ability to connect to the bigger picture while diving deep into the details and collaborate and consult across many teams, levels, and regions.


A day in the life
As a BeXT HR Partner, no two days look the same, but a typical day will most likely include the following responsibilities:
• Consult, coach, and develop leadership through decision making with empathy and sound judgement; collaborating and actioning on talent management processes, people development and performance management, compensation, and employee relations issues.
• Foster and role model an environment of inclusion for all Builders.
• Advocate for Builders’ needs through end-to-end experiences that help Builders feel fully engaged in the work they do and valued for who they are.
• Exercise high-judgement, manage through ambiguity and serve as first point of escalation for Builder concerns.
• Support Builder queries and situations with discretion and expertise, navigating Amazon Policies and applying high judgement as necessary.
• Actively promote adoption of technology and self-service.
• Collaborate and influence multiple levels of the organization, ranging from Builders to senior leaders.
• Conduct difficult workplace investigations in collaboration with Builder Relations.

Basic qualifications

- Experience as an HR generalist
- Experience with labor/employee relations
- Speak, write, and read fluently in Dutch

Preferred qualifications

- Strong business and HR acumen, including strong problem-solving skills, critical thinking and analysis, experience consulting on complex performance management cases Employee Relations/Investigations experience
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills; effective communication with the ability to build relationships and influence across a wide set of process partners and business stakeholders
- Thrives in a high-pressure, high-volume, ambiguous environment and able to manage multiple simultaneous priorities
- Demonstrated ability to adopt and apply AI tools to solve ambiguous problems, improve efficiency, and scale impact
- Use of AI and new technology with sound judgement to solve problems, scale impact, and continuously improve how we support Builder

title: Software Development Engineer II, Amazon FinAuto - GREF Workplace Support Tech
descriptionHtml:
The GREF Workplace Support Technology team, part of Finance Automation, develops services, products, and tools to enable Amazon's corporate real estate team to build and operate the company's global facilities in more than 60 countries, which is the largest corporate real estate footprint in the world. We builds the software that keeps Amazon's global workplaces running — from the helpdesk chat and ticketing systems employees use to report issues, to the automation that routes and resolves millions of facilities work orders behind the scenes. As an SDE II, you'll own services end to end across our Amazon Connect, AI-assisted triage, and work-order integration stack, shipping features that thousands of employees and facilities agents depend on every day.

We are seeking a passionate software development engineer who can help us create the next generation of real estate systems and support the GREF organization.

As a software development engineer in the team, you will get to collaborate with product managers, senior and peer-level software engineers across Finance Automation organization. This role provides you with autonomy and ownership on decisions, working backwards directly from customers. There is ample opportunity for growth due to the high visibility work and presence of senior engineering talent for guidance and mentorship.

Key job responsibilities
- Design and implement scalable service architectures that power AI-driven policy guidance, intelligent booking, and automated expense workflows for a global user base.
- Deliver working features across the full software development lifecycle, from requirements and design through implementation, testing, deployment, and operations.
- Collaborate with product managers, applied scientists, and engineers across Finance Automation and partner organizations to translate business needs into reliable technical solutions.
- Coach teammates through code reviews and design discussions, raising the quality bar for the team's software and establishing shared engineering best practices.
- Identify and resolve root causes of operational issues while continuously improving system reliability and maintainability.

About the team
The Workplace Support Tech team sits within FinAuto Global Real Estate & Facilities and is on a multi-year mission to transform how Amazon employees get help with their physical workplace worldwide — from reporting a facilities issue to getting it resolved. We build the helpdesk, intelligent ticket-routing, and work-order automation that keep Amazon's buildings running, backed by Amazon Connect agent tooling and AI-assisted resolution. If you want to build products at global scale that make a tangible difference in how people work, we would love to hear from you.

title: Manager of Construction, Data Center Construction
descriptionHtml:
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

As our Data Center Manager of Construction (CM MGR), you will be a part of a diverse, upbeat, and creative team tasked with solving fascinating problems constructing Amazon Data Centers. Our data centers are industry-leading examples of energy efficient and cost-effective designs.
You will:
• Own project scope, quality, schedule, and budget for construction of new builds or general capital projects.
• Own construction project management and oversight of construction related activities.
• Work alongside partner teams such as Operations, Networking, Controls, Security, and Commissioning to build Data Centers that directly support our Customers.
• Be a leader in your specific discipline (construction management, building services, architectural, electrical or mechanical engineering).
• Represent Amazon’s owner’s representative on construction sites daily, as, interacting with construction trades.

At Amazon, we are all Owners and leverage unique opportunities presented to us by owning everything from the design review to construction bidding, execution, and final hand-off to our customers. We develop innovative data centers for our Customers.

Key job responsibilities
• Be Amazon’s construction representative on multiple data centers building and capital improvement construction project sites from construction start through hand-off to operations.
• Direct interface with construction general contractors during the construction bidding, award, execution, punch-list, and closeout phases.
• Create construction project Scope of Work (SOW) and Request for Proposals (RFP).
• Conduct negotiations with general contractors and evaluate bids and proposals with detail and accuracy.
• Manage and drive cost, schedule, and quality while managing construction contractors and vendors.
• Perform construction project management activities, including management of documents, submittals, RFIs, change orders, invoices, quality, scope, and schedule.
• Drive construction teams to troubleshoot and perform root-cause failure analysis on equipment failures.
• Support commissioning and integrated system testing and oversight.
• Support operations of installed facilities, including review of procedures, best practices, and maintenance initiatives.
• Support capital request creation.
• Analyze and report construction progress and financials.
• Record and report key construction metrics to team members and management.
• Contribute to construction initiatives aimed at improving construction efficiency and increasing data center resiliency.
• Provide constructability reviews for civil, structural, electrical and mechanical designs for new or optimization of existing data centers.
• Be a leader within the group, and within internal and external data center support teams.


A day in the life
Manage the day to day responsibilities of the CM team, engage with other internal AWS managers and team members. New Carlisle or Hobart, Indiana will be the permanent reporting location.

About the team
Diverse Experiences
Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

Inclusive Team Culture
Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (gender diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

Mentorship and Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

descriptionHtml:
Amazon Leo is Amazon's low Earth orbit satellite network. Our mission is to deliver fast, reliable broadband connectivity to customers beyond the reach of existing networks. From households to small businesses, schools, hospitals, and government agencies, Amazon Leo will serve communities and organizations operating in places without dependable internet access.

We are seeking an ALG Strategy Lead to own the development of business strategy for all of Amazon Leo Government. As an individual contributor, you will independently develop and drive go-to-market strategy, cross-organizational programs, operational mechanisms, and business analytics across the ALG portfolio—spanning domestic and international government market segments. You will work in an ambiguous, fast-moving environment where the problem and strategy may not yet be defined, using your expertise and judgment to set direction, align stakeholders, and deliver results.
This role influences without authority across teams and functions, presents strategies and recommendations to senior leadership, and translates leadership priorities into actionable plans. Strategy Development & Planning

title: SDM Verification & Monitoring, AWS Governance
descriptionHtml:
AWS CloudTrail records API and user activity across hundreds of AWS services, giving customers complete visibility into their cloud operations for security and compliance. As AI agents increasingly make decisions and invoke APIs at scale, the need to verify that every event is generated correctly, completely, and on time has never been more urgent. We are looking for a Software Development Manager to lead the verification and monitoring team within AWS CloudTrail. You will own the platform that detects data loss, integrity issues, and coverage gaps before customers are impacted — across all delivery channels and 378+ integrated services. You will combine technical depth with people leadership to grow engineers, shape architecture, and drive end-to-end outcomes that give AWS service teams confidence to move fast without compromising event quality.

Key job responsibilities
- Own the technical roadmap for the verification and monitoring platform, defining strategy that ensures every event is delivered correctly and completely across all integrated AWS services.
- Lead and grow a team of engineers and technical leaders by recruiting top talent, providing coaching and actionable feedback, and building programs to develop and retain high performers.
- Establish AI-assisted development workflows — including AI-powered code generation, automated code reviews, and intelligent test creation — to multiply your team's engineering output while maintaining quality.
- Drive cross-team engagement with AWS service teams and internal stakeholders using agile practices and strong program management to align priorities, manage dependencies, and report findings that shape organizational decisions.
- Build and maintain automated monitoring systems that proactively detect data loss, integrity failures, and coverage gaps, ensuring issues are caught and remediated before they reach customers.

A day in the life
You start your morning reviewing verification dashboards and monitoring alerts to understand event integrity across AWS services. You join a design review where your engineers propose a new detection capability, and you pressure-test assumptions to sharpen the approach. After a one-on-one where you help a technical leader plan their next career milestone, you shift to a cross-team sync with an AWS service team to align on an upcoming launch and its event coverage requirements. Later, you review your team's prioritized project list, adjust sequencing based on new findings, and close the day by drafting a status update for leadership on recent impact metrics.

About the team
The Governance verification and monitoring team is the independent quality layer that ensures the accuracy and completeness of every audit event generated across AWS. Our work directly protects customers who depend on CloudTrail for security, compliance, and operational visibility. We are an inclusive group of engineers and leaders who value clear thinking, technical rigor, and a genuine commitment to each other's growth. As AWS accelerates AI adoption across its services, our mission is growing — we are investing in GenAI-powered monitoring, consolidating our platform architecture, and expanding coverage to keep pace with new services and agentic workloads.

- 7+ years of working directly within engineering teams experience

descriptionHtml:

You will also lead high impact, cross functional initiatives that drive efficiency, reduce cost, and improve service performance across the air network.

This role sits at the intersection of strategy and execution. You will partner with leaders across Amazon AIR, including Operations, Finance, and Analytics, and directly influence senior leadership decisions that shape how millions of packages move through our network. Your recommendations will balance customer experience with cost effectiveness, and your work will have a measurable impact on Amazon's end to end transportation ecosystem.

If you thrive on solving complex, ambiguous problems at scale, want to innovate across air and ground transportation solutions, and are passionate about delighting customers, we'd love for you to help us make Amazon AIR history.

- Develop and present data driven recommendations to senior leadership on network design changes, route adjustments, and capacity investments.

- Evaluate complex tradeoffs between customer needs and cost, building consensus across partner teams such as Finance, Operations, Process Engineering, and Procurement to drive aligned decision making.
- Partner with Research Science and Technology as a subject matter expert to design and develop next generation planning and forecasting tools.

Your day will blend data analysis, network modeling, and cross functional collaboration. You will build flight schedules to accommodate peak volume, analyze network to identify under-performing routes, or present capacity tradeoff scenarios to senior leadership. You will regularly partner with AIR carriers, operations, ground transportation teams to ensure flight schedules are tightly integrated with the broader network.

This role is ideal for someone who thrives in a fast paced environment and is energized by solving complex network optimization problems that directly impact millions of customer deliveries.

Flight Scheduling is one of the pillars of the Planning & Performance (P&P) organization within AIR Supply Chain and Analytics (SC&A). title: Security Incident Response Engineer, AWS Security Corporate Response
descriptionHtml:
AWS Corporate Security Response is looking for a Security Engineer who thrives at the intersection of hands-on incident response and intelligent automation. You must think like both an attacker and a defender — understanding adversary tradecraft to detect, investigate, and disrupt threats across Amazon's corporate infrastructure at massive scale.

You'll investigate active threats — malware campaigns, phishing attacks, credential compromise, and novel attack patterns — while simultaneously shaping an agentic investigation platform that scales our response capability beyond what any human team could achieve alone.

You will independently lead security investigations from detection through containment and remediation. You'll extract IOCs, perform host forensics, scope impact across multiple data sources, check for lateral movement, and drive security issues to resolution — documenting every step as the investigation unfolds. You'll also serve as a demanding customer and quality owner of our AI-powered investigation platform, authoring the investigation user stories that define how autonomous agents analyze threats, designing the guardrails that keep them safe, and validating that automated output meets the same standard a skilled human investigator would produce.

When you identify gaps in our capabilities, you won't wait — you'll quickly design and build tooling that enables programmatic automation at scale, then feed those patterns into the next generation of autonomous investigation.

Key job responsibilities
* Lead High Severity security investigations end-to-end: acknowledge, investigate with depth (not speed), document as you go, and own through resolution
* Triage High Severity candidates — promote decisively when indicators are clear, downgrade with documented rationale when they're not
* Analyze open source threat intelligence — these reports contain temporal IOCs that decay with age, making rapid validation and proactive blocking critical
* Author and validate agent investigation user stories, ensuring autonomous investigations match human-quality rigor
* Design and test guardrails and policies — think about how attackers would evade detection, how edge cases produce incorrect results, and how agents might fail in ways developers didn't anticipate
* Build tactical scripts, detection rules, and response automations that address immediate operational gaps — then drive their transition into scalable agentic capabilities
* Participate in a global on-call rotation: own the queue for your shift, monitor operational health, and maintain readiness
* Execute clean shift handoffs: document active investigations, flag anomalies observed during your shift, and explicitly transfer ticket ownership

About the team
CorpSec Response operates 24/7 as a global, follow-the-sun team protecting Amazon's corporate infrastructure. We combine deep human expertise with leading autonomous investigation capabilities. Our engineers are hands-on investigators who also shape the AI systems that augment their work — creating a unique feedback loop between human security expertise and machine-scale automation.

Inclusive Team Culture
We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive team. Amazon's culture of inclusion is reinforced within our Leadership Principles, which remind team members to seek diverse perspectives, learn and be curious, and earn trust.

Work-Life Balance
We value sustainable performance. Our follow-the-sun model means you're not carrying a pager 24/7 — your node owns its shift, and clean handoffs are a core operational discipline.

Growth and Impact
This role offers a rare combination: hands-on technical security work at massive scale, leadership of a high-performing team, and direct influence over an AI-augmented security platform. You'll grow as both a security practitioner and a technical leader.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent, or experience in IT Security
- Experience in security operations, incident response, or security engineering
- Hands-on experience investigating security incidents (malware analysis, phishing response, credential compromise, or network intrusion)
- Proficiency in Python or similar scripting language for security automation and tooling
- Experience with log analysis platforms (Splunk, ELK, or equivalent) and EDR tools (CrowdStrike, Carbon Black, or equivalent)
- Knowledge of networking protocols (HTTP, DNS, TCP/IP) and operating system internals (Windows and Linux)

Preferred qualifications

- Experience performing detection engineering in a dedicated or hybrid capacity supporting incident response and threat intelligence operations
- Experience designing or validating AI/LLM-powered automation in a security context
- Proficiency in at least one specialization domain: Malware Analysis / Reverse Engineering; Digital Forensics; Security Tool Development & Automation; Network & OS Security; Identity Management
- Experience with threat intelligence platforms and IOC enrichment (VirusTotal, MITRE ATT&CK framework)
- Track record of building security automation that measurably reduced manual operational burden
- Security certifications (GCIH, GCFA, GREM, OSCP, or equivalent) are a plus but not required

title: Sr. Production Manager
descriptionHtml:
We are seeking an experienced Production Manager to run the day-to-day operations of our Boston Development Center (BDC). In this role, you own the execution of the pilot operation, assembly builds, rapid prototyping shop operations, and manufacturing process development lines. You are accountable for delivering on build commitments, safely, on time, on quality.

This is a high-mix, high-development environment. Build campaigns change frequently, product configurations evolve between iterations, and you must keep operations running smoothly through the ambiguity. The ideal candidate is a hands-on and data driven leader who thrives on the manufacturing floor, coaches teams, drives operational discipline, bridges between engineering and manufacturing and delivers results in fast-paced pilot manufacturing environments.

Key job responsibilities
- Own the production execution across the BDC, assembly build campaigns, rapid prototyping shop, and manufacturing process development lines. Deliver on production goals (safety, quality, schedule, cost).
- Manage and develop production supervisors and their teams (supervisors, technicians, machinists, associates). Set clear expectations, coach performance, and build a culture of accountability and continuous improvement.
- Drive daily production planning and execution, ensure build plans are translated into actionable shift plans, resources are allocated, and production issues are resolved rapidly on the floor.
- Ensure safety and quality standards are maintained across all operations. Drive 5S, standard work, and housekeeping discipline. Own EHS compliance for the production floor.
- Partner with engineering, quality, and planning teams to align operational capacity with build requirements. Proactively flag constraints, resource conflicts, and risks to leadership.
- Support new product introductions and build campaign transitions, coordinate staffing, training, workspace setup, and material staging to enable smooth start-ups.
- Drive operational metrics (first pass yield, schedule adherence, throughput, safety incidents) and lead continuous improvement initiatives to raise the performance bar.
- Manage workforce planning, hiring, shift scheduling, cross-training, and skill development to maintain operational flexibility in a high-mix environment.
- Ensure readiness, coordinate with maintenance and facilities to maintain uptime for CNC machines, 3D printers, assembly stations, and test equipment.
- Foster open communication and collaboration across shifts and functional teams. Create an environment that is productive, safe, and engaged.

Basic qualifications

- Experience hiring and developing strong talent and building a team
- Experience with Six Sigma, lean manufacturing, or experience in similar environments
- Bachelor's degree in Manufacturing Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Operations Management, or a related field.
- 7+ years of experience in manufacturing operations or production management, with at least 3 years managing supervisors and frontline teams.
- Experience managing operations in pilot, prototype, or NPI manufacturing environments with high product mix and frequent changeover.
- Proven track record of delivering production targets (safety, quality, schedule) while managing competing priorities in fast-paced settings.
- Hands-on comfort with manufacturing environments, assembly, machining, additive manufacturing, or similar.

Preferred qualifications

- Six Sigma Green Belt, or Six Sigma Black Belt certification
- 10+ years of production management experience with progressive leadership responsibilities in advanced hardware or electromechanical manufacturing.
- Experience in robotics, automotive, aerospace, or other complex hardware development environments.
- Experience managing both assembly operations and machine shop / prototyping shop operations.
- Strong analytical skills — ability to use production data to identify trends, root causes, and improvement opportunities.
- Exceptional communication skills with the ability to lead diverse teams and engage effectively with engineering and leadership stakeholders.
- A proven track record of delivering results in high-growth, ambiguous environments while demonstrating ownership and bias for action (aligned with Amazon Leadership Principles).

title: Installation Technician
descriptionHtml:
Transform network infrastructure by joining our dynamic team! You'll be at the forefront of developing innovative solutions that drive network stability and scalability, using your technical expertise to create automated systems that power global technological advancement.

Infra Delivery Install Technicians will collaborate with cross-functional teams, troubleshoot complex technical scenarios, and implement strategic solutions that keep our network running seamlessly. Expect to engage in hands-on technical work that requires creativity, precision, and a passion for technological innovation.

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

NOTE: Amazon does not sponsor for immigration, including for H-1B, TN, and other non-immigrant visas, for this role.

NOTE: Lump sum stipend will be provided to eligible candidates who relocate for this position.

Key job responsibilities
Key job responsibilities
- Moving and implementing large enterprise equipment
- Installing Fiber and Copper cabling and patching cabling between equipment
- Ensuring proper safety and security standards are maintained during cabling and rack installation,
- Following well established hardware installation procedures and break-fix activities
- Safely using material handling tools and equipment
- Traveling within and outside of the regional work area is required. You will be responsible for having a reliable personal vehicle and valid driver's license to travel within the regional work area, as company transportation will not be provided

Physical Requirements:
- Regularly lift and/or move up to 40 pounds; and participate in group lifts for 41+ pounds
- Ability to work in an environment that operates 24/7 with an ability to participate in primary responder rotation and provide after-hours support as needed
- Working in cramped and/or elevated and/or noisy environments
- Bending, lifting, stretching, reaching, standing and walking for up to 8+ hours a day
- Ascending and descending ladders, stairs, and gangways safely and without limitation

This role supports data centers in various operational stages. The position may be assigned to a facility still under development, which could require travel to established locations for training until your designated site becomes fully operational.

Essential Requirements:
- Ability to travel to or commute between data center locations as needed
- Willingness to temporarily work at alternative sites during training periods or until assigned facility is operational
- Travel frequency will vary based on business needs and operational status of assigned facility

Candidates must be able to travel (over 50 miles) or commute (less than 50 miles) to active data center sites as required by business needs.

Basic qualifications

- 1+ years of Computer Hardware Repair, Infrastructure Cabling, Network Deployment, or Data Center Operations experience, or experience in similar technical or vocational roles
- High School diploma or equivalent

Preferred qualifications

- industry standard certification (CompTIA, CCENT, or Network+)
- Experience with cabling infrastructure best practices and methodologies
- Knowledge of network cabling, optic types, and test equipment

title: Safety Monitoring Compliance Analyst, NAST Compliance
descriptionHtml:
Amazon's North American Surface Transportation Safety & Compliance team (NAST S&C) is hiring a Compliance Analyst for Safety Monitoring. The team measures carrier safety performance against Amazon's standards using FMCSA Safety Measurement System (SMS) data and Amazon's Violation Rate Metrics (VRM), and takes action when a carrier falls below the standard.

This role supports either third-party (3P) carrier monitoring or monitoring of Amazon's own fleet, Transportation Operations Management (TOM); the core work is the same for both. You will run recurring monitoring steps on a fixed schedule, pull and validate data, keep every case record current, and report results. The work is methodical and procedure-driven: each step follows written procedures and fixed thresholds, and every result can trigger an enforcement or safety action, so you will verify the data before it moves. You will report to the Safety Monitoring manager and escalate anything that falls outside the procedure.

Key job responsibilities
Pull safety data from FMCSA SMS and internal sources on the monthly schedule.

Validate every record against source data before it goes out, reconciling counts, spot-checking individual records, and documenting each check.

Maintain SIM and Asana so the current status of every case lives in one place.

Prepare recurring metrics for business reviews, including suspension and reinstatement counts, exception outcomes, inspection results, and cycle timeliness.

Maintain procedure documents and recommend process improvements.

Escalate data discrepancies, new case types, and anything with possible legal exposure.

Prepare the monthly BASICs and VRM suspension and reinstatement lists against the written thresholds.

Log carrier exception requests, build each case file against the written criteria, and present cases at the weekly exception review.

Record every review decision as granted, denied, or pending final review.

Submit suspension and reinstatement tickets to Carrier Health and confirm they are actioned.

Send carrier notifications from approved templates once a decision is recorded, answer carrier questions about their status, and route anything outside the templates to your manager.

Monitor carriers under review each week for new violations, out-of-service events, and safety rating changes.

Run the same monitoring steps for Amazon's own fleet, tracking roadside inspection results, out-of-service events, violations, and BASICs results for TOM.

Report trends and open items to TOM safety and operations leaders on a set schedule.

Flag changes that need attention, such as a rising violation rate or a new out-of-service event, to your manager and TOM safety leaders.

Basic qualifications

- 2+ years of professional or military experience
- 1+ years of working with computers and Microsoft Office products and applications experience
- High school or equivalent
- Can lift up to 49 pounds, stand/walk during shifts lasting up to 12 hours, and be able to frequently push, pull, squat, bend, and reach
- Work 40 hours/week, and overtime as required
- Work a flexible schedule/shift/work area, including weekends, nights, and/or holidays
- Are 18 years of age or older
- Experience in data analysis, with the ability to interpret and draw insights from data to inform decision-making processes

Preferred qualifications

- Experience with end-to-end project management
- Experience working cross-functionally with tech and non-tech teams, including operations

title: Data Center Controls Technician, Service
descriptionHtml:
As a member of the Global Controls Team, you will collaborate with highly motivated operators, engineers and technicians in the data center industry to maintain and optimize critical infrastructure systems. You will be responsible for troubleshooting and maintaining the Building Management System (BMS) and Electrical Power Monitoring System (EPMS) while developing new processes and standards that drive innovation in the controls space.

AWS data centers utilize sophisticated industrial control systems to automatically operate mechanical equipment, maintaining optimal temperature and pressure conditions throughout the facilities. These systems integrate and monitor multiple critical components, including generators, uninterruptible power sources, diesel generators, electrical switchgear, power distribution units, variable frequency drives, automatic and static transfer switches, air-cooled and water-cooled chillers, pumps, cooling towers, heat exchangers, Computer Room Air Handlers (CRAHs), and air economizers. Within this industrial control system infrastructure, the BMS serves as the primary control platform for all mechanical systems within the data center, while the EPMS functions as the primary monitoring platform for all electrical systems. This position offers the opportunity to work with technology in mission-critical environments while contributing to the reliability and efficiency of AWS's global infrastructure.

Key job responsibilities
Primarily work in and support multiple data centers by deploying, servicing, and upgrading BMS and EPMS systems.

Mentor and train Facilities team members on the operation and control of BMS and EPMS systems.

Manage small to medium-sized projects and programs.

Perform point-to-point checkouts between field devices and controllers.

Perform first-line diagnostics, troubleshooting, and maintenance of programming code and hardware associated with BMS and EPMS in data centers.

Execute provisioning processes for servers, controllers, industrial PCs, and network configurations, including communication testing between third-party devices and controllers or servers.

Install, replace, configure, and calibrate sensors.

Read and interpret electrical schematics and control panel drawings with a basic understanding of closed-loop controls, field sensor scaling, and functions typically performed by industrial controllers.

Supervise low-voltage electrical contractors performing wiring and installation of field devices in compliance with AWS requirements.

Provide commissioning and systems-level testing support.

Create red-lined drawings and documentation of systems.

Follow change management processes to generate work requests and methods of procedures.

Participate in factory witness tests at vendor or panel builder facilities.

Perform root cause analysis during testing and commissioning.

Ensure personnel on site utilize proper safety methodology.

Perform service activities including monitoring and reviewing ticketing systems, conducting root cause analysis, and prioritizing tasks.

Actively manage service agreements including vendor labor scheduling, quality assurance, and financial invoice review.

Participate in material handling tasks such as lifting, carrying, or moving up to 50 lbs of equipment, and utilize OSHA-standard safety equipment including limited weight-bearing work platforms, ladders, step stools, and personal protective equipment (PPE) such as safety harnesses.

Perform other tasks as assigned by manager.

A day in the life
As a Data Center Controls Technician, your primary customers are Data Center Engineering Operations (DCEO), who rely on you to keep Building Management Systems (BMS) and Electrical Power Monitoring Systems (EPMS) healthy and operational. On a given day, you are the boots on the ground solving problems that directly impact data center availability. You might diagnose a controller communication loss, calibrate instruments feeding inaccurate data to operators, or supervise vendors performing quarterly maintenance. For new builds, you perform point to point testing and support commissioning alongside construction teams. Your internal stakeholders include your Controls Engineer, Controls Manager, partner teams (Field Engineering, Critical Project Implementation, DCEO), and the vendors you oversee.

About the team
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

Why AWS

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Diverse Experiences

Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Work/Life Balance

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE), inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

title: Business Analyst - ATS INSC
descriptionHtml:
Amazon – where builders can build! We’re looking for a smart, customer-obsessed innovator and owner to join our Operations Team


Purview of a Team Lead
The INSC CF MM team at Amazon India is hiring for a Business Analyst position, seeking a candidate with a strong performance record and hands-on experience in data-driven decision-making. The role requires exceptional analytical skills, the ability to break down complex problems into structured, executable plans, and comfort with high ambiguity in a fast-paced environment. The candidate must be proficient in Macro and SQL, experienced with BI tools, and capable of working with big data from multiple sources. Core responsibilities include setting up robust processes to drive consumer experience improvements, identifying and executing automation projects, building scalable solutions using SQL, Amazon S3 and Quick Sight, and rolling out best practices from other geographies to minimize end-to-end supply chain losses. The candidate should demonstrate the ability to influence stakeholders across business, operations, and technical functions using data and facts, and earn trust across varied teams without formal authority. Candidates are expected to demonstrate a high bar on Bias for Action, Deep Dive, Learn and Be Curious, Insist on the Highest Standards, and Ownership.

The candidate should have a basic understanding of the logistics space and should be able to communicate clearly in the written and oral form. She/he should be able to come up with process improvements drive them through completion.



Key job responsibilities
Key job responsibilities
1. Set up and maintain robust processes to drive improvement projects with an objective to maximize consumer experience across the MM network.
2. Identify, plan, and execute automation projects within the team to improve operational efficiency and reduce manual effort.
3. Create and work on data using SQL, Amazon S3, and QuickSight to generate actionable insights for business and operations teams.
4. Support business growth in constrained environments through frugal and innovative solutions, ensuring scalability without proportional cost increase.
5. Make existing processes scalable by identifying and implementing available tools, automation, and AI-driven solutions.
6. Roll out best practices from other geographies and standardize tools and processes to minimize end-to-end supply chain losses.
7. Partner with business, operations, and technical stakeholders to translate complex operational challenges into structured, data-backed recommendations.
8. Utilize strong problem-solving and communication skills to influence decisions across business, operations, and technical audiences.

Basic qualifications

- 1+ years of customer-facing environment, warehousing, logistics or manufacturing experience
- Bachelor's degree
- Speak, write, and read fluently in English
- Experience with Microsoft Office products and applications
- Experience with Excel
- Bachelor's degree in engineering, statistics or business, or a CFA and experience with data analytics platforms (Power BI, Python, SQL, Tableau)
- Bachelor's degree or above
- Knowledge of data pipelining and extraction using SQL
- Knowledge of and proficiency in Excel and SQL
- - Experience with data mining tools like SQL, SAS, SPSS, or similar

Preferred qualifications

- Knowledge of databases (querying and analyzing) such as SQL, MYSQL, and ETL Manager and working with large data sets
- 2+ years of data analytics or automation experience

title: Responsable de Site de Remédiation, WHS Due Diligence and Remediation
descriptionHtml:
Au sein de l'équipe Due Diligence et Remédiation Santé et Sécurité au Travail (WHS), vous occuperez le poste de Responsable de Site de Remédiation WHS et jouerez un rôle crucial dans la protection des communautés et de l'environnement. Votre mission : collaborer avec les équipes internes et externes de conception, de construction et d'exploitation, en apportant conseils, soutien et supervision de consultants sur les sites concernés.


Key job responsibilities
Principales responsabilités du poste

Développer un programme couvrant plusieurs équipes de parties prenantes afin de garantir une gestion sûre et conforme des sites contaminés.
Assumer la gestion départementale des sites contaminés après la due diligence, en veillant au respect de toutes les conditions d'approbation : gestion des contrôles techniques, restrictions d'usage et reporting.
Fournir des directives pour les conceptions de contrôles techniques préparées par les prestataires et les examiner.
Apporter un soutien à la planification de projet en phase de pré-construction, notamment en fournissant les informations de pré-construction et les informations techniques nécessaires aux procédures d'appel d'offres.
Examiner les dossiers d'appel d'offres et les réponses reçues afin de vérifier l'inclusion des exigences de conception et de santé et sécurité.
Examiner et valider les Plans de Gestion des Matériaux (Material Management Plans) et les Plans de Gestion de Site (Site Management Plans) pour s'assurer de leur conformité aux exigences d'Amazon.
Coordonner, inspecter et superviser les équipes prestataires et les cabinets de conseil en environnement lors des activités de construction en sous-sol.
Réaliser des inspections des systèmes de recouvrement (capping) et de confinement des sites contaminés.
Communiquer les risques à l'ensemble des parties prenantes, notamment les équipes de conception, de construction, d'exploitation et de rénovation.
Assurer l'interface avec les équipes de pré-construction/conception et de construction afin d'identifier et d'atténuer les risques environnementaux.
Suivre les calendriers des projets et tenir à jour la documentation des activités de conformité.
Veiller à ce que toutes les phases de développement et d'exploitation des sites respectent les exigences réglementaires.
Soutenir les travaux de rénovation sur les sites contaminés du portefeuille d'Amazon, dans la mesure des capacités disponibles.
Ce poste nécessite une coordination entre plusieurs équipes Amazon, des agences de réglementation et des parties prenantes externes, ainsi que des partenaires tels que les propriétaires fonciers, les structures de promotion immobilière et les équipes prestataires.

Basic qualifications

- Expérience de la communication avec un large éventail de parties prenantes, y compris des collègues et la direction, ou expérience de l'interaction avec une clientèle externe.
- Expérience en saisie et analyse de données précises.
- Un diplôme de licence (Bachelor) ou un niveau de qualification équivalent conformément au Cadre Européen des Certifications (CEC) en Géologie, Sciences de l'Environnement, Chimie, Génie Chimique ou Environnemental, Génie Civil, ou domaine d'études connexe.
- Expérience en construction ou en gestion de projet.
- Expérience en lecture, interprétation et création de plans de construction, de spécifications et de documents de soumission.
- Expérience en construction et gestion de sites contaminés, de préférence avec une expertise en PFAS.
- Connaissance des réglementations environnementales et des exigences de conformité.
- Expérience des contrôles techniques environnementaux et des systèmes de remédiation (recouvrements, systèmes de couverture, systèmes d'atténuation des intrusions de vapeurs/méthane, etc.).
- Expérience du travail avec des restrictions foncières ou de propriété (deed restrictions) et des contrôles d'usage des sols.

Preferred qualifications

- Diplôme de Master.
- Les qualifications préférées ne sont pas obligatoires pour postuler à un poste chez Amazon. Si vous réunissez toutes les qualifications de base ci-dessus, votre candidature nous intéresse.
- Certification dans un domaine technique pertinent.
- Expérience de projets de construction commerciale à grande échelle, y compris la remédiation de contamination.

descriptionHtml:

This role owns a program area end-to-end, identifies problems and opportunities independently, and drives cross-functional alignment to deliver results at scale. This position reports to a Sr. Manager.

- Design and scale loss prevention solutions across expanding last mile delivery methods, transportation modalities, and node types
- Develop and standardize OTR metrics for last mile operations globally, from dispatch to drop-off and return-to-station
- Work to standardize Security and Loss Prevention last mile metrics and benchmark performance
- Identify and tackle intrinsically hard problems - those that are ambiguous, structurally complex, carry business or reputational risk, or have potential for large-scale global impact
- Own program strategy and end-to-end delivery, defining the roadmap, success metrics, and mechanisms for assigned program area
- Drive alignment, collaboration, and accountability across multiple distinct organizations with competing priorities, translating shared objectives into coordinated execution
- Design and maintain structured communication processes that ensure stakeholders receive timely, actionable project intelligence
- Apply rigorous quantitative and qualitative analysis to prioritize investments, influence leadership decisions, and accelerate delivery
- Develop short-term actions and long-term (1-3 year) roadmaps; index on long-term value over short-term results while setting new standards
- Accompany and guide stakeholders through change via structured change management processes to ensure adoption; build sustainable mechanisms for long-term success
- Leverage analysis and high judgment; use quantitative and qualitative data to prioritize and influence, show creativity, experimentation and innovation, and drive projects with urgency in this fast-paced environment

title: Planning Data Analyst, Supply Chain & Linehaul Transportation
descriptionHtml:
A Amazon (Supply Chain and Capacity Planning) está procurando por pessoas motivadas para ajudar a desenvolver um processo logístico de classe mundial que entregue mercadorias no prazo e com o melhor custo. O objetivo da nossa equipe é gerenciar com excelência o planejamento de capacidade de Transporte Linehaul, focada nos pilares estratégicos de otimização, custo e performance.

 Esse papel exige pessoa ambiciosa. Você representará uma função crítica em nossas operações de transporte mais amplas na Amazon, enquanto trabalhamos para melhorar continuamente os níveis de serviço, as capacidades e os custos da Amazon Brazil Transportation Line Haul. Isso nos ajudará a garantir que as promessas feitas aos nossos valiosos clientes sejam cumpridas sempre.

 Uma pessoa especialista em Data Analytics (Middle Mile Planning) facilita o fluxo de informações entre diferentes partes interessadas, cria/ desenvolve relatórios, dashboards e reports gerenciais para liderança direta LATAM (Latin America/ Brasil e Mexico). Além disso, trabalhará com stakeholders (Supply Chain, Finance, Operations, ATS, First Mile, Air e Last Mile, garantindo visibilidade de todas as métricas de Middle Mile Planning para todos os níveis de liderança. Essa pessoa aborda quaisquer possíveis problemas que ocorram em dados/ métricas e direciona visibilidade para tomada de decisão.

 Nossa cultura inclusiva capacita os amazonians a oferecer os melhores resultados para nossos clientes. Não só celebramos a diversidade de nossa força de trabalho, mas também as diversas formas de trabalhar. Se você quiser solicitar uma acomodação para o processo de entrevista ou integração, informe nossa equipe e nós o conectaremos à nossa equipe de acomodação.

 Essa função funcionará em regime presencial e em horário comercial (Seg a Sex das 08h às 17h)

Key job responsibilities
Capacidade de extrair dados de vários bancos de dados (usando Excel, Access, SQL e/ou outros sistemas de gerenciamento de dados) e realizar relatórios e análises ad hoc conforme necessário.
Desenvolver e/ou compreender métricas de desempenho para ajudar a impulsionar os resultados operacionais e do business.
Deve ser capaz de entender rapidamente o impacto das métricas e respectivas tendências e tomar decisões que façam sentido com base nos dados disponíveis.
Deve ser capaz de encaminhar sistematicamente problemas ou variações nas informações e dados para os proprietários e equipes relevantes e cumprir as resoluções para garantir que sejam entregues.
Garantir excelência em Hyper CARE de dashboards e base de dados da área.
Trabalhe dentro de várias restrições de tempo para atender às necessidades críticas dos negócios, ao mesmo tempo em que mede e identifica as atividades realizadas.
Excelente comunicação, tanto verbal quanto escrita, para criar uma narrativa descrevendo as descobertas semanais e as variações das metas, e apresentá-las em um fórum de revisão.

Basic qualifications

- Knowledge of Excel
- Experience using SQL
- Experience developing PHY/MAC layer HW/SW targeting SoCs, FPGAs, and general-purpose processors

Preferred qualifications

- Experience in transportation or supply chain
