title: Manutentore Elettro/Meccanico, RME
descriptionHtml:
Il team Reliability Maintenance Engineering (RME) è fondamentale ad Amazon per monitorare tutte le attività operative: è grazie a questo team che viene garantito il corretto funzionamento di macchinari critici. In qualità di RME Technician, ti occuperai della manutenzione di una vasta gamma di macchinari e postazioni di lavoro, assicurando sempre il rispetto delle normative di salute e sicurezza. Aiuterai a tutelare la sicurezza dei colleghi, prevenendo fermi macchina. Il nostro team di RME ottimizza la disponibilità e la qualità dei nostri macchinari e migliora l’ambiente operativo nel complesso.

Il contratto collettivo nazionale di lavoro applicabile a questo ruolo è Logistica e Trasporti. La posizione è inquadrata al livello 3.

La retribuzione lorda per questa posizione è indicata di seguito. La retribuzione indicata corrisponde a un impiego a tempo pieno. Per un impiego a tempo parziale, la retribuzione sarà adeguata proporzionalmente.

Il pacchetto retributivo di Amazon può includere ulteriori componenti retributive, ove applicabili.

Il team di recruiting condividerà lo stipendio finale, in base ai requisiti specifici del ruolo e a eventuali integrazioni retributive applicabili in conformità al CCNL e al livello di inquadramento.

Oltre ai benefici previsti dalla legge e quelli applicabili al CCNL di riferimento, potrebbero essere previsti ulteriori benefici aziendali, soggetti a termini aggiuntivi.

Roma - 38,900€ lordi annui.


Key job responsibilities
Interventi di manutenzione preventiva e a guasto su un’ampia gamma di macchinari in sede.

Eseguire riparazioni di emergenza e diagnosi dei guasti nei magazzini di distribuzione.

Utilizzo di strumenti all’avanguardia per massimizzare l’efficacia dei macchinari.

Conformità a tutte le normative e prassi in materia di salute e sicurezza.

Favorire lo sviluppo e l’avanzamento di chi partecipa ai programmi di apprendistato nelle nostre sedi.

Sovraintendere a progetti di miglioramento continuo e implementare procedure chiave in una gamma di sedi europee.


A day in the life
I nostri RME Technician operano sul campo, in modo da intervenire prontamente nell’eventualità di problemi ai macchinari. A intervalli prestabiliti, eseguirai una serie di interventi di manutenzione preventiva sui macchinari delle nostre sedi, per assicurarne il corretto funzionamento. In qualità di RME Technician, interverrai prontamente in caso di guasti, investigandone le cause e implementando soluzioni in maniera tempestiva. Inoltre, indicherai possibili miglioramenti a lungo termine da apportare per scongiurare problematiche in futuro.
Affiancando i colleghi senior, ti occuperai della manutenzione ordinaria, come la tinteggiatura o l’idraulica, con il supporto di professionisti esterni se necessario. Il tuo lavoro sarà organizzato su diversi turni, per assicurare assistenza 24 ore su 24, in modo da consentire ad Amazon di effettuare le consegne con la velocità che ci contraddistingue.

About the team
La nostra forza è focalizzarci sul pensiero creativo e sul miglioraci continuamente per assicurare che milioni di prodotti arrivino nelle mani dei nostri consumatori. Il nostro obiettivo è semplice: regalare ai clienti l’esperienza di consegna più fluida possibile e lanciare soluzioni globali per la consegna nei nostri nuovi business, come Amazon Fresh, Prime Now e Amazon Restaurants.
La nostra attività si articola su due livelli. Da un lato c’è chi opera in sede e gestisce milioni di prodotti, facendoli arrivare ai team responsabili della consegna. Il nostro team è orientato alle persone e sempre pronto a darsi una mano, soprattutto considerato che molti dei nostri colleghi svolgono il turno notturno. Ci concentriamo principalmente sulle attività operative, con turni articolati sulle 24 ore, 7 giorni alla settimana, nella maggior parte delle nostre sedi.

Basic qualifications

- Vasta esperienza nella manutenzione di impianti meccanici e/o elettrici.
- Piena padronanza della lingua italiana, scritta e parlata.

Preferred qualifications

- Le qualifiche preferenziali non sono requisiti obbligatori per candidarsi a una posizione in Amazon. Se possiedi tutte le qualifiche richieste di cui sopra, non esitare a inviarci la tua candidatura: saremo felici di esaminarla!
- Esperienza nel monitoraggio "Condition Based Monitoring" (monitoraggio in base alle condizioni)
- Esperienza con procedure di sicurezza (LOTO, lockout-tagout)
- Esperienza professionale con i macchinari di stampa e applicazione etichette.
- Esperienza nell’individuazione dei guasti e nella manutenzione di nastri trasportatori o sistemi di automazione.

title: Base Building Project Manager , BBX (Base Building Excellence)

title: Safety Engineering Manager, AWS Health & Safety
descriptionHtml:
Join the world class safety culture at Amazon Web Services (AWS) and be part of supporting the largest cloud computing infrastructure team as a Safety Engineering Manager. We are looking for a manager for the Health and Safety (H&S) Engineering team who will be responsible for driving a strategic approach to delivering high-level engineering services for the AWS Safety team, strategic team leadership and development, setting and driving team vision and objectives, mentoring and growing safety engineer talent, managing team performance and career development

The ideal candidate will be a highly motivated manager with a solid knowledge in safety engineering, and a proven track record of designing, deploying, and managing global safety engineering programs. They will have a history of building partnerships with diverse teams across multiple jurisdictions. The candidate must have the ability to define clear requirements in ambiguity, proactively educate team members, leaders, and other support teams, and communicate effectively and consistently throughout all levels of the business. The role will evolve with the maturity and growth of the program and requires a high degree of flexibility, including the ability to deep dive into time critical programs and projects, manage a team of safety engineers, and deliver continuous improvement actions.

The AWS Health and Safety (H&S) team is an expanding a dynamic team that is critical to enabling AWS’s growth around the world, as well as ensuring compliance of AWS’s global operations, including physical data centers, as well as other AWS facilities, customer-facing enterprises and products. The H&S team has responsibility for architecting and implementing AWS’s global safety programs. This includes defining and implementing risk management and compliance systems and driving their continuous improvement; setting and refining global policies and procedures; overseeing the development of standards, tools, auditing and metrics, and employee training;

Key job responsibilities
• Manage and oversee a team of Safety Engineers and the safety lab.
• Manage and oversee multiple safety engineering projects. This includes technical writing, program maintenance, deployment of new projects, tools and programs, and continuous improvement of existing programs.
• Develop trusting relationships with partners and customers, understanding their business needs and troubleshoot challenges
• Collaborate with AWS programs teams, field safety teams, Engineering, and other functional team in the development and implementation of H&S operational excellence solutions
• Identify, action, and/or provide advice on how safety engineering will improve and streamline business operations to drive growth, improve organizational efficiency to improve workplace safety
• Demonstrate excellent time-management skills and the ability to work independently while using centralized resources, policies, and procedures
• Resource allocation and prioritization across team projects
• Strategic planning and roadmap development at a team level
• Budget management and resource planning

A day in the life
We are looking for an analytical and results-oriented person to work directly with members of the safety engineering team, Data Center Health and Safety (DCHS) teams, Data Center Operations (DCO), and the various AWS Engineering teams to focus on developing and implementing safety engineering solutions.

About the team
AWS Infrastructure Services (AIS) owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

Diverse Experiences
AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS?
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Inclusive Team Culture
Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (gender diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

Mentorship & Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Health and Safety or a related field
- 3+ years of technical program management experience
- 3+ years of people management experience
- Experience communicating across technical and non-technical audiences, including executive level stakeholders or clients

Preferred qualifications

- Knowledge of data center infrastructure design, operations, or delivery
- Experience managing projects across cross functional teams, building sustainable processes and coordinating release schedules
- Master's degree in Health and Safety or a related field
- Certified Safety Professional (CSP)
- Certified Machinery Safety Expert (CMSE)

title: Learning & Development Coach, MX, Leader Coaching Team (LCT)
descriptionHtml:
The Learning & Development Coach role within the Leader Coaching Team (LCT) provides superior facilitation and coaching across Worldwide Operations (WWOPs) leaders. They are responsible for facilitating remote and in-person learning experiences to support leader development for all Global Operations Learning and Development (GOLD) Programs. They partner with stakeholders, Program Managers (PMs), Learning Business Partners (LBPs), and Operations stakeholders to execute holistic solutions considering both an optimal learning experience and business needs. In addition to assisting in the ongoing development and facilitation of skills of peers, the L&D Coach also helps prepare and provide feedback to business presenters. They apply high standards for coaching effectiveness, demonstrating ethical practice and a client-centered coaching mindset.

Consultation, Solution Implementation, & Delivery: With emphasis on Earn Trust, the L&D Coach cultivates partnerships with participants and stakeholders to gather information and data to make necessary changes to evolve and improve the Instructor-Led-Training (ILT) and Remote-Instructor-Led-Training (VILT) experience. They enable the delivery of learning, utilizing technology and providing the learner with specific examples that address real-life scenarios applicable to their daily responsibilities. The L&D Coach identifies what types of information respond well via the ILT/VILT modality. As a result, Invent and Simplify will be a strategic component to success within the role and in future growth within LCT.

They are trained and/or experienced with delivering and providing relatable examples when facilitating DEI or leading inclusive content. For example, during each module/course introduction they lay the foundation to establish DEI policies and expectations. This individual also ensures learners, and business presenters all have safe and inclusive learning environment within each program, through the diversity of course materials and accessibility of the content; i.e., inclusive terminology.

Measuring Learning Impact: The L&D Coach requires Learn & Be Curious and Dive Deep by working backwards through the needs of the learner with a scientific approach using adult learning theory in the delivery, develop, and evaluate phases of program life-cycles. This person works with PMs and Business Intelligence (BI) to improve the quality of learning solutions. In developing facilitation solutions, the L&D Coach plans for the unexpected and proactively manages risks (i.e., technological fallback, business presenter mishaps, and audience disengagement). The L&D Coach ensures success metrics are in place for measuring projects, evaluating Business Presenters and analyzing survey engagement feedback. This person uses data analytics to create and monitor dashboards and consults with PMs to identify stakeholder key performance indicators and drives to meet goals.

Key job responsibilities
- Deliver instructor-led trainings (in-person and remote) programs. Must be able to facilitate high quality learner-focused programs which have informative content and engaging learning techniques and environment.
- Upskill, train, coach, and provide feedback to business presenters to ensure that these colleagues can deliver the same high quality training so that customers receive the appropriate learning outcomes.
- Partner with key customers and stakeholders (Program Managers, Learning Business Partners, and Operations leaders) in order to assess, understand, and provide GOLD support towards a number of different leadership development training programs.
- Identify, scope, and deliver individual and team-based projects to better suit the changing needs of the business and our customers.
- Develop, analyze, and interpret data, feedback, and results of training to assess level of competency gained in order to provide and communicate updates to stakeholders in addition to developing training sessions and products through continuous improvement.
- Develop products and solutions through independent and collaborative projects in order to address the fast-paced and dynamic needs of the business.
- This is position is located in São Paulo - SP Brazil
- Candidate must be willing to travel up to 75% of the time.

A day in the life
Approximately, 75% of the time would be spent in facilitation of various programs. 25% of the time would be spent on Project Management and Stakeholder Management.About the team
The Leader Coaching Team (LCT) coaches and develops leaders to effectively grow their skills and capabilities through a continuous leadership journey. We are development experts dedicated to the engagement, growth, and retention of WW Ops leaders. Our global approach to coaching and facilitation provides the knowledge, tools and techniques to better lead their teams.


About the team
Inclusive team culture
 
At Amazon we embrace our differences and we are committed to furthering our culture of inclusion. We host annual and ongoing learning experiences. Amazon’s culture of inclusion is reinforced within our 14 Leadership Principles, which remind team members to seek diverse perspectives, learn and be curious, and earn trust.  
 
Work Life Balance
 
We believe striking the right balance between your personal and professional life is critical to life-long happiness and fulfillment. We offer flexibility in working hours and encourage you to find your own balance between your work and personal lives.  
 
Mentorship & Career Growth
 
Our team is dedicated to supporting new members. We have a broad mix of experience levels and tenures, and we’re building an environment that celebrates knowledge sharing and mentorship. We care about your career growth and strive to assign projects based on what will help each team member develop into a better-rounded professional.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree or equivalent
- Speak, write, and read fluently in English, and have the ability to take direction in English
- Experience in stakeholder and communication management
- Experience in oral and written communication

Preferred qualifications

- Master's degree
- Knowledge of general AI tools

title: Partner Solutions Architect, Partner Solutions Architects - France & Europe South
descriptionHtml:
Are you passionate about helping partners solve complex technical challenges and leveraging cloud computing technologies to drive innovation? Do you have a talent for explaining intricate application architectures and integration approaches to C-level stakeholders? If so, we have an exciting opportunity for you to join Amazon Web Services (AWS) as a Senior Partner Solutions Architect (PSA) in France.

As a senior member of our Partner team, you'll play a crucial role in shaping and executing strategies to build mindshare and promote the broad adoption of AWS services across our Italian partner community. Your primary focus will be on owning the technical engagement with strategic system integrators and consulting partners in the Italian market, while influencing the broader Europe South partner ecosystem.

We're looking for a candidate who can demonstrate:

- Deep technical expertise in software architecture and cloud computing
- Strong customer-facing skills, ideally gained within a partner organization
- The ability to think strategically about business, product, and technical challenges
- A track record of driving technical initiatives and influencing senior stakeholders (CIO, CTO, VP Engineering)
- Experience mentoring and raising the bar for technical teams


This role offers a high level of autonomy and great opportunities to learn and share best practices across countries. You'll be part of the France and Europe South team, collaborating with colleagues throughout the region.


Key job responsibilities
1. Act as a trusted technical advisor to our managed system integrators in France, supporting partner-led customer opportunities with architectural guidance and recommendations for successful engagements.

2. Champion AWS partners and assist solution providers in defining technical strategies to enhance their offerings on AWS — you should be as comfortable discussing cloud strategy with the CIO, TCO with the CFO, or continuous deployment with the DevOps team.

3. Drive partner technical maturity by guiding them to achieve AWS recognitions such as AWS Competencies, Service Deliveries, and Specializations.

4. Capture and share best practices with the broader Solution Architect community, contributing thought leadership and mentoring junior team members.

5. Evangelize AWS services and solutions to the Italian partner community through summits, workshops, product launches, and industry events.

6. Collaborate with internal teams (sales, partner managers, engineering) to ensure partner success and drive adoption of AWS services.

7. Contribute to the development of technical content, such as whitepapers, reference architectures, and solution briefs.

8. Participate in and lead complex technical discussions with partners and customers, proposing innovative solutions to business and technical challenges.

9. Influence the partner technical strategy at a regional level, contributing to cross-country initiatives and programs.

A day in the life
As a Senior Partner Solutions Architect, you'll engage in a diverse range of activities that showcase your technical expertise and business acumen. On any given day, you might:
- Engage in strategic discussions with partner executives, aligning on cloud adoption strategies and driving them toward AWS Competencies and advanced specializations.
- Apply the "working backwards from the customer" approach to support partners on their customer opportunities, designing innovative solutions that address complex business needs.
- Conduct enablement sessions and hands-on workshops with partners and their customers, upskilling them on the latest AWS innovations and best practices.
- Support a partner's customer opportunity providing deep-dive guidance on architecture best practices and addressing complex technical challenges.
- Mentor other solutions architects and contribute to team-wide knowledge sharing and skill development.
- Author technical content and deliver public speaking engagements at AWS, industry, or partner events.
- Some travel may be required (within France and occasionally across Europe South and France).

About the team
You'll join a dynamic, collaborative team of solutions architects dedicated to partner success across France and Europe South (Spain, Portugal, Italy). Our friendly, fun-loving environment fosters continuous learning, knowledge sharing, and growth opportunities regionally and at the EMEA level. Collaborating closely with AWS sales, partner, and engineering teams, we ensure partners have the technical support to build successful cloud businesses. Teamwork is paramount, engaging colleagues from diverse backgrounds to share best practices and explore innovative solutions together. We prioritize an enjoyable atmosphere where strong relationships thrive alongside professional development, achieving goals while having fun.

Basic qualifications

- 8+ years of specific technology domain areas (e.g. software development, cloud computing, systems engineering, infrastructure, security, networking, data & analytics) experience
- 5+ years of design, implementation, or consulting in applications and infrastructures experience
- Experience communicating across technical and non-technical audiences, including executive level stakeholders or clients

Preferred qualifications

- Experience working within software development or Internet-related industries
- Experience in a customer-facing, partner-facing, or consulting role within a technology company or system integrator
- Experience migrating or transforming enterprise workloads to the public cloud (AWS preferred)
- Knowledge of modern application architectures: microservices, containers, serverless, CI/CD, and Infrastructure as Code
- Familiarity with AI/ML services and Generative AI use cases in enterprise environments
- AWS Certifications (Solutions Architect Professional, DevOps Engineer, or Specialty certifications)
- Experience engaging with C-level executives (CIO, CTO, CFO) on cloud strategy and business transformation
- Track record of mentoring technical teams and contributing to community knowledge sharing
- Fluent in French and English; additional European languages are a plus

title: Program Manager, Global Logistics
descriptionHtml:
Amazon is looking for a Program Manager with a strong delivery record and proven project management experience to own strategic, tactical, cross-functional and technology projects and programs across multiple verticals. This role requires scoping and creating project plans, developing processes, coordinating and driving execution, and communicating to senior management on status, risks and process/product changes. Cross-team coordination, project management and executive presentation skills are essential. The ideal candidate will leverage extensive project management experience, combined with deep analytical capabilities and a keen sense of innovation, to lead complex projects from conception to completion. We are seeking a Program Manager to effectively manage the creation and enhancement of our supply chain and transportation networks. In this role, you will scope large projects, track project timelines, and develop mechanisms for communicating status, risk, and business challenges. The ideal candidate must be adept at cross-team coordination, project management, and data analysis, with a proven history of delivering results. At Amazon, you'll work alongside the latest AI and GenAI tools that are increasingly woven into how teams operate: from AI-powered capabilities that accelerate decision-making, to Generative AI that helps you focus on work that truly matters. You'll have opportunities and resources to develop AI fluency at your own pace, with continuous learning built into the culture. Amazonでは、優れた実績と確実なプロジェクトマネジメント経験を持ち、複数の事業領域にまたがる戦略的・戦術的・部門横断的・テクノロジー関連のプロジェクトおよびプログラムを推進できるプログラムマネージャーを募集しています。本ポジションでは、プロジェクト計画のスコーピングと策定、プロセスの構築、実行の調整・推進、およびシニアマネジメントへの進捗・リスク・プロセスやプロダクトの変更に関する報告を担っていただきます。チーム間での協働、プロジェクトマネジメント力、経営層向けプレゼンテーションスキルが不可欠になります。豊富なプロジェクトマネジメント経験に加え、高い分析力と鋭いイノベーション感覚を活かし、複雑なプロジェクトを構想段階から完遂まで推進いただける方を求めています。 本ポジションでは特にサプライチェーンおよび輸送ネットワークの構築・改善を効果的に管理いただけるプログラムマネージャーを募集しています。主な業務としては大規模プロジェクトのスコーピング、プロジェクトタイムラインの管理、および進捗・リスク・ビジネス課題を共有するための仕組みの構築を行っていただきます。前述の通り、チーム間の協働力、プロジェクトマネジメント力、データ分析力に長け、成果を出してきた実績をお持ちの方を求めています。 Amazonでは、最新のAI Tool, 生成AIを日々の業務の中に積極的に取り入れています。 AI Toolは私たちの意思決定のスピードを加速させ、私たちを本当に重要な「判断」と「議論」に集中させることを可能にしています。Amazon では学習を継続する文化が根付いているため、ご自身のペースでAIに関する知識を深めることができるリソースが用意されています。

Key job responsibilities
• Supply chain, transportation, or logistic network management solution experience
• Manage and oversee various cross-functional programs, ensuring successful delivery.
• Develop and refine program strategies, effectively leading and motivating teams.
• Set clear objectives for programs, leveraging data analytics to drive improvements and achieve metrics.
• Navigate and resolve ambiguities in business scenarios, applying creative problem-solving skills.
• Foster collaboration with internal and external partners to optimize resource allocation and project success.
• Evaluate and prioritize projects in conjunction with customer needs and technical team inputs.
• Bridge gaps in team dynamics, processes, and systems, preventing common project pitfalls.
• Identify and mitigate risks, preventing them from escalating into major issues.
• Regularly communicate with senior managers, business leaders, and other stakeholders to support key business initiatives.
• Develop, implement, and oversee KPI reporting for a program portfolio, ensuring clear visibility of milestones and project performance.
• Manage and communicate project budgets effectively.

主な職務内容：
• サプライチェーン、輸送、またはロジスティクスネットワークの管理・改善経験を有すること
• 複数の部門横断プログラムを管理・監督し、確実なデリバリーを実現すること
• プログラム戦略を策定・改善し、チームを効果的にリードすること
• データ分析を活用してプログラムの明確な目標を設定し、改善を推進して指標を達成すること
• ビジネスにおける曖昧な状況を整理・解決し、創造的な問題解決スキルを発揮すること
• 社内外のパートナーとの協働を促進し、リソース配分とプロジェクトの成功を最適化すること
• 顧客ニーズと技術チームからのインプットを踏まえ、プロジェクトの評価・優先順位付けを行うこと
• チームダイナミクス、プロセス、システムにおけるギャップを特定・解消し、プロジェクトでの一般的な落とし穴を防止すること
• リスクを特定・軽減し、重大な問題への発展を未然に防ぐこと
• シニアマネージャー、ビジネスリーダー、その他ステークホルダーと定期的にコミュニケーションを取り、主要なビジネス施策を支援すること
• プログラムポートフォリオのKPIレポートを策定・実施・管理し、マイルストーンとプロジェクト進捗を明確に可視化すること
• プロジェクト予算の効果的な管理等

A day in the life
• Leadership and Strategy: Lead business and planning reviews with senior leaders, ensuring alignment and execution of strategic initiatives. Develop and implement strategies to enhance supply chain performance and support business growth.
• Operational Excellence: Create a robust and cost-efficient supply chain, ensuring reliable delivery processes. Drive execution discipline in operations across various stakeholders, including Global Logistics, Asia Pacific Operations, Retail and FBA, US Fulfillment Centers, Procurement, Finance, Compliance, and Legal.
• Data-Driven Decision Making: Utilize a strong analytical background to make data-driven decisions. Analyze data and metrics to identify opportunities for process improvements and operational efficiencies.
• Stakeholder Management: Manage relationships with multiple stakeholders across different programs. Lead through influence, demonstrating the ability to think broadly and strategically about supply chain initiatives and build consensus among senior leaders.
• Team Development: As the scope of the role expands and business volumes grow, hire and develop a high-performing team. Provide leadership and mentorship to foster professional growth and ensure team success.
• Collaboration and Execution: Collaborate with cross-functional teams to identify and implement process improvements. Ensure seamless execution of operational strategies and continuous improvement initiatives.
• Travel Requirements: This role may require travel to various Amazon facilities and on-site visits with Carriers and Logistics Service Providers (LSPs) based on business needs.

About the team
Global Logistics (GL) is a dynamic team of seasoned logistics professionals, carrier specialists, and program managers dedicated to enhancing Amazon's cross-border logistics. Our goal is to improve cost, speed, and reliability, enabling customers worldwide to access selections from any part of the globe. The Asia-Pacific, Japan and Brazil (APJ/BR) team manages import operations across: Japan (JP), Australia (AU) and Brazil (BR) through comprehensive cross-border Business-to-Business programs.
We are seeking a Program Manager in Tokyo, Japan to join our GL APJ/BR team. This individual will be instrumental in refining the cost, speed, and quality of multiple sourced programs and managing Destination Operations. They will collaborate with Amazon stakeholders and third-party logistics (3PL) partners in and destination countries to develop capabilities, manage projects, and formulate and execute operational strategies.

If you are passionate about logistics and supply chain management and have a proven track record of driving operational excellence, we invite you to apply for the Program Manager role at Amazon’s Global Logistics APJ/BR team. This is a unique opportunity to contribute to Amazon’s global growth and make a significant impact on our logistics operations.

Amazon offers a full range of benefits that support you and eligible family members, including domestic partners and their children. Benefits can vary by location, the number of regularly scheduled hours you work, length of employment, and job status such as seasonal or temporary employment. Please find general information about our Employee Benefits below:


チームについて
Global Logistics（GL）は、Amazonの国際物流の強化に取り組む、経験豊富な物流プロフェッショナル、キャリアスペシャリスト、プログラムマネージャーで構成されるチームです。コストの最適化、スピードと信頼性の向上を通じて、世界中のお客様が地球上のあらゆる国や地域のセレクションにアクセスできる環境の実現を目指しています。アジア太平洋・日本・ブラジル（APJ/BR）チームは、日本（JP）、ブラジル（BR）、オーストラリア（AU）を含む7カ国の輸入オペレーションを、包括的な越境B2Bプログラムを通じてマネージしています。
現在、東京オフィスにてGL APJ/BRチームに参画いただけるプログラムマネージャーを募集しています。本ポジションでは、複数のソーシングプログラム（輸入元）のコスト・スピード・品質の改善、および日本における仕向け国でのオペレーションの管理を担っていただきます。Amazonの社内ステークホルダーや仕向国の3PLパートナーと連携し、物流機能の開発、プロジェクト管理、オペレーション戦略の策定・実行に取り組んでいただきます。
物流およびサプライチェーンマネジメントに熱意があり、オペレーショナルエクセレンスの推進において実績のある方のご応募をお待ちしております。AmazonのGlobal Logistics APJ/BRチームのプログラムマネージャーとして、Amazonのグローバルな成長に貢献し、物流オペレーションに大きなインパクトを与える機会です。
Amazonでは、社員およびその対象家族（事実婚パートナーとその子どもを含む）を支援する各種福利厚生を提供しています。福利厚生の内容は、勤務地、所定労働時間、勤続期間、雇用形態（季節雇用・有期雇用等）により異なる場合がありますのでご留意ください。

Basic qualifications

- 3+ years of program or project management experience
- 3+ years of working cross functionally with tech and non-tech teams experience
- 3+ years of defining and implementing process improvement initiatives using data and metrics experience
- Bachelor's degree
- Knowledge of Excel (Pivot Tables, VLookUps) at an advanced level and SQL
- Read, speak & write Japanese and English at business level

Preferred qualifications

- 3+ years of driving end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership experience
- 3+ years of driving process improvements experience

descriptionHtml:
Quality Specialists play a vital role in establishing and maintaining comprehensive quality frameworks across our operations. Their primary responsibility begins with developing robust quality strategies in collaboration with customers and CPMs, encompassing metrics, audit approaches, and specific targets for each workflow. When quality issues arise, these specialists create prescriptive actions, examining data patterns to formulate effective solutions. They maintain a continuous improvement cycle by managing a critical feedback loop between operations and customers, drawing insights from multiple sources including quality auditors, side-by-side observations, and metric analysis. Through regular side-by-side sessions, they identify opportunities for workflow enhancement and quality improvements. The specialists serve as key escalation points for customer concerns, providing strategic recommendations based on their deep understanding of processes. They consistently evaluate quality tools, suggesting refinements to enhance effectiveness, while simultaneously maintaining and updating process documentation to ensure standardization and clarity across all workflows. This comprehensive approach ensures quality remains at the forefront of our operational excellence.

Key job responsibilities
* Define and implement quality metrics for established workflows

* Conduct side-by-sides to identify opportunities for workflow enhancement and quality improvements

You will spend approximately 30% of your time on analysis: reviewing data trends, investigating root causes of quality dips, and creating prescriptive actions for operations teams.

Another 30% goes to stakeholder communication: leading weekly customer meetings, preparing quality reports, and handling escalations. The remaining time is split between process work (updating SOPs, refining audit rubrics, conducting side-by-sides) and calibration activities (aligning audit standards with Senior Quality Auditors and operations teams).

You are measured on: SLA metrics (appeals and batch completion), customer satisfaction, quality improvement trends for your workflows, and documentation quality.

The Quality Operations team within FAI Data Services ensures that labeled training data meets accuracy and consistency standards before it is used to train Amazon's AI models. title: Senior Applied Scientist
descriptionHtml:
At Audible, we believe stories have the power to transform lives. It’s why we work with some of the world’s leading creators to produce and share audio storytelling with our millions of global listeners. We are dreamers and inventors who come from a wide range of backgrounds and experiences to empower and inspire each other. Imagine your future with us.

ABOUT THIS ROLE
As a Senior Applied Scientist, you will solve large complex real-world problems at scale, draw inspiration from the latest science and technology to empower undefined/untapped business use cases, delve into customer requirements, collaborate with tech and product teams on design, and create production-ready models that span various domains, including Machine Learning (ML), Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Generative AI, Natural Language Processing (NLP), Reinforcement Learning (RL), real-time and distributed systems.

ABOUT YOU
Your work will focus on inventing and extending scientific approaches, models, and algorithms driven by customer needs at the product level, framing new research problems even when the problem is ill-defined and no textbook solution exists. You will lead the design, implementation, and delivery of scientifically complex, end-to-end solutions that are deployed into production, defining system-level requirements and writing a significant portion of the critical-path code. You will develop reusable science components and services that resolve architecture deficiencies and customers’ pain points, while making technical trade-offs for long-term/short-term. You will work independently with limited guidance, and your decision-making will consistently incorporate robust, data-driven business and technical judgment. You will drive your team’s scientific agenda, author internal or external peer-reviewed publications that validate the novelty of your work, mentor and develop other scientists, and build consensus across multiple teams. You will have the opportunity to innovate, invent, and think big, and influence the experiences of millions of customers. We are looking for a results-oriented Senior Applied Scientist with deep expertise in ML, NLP, Deep Learning, GenAI, and/or large-scale distributed computation.

As an Applied Scientist, you will...
- Understand complex, ambiguous use cases across the business and adopt/extend/design/invent solutions/models that are scalable, efficient, and automated, where neither the problem nor the solution is well defined
- Work closely with fellow scientists and software engineers (at Audible and Amazon) to build and productionize models, and deliver novel and highly impactful features
- Review models of peers for the purpose of reducing and managing risk to the business, while improving customer experience
- Lead the design, development, and production deployment of scientifically complex, end-to-end solutions for Content Understanding, Recommendations, and GenAI-based product features, defining system-level requirements
- Drive and lead initiatives that employ the most recent advances in ML/AI/GenAI, drive your team’s scientific agenda, and author peer-reviewed publications
- Mentor and grow scientists on the team and across Amazon, and push the boundary of innovation

ABOUT AUDIBLE
Audible is the leading producer and provider of audio storytelling. We spark listeners’ imaginations, offering immersive, cinematic experiences full of inspiration and insight to enrich our customers daily lives. We are a global company with an entrepreneurial spirit. We are dreamers and inventors who are passionate about the positive impact Audible can make for our customers and our neighbors. This spirit courses throughout Audible, supporting a culture of creativity and inclusion built on our People Principles and our mission to build more equitable communities in the cities we call home.

- Experience in developing and deploying LLMs in production on GPUs, Neuron, TPU or other AI acceleration hardware, or experience in machine learning, data mining, information retrieval, statistics or natural language processing
- PhD plus 5+ years of research experience, or a Master’s degree plus 10+ years of research experience in one of the following disciplines: Machine Learning, Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Data Science, Applied Math, or a related quantitative field
- 5+ years of experience in Deep Learning, Natural Language Processing/Understanding, GenAI and/or Reinforcement Learning
- Experience with Python, SQL, other scripting languages
- Experience delivering science solutions into production systems

- Author of publications at top-tier peer-reviewed conferences or journals, cited by other scientists
- Experience with building Recommendation Systems and/or large-scale content understanding systems
- Experience with large-scale online experimentation / A/B testing to validate science solutions in production

title: Software Dev Engineer, Pricing Shared Platform
descriptionHtml:
Pricing Shared Services team owns the core set of systems which decides prices of products sold by Amazon Retail. The team owns system data vending, notification and price publishing systems which are used by multiple pricing strategy teams for building their price recommendation and submission of their recommended prices. These systems scale to thousands of TPS and computes prices for billions of listing every month. We are building new services that radically scales publishing capacity of our systems while making our services multi-tenant to support Amazon's growing number of businesses. We collaborate with product, science, and business teams to figure out new ideas. We innovate by applying state-of-the-art computer science to define, design, and build our systems. And we experiment with different approaches, eager to learn from whatever the results are while having fun along the way.

To help meet these goals, we are looking for a passionate, talented Software Development Engineer. We are looking for someone who innovates, loves solving hard problems, and looks for 'yes' as the answer. As a Software Development Engineer, you will develop services using your expertise and experience with a variety of technologies. You will deep-dive into distributed systems to design and optimize for performance, maintainability, scalability, and extensibility. You will innovate and scale services, addressing problems that span new feature development to new system creation. You will design and write clean, maintainable code and integrate data from a large number of services. And you will contribute to the development of yourself and colleagues through peer code-reviews and mentoring, improving the technical knowledge and engineering practices of your team.

Key job responsibilities
- Design, build, test, and operate features that scale and extend the Amazon Store experience on Echo Show and Fire devices.
- Write high-quality, well-tested code and participate actively in code reviews, both giving and receiving thoughtful feedback.
- Contribute to systems that render the Amazon store in real time, keep it in sync, and support conversational, multimodal shopping flows.
- Help extend the experience to new surfaces and international marketplaces, working through ambiguity where there is no existing playbook.
- Own your components end-to-end through livesite operations — monitoring, on-call participation, and continuous improvement of reliability and performance.
- Collaborate with engineering, science, product, and design partners across Alexa Shopping, including teammates in Seattle across time zones.
- Contribute ideas to technical designs, ask good questions, and grow your scope and autonomy over time with support from senior engineers and mentors.

About the team
You'll join Pricing Error Detection (PED), part of Amazon's Pricing Shared Services. Our job is simple to say and hard to do: make sure no customer ever sees a price that's wrong, too low for Amazon to sustain or too high for customers to trust. We review hundreds of millions of price decisions every week, before and after they go live, across Amazon's marketplaces worldwide. To do that, we build LLM-based agents that check prices against live signals from across the web, and machine learning models that judge whether each price makes sense. Together they catch errors, correct them, and stop them from happening again. If you want to put the latest GenAI to work at Amazon scale, where every decision protects both customers and the business, we'd love to talk.

- 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
- 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
- Experience programming with at least one software programming language

Preferred qualifications

- 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
- Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

title: Software Dev Engineer, Pricing Shared Platform
descriptionHtml:
Pricing Shared Services team owns the core set of systems which decides prices of products sold by Amazon Retail. The team owns system data vending, notification and price publishing systems which are used by multiple pricing strategy teams for building their price recommendation and submission of their recommended prices. These systems scale to thousands of TPS and computes prices for billions of listing every month. We are building new services that radically scales publishing capacity of our systems while making our services multi-tenant to support Amazon's growing number of businesses. We collaborate with product, science, and business teams to figure out new ideas. We innovate by applying state-of-the-art computer science to define, design, and build our systems. And we experiment with different approaches, eager to learn from whatever the results are while having fun along the way.

To help meet these goals, we are looking for a passionate, talented Software Development Engineer. We are looking for someone who innovates, loves solving hard problems, and looks for 'yes' as the answer. As a Software Development Engineer, you will develop services using your expertise and experience with a variety of technologies. You will deep-dive into distributed systems to design and optimize for performance, maintainability, scalability, and extensibility. You will innovate and scale services, addressing problems that span new feature development to new system creation. You will design and write clean, maintainable code and integrate data from a large number of services. And you will contribute to the development of yourself and colleagues through peer code-reviews and mentoring, improving the technical knowledge and engineering practices of your team.

Key job responsibilities
- Design, build, test, and operate features that scale and extend the Amazon Store experience on Echo Show and Fire devices.
- Write high-quality, well-tested code and participate actively in code reviews, both giving and receiving thoughtful feedback.
- Contribute to systems that render the Amazon store in real time, keep it in sync, and support conversational, multimodal shopping flows.
- Help extend the experience to new surfaces and international marketplaces, working through ambiguity where there is no existing playbook.
- Own your components end-to-end through livesite operations — monitoring, on-call participation, and continuous improvement of reliability and performance.
- Collaborate with engineering, science, product, and design partners across Alexa Shopping, including teammates in Seattle across time zones.
- Contribute ideas to technical designs, ask good questions, and grow your scope and autonomy over time with support from senior engineers and mentors.

About the team
You'll join Pricing Error Detection (PED), part of Amazon's Pricing Shared Services. Our job is simple to say and hard to do: make sure no customer ever sees a price that's wrong, too low for Amazon to sustain or too high for customers to trust. We review hundreds of millions of price decisions every week, before and after they go live, across Amazon's marketplaces worldwide. To do that, we build LLM-based agents that check prices against live signals from across the web, and machine learning models that judge whether each price makes sense. Together they catch errors, correct them, and stop them from happening again. If you want to put the latest GenAI to work at Amazon scale, where every decision protects both customers and the business, we'd love to talk.

title: Software Development Engineer - Security Automation, AWS Security Epoxy
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Security operates at a scale few engineers ever get to work at. Epoxy is the team that builds the automation making that coverage possible. We are looking for a Software Development Engineer to support the building and operating of the platforms that onboard threat detection, remediate security risk, and accelerate security response across every AWS account.

AWS Security, Epoxy builds a collection of automation platforms for AWS Security. We enable threat detection across a large fleet of AWS accounts (onboarding coverage, auditing it continuously, and making findings available to partner teams), we help partner teams remediate detected risks and respond to incidents automatically at scale, and we run the foundational services (communications, workflow orchestration, data enrichment, and secure access) that the rest of AWS Security][ operations relies on. Our systems operate at very high scale and carry a high operational bar: you build it, you run it.

You are a Software Development Engineer who enjoys taking a difficult, loosely specified problem and turning it into a well designed, thoroughly tested, and cleanly operated system. You care about the quality of what you ship and about leaving the systems you touch better than you found them. Experience in security is a plus, but it is not a requirement: what matters most is that you build robust, maintainable, high quality software using modern practices and technologies such as AWS services, Python, and TypeScript, and that you take ownership of the operational health of what you deliver.

Key job responsibilities
- Design and deliver features and components that solve difficult problems across AWS Security Epoxy's services, working independently from a well understood business goal even when the implementation is not fully specified.

- Own the operational excellence of the systems you work on: instrument them, alarm on the right signals, and drive down operational load through automation rather than manual toil.

- Write high quality, well tested code that meets a high engineering bar, and clear documentation and runbooks that let others maintain and extend your work.

- Participate in the team on-call rotation, supporting our services and responding to high-severity requests from AWS Security operations and Partner Teams. You resolve issues, then eliminate their contributing causes with permanent fixes.

- Improve the resiliency, scalability, and safety of systems that operate at very high scale, making sound trade-offs between short-term needs and long-term maintainability.

- Raise the bar through code reviews, design reviews, operational readiness reviews, and post-incident analyses, giving useful and actionable feedback including to more senior engineers.

- Mentor newer teammates and interns, and begin to influence partner teams by helping them adopt sound engineering and operational practices.

A day in the life
You pick up a feature request on one of Epoxy's services, break it into deliverable pieces, and ship it incrementally with tests and monitoring in place.

You review a teammate's design, ask the questions that surface a hidden resiliency risk, and help simplify the approach before code is written.

On an on-call week, you triage a high-severity issue, mitigate customer impact quickly, then open the follow-up work to make sure that class of failure cannot recur.

You spot a piece of manual operational work your team repeats every week and replace it with automation, giving the whole team time back.

You sync with a partner detection or response team to understand how they use an Epoxy capability, and feed what you learn back into the roadmap.

We offer talented security professionals the chance to accelerate their careers with opportunities to build experience in a wide variety of areas including cloud, devices, retail, entertainment, healthcare, operations, and physical stores.

title: Senior Corporate Counsel, Litigation & Regulatory
descriptionHtml:
We are seeking an experienced litigation lawyer to join our India Legal team as Senior Corporate Counsel (SCC). In this role, the SCC will independently manage a large and diverse portfolio of contentious matters — spanning commercial arbitrations, civil suits, consumer disputes, and high-stakes regulatory and enforcement proceedings. You will be a trusted advisor to the business, driving litigation strategy, managing risk, and protecting the company's interests across a complex and fast-moving legal landscape.
This is a high-impact, high-ownership role suited to a self-starter who thrives in a dynamic environment, is comfortable handling matters of significant financial and reputational exposure and can balance strategic judgment with hands-on execution.


Key job responsibilities

• Litigation portfolio management: Independently manage a high volume of litigation matters end-to-end, including commercial arbitrations, civil and commercial suits, consumer disputes, and regulatory/enforcement actions.
• Strategy & risk assessment: Develop and drive case strategy, assess litigation risk and exposure, and advise business and leadership on potential outcomes, settlement options, and mitigation.
• External counsel management: Select, instruct, and manage external counsel and law firms; control legal spend, review strategy and work product, and ensure cost-effective, high-quality outcomes.
• Regulatory & enforcement matters: Lead responses to regulatory inquiries, investigations, notices, and enforcement proceedings; engage with regulators and authorities as appropriate.
• Stakeholder advisory: Partner with business teams, compliance, and cross-functional stakeholders to provide clear, practical, and actionable legal advice on contentious issues.
• Pre-litigation & dispute resolution: Handle pre-litigation disputes, demand/response notices, and negotiate settlements; explore and drive alternative dispute resolution where appropriate.
• Governance & reporting: Maintain accurate case tracking, prepare litigation reports and risk dashboards for leadership, and ensure timely escalation of material matters.
• Process & knowledge: Contribute to playbooks, standardization of litigation processes, and continuous improvement in how the team manages disputes at scale.

Basic qualifications

- 13+ years of litigation experience
- Bachelor's degree in Law
- Enrolled and in good standing with the Bar Council of India.
- Strong track record in commercial arbitrations, civil/commercial suits, consumer disputes, and regulatory/enforcement matters — gained at a leading law firm and/or a reputed in-house legal team.
- Demonstrated experience independently managing a large volume of contentious matters simultaneously.
- Strong working knowledge of Indian civil procedure, arbitration law, consumer protection law, and the relevant regulatory frameworks.

Preferred qualifications

- Experience working closely with and advising senior executives of an organization or equivalent
- Experience working independently and directly with all levels of legal and business partners or equivalent
- A blend of in-house experience at a large corporation, ideally in a high-volume, fast-paced industry, and experience as a practicing Advocate.
- Experience managing high-stakes, high-value litigation with significant financial or reputational exposure.
- Experience managing external counsel and controlling legal spend across a large docket.
- Excellent judgment, strong written and oral advocacy, and the ability to communicate complex legal risk to non-legal stakeholders.
- Proven ability to work autonomously, prioritize across competing demands, and operate with a high degree of ownership and bias for action.

title: Program Manager Intern 6M- 2027
descriptionHtml:
here’s a universe of opportunity at Amazon.

At Amazon, your career doesn’t follow a straight line. It accelerates, twists, and challenges you in ways you never expected. From the moment you join, you’re part of something big: building products or services that reach millions and shaping how people live, work, and connect every day. This is where your ideas turn into real impact.

You’ll work with world class tools, global platforms, and systems built to operate at an extraordinary scale. You’ll move fast, experiment and launch solutions that matter. With endless opportunities to explore across teams and roles, you’ll learn quickly, apply what you know and discover skills you didn’t know existed. This is an environment designed for builders who want to see the impact of their work in the world. Ready to start your adventure?


What’s in it for you?

An internship at Amazon means real responsibility from day one. You’ll build, test, and learn alongside people who want to see you succeed, while making an impact that reaches far beyond campus.


Key job responsibilities
- You will collaborate with different internal stakeholders to learn how to improve a program’s offering and its benefits for our customers. This internship provides an opportunity to collaborate with cross-functional teams, demonstrate project management skills in a competitive and dynamic business climate.
- You will work on one or several projects with your hiring team in tracking open actions, conduct deep dives, provide data insights, analyse processes to identify critical points and anticipate risks.
- You will support the team in recommending and executing network improvements.
- You will contribute with innovative long-term and lasting solutions beneficial for the entire team.

A day in the life
Every day is different as a Program Manager Intern. You'll work alongside your dedicated mentor and team on real improvement and innovation projects that support the growth of Amazon's European network. You might spend your morning analysing a large dataset to identify operational bottlenecks, then spend your afternoon aligning with stakeholders across different countries on a project rollout plan. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams, track project milestones, and share updates with senior management.

Amazon is a data-driven business, so no matter which project you are working on, part of your role will involve extracting insights from data to drive decisions. You'll develop solutions to real operational challenges, test different approaches, and present your findings to leadership — building your analytical, communication, and project management skills in a fast-paced, international environment.

Note: You must have the right to work in the country of employment by the start date.

About the team
Intern Community:
As an Amazon Intern, you'll be part of a dynamic, supportive community that empowers your growth and development. You'll collaborate with interns from around the world, networking and participating in social events to broaden your perspectives. You can also join specialized groups focused on areas like sustainability to explore your diverse interests.

Support:
The internship program provides a robust support system, including weekly intern office hours, dedicated IT and HR support, and a program team committed to your success. This ensures you have the guidance and assistance needed to thrive.

Learning Sessions:
Exclusive learning sessions will further enhance your skills, granting you access to Amazon's industry-leading learning platforms and the expertise of industry leaders. These structured development opportunities will prepare you for the next step in your career.

Opportunities:
Upon successful completion of the internship, you may be considered for a graduate role or a second internship, allowing you to continue your journey with Amazon. Additionally, you'll enjoy a competitive monthly salary, relocation support, and access to a range of employee benefits.

Internship Start Dates across the year:
We are hiring interns to start anytime from January through September 2027. Each month, we'll hold 1-2 onboarding days for new hires.

Basic qualifications

- Speak, write, and read fluently in English
- Currently in your penultimate year and working towards a university bachelor’s or master's degree in Engineering, Project Management, Business Management or similar discipline.
- Knowledge of Microsoft Excel at an advanced level, including: pivot tables, macros, index/match, vlookup, VBA, data links, etc.
- Available for a full-time internship (40 hours/week) and commit to 6 month internship maximum

Preferred qualifications

- Experience working with clients
- Strong problem-solving and analytical skills, with the ability to identify process improvements and innovative solutions.
- Excellent communication and teamwork skills, able to collaborate effectively with others.

title: Sr. Software Dev Engineer, Amazon Connect
descriptionHtml:
AWS Applied AI Solutions (AAIS) is building toward a future where every business innovates with Amazon AI teammates. To get there, we build AI solutions that improve human capabilities and transform entire business functions. We create end-to-end products that surprise and delight out-of-the-box, making complex things easy and hard things possible, with no cloud experience required. We start with customers who embrace the future and build bridges to meet the rest where they are. We pursue ambitious opportunities with conviction, and we are looking for builders who share that mindset.

Amazon Connect is an AI-powered customer experience solution that enables superior outcomes at a lower cost. Since its 2017 public launch, Amazon Connect has become an AI leader, transforming how organizations of all types interact with their customers.

Are you inspired to work with a team than launches products with direct and massive impact on Amazon’s customers? Are you excited to join one of the newest and most exciting AWS services?

Amazon Connect is a highly disruptive cloud-based contact center that enables businesses to deliver engaging, dynamic, and personal customer service experiences. Amazon Connect is the result of the ten years of development that went into building the tools Amazon uses to provide its award winning customer service at massive scale and launching it as a publicly available AWS service. With Amazon Connect, you can create your own cloud-based contact center and be taking calls in minutes. Amazon Connect leverages the power of Artificial Intelligence and the large ecosystem of AWS services such as Amazon Lex, Amazon Polly, AWS Lambda, Amazon S3 and Amazon Kinesis to provide a truly frustration free, easy-to-use, extensible, and natural customer experience. With this technology, we are transforming an industry and the way customers interact with businesses and how agents service them.
See our section in Andy Jassy 2020 re:Invent keynote

We have a rapidly growing customer base and an exciting charter in front of us that includes solving highly complex engineering and algorithmic problems. We are looking for passionate and talented Software Development Engineers to join us to innovate on this new service that addresses customer needs to build modern contact centers in the cloud. The position represents a rare opportunity to be a part of a fast-growing business soon after launch, and help shape the technology and product as we grow. You will be playing a crucial role in developing the next generation contact center, and get the opportunity to design and deliver scaleable, resilient systems while maintaining a constant customer focus.

As a developer on our team, you’ll own code end-to-end from design to development, and work closely with senior technical leaders within the team and across AWS. You’ll have a sound understanding of computer science fundamentals and practical industry experience, working across the stack with technology involving Front-End technologies like React, open-source libraries, a full-stack code base, MicroServices, Data platforms, and more.

This team is a great fit for you if :
- You are passionate about data, metrics, and insights that support our team's decision making.
- You enjoy working with a fun team that prides itself on a great work environment with an inclusive group of people that are working together towards a common goal.
- You are sensitive to customer needs and interested in working on a service that will be used, directly and indirectly, by millions of customers and has a meaningful impact to their functions and interactions.
- You’d like to be directly responsible for solving real customer problems.
- You are a passionate learner and are motivated to take on new challenges.
- You want to have fun; surround yourself with a highly talented pool of engineers that like to solve complex problems, but also enjoy work life balance.

title: Security Engineer II, AWS Proactive Security Team
descriptionHtml:
Help us protect not only the Amazon Web Services (AWS) cloud computing environment but all of our customers as well! Since 2006, our great team at AWS has been enabling our customers to bring great ideas to life in ways that aren’t possible in traditional IT environments. With AWS you can flexibly harness compute, storage, security, and other services from across the globe as your business demands them.

AWS Security manages many security issues for a wide variety of platforms and technologies including cloud services, Internet of things (IoT), identity and access management, mobile devices, virtualization and custom hardware, all operating at massive scale. Similarly, our highly collaborative team is committed to each team member’s growth as our business grows.

AWS Security is looking for an Application Security Engineer to help validate that our services, applications, and websites are designed and implemented to the highest security standards. You will be responsible for analyzing the security of applications and services, discovering and addressing security issues, building security automation, and quickly reacting to new threat scenarios. You will have the opportunity to learn from, and be mentored by, those who are building and securing our services.

A Security Engineer at Amazon is expected to be strong in multiple domains and provide significant contributions to the AWS IT Security team and to multiple groups throughout Amazon. Security engineers are expected to develop elegant solutions to complex business problems and apply appropriate technologies while following security engineering best practices. You are also expected to mentor more junior engineers and be a security thought leader for the organization.

A Security Engineer must foster constructive dialogue and seek resolution when confronted with discordant views. Engineers in this role are expected to participate fully in the planning of the AWS IT Security team's work and constantly seek opportunities for process improvement. They should also have a deep understanding of at least one specialty for which they are a sought out resource (both within AWS IT Security and by groups throughout Amazon), while having an understanding of the application of Information Security in a broad range of technical areas.

title: Software Development Engineer, STRADA
descriptionHtml:
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

The Service Transformation and Deployment Automation team aims to remove all manual touchpoints from service operations within Amazon Web Services (AWS) Networking, one of the world’s largest and most complex networks. Software Development Engineers are instrumental in discovering innovative ways to automate and scale services. They drive stability, consistency, and sustainability of the network while never losing sight of the high security bar our customer’s demand. We own a container compute platform in the border network, network device access and locality software, and a business intelligence platform for providing insights into service maturity. This position is located in Minneapolis, USA and working in the heart of AWS global network.

Millions of customers rely on Amazon’s network for using our retail websites, accessing content on their Kindles, and building applications and businesses on top of the Amazon Web Services (AWS) Cloud. Our goal is to become The Infrastructure Platform for the world – achieving this goal requires automated and massively scalable software services. Success depends on our world-class network infrastructure, and our network depends on our automation.

This position involves on-call responsibilities, typically for one week every two months. We don’t like getting paged in the middle of the night or on the weekend, so we work to ensure that our systems are fault tolerant. When we do get paged, we work together to resolve the root cause so that we don’t get paged for the same issue twice.

Our team is dedicated to supporting new team members. Our team has a broad mix of experience levels and Amazon tenures, and we’re building an environment that celebrates knowledge sharing and mentorship. Our senior engineers truly enjoy mentoring more junior engineers and engineers from non-traditional backgrounds through one-on-one mentoring and thorough, but kind, code reviews. We care about your career growth. We try to assign projects and tasks based on what will help each team member develop into a better-rounded engineer and enable them to take on more complex tasks in the future.


Key job responsibilities
You will be responsible for the design, implementation and quality of services you deliver. Your experience working in software development or in an enterprise environment will help us implement automated solutions across a variety of applications and systems.
You’ll also:
• Design, implement, test, deploy and maintain innovative solutions to transform service performance, durability, cost, and security.
• Write high quality distributed system software.
• Work in an agile, startup-like development environment, where you are always working on the most important stuff.
• Work closely with our Network/Systems/Software Engineering teams to ensure fast and smooth roll-out of new designs and products, as well as assist with deployment and sustaining of networking software tools.
• Use data to measure success and take responsibility for the quality of your service and, regardless of their source, strive to prevent faults from impacting your customers.
• Use your strong problem-solving skills, ability to understand and scope solutions, work across teams to drive solutions.
• Contribute to documentation of process and procedures.
• Learn from others and help grow those in your team to achieve their best.
• Take ownership, consider tradeoffs and lean on your expertise to ensure the job gets done.
• Participate in an on-call rotation with your team.

A day in the life
Engineers in the Backbone Enterprise and Regional Engineering (BERE) organization have a wide range
of responsibilities; we work with internal partners to develop and implement the next-generation platforms along with the tooling ecosystems to support these platforms driving efficiency and scalability through the automation of builds, configuration deployment, and the scaling of capacity. As our network is one of the largest in the world, there is no blueprint allowing our engineers to develop solutions to complex challenges that we face daily. We encourage durable solutions that look around corners while taking into consideration our customer needs from a cost, performance, and reliability perspective. Our team develops tooling that provides the required visibility and control of
traffic across the network, while prioritizing the automatic mitigation of events to minimize the impact to our customers during events.
In this role you:
• Work in a 24x7 team on-call rotation, with ability to drive into workplace for critical events/needs.
• Manage customers during problem resolution and operating efficiently under pressure.
• Sit at the computer during scheduled work hours with appropriate breaks while maintaining a high level of alertness and attention to detail.
• Travel to data center/network sites and Amazon/customer offices as needed.

Within AWS Networking, the Backbone Enterprise, and Regional Engineering (BERE) organization is responsible for the design, implementation, and operations of a wide array of networking infrastructure that provide global connectivity between all AWS Regions and edge locations. BERE provides the massive scale required to support our AWS customers and internal services, via a network that experiences 70% growth annually. In addition, they have teams that are responsible for the design and operation of our global corporate office and Data Center network, allowing tens of thousands of Amazonians to perform their daily tasks in support of our customers.

title: Hardware Security Lab Engineer, Devices and Services Security
descriptionHtml:
Are you a hands-on engineer who thrives at the bench with a soldering iron in one hand and a multimeter in the other? Amazon's Hardware Security team is looking for a Lab Engineer to support security testing operations across our consumer electronics portfolio. This is a tactical role that combines two areas of work: physical device operations (teardowns, sample handling, and data gathering) and lab operations coordination (sample logistics, program tracking, and coordination support).

You will work alongside security engineers, using tools such as X-ray systems, microscopes, 3D printers, and other electronics lab equipment to evaluate hardware security across devices that ship to millions of households worldwide. Your findings will directly inform whether a product's security design meets the bar before it reaches customers. If you are comfortable performing device teardowns and rework at the bench, and equally at ease coordinating sample logistics and maintaining program records, this role offers a real opportunity to grow your career in hardware security.

Key job responsibilities
- Perform device teardowns and security assessments on prototype and production hardware using X-ray systems, microscopes, soldering irons, and other lab equipment, then capture, log, and organize teardown data and photographs for security engineering review.
- Manage end-to-end hardware sample logistics — request samples from program teams, coordinate shipment and receipt, maintain chain-of-custody records, and keep the device tracker accurate and up to date.
- Maintain a safe, clean, and organized lab environment, including developing and following Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), supporting environmental health and safety compliance, and identifying opportunities to improve lab efficiency.
- Collaborate with security engineers, Technical Program Managers (TPMs), and cross-functional partners in software, manufacturing, supply chain, and quality to ensure the hardware security team is engaged throughout the product development process.
- Support program coordination by tracking active security work, maintaining task tickets, and organizing documentation packages for security reviews.

A day in the life
Your morning might begin with preparing a batch of device samples for teardown and data acquisition - setting up the X-ray machine or microscope, verifying sample chain of custody, and working with security engineers to plan for the day. After a focused stretch at the bench capturing component-level data and photographs, you shift gears to update the device tracker and coordinate with a TPM on incoming samples for an upcoming milestone. You'll regularly participate in team stand-ups where you share status on open tasks and flag any blockers.

About the team
The Hardware Security team within Amazon Security partners with hardware development teams across the company to evaluate and strengthen the security of Amazon's consumer devices. The team is primarily composed of security engineers and works cross-functionally with software, hardware, manufacturing, supply chain, logistics, and quality organizations. Our assessments feed directly into product launch decisions, giving the work a clear link to what ships to customers.

We are investing in building a permanent, dedicated lab engineering capability to support our growing scope. Joining now means you will help shape how the lab operates for the long term while gaining broad exposure to the security challenges behind Amazon's consumer hardware lineup.

Basic qualifications

- Knowledge of mechanical or electrical systems design
- Experience in hardware lab equipment such as digital scopes, logic analyzers, and soldering tools
- Experience reviewing and understanding engineering design documents for electronic, mechanical and electro-mechanical parts and assembly drawings of products
- 2+ years of computer hardware troubleshooting and repair experience, or experience in a relevant field (e.g., Computer Science, Networking Engineering)
- Experience that includes strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and effective communication abilities, or experience with automation and any version control tools
- Associate's degree or equivalent in Electronics, Mechanics, Product Design, Manufacturing Technologies, Computer Science, or other STEM discipline, or equivalent relevant experience.

Preferred qualifications

- Bachelor's degree or above in mechanical engineering, electrical engineering, material science, physics or equivalent, or experience working in Science, Technology, Engineering, or Mathematics (STEM)
- Experience coordinating cross-functional inputs, meeting deadlines, and effectively managing competing priorities
- Experience managing and coordinating multiple projects simultaneously
- Experience with hardware security testing or prototype device handling.
- Experience managing hardware sample logistics and chain of custody.
- Familiarity with Amazon's Product Development Process (PDP) and hardware validation stages (HVT/EVT/DVT/PVT).
- Experience with program tracking tools (Taskei or similar) and status reporting.

title: Senior Maintenance Manager
descriptionHtml:
Operations is at the heart of Amazon's business. We are known for our speed, accuracy, and exceptional service. Our buildings deliver tens of thousands of products to hundreds of countries worldwide, every day. The Reliability & Maintenance Engineering (RME) team are the business partners that work tirelessly behind the scenes to make it happen. We drive continuous improvement and maintain all the robotics and material handling equipment (MHE) to ensure our customers are met with the Amazon smile. Come join us on our journey!
