We support all AWS data centers and all the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we're looking for talented people who want to help.

You'll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You'll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you'll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

The Data Center Engineering Operations (DCEO) Team is the backbone of AWS, supporting the rapid growth of AWS business and customers 24x7. We commit to maintain the critical facility infrastructure of AWS and ensure the standards for operational performance in the areas of safety, security, availability, productivity, capacity, efficiency and cost. The DCEO Team is seeking individuals who are motivated, self-starters, eager to learn, passionate and committed to join us. As part of the Infrastructure Operations Team, you will have the chance to work on the most advanced technologies in a dynamic environment. If you enjoy working in a strong, close-knit and diverse team, Infrastructure Operations Team is the place to be!

Key job responsibilities
• Serve as the primary business interface with the Colocation provider’s technical and facility teams to address day-to-day operational requirements within the Availability Zone (AZ);
• Supervise the on-site Colocation providers and respective contractors, to ensure all works performed is complied with established practices, procedures & local legislation;
• Manage Colocation suppliers to conduct routine maintenance, and respond to emergency services for critical systems including switchgear, generators, UPS systems, power distribution equipment, chillers, cooling towers, computer room air handlers, building monitoring systems, etc.;
• Generate change management requests & incident management tickets for Data Center facility;
• Engage in non-office on-call responsibilities and respond promptly to emergency situations or incident, such as power failures or natural disasters, and review to refine the established Emergency Operations Procedures to effectively handle these situations;
• Deeply involve with Colocation provider and contractors to resolve infrastructure engineering issues and conduct root cause analysis for operational issues;
• Establish comprehensive English documentation to business & facility operations in partnership with the Colocation provider;
• Constantly explore and recommend improvements to enhance the data center safety, security and availability;
• Maintain accurate and up-to-date Data Center infrastructure inventory through related matrices and internal dashboards
• Take charge of the installation of the racks and conduct the rack space, power/cooling assessment;
• Lead new build and expansion projects to improve the operations efficiency, including the design, implementation, and commissioning phases;
• Assist in internal recruitment including conducting interviews and assisting with onboarding.


A day in the life
Also expected from the DCEO is the ability to execute small-to-medium impacting projects from conception to completion. These projects involve moderate amounts of independent work as well as collaboration with external support groups including engineering, automation, processing, and finance in controlled environments. The DCEO will be tasked with creating and delivering on key milestones, obtaining and tracking quotes for all necessary costs, and documenting project results. The goals of such projects are to drive innovation and resiliency while reducing operational costs in the facilities.

• Providing timely escalation for all facilities-related issues within the data center
• First-line troubleshooting and reporting of facility and high-criticality events within a service level agreement (SLA)
• Providing assistance to junior and peers
• Oversight of third-party vendors to ensure that all work performed is in accordance with established safety protocols, best practices, and local legislation
• Utilization of administrative tools for change management, ticketing, and asset management.
• Supporting project/stakeholder team and vendor activities
• Overseeing of all Commissioning activities
• Completion of assigned project tasks and managing associated reporting metrics
• Engagement of other supporting teams for issue resolution
• Ensuring compliance of AWS Data Center safety and security protocols
• Involve in day-to-day data center facility operations work including facility change management
• Involve in vendor management and technical consultation work
• Review emergency and standard operating procedures
• Participate in facility event analysis
• Participate in emergency drills and emergency facility event response
• Participate in local and global facility operations-related projects
• Participate in multiple cross-team trainings
• Be provided an opportunity to drive operational excellence and better customer experience.

About the team
Diverse Experiences
Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

Inclusive Team Culture
Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (gender diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

Mentorship and Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Basic qualifications

- Holder of a diploma, an undergraduate degree or above in any engineering-related discipline;

- Minimum 3 years of relevant work experience with facility management, and operating and maintaining infrastructure equipment in critical facilities such as datacenters, operation factories, substations, hospitals, etc.;

- Knowledge of electrical systems in critical Data Center operations that include but are not limited to utility substation feeds, transformers, switchgear, VFI Class UPS, DRUPS, PDUs, ATS, STS, SLA/VRLA batteries and associated systems, diesel/gas turbine generators and related fuel systems, Surge Suppression, Active Harmonic Filtering, battery monitoring systems, branch circuit monitoring systems or SCADA systems

- Good verbal and written communication skills (English and Chinese);

Preferred qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related field

- Experience with operation and maintenance of data centers, or Mission Critical facility management experience for a large enterprise or large Colocation provider;

- Good work attitude and eagerness to learn, with deep attention to details and accuracy; also possess strong problem-solving skills and strong ability to work independently and take initiative, while also being a collaborative team player who can work effectively with others;

title: Financial Analyst II, Global Payroll Compliance
descriptionHtml:
Do you want to ensure Amazon employees are paid accurately, on time, and in full compliance with local regulations? As a Financial Analyst II on the Payroll Compliance team, you will partner with the Payroll Compliance Manager to build compliance tools, develop metrics, and produce reports that monitor risk across Amazon's countries in the region. You will apply your expertise in international payroll, employment tax, social security legislation, and cross-border worker regulations to directly impact how Amazon discovers, measures, and resolves payroll compliance risks. If you are detail-oriented, analytical, and motivated to make a tangible difference, this is the role for you.

Key job responsibilities
-Partner with project teams and stakeholders to embed payroll compliance requirements from day one for new country and entity launches, applying knowledge of local employment tax and social security legislation.
-Develop and maintain management reporting and metrics using Excel and compliance tools, tracking statutory requirements and ensuring effective monitoring of identified risks across multiple countries.
-Identify new risk areas and potential non-compliance issues, perform root cause analysis, and drive resolution through to full compliance while collaborating with Tax, Accounting, Human Resources, and Global Mobility teams.
-Manage and facilitate audits of operational payroll processes and statutory obligations, including Sarbanes-Oxley (SOX) compliance activities, and develop remediation plans to close identified gaps.
-Identify opportunities to automate and simplify compliance workflows, partner with technology teams to deploy solutions that reduce processing time and errors, and provide ongoing guidance and training to payroll teams on compliance matters.


Basic Qualifications
- Tax, employment legal, and/or payroll experience with specific exposure to NORM countries.
- Strong knowledge of international payroll, employment tax, and social security legislation.
- Solid understanding of cross-border workers, tax treaties, and international employment legislation.
- Experience with SOX compliance and related responsibilities.
- Strong Excel and reporting skills.
- Advanced analytical skills with the ability to dive deep into detail while understanding the broader picture.
- Fluent in English, both written and verbal.

Preferred Qualifications

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in a relevant discipline such as Finance, Tax, or Accounting.
- US tax knowledge or experience is highly preferable.
- Previous Payroll Compliance management experience across multiple geographies.
- Experience within a control or audit environment.
- Exposure to AI tools, automation platforms, or process simplification initiatives within payroll or finance operations.
- Additional language skills.
- Project management experience.


A day in the life
You start by reviewing compliance dashboards and validating payroll data inputs across countries in the region. From there, you may join a working session with the Payroll Compliance Manager to assess an emerging risk area, then shift to building out a new metric in Excel or your compliance tooling. You regularly connect with Tax, Accounting, Human Resources, and Global Mobility partners to align on statutory deadlines, and you carve out time to document processes and train payroll team members on updated compliance requirements.

About the team
The Payroll Compliance team sits within Amazon's broader finance organization with a clear mission: pay employees accurately and on time with the highest controllership and compliance standards. We partner with payroll operations, Tax, Human Resources, Global Mobility, and external advisors to monitor and resolve compliance risks across multiple countries. You will join a collaborative team that values knowledge sharing, continuous improvement, and professional growth as we scale our tools and processes to support Amazon's expanding presence.

Basic qualifications

- 5+ years of finance, tax or a related analytical field experience

Preferred qualifications

- 4+ years of participating in continuous improvement projects in your team to scale and improve controllership with measurable results experience

title: Program Manager, EF Planning, External Fulfillment
descriptionHtml:
We are seeking a Program Manager for the External Fulfillment (EF) Planning Team within Amazon Japan's Operations Division.

 EF handles order processing and shipping operations at fulfillment centers operated by 3PL (third party logistics) or vendors, rather than at Amazon Fulfillment Centers. These centers primarily handle large items, heavy items, and temperature-controlled products. EF team contributes to the company's growth by expanding this service, offering a wide product selection with remarkably fast delivery speeds, thereby enriching our customers' shopping experience.

 This position will be responsible for managing network capacity based on medium demand forecasts and executing the launch of new logistics centers to support business growth.

 For this position that will lead the expansion of the EF business, we welcome applications from individuals with diverse industry backgrounds and experiences.
 ====
 アマゾンジャパンのオペレーションズ部門のEF（ External Fulfillment）プランニングチーム にて、プログラムマネージャーを募集いたします。

 EFは、Amazonのお客様が注文された商品の注文処理・配送業務を自社の物流拠点（Amazon Fulfillment Center）ではなく、メーカー/卸売企業や協力会社の運営する物流拠点で行うセンターで、大型品や重量品、温度管理品などを中心に取り扱っています。EFチームは、そのサービスを成長させ、豊富な品揃えと圧倒的な配送スピードを実現し、お客様の購買体験をより豊かにすることで会社の成長に貢献しています。
 本ポジションは、その役割を果たすべく、ビジネスの成長をサポートする新規物流センターの立上計画を実行することに責任を持ちます。

 EFビジネスの拡大をリードいただける当ポジションでは、様々な業界や経験をお持ちの方からのご応募をお待ちしております。

Key job responsibilities
■Planning and Execution of Mid and long-term Launch Plans for New EF Sites
 Manage medium and long term demand forecasts and EF site capacity, while creating and executing launch plans for new EF sites to support business growth. We collaborate cross-functionally with stakeholders both internally and externally, and swiftly execute logistics network changes proposed in response to business environment shifts based on the latest demand forecasts.

 ■Cost Planning and Control
 We create and manage cost plans for executing new EF site launch plans. We collaborate with Finance, Operations, and partner companies to develop and implement necessary action plans.

 ■Warehouse Performance Data Management and Analysis
 To support the creation of medium- to long-term plans and decision-making for their execution, we collect and aggregate appropriate data from operational logistics facilities, and manage both historical and current information. Additionally, we analyze this data and transform it into information that enables accurate decision-making.
 ====
 ■新規EF拠点の中長期立上計画の実行
 中長期的な需要予測とEF拠点のキャパシティを管理し、ビジネスの成長をサポートする新規EF拠点の立上計画を実行します。社内外問わず多くのステークホルダーと部門横断的に協力し、最新の需要予測をベースにビジネス環境の変化から提案された物流ネットワークの変更を、スピード感を持って実行します。

 ■コスト計画の作成とコントロール
 新規EF拠点の立上計画を実行するにあたりコスト計画を作成、管理します。ファイナンス、オペレーションズや協力会社とも連携し、必要なアクションプランを策定、実行を進めます。

 ■倉庫実績データの管理および分析
 中長期計画の作成とその実行判断のサポートの為、稼働中の物流拠点の適切なデータを収集/集計し、過去及び最新情報を管理します。また、そのデータを分析し、正しい意思決定判断ができる情報に加工します。

title: Program Manager, Flow Control
descriptionHtml:
We are hiring Program Managers to run complex and cross functional supply chain projects. This role is a part of the centralized supply chain planning function at Amazon India. The role is very much like an internal consulting role where the incumbent will drive large high impact projects in supply chain. These projects will typically involve designing and building complex new processes, driving technology solutions, driving large cost reduction or efficiency improvement initiatives or launching exciting new supply chain models.

The incumbent will be own the following -

descriptionHtml:
オペレーション技術統括本部（英語名称JCFS: Japan Customer Fulfillment Solutions）はアマゾンジャパン オペレーション部門（JP Ops）の中核部門として、物流プロセスの設計・導入・改善に取り組むとともに、物流プロセスのベースとなる建屋の設計を最適化して、拠点の価値を最大化することに注力しています。

アマゾンジャパンは、商品をお客様に迅速に届けるための大規模拠点の立ち上げをリードするプロジェクトマネジメントをおこなうとともに、今までにない新しい建屋・設備に関するイノベーションやソリューションを生み出すことで、拠点の価値を最大化する活動を推進するSr Program Managerを探しています。

title: Program Manager, Non-UDS Service Program (AMXL), Program Manager, Non-UDS Service Program (AMXL)
descriptionHtml:
エアコン・水回り・ドライブレコーダー…「届けるだけ」では終わらない、設置まで責任を持つ新しい配送体験を一緒につくりませんか？
アマゾンジャパンでは、専門施工業者（Service Provider）と連携して商品の設置・組み立てを提供する「non-UDS（Non-Unified Delivery Services）」プログラムのプログラムマネージャーを募集しています。エアコン工事、水栓設置、スマートロック、ドライブレコーダー取り付け、壁掛けテレビなど、Customerが自分では難しい施工を、購入と同時にシームレスに予約・完了できる体験を作ることが私たちのミッションです。
本ポジションは Amazon Logistics Extra Large Team（AMXL）に所属し、専門施工業者との関係構築・運営管理、サービスカテゴリの拡張、そして Customerエクスペリエンスの継続的な改善をリードします。
本ポジションの所属部門等に関する詳細は、下記リンク先をご参照ください。 ■部門紹介：Last Mile (AMZL) / Extra Large (AMXL) ■職種紹介：Project / Program Management
※Amazon は多様かつインクルーシブな職場づくりを目指しています。Amazon は男女雇用機会均等法を順守しています。人種、出身国、性別、性的指向、障がい、年齢、その他の属性によって差別することなく、平等に採用選考の機会を提供しています。
Amazon では、最新の AI Tool・生成 AI を日々の業務に積極的に取り入れています。意思決定のスピードを加速させ、本当に重要な「判断」と「議論」に集中できる環境を提供しています。


﻿
Would you like to build a service experience that goes beyond delivery — one that takes responsibility all the way through installation?
Amazon Japan is hiring a Program Manager for its non-UDS (Non-Unified Delivery Services) program, which partners with professional Service Providers (SPs) to offer installation and assembly services — air conditioners, faucets, smart locks, dashcams, wall-mount TVs, and more — seamlessly bundled with product purchase.
This role sits within the Amazon Logistics Extra Large Team (AMXL) and leads SP relationship management, service category expansion, and continuous Customer experience improvement.

Key job responsibilities
Key job responsibilities / 主な職務内容
プログラムマネージャーとして、専門施工業者（SP）との関係を軸に、以下の業務全般をリードします。

施工業者の管理・立ち上げ
・新規施工業者の発掘・コスト交渉・契約締結
・既存施工業者の週次パフォーマンスレビューと改善指示（最速予約可能日・日程変更率・初回完工率などを管理）
・施工業者・社内サポート窓口からの問い合わせ対応・解決
・施工業者への月次支払い処理（将来的な自動化の推進を含む）

サービスカテゴリの管理
・エアコン・水回り・スマートロック・ドライブレコーダー等のサービス設定・価格設定・サービス紹介ページ作成
・取り付けサービスを提供する対象商品の管理（追加・削除）
・サービス選択フローの設計・最適化による現地での追加料金発生の削減
・新カテゴリのローンチロードマップ策定と実行

日常オペレーションの管理
・施工業者のサービス提供エリア・稼働枠の設定サポート
・試験稼働の実施・段階的ローンチ計画の立案
・カスタマーサービス・社内サポート向け作業マニュアルの作成・改訂

カスタマーエクスペリエンスの改善
・Customerレビュー・問い合わせデータの分析と改善策立案
・AIを活用したサービス選択フローの精度向上（2027年計画）
・サービス品質指標（初回完工率・日程変更率・Customerレビュー）のモニタリング

﻿-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
As a Program Manager, you will lead the following across partner management, service operations, and Customer experience.
・Build and manage relationships with professional installation partners across categories including air conditioning, plumbing, smart locks, dashcams, and TV mounting
・Lead weekly partner performance reviews, track key metrics (earliest appointment availability, rescheduling rate, first-visit completion rate), and drive improvement actions
・Own partner onboarding end-to-end: recruiting, cost negotiation, contract execution, and setup of service area and capacity management
・Manage service configuration, service page creation, and service option flow design to reduce unexpected on-site charges
・Handle partner and support team inquiry escalations; coordinate resolutions across Customer Service and product planning teams
・Create and revise operational manuals for Customer Service and support teams
・Drive service category expansion roadmap; manage phased launches with trial operations
・Analyze Customer review data and develop experience improvement plans (including 2027 AI-assisted service scoping initiative)

A day in the life
朝は前日のパフォーマンスデータの確認から始まります。日程変更率が上昇している施工業者があればすぐに原因を特定し、対応を調整します。

午前中は施工業者との週次定例で、稼働不足の解消策と新エリアの拡大計画を議論します。昼過ぎは商品企画チームと新カテゴリ（例：ガス周り施工）のローンチに向けたサービス選択フローの設計を検討。夕方は社内サポート窓口からエスカレーションされたサービス表示のトラブルを調査し、翌日の作業マニュアル更新につなげます。単なる「問題対応」ではなく、「次回は現場で自己解決できる仕組みを作る」という視点で動き続けます。

Each day starts with a review of previous-day performance data. If rescheduling rates are spiking for a particular partner, you quickly identify root causes and coordinate fixes. Morning brings a weekly sync with a partner to discuss staffing shortfalls and new area expansion.
In the afternoon, you work with the product planning team on service option flow design for a new category launch. In the evening, you investigate a service display issue escalated from the support team, then update the operational manual. The mindset is never just "fix the issue" — it's always "build the system so the field can solve it next time."

About the team
我々は施工業者・Amazon・Customerの三者全員にとって「良い仕組み」を作ることに情熱を持つチームです。オペレーションとビジネスの境界を越えて動くことを楽しめる人を求めています。経験よりも「なぜそうなっているのか」を問い続ける姿勢と、現場・データ・関係者の声を束ねて前進できる実行力を重視します。
施工業者との信頼関係の構築、商品企画チームとの戦略議論——多様な関係者と対等に向き合いながら、日本の施工サービス体験を変えていく仕事です。

We are a team passionate about building systems that work well for installation partners, Amazon, and Customers alike. We value people who enjoy moving across the boundaries of operations and business — those who keep asking "why does it work this way?" and who can synthesize the voices of the field, data, and stakeholders into forward momentum.

Basic qualifications

- 3+ years of program or project management experience
- 3+ years of working cross functionally with tech and non-tech teams experience
- 3+ years of defining and implementing process improvement initiatives using data and metrics experience
- Bachelor's degree
- Knowledge of Excel at an intermediate level (e.g., pivot tables & charts, multiple criteria lookups, nested logical/IF formulas, data cleansing, array formulas, etc.)
- Experience defining program requirements and using data and metrics to determine improvements
- Speak, write, and read fluently in Japanese

Preferred qualifications

- 3+ years of driving end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership experience
- 3+ years of driving process improvements experience
- Experience in stakeholder management, dealing with multiple stakeholders at varied levels of the organization
- Experience building processes, project management, and schedules
- Speak, write, and read fluently in English

title: Fulfillment Inbound Operations Program Manager - SA Marketplace, MENATR FBA
descriptionHtml:
Amazon MENA is seeking an experienced and results-driven Program Manager II to own end-to-end FBA (Fulfillment by Amazon) inbound operations for KSA. This is a single-threaded owner role responsible for managing the entire inbound lifecycle — from seller appointment scheduling and drop-off to receiving and stow — across multiple Fulfillment Centers and a large, diverse seller ecosystem.

The FBA Inbound Program Manager drives strategy and operational excellence to deliver best-in-class seller experience, operating within minimal forecasting deviations even during high-intensity peak events. The role demands strong cross-functional influence without authority, partnering with senior stakeholders across supply chain, fulfillment operations, technology, and business teams to deliver on program-level goals.

The PM manages a diverse seller base with varied inbounding personas and requirements, calibrating precise inbound and labor forecasting at multiple grains. The complexity intensifies with varied fulfillment processes, new site launches, and peak events where capacity constraints must be managed while business targets are delivered through innovative and strategic solutions.

Key job responsibilities
Own the full FBA inbound lifecycle for KSA, serving as the single-threaded owner for inbound speed and operational excellence programs

Develop and maintain forecasting models and capacity plans, driving forecast accuracy through continuous model refinement and cross-functional alignment

Lead end-to-end peak event planning and execution, including capacity modeling, contingency strategies, and leadership reporting to ensure operational stability under constraints

Drive cross-functional program management by influencing senior stakeholders across supply chain, fulfillment operations, technology, and business teams without direct authority

Own process improvement and change management initiatives including new site launch readiness, defect reduction programs, and throughput efficiency improvements

Set mechanisms, devise metrics, and build scalable processes that shift the operation from reactive problem-solving to predictive, preventive management

About the team
The FBA Supply Chain team sits within MENATR 3P Marketplace and is responsible for ensuring that Fulfillment by Amazon delivers a world-class seller experience across the Middle East, North Africa and Turkey regions. We operate at the intersection of supply chain strategy, operational execution, and seller experience — owning the programs that move inventory from seller to shelf faster, more accurately, and more reliably than the competition.

Our team works in a fast-growing, high-ambiguity environment where FBA is a critical differentiator for the marketplace. We partner deeply with fulfillment operations, supply chain planning, technology, and business teams to solve complex, multi-variable problems that directly impact seller satisfaction and topline growth. If you thrive on building from scratch, influencing without authority, and seeing the tangible impact of your work in real-time — this is the team for you.

- 4+ years of program or project management experience

title: Sr. Product Designer, AWS Search, Security, Observability, Governance
descriptionHtml:
Security is one of the hardest problems in the world and it just got harder. As AI agents begin to write code, triage infrastructure, and take action autonomously on customers' behalf, the old model of security — dashboards a human reads, alerts a human triages. The hard question is no longer can a person see what happened? It's can a customer trust a system that acts on its own, verify what it did, and stay in control? That question of trust is the design problem of this decade, and it sits at the center of this role.

We're looking for a Senior Product Designer to help reimagine what security looks like in an agentic world. You'll own the end-to-end experience for agentic security surfaces including AWS Continuum and AWS Security Hub products we're rebuilding from first principles around autonomy, action, and trust rather than around tables of findings. This is net-new territory: there is no established pattern language for how a customer grants an agent autonomy, watches it work, understands its reasoning, and reins it back when needed. You'll invent it. Your work will decide whether customers feel confident handing real consequence to a system that acts for them, the difference between security that customers tolerate and security they trust.

Key job responsibilities
1. Own the end-to-end design for agentic security surfaces — AWS Continuum, AWS Security Hub, and related products — from problem framing and research through interaction design, visual craft, and launch.
Define how trust is earned in the interface: how a customer grants autonomy, observes an agent's actions and reasoning, verifies outcomes, and intervenes — building confidence through evidence rather than demanding it up front.
2. Set the design vision and the pattern language for autonomy in security, in a space where those patterns don't yet exist, and bring partners along with sharp narratives and prototypes.
3. Partner daily with product, engineering, and science to balance customer needs, deep technical constraints, and the novel safety and verification demands of agentic systems.
4. Confront the runtime verification problem head-on: when an agent acts faster and more opaquely than a human can follow, design the experience that keeps the customer informed, in control, and able to trust what the system did.
5. Ground every decision in evidence — synthesize qualitative and quantitative signal, run research, and validate with real security practitioners before and after launch.
6. Translate dense security and agentic concepts (autonomy levels, agent reasoning, remediation, verification, telemetry) into interfaces that reduce cognitive load and build confidence.
7. Raise the design bar across the team through critique, mentorship, and reusable patterns, and extend the shared systems your work depends on.

A day in the life
Your morning might start in a working session with your PM and tech lead, pressure-testing how much autonomy a customer should be able to grant an agent on day one — and how the interface earns the right to ask for more. Midday you're in a critique, giving and getting sharp, specific feedback on how an agent surfaces its reasoning without burying the customer in detail. In the afternoon you watch a security analyst work through your Continuum prototype — the moment they hesitate before letting the agent act tells you more than any survey — and you redesign that moment before you log off. Across the week you move between zoomed-out strategy (what does security even look like when agents do most of the work?) and zoomed-in craft (is this the right default, the right disclosure, the right word for "undo"?). You're trusted to set your own direction, surrounded by partners who treat the trust problem as seriously as you do.

About the team
AWS Security sits inside SSOG, where the thesis is direct: as AI systems grow more capable and more autonomous, security has to keep pace — and the gap between what an agent can do and what a human can verify is one of the defining problems of the field. We're not bolting AI onto yesterday's security console; we're rebuilding the experience for a world where agents act and humans need to trust, verify, and stay in control. Our design org is the MOAT proving the clarity and trustworthiness of an experience is as much a differentiator as any capability. We're a senior, tight-knit group that ships real products for real customers, invests in craft and research, gives designers genuine ownership of their problem space, and cares about raising each other's work.

Basic qualifications

- 7+ years of design experience

Preferred qualifications

- Have an available online portfolio
- Knowledge of usability principles and techniques
- Experience using AI-assisted development tools in academic or professional settings

title: Senior Solutions Architect, EMEA Partner Solutions Architecture
descriptionHtml:
The largest enterprise transformation deals are won or lost through Global System Integrators (GSIs). The top-tier GSIs own the transformational relationship, but they need AWS technical leadership to shape, de-risk, and close multi-workload deals. These deals run for 18–36 months, and a single deal can be worth more than an entire portfolio of smaller opportunities.

AWS is hiring a Senior Partner Solutions Architect to lead technical strategy on these pursuits. This isn't an advisory role. You'll own the technical architecture and deal strategy. You'll work alongside the GSI's deal teams from the moment an opportunity is identified until it's ready for delivery. Your success is measured in the annual run rate (ARR) of the deals won.

Location: UK/NL/DE/ES

What you'll do in this role:

Lead large, complex pursuits. You'll own the technical strategy for multi-workload, multi-account, often multi-region deals worth $10M+ ARR, and you'll make the final call on architecture.

Engage early and shape the deal. You'll run deal clinics with GSI partners to build and qualify pipeline, shaping the technical approach and the commercial framing that follows from it.

Bring architectural rigour. You'll enforce Well-Architected design, size workloads, de-risk the technical path, and build the business case (TCO, ROI) that gives customers the confidence to commit.

Orchestrate the ecosystem. You'll align GSI deal teams, AWS account teams, specialists, and service teams around one executable plan.

Support the deal mechanics. As the architecture takes shape, you'll help translate it into the practical terms a deal needs. This includes teaming, milestones, funding, and consumption while working alongside the partner so the technical plan and the agreement stay aligned.

Hand off cleanly, then move on. You'll align the consumption model to the partner's Statement of Work milestones. You'll also hand delivery context over to the alliance and account teams, then move on to the next high-value pursuit.

Build mechanisms that scale. You'll turn what you learn into playbooks and deal clinic frameworks, including reusable patterns for structuring these engagements so alliance teams can run these deals on their own.

You'll work closely with Partner Development Managers, alliance PSAs, account managers, Account SAs, and Customer Success Managers. You'll also influence senior stakeholders at the GSI, the customer, and AWS.

The role requires roughly 25% travel to meet partners and customers.


Key job responsibilities
Lead technical engagement and own the architecture on GSI-led opportunities of $10M+ ARR, from identification through to delivery readiness.

Turn customer transformation roadmaps into clear, costed AWS solutions, and explain technical choices in terms of business outcomes.

Work through the GSI partner and respect its ownership of the customer relationship.

Design enterprise-scale architectures, landing zones, multi-account structures, and migration strategies, and run Well-Architected reviews.

Build proofs of concept, reference architectures, and implementation guides, and review and approve architectures that the GSI develops.

Develop business cases, TCO analyses, risk assessments, and mitigation plans that move deals to commitment.

Ensure the technical solution translates into the partner's commercial model.

Work with alliance PSAs to build GSI capability through certifications, reusable architecture patterns, and independent solution delivery.

Support deals through to revenue realisation with architecture reviews, specialist support, and get-to-green plans when delivery goes off track.

Share customer and partner feedback with AWS product and engineering teams to influence the roadmap.

Adapt solutions to industry-specific regulatory and compliance requirements across multiple industries.

Basic qualifications

- Experience communicating across technical and non-technical audiences, including executive level stakeholders or clients
- Experience in design, implementation, or consulting in applications and infrastructures
- Experience architecting or deploying Cloud/Virtualization solutions in enterprise customers
- Experience in IT development or implementation/consulting in the software or Internet industries
- Experience within specific technology domain areas (e.g. software development, cloud computing, systems engineering, infrastructure, security, networking, data & analytics).

title: Principal, Executive Recruiter, Global Specialty Recruiting
descriptionHtml:
Few companies on earth move at Amazon's scale and speed, and few searches carry the weight of the ones you'll own here. Amazon is constantly reinventing itself, and the leaders who steer that reinvention don't come from a résumé database; they have to be found, understood, and won. That's where you come in.

We're looking for a Principal Executive Recruiter to help the business scale by identifying and landing exceptional leaders across a broad portfolio of executive roles -- both technical and non-technical. You'll own Director- and Vice President-level searches end to end, partnering directly with Amazon's most senior executives to shape the teams that will define the next decade of the business. There is no greater reward in search than watching a leader you placed go on to have a significant, lasting impact -- and here, that impact is felt by hundreds of millions of customers.

Key job responsibilities
The Principal Executive Recruiter owns Amazon's most complex, confidential, and consequential Director- and Vice President-level searches across a diverse portfolio of technical and non-technical roles. This leader operates as a strategic advisor to senior executives, a recognized authority on the external talent market, and a force multiplier who raises the bar for how Amazon identifies and attracts leadership talent. Responsibilities include:

* Serving as a trusted talent advisor to VP and SVP hiring leaders — shaping role definition, influencing org design and leadership bar, and guiding go/no-go and selection decisions on the highest-stakes searches.
* Setting the search strategy and market point of view for ambiguous, first-of-their-kind, or business-critical mandates where no clear talent pool exists.
* Developing deep, differentiated market intelligence on industries, competitors, and leadership talent — and translating it into insights that shape Amazon's hiring and org strategy.
* Building and sustaining long-term relationships with senior leaders in the external market, creating durable talent networks that Amazon can draw on over time.
* Personally engaging, assessing, and winning the most senior and hardest-to-reach candidates, representing Amazon credibly at the executive level.
* Raising the bar on the craft of executive search — introducing new approaches, assessment frameworks, and mechanisms that improve quality, speed, and judgment across the recruiting team.
* Mentoring and elevating other recruiters, and acting as an escalation point and thought leader on complex searches, offers, and negotiations.
* Partnering with executive leadership as a true strategic partner — providing candid counsel on talent, market realities, and the tradeoffs behind critical hiring decisions.

About the team
You will join Amazon's Executive Recruiting organization — a tight-knit team of seasoned search professionals who operate as trusted advisors to the company's most senior leaders. We function like a best-in-class retained search firm, but with the unique advantage of being on the inside: we know the business deeply, we live the Leadership Principles, and we are personally invested in the long-term success of every leader we hire.

- 10+ years of progressive corporate or search firm recruiting at executive level experience

Aimez-vous les livres et la lecture? descriptionHtml:
Do you have a builder's mentality where "show me" means more than "tell me"? Are you passionate about technology, understand cloud architectures and platforms, and quick to pick up emerging technologies? Are you adept at working with customers to experiment with innovative approaches and validate the technical feasibility of solutions?

Core to Amazon's DNA is its methodology around executing experiments and prototypes to find the quickest way to prove new ideas, technologies, and business models in a real-world environment. This experimentation fuels Amazon's innovation.

Our team does horizon exploration. We take emerging technology, including our own inventions, build working prototypes with customers and partners, and demonstrate what becomes possible before the rest of the market gets there. Prototyping is how we do the work. Pushing the technology horizon is why we do it.

The role of the Prototyping Solutions Architect will apply these methods to assemble and build prototypes with leading customers around the world. You'll work closely with AWS Sales Teams and AWS Service Developers to partner with customers to solve hard problems. Engagements run in short build cycles, typically four to six weeks, and are designed to be innovative and evaluative, demonstrating the art of the possible on AWS while proving a credible path to production. AWS is seeking a senior technical professional with real world expertise and experience to join the AWS Specialist Prototyping team to support our rapidly growing and dynamic business.

Key job responsibilities
+ Work with AWS Prototyping engagement managers, solutions architects, customers, and partners to qualify and scope strategic prototyping use cases

+ Architect, design, develop and build working prototypes with customers

+ Extract best-practice knowledge, reference architectures, and patterns from engagements to promote re-use with the worldwide AWS community

+ Share insights and lessons learned with AWS Service teams to contribute to the continual improvement of AWS services based on Customer need

+ Develop and present detailed technical demonstrations and talks to Business and Technical leaders on 1:1 and 1:many/conference type situations

+ Position requires travel - generally around 25%

About the team
The mission of AWS Prototyping is to accelerate customer adoption of AWS, expedite their path to production, and catalyze a culture of innovation.

Prototyping at AWS helps customers envision complex uses of AWS Services by building working prototypes of specific customer use cases, tailored to their data, devices and systems. Prototyping engagements are designed to be innovative and evaluative, demonstrating "the art of the possible" on AWS.

You will build across the areas where we are placing our biggest bets. These shift as the technology does, but today they include:

- Physical AI and autonomous robotics. World models, vision-language-action (VLA) models, cloud-based and agentic VLA, real-to-sim and sim-to-real pipelines, and agentic control of physical systems.

- Autonomous scientific discovery. Self-driving labs and instrument intelligence, where agents plan, run, and interpret experiments across fleets of scientific instruments.

- Agentic developer intelligence. Multi-agent systems, code agents, and automated research workflows that change how software and science get built.

- Scaling what we learn. Turning one-off prototypes into reusable patterns and assets the broader field can pick up and run with.

title: CF Flex Logistic Assistant (contratto determinato di 6 mesi)
descriptionHtml:
Amazon è sempre alla ricerca di opportunità per mettere i propri partner di vendita nelle condizioni di utilizzare le tecnologie più recenti, così da migliorare la scelta e ridurre i costi per i nostri clienti. Uno dei modi in cui lo facciamo è attraverso la nostra rete CF Flex, che implementa i processi di Amazon Fulfillment nei magazzini dei fornitori o dei 3PL (Third-Party Logistics), consentendo loro di avere maggiore capacità per lo stoccaggio e la spedizione degli articoli ai clienti nel più breve tempo possibile.

Il team CF Flex è alla ricerca di un Logistics Assistant assegnato fisicamente nell’area di Palermo, a 940 km di distanza dalla sede amministrativa virtuale FCO1, Passo Corese (RI).

Ti occuperai di uno o più fornitori strategici o 3PL. Sarai responsabile del coordinamento dei processi operativi e del flusso di lavoro degli ordini dei clienti Amazon, oltre che del monitoraggio di diversi indicatori chiave di performance (KPI) e della comunicazione costante con gli stakeholder.

Poiché questo ruolo può comportare visite ai siti Vendor Flex per fornire supporto in loco, potrebbe essere necessaria la capacità di guidare.

Si offre un contratto di 6 mesi.

Il contratto collettivo nazionale di lavoro applicabile a questo ruolo è CCNL Logistica, Trasporti & merci. La posizione è inquadrata al livello 3 o superiore, in base alle competenze, capacità ed esperienza del/della candidato/a.

Key job responsibilities
Responsabilità per il funzionamento efficace e continuo dei processi operativi di Amazon e partecipazione al coordinamento e allo sviluppo ulteriore di tutti i processi nell’area CF Flex, nell’ambito della partnership tra Amazon e i Vendor/3PL.
Monitorare i processi operativi chiave all’interno del magazzino, garantendo l’assenza di difetti. Questi processi includono, ma non si limitano a: Receive, Stow, Pick, Pack, Shipping & Transportation, Quality, Stock Integrity e Transfers.
Contatto diretto con i rappresentanti dei nostri Vendor/3PL, nonché con le funzioni di supporto Amazon appartenenti a diversi team, tra cui, ma non solo: WHS, Retail, Transportation, IT e Business Development.
Responsabilità del monitoraggio e della progressione verso gli indicatori chiave di performance (KPI) in linea con gli obiettivi generali di CF Flex.
Supporto alla rete CF Flex, inclusi, ma non limitati a: copertura dei magazzini, aperture (launch), chiusure, trasferimenti e conversioni dei siti, oltre alla gestione di iniziative di miglioramento continuo e di nuovi progetti.

A day in the life
Come Logistics Assistant, agirai come rappresentante locale di Amazon, comunicando quotidianamente con stakeholder esterni (fornitori e 3PL) e interni (senior management e altri dipartimenti, tra cui, ma non solo, WHS, Retail, Transportation, IT e Business Development).

Siamo sempre alla ricerca di modi per migliorare i nostri processi, e tu sarai una parte fondamentale nell’identificare e contribuire all’implementazione di questi miglioramenti. Avrai una buona conoscenza delle attività operative quotidiane di un Logistics Assistant, ma agirai anche come modello di riferimento per Amazon, dimostrando impegno, affidabilità, attenzione alla salute e sicurezza sul lavoro, oltre a garantire elevata qualità nei risultati consegnati.

L’organizzazione CF Flex prevede principalmente la presenza individuale del Logistics Assistant sul sito, supportata da lavoro di squadra e gestione da remoto; per questo motivo, le capacità di comunicazione sono fondamentali.

title: Sr. Design Technologist, AWS Search, Security, Observability, Governance
descriptionHtml:
Most design teams hand off static mockups and hope engineering builds them faithfully. Our team runs a design intelligence flywheel — Delight Lab, where we prototype and test new patterns in real code; DesignBrain, knowledge-backed design agents that learn from what we test and hold our evolving library of evidence-cited design guidelines; and the front-end experience layer that turns all of it into production-quality interfaces. We're looking for a Senior Design Technologist to live at the center of that loop.

This is a role for someone who thinks in both design and code and refuses to treat them as separate disciplines. You'll build high-fidelity, interactive prototypes that behave like the real thing — not clickable facades — so we can put genuine experiences in front of customers and learn fast. You'll help extend DesignBrain so that what we learn in Delight Lab becomes reusable intelligence rather than tribal knowledge. And you'll raise the quality of our front-end craft, building the components, patterns, and tooling that let designers and engineers move at the same speed without losing fidelity between intent and implementation.

You should be as comfortable in a design critique as in a pull request. You'll turn ambiguous design ambition into working systems, make our prototypes indistinguishable from product, and help our team prove that design is a competitive weapon — by shipping the evidence.

Key job responsibilities
1. Build high-fidelity, interactive prototypes in real code — experiences that behave like the product, not clickable facades — so the team can put genuine interactions in front of customers and learn fast in Delight Lab.
2. Partner with designers to turn ambiguous design ambition into working systems, closing the gap between design intent and front-end implementation so nothing is lost in handoff.
3. Extend DesignBrain so that what the team proves in Delight Lab becomes reusable, evidence-cited intelligence — codified patterns and components rather than tribal knowledge.
4. Raise the quality and velocity of the front-end experience layer: build the components, design-system primitives, and tooling that let designers and engineers move at the same speed without sacrificing fidelity.
5. Prototype net-new interaction patterns for agentic and AI-native surfaces, where the established pattern language doesn't yet exist and has to be invented and tested.
6. Collaborate daily with design, product, and engineering — translating between disciplines and making technical feasibility a first-class input to design decisions, early rather than late.
7. Instrument prototypes so the team learns from real usage, and feed those findings back into the flywheel.
8. Raise the bar for engineering craft across the team through code review, reusable patterns, and mentorship.

A day in the life
Your morning might start in a design critique, where a teammate's concept sparks a "let me just build that" — and by midday you have a working prototype in real code that answers a question no static mockup could. In the afternoon you pair with a designer to pressure-test an interaction, then commit the pattern into DesignBrain so the whole team inherits it. Later you're deep in the front-end layer, refactoring a component so it's production-quality and reusable, not a one-off. Across the week you move between zoomed-out questions (what should an agentic security surface even feel like?) and zoomed-in craft (is this transition, this default, this micro-interaction right?). You're trusted to decide what's worth building to learn versus building to ship — and you're surrounded by designers and engineers who treat prototyping as thinking, not decoration.

About the team
We're the design team behind AWS SSOG experiences, and we run a design intelligence flywheel: Delight Lab (where we prototype and test in real code), DesignBrain (a knowledge-backed design agent that learns from what we test and holds our evolving library of evidence-cited guidelines), and the front-end experience layer that turns it all into production-quality product. We treat design as a competitive weapon, not a line item — and we prove it by shipping the evidence, not just the mockups. We're a senior, tight-knit group that gives our people genuine ownership, invests in craft and tooling, and cares about raising each other's work. For a technologist who refuses to choose between design and code, there's no better place to do the work.

Basic qualifications

- 6+ years of front-end technologist, engineer, or UX prototyper experience
- Have coding samples in front end programming languages
- Have an available online portfolio
- Experience developing visually polished, engaging, and highly fluid UX prototypes
- Experience collaborating with UX, Product, and technical partners

Preferred qualifications

- Knowledge of databases and AWS database services: ElasticSearch, Redshift, DynamoDB
- Experience with machine learning (ML) tools and methods

descriptionHtml:
Amazon's Security team is looking for a Security Incident Response Analyst to detect, investigate, and respond to threats against a U.S. Government program building a purpose-built, classified AI Factory. We are obsessed with protecting customer trust, and on a fully air-gapped platform with no commercial cloud control plane we build our detection and response capability from the ground up. In this role you monitor security telemetry, triage and investigate alerts, drive incidents through containment, eradication, and recovery, and turn every event into better detections and playbooks. You will work in the trenches with detection engineers, SOC analysts, forensics, and our Government counterparts to keep a high-value classified system defensible around the clock. • Coordinate incident reporting and handoffs with the ISSM and Government counterparts.

Your shift starts with a sweep of overnight security telemetry on the air-gapped platform. You triage queued alerts, separating noise from genuine threats, then dive deep into a suspicious authentication pattern. As you investigate, you drive it through containment and eradication, coordinating the response with your ISSM and Government counterparts. Midday, you huddle with detection engineers and SOC analysts to tune the alert logic that flagged it, turning today's incident into tomorrow's playbook. title: Software Development Manager, AWS Vulnerability Management - Automated Remediation, AWS Vulnerability Management
descriptionHtml:
At Amazon Web Services (AWS), Security is our highest priority. The AWS Security team is responsible for the security of services offered by AWS. The AWS Vulnerability Management team is responsible for driving innovative enhancements that raise the bar for how Amazon Builders discover, prioritize, and remediate vulnerabilities across their resources, systems, and data. At AWS' scale, we must invent new security capabilities that let Builders move fast while vulnerabilities are resolved quickly, with minimal manual effort.

The successful candidate loves working with engineering and business teams across the AWS Security organization to understand their needs, and partners with software and security engineers to design and build the automation that makes remediation effortless for Builders. You are passionate about eliminating manual toil and you want to solve real security problems at scale. You think in terms of capabilities that detect, decide, and act, so that the work in front of a Builder shrinks to a single click or disappears entirely.

As a Software Development Manager you will own the capabilities that power touchless remediation for Amazon Builders: the strategy, the goals, the requirements, and the mechanisms that deliver them. You will own the systems that apply AI and automated response actions at machine speed, closing the gap between detection and resolution so that Builders can remediate in minutes rather than days or weeks. You will partner with Engineering, TPMs, and cross-functional teams to equip Builders across the organization with automation that reduces their security work to the smallest possible action. You will own the delivery of industry-leading capabilities that combine descriptive and predictive analytics with security engineering, automating the complex work behind remediation and producing insights for our Builders and our customers.

One of the central challenges you will own is continuing to transform vulnerability remediation so that time to remediation drops to minutes. You will push the boundaries of what automation can do, building capabilities that generate ready-to-ship fixes, safely apply automated response actions at machine speed, and progressively expand the scope of findings that can be resolved with little or no manual effort, all while holding the safety, correctness, and trust bar that Amazon's scale demands. Builders stay accountable for their resources, but the capabilities you own make resolving a finding fast, safe, and nearly effortless.

You will need a deeply analytical and systems architecture mindset with the ability to tackle complex and ambiguous challenges and effectively influence stakeholders across the AWS Security organization. This is a high-impact and high-visibility role that requires not only strategic vision and inventing on behalf of customers, but also strong execution, technical depth, analytical rigor, and excellent communication.

Key job responsibilities
Own and build a best-in-class engineering team that delivers excellent results through rapid iterations

Own the design and development of state-of-the-art capabilities for touchless remediation, applying AI and automated response actions at machine speed

Own the capabilities that bring time to remediation down to minutes, continuing to transform remediation into safe, automated mechanisms Builders can trust

Own engineering and operational excellence through metrics and continuous learning

Own the long-term strategy for your programs and translate it into a roadmap and action plan

Report on the status of development, quality, operations, and system performance to management

Mentor and grow high-performing SDEs and security engineers to take on increasingly higher responsibilities

A day in the life
A high-severity vulnerability surfaces across thousands of Builder-owned resources, and the capabilities your team owns go to work before anyone opens a ticket. You watch the automation detect, decide, and act: generating validated fixes, applying automated response actions at machine speed, and resolving findings in minutes. By the time your coffee is cold, most of them are already closed, and you are digging into the handful that need a human eye.

Later you are working with an AWS engineering team that wants to bring a new class of findings into automated remediation. You have already mapped how a fix could go wrong at scale, so you set the safety and correctness bar the automation has to clear before it can act on a Builder's behalf. title: TEMPEST Security Specialist, US ADC Security
descriptionHtml:
Amazon's Security team is looking for a TEMPEST Engineer to protect the classified space and systems that a U.S. Government AI Factory program depends on.

Emanations security sits on the critical path for accreditation, and we need someone who can both run the test and own the program behind it. You will plan and perform instrumented TEMPEST/EMSEC testing and signal analysis, then develop and maintain the TEMPEST program and documentation that carries those results into the accreditation package. You will verify RED/BLACK separation and TEMPEST countermeasures and work directly with the certified TEMPEST technical authority (CTTA) and the Government accreditation authority. Partnering with physical security, construction security specialists, systems engineers, and our Government counterparts, you will take classified space and equipment from design to accredited, and keep it that way.

This position requires that the candidate selected be a US Citizen and must currently possess and maintain an active TS/SCI security clearance with polygraph.

Key job responsibilities
In this role, you will:
- Plan and perform instrumented TEMPEST/EMSEC testing and signal analysis on classified systems and facilities; set up test equipment, take measurements, record findings, and produce test reports.
- Identify compromising-emanation vulnerabilities and recommend, implement, and verify TEMPEST countermeasures and mitigations.
- Develop and maintain the TEMPEST program, TEMPEST Checklist, and emanations-security test documentation in support of the ICD 705 accreditation package.
- Verify RED/BLACK equipment and cabling separation and installation against CNSSAM TEMPEST/01-13 and related standards.
- Coordinate with the certified TEMPEST technical authority (CTTA) and the Government accreditation authority on TEMPEST requirements, countermeasure reviews, and findings.
- Track TEMPEST testing status, findings, and retest and reaccreditation actions.
- Collaborate with internal teams, general contractors, architects, and engineers prior to and during facility builds to ensure emanations-security requirements are captured and met.
- Read and understand construction details and drawings that capture Government TEMPEST and RED/BLACK requirements and standards.

A day in the life
No two days look the same, because classified space moves through phases and so do you. One morning you are on site with test equipment, taking instrumented emanations measurements and analyzing signals; that afternoon you are writing up findings and updating the TEMPEST Checklist and accreditation documentation. Some days you are walking a build with construction security specialists and engineers, confirming RED/BLACK separation against the drawings before walls close. Others you are on the phone with the CTTA and the Government accreditation authority, working countermeasure reviews and closing out findings. You move fluidly between the bench and the program, and you are the person who makes sure the emanations-security details are right so accreditation stays on track.

About the team
Diverse Experiences
Amazon Security values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why Amazon Security?
At Amazon, security is central to maintaining customer trust and delivering delightful customer experiences. Our organization is responsible for creating and maintaining a high bar for security across all of Amazon’s products and services. We offer talented security professionals the chance to accelerate their careers with opportunities to build experience in a wide variety of areas including cloud, devices, retail, entertainment, healthcare, operations, and physical stores.

Inclusive Team Culture
In Amazon Security, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Ongoing DEI events and learning experiences inspire us to continue learning and to embrace our uniqueness. Addressing the toughest security challenges requires that we seek out and celebrate a diversity of ideas, perspectives, and voices.

Training & Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, training, and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why flexible work hours and arrangements are part of our culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.

Basic qualifications

- 3+ years of experience in TEMPEST, EMSEC, or technical emanations security.
- Working knowledge of TEMPEST and RED/BLACK installation standards (for example NSTISSAM TEMPEST/1-92, CNSSAM TEMPEST/01-13, CNSSP-510).
- Current, active US Government TS/SCI security clearance with polygraph.

Preferred qualifications

- Hands-on instrumented TEMPEST test experience: test equipment setup, measurement, and signal analysis.
- Experience coordinating with a certified TEMPEST technical authority (CTTA) and a Government accreditation authority.
- Experience developing TEMPEST Checklists, test plans, and emanations-security documentation for an ICD 705 accreditation package.
- Knowledge of ICD 705 as it relates to TEMPEST and construction security.
- ICD 705 practitioner training, and/or a formal TEMPEST or EMSEC training certificate.

title: Sr. Risk Manager, Finance Operations, Finance Operations Risk, Governance, & Experience
descriptionHtml:
Amazon is seeking a Senior Risk Manager to support the Finance Operations (FinOps) Controllership team at Amazon. We’re looking for someone who can take lead in understanding complex FinOps processes and identify the full range of risks related to processes, regulatory compliance, organization, policy, and technology. This individual will ensure FinOps processes stay ahead of risks associated with process design, internal control effectiveness, computer system integration, and other relevant areas.
As a Senior Risk Manager on the FORGE team, you won't just find problems, you'll architect solutions. You will lead high-impact audits and risk programs across Finance Operations (FinOps), with a primary focus on Global Real Estate & Facilities. Your work will directly strengthen the control environment, protect Amazon from material risk, and drive the kind of operational excellence that lets Finance scale with confidence.

In this role, you will lead and oversee projects, such as inspections, risk assessments, and advisory services, that shape process and control design to mitigate risk and drive a continuous controllership culture. Responsibilities will also include preparation of findings and engagement with stakeholders to complete action items. Your subject matter expertise is critical to develop strong working knowledge of processes, current initiatives, and organizational changes.

This role requires strong leadership skills to influence others and/or self-serve in order to achieve critical inspection objectives. You will be expected to identify risks in our processes and work with the appropriate owners to mitigate risks. You will need to dive deep to understand Amazon’s disparate and complex processes and related applications and work through ambiguity to deliver results.

Key job responsibilities
Successful candidates must be eager to dive deep into processes and have a proven record of delivering meaningful risks and recommendations to the business. The candidate should have strong auditing skills, problem solving skills, systems and process knowledge, and a passion for customer service. Specific core responsibilities are below:
• Perform risk assessments of the organization
• Perform end to end audits, including scoping, fieldwork, and reporting
• Evaluate design and effectiveness of FinOps controls
• Evaluate policy and process exceptions
• Prepare clear, compelling audit reports, executive narratives, and leadership-ready communications. Present findings, recommendations, and risk trade-offs to senior leaders (Director and above) with precision and confidence
• Provide training that improves and raises the bar on controllership with respect to policies and other requirements
• Support ad hoc inspections, deep dives, and reviews across broader FinOps and upstream business processes as new risks emerge or business needs evolve
• Provide strategic perspective on risk-related business and technology decisions. Help stakeholders see around corners, prioritize the right mitigation investments, and avoid building risk into new processes

A day in the life
• Lead scoping, planning, and execution of complex audits and risk assessments across FinOps processes.
• Own end-to-end lifecycle of high-impact, cross-functional risk programs.
• Identify control gaps, evaluate control effectiveness, and drive sustainable remediation plans.
• Define project objectives, success criteria, and risk reduction metrics.
• Partner with cross-functional stakeholders to prioritize risk initiatives, influence decisions, and drive execution.
• Develop data-driven audit reports and executive communications presenting findings and recommendations to senior leadership.
• Influence stakeholders to implement scalable, automated controls and eliminate recurring risks.
• Leverage data, automation, and technology to improve risk detection and audit efficiency.

About the team
Finance Operations Risk, Governance & Experience (FORGE)’s mission is to improve controllership across Finance Operations (FinOps) by identifying risks, protecting assets, designing to-be controls, testing existing controls, and as appropriate, assisting process owners with risk mitigation or remediation. In addition, FORGE collaborates with teams within and beyond FinOps on risk assessments, compliance, corporate social responsibility, regulatory, and governance matters. FORGE also serves as FinOps's program manager for the global external audit, provides controllership support for non-integrated subsidiaries, and is the contact for FinOps owned Internal Audit findings.

- 7+ years of compliance, audit or risk management experience
- Knowledge of Microsoft Office products and applications at an advanced level

Preferred qualifications

- Master's degree or equivalent
- Experience at consulting firms or equivalent
- Experience working across teams and influencing teams that are not your own

descriptionHtml:
This permanent, full-time position is located in Jeffersonville, IN.
Operations is at the heart of Amazon’s business. We are known for our speed, accuracy, and exceptional service. Our buildings deliver tens of thousands of products to hundreds of countries worldwide, every day. Reliability Maintenance & Engineering (RME) are the business partners that work tirelessly behind the scenes to make it all happen. We drive continuous improvement, and maintain all of the Robotics and Material Handling Equipment (MHE) to ensure our customers are met with the Amazon smile. Come join us on our journey!
About the Role:

As a Mechatronics & Robotics Apprentice (MRA), you will learn to combine electronic, mechanical, computer and automation engineering skills at the workplace. During on-the-job learning (OJL) you will work with complex high-performance manufacturing systems and will learn to analyze, troubleshoot, and repair systems to maintain process efficiency. The focus of your role will be to learn the skills and abilities to ensure safety regulations and policies are adhered to, assist in the installation, maintenance, and repair of the automated packaging and distribution equipment, ensure preventative maintenance is conducted on time to a high standard, and provide high levels of equipment availability through continuous improvement.

You will be paired with journey workers to carry out their work at various facilities, including high automation and robotics facilities in connection with service operations. You will be expected to complete work based on technical documents and instructions and carry out your work in compliance with the relevant provisions and safety regulations.

You should be an effective communicator, work well in a team, and be self-motivated. You must have the ability to work collaboratively and coordinate your activities with upstream and downstream operations partners. In addition to developing your skills, you will be mentored by senior technicians to grow in your role.

Key job responsibilities
Key job responsibilities include, but are not limited to:
• You will perform preventative/predictive maintenance of conveyance equipment using the appropriate job plans, procedures, and manuals.

• You will conduct maintenance and basic troubleshooting of robotics and robotic work cells.

• You will troubleshoot electrical and mechanical problems related to all material handling equipment components.

• You will maintain and troubleshoot motors, photo eyes, relays, proximity sensors, solenoids, motor starters, tachs, etc.
• You must be able to move up to 49lbs, stand and walk during shifts lasting up to 12 hours, climb ladders and gangways safely, and without limitation, as well as perform regular bending, lifting, stretching, and reaching both below the waist and above the head

Program Requirements:
• Flexible to relocate after completion of the program

• Able to enroll in and attend a 9-week training at one of four designated training providers (Location to be determined post-interview)

• Meet the minimum qualifying score on a Mechanical Aptitude Test

Please note that while we strive to accommodate employees' preferences for shift assignments, due to operational requirements and scheduling constraints, we cannot guarantee a specific shift assignment.

Basic qualifications

- High school diploma
- 1+ years of PC software experience including Microsoft Word, Excel and Outlook experience
- vocational/technical training or an associate degree or above, or 1+ years of Amazon RME (Reliability Maintenance Engineering) experience
- Experience troubleshooting and repairing operational items
- Knowledge of mathematics
- Experience experience using data and metrics to measure impact and determine improvements
- Work flexible schedules including weekends, nights, and holidays

Preferred qualifications

- 4+ years of military experience
- Experience conducting predictive and preventative maintenance procedures
- Experience troubleshooting and diagnosing material handling equipment (MHE)
- Experience implementing safety standards
- Experience reading blueprints and electrical schematics

title: MFG Specialist Technician II, Robotics Manufacturing & Technical Operations
descriptionHtml:
Are you inspired by invention? Is problem solving through teamwork in your DNA? Do you like the idea of seeing how your work impacts the bigger picture? Answer yes to any of these and you’ll fit right in here at Amazon Robotics. We are a smart team of doers that work passionately to apply innovative advances in robotics and software to solve real-world challenges that will transform our customers’ experiences in ways we can’t even image yet. We invent new improvements every day. We are Amazon Robotics and we will give you the tools and support you need to invent with us in ways that are reward-ing, fulfilling and fun.

Amazon Robotics is seeking skilled Specialist Technicians to oversee the installation, maintenance, and fabrication of industrial equipment. As a Specialist Technician, you will be responsible for ensuring the smooth operation of machinery, mechanical equipment, and machine shop operations. This includes installing new equipment, performing regular services and maintenance procedures, troubleshooting equipment breakdowns, and performing precision machining tasks in a manufacturing machine shop environment.

Some positions within this role will focus heavily on machinist duties, including operating manual and CNC machine tools to fabricate, modify, and repair precision parts and components for production equipment. You will work in a machine shop setting producing parts from engineering drawings, performing setups, selecting tooling, and verifying dimensional accuracy.

To ensure success, you should have advanced mechanical knowledge of industrial machinery, machining fundamentals, excellent troubleshooting skills, and good time-management skills. A top-class Specialist Technician boosts production by ensuring all equipment functions correctly, receives regular maintenance, and that precision parts are fabricated to specification.

Key job responsibilities
- Install new equipment and understand technical manuals, read blueprints, and purchase replacement parts necessary to make equipment repairs.
- Service and maintain equipment including motors, conveyor systems, transmission systems, and production-related equipment.
- Disassemble/reassemble equipment such as gearboxes, cylinders, pumps, valves, etc. and repair/replace worn or defective parts. Experience troubleshooting and repairing hydraulics and pneumatics.
- Troubleshoot PLC systems and other control systems and install wiring systems for power and control. Troubleshoot, install, and repair AC/DC motors, starters, relays, and drives.
- Inspect and assess the functionality of production machines.
- Troubleshoot and repair all standard electrical components and detect minor equipment problems and correct them before they become major issues.
- Adjust mechanical parts using hand and machine tools.
- Fabricate parts for repairs and machine upgrades.
- Set up and operate manual and CNC lathes and mills to fabricate precision parts and components from engineering drawings.
- Select appropriate tooling, fixturing, speeds, feeds, and depth of cut for various materials and operations.
- Conduct in-process and final inspections using precision measuring instruments (micrometers, calipers, height gauges, bore gauges, CMM/Romer Arm).
- Perform preventive maintenance per planned schedules. Clean and lubricate machinery. Inspect equipment operating conditions. Identify root causes of equipment problems.
- Communicate with the production team and maintain a clean work area.
- Prepare and submit maintenance reports.
- Develop and implement preventative maintenance procedures.
- Help develop and implement the budget for the maintenance department.
- Maintain inventory records for equipment and supplies.
- Fix potential safety hazards to avoid injuries.



A day in the life
You are proficient in the use of hand tools such as torque wrenches, measuring equipment, multimeters, etc. relevant to your specific role. You are proficient in the use of at least one specialized manufacturing equipment such as but not limited to manual lathes/mills, CNC lathes/mills, welding machines, CMM/Romer Arm inspection equipment, or 3D printers. You communicate with engineers, peers, and other stakeholders using technical language and provide process feedback on your assigned products. You are skilled in reading and interpreting engineering documents like drawings using GD&T, schematics, or interface documents. You follow industry best practices and data to make technical decisions to solve common problems. You set up and run specialized manufacturing equipment to fabricate products. You may perform first article fabrications of simple products from engineering drawings, models, or industry specifications. You perform in-process inspections to verify the quality of your work for specified drawing dimensions (e.g., flatness, true position, custom gauging). You work primarily with industry standard raw materials like aluminum alloys, steels, polymers, carbon fiber, laser sintered materials and are learning about specialty materials for potential applicability to your job functions (e.g., various steel heat treated alloy usages, titanium and nickel-based alloys, appropriate additive manufacturing materials for different jobs, composite materials, etc.). You are proficient in applicable machine-specific software for role (CAD/CAM software, 3D printing software, precision inspection CMM software, etc.). You also may assist in the training of peers on equipment you are proficient in.

You maintain shop organization and cleanliness standards. You participate in continuous improvement initiatives to optimize machining processes, reduce scrap, and improve cycle times.
