title: Software Development Engineer, Devices Software & Services
descriptionHtml:
The Amazon Devices Software & Services team is looking for a Software Development Engineer to join a high-velocity, specialized team. This is not a traditional framework or infrastructure role - we are building a new groundbreaking customer experience that will define how millions of users worldwide interact with their technology - making it more proactive, intuitive, and invisible.

We’re building the systems that put AI into production — the runtime, services, and tooling that turn large language models and autonomous agents into reliable, safe, scalable products. As a Software Development Engineer II, you’ll design and ship core software in this stack: model and tool integrations, the agent execution loop, evaluation and quality pipelines, and the APIs that product teams build on. You’ll own meaningful components end to end, make real design decisions, and write production code that runs against real users and real data.
This is a hands-on building role for an engineer who wants to go deep on AI infrastructure — not just call an API, but engineer the reliability, safety, and performance around it. You’ll also work in an AI-native development environment: we use AI coding assistants and agentic workflows as part of our daily software-development lifecycle, and we hold that velocity to a hard bar of automated testing and code review. We expect engineers who can move fast and keep the quality gates green.


Key job responsibilities
- Invent New Paradigms: Move beyond traditional voice UI to build "Ambient Intelligence" experiences that span Alexa, Fire TV, and mobile/wearable surfaces, focusing on proactive assistance rather than reactive commands.
- Rapid Innovation: Operate in a fast-paced environment where you will prototype, test, and deploy features that leverage multimodal inputs (camera, audio, and documents) to create personalized customer magic.
- Cross-Surface Continuity: Ensure that a customer’s experience is persistent and context-aware beyond the device boundaries - whether they are at their desk using Alexa.com, in their living room with Fire TV, or on the go with a wearable.

- Integrate and harden model providers, tools, and agent capabilities behind clean, versioned interfaces — with sane failure behavior, observability, and cost/latency awareness.
- Build evaluation and regression tooling so AI behavior is measured, gated, and trustworthy — not vibes.
- Apply security-conscious, fail-closed design to anything touching credentials, user data, tool execution, or autonomous actions.
- Work fluently alongside AI coding assistants: decompose tasks an agent can execute, critically review AI-generated code, and keep engineering rigor high at AI speed.


A day in the life
In our team, you will get to build new products and features from the ground up. You will define and build features and tools used by thousands of developers for building for millions of customers. We work across multiple internal teams as well as product to define what we are building and make it a reality. SDEs on this team are actively writing code, as well as working on designs and mentoring others. As the Device OS org we get to work horizontally across many exciting new device types.

About the team
We’re a platform team that builds the shared AI/agent infrastructure used across multiple products. We care about correctness, safety, and developer experience in equal measure. We operate test-first, review adversarially, keep our core clean and reusable, and treat AI as a tool that raises the engineering bar.

- 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience

The Networking Procurement team is looking for a driven, organized, and collaborative Sr. Supply Chain Product Lifecyle Manager (PLM) for Switch portfolio. The Sr. Supply Chain PLM will drive hardware qualification activities with engineering counterparts, conduct NUDD reviews, own category SKU optimization, manage sustaining BOM configurations and lifecycle status changes, coordinate and execute last time buy and EOL plans, and partner with Sourcing, Supply Chain, and Engineering counterparts to ensure continuity of supply through effective lifecycle management of our portfolio of switches.

title: Technik BHP
descriptionHtml:
Bezpieczeństwo i dobrostan naszych pracowników to najwyższy priorytet w Amazon. Nasi Technicy BHP odgrywają kluczową rolę w jego zapewnianiu. To stanowisko jest szansą na rozpoczęcie kariery w dziedzinie bezpieczeństwa pracy i rozwój w międzynarodowej firmie. Będziesz ściśle współpracować z naszymi ekspertami, monitorując swój obiekt, dzięki czemu każdego dnia zobaczysz, jaką różnicę robisz dla dobrostanu ludzi.

Key job responsibilities
- Przeprowadzanie ocen ryzyka i audytów.
- Monitorowanie obiektu w celu zapewnienia zgodności procesów z procedurami bezpieczeństwa Amazon.
- Tworzenie i aktualizacja raportów dotyczących wskaźników bezpieczeństwa do przeglądu przez współpracowników.
- Współpraca z kolegami z działu Operations i całej firmy przy zadaniach związanych z bezpieczeństwem oraz doradztwo w zakresie procesów.
- Wsparcie we wdrażaniu nowych środków bezpieczeństwa.

A day in the life
Będziesz pracować w jednym z naszych obiektów. Oznacza to, że będziesz mógł/mogła ściśle śledzić to, co się dzieje, a pracownicy będą mogli łatwo zadawać Ci pytania podczas swoich zmian. Ta rola polega na identyfikowaniu potencjalnych problemów, zanim się pojawią. Będziesz poświęcać dużo czasu na sprawdzanie obiektu i poznawanie sposobu, w jaki ludzie korzystają ze sprzętu. Rozumiejąc, jak działa każde zadanie i każda maszyna, będziesz w stanie znaleźć najlepszy sposób na zapewnienie bezpieczeństwa procesów. Będziesz również jedną z osób wdrażających zmiany w zakresie bezpieczeństwa, co oznacza, że będziesz ściśle współpracować z wieloma osobami. Oprócz codziennych i tygodniowych zadań będziesz wspierać zespół Operations w doraźnych pracach związanych z bezpieczeństwem. Bezpieczeństwo jest niezwykle ważne w Amazon, a Ty pomożesz nam gromadzić kluczowe dane, które pozwalają nam kontrolować nasze procesy i wyprzedzać wszelkie problemy. Będziesz również dzielić się tymi danymi z pracownikami w całej firmie i współpracować z innymi zespołami, aby zapewnić, że bezpieczeństwo jest zawsze na pierwszym miejscu.

Zespół Workplace Health and Safety (WHS) odgrywa kluczową rolę w zapewnieniu dobrostanu psychicznego i fizycznego naszych pracowników. Nasz zespół współpracuje z kierownikami, pracownikami i lokalnymi władzami we wszystkich naszych obiektach, dbając o zgodność z politykami Amazon i przepisami prawnymi oraz zapewniając bezpieczeństwo naszych środowisk pracy. title: Project Engineering Manager, AMZL Field Engineering
descriptionHtml:

- Leading the whole project/program lifecycle from concept and budgeting creation to handover at completion to relevant stakeholders
- Handling independently or with minimal guidance different tactical phases of the projects/program. This may include dealing with substantial constraints related to resource allocation, capex and timelines linked to business requirements

Your day could include cross-functional engagement within the organization to agree program strategy, attend the site to monitor deployment progresses, plan and manage resources to execute activities according to business goals, enable efficient mechanisms to handover to customers. title: Responsable maintenance (H/F), Responsable Facility Management (F/H), Maintenance, Robotique & Systèmes Automatisés
descriptionHtml:
Au sein de l'équipe RME (Reliability Maintenance Engineering), vous intégrerez le moteur de l'innovation chez Amazon. Notre mission ? Faire en sorte que chaque infrastructure, chaque installation technique, chaque espace évolue au rythme d'Amazon pour garantir que des millions de clients reçoivent leurs commandes à temps, chaque jour.

En tant que Responsable Facility Management, vous aurez l'opportunité unique de construire, dès l'origine, l'organisation Facility Management du site : Vous piloterez l'ensemble des installations techniques du bâtiment et dirigerez une équipe de 30 experts techniques pluridisciplinaires en gestion directe, tout en supervisant plus de 20 prestataires externes.

Vous évoluerez dans un environnement où l'excellence opérationnelle n'est pas une ambition, mais une exigence, et où chacune de vos décisions impacte directement la sécurité et la satisfaction de vos équipes et de nos clients.

Vous aimez piloter des installations multi-techniques, manager des équipes et des prestataires, et faire progresser les performances au quotidien ? Alors ce poste est fait pour vous.


Key job responsibilities
- Exploitation technique du site : réception, tests et suivi du bon fonctionnement des installations CVC, incendie, air comprimé et espaces verts.
- Santé & sécurité : maintenir une culture sécurité exemplaire (LOTO, Safety Curriculum, toolbox talks), garantir la conformité des installations et viser le zéro incident grave.
- Gestion multi-technique : superviser les systèmes CVC, incendie, air comprimé et espaces verts, en garantissant disponibilité et conformité réglementaire.
- Management d'équipe : encadrer et faire monter en compétences une équipe de 30 techniciens et superviseurs.
- Gestion des prestataires : piloter plus de 20 prestataires externes (contrats, SLA, standards qualité/sécurité Amazon).
- Excellence opérationnelle : piloter la maintenance préventive et corrective et assurer la disponibilité technique des équipements.
- Amélioration continue : analyser la performance des installations, optimiser l'énergie et mener des projets Kaizen/QCC avec les équipes européennes.
- Budgets & projets : gérer le budget Facility Management et piloter les projets d'infrastructure avec les équipes internes (GES, GPO, Central RME) et externes.

A day in the life
Vous serez basé·e sur l’un de nos sites opérationnels, ce qui vous permettra d’être au plus près de votre équipe et d’avoir une vision claire de ce qui se passe sur votre site. Vous collecterez des données et résoudrez les problèmes dans un environnement dynamique. Vous aurez également l’occasion d’élaborer un plan opérationnel visant à rendre le site plus productif et plus efficace. Vous devrez notamment mettre en place de nouveaux projets visant à améliorer les processus opérationnels et l’entretien du matériel. Après la sécurité, la fonction la plus importante de votre rôle consistera à diriger votre équipe et à gérer ses performances et son évolution, notamment en mettant en place des formations.

About the team
Notre équipe d’ingénieurs RME (Reliability Maintenance Engineering) veille à ce que nos équipements fonctionnent au mieux. Guidés par des responsables expérimentés, nous sommes une équipe à l’esprit analytique. Nos collaborateurs·trices possèdent à la fois des connaissances techniques poussées et un bon esprit d’équipe. Nous travaillons ensemble pour assurer l’entretien, le dépannage et la réparation des ressources de notre réseau mondial de centres d’expédition. Certains de nos employé·es occupent des postes à responsabilités et sont chargés de superviser l’équipe dans son travail sur des technologies passionnantes, dont certaines n’existent que chez Amazon.
De l’installation de systèmes d’emballage automatisés à la supervision de la maintenance générale d’un site, en passant par la réparation d’équipements de distribution essentiels, notre équipe assure le bon fonctionnement de la plupart des éléments techniques d’Amazon. Nous veillons, par exemple, à ce que les bâtiments soient conformes à la législation, afin d’assurer la sécurité de tous et le fonctionnement à plein régime de nos sites. Les possibilités d’évolution sont nombreuses, tant au sein de l’équipe RME qu’à l’échelle d’Amazon.
Tout ce que nous faisons vise à réduire les temps d’arrêt dans les principaux sites logistiques d’Amazon, afin que les clients reçoivent leurs commandes à temps. Nous travaillons souvent tôt ou tard pour effectuer les tâches de maintenance avec un minimum de perturbations, y compris en équipes de nuit. Si nous voyons qu’il existe une méthodologie plus aboutie pour faire les choses, nous avons les compétences nécessaires pour développer et introduire des processus nouveaux ou des technologies de pointe, comme Amazon Robotics ou notre robot de tri ultra sophistiqué.

Basic qualifications

- - Une expérience préalable en Facility Management ou gestion multi-technique de bâtiments (CVC, incendie, air comprimé, espaces verts)
- - Une expérience préalable dans le management direct d'une équipe (idéalement 20+ collaborateurs)
- - Une expérience préalable dans la gestion et la coordination de prestataires externes multiples
- - Une expérience préalable dans des projets de création ou d'ouverture de site est un plus
- - Parfaite maîtrise du français et niveau courant anglais à l'oral et à l'écrit
- - Connaissance des réglementations statutaires telles que les contrôles de conformité et les protocoles de sécurité incendie et des installations techniques

Preferred qualifications

- - Connaissance approfondie des systèmes CVC, des installations de sécurité incendie et des réseaux d'air comprimé
- - Expérience dans la gestion de contrats de prestations et le pilotage de SLA
- - Expérience dans la mise en service (commissioning) de bâtiments ou d'installations techniques
- - Connaissance des outils d'analyse de données et des systèmes de gestion technique du bâtiment (GTB)
- - Expérience préalable dans la gestion de projets ou des processus Kaizen, Lean, Six Sigma
- - Connaissance des systèmes de gestion de la maintenance assistée par ordinateur (GMAO)

title: SR Risk Manager, Social Responsibility - Human Rights, Sustainability, GPO
descriptionHtml:
Amazon’s mission is to be the most customer-centric company on Earth. To get there, we need to develop leaders who represent, and can innovate, on behalf of a diverse and demanding global customer base. The Global Procurement Organization (GPO) identifies and procures goods and services at the best value for business, maintaining the quality of products and ensuring that alternative sources of supply are available. The Social Responsibility (SR) and Human Rights program drives customer trust and business continuity by ensuring respect for the rights of workers throughout Amazon’s supply chain and operations. We uphold company standards and expectations (such as Amazon's Supply Chain Standards and Human Rights Principles), and seek to constantly improve the tools and processes that we use in doing so.
As an SR Risk Manager in SR Ops, within the Global Procurement Sustainability (GPS) team, you will work closely with Amazon’s Social Responsibility team and the Global Procurement Organization to implement mechanisms to meet Amazon’s human rights principles and Supply Chain Standards and to ensure our suppliers are compliant with those.
You will be responsible for Audit risk assessment activities across Global Operations suppliers and remediation plan coordination. You will work closely with internal and external partners to plan and execute high-quality and impactful audits, which address the highest human right risks.

descriptionHtml:
Amazon Logistics (AMZL) is seeking an experienced candidate to identify, create, develop and integrate innovative solutions and programs that lead to improvements in our last mile delivery network and drive AI adoption across corporate and frontline teams. Partner with Orbit and other tech teams to build the platform capability, like a system connector, that unlocks the category for owner-builders.

You start your morning publishing this week's AI Flash: one practical tip and a success story from a recent tool adopter. title: Executive Assistant, Amazon Customer Service
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Customer Service (CS) CXP (Customer Experience Products) team is seeking an exceptional Executive Assistant to support the Vice President in a fast-paced, strategic environment. CXP is a global, multi-disciplinary organization across product, engineering, science, data intelligence, and design, with broad accountability spanning customer experience, innovation, and business performance. Our ambition is to reinvent Customer Service with GenAI toward a future where Amazon CS is so good that it is a reason customers choose Amazon.

This role requires someone who is bright, self-motivated, and thrives under pressure while maintaining exceptional organizational standards. The EA will be a critical partner to the VP, enabling them to focus on the highest-priority work, and will serve as the lead EA for the broader CXP organization. The right person will develop a strong understanding of the organization, its leaders, priorities, and operating rhythms, and use that knowledge to improve decision velocity, communication flow, and execution.

The strongest EAs do more than execute tasks. They develop enough organizational understanding to exercise judgment on behalf of the executive they support, knowing the VP's priorities, leadership team, and working style well enough to make sound decisions independently rather than requiring direction for every one.

Key job responsibilities
Executive Calendar and Priority Management
- Own the VP's executive calendar with strategic prioritization across multiple time zones, balancing the purpose and urgency of competing requests rather than simply filling available time.
- Protect time for important, non-urgent work and build a calendar that is realistic for a human, including transition time, preparation, meals, and travel.
- Create coordination mechanisms across the VP's leadership team, the broader Customer Service Leadership Team, and senior executives.
- Develop enough organizational context to recommend appropriate delegates and minimize unnecessary rescheduling once commitments are made.
- Anticipate scheduling conflicts and resolve them proactively, maintaining alignment with VP priorities.
Organizational Coordination and Communication
- Serve as the connective tissue of the organization, ensuring information, decisions, and follow-up move efficiently across the VP, leadership team, and key stakeholders.
- Proactively surface important developments, anticipate coordination needs before they become blockers, and create clarity when ownership, timing, or next steps are ambiguous.
- Use the right communication channels with appropriate urgency, distinguishing what requires escalation from what can be resolved independently.
- Build strong working relationships with the VP's leadership team, peer EAs, and key partners across Amazon.
- Track important commitments and ensure appropriate follow-through.
Meetings, Events, and Team Experiences
- Plan and execute a range of meetings and events, including leadership offsites, workshops, planning sessions, employee engagement activities, and social events.
- Handle all event logistics, including venue, catering, room setup, transportation, and materials preparation, ensuring participants have what they need in advance.
- Coordinate schedules across multiple leaders and organizations, anticipating logistical issues before they arise.
- Partner with leaders and other EAs to create well-run, thoughtful experiences.
- Lead space planning for a large, globally distributed organization spanning multiple buildings and countries, including seating allocation, office moves, and reconfigurations as the organization evolves.
Travel, Expenses, and Executive Logistics
- Coordinate complex domestic and international travel, including multi-city itineraries, visa requirements, time zone optimization, and contingency planning, with practical attention to preparation and transition time.
- Manage changes and disruptions as they occur, and complete expense reports accurately and promptly.
Strategic Deliverables and Project Management
- Track and drive completion of key deliverables across the VP's portfolio, following up on action items from leadership meetings to ensure timely closure.
- Support ad hoc strategic projects with increased scope and visibility.
- Design and implement process improvements to maximize efficiency and scalability across the EA community and broader organization.


A day in the life
A typical day as the Lead Executive Assistant to the VP of CXP combines organizational excellence with hands-on problem-solving. You'll orchestrate a complex executive calendar across global time zones, keeping it aligned with the VP's highest priorities while protecting space for the thinking and preparation that high-stakes leadership requires. You'll coordinate high-visibility meetings with senior leaders across Customer Service and partner organizations, track critical deliverables, and ensure follow-through on commitments across a fast-moving leadership team.

You'll manage communications flow to and from the VP, surface important developments before they become problems, and help create clarity when ownership or next steps are ambiguous. Each day brings opportunities to solve complex logistical challenges, advance important organizational initiatives, and identify better ways for the leadership team to operate — not just managing the work around the organization, but actively helping the organization work better.


About the team
Amazon Customer Service CXP is a global, multi-disciplinary organization across product, engineering, science, data intelligence, and design. We are reinventing Customer Service with GenAI, building toward a future where Amazon CS is so effortless and effective that it becomes a reason customers choose Amazon. Our work spans the full breadth of the customer service experience: from the products and experiences customers interact with, to the AI and data systems that power them, to the business performance that makes it all sustainable.

We are builders, scientists, and operators who develop products, services, and data-driven solutions that shape how hundreds of millions of customers around the world get help. By eliminating friction and making support effortless, we enhance the overall customer experience while driving efficiency and innovation across Amazon's global operations.

We are also a dynamic group of leaders who are smart, customer-obsessed, and genuinely fun to work with. We take our mission seriously and our camaraderie seriously too. We are looking for a Lead EA who brings the same energy: a real passion for customer service, sharp instincts, hustle, warmth, and a sense of humor. If you thrive in a fast-moving environment, love solving complex problems, and want to be at the center of an organization doing meaningful work, this team is for you.

title: Senior Security Engineer, Customer Service Security
descriptionHtml:
Want to change how security works at Amazon scale? Customer Service Application Security protects customer data for one of Amazon's largest businesses, and we're building intelligent automation that makes security a built-in part of how teams ship.

As a Senior Security Engineer, you'll be the embedded security lead on our biggest, most complex initiatives. You'll work with engineering teams from first design to launch, owning security assurance through threat modeling, security investigations and control testing. You'll give teams and leaders confidence that what they ship is secure. Then you'll go further, turning key findings into guardrails, paved paths and automation that eliminate whole classes of vulnerabilities across the business unit, so builders get secure systems by default.

This is a senior role with real influence. You'll take on problems with no playbook, where the business goal is clear but the technical strategy isn't, and you'll define the approach. You'll set the technical bar by reviewing other security engineers' and SDEs' designs and code to make sure they're secure, extensible and easy to adopt. You'll lead high-stakes escalations to closure with senior managers and principal engineers. You'll strengthen how teams operate, from alarms and runbooks to COEs.

Your impact will go beyond code. You'll champion secure coding standards, improve processes and build a security culture across development teams. You'll help shape the team's long-term strategy, mentor engineers and hire the people who grow this team.

Key job responsibilities
- Serve as the senior security engineer on large, complex initiatives across Customer Service. Own security assurance from ideation through launch and give teams and leaders confidence that what they ship protects customer data.
- Lead the design of automated security guardrails, paved paths and secure-by-default patterns that remove classes of vulnerabilities across the business unit, and set the technical direction other engineers build on.
- Take on ambiguous security problems where the business direction is clear but the technical strategy is not.
- Drive the shift from manual, point-in-time reviews to continuous security assurance by designing preventive and detective controls and automated assessment that work at scale
- Review the designs, code and tooling of security engineers and SDEs to make sure they fit the bigger picture and are well secured, extensible, efficient and easy for developers to adopt
- Improve security beyond technology by championing secure coding standards, building training, improving processes and strengthening security culture across development teams
- Help define and drive the team's long-term security strategy with security and engineering stakeholders, informed by research into emerging threats and new techniques
- Grow the team by mentoring engineers, taking part in hiring and interviews, and giving career guidance

A day in the life
As a Senior Security Engineer, you're the embedded security lead on Customer Service's most complex initiatives. Your morning might start with shaping the threat model for a major new service, then reviewing a teammate's guardrail design to make sure it scales and is easy to adopt. Later, you're turning a recurring finding into a paved path that removes the issue across the business unit, or leading an escalation to closure with senior leaders. You'll end the day mentoring an engineer or interviewing a candidate. Every day, you're setting the direction for how security is built into how teams ship.

About the team
Customer Service Application Security protects customer data for one of Amazon's largest internal business units. We're reimagining how security integrates with development, building intelligent automation that keeps customers safe while accelerating delivery.

We're a collaborative team of security engineers, Technical Program Managers, and SDEs who move fast, value ownership, and invest heavily in each other's growth. We bridge the gap between security and engineering by championing secure coding standards, building tools that reduce friction for developers, and embedding security early through guardrails and paved paths. We stay ahead through continuous research into emerging threats and new techniques and best practices.

Diverse Experiences
Amazon Security values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why Amazon Security?
At Amazon, security is central to maintaining customer trust and delivering delightful customer experiences. Our organization is responsible for creating and maintaining a high bar for security across all of Amazon’s products and services. We offer talented security professionals the chance to accelerate their careers with opportunities to build experience in a wide variety of areas including cloud, devices, retail, entertainment, healthcare, operations, and physical stores.

Inclusive Team Culture
In Amazon Security, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Ongoing DEI events and learning experiences inspire us to continue learning and to embrace our uniqueness. Addressing the toughest security challenges requires that we seek out and celebrate a diversity of ideas, perspectives, and voices.

Training & Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, training, and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why flexible work hours and arrangements are part of our culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.

title: Engineering Operations Technician (Night Shift)
descriptionHtml:
Join our dynamic team and become a critical guardian of technological infrastructure! As a Data Center Engineering Technician, you'll play a pivotal role in maintaining the heartbeat of mission-critical technology infrastructure, ensuring seamless operations that power global digital experiences. Your expertise will directly contribute to maintaining an extraordinary 99.999% uptime, keeping the digital world running smoothly and efficiently.

Engineering Technicians are Amazon’s front line when it comes to hands-on electrical and mechanical equipment troubleshooting. They will maintain, operate, and troubleshoot, Data Center Operation’s Mission Critical Facilities, which includes stand-by diesel generators and related fuel systems, as well as three phase electrical systems such as: switch gear, UPSs, PDUs, wet cell batteries and associated systems, CRAC, centrifugal chillers, cooling towers/water chemical system, air handlers and associated systems, pumps, & motors.

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

NOTE: Amazon does not sponsor for immigration, including for H-1B, TN, and other non-immigrant visas, for this role.

NOTE: Lump sum stipend will be provided to eligible candidates who relocate for this position.



Key job responsibilities
- Daily building rounds to monitor and record information from electrical, mechanical, and fire/life safety equipment to ensure 24/7 reliability and availability

- Monitor Building Management Systems (BMS) and Electrical Power Management System (EPMS)

- Assist in troubleshooting of facility and rack-level events within internal Service Level Agreements (SLA)

- Perform rack installs and rack decommissioning within internal SLA

- Perform PM, troubleshooting, root cause analysis, and repair of electrical and mechanical equipment

- Technical writing to support change management program

- Monitor daily work requests and manage to resolution, and execute projects from conception to completion

- On-site support of contractors, sub-contractors and vendors, ensuring that all work performed is in accordance with established practices, procedures & local legislation

- Work schedule changes depending on specific site needs. Shifts can be up to 12 hours and may rotate on a predefined schedule. Some locations have on-call rotations.

- Role may support more than one location/site.

Physical Requirements:

- Willingness and demonstrated ability to work in the following physical conditions with reasonable accommodations:

- Regularly lift and/or move up to 39 pounds independently

- Participate in group lifts for 40+ pounds

- Maintain balance and perform construction tasks while on a ladder

- Regularly walk, use hands and fingers, handle or feel, reach with hands and arms, stoop, kneel, crouch or crawl, climb stairs, twist, bend, work above shoulders, grasp, carry, push and pull objects into position

- Work in an environment requiring provided ear protection

- This role supports data centers in various operational stages. The position may be assigned to a facility still under development, which could require travel to established locations for training until your designated site becomes fully operational.

Essential Requirements:

- Ability to travel to or commute between data center locations as needed

- Willingness to temporarily work at alternative sites during training periods or until assigned facility is operational

- Travel frequency will vary based on business needs and operational status of assigned facility

- Candidates must be able to travel (over 50 miles) or commute (less than 50 miles) to active data center sites as required by business needs.


A day in the life
This role acts as Amazon’s front line when it comes to hands-on electrical and mechanical equipment preventative maintenance (PM) and troubleshooting, reporting to a site’s Data Center Facility Manager (FM). They will maintain, operate, and troubleshoot mission-critical data center facility equipment including stand-by diesel generators and related fuel systems, 3 phase electrical systems such as switchgear, UPS units, PDUs, and wet cell batteries and associated systems. Mechanical equipment includes CRAHU units, centrifugal chillers, cooling towers, water systems, air handlers and associated systems, pumps, and motors. Additional support equipment is included in the scope of the role which includes fire/life safety equipment, building automation systems, and general facilities equipment.

- 1+ years of Microsoft Office products and applications experience
- Work flexible shifts including night shifts/weekends
- 1+ years of electrical facilities maintenance, or 1+ years of mechanical facilities

Preferred qualifications

- 2+ years of data center engineering experience

title: Program Manager, AWS Payments & Fraud Prevention
descriptionHtml:
Would you like to join the team that protects the global AWS platform from fraud? Are you looking to solve exciting Fraud challenges in the cloud? Do you want to work on a Cloud business that is growing multiple fold annually? Do you enjoy thinking like a fraudster and using your technical skills to help detect & mitigate AWS accounts from causing damage on our platform? If so, AWS Fraud Prevention has an exciting opportunity for you.

Amazon Web Services (AWS) has the most services, and more features within those services, than any other cloud provider – from infrastructure technologies like compute, storage, and databases to emerging technologies, such as Machine Learning and Artificial Intelligence, data lakes and analytics, and Internet of Things. AWS Platform is the glue that holds the AWS ecosystem together. Whether it’s Identity features such as access management and sign on, cryptography, console, builder & developer tools, and even projects like automating all of our contractual billing systems, AWS Platform is always innovating with the customer in mind. The AWS Platform team sustains over 750 million transactions per second. Each day, hundreds of thousands of customers make billions of transactions worldwide on our cloud. They are harnessing the power of AWS to enable innovative applications, websites, and businesses. However, there are always a few people that try to take unfair advantage of a good thing.

The mission of the Fraud Prevention Team is to keep the AWS platform a safe and trusted place for our customers and partners. We achieve this goal by identifying and preventing fraud and abuse for all AWS services, worldwide. Every day fraudsters attempt to steal our services. We use extensive data and machine learning models to build software solutions to detect and prevent such activities.

The AWS Fraud Prevention vertical is responsible for detecting & mitigating AWS account risks. You’ll be part of a team of Scientists, Fraud Analysts, and Technical & non-Technical Program Managers. The team’s goal is to identify and neutralize bad actors from committing fraud on AWS.

descriptionHtml:
We are looking for a Senior Finance Analyst to join the US Prime Video Business Finance team. This is an exciting opportunity to use analytical insights to work directly with product and business leaders, and to build the tooling they make decisions with.

Prime Video offers customers the largest selection of any streaming service in the world, combining exclusive content available for Prime members (Amazon Original hits like Fallout, Reacher, and The Boys; licensed content from other studios; live events such as Thursday Night Football), 3P Channel subscriptions such as Paramount+, HBO Max, and Apple TV+, an expansive catalog of transactional (rent or buy) content, and linear ad supported channels with 24/7 programming. The PV team comprises individuals who are all obsessively focused on one mission: to give consumers the world's best in class digital video customer experience.

Our team connects business strategy to financial outcomes for the Prime Video Product and Business teams. You will own analyses that shape how the product evolves - what features drive acquisition and conversion, what drives retention, and where the returns on product investment actually are. While your analysis will focus on the US market, you will also collaborate with International teams to ensure we leverage insights globally.

The ideal candidate is someone who loves to dive into data and transform it into insights that connect back to the customer experience. Familiarity with SQL and large datasets is critical in order to access and combine data to iterate on new metrics and analyses. An interest in going one step further, using Python or AI tooling to automate and scale your own analysis, is a welcome addition. This is a fast-paced environment with inherent ambiguity which requires a self-starter that is comfortable working independently. They must be comfortable performing detailed, complicated analysis and communicating findings to stakeholders in a clear, efficient manner that highlights the most relevant points to the business’ strategy.

Key job responsibilities
- Partner directly with product managers and business leaders to size opportunities before they are built, and measure whether launches delivered what was sized
- Own and extend analytical tooling that lets product leaders size opportunities and measure results directly
- Develop performance tracking metrics that provide strategic insights for Prime Video's product and business leadership
- Prepare strategic analyses, reports, and recommendations that directly influence business strategy and investment decisions
- Collaborate cross functionally to support data driven decision making

A day in the life
Some days are analysis: pulling data, building a model, writing up what it means for a product decision. Others are building: extending a tool so it answers a question it could not answer last week, or automating a report so the time can go into the insight instead of the assembly. Most days are both.

About the team
We love Prime Video, but more broadly TV and film entertainment in general. Applying that passion on a daily basis and being able to connect our work to how Prime Video delivers for customers is what keeps us going. While we are a Finance team, we very much feel like part of the business and product teams and are treated as such.

- 3+ years of tax, finance or a related analytical field experience

- MBA, or CPA
- Knowledge of Tableau
- Experience working with large-scale data mining and reporting tools (examples: SQL, MS Access, Essbase, Cognos) and other financial systems (examples: Oracle, SAP, Lawson, JD Edwards)
- Experience working with large-scale data mining and reporting tools (examples: SQL, MS Access, Essbase, Cognos) and other financial systems (examples: Oracle, SAP, Lawson, JD Edwards), or experience working with large-scale data mining and reporting tools (i.e. SQL, MS Power Query, Python)

title: Senior Product Marketing Manager, Acquisitions, Carrier Services
descriptionHtml:
We are looking for a driven, analytically rigorous Paid Acquisition Senior Marketing Manager to own and scale our paid marketing efforts across both performance and awareness channels. Paid Search (SEM) remains the primary engine of this role, but you will also take ownership of paid awareness channels — including paid social, 3P publications, and event coordination — designed to drive top-of-funnel traffic and brand consideration. As a senior leader, you will manage and develop a team of marketing professionals, setting priorities, coaching talent, and fostering a culture of experimentation and accountability. This is a high-impact, highly visible role sitting at the intersection of data, creativity, and technology, directly influencing Amazon Relay's full-funnel growth strategy.

The ideal candidate brings a performance-first mindset and is equally comfortable steering paid search campaigns, launching paid awareness initiatives, leading deep-dive data analysis, and orchestrating high-visibility events. You will manage a multi-million dollar marketing budget spanning SEM and awareness channels and will be directly accountable for both top-of-funnel traffic volume and brand reach KPIs. You will also serve as the connective tissue between quantitative insights and strategic decision-making — translating complex data into clear narratives that influence roadmaps and investment decisions.


Key job responsibilities
SEM Strategy & Campaign Management
- Own end-to-end strategy, execution, and optimization of paid search campaigns across Google Ads and Microsoft Ads, covering Search, Performance Max, and DSA campaign types.
- Lead keyword research, match-type strategy, negative keyword governance, and ongoing search term analysis to maximize relevance and minimize wasted spend.
- Develop and test ad copy, extensions, and landing page strategies using a structured A/B testing framework to continuously improve Quality Score, CTR, and conversion rates.
- Maintain rigorous campaign architecture — ad groups, campaign hierarchy, and bidding strategies (tROAS, tCPA, Maximize Conversions) — ensuring scalability as budgets and markets grow.
- Manage and optimize a multi-million dollar annual SEM budget, allocating spend across campaigns to hit efficiency targets while scaling acquisition volume.

Paid Awareness Channel Management
- Plan, execute, and optimize paid awareness campaigns across programmatic display, paid social (Meta, LinkedIn, TikTok), online video (YouTube), and 3P industry publications to drive top-of-funnel reach and brand consideration among target carrier audiences.
- Define and track awareness-stage KPIs including reach, frequency, video completion rate (VCR), brand lift, share of voice, clearly separating them from lower-funnel SEM metrics.
- Collaborate with Creative and Product Marketing teams to brief, review, and iterate on awareness ad creative — including display banners, video scripts, and social ad formats — ensuring messaging consistency across all paid touchpoints.
- Analyze the downstream impact of awareness campaigns on SEM performance — including branded search lift, assisted conversions, and overall funnel velocity — to prove awareness ROI and inform future budget allocation between channels.

Event Strategy & Coordination
- Lead the planning, execution, and post-event analysis of industry events, trade shows, conferences, and sponsored activations that support acquisition and brand awareness goals.
- Develop event marketing strategies that integrate with paid and organic campaigns — including pre-event promotion, on-site lead capture, and post-event nurture sequences — to maximize attendee-to-lead conversion.
- Manage event budgets, vendor relationships, and cross-functional logistics in partnership with field marketing, sales, and product teams.
- Define and track event-specific KPIs such as qualified leads generated, cost per lead, pipeline influence, and post-event engagement to measure ROI and inform future event investment.

Team Leadership & People Management
- Directly manage, mentor, and develop a team of marketing professionals across SEM, paid social, and awareness functions — setting clear goals, providing regular feedback, and conducting performance reviews.
- Build a high-performing team culture rooted in data-driven decision-making, creative experimentation, and operational excellence.
- Identify skill gaps and invest in team development through coaching, training, and stretch assignments to grow individual capabilities and bench strength.
- Serve as a senior voice within the broader marketing organization, influencing strategy, advocating for resources, and representing the acquisition function in leadership forums.

Top-of-Funnel Performance & Budget Accountability
- Own and be directly accountable for top-of-funnel KPIs including impressions, clicks, CTR, search impression share, new user acquisition volume, and CPC benchmarks.
- Manage budget pacing across monthly and quarterly cycles, delivering accurate spend forecasts and proactively flagging risks or opportunities to senior leadership.
- Partner with Finance and Marketing leadership to build data-backed business cases for budget investment and growth modeling.
- Establish weekly, monthly, and quarterly performance reporting cadences with clear variance analysis and forward-looking recommendations.

Data Analysis, Insights & Tooling
- Be the hands-on power user of Google Analytics 4 (GA4) — building dashboards, custom reports, funnel analyses, and attribution models to surface actionable SEM and full-funnel insights.
- Conduct deep-dive data analysis across channels to identify trends, diagnose performance shifts, and uncover growth opportunities — translating complex datasets into clear, executive-ready narratives and recommendations.
- Leverage Google Auction Insights to monitor competitive positioning, identify share-of-voice shifts, and inform bidding and budget decisions in real time.
- Utilize Google Ads Search Term Reports, Keyword Planner, and Performance Planner to identify growth opportunities and validate strategy pivots.
- Implement and audit UTM tagging, conversion tracking, and Google Tag Manager (GTM) configurations to ensure data integrity across all paid search activity.
- Work with Business Intelligence and Data Science teams to integrate SEM and event data into broader marketing mix models and multi-touch attribution frameworks.
- Build and maintain cross-channel reporting infrastructure that connects paid media, event, and awareness performance into a unified view of acquisition health.
- Support Business Insights needs of the larger team.

AEO / SEO Collaboration
- Partner closely with SEO and Answer Engine Optimization (AEO) teams to align paid and organic search strategies, ensuring consistent keyword coverage and avoiding cannibalization.
- Apply understanding of AEO principles — structured data, featured snippets, and AI-generated answer optimization — to inform SEM messaging and landing page strategy.

title: Area Manager II
descriptionHtml:
Our WW Operations network delivers millions of packages and smiles to Amazon customers every day. We are looking for motivated, customer-focused individuals who want to join our team as an Area Manager. In this role, you will lead a team of hourly workforce and will be responsible for engaging your team during their shifts to maintain the highest levels of safety, quality, attendance, and performance. You will also play a key role in maintaining our customer expectations to ensure customer orders are delivered at the right time, to the right location.

Our Operation’s workflow has three major components: First mile - where the product is housed and ready for order; Middle mile - where the order is hauled to your area; and Last mile - when the product is delivered to the customer’s door. Please note that all workflows have slight building variations, but one thing is constant: our vision and dedication to the customer.

Key job responsibilities
* Support, mentor, and motivate your hourly workforce
* Manage safety, quality, productivity, and customer delivery promises
* Collaborate with all support teams including Safety, Engineering, Loss Prevention, Quality Assurance, Human Resources to develop plans to meet business objectives
* Lift up to 49 pounds and frequently push, pull, squat, bend, and reach
* Stand/walk for up to 12 hours during shifts
* Work in an environment where the noise level varies and can be loud
* Work in an environment that is subject to variable temperatures and weather (delivery stations include outside loading departments)
* Continuously climb and descend stairs (applies to sites with stairs)

descriptionHtml:
Fauna Robotics is building capable, safe, and delightful robots for everyday life. We are hiring a Senior Software Development Engineer to lead security engineering for our robot platform. You will drive the security of the robot from its boot chain to how it handles data.

We're changing that by developing tightly integrated hardware and software systems that make it faster, safer, and more intuitive to create real-world robotic products.

Our work spans the full stack: mechanical design, control systems, dynamic modeling, and intelligent software. The focus is not just functionality, but experience. We're building robots that feel responsive, expressive, and genuinely useful.

At Fauna, you'll work at the frontier of this space, helping define how robots move, manipulate, and interact with people in natural environments. It's an opportunity to solve hard problems across hardware and software with a team focused on making robotics accessible and joyful to build.

descriptionHtml:
Amazon LEO is an initiative to increase global broadband access through a constellation of 3,236 satellites in low Earth orbit (LEO). Its mission is to bring fast, affordable broadband to unserved and underserved communities around the world. Amazon LEO will help close the digital divide by delivering fast, affordable broadband to a wide range of customers, including consumers, businesses, government agencies, and other organizations operating in places without reliable connectivity.

Amazon Leo is seeking a Quality Assurance Engineer to build and own the quality foundation for the software stack that powers in-flight connectivity for commercial airlines. The quality standards, test strategies, automation frameworks, and QMS (quality management system) processes will govern how software is developed and tested across a growing fleet and multiple airline customers for the life of the program.

The in flight connectivity solution operates at the intersection of embedded software, satellite connectivity, and real-time networking. Quality is not a gate at the end of this development process; it is built into every sprint, every interface contract, and every integration milestone from day one.

This role is as much about process creation as it is about test execution. You will define how the team approaches quality management system (QMS) compliance, establish traceability from requirements through test to certification evidence, and serve as the quality voice in every engineering and program decision.

Export Control Requirement:
Due to applicable export control laws and regulations, candidates must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.

Key job responsibilities
-Establish the Quality Management System (QMS) framework - define and document the quality processes, standards, and workflows that the engineering team must follow from initial development through aviation certification and production release. This includes software quality assurance (SQA) planning, process compliance checklists, deviation and nonconformance tracking, and quality metrics reporting to program leadership and airline customers.
-Own the test strategy for the customer solutions we build covering unit, integration, system, and hardware-in-the-loop (HIL) test levels.
-Build and execute integration test plans for all program milestones
-Establish requirements traceability - build and maintain the bidirectional traceability matrix linking software requirements through design decisions through test cases through test results.
-Define and enforce performance requirements testing. Partner with engineering teams to define measurable acceptance criteria and build the test infrastructure to validate them against defined targets.
-Build test automation for the CI/CD pipeline.
-Drive design for testability across the engineering team - participate in architecture reviews, interface design reviews, and code reviews with an explicit focus on testability. Identify components or interfaces that cannot be adequately tested and drive design changes before implementation begins.
-Establish defect management process and quality reporting - define the defect lifecycle (discovery through triage through root cause through fix through regression), severity classifications aligned with aviation safety considerations, escalation thresholds, and the quality dashboards that program leadership uses to make release decisions.
-Champion quality culture - serve as the team's quality advocate in every program decision. Ensure that schedule pressure does not bypass quality gates, that certification evidence is generated alongside development rather than reconstructed after the fact, and that the team understands what aviation-grade quality means in practice.

A day in the life
Your morning might begin with a design review, where you assess the testability of an upcoming feature and outline your test approach. By midday, you are writing automated test scripts, validating complex workflows, and triaging newly reported defects to pinpoint root causes. Afternoons often involve collaborating with developers on bug fixes, refining test coverage based on code changes, and mentoring a teammate on automation best practices. You regularly contribute to retrospectives, sharing insights that help your team ship higher quality software faster.

About the team
Our team brings together engineers from avionics and embedded systems, enterprise networking, distributed cloud infrastructure, and aviation certification. Our team includes engineers with backgrounds ranging from embedded software to large-scale distributed systems - and we value the full range of that experience.
We are continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth's Best Employer. You will find extensive knowledge-sharing, mentorship, and career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded technical leader.

Basic qualifications

- 4+ years of quality assurance engineering experience
- Experience in automation testing
- Experience in manual testing
- Experience as QA lead on medium to large sized projects
- Experience developing high quality test plans, test designs, test strategies, and test execution
- Experience of using test case management tools (e.g. Test Rail, TestLink) and issue management tools (Jira)

Preferred qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent
- Experience with at least one automated test framework like Selenium or Appium
- Experience in gathering test requirements to create detailed test plans and defining quality metrics to measure product quality
- Experience developing test strategies and plans for complex hardware/software systems or systems of systems
- Experience with requirements traceability tools and methodologies - building and maintaining bidirectional traceability matrices from requirements through test cases to test results, in a context where traceability is reviewed by external regulatory or customer auditors

title: 2027 Applied Science Internship - Robotics - United States
descriptionHtml:
Robotics Applied Scientist II Intern/Co-op (2027)

Are you passionate about robotics and research? Do you want to solve real customer problems through innovative technology? Do you enjoy working on scalable research and projects in a collaborative team environment? Do you want to see your science solutions directly impact millions of customers worldwide?

We’re looking for current PhD students with a passion for robotic research and applications to join us in 2027 as Robotics Applied Scientist II Interns/Co-ops to shape the future of robotics and transform automation at Amazon’s scale.

By applying to this role, you will be considered for Robotics Applied Scientist II Intern/Co-op (2027) opportunities across various Robotics teams at Amazon with different robotics research focus. Internship positions are available for multiple locations, durations (3 to 6+ months), and year-round start dates (winter, spring, summer, fall).

Join us at the forefront of Applied Science, where your contributions will shape the future of Robotics!


Key job responsibilities
As a Robotics Applied Scientist II Intern/Co-op, you will work alongside global experts to advance the state of the art in robotics and artificial intelligence, tackling innovative problems that bridge the gap between research and real-world robotics implementation to innovate and build solutions on behalf of our customers.

We are particularly interested in students with specialization and expertise in one or more of the following research areas:

- Robotics
- Artificial Intelligence
- Robotics Manipulation (e.g., robot arm, grasping, dexterous manipulation, end of arm tools/end effector)
- Autonomous Mobile Robots
- Mobile Manipulation
- Multi-Robot Coordination
- Autonomous Navigation
- Locomotion
- Motion/Path Planning
- Controls
- Perception
- Sensing
- Robot Learning
- Machine Learning
- Computer Vision
- Large Language Models (LLM), Vision-Language-Action Models (VLA), Vision-Language-Models (VLM)
- World Models
- Human-Robot Interaction
- Robotics Simulation
- Optimization
- And related!

Key responsibilities may include:
- Develop novel, scalable algorithms and/or modeling techniques that advance the state-of-the-art in science areas such as robotics, artificial intelligence, or related
- Tackle challenging, innovative research problems within robotics, artificial intelligence, or related that bridge the gap between theoretical advancement and practical robotics implementation
- Collaborate with cross-functional teams to solve complex problems, and to communicate research findings clearly, leveraging your expertise in robotics, artificial intelligence, or related
- Demonstrate the ability to work independently, thrive in a fast-paced, ever-changing environment
- Leverage AI-powered tools where applicable to accelerate research, experimentation, and prototyping.
- Critically review and validate outputs from AI tools and automated systems.

About the team
Explore Robotics Teams at Amazon

At Amazon, robotics is where innovative research meets real-world deployment. There are many different specialized robotics teams, including the few highlighted below. Learn more about Robotics at Amazon here: https://www.amazon.science/research-areas/robotics

Fulfillment Technologies and Robotics
We build dynamic partnerships between people and intelligent machines. This intricate collaboration helps Amazon fulfill orders with unmatched accuracy. Working in symphony with our robotic technology, you’ll have the opportunity to extend your technical capabilities by working alongside some of the industry’s most advanced technologies. This includes our fleet of autonomous mobile robots, sophisticated control software, and technologies like language perception, machine learning, object recognition, and semantic understanding of commands. These technologies help us deliver an ever-improving customer and employee experience, as well as improve the safety of our facilities.

Amazon Robotics
Amazon Robotics is at the epicenter of robotics innovation. We design, test, and build mobile robots and mechatronic systems. Our offices, labs, test floors, and factories are close together, which means we can design the hardware, write the code, test, build, and watch it all come to life. Our areas of focus include advancements in autonomous mobility, AI, robotic management software, and much more.

Fauna
Fauna is focused on building capable, safe, and genuinely delightful robots for everyday life. Fauna’s goal is simple: make robots people actually want to live and interact with everyday. Fauna develops tightly integrated hardware and software systems that make it faster, safer, and more intuitive to create real-world robotic products. Fauna’s work spans the full stack: mechanical design, control systems, dynamic modeling, and intelligent software. The focus is not just functionality, but overall experience.

Amazon Fulfillment Technologies
Amazon Fulfillment Technologies develops tech solutions that create network optimizations for all Amazon sites worldwide. We own network infrastructure and devices in all buildings and labor planning and scheduling technology for fulfillment centers in North America and Europe.

Basic qualifications

- Are 18 years of age or older
- Are enrolled in a PhD
- PhD in engineering, technology, computer science, machine learning, robotics, operations research, statistics, mathematics or equivalent quantitative field
- Demonstrated science depth in a specific research area, evidenced through publications, thesis work, or equivalent contributions
- Relevant academic or industry research experience with state-of-the-art scientific principles and techniques in one or more science intern disciplines such as robotics, artificial intelligence, or related
- Experience programming in Python, C++, or similar language

Preferred qualifications

- Have publications at top-tier peer-reviewed conferences or journals
- Experience with research design, development, execution while following best practices in scientific methodology
- Experience inventing or adapting state-of-the art scientific approaches, models, or algorithms to solve business or customer problems
- Experience with algorithm development, data structures implementation, and software development concepts and methodologies
- Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to present complex technical information in a clear and concise manner to a variety of audiences
- Experience implementing algorithms using modern robotics and vision toolkits (e.g. PyTorch, ROS2, Isaac Sim, OpenCV, or PCL)
- Experience with AI-assisted development tools to accelerate research, coding, or evaluation

title: Corporate Counsel, Satellite & Broadband Infrastructure, Amazon Leo Product
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Leo is seeking an exceptional Corporate Counsel to advise on the legal and regulatory questions that arise from building and operating a global satellite broadband network. You will work closely with engineering and product teams on questions involving network design, infrastructure deployment, and interconnection arrangements.

Amazon Leo is Amazon's low Earth orbit satellite network. Our mission is to deliver fast, reliable internet connectivity to customers beyond the reach of existing networks. From individual households to schools, hospitals, businesses, and government agencies, Amazon Leo will serve people and organizations operating in locations without reliable connectivity.

The role sits at the intersection of technology, regulation, and operational strategy. You will help teams understand the legal implications of technical decisions, develop frameworks for evaluating new proposals, and build processes that allow engineering and product teams to move quickly while maintaining compliance. This role requires someone who is curious about how complex technical systems work, comfortable developing expertise in unfamiliar areas, and able to translate legal and regulatory requirements into practical guidance for engineering and product teams.

Export Control Requirement: Due to applicable export control laws and regulations, candidates must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.

Key job responsibilities
- Advise engineering and product teams on the legal and regulatory implications of network architecture and infrastructure decisions, including network design, routing, interconnection, and the use of third-party infrastructure
- Develop scalable legal frameworks for evaluating proposed technical and operational changes, distinguishing changes to implementation from changes that materially affect service commitments or regulatory obligations
- Identify, assess, and mitigate legal and regulatory risks arising from network operations across multiple jurisdictions, including telecommunications regulation, data localization, and cross-border compliance requirements
- Build cross-functional coordination mechanisms and repeatable processes that enable engineering and product teams to scale efficiently while maintaining appropriate legal oversight

A day in the life
You'll start your morning embedded with the engineering and product team as they design network architecture for a new region, helping them understand which design choices carry regulatory implications. Mid-morning, you'll research how a country's telecommunications framework applies to satellite broadband infrastructure, building the legal analysis that informs the team's technical approach. After lunch, you'll join a cross-functional session to map regulatory requirements for a new connectivity offering across target jurisdictions. Later, you'll build a legal playbook that standardizes how the team evaluates regulatory readiness for new deployments. Throughout the day, you're helping build the legal foundation for a network still taking shape.

About the team
Amazon Leo's legal team operates at the forefront of innovation, supporting one of Amazon's most ambitious global expansion initiatives. We're a collaborative group that values creative problem-solving and business partnership over simply identifying obstacles. Our team culture emphasizes proactive engagement, cross-functional collaboration, and finding pragmatic solutions to complex legal challenges. You'll work alongside talented colleagues who are passionate about enabling Leo's mission while maintaining the highest legal and ethical standards. We believe great legal counsel empowers businesses to scale efficiently and responsibly across borders.

Basic qualifications

- 5+ years of legal experience
- Juris Doctor and membership in one state bar or equivalent
- Experience in private practice or in house experience at a technology company or equivalent

Preferred qualifications

- Experience of a mix of corporate law firm and in-house work
- Experience engaging and influencing senior executives
- Experience solving problems with technology in the Telecommunications industry
- Experience with telecommunications regulatory matters, ISP obligations, or network management legal frameworks
- Background in technology or product-focused legal support

title: Transportation Specialist, Central Operations
descriptionHtml:
External job description

NOC (Network Operations Center) is the central command and control center for ‘Transportation Execution’ across the Amazon Supply Chain network supporting multiple geographies like NA, India and EU. It ensures hassle free, timely pick-up and delivery of freight from vendors to Amazon fulfillment centers (FC) and from Amazon FCs to carrier hubs. In case of any exceptions, NOC steps in to resolve the issue and keeps all the stakeholders informed on the proceedings. Along with this tactical problem solving NOC is also charged with understanding trends in network exceptions and then automating processes or proposing process changes to streamline operations. This second aspect involves network monitoring and significant analysis of network data. Overall, NOC plays a critical role in ensuring the smooth functioning of Amazon transportation and thereby has a direct impact on Amazon’s ability to serve its customers on time.
This role is based in Central Operations, which is a part of NOC. This team acts as a single point of contact for managing the route plans, scheduling and Capacity management for the last mile stations of LATAM region.

Purview of a Transportation Specialist
In this role, the candidate will work with business and operations team to solve customer escalations, analyze historic results, initiate programs – all in an environment of rapid growth and increasing complexity. Candidate will drive improvements to the visibility tools, methods, and processes utilized by the team to increase the availability and granularity of actionable data to internal and external partners. The successful candidate must show significant ownership on customer issues and proactively initiate SOPs and process changes as required. He/she will be passionate about their work, detail-oriented, and have excellent problem-solving abilities. He/she will have superb communication and customer-relationship skills, analytic insight, and be a passionate advocate of customer to other stakeholders. He/she will drive towards simple, scalable solutions to difficult problems, and have excellent project-management skills Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:
Communication with internal customers (CS, MM, LM, FC, Trans Program, HR).
Exceptional written and verbal communication skills with the ability to create compelling positioning / messaging strategy and present complex information clearly and concisely.
High attention to detail and proven ability to manage multiple, competing priorities simultaneously with minimal supervision.
Strong analytical, mediation and problem resolution skills.
Demonstrated leadership with a bias towards action, supporting a culture of ownership and learning.
Skilled in collaborative management environment, clear formal and informal communication with members of the remote and local management teams.
Strong understanding of process improvement technique

Key job responsibilities

Review and update SOPs as required. At times assist with execution duties, training associates and verifying SOP compliance.

Handle incoming work requests within standard service level agreements (SLAs).

Provide direction utilizing independent judgment.

Conduct regular audits with associates for engagement and standard work adherence.

Assist in shift execution with shift managers.

Work a flexible schedule as business demands, including overnight, weekends and holidays.

- Bachelor's degree in a quantitative/technical field such as computer science, engineering, statistics
- Experience with Excel
- Intermediate English

Preferred qualifications

- Experience with SQL

Our consultants will deliver Pilot projects, topical workshops, and lead implementation projects.

Professional Services engage in a wide variety of projects for customers, providing collective experience from across the AWS customer base and are obsessed about strong success for the Customer. Our team collaborates across the entire AWS organization to bring access to product and service teams, to get the right solution delivered and drive feature innovation based upon customer needs.

모집분야
Amazon Web Services (AWS)에서는 고객이 전문지식 역량을 개발할 수 있도록 돕고, 이를 위해 파트너와 협력할 수 있는 뛰어난 기술역량을 갖춘 클라우드 아키텍트를 채용하고 있습니다. AWS의 컨설턴트들은 아키텍쳐 검토와 파일럿 개발, 주제별 워크샵, 그리고 프로젝트를 통한 딜리버리를 담당하게 됩니다.

Key job responsibilities
We are looking for hands-on cloud architects who will work with other Professional Services consultants in a project to:
- Dive deep into inventory and application data of the customer’s on-premise services to assess the portfolio and develop decision criteria to create initial migration wave plans.
- Analyze the customer’s existing infrastructure design including network, storage, computing resources, along with the operational processes / policies to design a secure, robust, and highly tolerant multi-account AWS environment based on AWS best practices.
- Develop required operating and governance models, and help customers to migrate applications to AWS.
- Help customers and partners to be prepared for cloud operations, and identify the areas for automation to accelerate the migration and transformation of the organization.
- Establish the future operating model for cloud and plan, guide and support an efficient progression of the operational model during the migration.

title: Product Manager, Account Management Tools, Third-Party (3P) Seller Services
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Australia helps Australian businesses of every size reach millions of customers and grow their business. The AU 3P Seller Services team recruits local businesses to sell in the Amazon.com.au store and supports their success and growth. Much of that growth is delivered through Account Managers (AMs), who manage seller portfolios, solve problems for sellers and help them adopt the programs that grow their business. Our vision is for every AM to spend their time on the work that moves sellers forward, backed by tools that do the rest.

The AM Tools Product team builds and launches the products AMs use every day: seller insights, portfolio prioritisation, escalation tracking, reporting and AI assistants. We work with Amazon's global seller services, tech and AI teams to bring the right capabilities to Australian AMs, and we build our own where local needs call for it. As AI becomes central to how AMs work, we are building AI-powered tools that automate routine work, surface the next best action for each seller, and let one AM support more sellers with more impact.

We are looking for a Product Manager to own AM tools end to end, from discovery through launch, adoption and measured impact. The ideal candidate knows how AMs actually spend their day, spots where time is lost, studies working models to find patterns, and designs tools that remove that friction. They earn trust with AMs and their leaders, drive adoption through training, enablement and change management, and are accountable for whether a tool changes how the team works and what sellers achieve. They work across engineering, data science, BI, UX, and AM and operations leadership in a fast-paced, cross-functional environment.

You will own a product area end to end and see its impact directly in how AMs work and how sellers grow. You will build hands-on experience with GenAI and agentic products, from model evaluation to responsible AI practices, alongside data scientists and ML engineers. You will work with senior leaders in AU 3P and with global seller services and AI teams, which builds your influence and network across Amazon. Amazon also supports your development through product management training, mentoring from senior PMs, and room to take on a larger scope as the AM tools portfolio grows.

Key job responsibilities
- Define and own the AM tools strategy and roadmap across seller segments and the AM workflow, prioritising the investments that return the most AM time and seller growth.
- Build and launch AI-powered tools with partner teams, including GenAI assistants, automated seller insights and agentic workflows. Write clear requirements that balance technical feasibility, user needs, business impact and responsible AI standards.
- Drive adoption and change management after launch: run pilots and staged rollouts, design training and champion programs, retire redundant tools, and align AM leadership on new ways of working.
- Measure the impact of every tool through adoption, AM time saved, seller coverage and seller success, and report results through regular business reviews.
- Partner with global AM tooling, seller services and AI teams to reuse existing solutions, shape their roadmaps for Australian needs, and manage leadership communication on solution reviews and impact.

A day in the life
About a third of your time goes to collaboration: shadowing AMs, running discovery sessions, and working through requirements and trade-offs with partner teams. Around a quarter is deep focus, where you write PRFAQs and requirements, analyse adoption and productivity data, and plan launches. Another quarter goes to meetings with AM leaders and global partner teams: roadmap reviews, launch readiness and business reviews. You spend the rest in the field with users, running pilots, training sessions and feedback loops, and checking that each tool works in the AM's real day.

About the team
Our team is part of Amazon's AU 3P Seller Services organization. We build and maintain the tools that hundreds of Account Managers rely on every day to support thousands of Australian 3P sellers. We partner closely with Amazon's global seller services, AI, and engineering teams, as well as local operations and AM leadership. Our focus is on making AMs more effective through better tooling and AI-powered automation, so that every Australian seller gets the hands-on support they need to grow their business on Amazon.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree or equivalent, or 3+ years of sales or marketing work (like e-commerce, retail technology, SaaS) or equivalent experience
- Experience overseeing roadmap strategy and definition
- Experience with end to end product delivery
- Experience owning feature delivery and tradeoffs of a product

Preferred qualifications

- Experience influencing at all levels within an organization, particularly at the executive level
- Experience with AI/ML technologies

title: Quality Manager, Flex Investigations and Offboarding
descriptionHtml:
